Deduplicate entries and constrain batch request sizes in production. | Code example NSArray inputUserIDs = @ @"user a", @"user b", @"user a" ; NSArray userIDs = NSOrderedSet orderedSetWithArray:inputUserIDs .array; OIMManager manager getUsersInfo:userIDs onSuccess:^ NSArray users for OIMPublicUserInfo user in users publicUsersByID user.userID = user; onFailure:^ NSInteger code, NSString message NSLog @"getUsersInfo failed: %ld %@", long code, message ; ; Return value The onSuccess callback delivers an array of OIMPublicUserInfo objects corresponding to the queried IDs: | Property | Type | Description | | | | | | userID | NSString | The unique OpenIM user identifier. | | nickname | NSString | Account level public nickname. | | faceURL | NSString | Account level public avatar URL. | | ex | NSString | Account level custom extension field formatted according to business specifications. | The ex field is read only in this context. Client devices cannot directly mutate other users' public profiles. To update the current authenticated user's profile and extension properties, refer to Update your profile /sdk/ios/user/retrieving and updating user information/update self profile . Cache management and data refreshing This method returns an instantaneous snapshot of public user metadata at the time of invocation and does not trigger real time profile change events. Re fetch profiles by userID when displaying user detail views, pulling to refresh, reconnecting after network drops, or upon receiving push notifications from your application backend. When rendering lists containing multiple users, collect visible IDs, deduplicate them, execute batch queries, and merge results by userID . The SDK does not emit generic profile change delegates for arbitrary remote users. The onSelfInfoUpdated: callback exclusively delivers profile updates for the currently logged in account and must not be written into public user caches for other accounts. Search and add friends When searching for new contacts, retrieve candidate IDs from your backend service before looking up their OpenIM public profiles: userDirectory searchUserIDs:keyword completion:^ NSArray candidateIDs if candidateIDs.count == 0 searchStore replaceResults:@ ; return; OIMManager manager getUsersInfo:candidateIDs onSuccess:^ NSArray users searchStore replaceResults:users ; onFailure:^ NSInteger code, NSString message NSLog @"getUsersInfo failed: %ld %@", long code, message ; ; ; When your system supports exact user ID search, pass the input directly as userID . For fuzzy search, prefix matching, or searching by custom business attributes, obtain candidate IDs from your backend directory service. Select models by scenario | Scenario | Preferred model | | | | | Application user search, stranger profile cards | OIMPublicUserInfo | | Friend lists, address books, friend remarks | OIMFriendInfo | | Group member rosters, in group aliases, member role levels | OIMGroupMemberInfo | The same userID can have different display titles and relationship data across contexts. Never overwrite a custom friend remark or group member nickname with an account's public nickname. Next steps Retrieve the friend list by page /sdk/ios/user/friends/get friend list page Retrieve specified friends /sdk/ios/user/friends/get specified friends info Retrieve received friend requests /sdk/ios/user/friend applications/get friend application list as recipient Retrieve group members /sdk/ios/group/retrieving group members/overview retrieving group members

title: Retrieve your profile
description: Retrieve the signed-in user’s profile with OpenIM iOS SDK.
keywords: sdk ios v4 sdk ios user retrieving-and-updating-user-information get-self-profile
content: Retrieve the full profile snapshot for the currently signed in user using getSelfInfoWithOnSuccess:onFailure: . This method requires no arguments. Code example OIMManager manager getSelfInfoWithOnSuccess:^ OIMUserInfo user profileStore replaceCurrentUser:user ; onFailure:^ NSInteger code, NSString message NSLog @"getSelfInfo failed: %ld %@", long code, message ; ; Return value The onSuccess callback delivers an OIMUserInfo object containing the authenticated user's current settings: | Property | Type | Description | | | | | | userID | NSString | The authenticated user's unique identifier. | | nickname | NSString | User's profile display name. | | faceURL | NSString | User's profile avatar URL. | | ex | NSString | Custom application extension metadata string. | | globalRecvMsgOpt | OIMReceiveMessageOpt | Account level global message reception policy. | This query retrieves an instantaneous snapshot and does not emit delegate updates. To update these attributes, refer to Update your profile /sdk/ios/user/retrieving and updating user information/update self profile .

title: Update your profile
description: Update the signed-in user’s profile with OpenIM iOS SDK.
keywords: sdk ios v4 sdk ios user retrieving-and-updating-user-information update-self-profile
content: Update the signed in user's profile attributes using setSelfInfo:onSuccess:onFailure: . First retrieve the existing user snapshot with Retrieve your profile /sdk/ios/user/retrieving and updating user information/get self profile and mutate only the intended fields e.g., nickname , faceURL , or ex . Avoid passing an uninitialized model object, as default unassigned fields may overwrite existing profile data on the server. Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | userInfo | OIMUserInfo | Yes | User information object containing the modified profile fields. | Code example current.nickname = nickname; current.faceURL = avatarURL; OIMManager manager setSelfInfo:current onSuccess:^ NSString data profileStore refreshCurrentUserInfo:current ; onFailure:^ NSInteger code, NSString message NSLog @"setSelfInfo failed: %ld %@", long code, message ; ; The ex attribute is replaced as an entire string. Parse existing JSON metadata, update your business properties, and re serialize the string before assigning it. Return value The onSuccess callback signifies that OpenIMServer processed the profile update. The local client can immediately refresh its visible view state. Multi terminal sync and cross device propagation are received asynchronously through the user delegate. State changes after the call Local state merge : Merge profile attributes using the authenticated user's userID as the unique entity key. Asynchronous event listening : Multi terminal devices and local caches observe updates via onSelfInfoUpdated: in OIMUserListener . Re query calibration : If delegate delivery fails or local cache becomes desynchronized, invoke getSelfInfoWithOnSuccess:onFailure: to restore an authoritative profile snapshot. @interface ProfileStore @end @implementation ProfileStore void startListening OIMManager callbacker addUserListener:self ; void stopListening OIMManager callbacker removeUserListener:self ; void onSelfInfoUpdated: OIMUserInfo info self updateLocalCurrentUser:info ; @end Retain this listener instance strongly, and invoke removeUserListener: with the same reference when logging out or switching user accounts.

title: Set global message reception
description: Configure the signed-in account’s default message-reception and notification behavior with OpenIM iOS SDK.
keywords: sdk ios v4 sdk ios user retrieving-and-updating-user-information set-global-message-reception
content: Configure the account wide default message reception policy and offline push notification behavior using setGlobalRecvMessageOpt:onSuccess:onFailure: . Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | opt | OIMReceiveMessageOpt | Yes | Global message reception enum option. | Message reception options | Enum | Value | Description | | | | | | OIMReceiveMessageOptReceive | 0 | Receive messages normally and trigger offline push notifications. | | OIMReceiveMessageOptNotReceive | 1 | Block message reception entirely; suppress offline push notifications. | | OIMReceiveMessageOptNotNotify | 2 | Receive and sync messages silently; suppress offline push notifications Do Not Disturb . | If your application provides a single "Do Not Disturb" toggle, switch between Receive and NotNotify . Present NotReceive with caution, as it completely stops new message delivery to the client. Code example OIMManager manager setGlobalRecvMessageOpt:OIMReceiveMessageOptNotNotify onSuccess:^ NSString data profileStore refreshGlobalRecvOpt:OIMReceiveMessageOptNotNotify ; onFailure:^ NSInteger code, NSString message NSLog @"setGlobalRecvMessageOpt failed: %ld %@", long code, message ; ; Return value The onSuccess callback signifies that OpenIMServer updated the global reception preference. State changes after the call Local state merge : Merge setting state using the authenticated user's userID as the unique entity key. Verification and calibration : When authoritative confirmation is needed, invoke Retrieve your profile /sdk/ios/user/retrieving and updating user information/get self profile to re query the current user's profile and inspect the updated globalRecvMsgOpt property.

title: Subscribe to user status
description: Subscribe to the online status of visible users with OpenIM iOS SDK.
keywords: sdk ios v4 sdk ios user retrieving-and-updating-user-information subscribe-user-status
content: Subscribe to target users' online presence and multi device connection statuses using subscribeUsersStatus:onSuccess:onFailure: . Once subscribed, the client receives real time updates when those users log in, disconnect, or change active platforms. Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | userIDs | NSArray | Yes | List of user IDs to subscribe to. Filter empty strings and duplicate entries, and subscribe exclusively to users currently visible on screen. | Code example OIMManager manager subscribeUsersStatus:userIDs onSuccess:^ NSArray states presenceStore mergeStates:states ; onFailure:^ NSInteger code, NSString message NSLog @"subscribeUsersStatus failed: %ld %@", long code, message ; ; When users scroll out of view or when leaving the screen, invoke Unsubscribe from user status /sdk/ios/user/retrieving and updating user information/unsubscribe user status to release subscription quotas. Return value The onSuccess callback delivers an array of OIMUserStatusInfo objects capturing the initial presence state and active client platforms for all successfully subscribed users. State changes after the call Local state merge : Merge presence records into local UI collections using userID as the unique entity key. Asynchronous event listening : Receive ongoing presence updates via the onUserStatusChanged: delegate in OIMUserListener . Re query calibration : To refresh snapshots of active subscriptions, invoke Refresh subscribed user status /sdk/ios/user/retrieving and updating user information/get subscribed user status . @interface PresenceStore @end @implementation PresenceStore void startListening OIMManager callbacker addUserListener:self ; void stopListening OIMManager callbacker removeUserListener:self ; void onUserStatusChanged: OIMUserStatusInfo status self updateUserStatus:status ; @end Retain this listener instance strongly, and invoke removeUserListener: when logging out or switching user accounts.

title: Retrieve subscribed user status
description: Retrieve an online-status snapshot for subscribed users with OpenIM iOS SDK.
keywords: sdk ios v4 sdk ios user retrieving-and-updating-user-information get-subscribed-user-status
content: Query the current real time presence snapshot for all active subscribed users using getSubscribeUsersStatusWithOnSuccess:onFailure: . This method accepts no parameters and leaves the active subscription roster unchanged. Code example OIMManager manager getSubscribeUsersStatusWithOnSuccess:^ NSArray states presenceStore mergeStates:states ; onFailure:^ NSInteger code, NSString message NSLog @"getSubscribeUsersStatus failed: %ld %@", long code, message ; ; Use this method to reconcile presence records upon network reconnection or view foregrounding. Return value The onSuccess callback delivers an array of OIMUserStatusInfo objects capturing the latest online status and platform lists for all actively subscribed users. State changes after the call Local state merge : Merge presence records into local state collections using userID as the unique entity key. Asynchronous event tracking : This query returns a point in time snapshot and does not emit delegate callbacks. Ongoing incremental status changes continue to arrive via onUserStatusChanged: in OIMUserListener see Subscribe to user status /sdk/ios/user/retrieving and updating user information/subscribe user status .

title: Unsubscribe from user status
description: Stop subscribing to users’ online status with OpenIM iOS SDK.
keywords: sdk ios v4 sdk ios user retrieving-and-updating-user-information unsubscribe-user-status
content: Cancel active presence subscriptions for specific users using unsubscribeUsersStatus:onSuccess:onFailure: . Invoke this method when target users scroll out of the visible screen area, when navigating away from contact views, or during account teardown. Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | userIDs | NSArray | Yes | List of user IDs to unsubscribe from. | Code example OIMManager manager unsubscribeUsersStatus:userIDs onSuccess:^ NSString data presenceStore removeUserIDs:userIDs ; onFailure:^ NSInteger code, NSString message NSLog @"unsubscribeUsersStatus failed: %ld %@", long code, message ; ; Unsubscribing from specific user IDs releases server quotas; it is distinct from removing the global OIMUserListener delegate. Return value The onSuccess callback signifies that OpenIMServer removed the specified users from the client's presence push roster. The server will cease pushing status notifications for these accounts to this client. State changes after the call Local state merge : Remove the unsubscribed users from local active presence caches using userID as the unique entity key. Subsequent subscriptions : To resume monitoring these users, invoke Subscribe to user status /sdk/ios/user/retrieving and updating user information/subscribe user status .

title: Retrieve the friend list by page
description: Retrieve the current iOS user’s friend list with pagination.
keywords: sdk ios v4 sdk ios user friends get-friend-list-page
content: Retrieve the authenticated user's friend list with pagination using getFriendListPageWithOffset:count:filterBlack:onSuccess:onFailure: . Paginating friend queries prevents memory spikes and UI hitches in large contact directories. Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | offset | NSInteger | Yes | Pagination starting offset index. Pass 0 for the initial page. | | count | NSInteger | Yes | Number of friend items to fetch per page. | | filterBlack | BOOL | Yes | Whether to filter out users currently present on the user's blacklist. Pass YES to omit blacklisted friends. | Code example OIMManager manager getFriendListPageWithOffset:0 count:50 filterBlack:YES onSuccess:^ NSArray friends friendStore replaceFirstPage:friends ; onFailure:^ NSInteger code, NSString message NSLog @"getFriendListPage failed: %ld %@", long code, message ; ; When fetching subsequent pages, increment offset by the count of items already loaded and deduplicate contact records by userID . Return value The onSuccess callback returns an NSArray containing friend items for the requested page. When the returned array is empty or contains fewer than count items, all friends have been retrieved. State changes after the call Snapshot creation : The paginated query creates an initial data snapshot and does not emit friendship delegate callbacks. Asynchronous event listening : Register OIMFriendshipListener to merge incremental friend additions, remark updates, and friend removals in real time. @interface FriendshipStore @end @implementation FriendshipStore void startListening OIMManager callbacker addFriendListener:self ; void stopListening OIMManager callbacker removeFriendListener:self ; void onFriendAdded: OIMFriendInfo info friendStore mergeFriend:info ; void onFriendInfoChanged: OIMFriendInfo info friendStore mergeFriend:info ; void onFriendDeleted: OIMFriendInfo info friendStore removeUserID:info.userID ; @end Retain this listener instance strongly, and invoke removeFriendListener: when signing out or releasing the contacts view model.

title: Search friends
description: Search the current user’s friends with OpenIM iOS SDK.
keywords: sdk ios v4 sdk ios user friends search-friends
content: Search local friend records matching specified keywords using searchFriends:onSuccess:onFailure: . Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | param | OIMSearchFriendsParam | Yes | Search parameter object specifying keywords and matching scopes. If keywords are empty, clear search UI results immediately. | Search parameter attributes OIMSearchFriendsParam | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | keywordList | NSArray | Yes | List of search keyword strings. | | isSearchUserID | BOOL | No | Whether to match keywords against user IDs. | | isSearchNickname | BOOL | No | Whether to match keywords against friend nicknames. | | isSearchRemark | BOOL | No | Whether to match keywords against friend remarks. | Code example OIMSearchFriendsParam param = OIMSearchFriendsParam new ; param.keywordList = @ keyword ; param.isSearchUserID = YES; param.isSearchNickname = YES; param.isSearchRemark = YES; OIMManager manager searchFriends:param onSuccess:^ NSArray items searchStore replaceResults:items ; onFailure:^ NSInteger code, NSString message NSLog @"searchFriends failed: %ld %@", long code, message ; ; Return value The onSuccess callback delivers an array of OIMSearchFriendsInfo matching the search criteria. State changes after the call Local state merge : Search results form an isolated, ephemeral result set; do not overwrite the primary contact directory cache. Snapshot query : Friend searches capture a local database snapshot and do not emit friendship delegate events.

title: Retrieve specified friend profiles
description: Retrieve relationship profiles for specified friends with OpenIM iOS SDK.
keywords: sdk ios v4 sdk ios user friends get-specified-friends-info
content: Batch query detailed relationship profiles for specified friends by user ID using getSpecifiedFriendsInfo:filterBlack:onSuccess:onFailure: . Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | userIDs | NSArray | Yes | List of user IDs to query. | | filterBlack | BOOL | Yes | Whether to filter out users currently present on the user's blacklist. Pass YES to exclude blacklisted friends. | Code example OIMManager manager getSpecifiedFriendsInfo:@ @"user a", @"user b" filterBlack:YES onSuccess:^ NSArray friends friendStore mergeFriends:friends ; onFailure:^ NSInteger code, NSString message NSLog @"getSpecifiedFriendsInfo failed: %ld %@", long code, message ; ; Return value The onSuccess callback delivers an array of OIMFriendInfo objects matching the queried IDs. If the returned array is empty, none of the requested users are friends with the current account, or all matching entries were excluded by the blacklist filter. State changes after the call Local state merge : Merge retrieved friend records into contact caches using userID as the unique entity key. Snapshot query : This query establishes an instantaneous point in time snapshot and does not emit friendship delegate events. Lightweight verification : To verify friend relationship status without fetching full relationship details, invoke Check friendship status /sdk/ios/user/friends/check friend .

title: Check friendship status
description: Check the friendship status of specified users with OpenIM iOS SDK.
keywords: sdk ios v4 sdk ios user friends check-friend
content: Batch verify friendship relationship statuses for target user IDs using checkFriend:onSuccess:onFailure: . Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | userIDs | NSArray | Yes | List of user IDs to check. | Code example OIMManager manager checkFriend:@ @"user a", @"user b" onSuccess:^ NSArray results relationshipStore mergeResults:results ; onFailure:^ NSInteger code, NSString message NSLog @"checkFriend failed: %ld %@", long code, message ; ; Return value The onSuccess callback delivers an array of OIMSimpleResultInfo objects. Each entry contains a userID and an integer result . A result of 1 indicates that the target user and the current account are mutual friends and neither has blacklisted the other. State changes after the call Local state merge : Merge verification results into relationship caches using userID as the unique entity key. Snapshot query : This call returns an instantaneous relationship snapshot and does not emit friendship delegate events. Full relationship profiles : To retrieve detailed profile properties like friend remarks or avatars, invoke Retrieve specified friends /sdk/ios/user/friends/get specified friends info .

title: Update friend information
description: Update iOS friend remarks, pinned status, or extension fields.
keywords: sdk ios v4 sdk ios user friends update-friends
content: Update friend remarks, pinned statuses, or custom relationship extension attributes using updateFriends:onSuccess:onFailure: . Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | req | OIMUpdateFriendsReq | Yes | Request object containing target friend user IDs and attributes to update. | Request attributes OIMUpdateFriendsReq | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | friendUserIDs | NSArray | Yes | List of friend user IDs. Modifications apply uniformly to every listed friend. | | remark | NSString | No | Custom alias or remark name for the friend. | | isPinned | BOOL | No | Whether to pin the friend in contact lists. | | ex | NSString | No | Custom extension string, replacing the existing field entirely. | Code example OIMUpdateFriendsReq req = OIMUpdateFriendsReq new ; req.friendUserIDs = @ @"user b" ; req.remark = @"Alex"; req.isPinned = YES; OIMManager manager updateFriends:req onSuccess:^ NSString data friendStore updateRemark:req.remark forUserID:@"user b" ; onFailure:^ NSInteger code, NSString message NSLog @"updateFriends failed: %ld %@", long code, message ; ; The ex attribute replaces the previous string in its entirety. Preserve existing application JSON key value pairs before writing. Return value The onSuccess callback signifies that OpenIMServer processed the update request. State changes after the call Local state merge : Merge updated friend attributes using userID as the unique entity key. Asynchronous event listening : Multi device clients and local listeners observe updates via onFriendInfoChanged: in OIMFriendshipListener see Retrieve the friend list by page /sdk/ios/user/friends/get friend list page . Re query calibration : To reconcile contact data snapshots, invoke Retrieve specified friends /sdk/ios/user/friends/get specified friends info .

title: Delete a friend
description: Delete an iOS friend relationship.
keywords: sdk ios v4 sdk ios user friends delete-friend
content: Remove a friendship relationship between the authenticated user and a target contact using deleteFriend:onSuccess:onFailure: . Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | friendUserID | NSString | Yes | Target friend user ID to delete. | Code example OIMManager manager deleteFriend:@"user b" onSuccess:^ NSString data friendStore removeUserID:@"user b" ; onFailure:^ NSInteger code, NSString message NSLog @"deleteFriend failed: %ld %@", long code, message ; ; Return value The onSuccess callback confirms that OpenIMServer processed the friend removal request. State changes after the call Local state merge : Remove the deleted contact from local friend lists using userID as the unique entity key. Asynchronous event listening : Linked client devices and the former friend receive deletion notifications via onFriendDeleted: in OIMFriendshipListener see Retrieve the friend list by page /sdk/ios/user/friends/get friend list page . Verification : To verify current friendship status, invoke Check friendship status /sdk/ios/user/friends/check friend .

title: Send a friend request
description: Send a friend request with OpenIM iOS SDK.
keywords: sdk ios v4 sdk ios user friend-applications add-friend
content: Dispatch a friend request to a target user using addFriend:reqMessage:onSuccess:onFailure: . Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | userID | NSString | Yes | Target recipient user ID. | | reqMessage | NSString | No | Optional verification note or message. Pass an empty string @"" when omitted. | Code example OIMManager manager addFriend:@"user b" reqMessage:@"Hi, I'm Alex" onSuccess:^ NSString data applicationStore markSentToUserID:@"user b" ; onFailure:^ NSInteger code, NSString message NSLog @"addFriend failed: %ld %@", long code, message ; ; Return value The onSuccess callback confirms only that OpenIMServer accepted and routed the application; it does not indicate that the recipient accepted or that a friend relationship has formed. State changes after the call Local state merge : Record the pending outgoing request using userID as the unique entity key. Outgoing history : To inspect all dispatched requests, invoke Retrieve sent friend requests /sdk/ios/user/friend applications/get friend application list as applicant . Asynchronous event listening : When the recipient accepts or rejects the request, the sender receives notification callbacks through OIMFriendshipListener see Retrieve received friend requests /sdk/ios/user/friend applications/get friend application list as recipient .

title: Retrieve received friend requests
description: Retrieve friend requests received by the current iOS user with pagination.
keywords: sdk ios v4 sdk ios user friend-applications get-friend-application-list-as-recipient
content: Retrieve friend requests received by the current user with pagination using getFriendApplicationListAsRecipientWithReq:onSuccess:onFailure: . Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | req | GetFriendApplicationListAsRecipientReq | Yes | Request object configuring status filters and pagination limits. | Request attributes GetFriendApplicationListAsRecipientReq | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | handleResults | NSArray | No | Status filter list. Pass @ @ OIMApplicationStatusNormal to query pending, unhandled applications. | | offset | NSInteger | Yes | Pagination starting offset. Pass 0 for the first page. | | count | NSInteger | Yes | Number of request items to fetch per page. | Code example GetFriendApplicationListAsRecipientReq req = GetFriendApplicationListAsRecipientReq new ; req.handleResults = @ @ OIMApplicationStatusNormal ; req.offset = 0; req.count = 20; OIMManager manager getFriendApplicationListAsRecipientWithReq:req onSuccess:^ NSArray items requestStore replaceReceived:items ; onFailure:^ NSInteger code, NSString message NSLog @"getFriendApplicationListAsRecipient failed: %ld %@", long code, message ; ; Return value The onSuccess callback returns an NSArray containing received application records for the requested page. State changes after the call Local state merge : Merge friend application records using fromUserID:toUserID or fromUserID as the unique entity key. Asynchronous event listening : Observe incoming, accepted, rejected, or deleted friend applications via the OIMFriendshipListener protocol. void onFriendApplicationAdded: OIMFriendApplication item requestStore upsertApplication:item ; void onFriendApplicationAccepted: OIMFriendApplication item requestStore upsertApplication:item ; void onFriendApplicationRejected: OIMFriendApplication item requestStore upsertApplication:item ; void onFriendApplicationDeleted: OIMFriendApplication item requestStore removeFromUserID:item.fromUserID toUserID:item.toUserID ; Implement these callbacks in your primary OIMFriendshipListener instance see Retrieve the friend list by page /sdk/ios/user/friends/get friend list page . Filter records into the incoming or outgoing application list based on whether toUserID matches the current logged in user.

title: Retrieve sent friend requests
description: Retrieve friend requests sent by the current iOS user with pagination.
keywords: sdk ios v4 sdk ios user friend-applications get-friend-application-list-as-applicant
content: Retrieve friend requests sent by the authenticated user with pagination using getFriendApplicationListAsApplicantWithReq:onSuccess:onFailure: . Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | req | GetFriendApplicationListAsApplicantReq | Yes | Request configuration object for sent applications. | Request attributes GetFriendApplicationListAsApplicantReq | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | offset | NSInteger | Yes | Starting offset for pagination. Pass 0 for the first page. | | count | NSInteger | Yes | Number of application records to fetch per page. | Code example GetFriendApplicationListAsApplicantReq req = GetFriendApplicationListAsApplicantReq new ; req.offset = 0; req.count = 20; OIMManager manager getFriendApplicationListAsApplicantWithReq:req onSuccess:^ NSArray items requestStore replaceSent:items ; onFailure:^ NSInteger code, NSString message NSLog @"getFriendApplicationListAsApplicant failed: %ld %@", long code, message ; ; Return value The onSuccess callback returns an NSArray containing the outgoing friend requests for the current page. State changes after the call Local state merge : Merge sent request records using fromUserID:toUserID as the unique composite entity key. Snapshot query : This query establishes an instantaneous point in time snapshot and does not emit delegate callbacks. Asynchronous responses : When target users accept or reject outgoing requests, notifications arrive via OIMFriendshipListener callbacks see Retrieve received friend requests /sdk/ios/user/friend applications/get friend application list as recipient .

title: Retrieve the unhandled friend-request count
description: Retrieve the number of unhandled friend requests on iOS.
keywords: sdk ios v4 sdk ios user friend-applications get-friend-application-unhandled-count
content: Query the count of pending, unhandled friend requests received after a specified timestamp using getFriendApplicationUnhandledCount:onSuccess:onFailure: . Use this count to render badge counts or unread indicator dots on contact tabs. Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | req | GetFriendApplicationUnhandledCountReq | Yes | Request object specifying the cutoff timestamp. | Request attributes GetFriendApplicationUnhandledCountReq | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | time | NSInteger | Yes | Millisecond timestamp. Typically pass the timestamp when the user last viewed the friend requests view. | Code example GetFriendApplicationUnhandledCountReq req = GetFriendApplicationUnhandledCountReq new ; req.time = lastViewedAt; OIMManager manager getFriendApplicationUnhandledCount:req onSuccess:^ NSInteger count requestStore setUnhandledCount:count ; onFailure:^ NSInteger code, NSString message NSLog @"getFriendApplicationUnhandledCount failed: %ld %@", long code, message ; ; Return value The onSuccess callback delivers an integer count representing the total number of unhandled friend requests received after req.time . State changes after the call Local badge updates : Render or update tab badge indicators with the returned count. Snapshot query : This query establishes an instantaneous point in time snapshot and does not emit delegate callbacks. Real time increments : As new incoming friend requests arrive, increment the badge count dynamically via onFriendApplicationAdded: in OIMFriendshipListener see Retrieve received friend requests /sdk/ios/user/friend applications/get friend application list as recipient .

title: Accept a friend request
description: Accept a friend request with OpenIM iOS SDK.
keywords: sdk ios v4 sdk ios user friend-applications accept-friend-application
content: Accept a friend request from an applicant to establish mutual friendship using acceptFriendApplication:handleMsg:onSuccess:onFailure: . Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | userID | NSString | Yes | The applicant user ID who initiated the friend request. | | handleMsg | NSString | No | Optional acceptance note e.g., @"Accepted" . Pass an empty string @"" when omitted. | Code example OIMManager manager acceptFriendApplication:applicantUserID handleMsg:@"Accepted" onSuccess:^ NSString data applicationStore markAcceptedForUserID:applicantUserID ; onFailure:^ NSInteger code, NSString message NSLog @"acceptFriendApplication failed: %ld %@", long code, message ; ; Return value The onSuccess callback signifies that OpenIMServer processed the acceptance and established mutual friendship on the server. State changes after the call Local state merge : Merge application resolution state using userID as the unique entity key. Application updates : The application record updates via onFriendApplicationAccepted: in OIMFriendshipListener see Retrieve received friend requests /sdk/ios/user/friend applications/get friend application list as recipient . Friend addition : The new friendship record arrives via onFriendAdded: in OIMFriendshipListener see Retrieve the friend list by page /sdk/ios/user/friends/get friend list page , where the client merges the new contact by userID .

title: Reject a friend request
description: Reject a friend request with OpenIM iOS SDK.
keywords: sdk ios v4 sdk ios user friend-applications refuse-friend-application
content: Decline an incoming friend application using refuseFriendApplication:handleMsg:onSuccess:onFailure: . Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | userID | NSString | Yes | The applicant user ID whose request is being rejected. | | handleMsg | NSString | No | Optional rejection note. Pass an empty string @"" when omitted. | Code example OIMManager manager refuseFriendApplication:applicantUserID handleMsg:@"Not adding contacts at this time" onSuccess:^ NSString data applicationStore markRejectedForUserID:applicantUserID ; onFailure:^ NSInteger code, NSString message NSLog @"refuseFriendApplication failed: %ld %@", long code, message ; ; Return value The onSuccess callback confirms that OpenIMServer processed the rejection command. State changes after the call Local state merge : Merge rejection status into the application list using userID as the unique entity key. Asynchronous event listening : Linked client devices and the applicant receive rejection notifications via onFriendApplicationRejected: in OIMFriendshipListener see Retrieve received friend requests /sdk/ios/user/friend applications/get friend application list as recipient .

title: Delete friend requests
description: Delete friend-request records with OpenIM iOS SDK.
keywords: sdk ios v4 sdk ios user friend-applications delete-friend-requests
content: Batch delete historical friend application records using deleteFriendRequests:onSuccess:onFailure: . Deleting application history cleans up request logs without mutating or terminating established friend relationships. Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | friendRequests | NSArray | Yes | List of DeleteFriendRequest objects to delete. Each item must supply both fromUserID and toUserID . | Code example DeleteFriendRequest request = DeleteFriendRequest alloc initWithFromUserID:application.fromUserID toUserID:application.toUserID ; OIMManager manager deleteFriendRequests:@ request onSuccess:^ NSString data applicationStore removeApplicationForFromUserID:application.fromUserID toUserID:application.toUserID ; onFailure:^ NSInteger code, NSString message NSLog @"deleteFriendRequests failed: %ld %@", long code, message ; ; Return value The onSuccess callback signifies that OpenIMServer deleted the specified application records. State changes after the call Local state merge : Remove matching application records from local UI collections using fromUserID:toUserID as the composite key. Asynchronous event listening : Multi terminal devices synchronize the deletion via onFriendApplicationDeleted: in OIMFriendshipListener see Retrieve received friend requests /sdk/ios/user/friend applications/get friend application list as recipient . Relationship boundary : This operation only clears pending or archived application logs; it does not alter actual friendship relationships.

title: Retrieve the blocklist
description: Retrieve the current user’s blocklist.
keywords: sdk ios v4 sdk ios user moderating-a-user retrieve-a-list-of-blocked-users
content: The OpenIM iOS SDK blacklist tracks accounts that the currently logged in user has blocked. Invoke getBlackListWithOnSuccess:onFailure: to retrieve the complete collection of blocked users as OIMBlackInfo objects. Use this list to construct blacklist settings views, render block status indicators on user profiles, and restrict messaging actions. Blacklists operate independently of group member mutes or room kicks. To restrict permissions within a group, invoke group member moderation APIs. This query also does not reflect server side platform account suspensions. Code example OIMManager manager getBlackListWithOnSuccess:^ NSArray items blacklistStore replaceItems:items ; onFailure:^ NSInteger code, NSString message NSLog @"getBlackList failed: %ld %@", long code, message ; ; Profile views and chat option sheets typically only require checking whether a given userID exists in the blacklist. Maintain a local lookup set keyed by userID . Return value The onSuccess callback delivers an NSArray containing all blocked accounts: | Property | Type | Description | | | | | | userID | NSString Nullable | The blocked user's ID, serving as the list entity key. | | nickname | NSString Nullable | Blocked user's display nickname. | | faceURL | NSString Nullable | Blocked user's avatar image URL. | | createTime | NSInteger | Timestamp when the user was added to the blacklist. | | addSource | NSInteger | Origin source identifier indicating how the block was initiated. | | operatorUserID | NSString Nullable | User ID of the account that executed the block action. | | attachedInfo | NSString Nullable | Reserved internal metadata string. | | ex | NSString Nullable | Custom application extension string. | When combining blacklist views with friend remarks, merge records by userID while keeping OIMBlackInfo , OIMFriendInfo , and OIMPublicUserInfo models distinct. State changes after the call Local state merge : Replace or merge the blocklist snapshot using userID as the unique entity key. Snapshot query : This query retrieves the current snapshot and does not emit delegate callbacks. Modifications and events : To block or unblock users and monitor real time blacklist events, refer to Block a user /sdk/ios/user/moderating a user/block user and Unblock a user /sdk/ios/user/moderating a user/unblock user .

title: Block a user
description: Add a user to the current account’s blocklist with OpenIM iOS SDK.
keywords: sdk ios v4 sdk ios user moderating-a-user block-user
content: Add a specified user to the authenticated account's blacklist using addToBlackList:ex:onSuccess:onFailure: . Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | userID | NSString | Yes | Target user ID to blacklist. | | ex | NSString | No | Custom extension string e.g., JSON payload documenting reason or origin . Pass an empty string @"" when omitted. | Code example OIMManager manager addToBlackList:targetUserID ex:@" \"source\":\"profile menu\" " onSuccess:^ NSString data blacklistStore addUserID:targetUserID ; onFailure:^ NSInteger code, NSString message NSLog @"addToBlackList failed: %ld %@", long code, message ; ; Blacklisting is a unilateral relationship established by the local user. It suppresses incoming messages and direct interactions from the blocked user; it is distinct from channel level mutes or system wide account bans. Return value The onSuccess callback signifies that OpenIMServer recorded the blacklist relationship. State changes after the call Local state merge : Insert or merge the newly blocked user into blacklist collections using userID as the unique entity key. Asynchronous event listening : Linked devices observe blacklist changes in real time via onBlackAdded: in OIMFriendshipListener . Re query calibration : To retrieve a full snapshot of all blocked accounts, invoke Retrieve the blocklist /sdk/ios/user/moderating a user/retrieve a list of blocked users . @interface BlacklistStore @end @implementation BlacklistStore void startListening OIMManager callbacker addFriendListener:self ; void stopListening OIMManager callbacker removeFriendListener:self ; void onBlackAdded: OIMBlackInfo info self upsertBlackInfo:info ; @end Retain this listener instance strongly, and invoke removeFriendListener: when signing out or switching accounts.

title: Unblock a user
description: Remove a user from the current account’s blocklist with OpenIM iOS SDK.
keywords: sdk ios v4 sdk ios user moderating-a-user unblock-user
content: Remove a user from the current account's blacklist using removeFromBlackList:onSuccess:onFailure: , restoring standard interaction and message delivery. Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | userID | NSString | Yes | Target user ID to unblock. | Code example OIMManager manager removeFromBlackList:targetUserID onSuccess:^ NSString data blacklistStore removeUserID:targetUserID ; onFailure:^ NSInteger code, NSString message NSLog @"removeFromBlackList failed: %ld %@", long code, message ; ; Return value The onSuccess callback signifies that OpenIMServer processed the unblock request and removed the user from the blacklist. State changes after the call Local state merge : Remove the unblocked user from blacklist caches using userID as the unique entity key. Asynchronous event listening : Multi device sessions synchronize the removal via onBlackDeleted: in OIMFriendshipListener . Re query calibration : To restore a complete snapshot of remaining blocked users, invoke Retrieve the blocklist /sdk/ios/user/moderating a user/retrieve a list of blocked users . @interface BlacklistStore @end @implementation BlacklistStore void startListening OIMManager callbacker addFriendListener:self ; void stopListening OIMManager callbacker removeFriendListener:self ; void onBlackDeleted: OIMBlackInfo info self removeBlackInfoForUserID:info.userID ; @end Retain this listener instance strongly, and invoke removeFriendListener: when signing out or releasing the contacts model.

title: Conversations overview
description: Understand the responsibilities of OIMConversationInfo, conversationID, conversation settings, and conversation events in OpenIM iOS SDK.
keywords: sdk ios v4 sdk ios conversation overview-conversation
content: In the OpenIM architecture, a conversation encapsulates the local client state maintained for a direct 1 on 1 chat or group session, represented by an OIMConversationInfo object. It tracks list presentation states including unread counts, latest messages, pinned statuses, drafts, message reception preferences, and custom extension strings. Conversation records are identified separately from their underlying chat targets: conversationID identifies the authenticated user's personal conversation session, whereas direct chat targets use the recipient's userID and group chat targets use groupID . Both direct and group chats maintain chat list states via conversation records. Group metadata, member lists, and role permissions remain managed under the Group API domain. Group chat views consume groupID for group member capabilities, while utilizing conversationID for conversation settings, unread counts, drafts, and message history. Conversation identifiers Direct 1 on 1 conversations use the peer user ID as sourceID with conversation type OIMConversationTypeC2C . Group conversations use groupID as sourceID with conversation type OIMConversationTypeGroup . Invoke Generate a conversation ID /sdk/ios/conversation/retrieving conversations/get conversation id to obtain a deterministic conversationID for conversation settings, read marks, hiding, and message clearance. | Identifier | Purpose | | | | | conversationID | Personal conversation record ID for the signed in account; routes settings, message history, and unread states. | | userID | Target peer user ID for direct 1 on 1 conversations. | | groupID | Target group ID for group chats, serving as the entity key for Group APIs. | | sourceID | Target entity ID used in type based queries: userID for 1 on 1 chats, or groupID for group chats. | OIMConversationInfo properties | Property | Description | | | | | conversationID | Unique conversation identifier. | | conversationType | OIMConversationType enum indicating conversation category. | | userID / groupID | Target peer user ID or group ID for the conversation. | | showName / faceURL | Resolved display name and avatar URL for UI rendering. | | unreadCount | Unread message count for this conversation. | | latestMsg / latestMsgSendTime | Last message content preview and its send timestamp in milliseconds. | | recvMsgOpt | OIMReceiveMessageOpt message reception and notification setting. | | groupAtType | OIMGroupAtType mention state e.g., at all, at me . | | draftText / draftTextTime | Draft message text and last update timestamp. | | isPinned | Whether the conversation is pinned to the top of the chat list. | | isPrivateChat / burnDuration Enterprise | Burn after reading private chat toggle and countdown duration in seconds. | | isMsgDestruct / msgDestructTime Enterprise | Scheduled server message deletion toggle and destruction cycle. | | isNotInGroup | Whether the current user has left or been removed from the group. | | attachedInfo | Reserved SDK metadata string. | | ex | Custom application defined extension string. | Feature navigation Retrieve a conversation by chat target /sdk/ios/conversation/retrieving conversations/get conversation by target Retrieve conversations by ID /sdk/ios/conversation/retrieving conversations/get conversations by id Retrieve the conversation list /sdk/ios/conversation/retrieving conversations/retrieve conversation list Pin or unpin a conversation /sdk/ios/conversation/managing conversations/pin conversation Set message reception for a conversation /sdk/ios/conversation/managing conversations/set message receive option Enable or disable burn after reading /sdk/ios/conversation/managing conversations/set private chat Set the burn after reading duration /sdk/ios/conversation/managing conversations/set burn duration Periodically delete server side messages /sdk/ios/conversation/managing conversations/set message destruct Set the server message deletion cycle /sdk/ios/conversation/managing conversations/set message destruct time Reset group mention state /sdk/ios/conversation/managing conversations/clear group mentions Set the conversation extension field /sdk/ios/conversation/managing conversations/set conversation extension Set a conversation draft /sdk/ios/conversation/managing conversations/set conversation draft Mark a conversation as read /sdk/ios/conversation/managing conversations/mark conversation read Maintain the total unread count /sdk/ios/conversation/managing conversations/get total unread count Conversation lifecycle Hide a conversation /sdk/ios/conversation/managing conversations/hide a conversation Hide all conversations /sdk/ios/conversation/managing conversations/hide all conversations Delete a conversation and its messages /sdk/ios/conversation/managing conversations/delete conversation with messages Clear conversation messages /sdk/ios/conversation/managing conversations/clear conversation messages Conversation groups Conversation groups overview /sdk/ios/conversation/managing conversation groups/overview conversation groups explains how to classify conversations into user defined folders. Members are referenced by conversationID , while the group itself uses conversationGroupID . Conversation grouping reorganizes personal chat presentation without creating group chats or altering groupID , group metadata, or membership. The iOS SDK exposes conversation grouping through OpenIMCore JSON interfaces bundled with the SDK and tracks updates via a single conversation group listener. Query calls return current category snapshots. Group updates merge by conversationGroupID , and member associations merge by conversationGroupID and conversationID . State synchronization Query APIs establish initial data snapshots, while delegate methods merge subsequent changes: New conversations and property alterations are observed in Retrieve the conversation list /sdk/ios/conversation/retrieving conversations/retrieve conversation list . Account level total unread changes are observed in Maintain the total unread count /sdk/ios/conversation/managing conversations/get total unread count . Treat API completion callbacks, asynchronous delegate events, and reconciliation queries as distinct operational phases. Never assume remote multi terminal synchronization has completed solely because a local write callback returned successfully.

title: Retrieve a conversation by chat target
description: Retrieve a conversation for a user or group with OpenIM iOS SDK.
keywords: sdk ios v4 sdk ios conversation retrieving-conversations get-conversation-by-target
content: Retrieve a conversation snapshot for a specific user or group using getOneConversationWithSessionType:sourceID:onSuccess:onFailure: . Use this method when navigating to a chat view from a profile card or group detail screen. Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | sessionType | OIMConversationType | Yes | Conversation category. Pass OIMConversationTypeC2C for direct chats, or OIMConversationTypeGroup for group chats. | | sourceID | NSString | Yes | Target entity identifier: peer user ID for direct chats, or group ID for group chats. | Session types OIMConversationType | Enum | Value | Description | | | | | | OIMConversationTypeC2C | 1 | Direct one to one conversation. | | OIMConversationTypeGroup | 2 | Regular group conversation. | | OIMConversationTypeSuperGroup | 3 | Large scale super group conversation. | Code example OIMManager manager getOneConversationWithSessionType:OIMConversationTypeC2C sourceID:@"user 1002" onSuccess:^ OIMConversationInfo conversation chatRouter openConversation:conversation ; onFailure:^ NSInteger code, NSString message NSLog @"getOneConversation failed: %ld %@", long code, message ; ; Return value The onSuccess callback returns a complete OIMConversationInfo object. Even if no message history exists between the participants, the SDK automatically initializes and returns a valid conversation object. Avoid manually synthesizing conversation models. To obtain only the calculated conversation identifier string locally, invoke Generate a conversation ID /sdk/ios/conversation/retrieving conversations/get conversation id . State changes after the call Local state merge : Merge the returned record into active view models using conversationID as the primary key. Snapshot query : This query establishes an instantaneous point in time snapshot and does not emit delegate callbacks. Subsequent synchronization : Live conversation changes continue to arrive via OIMConversationListener see Retrieve the conversation list /sdk/ios/conversation/retrieving conversations/retrieve conversation list .

title: Generate a conversation ID
description: Derive a conversation ID from a chat target with OpenIM iOS SDK.
keywords: sdk ios v4 sdk ios conversation retrieving-conversations get-conversation-id
content: Compute a deterministic conversation identifier string synchronously using getConversationIDBySessionType:sourceID: . Use this method to obtain conversation IDs locally without performing string concatenation or sending network requests. Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | sessionType | OIMConversationType | Yes | Conversation category. Pass OIMConversationTypeC2C for direct chats or OIMConversationTypeGroup for group chats. | | sourceID | NSString | Yes | Peer user ID for direct chats, or group ID for group chats. | Code example NSString conversationID = OIMManager manager getConversationIDBySessionType:OIMConversationTypeC2C sourceID:@"user 1002" ; if conversationID.length 0 self handleConversationID:conversationID ; Return value The method synchronously returns a normalized NSString representing the unique conversation identifier. If arguments are invalid, it may return nil or an empty string. This method operates purely in memory without initiating network requests, database transactions, or delegate notifications. It derives identifier strings only; to retrieve complete conversation metadata including unread counts and drafts, invoke Retrieve a conversation by chat target /sdk/ios/conversation/retrieving conversations/get conversation by target .

title: Retrieve conversations by ID
description: Batch-retrieve conversations by conversationID with OpenIM iOS SDK.
keywords: sdk ios v4 sdk ios conversation retrieving-conversations get-conversations-by-id
content: Batch retrieve conversation snapshots for a list of conversation identifiers using getMultipleConversation:onSuccess:onFailure: . Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | conversationIDs | NSArray | Yes | List of conversation IDs to retrieve. | Code example OIMManager manager getMultipleConversation:@ @"c2c user1001", @"group group2001" onSuccess:^ NSArray items conversationStore mergeByConversationID:items ?: @ ; onFailure:^ NSInteger code, NSString message NSLog @"getMultipleConversation failed: %ld %@", long code, message ; ; Return value The onSuccess callback delivers an NSArray containing the matching conversation objects. If none of the requested IDs exist, an empty array is returned. If certain requested conversations have not yet been created, the returned array will omit those entries. The order of elements in the response array is not guaranteed to align positionally with the input list. State changes after the call Local state merge : Merge returned records into local conversation collections using conversationID as the unique entity key. Snapshot query : This query establishes an instantaneous point in time snapshot and does not emit conversation delegate events. Ongoing synchronization : Real time property updates for these conversations continue to arrive via OIMConversationListener see Retrieve the conversation list /sdk/ios/conversation/retrieving conversations/retrieve conversation list .

title: Retrieve the conversation list
description: Retrieve the current user’s conversation list with pagination and merge subsequent changes through delegates.
keywords: sdk ios v4 sdk ios conversation retrieving-conversations retrieve-conversation-list
content: The conversation list belongs to the authenticated user. Each OIMConversationInfo object contains conversation identifiers, unread counts, latest messages, pinned statuses, and draft texts. Always query conversations using paginated APIs rather than unpaginated complete fetch methods. Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | offset | NSInteger | Yes | Starting offset index. Pass 0 for the first page. | | count | NSInteger | Yes | Number of conversation items to fetch per page. | Code example NSInteger pageSize = 50; OIMManager manager getConversationListSplitWithOffset:0 count:pageSize onSuccess:^ NSArray items conversationStore mergeByConversationID:items ?: @ ; onFailure:^ NSInteger code, NSString message NSLog @"getConversationListSplit failed: %ld %@", long code, message ; ; Conversation state merges using conversationID as the unique entity key. Return value The onSuccess callback returns an NSArray containing conversation objects for the requested page. An empty array or an array with fewer than count items indicates that the end of the conversation list has been reached. When fetching additional pages, increment offset by the count of successfully retrieved items and merge results into local stores idempotently using conversationID . When the user triggers a pull to refresh action, reset the pagination cursor to 0 and re fetch the initial page. Synchronize conversation updates Paginated queries establish an initial conversation snapshot, while the OIMConversationListener protocol handles real time updates for newly created conversations or mutated properties. Register the listener after SDK initialization. Retain the listener instance strongly, as OIMCallbacker maintains only weak references to delegates. @interface ConversationListSync : NSObject @end @interface ConversationListController @property nonatomic, strong ConversationListSync conversationListSync; @end @implementation ConversationListSync void onNewConversation: NSArray items conversationStore mergeByConversationID:items ; void onConversationChanged: NSArray items conversationStore mergeByConversationID:items ; @end ConversationListSync sync = ConversationListSync new ; self.conversationListSync = sync; OIMManager callbacker addConversationListener:sync ; // Upon account logout or view controller deallocation: OIMManager callbacker removeConversationListener:self.conversationListSync ; self.conversationListSync = nil; Merge all incoming updates idempotently by conversationID . Account wide unread counts are observed via Maintain the total unread count /sdk/ios/conversation/managing conversations/get total unread count , and typing status indicators are managed via Report typing status /sdk/ios/message/composing messages/update typing status . Do not substitute the joined group list for the conversation list: a user may belong to a group that has not yet generated messages, or may retain historical conversation state after leaving a group.

title: Pin or unpin a conversation
description: Set a conversation’s pinned state with OpenIM iOS SDK.
keywords: sdk ios v4 sdk ios conversation managing-conversations pin-conversation
content: Update the pinned status of a specified conversation in the chat list using pinConversation:isPinned:onSuccess:onFailure: . Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | conversationID | NSString | Yes | Target conversation ID to pin or unpin. | | isPinned | BOOL | Yes | Pinned state flag. Pass YES to pin the conversation, or NO to unpin it. | Code example OIMManager manager pinConversation:@"c2c user1002" isPinned:YES onSuccess:^ NSString Nullable data NSLog @"pinConversation success" ; onFailure:^ NSInteger code, NSString message NSLog @"pinConversation failed: %ld %@", long code, message ; ; Return value The onSuccess callback signifies that OpenIMServer updated the pinned status. State changes after the call Local state merge : Merge the updated isPinned flag into local conversation stores using conversationID as the entity key, and re sort the conversation list. Asynchronous event listening : Multi device sessions and local listeners observe updates via onConversationChanged: in OIMConversationListener see Retrieve the conversation list /sdk/ios/conversation/retrieving conversations/retrieve conversation list . Re query calibration : To restore authoritative conversation metadata, invoke Retrieve conversations by ID /sdk/ios/conversation/retrieving conversations/get conversations by id .

title: Set the conversation extension field
description: Set a conversation extension field with OpenIM iOS SDK.
keywords: sdk ios v4 sdk ios conversation managing-conversations set-conversation-extension
content: Attach custom business metadata to a conversation using setConversationEx:ex:onSuccess:onFailure: . Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | conversationID | NSString | Yes | Target conversation identifier. | | ex | NSString | Yes | Custom extension string typically JSON formatted . Overwrites the existing field completely. | Code example NSString ex = @" \"category\":\"work\",\"tag\":\"important\" "; OIMManager manager setConversationEx:@"c2c user1002" ex:ex onSuccess:^ NSString Nullable data NSLog @"setConversationEx success" ; onFailure:^ NSInteger code, NSString message NSLog @"setConversationEx failed: %ld %@", long code, message ; ; The ex property is written as an atomic replacement string. The SDK does not parse or merge JSON keys on the client. To update specific keys without losing existing metadata, fetch the existing conversation snapshot first, merge your dictionary changes, and then submit the updated serialized string. Return value The onSuccess callback signifies that OpenIMServer processed the conversation extension update. State changes after the call Local state merge : Merge the new ex property into local conversation records using conversationID as the entity key. Asynchronous event listening : Multi device clients observe updates via onConversationChanged: in OIMConversationListener see Retrieve the conversation list /sdk/ios/conversation/retrieving conversations/retrieve conversation list . Re query calibration : To restore authoritative conversation metadata, invoke Retrieve conversations by ID /sdk/ios/conversation/retrieving conversations/get conversations by id .

title: Set a conversation draft
description: Save or clear a conversation draft with OpenIM iOS SDK.
keywords: sdk ios v4 sdk ios conversation managing-conversations set-conversation-draft
content: Save or clear draft messages for a specified conversation using setConversationDraft:draftText:onSuccess:onFailure: . While the user edits text, retain input values locally and apply debounce strategies; commit the final draft when the user leaves the chat view or changes conversations. Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | conversationID | NSString | Yes | Target conversation identifier. | | draftText | NSString | Yes | Draft message content. Pass an empty string @"" to clear the draft. | Code example Save a draft OIMManager manager setConversationDraft:@"c2c user1002" draftText:@"Meeting at 3:00 PM" onSuccess:^ NSString Nullable data NSLog @"setConversationDraft success" ; onFailure:^ NSInteger code, NSString message NSLog @"setConversationDraft failed: %ld %@", long code, message ; ; Clear a draft OIMManager manager setConversationDraft:@"c2c user1002" draftText:@"" onSuccess:^ NSString Nullable data NSLog @"clear draft success" ; onFailure:^ NSInteger code, NSString message NSLog @"clear draft failed: %ld %@", long code, message ; ; Return value The onSuccess callback confirms that OpenIMServer saved or removed the draft. State changes after the call Local state merge : Merge draftText and draftTextTime into local conversation models using conversationID as the entity key. Asynchronous event listening : Views observe updates via onConversationChanged: in OIMConversationListener see Retrieve the conversation list /sdk/ios/conversation/retrieving conversations/retrieve conversation list . Re query calibration : To verify draft attributes immediately, invoke Retrieve conversations by ID /sdk/ios/conversation/retrieving conversations/get conversations by id . Clear in memory editor states when logging out or switching user accounts.

title: Set message reception for a conversation
description: Configure message reception for a conversation with OpenIM iOS SDK.

content: Configure the message reception policy for a specific conversation such as enabling Do Not Disturb or muting notifications using setConversationRecvMessageOpt:status:onSuccess:onFailure: . Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | conversationID | NSString | Yes | Target conversation identifier. | | status | OIMReceiveMessageOpt | Yes | Message reception option enum. | Message reception options OIMReceiveMessageOpt | Enum | Value | Description | | | | | | OIMReceiveMessageOptReceive | 0 | Receive messages normally and trigger offline push notifications. | | OIMReceiveMessageOptNotReceive | 1 | Block message reception entirely; suppress offline push notifications. | | OIMReceiveMessageOptNotNotify | 2 | Receive messages while suppressing offline push notifications Do Not Disturb . | Code example OIMManager manager setConversationRecvMessageOpt:@"c2c user1002" status:OIMReceiveMessageOptNotNotify onSuccess:^ NSString Nullable data NSLog @"setConversationRecvMessageOpt success" ; onFailure:^ NSInteger code, NSString message NSLog @"setConversationRecvMessageOpt failed: %ld %@", long code, message ; ; Return value The onSuccess callback confirms that OpenIMServer updated the message reception setting. title: Reset group-mention state

keywords: sdk ios v4 sdk ios conversation managing-conversations clear-group-mentions
content: Invoke resetConversationGroupAtType:onSuccess:onFailure: to reset the @ mention alert state of a specified group conversation to normal after the user has viewed or handled mention messages: Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | conversationID | NSString | Yes | Target group conversation ID. | Code example OIMManager manager resetConversationGroupAtType:@"group 2001" onSuccess:^ NSString Nullable data NSLog @"resetConversationGroupAtType success" ; onFailure:^ NSInteger code, NSString message NSLog @"resetConversationGroupAtType failed: %ld %@", long code, message ; ; Return value The onSuccess callback returns confirmation when the operation succeeds. Local state update : The conversation's groupAtType property is reset to normal OIMGroupAtTypeNormal , clearing any special @ mention badge or indicator on the conversation item. 2. Event notification : Updated conversation properties are broadcast via the onConversationChanged: delegate callback. Match conversations by conversationID to refresh list presentation. 3. Re query calibration : Group @ mention status is independent from message read status. If the local cache needs verification, call getConversationsWithIDs:onSuccess:onFailure: or re query the conversation list. To mark messages as read, refer to Mark a conversation as read /sdk/ios/conversation/managing conversations/mark conversation read . title: Mark a conversation as read
description: Mark messages in a specified conversation as read with OpenIM iOS SDK.
keywords: sdk ios v4 sdk ios conversation managing-conversations mark-conversation-read
content: Mark messages in a specified conversation as read using markConversationMessageAsRead:onSuccess:onFailure: . Invoke this method when the user enters a chat screen and reads active unread messages. Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | conversationID | NSString | Yes | Target conversation ID to mark as read. | Code example OIMManager manager markConversationMessageAsRead:@"c2c user1002" onSuccess:^ NSString Nullable data NSLog @"markConversationMessageAsRead success" ; onFailure:^ NSInteger code, NSString message NSLog @"markConversationMessageAsRead failed: %ld %@", long code, message ; ; Do not invoke this method during notification banner previews or when silent background messages arrive. Return value The onSuccess callback confirms that OpenIMServer processed the read mark. State changes after the call Local unread reset : The unread count for this conversation resets to zero, broadcasting onConversationChanged: in OIMConversationListener . Global unread reduction : The global account level unread count decreases, notifying listeners via onTotalUnreadMessageCountChanged: see Maintain the total unread count /sdk/ios/conversation/managing conversations/get total unread count . C2C read receipt delivery : In 1 on 1 direct conversations, the peer user receives read receipt events via onRecvC2CReadReceipt: in OIMAdvancedMsgListener : void onRecvC2CReadReceipt: NSArray items self mergeC2CReceipts:items ?: @ ; Locate the target conversation using the sender identity, then mark messages as read using each clientMsgID provided in msgIDList . For group message reader tracking, refer to Send group read receipts /sdk/ios/message/managing read status/send group read receipts .

title: Retrieve and maintain the total unread count
description: Retrieve and continuously maintain the account’s total unread count with OpenIM iOS SDK.

content: Query the aggregate unread message count across all conversations for the authenticated account using getTotalUnreadMsgCountWithOnSuccess:onFailure: . This method calculates the complete server backed unread total, avoiding manual client side tallying across paginated conversation lists. Code example OIMManager manager getTotalUnreadMsgCountWithOnSuccess:^ NSInteger count badgeStore setTotalUnread:count ; onFailure:^ NSInteger code, NSString message NSLog @"getTotalUnreadMsgCount failed: %ld %@", long code, message ; ; Return value The onSuccess callback delivers an integer count representing the total unread message count across all conversations for the logged in user. State changes after the call Local badge update : Update global tab bar badges or unread counter labels with the returned count. Snapshot query : This query retrieves an instantaneous snapshot and does not emit delegate callbacks. Asynchronous event listening : When new incoming messages arrive or conversations are marked as read, the SDK broadcasts the updated total unread count via onTotalUnreadMessageCountChanged: in OIMConversationListener : @interface TotalUnreadSync : NSObject @end @implementation TotalUnreadSync void onTotalUnreadMessageCountChanged: NSInteger count badgeStore setTotalUnread:count ; @end TotalUnreadSync sync = TotalUnreadSync new ; OIMManager callbacker addConversationListener:sync ; // When logging out or tearing down view controllers: OIMManager callbacker removeConversationListener:sync ; To synchronize this count with the iOS system application icon badge, refer to Set the app badge count /sdk/ios/message/set app badge .

Duration configuration : Configure the message self destruction countdown independently using Set the burn after reading duration /sdk/ios/conversation/managing conversations/set burn duration . title: Hide a conversation

Persistence and reappearance : Stored messages and relationship states are retained. title: Delete a conversation and its messages
description: Delete a specified conversation and all of its messages with OpenIM iOS SDK.
keywords: sdk ios v4 sdk ios conversation managing-conversations delete-conversation-with-messages
content: Invoke deleteConversationAndDeleteAllMsg:onSuccess:onFailure: to delete a specified conversation entry and clear all of its associated message records: Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | conversationID | NSString | Yes | Target conversation ID to delete. | Code example OIMManager manager deleteConversationAndDeleteAllMsg:@"c2c user1002" onSuccess:^ NSString Nullable data NSLog @"deleteConversationAndDeleteAllMsg success" ; onFailure:^ NSInteger code, NSString message NSLog @"deleteConversationAndDeleteAllMsg failed: %ld %@", long code, message ; ; Return value The onSuccess callback returns confirmation when the operation succeeds. Relationship scope : This operation only deletes local conversation and message data for the current account. It does not terminate friend relationships, nor does it leave or disband groups. When new messages arrive for this target, the conversation is recreated automatically and returns to the list. 3. Re query calibration : If you only need to temporarily remove the conversation entry while keeping chat history intact, refer to Hide a conversation /sdk/ios/conversation/managing conversations/hide a conversation . The conversation's latest message preview is wiped, and its unread message count resets to 0. The conversation entry remains in the list. 2. Event notification : Updated conversation properties are broadcast via the onConversationChanged: delegate callback. The client uses conversationID as the primary key to refresh the list cell and empty preview text. 3. Persistence and reappearance : This operation only affects list visibility for the current account. It does not delete historical message records or alter friend or group relationships. Re query calibration : To hide a single specific conversation, refer to Hide a conversation /sdk/ios/conversation/managing conversations/hide a conversation . title: Conversation groups overview
description: Understand conversation-group data boundaries and listener lifecycle in OpenIM iOS SDK.
keywords: sdk ios v4 sdk ios conversation managing-conversation-groups overview-conversation-groups
content: Conversation groups categorize and organize the signed in user's conversation list. They manage relationships between conversationID values and custom groups, without creating chat groups, modifying member lists, or changing message delivery targets. The iOS SDK exposes conversation group capabilities through OpenIMCore Objective C functions distributed with OpenIMSDK ; they are not yet wrapped in high level OIMManager model classes. Requests, results, and listener payloads are JSON NSString values. Parse them using NSJSONSerialization rather than declaring custom model classes. Group types | Value | Meaning | | : | | | 0 | Regular custom group, created and managed manually by the user. | | 1 | Rule filtered group, maintained automatically by server or SDK rules. | | 2 | All group types, used strictly as a query filter parameter and not for group creation. | Use type 0 for user defined categories. The generation rules for filtered groups depend on backend configuration. Available operations Create a conversation group /sdk/ios/conversation/managing conversation groups/create conversation group Retrieve conversation groups /sdk/ios/conversation/managing conversation groups/get conversation groups Retrieve conversations in a group /sdk/ios/conversation/managing conversation groups/get conversation group info with conversations Retrieve group IDs containing a conversation /sdk/ios/conversation/managing conversation groups/get conversation group ids by conversation id Update a conversation group /sdk/ios/conversation/managing conversation groups/update conversation group Set conversation group order /sdk/ios/conversation/managing conversation groups/set conversation group order Add conversations to groups /sdk/ios/conversation/managing conversation groups/add conversations to groups Remove conversations from groups /sdk/ios/conversation/managing conversation groups/remove conversations from groups Delete a conversation group /sdk/ios/conversation/managing conversation groups/delete conversation group Set the conversation group listener Open im sdkSetConversationGroupListener maintains a single active Open im sdk callbackOnConversationGroupListener instance. Because there is no separate unregister function, retain the listener within an account scoped manager and initialize it once during session startup. import @import OpenIMCore; @interface ConversationGroupStore @end @implementation ConversationGroupStore void startListening Open im sdkSetConversationGroupListener self ; void onConversationGroupAdded: NSString Nullable json self mergeConversationGroupsJSON:json ; void onConversationGroupChanged: NSString Nullable json self mergeConversationGroupsJSON:json ; void onConversationGroupDeleted: NSString Nullable json self removeConversationGroupsJSON:json ; void onConversationGroupMemberAdded: NSString Nullable json self mergeConversationGroupMembersJSON:json ; void onConversationGroupMemberDeleted: NSString Nullable json self removeConversationGroupMembersJSON:json ; @end The group added, changed, and deleted callbacks pass JSON arrays of groups. Member modification callbacks provide JSON containing group , conversationIDs , and conversations . Merge group state using conversationGroupID as the primary key, and identify member associations using composite keys of conversationGroupID and conversationID . When switching accounts, stop the active listener from dispatching to UI components and register the new account's listener. Method execution completion, listener event delivery, and cache calibration queries are three distinct stages.

title: Create a conversation group
description: Create a conversation group with OpenIM iOS SDK.
keywords: sdk ios v4 sdk ios conversation managing-conversation-groups create-conversation-group
content: Invoke Open im sdkCreateConversationGroup to create a custom conversation group for the signed in user. A regular group requires a name; pass a conversationID to add an initial conversation into the group at creation time: Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | name | NSString | Yes | Name of the conversation group. | | order | NSNumber | No | Sorting order index for group display. | | ex | NSString | No | Custom extension string. | | conversationID | NSString | No | ID of a conversation to include immediately upon creation. | | conversationGroupType | NSNumber | No | Group type 0 for a regular custom group, 1 for a rule filtered group . | Code example import @import OpenIMCore; NSDictionary request = @ @"name": @"Work", @"order": @100, @"conversationID": @"c2c user1002", @"conversationGroupType": @0, ; NSData requestData = NSJSONSerialization dataWithJSONObject:request options:0 error:nil ; NSString requestJSON = NSString alloc initWithData:requestData encoding:NSUTF8StringEncoding ; CallbackProxy callback = CallbackProxy alloc initWithOnSuccess:^ NSString Nullable data if data == nil return; self upsertConversationGroupJSON:data ; onFailure:^ NSInteger code, NSString Nullable message NSLog @"CreateConversationGroup failed: %ld %@", long code, message ; ; Open im sdkCreateConversationGroup callback, requestJSON ; Return value The onSuccess callback delivers a JSON string in data representing the newly created group. Common fields include conversationGroupID , name , order , version , conversationGroupType , hidden , unreadCount , and conversationIDs . State changes after the call 1. Local state update : The client parses the JSON response and inserts or updates the group record using conversationGroupID as the unique key. 2. Event notification : Multi device synchronization or subsequent changes broadcast via the onConversationGroupAdded: listener callback. 3. Re query calibration : For comprehensive listener configuration and data structures, refer to Conversation groups overview /sdk/ios/conversation/managing conversation groups/overview conversation groups .

title: Retrieve conversation groups
