content: Invoke Open im sdkGetConversationGroups to query the list of conversation groups belonging to the signed in user by category: Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | groupType | int64 t | Yes | Category of conversation groups to retrieve. | Group type enumeration | Value | Numeric value | Description | | | | | | 0 | 0 | Regular custom groups manually created and managed by users. | | 1 | 1 | Rule filtered groups maintained automatically. | | 2 | 2 | All group categories. | Code example import @import OpenIMCore; int64 t groupType = 2; // 0: regular, 1: filtered, 2: all CallbackProxy callback = CallbackProxy alloc initWithOnSuccess:^ NSString Nullable data self replaceConversationGroupsFromJSON:data ; onFailure:^ NSInteger code, NSString Nullable message NSLog @"GetConversationGroups failed: %ld %@", long code, message ; ; Open im sdkGetConversationGroups callback, groupType ; Return value The onSuccess callback delivers a JSON array string in data containing the matching group objects. Parse the array and update the local in memory group list keyed by conversationGroupID . State changes after the call 1. Snapshot query : This method provides an initial snapshot of group metadata without triggering asynchronous listener events. 2. Event notification : Real time modifications to groups across sessions or devices arrive via listener delegates. For listener registration and lifecycle details, refer to Conversation groups overview /sdk/ios/conversation/managing conversation groups/overview conversation groups .

title: Retrieve conversations in a group

Pagination state : Use isEnd to determine whether more pages should be loaded. 3. For listener handling, refer to Conversation groups overview /sdk/ios/conversation/managing conversation groups/overview conversation groups .

title: Set conversation-group order
description: Set the order of multiple conversation groups with Open_im_sdkSetConversationGroupOrder.
keywords: sdk ios v4 sdk ios conversation managing-conversation-groups set-conversation-group-order
content: Invoke Open im sdkSetConversationGroupOrder to update display ordering indexes for multiple conversation groups in a batch: Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | conversationGroupID | NSString | Yes | Target conversation group ID within each order entry. | | order | NSNumber | Yes | New numeric ordering index. | Code example import @import OpenIMCore; NSArray orders = @ @ @"conversationGroupID": @"group work 101", @"order": @100 , @ @"conversationGroupID": @"group life 102", @"order": @200 , ; NSData requestData = NSJSONSerialization dataWithJSONObject:orders options:0 error:nil ; NSString requestJSON = NSString alloc initWithData:requestData encoding:NSUTF8StringEncoding ; CallbackProxy callback = CallbackProxy alloc initWithOnSuccess:^ NSString Nullable data NSLog @"SetConversationGroupOrder success" ; onFailure:^ NSInteger code, NSString Nullable message NSLog @"SetConversationGroupOrder failed: %ld %@", long code, message ; ; Open im sdkSetConversationGroupOrder callback, requestJSON ; Return value The onSuccess callback returns confirmation when the ordering request is completed. State changes after the call 1. Local state update : The client updates the order property for matching groups keyed by conversationGroupID and re sorts the group list. 2. Event notification : Group property changes broadcast via the onConversationGroupChanged: listener callback across client sessions. 3. Re query calibration : For listener integration details, refer to Conversation groups overview /sdk/ios/conversation/managing conversation groups/overview conversation groups .

title: Add conversations to groups
description: Add conversation-group relationships with Open_im_sdkAddConversationsToGroups.
keywords: sdk ios v4 sdk ios conversation managing-conversation-groups add-conversations-to-groups
content: Invoke Open im sdkAddConversationsToGroups to associate one or more conversations with specified conversation groups in a batch. This operation establishes group associations only; it does not alter conversation data or message delivery: Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | conversationIDs | NSArray | Yes | List of conversation IDs to add into the groups. | | conversationGroupIDs | NSArray | Yes | List of target conversation group IDs. | Code example import @import OpenIMCore; NSData conversationData = NSJSONSerialization dataWithJSONObject:@ @"c2c user1002" options:0 error:nil ; NSString conversationIDsJSON = NSString alloc initWithData:conversationData encoding:NSUTF8StringEncoding ; NSData groupData = NSJSONSerialization dataWithJSONObject:@ @"group work 101" options:0 error:nil ; NSString groupIDsJSON = NSString alloc initWithData:groupData encoding:NSUTF8StringEncoding ; CallbackProxy callback = CallbackProxy alloc initWithOnSuccess:^ NSString Nullable data NSLog @"AddConversationsToGroups success" ; onFailure:^ NSInteger code, NSString Nullable message NSLog @"AddConversationsToGroups failed: %ld %@", long code, message ; ; Open im sdkAddConversationsToGroups callback, conversationIDsJSON, groupIDsJSON ; Return value The onSuccess callback returns confirmation when the association request completes successfully. State changes after the call 1. Local state update : The client updates local membership records keyed by composite identifiers conversationGroupID and conversationID . 2. Event notification : Active client sessions receive notifications through the onConversationGroupMemberAdded: listener callback. 3. Re query calibration : For listener integration details, refer to Conversation groups overview /sdk/ios/conversation/managing conversation groups/overview conversation groups .

title: Remove conversations from groups
description: Remove conversation-group relationships with Open_im_sdkRemoveConversationsFromGroups.
keywords: sdk ios v4 sdk ios conversation managing-conversation-groups remove-conversations-from-groups
content: Invoke Open im sdkRemoveConversationsFromGroups to remove specified conversations from one or more conversation groups. This operation removes group associations only; it does not delete conversations or clear message history: Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | conversationIDs | NSArray | Yes | List of conversation IDs to remove from the groups. | | conversationGroupIDs | NSArray | Yes | List of target conversation group IDs. | Code example import @import OpenIMCore; NSData conversationData = NSJSONSerialization dataWithJSONObject:@ @"c2c user1002" options:0 error:nil ; NSString conversationIDsJSON = NSString alloc initWithData:conversationData encoding:NSUTF8StringEncoding ; NSData groupData = NSJSONSerialization dataWithJSONObject:@ @"group work 101" options:0 error:nil ; NSString groupIDsJSON = NSString alloc initWithData:groupData encoding:NSUTF8StringEncoding ; CallbackProxy callback = CallbackProxy alloc initWithOnSuccess:^ NSString Nullable data NSLog @"RemoveConversationsFromGroups success" ; onFailure:^ NSInteger code, NSString Nullable message NSLog @"RemoveConversationsFromGroups failed: %ld %@", long code, message ; ; Open im sdkRemoveConversationsFromGroups callback, conversationIDsJSON, groupIDsJSON ; Return value The onSuccess callback returns confirmation when the disassociation request completes. State changes after the call 1. Local state update : The client removes member associations keyed by composite pairs of conversationGroupID and conversationID . 2. Event notification : Active client sessions receive removal notifications via the onConversationGroupMemberDeleted: listener callback. 3. Re query calibration : For listener lifecycle and integration details, refer to Conversation groups overview /sdk/ios/conversation/managing conversation groups/overview conversation groups .

title: Delete a conversation group
description: Delete a conversation group with Open_im_sdkDeleteConversationGroup.
keywords: sdk ios v4 sdk ios conversation managing-conversation-groups delete-conversation-group
content: Invoke Open im sdkDeleteConversationGroup to delete a specified conversation group and its member associations. This operation only removes the group categorization; it does not delete any underlying conversations or chat messages: Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | conversationGroupID | NSString | Yes | Target conversation group ID to delete. | Code example import @import OpenIMCore; CallbackProxy callback = CallbackProxy alloc initWithOnSuccess:^ NSString Nullable data self removeConversationGroupByID:@"group work 101" ; onFailure:^ NSInteger code, NSString Nullable message NSLog @"DeleteConversationGroup failed: %ld %@", long code, message ; ; Open im sdkDeleteConversationGroup callback, @"group work 101" ; Return value The onSuccess callback returns confirmation when the conversation group is successfully deleted. State changes after the call 1. Local state removal : The client removes the group record keyed by conversationGroupID from local storage and group navigation interfaces. 2. Event notification : Other connected client sessions receive notification through the onConversationGroupDeleted: listener callback. 3. Data preservation : Deleting a group does not affect conversations or historical chat history. For listener lifecycle details, refer to Conversation groups overview /sdk/ios/conversation/managing conversation groups/overview conversation groups .

title: Groups overview
description: Understand group profiles, members, applications, roles, and group events in OpenIM iOS SDK.
keywords: sdk ios v4 sdk ios group overview-group
content: OpenIM manages multi user chat scenarios through groups, encapsulating shared profiles, membership relations, and role based permissions. The groupID uniquely identifies a group and is required whenever sending group messages, querying profiles, administering members, or handling join requests. Conversations in the chat list continue to use conversationID ; maintain clear separation between both keys. Core data types | Type | Description | | | | | OIMGroupInfo | Contains group name, avatar URL, announcement, owner user ID, join verification mode, member counts, and extension attributes. | | OIMGroupMemberInfo | Represents a member's profile within a specific group, including nickname, role, mute status, and join timestamp. | | OIMGroupApplicationInfo | Represents join applications and their administrative review states. | Group roles are represented by the OIMGroupMemberRole enumeration: regular member OIMGroupMemberRoleMember = 20 , administrator OIMGroupMemberRoleAdmin = 60 , and group owner OIMGroupMemberRoleOwner = 100 . While client apps use these values to adjust UI controls, final permission enforcement is performed by the OpenIM server. Group profile and lifecycle Create a group /sdk/ios/group/create group Update the group name, description, and avatar /sdk/ios/group/update group profile Publish or update a group announcement /sdk/ios/group/set group announcement Set group join verification /sdk/ios/group/set group join verification Set access to member profiles /sdk/ios/group/set group member profile access Set permission to add friends from a group /sdk/ios/group/set group member friend permission Set the group extension field /sdk/ios/group/set group extension Apply to join a group /sdk/ios/group/join group Leave a group /sdk/ios/group/quit group Dismiss a group /sdk/ios/group/dismiss group Retrieve group profiles /sdk/ios/group/retrieving groups/get specified groups info Search groups /sdk/ios/group/retrieving groups/search groups Group members and applications Group applications overview /sdk/ios/group/group applications/overview group applications Retrieve group members overview /sdk/ios/group/retrieving group members/overview retrieving group members Invite users to a group /sdk/ios/group/managing group members/invite user to group Group moderation Mute or unmute the entire group /sdk/ios/group/change group mute Mute or unmute a group member /sdk/ios/group/managing group members/change group member mute State updates Listen to group profile changes, member joins/leaves, and group dissolutions by implementing the OIMGroupListener protocol: void startGroupEvents OIMManager callbacker addGroupListener:self ; void stopGroupEvents OIMManager callbacker removeGroupListener:self ; void onJoinedGroupAdded: OIMGroupInfo group self upsertGroup:group ; void onJoinedGroupDeleted: OIMGroupInfo group self removeGroupID:group.groupID ; void onGroupInfoChanged: OIMGroupInfo group self upsertGroup:group ; void onGroupDismissed: OIMGroupInfo group self markDismissed:group.groupID ; Retain a stable OIMGroupListener instance and pass the exact same reference when adding or removing listeners. Merge group state using groupID as the primary key. Method return callbacks, asynchronous delegate notifications, and local cache calibrations represent three distinct stages. For member events, refer to Retrieve group members overview /sdk/ios/group/retrieving group members/overview retrieving group members . For join request events, refer to Group applications overview /sdk/ios/group/group applications/overview group applications .

title: Create a group
description: Create a group and configure its initial members with the Objective-C API.
keywords: sdk ios v4 sdk ios group create-group
content: Invoke createGroup:onSuccess:onFailure: to create a new group and configure its base information, initial members, administrators, and group owner: Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | groupCreateInfo | OIMGroupCreateInfo | Yes | Creation request model specifying group profile metadata, member lists, and ownership. | OIMGroupCreateInfo properties | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | groupInfo | OIMGroupBaseInfo | Yes | Base group metadata, including groupName and groupType such as OIMGroupTypeWorking . | | memberUserIDs | NSArray | No | Initial list of regular member user IDs. | | adminUserIDs | NSArray | No | Initial list of administrator user IDs. | | ownerUserID | NSString | No | Group owner user ID, typically the currently signed in user. User IDs must not duplicate across member, admin, and owner assignments. | Code example OIMGroupBaseInfo base = OIMGroupBaseInfo new ; base.groupName = @"Project Discussion"; base.groupType = OIMGroupTypeWorking; OIMGroupCreateInfo request = OIMGroupCreateInfo new ; request.groupInfo = base; request.memberUserIDs = @ @"user 003" ; request.adminUserIDs = @ @"user 002" ; request.ownerUserID = currentUserID; OIMManager manager createGroup:request onSuccess:^ OIMGroupInfo group self openGroupWithID:group.groupID ; onFailure:^ NSInteger code, NSString message NSLog @"createGroup failed: %ld %@", long code, message ; ; Return value The onSuccess callback delivers the fully initialized OIMGroupInfo object, including the newly assigned groupID . State changes after the call 1. Local state update : The client inserts the new group into local storage using groupID as the primary key. 2. Event notification : Active client sessions receive notifications through the onJoinedGroupAdded: listener callback. 3. Re query calibration : For comprehensive group event listener configuration, refer to Groups overview /sdk/ios/group/overview group .

title: Update the group name, description, and avatar
description: Update a group’s basic display profile with OpenIM iOS SDK.
keywords: sdk ios v4 sdk ios group update-group-profile
content: Invoke setGroupInfo:onSuccess:onFailure: to update basic display attributes such as group name, description, and avatar URL. Obtain the latest OIMGroupInfo instance before modifying target properties to avoid unintentionally overwriting uninitialized verification or permission settings: Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | groupInfo | OIMGroupInfo | Yes | Group model containing the target groupID and modified fields. | Code example OIMGroupInfo group = latestGroup; group.groupName = groupName; group.introduction = introduction; group.faceURL = avatarURL; OIMManager manager setGroupInfo:group onSuccess:^ NSString Nullable data NSLog @"setGroupInfo success" ; onFailure:^ NSInteger code, NSString message NSLog @"setGroupInfo failed: %ld %@", long code, message ; ; Return value The onSuccess callback returns confirmation when the server accepts the group profile update. State changes after the call 1. Local state update : The client updates local cached group attributes corresponding to groupID . 2. Event notification : Updated group details broadcast across sessions and devices via the onGroupInfoChanged: listener callback. 3. Re query calibration : For group profile verification, call getSpecifiedGroupsInfo:onSuccess:onFailure: . For listener setup, refer to Groups overview /sdk/ios/group/overview group .

title: Publish or update a group announcement
description: Partially update a group announcement with OpenIM iOS SDK.
keywords: sdk ios v4 sdk ios group set-group-announcement
content: Invoke setGroupInfoDictionary:onSuccess:onFailure: to publish or update a group announcement typically restricted to group owners and administrators : Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | groupInfoDictionary | NSDictionary | Yes | Dictionary containing the target groupID and modified key value pairs. | Dictionary keys | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | groupID | NSString | Yes | Target group ID. | | notification | NSString | Yes | Group announcement text. Pass an empty string to clear the current announcement. Note that this uses the notification key rather than introduction . | Code example NSDictionary changes = @ @"groupID": groupID, @"notification": announcement ; OIMManager manager setGroupInfoDictionary:changes onSuccess:^ NSString Nullable data NSLog @"setGroupInfoDictionary success" ; onFailure:^ NSInteger code, NSString message NSLog @"setGroupInfoDictionary failed: %ld %@", long code, message ; ; Return value The onSuccess callback returns confirmation when the server accepts the announcement update. State changes after the call 1. Local state update : The client updates the local cached group's announcement text matching groupID . 2. Event notification : All members in the group receive an updated OIMGroupInfo object through the onGroupInfoChanged: listener callback. 3. Re query calibration : To verify group state immediately, call getSpecifiedGroupsInfo:onSuccess:onFailure: . For listener setup, refer to Groups overview /sdk/ios/group/overview group .

title: Set the group extension field
description: Set an application-defined group extension string with OpenIM iOS SDK.
keywords: sdk ios v4 sdk ios group set-group-extension
content: Invoke setGroupInfoDictionary:onSuccess:onFailure: to update custom application defined extension data for a group typically restricted to group owners and administrators : Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | groupInfoDictionary | NSDictionary | Yes | Dictionary containing the target groupID and extension key value pairs. | Dictionary keys | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | groupID | NSString | Yes | Target group ID. | | ex | NSString | Yes | Custom extension string such as serialized JSON . The write completely overwrites the existing value; preserve other module namespaces before saving. | Code example NSDictionary changes = @ @"groupID": groupID, @"ex": mergedExtensionJSON ; OIMManager manager setGroupInfoDictionary:changes onSuccess:^ NSString Nullable data NSLog @"setGroupInfoDictionary success" ; onFailure:^ NSInteger code, NSString message NSLog @"setGroupInfoDictionary failed: %ld %@", long code, message ; ; Return value The onSuccess callback returns confirmation when the server accepts the extension update. State changes after the call 1. Local state update : The client updates the local cached group's ex attribute matching groupID . 2. Event notification : Group members receive an updated OIMGroupInfo object through the onGroupInfoChanged: listener callback. 3. Re query calibration : To calibrate local cache values, call getSpecifiedGroupsInfo:onSuccess:onFailure: . For listener setup, refer to Groups overview /sdk/ios/group/overview group .

title: Set group join verification
description: Configure verification policies for group applications and invitations with OpenIM iOS SDK.
keywords: sdk ios v4 sdk ios group set-group-join-verification
content: Invoke setGroupInfoDictionary:onSuccess:onFailure: to configure join verification requirements for applications and member invitations typically restricted to group owners and administrators : Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | groupInfoDictionary | NSDictionary | Yes | Dictionary containing the target groupID and the join verification mode. | Verification type options | Enumeration value | Numeric value | Description | | | | | | OIMGroupVerificationTypeApplyNeedVerificationInviteDirectly | 0 | Join applications require review; member invitations join directly. | | OIMGroupVerificationTypeAllNeedVerification | 1 | Both join applications and regular member invitations require review owner/admin invitations bypass review . | | OIMGroupVerificationTypeDirectly | 2 | Anyone can join directly without requiring approval. | Code example NSDictionary changes = @ @"groupID": groupID, @"needVerification": @ OIMGroupVerificationTypeAllNeedVerification ; OIMManager manager setGroupInfoDictionary:changes onSuccess:^ NSString Nullable data NSLog @"setGroupInfoDictionary success" ; onFailure:^ NSInteger code, NSString message NSLog @"setGroupInfoDictionary failed: %ld %@", long code, message ; ; Return value The onSuccess callback returns confirmation when the server accepts the updated verification policy. State changes after the call 1. Local state update : The client updates the local cached group's needVerification property matching groupID . 2. Event notification : Group members receive an updated OIMGroupInfo object through the onGroupInfoChanged: listener callback. 3. Re query calibration : To calibrate local cache values, call getSpecifiedGroupsInfo:onSuccess:onFailure: . For listener setup, refer to Groups overview /sdk/ios/group/overview group .

title: Set access to member profiles
description: Control whether group members can view other members’ profiles with OpenIM iOS SDK.
keywords: sdk ios v4 sdk ios group set-group-member-profile-access
content: Invoke setGroupInfoDictionary:onSuccess:onFailure: to configure whether regular group members can inspect profiles of other members in the group: Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | groupInfoDictionary | NSDictionary | Yes | Dictionary containing the target groupID and profile access permissions. | Access permission options | Enumeration value | Numeric value | Description | | | | | | OIMAllowTypeAllowed | 0 | Members can view profiles of other group members. | | OIMAllowTypeNotAllowed | 1 | Regular members cannot view profiles of other group members. | Code example NSDictionary changes = @ @"groupID": groupID, @"lookMemberInfo": @ OIMAllowTypeNotAllowed ; OIMManager manager setGroupInfoDictionary:changes onSuccess:^ NSString Nullable data NSLog @"setGroupInfoDictionary success" ; onFailure:^ NSInteger code, NSString message NSLog @"setGroupInfoDictionary failed: %ld %@", long code, message ; ; Return value The onSuccess callback returns confirmation when the server accepts the profile access configuration. State changes after the call 1. Local state update : The client updates the local cached group's lookMemberInfo property matching groupID . 2. Event notification : Group members receive an updated OIMGroupInfo object through the onGroupInfoChanged: listener callback. 3. Re query calibration : This setting is independent from friend addition permissions. To restrict adding friends within the group, refer to Set permission to add friends from a group /sdk/ios/group/set group member friend permission . For listener setup, refer to Groups overview /sdk/ios/group/overview group .

title: Set permission to add friends from a group
description: Control whether group members can send friend requests through a group with OpenIM iOS SDK.
keywords: sdk ios v4 sdk ios group set-group-member-friend-permission
content: Invoke setGroupInfoDictionary:onSuccess:onFailure: to configure whether group members can initiate friend requests to other members directly from the group: Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | groupInfoDictionary | NSDictionary | Yes | Dictionary containing the target groupID and friend addition permissions. | Friend permission options | Enumeration value | Numeric value | Description | | | | | | OIMAllowTypeAllowed | 0 | Members can send friend requests to fellow group members. | | OIMAllowTypeNotAllowed | 1 | Members are prohibited from initiating friend requests within this group. | Code example NSDictionary changes = @ @"groupID": groupID, @"applyMemberFriend": @ OIMAllowTypeNotAllowed ; OIMManager manager setGroupInfoDictionary:changes onSuccess:^ NSString Nullable data NSLog @"setGroupInfoDictionary success" ; onFailure:^ NSInteger code, NSString message NSLog @"setGroupInfoDictionary failed: %ld %@", long code, message ; ; Return value The onSuccess callback returns confirmation when the server accepts the friend permission configuration. State changes after the call 1. Local state update : The client updates the local cached group's applyMemberFriend property matching groupID . 2. Event notification : Group members receive an updated OIMGroupInfo object through the onGroupInfoChanged: listener callback. 3. Re query calibration : This setting only restricts friend application initiation. To prevent members from viewing other profiles entirely, refer to Set access to member profiles /sdk/ios/group/set group member profile access . For listener setup, refer to Groups overview /sdk/ios/group/overview group .

title: Mute or unmute the entire group
description: Enable or disable group-wide mute with OpenIM iOS SDK.
keywords: sdk ios v4 sdk ios group change-group-mute
content: Invoke changeGroupMute:isMute:onSuccess:onFailure: to enable or disable group wide muting typically restricted to group owners and administrators : Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | groupID | NSString | Yes | Target group ID. | | isMute | BOOL | Yes | Pass YES to enable group wide mute, or NO to disable. | Code example OIMManager manager changeGroupMute:groupID isMute:YES onSuccess:^ NSString Nullable data NSLog @"changeGroupMute success" ; onFailure:^ NSInteger code, NSString message NSLog @"changeGroupMute failed: %ld %@", long code, message ; ; Return value The onSuccess callback returns confirmation when the server accepts the group mute status change. State changes after the call 1. Local state update : The client updates the local cached group's status or mute attribute matching groupID . Regular members are prohibited from sending messages, while the group owner and administrators remain unaffected. 2. Event notification : All members in the group receive an updated OIMGroupInfo object via the onGroupInfoChanged: listener callback. 3. Re query calibration : To mute an individual member for a specified duration, refer to Mute or unmute a group member /sdk/ios/group/managing group members/change group member mute . For listener setup, refer to Groups overview /sdk/ios/group/overview group .

title: Apply to join a group
description: Apply to join or directly join an OpenIM group on iOS.
keywords: sdk ios v4 sdk ios group join-group
content: Invoke joinGroup:reqMsg:joinSource:ex:onSuccess:onFailure: to apply to join or directly enter a specified group: Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | groupID | NSString | Yes | Target group ID. | | reqMsg | NSString | No | Application note message; pass an empty string if not required. | | joinSource | OIMJoinType | Yes | Origin method of joining the group, such as OIMJoinTypeSearch . | | ex | NSString | No | Custom extension string; pass nil if not needed. | Code example OIMManager manager joinGroup:groupID reqMsg:@"Applying to join the discussion group" joinSource:OIMJoinTypeSearch ex:nil onSuccess:^ NSString Nullable data NSLog @"joinGroup success" ; onFailure:^ NSInteger code, NSString message NSLog @"joinGroup failed: %ld %@", long code, message ; ; Return value The onSuccess callback returns confirmation when the request is accepted by the server. State changes after the call 1. Direct join vs. review flow : If the target group permits direct joining without verification, the user enters the group immediately and receives an onJoinedGroupAdded: event. If the group requires administrator review, onSuccess confirms that the application ticket has been recorded, and the user must await approval. 2. Event notification : Successful group entries trigger onJoinedGroupAdded: . Application state tracking is documented in Group applications overview /sdk/ios/group/group applications/overview group applications . 3. Re query calibration : For group listener lifecycle details, refer to Groups overview /sdk/ios/group/overview group .

title: Leave a group
description: Leave a specified OpenIM group on iOS.
keywords: sdk ios v4 sdk ios group quit-group
content: Invoke quitGroup:onSuccess:onFailure: to voluntarily leave a specified group: Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | groupID | NSString | Yes | Target group ID. Regular members and administrators can exit directly; group owners must transfer ownership first via Transfer group ownership /sdk/ios/group/managing group members/transfer group owner . | Code example OIMManager manager quitGroup:groupID onSuccess:^ NSString Nullable data NSLog @"quitGroup success" ; onFailure:^ NSInteger code, NSString message NSLog @"quitGroup failed: %ld %@", long code, message ; ; Return value The onSuccess callback returns confirmation when the server accepts the group departure. State changes after the call 1. Local state removal : The client removes the group corresponding to groupID from the locally cached joined group collection. 2. Event notification : Active client sessions receive notifications through the onJoinedGroupDeleted: listener callback. 3. Re query calibration : For group listener lifecycle details, refer to Groups overview /sdk/ios/group/overview group .

title: Dismiss a group
description: Dismiss a specified OpenIM group as its owner on iOS.
keywords: sdk ios v4 sdk ios group dismiss-group
content: Invoke dismissGroup:onSuccess:onFailure: to permanently dissolve a specified group only the group owner has permission to perform this action : Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | groupID | NSString | Yes | Target group ID to dismiss. Only the group owner has permission. | Code example OIMManager manager dismissGroup:groupID onSuccess:^ NSString Nullable data NSLog @"dismissGroup success" ; onFailure:^ NSInteger code, NSString message NSLog @"dismissGroup failed: %ld %@", long code, message ; ; Return value The onSuccess callback returns confirmation when the server completes group dissolution. State changes after the call 1. Entity dissolution : Dissolving a group permanently destroys the group entity on the server, which is fundamentally distinct from locally hiding or deleting a conversation entry. 2. Event notification : All members of the group across devices receive the onGroupDismissed: listener callback, removing the group row and disabling message composition. 3. Re query calibration : For group listener lifecycle details, refer to Groups overview /sdk/ios/group/overview group .

title: Retrieve specified group profiles
description: Retrieve iOS group profiles by group ID.
keywords: sdk ios v4 sdk ios group retrieving-groups get-specified-groups-info
content: Invoke getSpecifiedGroupsInfo:onSuccess:onFailure: to query detailed profile snapshots for specified group IDs in a batch: Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | groupsID | NSArray | Yes | List of target group IDs to query. | Code example OIMManager manager getSpecifiedGroupsInfo:@ @"group 1001", @"group 1002" onSuccess:^ NSArray groups groupStore mergeGroups:groups ; onFailure:^ NSInteger code, NSString message NSLog @"getSpecifiedGroupsInfo failed: %ld %@", long code, message ; ; Return value The onSuccess callback delivers an array of matched OIMGroupInfo objects NSArray . When retrieving a single group, pass an array containing one ID and read the first result item; an empty array indicates that no matching groups were found. State changes after the call 1. Snapshot query : This method retrieves an instantaneous profile snapshot without triggering group delegate callbacks. 2. Local cache update : The client updates local cached group records using groupID as the primary key. 3. Event notification : Subsequent group profile updates across sessions broadcast via onGroupInfoChanged: . For listener setup, refer to Groups overview /sdk/ios/group/overview group .

title: Retrieve joined groups
description: Retrieve every iOS group joined by the current user.
keywords: sdk ios v4 sdk ios group retrieving-groups get-joined-group-list
content: Invoke getJoinedGroupListWithOnSuccess:onFailure: to retrieve a complete snapshot of all groups joined by the currently signed in user: Code example OIMManager manager getJoinedGroupListWithOnSuccess:^ NSArray groups self replaceGroups:groups ; onFailure:^ NSInteger code, NSString message NSLog @"getJoinedGroupList failed: %ld %@", long code, message ; ; This method requires no business parameters. If the account belongs to a large number of groups, prefer Retrieve joined groups by page /sdk/ios/group/retrieving groups/get joined group list page to avoid unbounded payloads. Return value The onSuccess callback delivers an array of OIMGroupInfo objects NSArray representing all groups joined by the user. State changes after the call 1. Snapshot query : This query retrieves an instantaneous snapshot without triggering delegate callbacks. 2. Local cache sync : The client updates or replaces its cached joined group collection using groupID as the primary key. 3. Event notification : Subsequent group joins or departures broadcast via onJoinedGroupAdded: and onJoinedGroupDeleted: . For listener setup, refer to Groups overview /sdk/ios/group/overview group .

title: Retrieve joined groups by page
description: Retrieve groups joined by the current user with pagination on iOS.
keywords: sdk ios v4 sdk ios group retrieving-groups get-joined-group-list-page
content: Invoke getJoinedGroupListPageWithOffset:count:onSuccess:onFailure: to retrieve groups joined by the current user with pagination: Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | offset | NSInteger | Yes | Pagination offset index; pass 0 for the initial page. | | count | NSInteger | Yes | Number of group items to fetch per page. | Code example OIMManager manager getJoinedGroupListPageWithOffset:0 count:50 onSuccess:^ NSArray groups self replaceFirstPage:groups ; onFailure:^ NSInteger code, NSString message NSLog @"getJoinedGroupListPage failed: %ld %@", long code, message ; ; Return value The onSuccess callback delivers an array of OIMGroupInfo objects NSArray representing the requested page. State changes after the call 1. Snapshot query : This method retrieves an instantaneous paginated slice without triggering group delegate callbacks. 2. Local pagination merge : When loading more items, increment offset by the count of received records and merge items idempotently using groupID . 3. Event notification : Subsequent additions or removals of joined groups broadcast via onJoinedGroupAdded: and onJoinedGroupDeleted: . For listener setup, refer to Groups overview /sdk/ios/group/overview group .

title: Check whether the current user joined a group
description: Check whether the current user has joined a specified iOS group.
keywords: sdk ios v4 sdk ios group retrieving-groups is-join-group
content: Invoke isJoinedGroup:onSuccess:onFailure: to check whether the currently signed in user is a member of a specified group: Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | groupID | NSString | Yes | Target group ID to inspect. | Code example OIMManager manager isJoinedGroup:@"group 1001" onSuccess:^ BOOL joined self updateJoinedState:joined ; onFailure:^ NSInteger code, NSString message NSLog @"isJoinedGroup failed: %ld %@", long code, message ; ; Return value The onSuccess callback delivers a boolean flag joined . YES indicates that the user is currently a group member; NO indicates that the user is not in the group or has departed. State changes after the call 1. Lightweight check : This method queries an instantaneous membership flag without triggering group delegate callbacks. 2. Operations and events : To join or leave a group, refer to Apply to join a group /sdk/ios/group/join group and Leave a group /sdk/ios/group/quit group . For membership change events, refer to Groups overview /sdk/ios/group/overview group .

title: Search groups
description: Search locally synchronized joined groups on iOS.
keywords: sdk ios v4 sdk ios group retrieving-groups search-groups

title: Group applications overview
description: Retrieve, process, and listen for group applications on iOS.
keywords: sdk ios v4 sdk ios group group-applications overview-group-applications
content: When a group enables join verification, member join requests require administrative review by the group owner or an administrator. Group applications are encapsulated by OIMGroupApplicationInfo models, using the composite key groupID:userID where userID is the applicant's user ID as the primary identifier for deduplication and local cache merges. Application operations Retrieve received group applications /sdk/ios/group/group applications/get group application list as recipient : Paginated query for incoming applications reviewed by owners and administrators. Retrieve sent group applications /sdk/ios/group/group applications/get group application list as applicant : Paginated query for outgoing applications submitted by the current user. Retrieve unhandled group application count /sdk/ios/group/group applications/get group application unhandled count : Count of pending review requests for badge and notification displays. Accept a group application /sdk/ios/group/group applications/accept group application : Approve a join request and admit the applicant into the group. Reject a group application /sdk/ios/group/group applications/refuse group application : Decline an incoming join request. Delete group application records /sdk/ios/group/group applications/delete group requests : Prune application history records from storage. Application event listeners Handle application lifecycle events by implementing the OIMGroupListener protocol: void startApplicationEvents OIMManager callbacker addGroupListener:self ; void stopApplicationEvents OIMManager callbacker removeGroupListener:self ; void onGroupApplicationAdded: OIMGroupApplicationInfo item // New group application received self upsertApplication:item ; void onGroupApplicationAccepted: OIMGroupApplicationInfo item // Group application accepted self upsertApplication:item ; void onGroupApplicationRejected: OIMGroupApplicationInfo item // Group application rejected self upsertApplication:item ; void onGroupApplicationDeleted: OIMGroupApplicationInfo item // Group application record deleted self removeApplication:item ; All application events use groupID:userID as the primary key. When new application notifications arrive during pagination, reset the pagination offset to 0 and re query the list to ensure accurate badge counts and item ordering.

title: Group member queries overview
description: Retrieve iOS group members and process member delegates.
keywords: sdk ios v4 sdk ios group retrieving-group-members overview-retrieving-group-members
content: The group member module maintains user associations within a group, including member roles owner, administrator, regular member , group specific nicknames, and individual muting configurations. In client state management, the composite identifier groupID:userID serves as the primary key for member deduplication and cache updates. Member query operations The iOS SDK provides several query interfaces across different dimensions: Retrieve group members by page /sdk/ios/group/retrieving group members/get group member list : Filter members by role and load the roster with pagination. Retrieve the group owner and administrators /sdk/ios/group/retrieving group members/get group member owner and admin : Rapidly fetch group management accounts without traversing the entire member roster. Retrieve specified group member profiles /sdk/ios/group/retrieving group members/get specified group members info : Query member cards and profile snapshots for known user IDs in a batch. Search group members /sdk/ios/group/retrieving group members/search group members : Search group members by user ID or group nickname keywords. Check users’ group membership /sdk/ios/group/retrieving group members/get users in group : Verify whether candidate users belong to the group without fetching complete profiles. Member event listeners When members join, leave, are removed, or change their profiles, the SDK dispatches delegate callbacks defined in OIMGroupListener : void startMemberEvents OIMManager callbacker addGroupListener:self ; void stopMemberEvents OIMManager callbacker removeGroupListener:self ; void onGroupMemberAdded: OIMGroupMemberInfo item // New member joined; merge into the local list keyed by groupID:userID self upsertMember:item ; void onGroupMemberDeleted: OIMGroupMemberInfo item // Member left or was removed; delete from local cache keyed by groupID:userID self removeMember:item ; void onGroupMemberInfoChanged: OIMGroupMemberInfo item // Member role, group nickname, or mute status changed; update locally self upsertMember:item ; Retain a stable listener object reference and pass the same instance when registering or removing listeners. If member change events arrive during paginated loading, reset offset to 0 and re query the list to prevent index drift and display inconsistencies.

State changes after the call 1. Snapshot query : This method queries a paginated slice of members without triggering delegate events. Increment offset by the received item count to load subsequent pages. 2. Mute status inspection : The iOS SDK does not provide a dedicated query endpoint exclusively for muted members; to display muted users, inspect muteEndTime on each OIMGroupMemberInfo model a timestamp greater than current Unix time indicates an active mute . 3. Event notification : Member additions, removals, and profile changes broadcast via listener callbacks. For listener setup, refer to Group member queries overview /sdk/ios/group/retrieving group members/overview retrieving group members .

content: Invoke setGroupMemberInfo:onSuccess:onFailure: with a parameter dictionary containing ex to set custom application defined extension data for a specified group member: Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | groupMemberInfoDictionary | NSDictionary | Yes | Dictionary containing member identification and updated extension string. | Dictionary keys | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | groupID | NSString | Yes | Target group ID. | | userID | NSString | Yes | Target member user ID. | | ex | NSString | Yes | Custom extension string typically formatted as JSON . | Code example NSDictionary updates = @ @"groupID": @"group 1001", @"userID": @"user 003", @"ex": @" \"level\":5,\"title\":\"Technical Lead\" " ; OIMManager manager setGroupMemberInfo:updates onSuccess:^ NSString Nullable data NSLog @"setGroupMemberInfo ex success" ; onFailure:^ NSInteger code, NSString message NSLog @"setGroupMemberInfo ex failed: %ld %@", long code, message ; ; Return value The onSuccess callback returns confirmation when the server saves the member extension string. The write operation completely replaces the stored extension string without merging nested keys. 2. Event notification : Updated member details broadcast across active client sessions through onGroupMemberInfoChanged: . 3. Re query calibration : For member queries, refer to Group member queries overview /sdk/ios/group/retrieving group members/overview retrieving group members .

title: Transfer group ownership
description: Transfer group ownership to another member with the Objective-C API.
keywords: sdk ios v4 sdk ios group managing-group-members transfer-group-owner
content: Invoke transferGroupOwner:newOwner:onSuccess:onFailure: to transfer group ownership to another existing member only the current group owner has permission to perform this action : Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | groupID | NSString | Yes | Target group ID. | | newOwner | NSString | Yes | User ID of the new group owner. | Code example OIMManager manager transferGroupOwner:@"group 1001" newOwner:@"user 002" onSuccess:^ NSString Nullable data NSLog @"transferGroupOwner success" ; onFailure:^ NSInteger code, NSString message NSLog @"transferGroupOwner failed: %ld %@", long code, message ; ; Return value The onSuccess callback returns confirmation when the server completes the ownership transfer. State changes after the call 1. Role transition : The former owner is demoted to a regular member, while the designated member is promoted to group owner. Both role updates broadcast via onGroupMemberInfoChanged: . 2. Local state merge : Merge updated roles for both affected users using groupID:userID . To refresh the management list immediately, call Retrieve the group owner and administrators /sdk/ios/group/retrieving group members/get group member owner and admin . 3. Leaving the group : A group owner wishing to exit must transfer ownership before calling Leave a group /sdk/ios/group/quit group , or dissolve the group with Dismiss a group /sdk/ios/group/dismiss group .

title: Mute or unmute a group member
description: Mute or unmute an iOS group member.
keywords: sdk ios v4 sdk ios group managing-group-members change-group-member-mute
content: Invoke changeGroupMemberMute:userID:mutedSeconds:onSuccess:onFailure: to mute or unmute a specified group member for a given duration restricted to group owners and administrators : Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | groupID | NSString | Yes | Target group ID. | | userID | NSString | Yes | Target member user ID. | | mutedSeconds | NSInteger | Yes | Duration of mute in seconds. Pass 0 to unmute the member. | Code example OIMManager manager changeGroupMemberMute:@"group 1001" userID:@"user 003" mutedSeconds:3600 onSuccess:^ NSString Nullable data NSLog @"changeGroupMemberMute success" ; onFailure:^ NSInteger code, NSString message NSLog @"changeGroupMemberMute failed: %ld %@", long code, message ; ; Return value The onSuccess callback returns confirmation when the server accepts the mute configuration. State changes after the call 1. Local state update : The member model's muteEndTime property is updated to reflect the Unix timestamp when muting expires. 2. Event notification : Updated member details broadcast across active client sessions through onGroupMemberInfoChanged: . The client merges state using groupID:userID . 3. Re query calibration : To mute all regular members in the group simultaneously, refer to Mute or unmute the entire group /sdk/ios/group/change group mute . For member queries, refer to Group member queries overview /sdk/ios/group/retrieving group members/overview retrieving group members .

title: Messages overview
description: Understand message creation, sending, reception, and local storage in OpenIM iOS SDK.
keywords: sdk ios v4 sdk ios message overview-message
content: Message capabilities in the OpenIM iOS SDK center on the OIMMessageInfo model. Plain text messages and media messages created from local files are initialized via corresponding OIMMessageInfo factory class methods, then sent through Send a message /sdk/ios/message/sending messages/send message . If media files have already been uploaded by your application to object storage and public URLs are available, create messages using URL based factory methods and send them via Send a message without OSS /sdk/ios/message/sending messages/send message not oss . Both delivery pathways support one to one and group chats. Incoming messages, message revocations, deletions, read receipts, media upload progress, and conversation updates synchronize to the application through listener protocols and delegates. Client side message interfaces and state stores maintain the following core identifiers: | Identifier | Description | | | | | clientMsgID | Stable client generated unique message identifier, used for list deduplication, state updates, queries, and pagination cursors. | | conversationID | Conversation record identifier, used for history queries, searching, and unread count tracking. Take directly from conversation data rather than deriving from array indices. | | recvID | Recipient user ID for one to one messages. Pass nil when sending group messages. | | groupID | Target group ID for group messages. Pass nil when sending one to one messages. | Message types Initialize OIMMessageInfo instances for each content type using dedicated class methods. The sending layer dispatches all message models uniformly without requiring separate transport channels for different formats. Message type comparison | Content type | Typical use case | Guide | | | | | | Plain text | Standard text chat messages. | Create a text message /sdk/ios/message/creating messages/create text message | | @ Mention text | Mention one or more members in a group chat. | Create an @ message /sdk/ios/message/creating messages/create text at message | | Image | Create image messages from local files or hosted URLs. | Create an image message from a local path /sdk/ios/message/creating messages/create image message from full path | | Audio | Create voice and sound recording messages. | Create an audio message from a local path /sdk/ios/message/creating messages/create sound message from full path | | Video | Create video messages with video snapshot covers. | Create a video message from a local path /sdk/ios/message/creating messages/create video message from full path | | File | Create general file attachments. | Create a file message from a local path /sdk/ios/message/creating messages/create file message from full path | | Custom message | Structured business payloads cards, red packets, orders . | Create a custom message /sdk/ios/message/creating messages/create custom message | | Markdown | Rich text formatted with Markdown syntax. | Create a Markdown message /sdk/ios/message/creating messages/create markdown message | When the SDK should handle media uploads, use path based factory methods and Send a message /sdk/ios/message/sending messages/send message . When your backend already hosts the files, use URL based creation methods and Send a message without OSS /sdk/ios/message/sending messages/send message not oss to bypass the built in upload pipeline. Store data that must be shared across devices inside the message payload, and store private rendering state in localEx . Common OIMMessageInfo properties | Property | Type | Description | | | | | | clientMsgID | NSString Nullable | Client message ID used as the primary deduplication and merge key. | | serverMsgID | NSString Nullable | Server message ID, which does not replace clientMsgID for local merging. | | sessionType | OIMConversationType | Conversation type one to one or group used to route the message. | | sendID | NSString Nullable | User ID of the message sender. | | recvID | NSString Nullable | User ID of the recipient in one to one chats. | | groupID | NSString Nullable | Group ID in group chats. | | contentType | OIMMessageContentType | Content type enumeration determining which element to parse and render. | | sendTime | NSTimeInterval | Timestamp when the message was sent, used for chronological sorting. | | status | OIMMessageStatus | Message dispatch status sending, succeeded, failed . | | isRead | BOOL | Read receipt status of the message. | Specific content properties such as textElem , pictureElem , soundElem , videoElem , fileElem , atTextElem , and customElem are populated based on contentType . Validate that both contentType and the corresponding element are non nil when rendering views, providing fallback placeholders if content is absent. Message handling pipeline 1. Construct the message object locally using an OIMMessageInfo factory method. 2. Call Send a message /sdk/ios/message/sending messages/send message or Send a message without OSS /sdk/ios/message/sending messages/send message not oss to dispatch to a user or group. 3. On the sender client, update UI bubble states using clientMsgID upon success or progress callbacks; receiving clients capture new messages via OIMAdvancedMsgListener . 4. When opening a conversation view, fetch an initial history snapshot, then maintain state by listening for incoming messages, revocations, deletions, and read receipts. Message creation factory methods instantiate models in local memory without initiating network requests or triggering events. Callback completion, asynchronous listener notifications, and cache reconciliation queries operate as three distinct stages. Conversation routing rules When sending one to one messages, supply recvID and set groupID to nil . When sending group messages, supply groupID and set recvID to nil . Deduplicate messages in local storage using clientMsgID scoped to conversationID ; never use array positions or text summaries as primary keys. Feature navigation Sending and receiving Send a message /sdk/ios/message/sending messages/send message : Dispatch local message instances with built in upload and progress tracking. Send a message without OSS /sdk/ios/message/sending messages/send message not oss : Dispatch messages initialized with pre hosted media URLs. Receive messages /sdk/ios/message/receiving messages/receive messages : Register message listeners to handle incoming real time and synchronized messages. Receive custom business messages /sdk/ios/message/receiving messages/custom business listener : Receive standalone business notification signals outside conversation message streams. Retrieval and searching Load older messages /sdk/ios/message/retrieving messages/load older messages : Retrieve historical messages by scrolling upward from an anchor message. Load newer messages /sdk/ios/message/retrieving messages/load newer messages : Retrieve newer messages downward from a historical anchor. Load message context /sdk/ios/message/retrieving messages/load message context : Read surrounding messages before and after a specified message. Find messages by ID /sdk/ios/message/retrieving messages/find messages by id : Retrieve specific messages by clientMsgID within a conversation. Search messages /sdk/ios/message/searching messages/search messages : Search locally synchronized chat history by keyword. Message management and read status Revoke a message /sdk/ios/message/managing messages/revoke a message : Revoke a sent message and notify connected clients. Delete a message /sdk/ios/message/managing messages/delete saved message : Delete a single locally stored message. Delete messages in batches /sdk/ios/message/managing messages/delete saved messages : Delete multiple historical messages in a batch. Modify a message /sdk/ios/message/managing messages/modify a message Commercial : Edit text content of a previously sent message. Pin or unpin a message /sdk/ios/message/managing messages/set message pinned Commercial : Pin or unpin a message within a conversation. Retrieve pinned messages /sdk/ios/message/managing messages/get pinned messages Commercial : Query the list of pinned messages in a conversation. Set local message extension /sdk/ios/message/managing messages/set message local ex : Store device local private metadata on a message. Send group message read receipts /sdk/ios/message/managing read status/send group read receipts : Acknowledge read status for messages in a group chat. Retrieve group message readers /sdk/ios/message/managing read status/get group message readers : Query read and unread member breakdowns for a group message. Composition and transcription Update typing status /sdk/ios/message/composing messages/update typing status : Send typing indicators to the peer during input changes. Retrieve typing status /sdk/ios/message/composing messages/get typing status : Inspect whether the other participant is actively typing. Transcribe audio /sdk/ios/message/composing messages/transcribe audio Commercial : Convert voice messages to text. Save local transcript /sdk/ios/message/composing messages/save local transcript Commercial : Persist transcribed speech text into local message extension storage. Check speech to text availability /sdk/ios/message/composing messages/check speech to text Commercial : Check whether voice transcription is supported on the server. Set the app badge count /sdk/ios/message/set app badge : Synchronize total unread message counts to the system push badge.

title: Create a text message
description: Create a text message with OpenIM iOS SDK.
keywords: sdk ios v4 sdk ios message creating-messages create-text-message
content: Invoke createTextMessage: on OIMMessageInfo to construct an in memory plain text message object ready for delivery: Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | text | NSString | Yes | Plain text body content. Handle whitespace validation and maximum character length limits before calling. | Code example OIMMessageInfo message = OIMMessageInfo createTextMessage:text ; Return value Returns an initialized OIMMessageInfo model with its content type set to plain text. State changes after the call 1. Local memory instantiation : This synchronous factory method instantiates an object in memory only. It does not save records to local storage, establish network connections, or trigger listener events. 2. Subsequent dispatch : Send the message to a user or group conversation by calling Send a message /sdk/ios/message/sending messages/send message .

title: Create an @ message
description: Create a text message that mentions specified group members with OpenIM iOS SDK.
keywords: sdk ios v4 sdk ios message creating-messages create-text-at-message
content: Invoke createTextAtMessage:atUsersID:atUsersInfo:message: on OIMMessageInfo to construct a text message mentioning one or more specific group members: Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | text | NSString | Yes | The text content including @ mention display strings. | | atUsersID | NSArray | Yes | List of user IDs corresponding to mentioned group members. | | atUsersInfo | NSArray | Yes | List of display models providing member nicknames for UI rendering. | | message | OIMMessageInfo Nullable | No | Quoted reference message; pass nil if no message is being quoted. | Code example OIMAtInfo info = OIMAtInfo new ; info.atUserID = member.userID; info.groupNickname = member.nickname; OIMMessageInfo message = OIMMessageInfo createTextAtMessage:text atUsersID:@ member.userID atUsersInfo:@ info message:nil ; Return value Returns an initialized OIMMessageInfo model with its content type set to @ mention text. State changes after the call 1. Local memory instantiation : This method creates an in memory object without writing to the database or triggering network requests. 2. Subsequent dispatch : Deliver this message to a group conversation by calling Send a message /sdk/ios/message/sending messages/send message .

title: Create an @all message
description: Create a message that mentions every group member with OpenIM iOS SDK.
keywords: sdk ios v4 sdk ios message creating-messages create-text-at-all-message
content: Invoke createTextAtAllMessage:displayText:message: on OIMMessageInfo to construct a message that mentions every member of a group: Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | text | NSString | Yes | The complete message text. | | displayText | NSString | Yes | The display placeholder string representing all members such as @All . | | message | OIMMessageInfo Nullable | No | Quoted message reference; pass nil if not quoting. | Code example OIMMessageInfo message = OIMMessageInfo createTextAtAllMessage:@"@All Please review the announcement" displayText:@"@All" message:nil ; Return value Returns an initialized OIMMessageInfo model configured with an all members mention. State changes after the call 1. Local memory instantiation : This method builds an object in memory only. Whether the current user is authorized to send @all notifications is enforced by server policies during dispatch. 2. Subsequent dispatch : Deliver this message to a group conversation by calling Send a message /sdk/ios/message/sending messages/send message .

title: Create an @all marker
description: Create an all-members mention marker with OpenIM iOS SDK.
keywords: sdk ios v4 sdk ios message creating-messages create-at-all-flag
content: Invoke createAtAllFlag: on OIMMessageInfo to construct an OIMAtInfo model representing all group members when assembling custom @ mention structures: Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | displayText | NSString | Yes | The placeholder text to display in the UI such as @All . | Code example OIMAtInfo atAll = OIMMessageInfo createAtAllFlag:@"@All" ; Return value Returns an initialized OIMAtInfo instance configured to designate all group members. This marker does not represent a real user account and serves strictly as an all member indicator in @ messages. State changes after the call 1. Local memory instantiation : This method builds an in memory OIMAtInfo instance without making network calls. 2. Usage : Supply this instance in the atUsersInfo parameter when assembling compound mention messages via Create an @ message /sdk/ios/message/creating messages/create text at message .

title: Retrieve the @all tag
description: Retrieve the special all-members tag defined by OpenIM iOS SDK.
keywords: sdk ios v4 sdk ios message creating-messages get-at-all-tag
content: Invoke getAtAllTag on OIMMessageInfo to obtain the SDK's internal constant string used to identify an all members mention: Code example NSString tag = OIMMessageInfo getAtAllTag ; Return value Returns the constant placeholder string used by the SDK to represent all group members. This string is not a valid user ID and is used to detect whether an incoming group message targets everyone. For constructing all member messages, refer to Create an @all message /sdk/ios/message/creating messages/create text at all message .

title: Create a custom message
description: Create a structured application-defined message with OpenIM iOS SDK.
keywords: sdk ios v4 sdk ios message creating-messages create-custom-message
content: Invoke createCustomMessage:extension:description: on OIMMessageInfo to construct a message carrying structured business payloads such as order cards, polls, red packets, or custom transfer receipts : Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | data | NSString | Yes | Serialized custom business JSON payload string. | | extension | NSString | Yes | Custom protocol identifier or payload type such as com.example.order . | | description | NSString | Yes | Fallback summary string displayed in conversation previews or legacy clients. | Code example OIMMessageInfo message = OIMMessageInfo createCustomMessage:jsonString extension:@"com.example.order" description:@" Order Card " ; Return value Returns an initialized OIMMessageInfo instance configured as a custom message. State changes after the call 1. Local memory instantiation : This method creates an in memory object only. Receiving clients must validate protocol schemas; critical business states such as payment processing must be verified by backend servers. 2. Subsequent dispatch : Deliver this message to a user or group conversation by calling Send a message /sdk/ios/message/sending messages/send message .

title: Create an image message from a local path
description: Create an image message from an absolute path with OpenIM iOS SDK.

content: Invoke createImageMessageFromFullPath: on OIMMessageInfo to construct an image message from an absolute file path in the local application sandbox. The SDK automatically extracts image dimensions and performs object storage uploads during dispatch: Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | imagePath | NSString | Yes | Absolute path to the image file within the application sandbox. | Code example OIMMessageInfo message = OIMMessageInfo createImageMessageFromFullPath:imageURL.path ; Return value Returns an initialized OIMMessageInfo model with its content type set to image. State changes after the call 1. Local memory instantiation : This method builds an in memory model without writing to the database or uploading files immediately. 2. Subsequent dispatch : Call Send a message /sdk/ios/message/sending messages/send message to initiate built in media uploading and message dispatch. If the image is already hosted externally, use Create an image message from a URL /sdk/ios/message/creating messages/create image message by url .

title: Create an image message from a URL
description: Create an image message from a previously uploaded URL with OpenIM iOS SDK.
keywords: sdk ios v4 sdk ios message creating-messages create-image-message-by-url
content: When the application has already uploaded image assets to object storage and possesses remote URLs, invoke createImageMessageByURL:sourcePicture:bigPicture:snapshotPicture: on OIMMessageInfo to construct an image message object directly without redundant uploads by the SDK: Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | sourcePath | NSString | Yes | Local source path. Pass an empty string @"" when referencing remote resources directly. | | sourcePicture | OIMPictureInfo | Yes | Original image metadata object containing remote URL, dimensions, and file size. | | bigPicture | OIMPictureInfo | Yes | High resolution image metadata object. | | snapshotPicture | OIMPictureInfo | Yes | Thumbnail image metadata object. | Code example OIMMessageInfo message = OIMMessageInfo createImageMessageByURL:@"" sourcePicture:source bigPicture:big snapshotPicture:snapshot ; Return value Returns an initialized OIMMessageInfo model populated with the remote image information. The URLs, dimensions, and file sizes across all three OIMPictureInfo objects must represent valid remote assets. State changes after the call 1. Local memory instantiation : This method constructs an in memory message object without writing to the local database or initiating network requests. 2. Subsequent dispatch : Because media assets are already uploaded, deliver the message by calling Send a message without SDK managed upload /sdk/ios/message/sending messages/send message not oss . If you want the SDK to handle local file upload automatically, use Create an image message from a local path /sdk/ios/message/creating messages/create image message from full path .

title: Create a location message
description: Create a location message with OpenIM iOS SDK.
keywords: sdk ios v4 sdk ios message creating-messages create-location-message
content: Invoke createLocationMessage:latitude:longitude: on OIMMessageInfo to construct a location message object containing geographical coordinates and a text description: Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | description | NSString | Yes | Location name or detailed address description text. | | latitude | double | Yes | Latitude coordinate value. | | longitude | double | Yes | Longitude coordinate value. | Code example OIMMessageInfo message = OIMMessageInfo createLocationMessage:@"Pudong New Area, Shanghai" latitude:31.2304 longitude:121.4737 ; Return value Returns an initialized OIMMessageInfo model with its content type set to location. State changes after the call 1. Local memory instantiation : This method builds an in memory message model without persisting records to local storage or making network requests. 2. Coordinate system coordination : The SDK does not invoke system location services or perform coordinate conversions. Ensure that sender and receiver clients agree on a coordinate system convention such as WGS 84 or GCJ 02 . 3. Subsequent dispatch : Call Send a message /sdk/ios/message/sending messages/send message to deliver the location message.

title: Create an emoji message
description: Create an emoji message with OpenIM iOS SDK.
keywords: sdk ios v4 sdk ios message creating-messages create-face-message
content: Invoke createFaceMessageWithIndex:data: on OIMMessageInfo to construct an in app sticker or custom face emoji message object: Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | index | NSInteger | Yes | Numeric index of the sticker within the sticker package. | | data | NSString | Yes | Sticker protocol identifier, key name, or custom JSON string. | Code example OIMMessageInfo message = OIMMessageInfo createFaceMessageWithIndex:1 data:@"smile" ; Return value Returns an initialized OIMMessageInfo model with its content type set to custom emoji/sticker. State changes after the call 1. Local memory instantiation : This method builds an in memory message object without writing to the database or initiating network requests. 2. Sticker protocol agreement : The semantics of index and data are defined by the application layer. Ensure that the sending and receiving clients adhere to matching sticker resources and provide fallback rendering for unrecognized emojis. 3. Subsequent dispatch : Call Send a message /sdk/ios/message/sending messages/send message to deliver the sticker message.

title: Create a reply message
description: Create a quoted reply with OpenIM iOS SDK.
keywords: sdk ios v4 sdk ios message creating-messages create-quote-message
content: Invoke createQuoteMessage:message: on OIMMessageInfo to construct a reply message object quoting an existing original message: Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | text | NSString | Yes | Body text of the new reply message. | | message | OIMMessageInfo | Yes | Original message object being quoted, typically obtained from the active conversation list. | Code example OIMMessageInfo message = OIMMessageInfo createQuoteMessage:@"Agreed with this approach" message:originalMessage ; Return value Returns an initialized OIMMessageInfo model with its content type set to quoted reply. State changes after the call 1. Local memory instantiation : This method builds a new in memory message object and does not mutate the original quoted message. 2. Subsequent dispatch : Call Send a message /sdk/ios/message/sending messages/send message to deliver the quoted reply.

title: Create a rich-text message
description: Create an advanced text message with entity annotations using OpenIM iOS SDK.
keywords: sdk ios v4 sdk ios message creating-messages create-advanced-text-message
content: Invoke createAdvancedTextMessage:messageEntityList: on OIMMessageInfo to construct a rich text message containing formatted entity spans such as hyperlinks, tags, or mentions : Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | text | NSString | Yes | Complete plain text body of the rich text message. | | messageEntityList | NSArray | Yes | Array of rich text entity objects defining formatting spans. Each entity specifies type , offset , length , and optional target URL or metadata. | Code example OIMMessageInfo message = OIMMessageInfo createAdvancedTextMessage:text messageEntityList:entities ; Return value Returns an initialized OIMMessageInfo model with its content type set to advanced text. State changes after the call 1. Local memory instantiation : This method builds an in memory message model without persisting records to local storage or making network requests. 2. Span boundary alignment : Ensure that the offset and length of each entity accurately correspond to character indices within text . 3. Subsequent dispatch : Call Send a message /sdk/ios/message/sending messages/send message to deliver the rich text message.

title: Create a Markdown message
description: Create a Markdown message through OpenIMCore on iOS.
keywords: sdk ios v4 sdk ios message creating-messages create-markdown-message
content: Use the underlying OpenIMCore C function Open im sdkCreateMarkdownMessage to construct a message data structure formatted with Markdown syntax: Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | payloadJSON | NSString | Yes | JSON string containing Markdown body text in the format "content": " Markdown text " . | Code example NSString payloadJSON = @" \"content\":\" Project Update \" "; NSString messageJSON = Open im sdkCreateMarkdownMessage payloadJSON ; OIMMessageInfo message = OIMMessageInfo mj objectWithKeyValues:messageJSON ; Return value The core function returns a JSON string representing the created message. Parse this string into an OIMMessageInfo instance whose body content resides in markdownTextElem.content . State changes after the call 1. Local memory instantiation : This function builds an in memory message structure without persisting to local storage or making network calls. 2. Parsing and sanitization : Creation, deserialization, and network transmission are separate stages. Rendering components should sanitize untrusted Markdown and provide text fallbacks if rendering fails. 3. Subsequent dispatch : Call Send a message /sdk/ios/message/sending messages/send message to deliver the Markdown message.

title: Create a forwarded message
description: Create a single-message forward with OpenIM iOS SDK.
keywords: sdk ios v4 sdk ios message creating-messages create-forward-message
content: Invoke createForwardMessage: on OIMMessageInfo to construct a new forwarded message object copied from an existing historical message: Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | message | OIMMessageInfo | Yes | Source message object to forward, typically obtained from conversation history. | Code example OIMMessageInfo message = OIMMessageInfo createForwardMessage:sourceMessage ; Return value Returns a new initialized OIMMessageInfo model with its own unique clientMsgID . The original message content and delivery state remain unchanged. State changes after the call 1. Local memory instantiation : This method builds an in memory message object without altering the source message record or committing new entries to local storage. 2. Subsequent dispatch : Call Send a message /sdk/ios/message/sending messages/send message to deliver the forwarded message to the desired user or group conversation.

title: Create a merged message
description: Create a merged message forward with OpenIM iOS SDK.
keywords: sdk ios v4 sdk ios message creating-messages create-merge-message
content: Invoke createMergeMessage:title:summaryList: on OIMMessageInfo to package multiple historical messages into a single merged forward card message: Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | messageList | NSArray | Yes | Array of historical message objects to be bundled together. | | title | NSString | Yes | Title displayed on the outer bubble of the merged message card e.g. Chat History . | | summaryList | NSArray | Yes | Preview summary snippets displayed in the merged card body. | Code example OIMMessageInfo message = OIMMessageInfo createMergeMessage:selectedMessages title:@"Chat History" summaryList:summaries ; Return value Returns an initialized OIMMessageInfo model with its content type set to merged message. State changes after the call 1. Local memory instantiation : This method builds an in memory message model and does not mutate any of the bundled source messages. 2. Subsequent dispatch : Call Send a message /sdk/ios/message/sending messages/send message to deliver the merged forward card.

title: Send a message
description: Send a prepared message object with OpenIM iOS SDK.
keywords: sdk ios v4 sdk ios message sending-messages send-message
content: Invoke sendMessage:recvID:groupID:isOnlineOnly:offlinePushInfo:onProgress:onSuccess:onFailure: on OIMManager to dispatch a prepared message object to a user or group conversation. For rich media messages, the SDK manages local database insertion and object storage uploads while notifying progress callbacks: Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | message | OIMMessageInfo | Yes | Prepared message object created by factory methods. | | recvID | NSString | Conditional | Receiver user ID for one to one chats. Required for single chat; pass nil for group messages. | | groupID | NSString | Conditional | Target group ID for group chats. Required for group chat; pass nil for single messages. recvID and groupID are mutually exclusive. | | isOnlineOnly | BOOL | Yes | Whether the message is delivered to online users only. Set to YES to bypass offline storage and push notifications; normally set to NO . | | offlinePushInfo | OIMOfflinePushInfo | No | Custom offline push configuration including title, description, and pass through payload. Pass nil for defaults. | | onProgress | OIMNumberCallback | No | Upload progress callback returning values from 0 to 100 . Non media messages do not trigger this callback. | | onSuccess | void ^ OIMMessageInfo sent | Yes | Success callback returning the confirmed message model. | | onFailure | OIMFailureCallback | Yes | Failure callback returning error code code and descriptive message msg . | Code example OIMManager manager sendMessage:message recvID:receiverUserID groupID:nil isOnlineOnly:NO offlinePushInfo:nil onProgress:^ NSInteger progress // Rich media upload progress 0 to 100 messageStore updateProgress:progress clientMsgID:message.clientMsgID ; onSuccess:^ OIMMessageInfo sent // Delivery succeeded; merge confirmed message by clientMsgID if sent = nil messageStore upsert:sent ; onFailure:^ NSInteger code, NSString Nullable msg // Handle message delivery failure ; Return value The onSuccess callback receives the confirmed OIMMessageInfo model returned by the server. The client merge key is clientMsgID scoped to conversationID when organizing multi conversation caches . State changes after the call 1. Local write and upload : Sending rich media initiates local database insertion, asset uploading with progress notifications, and subsequent network dispatch. 2. Delivery confirmation vs receipt : Success callback confirms that the server accepted the message. Counterparty arrival notifications and history queries represent distinct synchronization stages. 3. Incoming message handling : For incoming message event listeners and UI update flows, see Receive messages /sdk/ios/message/receiving messages/receive messages .

title: Send a message without SDK-managed upload
description: Send a message that already contains remote resource URLs with OpenIM iOS SDK.
keywords: sdk ios v4 sdk ios message sending-messages send-message-not-oss
