content: Invoke sendMessageNotOss:recvID:groupID:isOnlineOnly:offlinePushInfo:onProgress:onSuccess:onFailure: on OIMManager when your application has already uploaded images, audio, video, or files to external storage and built a message using a URL factory method. This dispatches the message directly without triggering SDK managed upload flows: Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | urlMessage | OIMMessageInfo | Yes | Prepared message object already containing remote resource URLs. | | recvID | NSString | Conditional | Receiver user ID for one to one chats. Required for single chat; pass nil for group messages. | | groupID | NSString | Conditional | Target group ID for group chats. Required for group chat; pass nil for single messages. recvID and groupID are mutually exclusive. | | isOnlineOnly | BOOL | Yes | Whether the message is delivered to online users only. Set to YES to bypass offline storage and push notifications; normally set to NO . | | offlinePushInfo | OIMOfflinePushInfo | No | Custom offline push configuration including title, description, and pass through payload. Pass nil for defaults. | | onProgress | OIMNumberCallback | No | Progress callback. Typically pass nil because resources are already uploaded. | | onSuccess | void ^ OIMMessageInfo sent | Yes | Success callback returning the confirmed message model. | | onFailure | OIMFailureCallback | Yes | Failure callback returning error code code and descriptive message msg . | Code example OIMManager manager sendMessageNotOss:urlMessage recvID:receiverUserID groupID:nil isOnlineOnly:NO offlinePushInfo:nil onProgress:nil onSuccess:^ OIMMessageInfo sent // Delivery succeeded; merge confirmed message by clientMsgID if sent = nil messageStore upsert:sent ; onFailure:^ NSInteger code, NSString Nullable msg // Handle message delivery failure ; Return value The onSuccess callback receives the confirmed OIMMessageInfo model returned by the server. The client merge key is clientMsgID scoped to conversationID when organizing multi conversation caches . State changes after the call 1. Bypassing storage uploads : The SDK performs local record insertion and direct network dispatch without uploading media assets. 2. Metadata verification : Ensure that the asset URLs, file sizes, MIME types, dimensions, and playback durations inside urlMessage represent valid remote resources. 3. Incoming message handling : For incoming message event listeners and UI update flows, see Receive messages /sdk/ios/message/receiving messages/receive messages .

title: Receive messages
description: Register the iOS message listener and merge new messages into conversation state.
keywords: sdk ios v4 sdk ios message receiving-messages receive-messages
content: The iOS SDK delivers regular new messages, online only messages, revocations, deletions, and read receipts through OIMAdvancedMsgListener . Register the listener once when initializing the message state layer and retain the listener strongly because OIMCallbacker holds only a weak reference. Message types Each regular event returns one OIMMessageInfo . Choose text, @ text, custom, image, audio, video, file, or fallback rendering according to the message element. Do not assume that every message contains textElem . For media messages, read the remote URL, size, name, duration, and snapshot from the element; do not upload the resource again. A message may belong to a conversation that is not currently open. Determine the target conversation first from sessionType , sendID , recvID , and groupID , then merge idempotently by clientMsgID . Common OIMMessageInfo properties used for reception, routing, and merging are: | Property | Type | Description | | | | | | clientMsgID | NSString Nullable | Client message ID; use it as the stable unique merge key when non empty. | | serverMsgID | NSString Nullable | Server message ID. It does not replace clientMsgID for local merging. | | sessionType | OIMConversationType | Conversation type enum used to determine single or group chat routing. | | sendID | NSString Nullable | Sender user ID. | | recvID | NSString Nullable | Recipient user ID. | | groupID | NSString Nullable | Target group ID for group messages. | | contentType | OIMMessageContentType | Content type enum determining which content element to render. | | sendTime | NSTimeInterval | Message dispatch timestamp used for sorting; cannot serve as a unique ID. | | status | OIMMessageStatus | Message delivery status enum. | | isRead | BOOL | Read receipt state recorded by the SDK. | Content properties such as textElem , pictureElem , soundElem , videoElem , fileElem , atTextElem , and customElem may be nil . Check both contentType and the corresponding element when rendering. Display fallback placeholders when expected content is missing instead of force unwrapping. Register the new message listener @interface MessageStore @end @implementation MessageStore void startListening OIMManager callbacker addAdvancedMsgListener:self ; void stopListening OIMManager callbacker removeAdvancedMsgListener:self ; void onRecvNewMessage: OIMMessageInfo Nullable message if message.clientMsgID.length == 0 return; self mergeMessage:message ; void onRecvOnlineOnlyMessage: OIMMessageInfo Nullable message if message.clientMsgID.length == 0 return; self handleOnlineOnlyMessage:message ; @end Register the global message listener after initSDK succeeds and before login . Remove the listener with the same instance when signing out, switching accounts, or destroying the state layer. The callback message parameter can be nil , so validate clientMsgID before processing. Each callback delivers a single OIMMessageInfo model. Online only messages are not stored in regular offline history and are suitable for transient hints or business notifications. For sending parameters, see Send a message /sdk/ios/message/sending messages/send message . Merge messages Resolve the target conversation from routing fields first, then merge idempotently by clientMsgID . A new message event can overlap with a send success callback or history query result, so never append it directly without deduplication. History queries establish the baseline snapshot, onRecvNewMessage: provides online increments, and the SDK synchronizes offline changes upon logging in. After synchronization completes, re query the current conversation's history to reconcile list state. Retrieve history when first opening a conversation Event callbacks only supply newly arriving messages. Use getAdvancedHistoryMessageList:onSuccess:onFailure: to retrieve history when opening a conversation, scrolling upward, or refreshing a list after synchronization. Set startClientMsgID to nil for the first page and use the boundary message's clientMsgID for subsequent pages. See Load message history /sdk/ios/message/retrieving messages/load older messages for details. The query callback returns a snapshot of messages and does not trigger the new message listener. Both pagination and incoming events must use identical conversation routing and clientMsgID deduplication rules. Mark the conversation as read After the user opens the conversation and views visible messages, invoke the mark as read API to clear the unread counter. For one to one chat receipts, see Mark a conversation as read /sdk/ios/conversation/managing conversations/mark conversation read . For member level group receipts, see Report group message read status /sdk/ios/message/managing read status/send group read receipts . Other message events For message revocation handling, see Revoke a message /sdk/ios/message/managing messages/revoke a message . For deletion events, see Delete messages in batches /sdk/ios/message/managing messages/delete saved messages . For one to one read receipts, see Mark a conversation as read /sdk/ios/conversation/managing conversations/mark conversation read ; for group read receipts, see Report group message read status /sdk/ios/message/managing read status/send group read receipts . For custom business notifications, see Receive custom business messages /sdk/ios/message/receiving messages/custom business listener . Query APIs, local insertion, and message creation do not trigger onRecvNewMessage: . Verify the receiving flow Send a message to the target one to one or group chat from another account and verify that it merges exactly once by conversation and clientMsgID . Send an online only message and verify that it arrives through onRecvOnlineOnlyMessage: and is not returned by history queries. Revoke or delete a message and verify that the message view updates the corresponding bubble by clientMsgID . After signing out or switching accounts, verify that the listener was removed and does not process duplicate messages after the next login.

title: Receive custom business messages
description: Register and remove the custom-business notification listener in OpenIM iOS SDK.
keywords: sdk ios v4 sdk ios message receiving-messages custom-business-listener
content: The custom business message listener receives server pushed business notifications or custom signaling data. Unlike custom chat messages delivered within regular conversations, these notifications are typically used for audio/video room signaling, real time control directives, or custom cross device state synchronization. Register and remove the listener Retain a strong reference to your OIMCustomBusinessListener instance in your state management layer, and unregister it when the session ends or during logout: // Register the custom business message listener OIMManager callbacker addCustomBusinessListener:businessListener ; // Remove the listener when destroying components or signing out OIMManager callbacker removeCustomBusinessListener:businessListener ; Event callback handling In your class conforming to OIMCustomBusinessListener , implement the message reception callback: void onRecvCustomBusinessMessage: NSString Nullable businessMessage if businessMessage.length == 0 return; // Parse business JSON payload and dispatch accordingly State changes after the call 1. Payload verification : The message string supplied to the callback may be nil or empty. Validate the JSON protocol version, message type, and mandatory fields before consumption. 2. Idempotency handling : Process business actions using application level idempotency identifiers such as a business transaction ID or serial number to prevent duplicate execution. 3. Regular custom messages : Custom messages sent within regular conversations such as red packets, stickers, or contact cards arrive through the standard message listener instead. See Receive messages /sdk/ios/message/receiving messages/receive messages .

title: Set the app badge count
description: Synchronize the app's current unread count with the OpenIMClientSDK push badge state.
keywords: sdk ios v4 sdk ios message set-app-badge
content: Invoke setAppBadge:onSuccess:onFailure: to report the application's overall unread message count to the SDK, synchronizing badge numbers with the server and push notification services: Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | count | NSInteger | Yes | The aggregate total unread message count across the entire application non negative integer . Pass the global unread count rather than a single conversation's count. | Code example OIMManager manager setAppBadge:totalUnreadCount onSuccess:^ NSString Nullable data NSLog @"setAppBadge success" ; onFailure:^ NSInteger code, NSString Nullable msg NSLog @"setAppBadge failed: %ld %@", long code, msg ; ; Return value The onSuccess callback returns confirmation when the SDK successfully records the badge count. State changes after the call 1. Push service synchronization : This call updates badge metadata for backend push delivery; it does not alter conversation level unread records. To update the app icon badge on the iOS home screen, pair this call with Apple's user notification framework. 2. Re query calibration : For unread counter calculation and listener maintenance, refer to Retrieve and maintain the total unread count /sdk/ios/conversation/managing conversations/get total unread count .

title: Load message history
description: Retrieve conversation history by page with OpenIM iOS SDK.
keywords: sdk ios v4 sdk ios message retrieving-messages load-older-messages
content: When entering a conversation or pulling down to view earlier messages, invoke getAdvancedHistoryMessageList:onSuccess:onFailure: on OIMManager to query history paginated backward in time: Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | opts | OIMGetAdvancedHistoryMessageListParam | Yes | Query configuration parameters object. | Properties of OIMGetAdvancedHistoryMessageListParam | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | conversationID | NSString | Yes | Target conversation identifier. | | startClientMsgID | NSString Nullable | No | Client message ID clientMsgID of the pagination anchor message. Pass nil for the initial page of latest history; pass the topmost message's clientMsgID when loading earlier messages. | | count | NSInteger | Yes | Maximum number of messages to retrieve per page. | | viewType | OIMGetHistoryViewType | Yes | History query view type typically OIMGetHistoryViewTypeHistory . | Code example OIMGetAdvancedHistoryMessageListParam param = OIMGetAdvancedHistoryMessageListParam new ; param.conversationID = conversationID; param.startClientMsgID = startClientMsgID; param.count = 20; param.viewType = OIMGetHistoryViewTypeHistory; OIMManager manager getAdvancedHistoryMessageList:param onSuccess:^ OIMGetAdvancedHistoryMessageListInfo Nullable result // Prepend retrieved messages and update pagination boundaries self prependMessages:result.messageList ?: @ ; onFailure:^ NSInteger code, NSString Nullable msg // Handle retrieval failure ; Return value The onSuccess callback delivers an OIMGetAdvancedHistoryMessageListInfo instance containing: messageList : Array of retrieved OIMMessageInfo models NSArray . isEnd : Boolean indicating whether the beginning of conversation history has been reached. When YES , stop further backward pagination. lastMinSeq : Minimum sequence number in the current retrieved chunk. State changes after the call 1. Snapshot establishment : History queries establish or extend the local message snapshot. Calling this method does not trigger incoming message event listeners. 2. Deduplication : Retrieved historical messages may overlap with messages received via real time listeners. Merge items into the UI list idempotently using clientMsgID scoped to conversationID . 3. Forward pagination : If you need to retrieve messages moving forward from a specific historical anchor, see Load message history in reverse /sdk/ios/message/retrieving messages/load newer messages .

title: Load message history in reverse
description: Retrieve history toward newer messages from an anchor with OpenIM iOS SDK.
keywords: sdk ios v4 sdk ios message retrieving-messages load-newer-messages
content: When navigating to a specific message via search results, notifications, or reply references, invoke getAdvancedHistoryMessageListReverse:onSuccess:onFailure: on OIMManager to load newer messages chronologically forward from that anchor message: Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | opts | OIMGetAdvancedHistoryMessageListParam | Yes | Query configuration parameters object. | Properties of OIMGetAdvancedHistoryMessageListParam | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | conversationID | NSString | Yes | Target conversation identifier. | | startClientMsgID | NSString | Yes | Anchor message's clientMsgID . The SDK retrieves pages of newer messages starting after this message. | | count | NSInteger | Yes | Maximum number of messages to retrieve per page. | | viewType | OIMGetHistoryViewType | Yes | History query view type typically OIMGetHistoryViewTypeHistory . | Code example OIMGetAdvancedHistoryMessageListParam param = OIMGetAdvancedHistoryMessageListParam new ; param.conversationID = conversationID; param.startClientMsgID = anchorMessage.clientMsgID; param.count = 20; param.viewType = OIMGetHistoryViewTypeHistory; OIMManager manager getAdvancedHistoryMessageListReverse:param onSuccess:^ OIMGetAdvancedHistoryMessageListInfo Nullable result // Append retrieved newer messages to the bottom of the list self appendMessages:result.messageList ?: @ ; onFailure:^ NSInteger code, NSString Nullable msg // Handle retrieval failure ; Return value The onSuccess callback delivers an OIMGetAdvancedHistoryMessageListInfo instance containing: messageList : Array of retrieved messages sorted in ascending chronological order NSArray . isEnd : Boolean indicating whether the newest message boundary in the conversation has been reached. lastMinSeq : Minimum sequence number in the current retrieved chunk. State changes after the call 1. Snapshot loading : Reverse pagination retrieves existing message snapshots on demand and does not trigger incoming message listeners. 2. Scroll state coordination : Avoid mixing forward and backward pagination arbitrarily at the same scroll boundary. Deduplicate messages using clientMsgID scoped to conversationID . For standard backward history queries, see Load message history /sdk/ios/message/retrieving messages/load older messages .

title: Find messages by ID
description: Locate messages by conversationID and clientMsgID with OpenIM iOS SDK.
keywords: sdk ios v4 sdk ios message retrieving-messages find-messages-by-id
content: By specifying a list of conversation IDs and client message IDs, invoke findMessageList:onSuccess:onFailure: on OIMManager to locate specific historical messages stored locally: Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | paramList | NSArray | Yes | Array of search criteria models. Supports querying across multiple conversations in a single request. | Properties of OIMFindMessageListParam | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | conversationID | NSString | Yes | Target conversation identifier. | | clientMsgIDList | NSArray | Yes | Array of client message IDs clientMsgID to look up. | Code example OIMFindMessageListParam query = OIMFindMessageListParam new ; query.conversationID = conversationID; query.clientMsgIDList = @ clientMsgID ; OIMManager manager findMessageList:@ query onSuccess:^ OIMSearchResultInfo Nullable result OIMSearchResultItemInfo item = result.findResultItems.firstObject; OIMMessageInfo message = item.messageList.firstObject; if message = nil self openMessage:message conversationID:item.conversationID ; onFailure:^ NSInteger code, NSString Nullable msg // Handle lookup failure ; Return value The onSuccess callback delivers an OIMSearchResultInfo model containing: totalCount : Total number of matching messages found across all queried conversations. findResultItems : Array of conversation results NSArray . Each item includes conversationID and its corresponding messageList . State changes after the call 1. Local cache reading : This method only queries the local storage database and does not trigger incoming message listeners. 2. Missing or deleted records : If the local database is not yet synchronized, the message was deleted, or the specified IDs do not exist, the message list will not contain those records. Always match retrieved messages by conversationID and clientMsgID rather than relying on index positions.

title: Load message context
description: Retrieve messages before and after a specified message with OpenIM iOS SDK.
keywords: sdk ios v4 sdk ios message retrieving-messages load-message-context
content: When navigating from global search results, jump to quote interactions, or specific message alerts, invoke fetchSurroundingMessages:onSuccess:onFailure: on OIMManager to load historical messages surrounding a target anchor message: Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | req | OIMFetchSurroundingMessagesReq | Yes | Request configuration parameters object. | Properties of OIMFetchSurroundingMessagesReq | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | startMessage | OIMMessageInfo | Yes | Reference anchor message model. | | before | NSInteger | Yes | Number of messages to retrieve before earlier than the anchor. | | after | NSInteger | Yes | Number of messages to retrieve after newer than the anchor. | | viewType | OIMFetchSurroundingHistoryViewType | Yes | Context view query type e.g. OIMFetchSurroundingHistoryViewTypeSearch for search jumps . | Code example OIMFetchSurroundingMessagesReq request = OIMFetchSurroundingMessagesReq new ; request.startMessage = locatedMessage; request.viewType = OIMFetchSurroundingHistoryViewTypeSearch; request.before = 20; request.after = 20; OIMManager manager fetchSurroundingMessages:request onSuccess:^ NSArray Nullable messages // Refresh context view with messages sorted in chronological order self replaceContext:messages ?: @ ; onFailure:^ NSInteger code, NSString Nullable msg // Handle context fetch failure ; Return value The onSuccess callback delivers an array of OIMMessageInfo models sorted in chronological order NSArray . State changes after the call 1. Context array boundaries : The actual number of returned messages may be smaller than before + after + 1 if the anchor is near the start or end of the conversation history. Deduplicate items using clientMsgID scoped to conversationID rather than relying on fixed index positions. 2. Obtaining anchor models : If you only have a message ID rather than a complete model, locate the anchor object first using Find messages by ID /sdk/ios/message/retrieving messages/find messages by id .

title: Search messages
description: Search messages already synchronized to the iOS SDK’s local storage.
keywords: sdk ios v4 sdk ios message searching-messages search-messages
content: Invoke searchLocalMessages:onSuccess:onFailure: on OIMManager to search for messages containing specified keywords across history synchronized to the local database. When searching group chat messages, provide the group's corresponding conversationID rather than groupID : Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | param | OIMSearchParam | Yes | Search criteria parameters object. | Properties of OIMSearchParam | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | conversationID | NSString | No | Target conversation ID. Pass an empty string @"" to search across all local conversations. For group chats, pass the conversation ID rather than groupID . | | keywordList | NSArray | Yes | Array of keyword strings. Currently supports a single keyword. | | keywordListMatchType | NSInteger | No | Multi keyword matching mode currently reserved . | | senderUserIDList | NSArray Nullable | No | Sender user ID filter list currently reserved . | | messageTypeList | NSArray Nullable | No | Optional array of message content type codes such as text messages . | | searchTimePosition | NSInteger | No | Starting UTC timestamp in seconds. Pass 0 to search from current time. | | searchTimePeriod | NSInteger | No | Time window in seconds from the starting point. Pass 0 for unrestricted range. | | pageIndex | NSInteger | Yes | Page index starting from 1 for single conversation searches. Ignored during cross conversation searches. | | count | NSInteger | Yes | Number of messages per page for single conversation searches. Ignored during cross conversation searches. | Code example NSString keyword = searchText stringByTrimmingCharactersInSet: NSCharacterSet.whitespaceAndNewlineCharacterSet ; if keyword.length == 0 self renderSearchItems:@ totalCount:0 ; return; OIMSearchParam param = OIMSearchParam new ; param.conversationID = conversationID; param.keywordList = @ keyword ; param.messageTypeList = @ @ OIMMessageContentTypeText ; param.searchTimePosition = 0; param.searchTimePeriod = 0; param.pageIndex = 1; param.count = 20; OIMManager manager searchLocalMessages:param onSuccess:^ OIMSearchResultInfo Nullable result if result == nil self showSearchError:0 message:@"Search callback returned no result" ; return; self renderSearchItems:result.searchResultItems totalCount:result.totalCount ; onFailure:^ NSInteger code, NSString Nullable message self showSearchError:code message:message ?: @"Search failed" ; ; Return value The onSuccess callback delivers an OIMSearchResultInfo model containing: | Property | Type | Description | | | | | | totalCount | NSInteger | Total number of messages matching search criteria. | | searchResultItems | NSArray | Array of search result buckets grouped by conversation. | | findResultItems | NSArray | Result items dedicated to exact ID lookup; not the primary search list. | Each OIMSearchResultItemInfo conversation bucket contains: | Property | Type | Description | | | | | | conversationID | NSString | Identifier of the conversation containing matches. | | conversationType | OIMConversationType | Conversation type enum. | | showName | NSString | Conversation display name. | | faceURL | NSString | Conversation avatar URL. | | messageCount | NSInteger | Number of matching messages in this conversation. | | messageList | NSArray | Array of matching messages on the current page for this conversation. | State changes after the call 1. Local cache reading : Search executes against the local SQLite database snapshot only and does not trigger real time message listeners. 2. Pagination and deduplication : When paging through single conversation matches, keep query parameters identical and increment pageIndex . Deduplicate items using composite key conversationID:clientMsgID . 3. Context navigation : When a user selects a search result item, obtain the full message model via Find messages by ID /sdk/ios/message/retrieving messages/find messages by id if needed, and retrieve adjacent messages via Load message context /sdk/ios/message/retrieving messages/load message context .

title: Report typing status
description: Report the current user’s typing status with OpenIM iOS SDK.
keywords: sdk ios v4 sdk ios message composing-messages update-typing-status
content: When the user begins typing text in the input bar or ceases input, invoke changeInputStates:focus:onSuccess:onFailure: on OIMManager to synchronize the typing indicator with remote members in the conversation: Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | conversationID | NSString | Yes | Target conversation identifier. | | focus | BOOL | Yes | Input focus flag. Pass YES when input commences; pass NO when the message is sent, focus is lost, the conversation switches, or typing halts. | | onSuccess | OIMSuccessCallback | Yes | Success callback confirming the server accepted the typing status request. | | onFailure | OIMFailureCallback | Yes | Failure callback returning error code code and descriptive message msg . | Code example OIMManager manager changeInputStates:conversationID focus:YES onSuccess:^ NSString Nullable data // Typing indicator reported successfully onFailure:^ NSInteger code, NSString Nullable msg // Handle reporting failure ; Return value The onSuccess callback confirms that the server accepted the input state change. The response data does not return a persistent record. State changes after the call 1. Ephemeral nature : Typing status is a transient state scoped to conversationID . It is not stored in the database, does not create drafts, and is not recorded in conversation history. Debounce or throttle start typing invocations to avoid excessive network overhead. 2. Receiving typing updates : Counterparties receive typing updates through onConversationUserInputStatusChanged: in OIMConversationListener , which tracks active input platform IDs keyed by composite identity conversationID:userID . For complete conversation listener setup and teardown, see Retrieve conversation list /sdk/ios/conversation/retrieving conversations/retrieve conversation list . To actively poll input states, see Retrieve typing status /sdk/ios/message/composing messages/get typing status .

title: Retrieve typing status
description: Retrieve the current typing status of a specified member with OpenIM iOS SDK.
keywords: sdk ios v4 sdk ios message composing-messages get-typing-status
content: Invoke getInputstates:userID:onSuccess:onFailure: on OIMManager to check whether a specific user is actively typing in a conversation, along with their active client platform identifiers: Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | conversationID | NSString | Yes | Target conversation identifier. | | userID | NSString | Yes | User ID of the target member being queried. | | onSuccess | void ^ NSArray Nullable platformIDs | Yes | Success callback returning an array of active platform ID numbers. | | onFailure | OIMFailureCallback | Yes | Failure callback returning error code code and descriptive message msg . | Code example OIMManager manager getInputstates:conversationID userID:memberUserID onSuccess:^ NSArray Nullable platformIDs // Check if member is actively typing based on platform array emptiness self setTyping:platformIDs.count 0 userID:memberUserID ; onFailure:^ NSInteger code, NSString Nullable msg // Handle query failure ; Return value The onSuccess callback delivers an array of platform ID numbers NSArray . A non empty array indicates that the user is actively typing; an empty array indicates that typing has stopped. State changes after the call 1. Snapshot nature : This query returns an instantaneous snapshot and does not trigger typing event listeners. 2. Polling considerations : Avoid frequent polling across all members in large group chats. Typically invoke this query upon entering a conversation or reconnecting to calibrate state. Subsequent live changes are pushed via the listener detailed in Report typing status /sdk/ios/message/composing messages/update typing status .

title: Check speech-recognition support
description: Query speech-recognition capabilities through OpenIMCore on iOS.
keywords: sdk ios v4 sdk ios message composing-messages check-speech-to-text
content: Use the underlying OpenIMCore C function Open im sdkSpeechToTextCapabilities to check speech recognition capabilities and configuration limits such as audio formats, sample rates, maximum recording durations, and file sizes prior to recording: Code example CallbackProxy callback = CallbackProxy alloc initWithOnSuccess:^ NSString Nullable data // Parse capability configuration JSON and adapt UI controls self applySpeechToTextCapabilitiesJSON:data ; onFailure:^ NSInteger code, NSString Nullable msg // Disable audio transcription feature if capability query fails self disableTranscription ; ; Open im sdkSpeechToTextCapabilities callback, @"" ; Return value The onSuccess callback delivers a JSON string containing the speech to text capability parameters: format : Supported audio encoding and container format e.g. m4a , wav . sampleRateHz : Audio sample rate in Hz. maxRecordTimeMs : Maximum supported recording duration in milliseconds. maxFileSize : Maximum allowed file size in bytes per audio segment. provider : Underlying speech recognition service provider code. State changes after the call 1. Client side boundary constraints : Use the returned formats and constraints to configure audio recording parameters and perform client side validation before transcription. 2. Executing transcription : To send an audio file for speech to text conversion, see Transcribe audio /sdk/ios/message/composing messages/transcribe audio .

title: Transcribe audio
description: Transcribe audio to text through OpenIMCore on iOS.
keywords: sdk ios v4 sdk ios message composing-messages transcribe-audio
content: Use the underlying OpenIMCore C function Open im sdkSpeechToText to submit audio data or local audio files to the speech recognition engine for transcription. On native iOS, passing an accessible file path in filename is preferred over providing Base64 data: Parameters Construct a JSON request payload with the following fields: | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | filename | NSString | Conditional | Sandboxed absolute path to the local audio file within the application container recommended . | | data | NSString | Conditional | Base64 encoded audio data string used when a local file path cannot be provided . filename and data are mutually exclusive. | Code example NSDictionary request = @ @"filename": audioFileURL.path ; NSString requestJSON = self JSONString:request ; CallbackProxy callback = CallbackProxy alloc initWithOnSuccess:^ NSString Nullable data // Parse transcription JSON and display text self showTranscription: self textFromResultJSON:data ; onFailure:^ NSInteger code, NSString Nullable msg // Handle transcription failure ; Open im sdkSpeechToText callback, @"", requestJSON ; Return value The onSuccess callback delivers a JSON string containing the transcribed text formatted as "text": "transcribed text content" . State changes after the call 1. Independent evaluation : Transcription executes text recognition without mutating the original audio message model or triggering local/remote message event listeners. 2. Local transcript persistence : To persist the recognized text on the local device alongside the message, save it in the message's local extension field. See Save a local transcript /sdk/ios/message/composing messages/save local transcript . 3. Capability validation : Prior to submitting audio for transcription, verify format and size limitations via Check speech recognition support /sdk/ios/message/composing messages/check speech to text .

title: Save a local transcript
description: Save a transcript in the current device’s message extension field with OpenIM iOS SDK.
keywords: sdk ios v4 sdk ios message composing-messages save-local-transcript
content: Audio message models OIMSoundElem do not possess built in properties for storing transcript text. To persist and display transcribed text for a voice message on the current device, save the transcript payload into the message's local extension field localEx : Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | conversationID | NSString | Yes | Target conversation identifier. | | clientMsgID | NSString | Yes | Client message ID of the target audio message. | | localEx | NSString | Yes | Local extension JSON string containing the transcript data. | | onSuccess | OIMSuccessCallback | Yes | Success callback confirming the local record was updated. | | onFailure | OIMFailureCallback | Yes | Failure callback returning error code code and descriptive message msg . | Code example NSString localEx = self mergeTranscript:transcript intoLocalEx:message.localEx ; OIMManager manager setMessageLocalEx:conversationID clientMsgID:message.clientMsgID localEx:localEx onSuccess:^ NSString Nullable data // Local extension saved; refresh message bubble UI onFailure:^ NSInteger code, NSString Nullable msg // Handle save failure ; Return value The onSuccess callback confirms that the local SQLite database record was updated on the current device. State changes after the call 1. Local only persistence : Updating localEx mutates only the local database record on the current device. It is not synchronized to remote servers or other client devices, and does not trigger remote message events. The client merge key is clientMsgID scoped to conversationID . 2. Namespace safety : Merge the transcript under a distinct key e.g. transcript within existing JSON data rather than overwriting other custom local properties. For general local extension updates, see Set a message’s local extension /sdk/ios/message/managing messages/set message local ex . For transcription workflows, see Transcribe audio /sdk/ios/message/composing messages/transcribe audio .

title: Delete a local message
description: Delete one message from the current device only with OpenIM iOS SDK.
keywords: sdk ios v4 sdk ios message managing-messages delete-local-message
content: Invoke deleteMessageFromLocalStorage:clientMsgID:onSuccess:onFailure: on OIMManager to remove a single message from the current device's local database without contacting the server or affecting other devices: Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | conversationID | NSString | Yes | Target conversation identifier. | | clientMsgID | NSString | Yes | Client message ID of the message to delete. | | onSuccess | OIMSuccessCallback | Yes | Success callback confirming local deletion. | | onFailure | OIMFailureCallback | Yes | Failure callback returning error code code and descriptive message msg . | Code example OIMManager manager deleteMessageFromLocalStorage:conversationID clientMsgID:clientMsgID onSuccess:^ NSString Nullable data // Local deletion succeeded; update message list UI self removeMessageFromUI:clientMsgID ; onFailure:^ NSInteger code, NSString Nullable msg // Handle local deletion failure ; Return value The onSuccess callback confirms that the message was removed from local storage on the current device. State changes after the call 1. Local only removal : This method deletes the record from the current device's SQLite database only. Server roaming records remain intact; if the user clears app data or rebuilds the local database, the message may be synchronized again. 2. No remote events : This is a purely local operation that does not emit events to other devices or conversation participants. The client merge key is clientMsgID scoped to conversationID . To delete a message across both local storage and the server, see Delete a message /sdk/ios/message/managing messages/delete saved message .

title: Delete a message
description: Delete one message from a specified conversation for the current account with OpenIM iOS SDK.
keywords: sdk ios v4 sdk ios message managing-messages delete-saved-message
content: Invoke deleteMessage:clientMsgID:onSuccess:onFailure: on OIMManager to delete a single historical message in a specified conversation for the current logged in user: Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | conversationID | NSString | Yes | Target conversation identifier. | | clientMsgID | NSString | Yes | Client message ID of the message to delete. | | onSuccess | OIMSuccessCallback | Yes | Success callback confirming deletion request completion. | | onFailure | OIMFailureCallback | Yes | Failure callback returning error code code and descriptive message msg . | Code example OIMManager manager deleteMessage:conversationID clientMsgID:clientMsgID onSuccess:^ NSString Nullable data // Deletion succeeded; remove message bubble from local UI self removeMessageFromUI:clientMsgID ; onFailure:^ NSInteger code, NSString Nullable msg // Handle deletion failure ; Return value The onSuccess callback confirms that the deletion request was processed for the current account. State changes after the call 1. Current account visibility : This operation removes the message from the current account's local storage and server records. It does not delete copies held by other conversation participants and does not render a "message revoked" placeholder. 2. Client merge key : The merge key is clientMsgID scoped to conversationID when managing multi conversation stores . 3. Revocation vs batch deletion : If you need to retract a message so that all members see a revocation notice, see Revoke a message /sdk/ios/message/managing messages/revoke a message . To delete multiple messages simultaneously or synchronize deletion across multiple devices of the current account, see Delete messages in batches /sdk/ios/message/managing messages/delete saved messages .

title: Delete messages in batches
description: Delete multiple messages from one conversation with OpenIM iOS SDK.
keywords: sdk ios v4 sdk ios message managing-messages delete-saved-messages
content: Invoke deleteMessages:clientMsgID:isSync:onSuccess:onFailure: on OIMManager to delete multiple historical messages from a single conversation in one batch, with optional cross device synchronization for the current account: Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | conversationID | NSString | Yes | Target conversation identifier. | | clientMsgID | NSArray | Yes | Array of client message IDs to delete. All specified IDs must belong to the same conversation. | | isSync | BOOL | Yes | Whether to synchronize the deletion status to the current account's other online devices. | | onSuccess | OIMSuccessCallback | Yes | Success callback confirming batch deletion. | | onFailure | OIMFailureCallback | Yes | Failure callback returning error code code and descriptive message msg . | Code example OIMManager manager deleteMessages:conversationID clientMsgID:selectedClientMsgIDs isSync:YES onSuccess:^ NSString Nullable data // Local deletion succeeded; remove items from UI self removeMessagesByIDs:selectedClientMsgIDs ; onFailure:^ NSInteger code, NSString Nullable msg // Handle batch deletion failure ; Return value The onSuccess callback confirms that the batch deletion request completed. Listen for message deletion events When the current account deletes messages on another device with isSync enabled, the SDK notifies the local client via onMsgDeleted: in OIMAdvancedMsgListener : void onMsgDeleted: OIMMessageInfo message if message.clientMsgID.length == 0 return; // Remove the message idempotently from local data sources by clientMsgID self removeMessageByClientMsgID:message.clientMsgID ; State changes after the call 1. Account scoped deletion : Deleting messages removes them for the current account only; counterparty copies remain unaffected. 2. Client merge key : The merge key is clientMsgID scoped to conversationID . Remove items idempotently from local caches upon callback success or when receiving onMsgDeleted: . 3. Single message deletion : For deleting a single message, see Delete a message /sdk/ios/message/managing messages/delete saved message . For full listener setup, see Receive messages /sdk/ios/message/receiving messages/receive messages .

title: Delete all messages from a user in a group chat
description: Delete every message sent by a specified user in a group chat with OpenIM iOS SDK.
keywords: sdk ios v4 sdk ios message managing-messages delete-user-messages
content: In group administration or moderation scenarios, group owners and administrators can invoke deleteUserAllMessagesInConversation:userID:onSuccess:onFailure: on OIMManager to delete all historical messages sent by a specified member in a group conversation: Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | conversationID | NSString | Yes | Target group conversation identifier. | | userID | NSString | Yes | User ID of the target group member whose messages will be removed. | | onSuccess | OIMSuccessCallback | Yes | Success callback confirming the deletion request was accepted. | | onFailure | OIMFailureCallback | Yes | Failure callback returning error code code and descriptive message msg e.g. insufficient permissions . | Code example OIMManager manager deleteUserAllMessagesInConversation:conversationID userID:targetUserID onSuccess:^ NSString Nullable data // Member messages deletion initiated successfully onFailure:^ NSInteger code, NSString Nullable msg // Handle deletion failure ; Return value The onSuccess callback confirms that the deletion request was processed by the server. Listen for user message cleanup events When a member's messages are removed from a group conversation, the SDK notifies group members via onDeleteUserAllMsgsInConv:userID: in OIMAdvancedMsgListener : void onDeleteUserAllMsgsInConv: NSString conversationID userID: NSString userID if conversationID.length == 0 || userID.length == 0 return; // Remove all cached messages sent by this user in the specified conversation self removeMessagesByConversationID:conversationID senderUserID:userID ; State changes after the call 1. Composite state merge : The merge key is conversationID and sender userID . Because the event payload does not include individual clientMsgID values, filter out and remove all messages matching the sender in that conversation, or re query conversation history to reconcile state. 2. Permission validation : This is an administrative operation; the server validates whether the calling user has owner or administrator privileges in the group. For listener registration and lifecycle details, see Receive messages /sdk/ios/message/receiving messages/receive messages .

title: Revoke a message
description: Revoke a message and synchronize its revoked state through the message listener.
keywords: sdk ios v4 sdk ios message managing-messages revoke-a-message
content: When other conversation participants should see that a message was revoked, invoke revokeMessage:clientMsgID:onSuccess:onFailure: on OIMManager rather than substituting a regular deletion. Deletion affects visibility for the current account only; see Delete a message /sdk/ios/message/managing messages/delete saved message . To retain the message while changing its content, use Modify a message /sdk/ios/message/managing messages/modify a message . Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | conversationID | NSString | Yes | Target conversation identifier. | | clientMsgID | NSString | Yes | Client message ID of the message to revoke. | | onSuccess | OIMSuccessCallback | Yes | Success callback confirming the revocation request completed. | | onFailure | OIMFailureCallback | Yes | Failure callback returning error code code and descriptive message message . | Code example OIMManager manager revokeMessage:conversationID clientMsgID:clientMsgID onSuccess:^ NSString Nullable data // Revocation succeeded; update message bubble to revoked state in local UI self markMessageRevoked:clientMsgID conversationID:conversationID ; onFailure:^ NSInteger code, NSString Nullable message self showRevokeError:code message:message ?: @"Failed to revoke the message" ; ; Return value The onSuccess callback confirms that the revocation request was processed by the server. The client merge key is clientMsgID scoped to conversationID . Receive revocation events When another member or another logged in device revokes a message, the SDK notifies the client via onRecvMessageRevoked: in OIMAdvancedMsgListener : void onRecvMessageRevoked: OIMMessageRevokedInfo revokedInfo if revokedInfo == nil return; self markMessageRevokedByClientMsgID:revokedInfo.clientMsgID sessionType:revokedInfo.sessionType ; When using block callbacks on OIMCallbacker , the revokedInfo argument may be nil and must be validated before processing: OIMRevokedCallback handleMessageRevoked = ^ OIMMessageRevokedInfo Nullable revokedInfo if revokedInfo == nil return; self markMessageRevokedByClientMsgID:revokedInfo.clientMsgID sessionType:revokedInfo.sessionType ; ; State changes after the call 1. Permissions and validation : The server enforces permission checks, time window restrictions, and eligible message types for revocation. Do not mutate the UI to a revoked state if the call fails. 2. Context resolution : Because OIMMessageRevokedInfo does not provide conversationID , locate the cached original message by clientMsgID , then combine its conversation with the event's sessionType to update the bubble display. 3. Synchronization phases : The successful call, event arrival on remote devices, and reloading history are three distinct operational stages. For complete listener lifecycle details, see Receive messages /sdk/ios/message/receiving messages/receive messages .

title: Modify a message
description: Modify the content of a sent message with OpenIM iOS SDK.
keywords: sdk ios v4 sdk ios message managing-messages modify-a-message
content: Invoke modifyMessageWithConversationID:message:onSuccess:onFailure: on OIMManager to edit the content of a previously sent message in a conversation. This differs from Delete a message /sdk/ios/message/managing messages/delete saved message and Revoke a message /sdk/ios/message/managing messages/revoke a message : deletion controls visibility for the current account, revocation displays a placeholder indicating the message was recalled, and modification updates the body content across all devices. Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | conversationID | NSString | Yes | Target conversation identifier. | | message | OIMMessageInfo | Yes | Complete modified message model. Must preserve the original clientMsgID and routing attributes. | | onSuccess | OIMSuccessCallback | Yes | Success callback confirming the modification request was accepted. | | onFailure | OIMFailureCallback | Yes | Failure callback returning error code code and descriptive message errorMessage . | Code example if message.textElem == nil || editedText.length == 0 return; NSString previousText = message.textElem.content; message.textElem.content = editedText; OIMManager manager modifyMessageWithConversationID:conversationID message:message onSuccess:^ NSString Nullable data // Modification accepted; update local UI bubble self replaceMessage:message conversationID:conversationID clientMsgID:message.clientMsgID ; onFailure:^ NSInteger code, NSString Nullable errorMessage // Roll back edited text on failure message.textElem.content = previousText; self showModifyError:code message:errorMessage ?: @"Failed to modify message" ; ; Return value The onSuccess callback confirms that the modification request was accepted by the server. The callback string is not the updated message object; client state is merged using clientMsgID scoped to conversationID . Listen for message modifications When other members or other logged in clients receive an edited message, the SDK dispatches the update via onMessageModified: in OIMAdvancedMsgListener : void onMessageModified: OIMMessageInfo message if message.clientMsgID.length == 0 return; NSString conversationID = self conversationIDForMessage:message ; // Replace cached message by clientMsgID self replaceMessage:message conversationID:conversationID clientMsgID:message.clientMsgID ; State changes after the call 1. Full model replacement : Message modification is not an incremental field patch. Start from the complete existing OIMMessageInfo instance and update only the target content property while strictly preserving clientMsgID , conversation type, sender, send time, and other elements. 2. Server policy validation : The server verifies editor permissions, editable time windows, and supported message types. If modification fails, restore the original content rather than leaving an unconfirmed local edit in the UI. 3. Multi client synchronization : Calling the API and receiving onMessageModified: across other clients are distinct phases. For listener registration and lifecycle details, see Receive messages /sdk/ios/message/receiving messages/receive messages .

title: Retrieve pinned messages
description: Retrieve a snapshot of pinned messages in a conversation with OpenIM iOS SDK.
keywords: sdk ios v4 sdk ios message managing-messages get-pinned-messages
content: Invoke getConversationPinnedMsgWithConversationID:onSuccess:onFailure: on OIMManager to retrieve a list of currently pinned messages in a specified conversation: Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | conversationID | NSString | Yes | Target conversation identifier. | | onSuccess | void ^ NSArray Nullable messages | Yes | Success callback returning an array of pinned message models. | | onFailure | OIMFailureCallback | Yes | Failure callback returning error code code and descriptive message msg . | Code example OIMManager manager getConversationPinnedMsgWithConversationID:conversationID onSuccess:^ NSArray Nullable messages // Render or refresh the pinned messages banner at the top of the conversation view self replacePinnedMessages:messages ?: @ conversationID:conversationID ; onFailure:^ NSInteger code, NSString Nullable msg // Handle query failure ; Return value The onSuccess callback delivers an array of OIMMessageInfo models representing pinned messages. The array contains message entities only, without pin timestamps or operator metadata. State changes after the call 1. Snapshot querying : This query establishes an instantaneous snapshot of pinned messages and does not trigger pin event listeners. 2. Client merge key : The merge key is clientMsgID scoped to conversationID . 3. Live updates : Real time additions or removals of pinned messages are delivered via the listener documented in Pin or unpin a message /sdk/ios/message/managing messages/set message pinned .

title: Pin or unpin a message
description: Pin or unpin a message with OpenIM iOS SDK.
keywords: sdk ios v4 sdk ios message managing-messages set-message-pinned
content: Invoke setConversationPinnedMsgWithConversationID:clientMsgID:pinned:onSuccess:onFailure: on OIMManager to pin an important historical message to the top of a conversation, or unpin a currently pinned message: Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | conversationID | NSString | Yes | Target conversation identifier. | | clientMsgID | NSString | Yes | Client message ID of the target message to pin or unpin. | | pinned | BOOL | Yes | Pin status flag. Pass YES to pin the message; pass NO to unpin it. | | onSuccess | OIMSuccessCallback | Yes | Success callback confirming the pin state request was accepted. | | onFailure | OIMFailureCallback | Yes | Failure callback returning error code code and descriptive message msg . | Code example OIMManager manager setConversationPinnedMsgWithConversationID:conversationID clientMsgID:message.clientMsgID pinned:YES onSuccess:^ NSString Nullable data // Pin status request submitted successfully onFailure:^ NSInteger code, NSString Nullable msg // Handle pinning failure ; Return value The onSuccess callback confirms that the server accepted the pin status modification. Listen for pinned message changes When pinned messages in a conversation change, the SDK notifies group members via onChangedPinnedMsg: in OIMAdvancedMsgListener : void onChangedPinnedMsg: OIMChangedPinnedMsg changedPinnedMsg if changedPinnedMsg == nil return; // Refresh the pinned message list for the corresponding conversation self replacePinnedMessages:changedPinnedMsg.messageList conversationID:changedPinnedMsg.conversationID ; State changes after the call 1. Client merge key : The merge key is clientMsgID scoped to conversationID . Upon receiving onChangedPinnedMsg: , replace the pinned messages collection for that conversation and deduplicate items by clientMsgID . 2. Multi client synchronization : Calling the API confirms server receipt, while the updated pinned banner across all clients is refreshed upon event arrival. To actively retrieve the current pinned snapshot, see Retrieve pinned messages /sdk/ios/message/managing messages/get pinned messages . For listener lifecycle management, see Receive messages /sdk/ios/message/receiving messages/receive messages .

title: Insert a local one-to-one message
description: Insert one local one-to-one message with OpenIM iOS SDK.
keywords: sdk ios v4 sdk ios message managing-messages insert-local-single-message
content: Invoke insertSingleMessageToLocalStorage:recvID:sendID:onSuccess:onFailure: on OIMManager to write a custom message record such as a local system prompt, security alert, or placeholder directly into the local one to one conversation database without sending it over the network: Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | message | OIMMessageInfo | Yes | Prepared message model to be inserted locally. | | recvID | NSString | Yes | Recipient user ID for the one to one chat. | | sendID | NSString | Yes | Sender user ID for the one to one chat. | | onSuccess | void ^ OIMMessageInfo Nullable stored | Yes | Success callback returning the locally persisted message model. | | onFailure | OIMFailureCallback | Yes | Failure callback returning error code code and descriptive message msg . | Code example OIMManager manager insertSingleMessageToLocalStorage:message recvID:targetUserID sendID:currentUserID onSuccess:^ OIMMessageInfo Nullable stored // Local insertion succeeded; update conversation message list if stored = nil self upsertMessage:stored ; onFailure:^ NSInteger code, NSString Nullable msg // Handle insertion failure ; Return value The onSuccess callback delivers the locally stored OIMMessageInfo model. When non nil, merge it into the conversation message cache using clientMsgID scoped to conversationID . State changes after the call 1. Local only persistence : This operation modifies local device storage only. It does not send network requests to the server, does not notify the counterparty, and does not trigger incoming message listeners onRecvNewMessage: . 2. Group chat insertion : To insert a local message into a group conversation, see Insert a local group message /sdk/ios/message/managing messages/insert local group message .

title: Insert a local group message
description: Insert one local group message with OpenIM iOS SDK.
keywords: sdk ios v4 sdk ios message managing-messages insert-local-group-message
content: Invoke insertGroupMessageToLocalStorage:groupID:sendID:onSuccess:onFailure: on OIMManager to write a custom group message record such as a local group reminder, security warning, or placeholder directly into the local group conversation database without broadcasting it over the network: Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | message | OIMMessageInfo | Yes | Prepared message model to be inserted locally. | | groupID | NSString | Yes | Target group ID for the group conversation. | | sendID | NSString | Yes | Sender user ID for the group message. | | onSuccess | void ^ OIMMessageInfo Nullable stored | Yes | Success callback returning the locally persisted message model. | | onFailure | OIMFailureCallback | Yes | Failure callback returning error code code and descriptive message msg . | Code example OIMManager manager insertGroupMessageToLocalStorage:message groupID:groupID sendID:currentUserID onSuccess:^ OIMMessageInfo Nullable stored // Local insertion succeeded; update group message list if stored = nil self upsertMessage:stored ; onFailure:^ NSInteger code, NSString Nullable msg // Handle insertion failure ; Return value The onSuccess callback delivers the locally stored OIMMessageInfo model. When non nil, merge it into the local group conversation cache using clientMsgID scoped to the group's conversationID . State changes after the call 1. Local only persistence : This operation mutates only the current device's SQLite database. It does not broadcast to group members, does not upload files, and does not trigger incoming message listeners onRecvNewMessage: . 2. One to one chat insertion : To insert a local message into a one to one conversation, see Insert a local one to one message /sdk/ios/message/managing messages/insert local single message .

title: Clear all local messages
description: Clear every local message for the current account with OpenIM iOS SDK.
keywords: sdk ios v4 sdk ios message managing-messages clear-all-local-messages
content: Invoke deleteAllMsgFromLocalWithOnSuccess:onFailure: on OIMManager to wipe all historical messages for the current account from local SQLite database storage on the current device: Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | onSuccess | OIMSuccessCallback | Yes | Success callback confirming local message storage has been cleared. | | onFailure | OIMFailureCallback | Yes | Failure callback returning error code code and descriptive message msg . | Code example OIMManager manager deleteAllMsgFromLocalWithOnSuccess:^ NSString Nullable data // Local messages cleared; reset in memory message caches and UI self resetAllMessageSnapshots ; onFailure:^ NSInteger code, NSString Nullable msg // Handle clearing failure ; Return value The onSuccess callback confirms that all local message records on the device were deleted. State changes after the call 1. Local only operation : This destructive operation removes records from the current device's local database only. Server roaming records remain intact; if the client synchronizes or re queries history from the server, messages may be restored. 2. No remote events : This method does not dispatch message deletion events to other devices or users. To clear messages across both the server and local storage simultaneously, see Clear all messages /sdk/ios/message/managing messages/clear all messages .

title: Clear all messages
description: Clear all local and server-side messages for the current account with OpenIM iOS SDK.
keywords: sdk ios v4 sdk ios message managing-messages clear-all-messages
content: Invoke deleteAllMsgFromLocalAndSvrWithOnSuccess:onFailure: on OIMManager to permanently clear all conversation history stored locally and on the server for the current account: Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | onSuccess | OIMSuccessCallback | Yes | Success callback confirming message history was cleared across local and server storage. | | onFailure | OIMFailureCallback | Yes | Failure callback returning error code code and descriptive message msg . | Code example OIMManager manager deleteAllMsgFromLocalAndSvrWithOnSuccess:^ NSString Nullable data // Clear completed; reset local message caches and refresh conversation views self resetAllMessageSnapshots ; onFailure:^ NSInteger code, NSString Nullable msg // Handle clearing failure ; Return value The onSuccess callback confirms that all local and server side message records for the current account were deleted. State changes after the call 1. Irreversible account level operation : This operation clears message records for the current logged in account across both local SQLite storage and remote server storage. It does not delete copies stored on other conversation members' devices. 2. Conversation summary synchronization : After clearing messages, update the in memory cache and UI views. Conversation summaries and latest message previews will reflect these changes through conversation change events or subsequent conversation list queries. To clear local device storage only without touching server records, see Clear all local messages /sdk/ios/message/managing messages/clear all local messages .

title: Set a message’s local extension
description: Update a message’s device-local extension field with OpenIM iOS SDK.
keywords: sdk ios v4 sdk ios message managing-messages set-message-local-ex
content: Invoke setMessageLocalEx:clientMsgID:localEx:onSuccess:onFailure: on OIMManager to store or update custom business metadata localEx on a message in the local SQLite database. This field is scoped strictly to the current device and is commonly used for audio playback states, media download flags, or speech to text transcripts: Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | conversationID | NSString | Yes | Target conversation identifier. | | clientMsgID | NSString | Yes | Client message ID of the target message. | | localEx | NSString | Yes | Custom extension string typically in JSON format . | | onSuccess | OIMSuccessCallback | Yes | Success callback confirming the local record was updated. | | onFailure | OIMFailureCallback | Yes | Failure callback returning error code code and descriptive message msg . | Code example OIMManager manager setMessageLocalEx:conversationID clientMsgID:message.clientMsgID localEx:@" \"downloaded\":true " onSuccess:^ NSString Nullable data // Local extension updated successfully onFailure:^ NSInteger code, NSString Nullable msg // Handle update failure ; Return value The onSuccess callback confirms that localEx was updated in the device's local database. State changes after the call 1. Local only persistence : This operation modifies local device storage only. It does not send network updates to the server, does not notify other devices or users, and does not trigger incoming message listeners onRecvNewMessage: . 2. Full replacement : The method performs a complete string replacement of localEx . To preserve existing properties, parse the current localEx JSON, merge new keys into it, and write back the consolidated string. For an example saving speech transcription text, see Save a local transcript /sdk/ios/message/composing messages/save local transcript .

title: Report group-message read status
description: Report group-message read receipts with OpenIM iOS SDK.
keywords: sdk ios v4 sdk ios message managing-read-status send-group-read-receipts
content: When group chat messages become visible on the user's screen, invoke sendGroupMessageReadReceipt:clientMsgIDs:onSuccess:onFailure: on OIMManager to report read status to the server. The server records the read timestamps and broadcasts receipt updates to other group members: Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | conversationID | NSString | Yes | Target group conversation identifier. | | clientMsgIDs | NSArray | Yes | Array of client message IDs visible and read on the screen. All IDs in a batch must belong to the same group conversation. | | onSuccess | OIMSuccessCallback | Yes | Success callback confirming receipts were accepted by the server. | | onFailure | OIMFailureCallback | Yes | Failure callback returning error code code and descriptive message msg . | Code example OIMManager manager sendGroupMessageReadReceipt:conversationID clientMsgIDs:visibleClientMsgIDs onSuccess:^ NSString Nullable data // Read receipts sent to server successfully onFailure:^ NSInteger code, NSString Nullable msg // Handle reporting failure ; Return value The onSuccess callback confirms that the read receipts were transmitted to and acknowledged by the server. Listen for group read receipt events When other members read messages in the group, the SDK dispatches updates via onRecvGroupReadReceipt: in OIMAdvancedMsgListener : void onRecvGroupReadReceipt: OIMGroupMessageReceipt receipt if receipt == nil return; // Update read/unread participant counts by conversationID and clientMsgID self mergeGroupReceipt:receipt ; State changes after the call 1. Client merge key : The merge key is clientMsgID scoped to conversationID . Upon receiving onRecvGroupReadReceipt: , update read and unread participant counters on the corresponding message bubble. 2. Conversation unread count separation : Reporting group message receipts informs other members of your read progress; update the local conversation's overall unread badge using the dedicated conversation read API. 3. Distinct operational phases : Reporting receipts, receiving incoming receipt broadcasts, and querying reader lists are distinct stages. To inspect the detailed list of members who have read a specific message, see Retrieve group message readers /sdk/ios/message/managing read status/get group message readers . For listener setup, see Receive messages /sdk/ios/message/receiving messages/receive messages .

title: Retrieve group-message readers
description: Retrieve members who have or have not read a group message by page with OpenIM iOS SDK.
keywords: sdk ios v4 sdk ios message managing-read-status get-group-message-readers
content: Invoke getGroupMessageReaderList:clientMsgID:filter:offset:count:onSuccess:onFailure: on OIMManager to query a paginated list of members who have or have not read a specific group message: Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | conversationID | NSString | Yes | Target group conversation identifier. | | clientMsgID | NSString | Yes | Client message ID of the target group message. | | filter | NSInteger | Yes | Filter mode: pass 0 to retrieve members who have read the message; pass 1 to retrieve members who have not read it. | | offset | NSInteger | Yes | Pagination starting offset 0 indexed . | | count | NSInteger | Yes | Maximum number of group members to retrieve per page. | | onSuccess | void ^ NSArray Nullable members | Yes | Success callback returning a list of group member models. | | onFailure | OIMFailureCallback | Yes | Failure callback returning error code code and descriptive message msg . | Code example OIMManager manager getGroupMessageReaderList:conversationID clientMsgID:clientMsgID filter:0 offset:0 count:20 onSuccess:^ NSArray Nullable members // Render current page of group message readers self replaceReaders:members ?: @ clientMsgID:clientMsgID ; onFailure:^ NSInteger code, NSString Nullable msg // Handle query failure ; Return value The onSuccess callback delivers an array of OIMGroupMemberInfo models NSArray representing the queried member list snapshot. State changes after the call 1. Snapshot querying : This query establishes an on demand snapshot of group member read states and does not trigger read receipt event listeners. 2. Client merge key : Group member models are merged using the composite key groupID:userID . 3. Receipt counters and live broadcasts : Real time read and unread counter increments are driven by incoming receipt events. For reporting receipts and receipt event handling, see Report group message read status /sdk/ios/message/managing read status/send group read receipts .

title: Upload a file
description: Upload a standalone file with the OpenIM iOS SDK.
keywords: sdk ios v4 sdk ios file-uploads upload-file
content: Use standalone file uploads for user avatars, group avatars, profile attachments, or custom business files that do not directly belong to a message. Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | fullPath | NSString | Yes | Absolute filesystem path readable by the iOS application sandbox. | | name | NSString | No | Target filename on the remote store. Pass nil to use the last path component of fullPath . | | cause | NSString | Yes | Business upload category or tag agreed upon with the backend. | | onProgress | OIMUploadProgressCallback | No | Closure receiving saved bytes, currently uploaded bytes, and total file bytes. | | onCompletion | OIMUploadCompletionCallback | No | Closure receiving total bytes, the remote URL, and storage type putType . | Code example OIMManager manager uploadFile:fileURL.path name:fileURL.lastPathComponent cause:@"user avatar" onProgress:^ NSInteger saved, NSInteger current, NSInteger total uploadStore updateCurrentBytes:current totalBytes:total ; onCompletion:^ NSInteger total, NSString url, NSInteger putType profileService saveAvatarURL:url ; onSuccess:nil onFailure:^ NSInteger code, NSString message NSLog @"uploadFile failed: %ld %@", long code, message ; ; Return value The onCompletion callback provides the remote resource URL, total size in bytes, and storage engine type putType . The overall operational status resolves through onSuccess or onFailure . Uploading a file does not alter user profiles or automatically construct messages. To share the uploaded file in a chat session, supply the returned URL to the corresponding URL based message creation method and send it explicitly.

title: Audio and video calling overview
description: Understand the signaling, room information, and event boundaries of audio and video calls in the OpenIM iOS SDK.
keywords: sdk ios v4 sdk ios calling overview-calling
content: The OpenIM iOS SDK provides signaling APIs to initiate, accept, reject, cancel, and hang up call invitations, query room status, and synchronize participant states. The SDK manages invitation lifecycles and room membership coordination; it does not capture camera feeds, play audio streams, or render video canvas views. Your application passes credentials returned by the SDK roomID , token , and liveURL to your chosen WebRTC or RTC media engine. The application layer handles system camera and microphone permissions, audio session management, media tracks, network adaptability, and UI rendering. Call workflow 1. Invoke Start a one to one call /sdk/ios/calling/managing calls/start single call to invite a single user, or invoke Start a group call /sdk/ios/calling/managing calls/start group call for multi party group calls. 2. The invitee extracts OIMSignalingInfo from the incoming invitation callback and chooses to accept or reject the call. 3. Upon acceptance via Accept a call /sdk/ios/calling/managing calls/accept call , both caller and callee use the returned room credentials to join the media channel. 4. During an active call, track member join/leave events, stream state changes, and custom signaling data via delegates. 5. The initiator can Cancel a call invitation /sdk/ios/calling/managing calls/cancel call before connection, and any participant can Hang up a call /sdk/ios/calling/managing calls/hang up call once connected. Core data structures | Structure | Description | | | | | OIMInvitationInfo | Details invitee list, group ID, room ID, media type audio or video , timeout duration, and session type. | | OIMSignalingInfo | Encapsulates caller identity, invitation parameters, and offline APNs notification payloads. | | OIMInvitationResultInfo | Delivers the server assigned roomID , authentication token , liveURL , and busy user list. | | OIMParticipantConnectedInfo | Captures active room status, inviter details, and currently connected participants for a group room. | Custom signals transmit lightweight, transient negotiation payloads during a call session. Do not use custom signals for persistent storage or bulk data transfer. State synchronization and event boundaries Write actions such as initiating, accepting, rejecting, cancelling, or hanging up require handling both completion callbacks and signaling delegate events. Completion callbacks confirm that OpenIMServer processed the request. Delegate callbacks notify other participants and linked multi terminal devices of state transitions; they represent distinct asynchronous milestones. Listen for the full invitation lifecycle, participant connection events, hangup triggers, and stream changes in Handle call events /sdk/ios/calling/managing calls/handle call events . For transient signaling, refer to Send a custom signal /sdk/ios/calling/sending custom signals/send a custom signal . Merge call session state using roomID as the primary key, and key participant states with userID . When the application relaunches with unresolved invitations, recover state via Restore a pending invitation /sdk/ios/calling/retrieving call information/restore pending invitation . To inspect an ongoing group call room, invoke Query a group call room /sdk/ios/calling/retrieving call information/get room by group id . Related documentation Start a one to one call /sdk/ios/calling/managing calls/start single call Start a group call /sdk/ios/calling/managing calls/start group call Handle call events /sdk/ios/calling/managing calls/handle call events Restore a pending invitation /sdk/ios/calling/retrieving call information/restore pending invitation Send a custom signal /sdk/ios/calling/sending custom signals/send a custom signal

title: Start a one-to-one call
description: Start a one-to-one audio or video call with the OpenIM iOS SDK.
keywords: sdk ios v4 sdk ios calling managing-calls start-single-call
content: Initiate a direct audio or video call by dispatching a call invitation. The SDK coordinates signaling exchange and room credential allocation. The application layer consumes the returned room credentials to connect to your WebRTC or RTC media engine. Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | inviteeUserIDList | NSArray | Yes | List of target user IDs. For one to one calls, provide exactly one target user ID. | | roomID | NSString | Yes | Unique room identifier, generated as a UUID by the client or provided by your backend. | | timeout | NSInteger | Yes | Invitation timeout duration in seconds. | | mediaType | NSString | Yes | Media stream type: @"video" or @"audio" . | | groupID | NSString | No | Target group identifier. Pass an empty string @"" for one to one calls. | Code example OIMInvitationInfo invitation = OIMInvitationInfo new ; invitation.inviteeUserIDList = @ @"user b" ; invitation.roomID = NSUUID.UUID.UUIDString.lowercaseString; invitation.timeout = 30; invitation.mediaType = @"video"; invitation.groupID = @""; OIMSignalingInfo signalingInfo = OIMManager manager signalingInvite:invitation offlinePushInfo:push onSuccess:^ OIMInvitationResultInfo Nullable credentials if credentials = nil self joinMediaRoom:credentials ; onFailure:^ NSInteger code, NSString Nullable message self showCallError:code message:message ?: @"Failed to initiate call" ; ; Retain the OIMSignalingInfo object returned synchronously by signalingInvite:... ; it stores the active signaling snapshot required to cancel, hang up, or correlate subsequent signaling events. Return value The onSuccess callback returns an OIMInvitationResultInfo instance containing the allocated roomID , room access token , streaming liveURL , and busy user list busyLineUserIDList . Success indicates only that OpenIMServer processed the signaling invitation; it does not indicate that the callee has answered. State changes after the call Local state merge : Track active call session state using roomID as the primary key and track participant states combining roomID and userID . Remote event notification : The callee receives an incoming invitation notification via onReceiveNewInvitation: in OIMSignalingListener see Handle call events /sdk/ios/calling/managing calls/handle call events . Answer detection : The caller tracks whether the callee accepts or rejects the call via the onInviteeAccepted: and onInviteeRejected: delegate callbacks.

title: Start a group call
description: Start a group audio or video call with the OpenIM iOS SDK.
keywords: sdk ios v4 sdk ios calling managing-calls start-group-call
content: Initiate a multi party group audio or video call using signalingInviteInGroup:offlinePushInfo:onSuccess:onFailure: . The SDK dispatches invitations solely to members explicitly enumerated in inviteeUserIDList , rather than automatically inviting all members in the group. Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | inviteeUserIDList | NSArray | Yes | List of target group member user IDs to invite. | | groupID | NSString | Yes | Target group identifier. Must not be empty. | | roomID | NSString | Yes | Room identifier. You can pass the groupID or a uniquely assigned business room ID. | | timeout | NSInteger | Yes | Invitation timeout duration in seconds. | | mediaType | NSString | Yes | Media stream format: @"video" or @"audio" . | Code example OIMInvitationInfo invitation = OIMInvitationInfo new ; invitation.inviteeUserIDList = selectedGroupMemberIDs; invitation.groupID = groupID; invitation.roomID = groupID; invitation.timeout = 30; invitation.mediaType = @"video"; OIMManager manager signalingInviteInGroup:invitation offlinePushInfo:nil onSuccess:^ OIMInvitationResultInfo Nullable credentials if credentials = nil self joinMediaRoom:credentials ; onFailure:^ NSInteger code, NSString Nullable message self showCallError:code message:message ?: @"Failed to initiate group call" ; ; Return value The onSuccess callback delivers an OIMInvitationResultInfo instance containing the confirmed roomID , media token , liveURL , and busy user list busyLineUserIDList . Entries in busyLineUserIDList indicate that specific members are engaged in other calls; this does not abort invitations destined for available members. State changes after the call Local state merge : Merge call state by roomID , combining with userID to maintain participant states. If your application provides custom room IDs, ensure all clients utilize the identical roomID . Remote event notification : Selected group members receive invitations via onReceiveNewInvitation: in OIMSignalingListener .
