Each record exposes: | Field | Description | | | | | fromUserID / fromNickname / fromFaceURL | User ID, display nickname, and avatar URL of the applicant. | | toUserID / toNickname / toFaceURL | User ID, nickname, and avatar of the recipient the authenticated user . | | reqMsg | Greeting or verification message provided by the applicant. | | handleResult | Approval result: 0 for pending, 1 for approved, 1 or 2 for rejected. | | handlerUserID | User ID of the user who evaluated the application. | | handleMsg | Note or explanation attached by the reviewer. | | handleTime | Unix timestamp when the request was reviewed. | | createTime | Unix timestamp when the application was submitted. | | ex | Custom extension string attached to the application. | State changes after the call Friend application events arrive in real time through OnFriendshipListener : @Override public void onFriendApplicationAdded FriendApplicationInfo application // Process new or updated friend applications @Override public void onFriendApplicationAccepted FriendApplicationInfo application // Process accepted friend applications @Override public void onFriendApplicationRejected FriendApplicationInfo application // Process rejected friend applications @Override public void onFriendApplicationDeleted FriendApplicationInfo application // Process deleted friend applications Route records into received or sent collections based on whether toUserID equals the current user's ID. When an application is accepted, the SDK dispatches onFriendAdded to notify the client of the newly established friendship; see Get the friend list /sdk/android/user/friends/get friend list page .

title: Get sent friend applications
description: Paginate friend requests sent by the authenticated account using getSendFriendApplicationList().
keywords: sdk android v4 sdk android user friend-applications get-send-friend-application-list
content: Paginate outgoing friend requests initiated by the authenticated account along with their current review statuses. Code example GetFriendApplicationListAsApplicantReq request = new GetFriendApplicationListAsApplicantReq 0, 20 ; OpenIMClient.getInstance .friendshipManager.getSendFriendApplicationList new OnBase @Override public void onSuccess List applications // Update outgoing friend requests UI using applications @Override public void onError int code, String error // Handle error , request ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | base | OnBase | Yes | Callback delivering the asynchronous operation result. | | request | GetFriendApplicationListAsApplicantReq | Yes | Request payload holding paging parameters offset and count . | Paging request attributes | Field | Type | Description | | | | | | offset | int | Zero based paging offset; pass 0 for the initial page. | | count | int | Number of sent requests to return in this page. | Return value The successful callback returns the current page as List . In outgoing records, the authenticated account is fromUserID and the recipient is toUserID . Deduplicate and present status using the recipient's user ID toUserID as the primary key. Individual fields and status codes are identical to those documented in Get received friend applications /sdk/android/user/friend applications/get recv friend application list .

title: Accept a friend application
description: Approve a friend request from a specified user and establish a bilateral friendship using acceptFriendApplication().
keywords: sdk android v4 sdk android user friend-applications accept-friend-application
content: Accept an incoming friend request from a specified user to establish a bilateral friendship. Code example OpenIMClient.getInstance .friendshipManager.acceptFriendApplication new OnBase @Override public void onSuccess String data // Friend application accepted successfully @Override public void onError int code, String error // Handle error , applicantUserID, "Accepted" ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | base | OnBase | Yes | Callback delivering the asynchronous operation result. | | applicantUserID | String | Yes | User ID of the applicant who submitted the request. | | handleMsg | String | No | Optional approval note attached to the resolution. | Return value The successful callback indicates that the server recorded the acceptance and established a bilateral friendship between the accounts. State changes after the call Upon acceptance, the SDK delivers events through OnFriendshipListener : onFriendApplicationAccepted FriendApplicationInfo application : Reports that the request status transitioned to approved. Update the matching application item using application.getFromUserID . onFriendAdded FriendInfo friend : Reports that the new friend was added to the contacts roster. Insert the friend into your local cache using friend.getUserID . For complete listener registration details, see Get the friend list /sdk/android/user/friends/get friend list page .

title: Refuse a friend application
description: Decline a friend request from a specified user with an optional rejection reason using refuseFriendApplication().
keywords: sdk android v4 sdk android user friend-applications refuse-friend-application
content: Decline an incoming friend request from a specified user with an optional reason note. Code example OpenIMClient.getInstance .friendshipManager.refuseFriendApplication new OnBase @Override public void onSuccess String data // Friend application rejected successfully @Override public void onError int code, String error // Handle error , applicantUserID, "Declined for now" ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | base | OnBase | Yes | Callback delivering the asynchronous operation result. | | applicantUserID | String | Yes | User ID of the applicant who submitted the request. | | handleMsg | String | No | Optional rejection explanation note. | Return value The successful callback indicates that the server recorded the rejection status. State changes after the call Upon rejection, the SDK dispatches the onFriendApplicationRejected FriendApplicationInfo application event via OnFriendshipListener . Locate the matching entry in your received requests list using application.getFromUserID and update its status to rejected. For complete listener registration details, see Get received friend applications /sdk/android/user/friend applications/get recv friend application list .

title: Get the blacklist
description: Retrieve the complete list of blocked users for the authenticated account using getBlacklist().
keywords: sdk android v4 sdk android user blacklist get-blacklist
content: Retrieve the full list of users blocked by the authenticated account. This is typically used in privacy settings to manage blocked accounts or on user profile cards to render a "Blocked" state. Code example OpenIMClient.getInstance .friendshipManager.getBlacklist new OnBase @Override public void onSuccess List users // Update blocked users list UI using users @Override public void onError int code, String error // Handle error ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | base | OnBase | Yes | Callback delivering the asynchronous operation result. | Return value The successful callback returns a List . If no users are blocked, an empty list is returned. Deduplicate and cache items using userID as the unique key. Access BlacklistInfo on each UserInfo object via the blackInfo property: | Field | Description | | | | | userID | User ID of the blocked user. | | nickname | Display nickname of the blocked user. | | faceURL | Avatar URL of the blocked user. | | gender | Gender indicator of the blocked user. | | operatorUserID | User ID of the operator who executed the block. | | createTime | Unix timestamp when the user was added to the blocklist. | | addSource | Channel or origin of the block operation. | | ex | Custom blocklist extension metadata. | When users are added to or removed from the blocklist, the SDK dispatches events via OnFriendshipListener ; see Add to blacklist /sdk/android/user/blacklist/add blacklist and Remove from blacklist /sdk/android/user/blacklist/remove blacklist .

title: Add to blacklist
description: Add a specified user to the authenticated account blocklist using addBlacklist().
keywords: sdk android v4 sdk android user blacklist add-blacklist
content: Add a specified user to the authenticated account's blocklist. Blocking is an asymmetric relationship; once blocked, the target user cannot send direct messages to the authenticated user. Code example OpenIMClient.getInstance .friendshipManager.addBlacklist new OnBase @Override public void onSuccess String data // User blocked successfully @Override public void onError int code, String error // Handle error , targetUserID, " \"source\":\"profile menu\" " ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | base | OnBase | Yes | Callback delivering the asynchronous operation result. | | targetUserID | String | Yes | Target user ID to block. | | ex | String | No | Custom business extension string. Pass an empty string or omit when no extension metadata is needed. | Return value The successful callback indicates that the server placed the target user on the authenticated account's blocklist. State changes after the call Once the block takes effect, the SDK triggers the onBlacklistAdded BlacklistInfo user event via OnFriendshipListener . Locate and update the user entry matching user.getUserID in your local blocklist cache: @Override public void onBlacklistAdded BlacklistInfo user // Received block event; update local blocklist using user.getUserID For complete listener registration details, see Get the blacklist /sdk/android/user/blacklist/get blacklist . To unblock a user, see Remove from blacklist /sdk/android/user/blacklist/remove blacklist .

title: Remove from blacklist
description: Unblock a specified user and remove them from the authenticated account blocklist using removeBlacklist().
keywords: sdk android v4 sdk android user blacklist remove-blacklist
content: Remove a specified user from the authenticated account's blocklist. Once unblocked, the target user can send direct messages to the authenticated account again. Code example OpenIMClient.getInstance .friendshipManager.removeBlacklist new OnBase @Override public void onSuccess String data // User unblocked successfully @Override public void onError int code, String error // Handle error , targetUserID ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | base | OnBase | Yes | Callback delivering the asynchronous operation result. | | targetUserID | String | Yes | Target user ID to unblock. | Return value The successful callback indicates that the server removed the user from the blocklist. State changes after the call Once the unblock operation takes effect, the SDK triggers the onBlacklistDeleted BlacklistInfo user event via OnFriendshipListener . Locate and remove the entry matching user.getUserID from your local blocklist dataset: @Override public void onBlacklistDeleted BlacklistInfo user // Received unblock event; delete entry matching user.getUserID from local cache For complete listener registration details, see Get the blacklist /sdk/android/user/blacklist/get blacklist .

title: Conversation overview
description: Understand ConversationInfo, conversationID, conversation settings, and event handling in the OpenIM Android SDK.
keywords: sdk android v4 sdk android conversation overview-conversation
content: A conversation maintains chat list state for the authenticated user in a direct or group chat, represented by a ConversationInfo entity. It tracks unread counts, latest messages, pinning status, drafts, message reception options, and custom extension fields. A conversationID uniquely identifies a conversation and serves as the primary key when querying conversation metadata and updating conversation settings. In direct chats, the target is the peer userID ; in group chats, the target is the groupID . Group profiles, membership rosters, and permission management belong to group capabilities. Group chat screens use groupID when calling Group APIs, and use conversationID when managing conversation settings, unread counts, drafts, and message purging. Conversation identifiers | Identifier | Purpose | | | | | conversationID | Unique conversation record ID for the current account, used for conversation settings, unread states, and message history. | | userID | Target user ID in a direct chat. | | groupID | Target group ID in a group chat, also used as the target identifier in Group APIs. | | sourceId | Target passed when generating or querying conversation IDs: userID for direct chats, groupID for group chats. | Conversation data | Field | Description | | | | | conversationID | Unique conversation identifier. | | conversationType | Conversation type: ConversationType.SINGLE CHAT for direct chats; ConversationType.GROUP CHAT or ConversationType.SUPER GROUP CHAT for group chats. | | userID / groupID | userID identifies the peer user in direct chats; groupID identifies the destination group in group chats. Exactly one is populated. | | showName | Conversation display name: peer user's nickname or remark in direct chats; group name or remark in group chats. | | faceURL | Conversation avatar URL. | | unreadCount | Unread message count for this conversation. | | latestMsg | JSON string representation of the latest message. | | latestMsgSendTime | Unix timestamp in milliseconds of the latest message. | | recvMsgOpt | Message reception option for this conversation. | | groupAtType | Group mention reminder status. | | draftText | Draft message text. | | draftTextTime | Unix timestamp when the draft was last updated. | | isPinned | Whether the conversation is pinned to the top of the list. | | isPrivateChat Enterprise | Whether burn after reading mode is enabled. | | burnDuration Enterprise | Reading duration in seconds before messages are destroyed in burn after reading mode. | | isMsgDestruct Enterprise | Whether scheduled server side message deletion is active. | | msgDestructTime Enterprise | Retention duration for scheduled server side message deletion. | | ext | Reserved conversation extension string. | | ex | Custom application defined extension string. | | isNotInGroup | Indicates whether the current user is no longer a member of the group. | Navigation by task | Task | Documentation page | | | | | Query a single conversation, batch conversations, or paginated lists | Get a conversation by target /sdk/android/conversation/retrieving conversations/get conversation by target , Get conversations by ID /sdk/android/conversation/retrieving conversations/get conversations by id , Get the conversation list /sdk/android/conversation/retrieving conversations/retrieve conversation list | | Generate a conversation ID | Generate a conversation ID /sdk/android/conversation/retrieving conversations/get conversation id | | Organize conversation listings | Pin or unpin a conversation /sdk/android/conversation/managing conversations/pin conversation , Hide a conversation /sdk/android/conversation/managing conversations/hide a conversation | | Manage drafts and extension fields | Set a conversation draft /sdk/android/conversation/managing conversations/set conversation draft , Set conversation extension data /sdk/android/conversation/managing conversations/set conversation extension | | Configure message reception and retention rules | Set conversation message reception /sdk/android/conversation/managing conversations/set message receive option , Enable or disable burn after reading /sdk/android/conversation/managing conversations/set private chat , Set burn after reading duration /sdk/android/conversation/managing conversations/set burn duration , Schedule server message deletion /sdk/android/conversation/managing conversations/set message destruct | | Manage unread counters and group mentions | Mark a conversation as read /sdk/android/conversation/managing conversations/mark conversation read , Get the total unread count /sdk/android/conversation/managing conversations/get total unread count , Reset group mention status /sdk/android/conversation/managing conversations/clear group mentions | | Delete or purge conversation data | Delete a conversation and its messages /sdk/android/conversation/managing conversations/delete conversation with messages , Clear messages in a conversation /sdk/android/conversation/managing conversations/clear conversation messages | State updates After registering OnConversationListener at the application layer, the client receives real time event notifications for conversation list modifications and total unread count adjustments. Merge incremental changes and deduplicate items using conversationID as the primary key. For complete listener configuration, see Get the conversation list /sdk/android/conversation/retrieving conversations/retrieve conversation list : onNewConversation : Delivers newly created conversations to insert at the top or into custom sorted order. onConversationChanged : Delivers conversations with modified attributes, such as unread count, latest message, pinning status, or draft changes. onTotalUnreadMessageCountChanged : Delivers updates to the overall unread message counter for badge rendering. ConversationManager retains a single listener instance; subsequent calls replace previously registered listeners. When logging out or switching accounts, reset event dispatching logic accordingly.

title: Get a conversation by target
description: Query detailed information for a single conversation using a target user ID or group ID.
keywords: sdk android v4 sdk android conversation retrieving-conversations get-conversation-by-target
content: Retrieve a snapshot of a single conversation using the target user ID or group ID. This is typically used when opening a chat screen directly from a contact card, group profile, or search result. If the conversation does not exist locally yet, the SDK creates and returns a base conversation entity automatically. Code example OpenIMClient.getInstance .conversationManager.getOneConversation new OnBase @Override public void onSuccess ConversationInfo conversation // conversation contains the target conversation data. @Override public void onError int code, String error // code and error describe the failure. , sourceId, ConversationType.SINGLE CHAT ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | base | OnBase | Yes | Callback delivering the asynchronous query result. | | sourceId | String | Yes | Target identifier. Pass the peer userID for direct chats or the groupID for group chats. | | sessionType | int | Yes | Conversation type: ConversationType.SINGLE CHAT for direct chats; ConversationType.GROUP CHAT or ConversationType.SUPER GROUP CHAT for group chats. | Return value The successful callback returns the ConversationInfo snapshot of the target conversation, containing unread counts, draft text, pinning status, and the latest message. Use conversation.conversationID as the unique key to merge or cache conversation state. To monitor conversation property modifications or incoming messages continuously, register OnConversationListener at the application layer as shown in Get the conversation list /sdk/android/conversation/retrieving conversations/retrieve conversation list .

title: Generate a conversation ID
description: Compute a conversation ID locally from the chat target and session type.
keywords: sdk android v4 sdk android conversation retrieving-conversations get-conversation-id
content: Compute a conversationID synchronously on the client from the target ID and session type without executing network queries. Code example String conversationID = OpenIMClient.getInstance .conversationManager .getConversationIDBySessionType sourceId, ConversationType.SINGLE CHAT ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | sourceId | String | Yes | Target identifier. Pass the peer userID for direct chats or the groupID for group chats. | | sessionType | int | Yes | Conversation type: ConversationType.SINGLE CHAT for direct chats; ConversationType.GROUP CHAT or ConversationType.SUPER GROUP CHAT for group chats. | Return value Returns the computed conversationID string synchronously. This method is a pure local calculation that performs no network requests. To retrieve conversation metadata such as unread count, draft text, or latest message, call Get a conversation by target /sdk/android/conversation/retrieving conversations/get conversation by target .

title: Get conversations by ID
description: Batch retrieve conversation records by a list of conversation IDs using getMultipleConversation().
keywords: sdk android v4 sdk android conversation retrieving-conversations get-conversations-by-id
content: Retrieve conversation snapshots in batches using a list of conversationID values. This is typically used for notification routing, quick syncs, or custom grouping interfaces. Code example OpenIMClient.getInstance .conversationManager.getMultipleConversation new OnBase @Override public void onSuccess List conversations // conversations contains the retrieved ConversationInfo items. @Override public void onError int code, String error // code and error describe the failure. , conversationIDs ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | base | OnBase | Yes | Callback delivering the asynchronous query results. | | conversationIDs | List | Yes | List of conversationID values to query. Filter empty strings and duplicate entries before calling. | Return value The successful callback delivers a List containing the matched conversations. Merge returned records into your local conversation cache using each item's conversationID as the primary key. If any queried IDs do not exist, they are omitted from the returned list.

title: Get the conversation list
description: Paginate the conversation list for the authenticated user and keep it synchronized with real-time updates.
keywords: sdk android v4 sdk android conversation retrieving-conversations retrieve-conversation-list
content: The conversation list belongs to the authenticated user. Paginate queries to avoid loading excessive data into memory at once. Each ConversationInfo record encapsulates unread counts, latest messages, pinning state, and drafts. Code example OpenIMClient.getInstance .conversationManager.getConversationListSplit new OnBase @Override public void onSuccess List conversations // conversations contains the current page of conversations. @Override public void onError int code, String error // code and error describe the failure. , 0, 50 ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | base | OnBase | Yes | Callback delivering the asynchronous query result. | | offset | long | Yes | Zero based paging offset; reset to 0 on initial load or pull to refresh. | | count | long | Yes | Number of conversation items to fetch in this page. | Return value The successful callback returns the current page as List . Merge and deduplicate items using conversationID as the unique primary key. When the returned list size is less than count , the end of the conversation list has been reached. When loading the next page, increment offset by the total number of conversations fetched so far. Keep the list synchronized Register OnConversationListener at the application layer to receive real time notifications when conversations are added or updated: OnConversationListener conversationListener = new OnConversationListener @Override public void onNewConversation List conversations // conversations contains newly created conversations. @Override public void onConversationChanged List conversations // conversations contains updated conversations. ; OpenIMClient.getInstance .conversationManager.setOnConversationListener conversationListener ; Both callbacks carry a List . When receiving updates, iterate through the list, locate the corresponding local conversation using conversationID , merge modified fields or insert new records, and re sort the UI list. When logging out or switching accounts, pass null or unregister callbacks to clear stale listeners.

title: Pin or unpin a conversation
description: Pin or unpin a conversation at the top of the conversation list for the authenticated user.
keywords: sdk android v4 sdk android conversation managing-conversations pin-conversation
content: Pin or unpin a conversation in the authenticated user's conversation list. Pinned conversations remain anchored at the top of the list view. Code example OpenIMClient.getInstance .conversationManager.pinConversation new OnBase @Override public void onSuccess String data // Pin request succeeded. @Override public void onError int code, String error // code and error describe the failure. , conversationID, true ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | base | OnBase | Yes | Callback delivering the asynchronous operation result. | | conversationID | String | Yes | Target conversation identifier. | | isPinned | boolean | Yes | Set to true to pin the conversation, or false to unpin it. | Return value The successful callback indicates that the server recorded the updated pinning status. Pinning affects only the authenticated user's view and does not modify the conversation layout for peer users or group members. State changes after the call Once the call succeeds, the SDK dispatches the OnConversationListener.onConversationChanged event. When your listener receives this event, locate the matching local conversation by conversationID , update its isPinned flag, and re sort the conversation list. For complete listener registration details, see Get the conversation list /sdk/android/conversation/retrieving conversations/retrieve conversation list .

title: Set conversation extension data
description: Store custom application metadata on a conversation using setConversationEx().
keywords: sdk android v4 sdk android conversation managing-conversations set-conversation-extension
content: Attach custom business metadata to a conversation. The extension string is typically a serialized JSON string used to store domain tags, category identifiers, or custom presentation attributes. Code example OpenIMClient.getInstance .conversationManager.setConversationEx new OnBase @Override public void onSuccess String data // Extension update succeeded. @Override public void onError int code, String error // code and error describe the failure. , conversationID, extensionJSON ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | base | OnBase | Yes | Callback delivering the asynchronous operation result. | | conversationID | String | Yes | Target conversation identifier. | | ex | String | Yes | Custom extension string, typically formatted as JSON text. | Return value The successful callback indicates that the server persisted the extension string. The update synchronizes across all devices logged into the authenticated account. State changes after the call Once the extension string takes effect, the SDK triggers the OnConversationListener.onConversationChanged event. When your listener receives this event, locate the conversation matching conversationID and update its ex field. For complete listener registration details, see Get the conversation list /sdk/android/conversation/retrieving conversations/retrieve conversation list .

title: Set a conversation draft
description: Save or clear unsent draft text locally for a conversation.
keywords: sdk android v4 sdk android conversation managing-conversations set-conversation-draft
content: Save unsent draft text when the user leaves a chat screen, switches conversations, or modifies input contents. Debounce frequent text changes while the user is typing, and commit the final draft immediately when navigating away. Code example OpenIMClient.getInstance .conversationManager.setConversationDraft new OnBase @Override public void onSuccess String data // Draft saved successfully. @Override public void onError int code, String error // code and error describe the failure. , conversationID, editorValue ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | base | OnBase | Yes | Callback delivering the asynchronous operation result. | | conversationID | String | Yes | Target conversation identifier. | | draftText | String | Yes | Draft text content. Pass an empty string "" to clear the draft. | Return value The successful callback indicates that the draft was saved to local conversation storage. Drafts are persisted exclusively on the local device and do not synchronize to other devices or clients. State changes after the call Saving or clearing a draft triggers the OnConversationListener.onConversationChanged event. Locate the conversation by conversationID and update its draftText and draftTextTime fields. For complete listener registration details, see Get the conversation list /sdk/android/conversation/retrieving conversations/retrieve conversation list .

title: Set conversation message reception
description: Configure message reception and offline notification behavior for a specific conversation.
keywords: sdk android v4 sdk android conversation managing-conversations set-message-receive-option
content: Configure message reception and do not disturb DND modes for a specific conversation, such as standard alerts, silent reception without push alerts, or blocking messages entirely. Code example OpenIMClient.getInstance .conversationManager.setConversationRecvMessageOpt new OnBase @Override public void onSuccess String data // Reception option updated. @Override public void onError int code, String error // code and error describe the failure. , conversationID, 2 ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | base | OnBase | Yes | Callback delivering the asynchronous operation result. | | conversationID | String | Yes | Target conversation identifier. | | opt | int | Yes | Message reception mode integer code. | Message reception modes | Enum constant | Value | Description | | | | | | ReceiveMessageOpt.Normal | 0 | Receive messages normally with local alerts and offline push notifications. | | ReceiveMessageOpt.NotReceive | 1 | Reject incoming messages for this conversation entirely without notifications. | | ReceiveMessageOpt.NotNotify | 2 | Receive messages and display them in the chat list, but suppress sound, badge alerts, and offline push notifications Do Not Disturb . | Return value The successful callback indicates that the server recorded the updated reception option. The setting synchronizes across all active sessions belonging to the user. State changes after the call Once the option takes effect, the SDK triggers the OnConversationListener.onConversationChanged event. When your listener receives this event, locate the conversation by conversationID , update its recvMsgOpt property, and adjust DND indicator icons in the UI. For complete listener registration details, see Get the conversation list /sdk/android/conversation/retrieving conversations/retrieve conversation list . To configure account wide notification preferences, see Set global message reception /sdk/android/user/user profile/set global message reception .

title: Reset group mention status
description: Clear group mention badges and reminders for a specific group conversation using resetConversationGroupAtType().
keywords: sdk android v4 sdk android conversation managing-conversations clear-group-mentions
content: When group members mention the authenticated user or invoke @everyone , the conversation's groupAtType flags the corresponding mention status. After the user opens the group chat and views the relevant messages, reset the mention flag to dismiss high priority badges or highlight indicators in the conversation list. Code example OpenIMClient.getInstance .conversationManager.resetConversationGroupAtType new OnBase @Override public void onSuccess String data // Group mention reset completed. @Override public void onError int code, String error // code and error describe the failure. , conversationID ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | base | OnBase | Yes | Callback delivering the asynchronous operation result. | | conversationID | String | Yes | Target group conversation identifier. | Return value The successful callback indicates that the server recorded the reset operation and restored groupAtType to its default state. State changes after the call After resetting the mention flag, the SDK triggers the OnConversationListener.onConversationChanged event. Locate the conversation by conversationID , clear mention banners such as "@mention" or "@everyone" from the conversation item, and refresh the UI. For complete listener registration details, see Get the conversation list /sdk/android/conversation/retrieving conversations/retrieve conversation list .

title: Mark a conversation as read
description: Mark all unread messages in a conversation as read and reset the conversation unread count.
keywords: sdk android v4 sdk android conversation managing-conversations mark-conversation-read
content: Mark all unread messages within a conversation as read when the user opens the chat screen and views incoming messages. Call this method after the messages are rendered on screen; avoid triggering it prematurely from background notifications or transient popups. Code example OpenIMClient.getInstance .messageManager.markConversationMessageAsRead conversationID, new OnBase @Override public void onSuccess String data // Read receipt reported successfully. @Override public void onError int code, String error // code and error describe the failure. ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | conversationID | String | Yes | Target conversation identifier. | | base | OnBase | Yes | Callback delivering the asynchronous operation result. | Return value The successful callback indicates that the server recorded the read receipt. The conversation unread count resets to zero locally, and the overall unread counter decrements accordingly. State changes after the call Once the call succeeds, the SDK dispatches the OnConversationListener.onConversationChanged event. Locate the conversation by conversationID and clear its unread badge. For complete listener registration details, see Get the conversation list /sdk/android/conversation/retrieving conversations/retrieve conversation list . In direct chats, the peer receives a C2C read receipt event via OnAdvanceMsgListener.onRecvC2CReadReceipt . For complete message event details, see Receive messages /sdk/android/message/receiving messages/receive messages and Message overview /sdk/android/message/overview message .

title: Get the total unread count
description: Retrieve the total unread message count across all conversations for the authenticated user.
keywords: sdk android v4 sdk android conversation managing-conversations get-total-unread-count
content: Retrieve the aggregate unread message count across all conversations for the authenticated account. This is typically used after login, upon application initialization, or when returning to the foreground to reconcile bottom navigation tab badges. Code example OpenIMClient.getInstance .conversationManager.getTotalUnreadMsgCount new OnBase @Override public void onSuccess String value int totalUnread = Integer.parseInt value ; // totalUnread represents the total unread count. @Override public void onError int code, String error // code and error describe the failure. ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | base | OnBase | Yes | Callback delivering the asynchronous operation result. | Return value The successful callback returns a String representing the total unread count. Parse it into an integer to update global badge counts across your application. State changes after the call Whenever new messages arrive, conversations are marked as read, or unread states synchronize from another client, the SDK dispatches updates via OnConversationListener.onTotalUnreadMessageCountChanged . For complete listener configuration, see Get the conversation list /sdk/android/conversation/retrieving conversations/retrieve conversation list .

title: Enable or disable burn after reading
description: Toggle private chat mode (burn after reading) for a specific direct conversation.
keywords: sdk android v4 sdk android conversation managing-conversations set-private-chat
content: Enable or disable burn after reading private chat mode for a direct chat conversation. When enabled, messages sent within the conversation trigger a countdown timer and delete automatically once the recipient views them. Code example OpenIMClient.getInstance .conversationManager.setOneConversationPrivateChat new OnBase @Override public void onSuccess String data // Private chat status updated. @Override public void onError int code, String error // code and error describe the failure. , conversationID, true ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | base | OnBase | Yes | Callback delivering the asynchronous operation result. | | conversationID | String | Yes | Target conversation identifier. | | isPrivate | boolean | Yes | Pass true to enable burn after reading; pass false to disable it. | Return value The successful callback indicates that the server updated the burn after reading flag for the conversation. You can customize the destruction countdown interval using Set burn after reading duration /sdk/android/conversation/managing conversations/set burn duration . State changes after the call Once the setting takes effect, the SDK triggers the OnConversationListener.onConversationChanged event. Locate the conversation by conversationID , update its isPrivateChat property, and reflect private chat indicators in your UI. For complete listener registration details, see Get the conversation list /sdk/android/conversation/retrieving conversations/retrieve conversation list .

title: Set burn-after-reading duration
description: Configure the destruction countdown interval (in seconds) for burn-after-reading messages in a conversation.
keywords: sdk android v4 sdk android conversation managing-conversations set-burn-duration
content: Configure the reading countdown interval in seconds for a conversation operating in burn after reading mode. Once burn after reading is active, messages trigger this destruction timer as soon as the recipient opens them. Code example OpenIMClient.getInstance .conversationManager.setConversationBurnDuration new OnBase @Override public void onSuccess String data // Burn duration updated. @Override public void onError int code, String error // code and error describe the failure. , conversationID, 30 ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | base | OnBase | Yes | Callback delivering the asynchronous operation result. | | conversationID | String | Yes | Target conversation identifier. | | burnDuration | int | Yes | Countdown duration in seconds, such as 30 . Do not confuse with scheduled server side message deletion. | Return value The successful callback indicates that the server persisted the burn duration setting. To activate or deactivate burn after reading mode itself, call Enable or disable burn after reading /sdk/android/conversation/managing conversations/set private chat . State changes after the call Once the duration takes effect, the SDK triggers the OnConversationListener.onConversationChanged event. Locate the conversation by conversationID and update its burnDuration property. For complete listener registration details, see Get the conversation list /sdk/android/conversation/retrieving conversations/retrieve conversation list .

title: Schedule server message deletion
description: Enable, disable, and configure scheduled server-side message retention for a specific conversation.
keywords: sdk android v4 sdk android conversation managing-conversations set-message-destruct
content: Configure scheduled server side message destruction policies for a specific conversation. When enabled, the server automatically purges historical messages that exceed the configured retention window. This is a server retention strategy, distinct from client side burn after reading. Code example ConversationReq request = new ConversationReq ; request.setMsgDestruct true ; request.setMsgDestructTime 3600 ; OpenIMClient.getInstance .conversationManager.setConversation new OnBase @Override public void onSuccess String data // Destruction settings saved successfully. @Override public void onError int code, String error // code and error describe the failure. , conversationID, request ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | base | OnBase | Yes | Callback delivering the asynchronous operation result. | | conversationID | String | Yes | Target conversation identifier. | | request | ConversationReq | Yes | Conversation configuration request object. | Request attributes | Property | Type | Description | | | | | | isMsgDestruct | boolean | Enables or disables scheduled server side message purging. Pass false to disable. | | msgDestructTime | int | Retention interval in seconds, such as 3600 . | Return value The successful callback indicates that the server recorded the destruction policy. This configuration applies strictly to server side history retention; to destroy messages immediately upon viewing, see Enable or disable burn after reading /sdk/android/conversation/managing conversations/set private chat . State changes after the call Once the policy takes effect, the SDK triggers the OnConversationListener.onConversationChanged event. Locate the conversation by conversationID and update its isMsgDestruct and msgDestructTime fields. For complete listener registration details, see Get the conversation list /sdk/android/conversation/retrieving conversations/retrieve conversation list .

title: Hide a conversation
description: Temporarily hide a conversation from the authenticated user conversation list using hideConversation().
keywords: sdk android v4 sdk android conversation managing-conversations hide-a-conversation
content: Temporarily hide a conversation entry from the authenticated account's conversation list. This operation collapses the conversation entry without deleting chat history, altering friendships, or leaving groups. Code example OpenIMClient.getInstance .conversationManager.hideConversation new OnBase @Override public void onSuccess String data // Conversation hidden successfully. @Override public void onError int code, String error // code and error describe the failure. , conversationID ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | base | OnBase | Yes | Callback delivering the asynchronous operation result. | | conversationID | String | Yes | Target conversation identifier. | Return value The successful callback indicates that the server recorded the hidden state for the conversation. State changes after the call Hiding removes the conversation strictly from the active list presentation. If a new message arrives in this conversation or an incremental synchronization restores it, the SDK automatically brings the conversation back into view. Upon callback success, remove the item matching conversationID from your in memory list and update the view. For subsequent conversation updates, see Get the conversation list /sdk/android/conversation/retrieving conversations/retrieve conversation list .

title: Delete a conversation and its messages
description: Remove a conversation from the conversation list and delete all associated messages using deleteConversationAndDeleteAllMsg().
keywords: sdk android v4 sdk android conversation managing-conversations delete-conversation-with-messages
content: Remove a conversation from the authenticated user's conversation list and permanently delete all associated historical messages. This corresponds to the user initiated "Delete chat" action in a chat list. Code example OpenIMClient.getInstance .conversationManager.deleteConversationAndDeleteAllMsg new OnBase @Override public void onSuccess String data // Conversation and messages deleted successfully. @Override public void onError int code, String error // code and error describe the failure. , conversationID ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | base | OnBase | Yes | Callback delivering the asynchronous operation result. | | conversationID | String | Yes | Target conversation identifier. | Return value The successful callback indicates that both the server and local database completed the deletion of the conversation record and all its messages. This operation removes records solely for the authenticated account; it does not terminate friendships, nor does it leave or dismiss groups. If a new message arrives in this conversation later, the SDK re creates the conversation entry as a fresh thread. State changes after the call Upon deletion, the SDK dispatches the OnConversationListener.onConversationChanged event. Remove the item matching conversationID from your local list dataset and refresh the UI. For complete listener registration details, see Get the conversation list /sdk/android/conversation/retrieving conversations/retrieve conversation list . To clear message history while keeping the conversation entry visible, see Clear messages in a conversation /sdk/android/conversation/managing conversations/clear conversation messages .

title: Clear messages in a conversation
description: Purge all local and remote messages from a specific conversation while preserving the conversation entry.
keywords: sdk android v4 sdk android conversation managing-conversations clear-conversation-messages
content: Purge all historical messages from a conversation while preserving the conversation entry itself in the chat list. Use this operation when the user wants to wipe message history without removing the chat contact or group item. Code example OpenIMClient.getInstance .messageManager.clearConversationAndDeleteAllMsg conversationID, new OnBase @Override public void onSuccess String data // Messages cleared successfully. @Override public void onError int code, String error // code and error describe the failure. ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | conversationID | String | Yes | Target conversation identifier. | | base | OnBase | Yes | Callback delivering the asynchronous operation result. | Return value The successful callback indicates that all messages for the specified conversation were deleted locally and remotely. The conversation entry remains in the chat list, but its latest message preview latestMsg is cleared. State changes after the call Purging messages triggers the OnConversationListener.onConversationChanged event. Locate the conversation by conversationID , reset message history in active chat views, and clear the latest message preview in the list. For complete listener registration details, see Get the conversation list /sdk/android/conversation/retrieving conversations/retrieve conversation list . To delete the conversation entry alongside its messages, see Delete a conversation and its messages /sdk/android/conversation/managing conversations/delete conversation with messages .

title: Group overview
description: Understand group concepts, core data models, and group management capabilities in the OpenIM Android SDK.
keywords: sdk android v4 sdk android group overview-group
content: Multi user chat scenarios in OpenIM rely on groups to maintain shared profiles, membership rosters, and permission policies. A groupID uniquely identifies a group; use it when sending group messages, querying group metadata, moderating members, or reviewing join applications. In contrast, the user's chat list entry for the group is tracked by conversationID . Core data types | Type | Description | | | | | GroupInfo | Group name, avatar, announcement, owner, verification mode, member count, and custom extension fields. | | GroupMembersInfo | In group member nickname, role, mute status, and join timestamp. | | GroupApplicationInfo | Join applications and their current review statuses. | Member roles are represented by GroupRole constants: MEMBER standard member , ADMIN administrator , and OWNER group owner . Key capabilities Create a group /sdk/android/group/create group and Update group profile /sdk/android/group/update group profile Set group join verification /sdk/android/group/set group join verification and Set group announcement /sdk/android/group/set group announcement Apply to join a group /sdk/android/group/join group , Quit a group /sdk/android/group/quit group , and Dismiss a group /sdk/android/group/dismiss group Get specified groups info /sdk/android/group/retrieving groups/get specified groups info and Get joined group list /sdk/android/group/retrieving groups/get joined group list page Get received group applications /sdk/android/group/group applications/get group application list as recipient and Accept a group application /sdk/android/group/group applications/accept group application Get group member list /sdk/android/group/retrieving group members/get group member list and Get group owner and admins /sdk/android/group/retrieving group members/get group member owner and admin Invite users to a group /sdk/android/group/managing group members/invite user to group and Remove a group member /sdk/android/group/managing group members/kick group member State updates Register OnGroupListener before logging in to receive real time notifications for group profile modifications, member changes, and join applications. Merge group states locally using groupID as the primary key, and merge group member states using groupID:userID : private final OnGroupListener groupListener = new OnGroupListener @Override public void onJoinedGroupAdded GroupInfo group // Refresh joined groups list, merging by group.getGroupID @Override public void onJoinedGroupDeleted GroupInfo group // Remove group.getGroupID from the joined groups list @Override public void onGroupInfoChanged GroupInfo group // Refresh group profile matching group.getGroupID @Override public void onGroupDismissed GroupInfo group // Flag group as dismissed and update active chat views matching group.getGroupID @Override public void onGroupMemberAdded GroupMembersInfo member // Incrementally add member to group member list for member.getGroupID @Override public void onGroupMemberDeleted GroupMembersInfo member // Remove member matching member.getGroupID and member.getUserID @Override public void onGroupMemberInfoChanged GroupMembersInfo member // Update member role, nickname, or mute status for member.getGroupID and member.getUserID @Override public void onGroupApplicationAdded GroupApplicationInfo application // Refresh join applications list @Override public void onGroupApplicationAccepted GroupApplicationInfo application // Refresh join applications list @Override public void onGroupApplicationRejected GroupApplicationInfo application // Refresh join applications list @Override public void onGroupApplicationDeleted GroupApplicationInfo application // Refresh join applications list ; public void registerGroupListener OpenIMClient.getInstance .groupManager.setOnGroupListener groupListener ; A successful API callback indicates that the local or remote operation succeeded. Reconcile in memory lists and member caches using listener events, or re query paginated endpoints when recovering state after network disconnections.

title: Create a group
description: Create a group with initial members, administrators, and an owner using createGroup().
keywords: sdk android v4 sdk android group create-group
content: Create a group and configure its initial profile. Populate the GroupInfo payload with basic properties such as group name and description, and supply lists specifying initial members, administrators, and the group owner. The successful callback delivers the created GroupInfo containing the server assigned groupID . Code example GroupInfo info = new GroupInfo ; info.setGroupName "Project Discussion" ; info.setIntroduction "Project members only" ; List memberUserIDs = Arrays.asList "user a", "user b" ; List adminUserIDs = Arrays.asList "user c" ; String ownerUserID = "user owner"; OpenIMClient.getInstance .groupManager.createGroup memberUserIDs, adminUserIDs, info, ownerUserID, new OnBase @Override public void onSuccess GroupInfo group // group contains the created group information and groupID @Override public void onError int code, String error // Handle creation failure ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | memberUserIDs | List | No | List of initial standard member user IDs; pass an empty list if none. | | adminUserIDs | List | No | List of initial administrator user IDs; do not overlap with members or the owner. | | info | GroupInfo | Yes | Group profile configuration object; must include groupName . | | ownerUserID | String | Yes | User ID designated as the group owner; must not overlap with member or admin lists. | | base | OnBase | Yes | Callback delivering the asynchronous operation result. | Return value The successful callback returns the created GroupInfo entity. Extract groupID to initiate group messages, query group metadata, or moderate members. State changes after the call A successful callback confirms that group creation completed on the server. The authenticated user and included members receive real time notifications via the onJoinedGroupAdded event on OnGroupListener . Merge the new group entry into your local cache using groupID . For complete listener registration details, see Group overview /sdk/android/group/overview group .

title: Update group profile
description: Update basic group attributes such as group name, introduction, and avatar using setGroupInfo().
keywords: sdk android v4 sdk android group update-group-profile
content: Update basic group attributes including the group name, avatar image URL, and introduction text. Set the target groupID and desired fields in the GroupInfo object; unassigned fields remain unchanged. Code example GroupInfo update = new GroupInfo ; update.setGroupID "group 123" ; update.setGroupName "Mobile Engineering Team" ; update.setIntroduction "Android and iOS collaboration group" ; update.setFaceURL "https://example.com/group avatar.png" ; OpenIMClient.getInstance .groupManager.setGroupInfo update, new OnBase @Override public void onSuccess String data // Group profile updated successfully @Override public void onError int code, String error // Handle update failure ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | groupInfo | GroupInfo | Yes | Group entity holding the target groupID and modified properties such as groupName , introduction , or faceURL . | | base | OnBase | Yes | Callback delivering the asynchronous operation result. | Return value The successful callback confirms that the group profile update was persisted on the server. State changes after the call Once the update takes effect, all online group members receive the onGroupInfoChanged GroupInfo group event via OnGroupListener . Merge the updated properties into local group caches using groupID . For complete listener registration details, see Group overview /sdk/android/group/overview group . To manage group announcements or custom business extension metadata, see Set group announcement /sdk/android/group/set group announcement and Set group extension data /sdk/android/group/set group extension .

title: Set group announcement
description: Publish or update announcement text for a specific group using setGroupInfo().
keywords: sdk android v4 sdk android group set-group-announcement
content: Publish or update the announcement text for a specific group. Assign the target groupID and the updated notification string in the GroupInfo object. Once persisted, the server automatically updates the announcement author ID and timestamp. Code example GroupInfo update = new GroupInfo ; update.setGroupID "group 123" ; update.setNotification "Release deployment confirmation tonight at 20:00." ; OpenIMClient.getInstance .groupManager.setGroupInfo update, new OnBase @Override public void onSuccess String data // Group announcement updated successfully @Override public void onError int code, String error // Handle update failure ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | groupInfo | GroupInfo | Yes | Group entity holding the target groupID and the updated notification text. | | base | OnBase | Yes | Callback delivering the asynchronous operation result. | Return value The successful callback confirms that the announcement was persisted on the server. State changes after the call After the announcement is updated, online group members receive the onGroupInfoChanged GroupInfo group event via OnGroupListener . The updated GroupInfo payload contains the new notification text, notificationUpdateTime , and notificationUserID . Merge these properties into your local cache using groupID . For complete listener registration details, see Group overview /sdk/android/group/overview group .

title: Set group extension data
description: Store custom application metadata on a group using setGroupInfo().
keywords: sdk android v4 sdk android group set-group-extension
content: Configure custom business extension metadata on a group. Populate the ex field on a GroupInfo instance to attach arbitrary business metadata such as a JSON string holding project tags or department IDs . The server replaces the existing extension string in its entirety; provide the complete updated payload on each call. Code example GroupInfo update = new GroupInfo ; update.setGroupID "group 123" ; update.setEx " \"projectCode\":\"mobile\",\"archived\":false " ; OpenIMClient.getInstance .groupManager.setGroupInfo update, new OnBase @Override public void onSuccess String data // Group extension updated successfully @Override public void onError int code, String error // Handle update failure ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | groupInfo | GroupInfo | Yes | Group entity holding the target groupID and the updated ex extension string. | | base | OnBase | Yes | Callback delivering the asynchronous operation result. | Return value The successful callback confirms that the extension string was persisted on the server. State changes after the call Once the extension string is saved, online group members receive the onGroupInfoChanged GroupInfo group event via OnGroupListener . Merge the updated ex field into your local group records using groupID . For complete listener registration details, see Group overview /sdk/android/group/overview group .

title: Set group join verification
description: Configure approval policies for joining and inviting members to a group using setGroupInfo().
keywords: sdk android v4 sdk android group set-group-join-verification
content: Configure the join verification policy for a group. Group owners and administrators can set the needVerification property on GroupInfo to govern whether direct join requests or member invitations require administrative review. Code example GroupInfo update = new GroupInfo ; update.setGroupID "group 123" ; update.setNeedVerification GroupVerification.ALL NEED VERIFICATION ; OpenIMClient.getInstance .groupManager.setGroupInfo update, new OnBase @Override public void onSuccess String data // Join verification updated successfully @Override public void onError int code, String error // Handle update failure ; Verification modes Use the constants defined in GroupVerification : | Enum constant | Value | Description | | | | | | DIRECTLY | 0 | Direct join; anyone who requests to join or is invited enters the group immediately. | | APPLY NEED VERIFICATION INVITE DIRECTLY | 1 | Direct join requests require administrative approval, whereas member invitations add invitees immediately. | | ALL NEED VERIFICATION | 2 | All join paths require administrative approval, including both direct applications and invitations. | Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | groupInfo | GroupInfo | Yes | Group entity holding the target groupID and the updated needVerification mode. | | base | OnBase | Yes | Callback delivering the asynchronous operation result. | Return value The successful callback confirms that the verification rule was updated on the server. State changes after the call A successful callback confirms that the server persisted the new join verification policy. The rule applies strictly to requests submitted after the update; it does not auto resolve or discard existing pending applications. Group members receive the onGroupInfoChanged GroupInfo group event via OnGroupListener . Merge the updated policy into your local cache using groupID . For complete listener registration details, see Group overview /sdk/android/group/overview group .

title: Set group member profile access
description: Control whether regular group members can view profile cards of other members using setGroupInfo().
keywords: sdk android v4 sdk android group set-group-member-profile-access
content: Control whether regular group members can inspect other members' personal profiles from the group roster. Group owners and administrators manage this restriction via the lookMemberInfo field on GroupInfo . This privacy safeguard prevents regular members from harvesting or viewing member profile cards. Code example GroupInfo update = new GroupInfo ; update.setGroupID "group 123" ; update.setLookMemberInfo 0 ; // 0 disallows regular members from viewing other member profiles OpenIMClient.getInstance .groupManager.setGroupInfo update, new OnBase @Override public void onSuccess String data // Permission updated successfully @Override public void onError int code, String error // Handle update failure ; Permission values The lookMemberInfo field accepts the following integers: | Mode | Value | Description | | | | | | Disallow viewing profiles | 0 | Regular members cannot tap or view other members' personal profile cards group owners and administrators remain exempt . | | Allow viewing profiles | 1 | All group members can tap and view other members' profiles. | Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | groupInfo | GroupInfo | Yes | Group entity holding the target groupID and the updated lookMemberInfo integer. | | base | OnBase | Yes | Callback delivering the asynchronous operation result. | Return value The successful callback confirms that the permission update was persisted on the server. State changes after the call Once updated, group members receive the onGroupInfoChanged GroupInfo group event via OnGroupListener . Merge the updated GroupInfo into local cache using groupID , and disable profile tap interactions in the group roster accordingly. For complete listener registration details, see Group overview /sdk/android/group/overview group .

title: Set in-group friending permission
description: Control whether members can send friend requests to each other from within a group using setGroupInfo().
keywords: sdk android v4 sdk android group set-group-member-friend-permission
content: Control whether group members can initiate friend applications to one another directly from the group roster. Group owners and administrators toggle this policy using the applyMemberFriend property on GroupInfo . This restriction specifically governs the friend request entry point in group member cards. Code example GroupInfo update = new GroupInfo ; update.setGroupID "group 123" ; update.setApplyMemberFriend 0 ; // 0 disallows members from adding each other as friends OpenIMClient.getInstance .groupManager.setGroupInfo update, new OnBase @Override public void onSuccess String data // Permission updated successfully @Override public void onError int code, String error // Handle update failure ; Permission values The applyMemberFriend field accepts the following integers: | Mode | Value | Description | | | | | | Disallow in group friending | 0 | Disallows members from sending friend applications to each other from this group. | | Allow in group friending | 1 | Allows members to send friend applications normally from group profile cards. | Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | groupInfo | GroupInfo | Yes | Group entity holding the target groupID and the updated applyMemberFriend integer. | | base | OnBase | Yes | Callback delivering the asynchronous operation result. | Return value The successful callback confirms that the permission setting was saved on the server. State changes after the call Once updated, group members receive the onGroupInfoChanged GroupInfo group event via OnGroupListener . Merge the updated GroupInfo using groupID , and hide or disable "Add friend" buttons on member profile cards. For complete listener registration details, see Group overview /sdk/android/group/overview group .

title: Mute or unmute a group
description: Enable or disable group-wide mute mode using changeGroupMute().
keywords: sdk android v4 sdk android group change-group-mute
content: Enable or disable mute mode for the entire group. This operation is typically restricted to group owners and administrators. When group wide mute is enabled, regular members cannot post messages, while owners and administrators can continue chatting. To mute an individual member instead, see Mute or unmute a group member /sdk/android/group/managing group members/change group member mute . Code example String groupID = "group 123"; boolean isMute = true; // true to mute all members, false to unmute OpenIMClient.getInstance .groupManager.changeGroupMute new OnBase @Override public void onSuccess String data // Group mute status updated successfully @Override public void onError int code, String error // Handle failure , groupID, isMute ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | base | OnBase | Yes | Callback delivering the asynchronous operation result. | | groupID | String | Yes | Target group ID. | | isMute | boolean | Yes | Pass true to mute all regular members, or false to unmute the group. | Return value The successful callback confirms that the mute setting was updated on the server. State changes after the call A successful callback confirms that the server updated group wide mute configuration. Group members subsequently receive the onGroupInfoChanged GroupInfo group event via OnGroupListener . Inspect the updated status mute flag, merge group state using groupID , and enable or disable the chat input bar accordingly. For complete listener registration details, see Group overview /sdk/android/group/overview group .

title: Apply to join a group
description: Submit an application to join a group or enter directly based on verification settings using joinGroup().
keywords: sdk android v4 sdk android group join-group
content: Submit a request to join a specified group. Depending on the group's verification mode, this operation either adds the user immediately or forwards an application to group administrators for approval. Code example String groupID = "group 123"; String reqMsg = "Requesting to join the developer group"; int joinSource = 3; // 3 indicates joining via search String ex = " \"source\":\"search page\" "; OpenIMClient.getInstance .groupManager.joinGroup new OnBase @Override public void onSuccess String data // Join request processed or application submitted successfully @Override public void onError int code, String error // Handle failure , groupID, reqMsg, joinSource, ex ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | base | OnBase | Yes | Callback delivering the asynchronous operation result. | | groupID | String | Yes | Target group ID. | | reqMsg | String | No | Optional application greeting or reason message sent to administrators. | | joinSource | int | Yes | Join source code: 2 for invitation, 3 for search, 4 for QR code scan. | | ex | String | No | Custom metadata string attached to the request such as a JSON string . Pass "" if not needed. | Return value Upon success, data in onSuccess returns a confirmation message. State changes after the call 1. Callback confirmation : The onSuccess callback confirms that the request was accepted and processed by the server. The group's configured policy in Set group join verification /sdk/android/group/set group join verification determines the subsequent lifecycle. 2. Direct join vs. application verification : Direct join : The user becomes a group member immediately. The SDK triggers OnGroupListener.onJoinedGroupAdded , delivering the new GroupInfo to merge into the joined groups list using groupID . Requires verification : The application is stored on the server awaiting owner or admin approval. Once approved, the client receives onJoinedGroupAdded . 3. Re query calibration : To verify current group membership or refresh joined groups, call Check group membership /sdk/android/group/retrieving groups/is join group or Get joined groups /sdk/android/group/retrieving groups/get joined group list page . For complete listener registration details, see Group overview /sdk/android/group/overview group .

title: Quit a group
description: Leave a specified group as the authenticated user using quitGroup().
keywords: sdk android v4 sdk android group quit-group
content: Leave a specified group that the authenticated user currently belongs to. This operation affects only the leaving user; the group itself and other members remain active. Group owners must transfer ownership or dismiss the group before quitting. Code example String groupID = "group 123"; OpenIMClient.getInstance .groupManager.quitGroup new OnBase @Override public void onSuccess String data // Group quitted successfully @Override public void onError int code, String error // Handle failure , groupID ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | base | OnBase | Yes | Callback delivering the asynchronous operation result. | | groupID | String | Yes | Target group ID to quit. | Return value The successful callback confirms that the server processed the exit operation. State changes after the call A successful callback confirms that the user was removed from the group on the server. The SDK then triggers the onJoinedGroupDeleted GroupInfo group event on OnGroupListener . Remove the group record matching groupID from your local joined groups list, and adjust or clear the associated group conversation view. For complete listener registration details, see Group overview /sdk/android/group/overview group . For group owners transferring ownership before leaving, see Transfer group ownership /sdk/android/group/managing group members/transfer group owner ; to terminate the group entirely, see Dismiss a group /sdk/android/group/dismiss group .

title: Dismiss a group
description: Disband a specified group and terminate all member sessions using dismissGroup().
keywords: sdk android v4 sdk android group dismiss-group
content: Disband a specified group as the group owner. Once dismissed, all members are evicted from the group, new messages cannot be sent, and the group cannot be restored. Code example String groupID = "group 123"; OpenIMClient.getInstance .groupManager.dismissGroup new OnBase @Override public void onSuccess String data // Group dismissed successfully @Override public void onError int code, String error // Handle failure , groupID ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | base | OnBase | Yes | Callback delivering the asynchronous operation result. | | groupID | String | Yes | Target group ID to dismiss. Only the group owner can execute this action. | Return value The successful callback confirms that the group dismissal was completed on the server. State changes after the call Group members receive the onGroupDismissed GroupInfo group event via OnGroupListener . Use groupID to flag the group as dissolved in local storage, disable the message composer in the chat interface, and update the group roster. For complete listener registration details, see Group overview /sdk/android/group/overview group .

title: Get specified groups info
description: Batch query detailed group profiles by a list of group IDs using getGroupsInfo().
keywords: sdk android v4 sdk android group retrieving-groups get-specified-groups-info
content: Batch retrieve profile details for specified groups using a list of group IDs. This is typically used to render chat headers, group profile cards, and settings views. Code example List groupIDs = Arrays.asList "group 123", "group 456" ; OpenIMClient.getInstance .groupManager.getGroupsInfo new OnBase @Override public void onSuccess List groups // groups contains the retrieved GroupInfo items @Override public void onError int code, String error // Handle query failure , groupIDs ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | base | OnBase | Yes | Callback delivering the asynchronous operation result. | | groupIDs | List | Yes | List of target group IDs to query. | Return value The successful callback returns a List . Each entity exposes properties including groupName , faceURL , notification , memberCount , ownerUserID , and ex . Merge returned group snapshots into your local cache using groupID . If group properties change later, the SDK broadcasts the onGroupInfoChanged event; for complete listener registration details, see Group overview /sdk/android/group/overview group .

title: Get joined group list
description: Paginate the list of groups joined by the authenticated user using getJoinedGroupListPage().
keywords: sdk android v4 sdk android group retrieving-groups get-joined-group-list-page
content: Paginate the list of all groups that the authenticated user has joined. Specify an offset and count to fetch pages iteratively for contacts lists, group pickers, or directory screens. Code example int offset = 0; int count = 20; OpenIMClient.getInstance .groupManager.getJoinedGroupListPage new OnBase @Override public void onSuccess List groups // groups contains the current page of joined groups @Override public void onError int code, String error // Handle query failure , offset, count ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | base | OnBase | Yes | Callback delivering the asynchronous operation result. | | offset | int | Yes | Zero based paging offset; pass 0 for the initial page. | | count | int | Yes | Maximum number of group records to fetch in this page. | Return value The successful callback returns the current page as List . Core properties of each group record include: | Field | Description | | | | | groupID | Unique global group ID. | | groupName | Display name of the group. | | faceURL | Avatar URL of the group. | | memberCount | Total member count in the group. | | ownerUserID | User ID of the group owner. | | status | Group lifecycle status 0 for active, 1 for banned, 2 for dismissed . | Deduplicate and merge group entries in your local cache using groupID . Subsequent joins or exits trigger onJoinedGroupAdded and onJoinedGroupDeleted events via OnGroupListener . For complete listener registration details, see Group overview /sdk/android/group/overview group .

title: Check group membership
description: Verify whether the authenticated user is currently a member of a specified group using isJoinGroup().
keywords: sdk android v4 sdk android group retrieving-groups is-join-group
content: Verify whether the authenticated user is already a member of a specified group. This is typically used to determine UI routing before entering a group from search results, shared links, or QR code scans. Code example String groupID = "group 123"; OpenIMClient.getInstance .groupManager.isJoinGroup groupID, new OnBase @Override public void onSuccess Boolean joined // joined is true if the authenticated user is a member of the group @Override public void onError int code, String error // Handle check failure ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | groupID | String | Yes | Target group ID to verify. | | base | OnBase | Yes | Callback delivering the asynchronous operation result. | Return value The successful callback returns a Boolean : true : The current user is an active group member; navigate directly to the group chat screen. false : The current user is not a group member; prompt the user to Apply to join a group /sdk/android/group/join group .

title: Search groups
description: Search local group records by keywords matching group ID or group name using searchGroups().
keywords: sdk android v4 sdk android group retrieving-groups search-groups
content: Search local group records by keywords matching group IDs or group names. Configure individual boolean toggles to enable or disable search targets. Code example List keywordList = Collections.singletonList "Engineering" ; boolean isSearchGroupID = true; boolean isSearchGroupName = true; OpenIMClient.getInstance .groupManager.searchGroups new OnBase @Override public void onSuccess List groups // groups contains matching group records @Override public void onError int code, String error // Handle search failure , keywordList, isSearchGroupID, isSearchGroupName ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | base | OnBase | Yes | Callback delivering the asynchronous operation result. | | keywordList | List | Yes | List of query keyword strings. Avoid querying with empty keywords or when both toggles are false . | | isSearchGroupID | boolean | Yes | Whether to search against group IDs: true to include, false to exclude. | | isSearchGroupName | boolean | Yes | Whether to search against group names: true to include, false to exclude. | Return value The successful callback returns a List containing all matching group records. Search results reflect a local matching snapshot at query execution time. Returned groups do not necessarily indicate that the user has joined them; to verify membership, call Check group membership /sdk/android/group/retrieving groups/is join group .

title: Get received group applications
description: Paginate group join requests received by the user as group owner or administrator using getRecvGroupApplicationList().
keywords: sdk android v4 sdk android group group-applications get-group-application-list-as-recipient
content: Paginate join requests that the authenticated user is authorized to review as a group owner or administrator. Configure the request object with paging offset and count, and optionally filter by target group IDs or review statuses. Code example GetGroupApplicationListAsRecipientReq request = new GetGroupApplicationListAsRecipientReq 0, 20 ; OpenIMClient.getInstance .groupManager.getRecvGroupApplicationList new OnBase @Override public void onSuccess List items // items contains the current page of application records @Override public void onError int code, String error // Handle query failure , request ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | base | OnBase | Yes | Callback delivering the asynchronous operation result. | | request | GetGroupApplicationListAsRecipientReq | Yes | Paging and filter configuration object holding offset and count , with optional groupIDs and handleResults filters. | Return value The successful callback returns the current page as List .
