For review actions, see Accept a group application /sdk/android/group/group applications/accept group application and Refuse a group application /sdk/android/group/group applications/refuse group application .

title: Get sent group applications
description: Paginate group join requests sent by the authenticated user using getSendGroupApplicationList().
keywords: sdk android v4 sdk android group group-applications get-group-application-list-as-applicant
content: Paginate outgoing group join applications submitted by the authenticated user. Configure the request object with paging offset and count to render request statuses such as pending, approved, or rejected . Code example GetGroupApplicationListAsApplicantReq request = new GetGroupApplicationListAsApplicantReq 0, 20 ; OpenIMClient.getInstance .groupManager.getSendGroupApplicationList new OnBase @Override public void onSuccess List items // items contains the current page of application records @Override public void onError int code, String error // Handle query failure , request ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | base | OnBase | Yes | Callback delivering the asynchronous operation result. | | request | GetGroupApplicationListAsApplicantReq | Yes | Paging parameter object holding offset and count . | Return value The successful callback returns the current page as List . Core properties of each outgoing record include: | Field | Description | | | | | groupID | Target group ID of the join application. | | groupName | Name of the target group. | | reqMsg | Note or greeting submitted with the application. | | handleResult | Approval status: 0 for pending, 1 for approved, 1 for rejected. | | handledMsg | Review note or response returned by the group administrator. | | reqTime | Timestamp in milliseconds when the application was sent. | Manage and display application statuses using groupID as the primary key. When an administrator approves the application, the client receives the onJoinedGroupAdded event on OnGroupListener to merge the group into the user's joined list. For complete listener registration details, see Group overview /sdk/android/group/overview group .

title: Accept a group application
description: Use the Android SDK to accept a user’s application to join a group.
keywords: sdk android v4 sdk android group group-applications accept-group-application
content: Group owners and administrators can accept an applicant's request to join a group. To process the request, provide the target group ID, the applicant's user ID, and an optional processing note. Code example String groupID = "group 123"; String applicantUserID = "user applicant"; String handleMsg = "Welcome to the group"; OpenIMClient.getInstance .groupManager.acceptGroupApplication new OnBase @Override public void onSuccess String data // Group application accepted successfully @Override public void onError int code, String error // Failed to accept group application , groupID, applicantUserID, handleMsg ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | base | OnBase | Yes | Callback handler for the asynchronous request. | | groupID | String | Yes | Globally unique ID of the target group. | | applicantUserID | String | Yes | User ID of the applicant requesting to join. | | handleMsg | String | No | Optional note or explanation for accepting the request. Pass an empty string if not needed. | Return value Upon success, data in onSuccess returns a confirmation message. State changes after the call 1. Callback confirmation : The onSuccess callback indicates that the server has processed the approval and updated the application state. 2. Asynchronous event delivery : The SDK triggers synchronization events across affected clients: onGroupApplicationAccepted : Delivers the updated GroupApplicationInfo . The client should merge or update the application record using groupID:userID as the unique key. onGroupMemberAdded : Delivers the new GroupMembersInfo object. The client should add the applicant to the local group member cache using groupID:userID as the unique key. 3. Re query calibration : If application state or member list counts diverge after intermittent network conditions, call getJoinedGroupListPage , getGroupMemberList , or getGroupApplicationListAsRecipient to reconcile local state with the server. For complete listener registration and lifecycle management, see Group overview /sdk/android/group/overview group .

title: Reject a group application
description: Use the Android SDK to reject a user’s application to join a group.
keywords: sdk android v4 sdk android group group-applications refuse-group-application
content: Group owners and administrators can reject a user's application to join a group. To reject the request, specify the target group ID, the applicant's user ID, and an optional rejection reason. Code example String groupID = "group 123"; String applicantUserID = "user applicant"; String handleMsg = "The group has reached its maximum member capacity."; OpenIMClient.getInstance .groupManager.refuseGroupApplication new OnBase @Override public void onSuccess String data // Group application rejected successfully @Override public void onError int code, String error // Failed to reject group application , groupID, applicantUserID, handleMsg ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | base | OnBase | Yes | Callback handler for the asynchronous request. | | groupID | String | Yes | Globally unique ID of the target group. | | applicantUserID | String | Yes | User ID of the applicant requesting to join. | | handleMsg | String | No | Optional rejection reason or explanation. Pass an empty string if not needed. | Return value Upon success, data in onSuccess returns a confirmation message. State changes after the call 1. Callback confirmation : The onSuccess callback indicates that the server has processed the rejection and updated the application record. 2. Asynchronous event delivery : The SDK triggers the onGroupApplicationRejected event on affected clients, delivering the updated GroupApplicationInfo . The client should merge or update the application record using groupID:userID as the unique key. 3. Re query calibration : If application state or counts diverge after network reconnections, call getGroupApplicationListAsRecipient to reconcile local records with the server. For complete listener registration and lifecycle management, see Group overview /sdk/android/group/overview group .

title: Delete group applications
description: Use deleteGroupRequests to delete specified group application records in a batch.
keywords: sdk android v4 sdk android group group-applications delete-group-requests
content: Batch delete historical group application records. This method clears processed, expired, or obsolete application items from the application history list. It does not alter the underlying approval status such as accepted or rejected of the application itself. To reject a pending application, call Reject a group application /sdk/android/group/group applications/refuse group application . Code example SimpleGroupRequests requests = new SimpleGroupRequests "user a", "group 123" , new SimpleGroupRequests "user b", "group 456" ; DeleteGroupRequestsReq deleteReq = new DeleteGroupRequestsReq requests ; OpenIMClient.getInstance .groupManager.deleteGroupRequests new OnBase @Override public void onSuccess String data // Group application records deleted successfully @Override public void onError int code, String error // Failed to delete application records , deleteReq ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | base | OnBase | Yes | Callback handler for the asynchronous request. | | deleteGroupRequestsReq | DeleteGroupRequestsReq | Yes | Request object containing an array of SimpleGroupRequests . Each entry specifies fromUserID the applicant user ID and groupID the target group ID to identify the specific application record. | Return value Upon success, data in onSuccess returns a confirmation message. State changes after the call 1. Callback confirmation : The onSuccess callback confirms that the specified group application records were removed from the server. 2. Asynchronous event delivery : This operation deletes history records and does not trigger group membership or status events. 3. Re query calibration : The client should remove the deleted items from the local application cache matching groupID:userID , or call Get group application list as recipient /sdk/android/group/group applications/get group application list as recipient to refresh the list from the server.

title: Get group members
description: Use getGroupMemberList to retrieve group members by role and page.
keywords: sdk android v4 sdk android group retrieving-group-members get-group-member-list
content: Retrieve a paginated list of members for a specified group. You can filter members by role all members, regular members, group owner, or group administrators , making this suitable for member rosters, permission management, and @ mention pickers. Code example String groupID = "group 123"; int filter = 0; // 0: retrieve all members int offset = 0; int count = 50; OpenIMClient.getInstance .groupManager.getGroupMemberList new OnBase @Override public void onSuccess List members // members contains the list of group members for the current page @Override public void onError int code, String error // Failed to retrieve group members , groupID, filter, offset, count ; Role filter values The filter parameter filters group members based on their assigned role: | Value | Description | | | | | 0 | All group members. | | 1 | Regular group members only. | | 2 | Group owner only. | | 3 | Group administrators only. | Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | base | OnBase | Yes | Callback handler for the asynchronous request. | | groupID | String | Yes | Globally unique ID of the target group. | | filter | int | Yes | Role filter flag 0 : all, 1 : regular members, 2 : owner, 3 : administrators . | | offset | int | Yes | Starting offset for pagination, starting from 0 . | | count | int | Yes | Maximum number of member records to retrieve in this batch. | Return value Upon success, onSuccess returns a list of group member objects List . Key fields of each member include: | Field | Description | | | | | groupID | Group ID. | | userID | User ID of the member. | | nickname | Display name of the member within the group. | | faceURL | Profile avatar URL of the member. | | roleLevel | Role level: 20 for regular members, 60 for administrators, and 100 for the group owner. | | joinTime | Timestamp in milliseconds when the member joined the group. | | muteEndTime | Timestamp in milliseconds when the mute expires 0 indicates not muted . | State changes after the call 1. Snapshot retrieval : This is a read only query that fetches a point in time member list snapshot and does not mutate group state or trigger membership events. 2. Cache maintenance : Clients should cache and deduplicate members using groupID:userID as the composite key. 3. Incremental sync : Subsequent membership changes are dispatched asynchronously via events such as onGroupMemberAdded , onGroupMemberDeleted , and onGroupMemberInfoChanged . For complete event handling, see Group overview /sdk/android/group/overview group .

title: Get group member profiles
description: Use getGroupMembersInfo to retrieve specified users’ profiles within a group.
keywords: sdk android v4 sdk android group retrieving-group-members get-specified-group-members-info
content: Retrieve detailed member profiles for specific users within a given group including in group nickname, role level, and mute status . Pass the target group ID and a list of user IDs. This method is commonly used for message bubble rendering, member profile cards, and mention parsing. Code example String groupID = "group 123"; List userIDs = Arrays.asList "user a", "user b" ; OpenIMClient.getInstance .groupManager.getGroupMembersInfo new OnBase @Override public void onSuccess List members // members contains the retrieved group member profiles @Override public void onError int code, String error // Failed to retrieve member profiles , groupID, userIDs ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | base | OnBase | Yes | Callback handler for the asynchronous request. | | groupID | String | Yes | Globally unique ID of the target group. | | userIDs | List | Yes | List of user IDs whose member profiles are being queried. | Return value Upon success, onSuccess returns a list of member profiles List . Each entry contains member attributes such as nickname , faceURL , roleLevel , and muteEndTime . State changes after the call 1. Snapshot retrieval : This is a read only query that retrieves the specified member records without mutating group state. 2. Local cache update : The client should merge the returned items into the local member cache using groupID:userID as the unique key. 3. Modifications : To update a member's in group information, see Set group member nickname /sdk/android/group/managing group members/set group member nickname .

title: Check users in a group
description: Use getUsersInGroup to select the users who are currently members of a group.
keywords: sdk android v4 sdk android group retrieving-group-members get-users-in-group
content: Filter a candidate list of user IDs to determine which users are already members of a specified group. This is typically used to validate and filter candidate lists before inviting users to a group. Code example String groupID = "group 123"; List candidateUserIDs = Arrays.asList "user a", "user b", "user c" ; OpenIMClient.getInstance .groupManager.getUsersInGroup new OnBase @Override public void onSuccess List joinedUserIDs // joinedUserIDs contains candidate users who are already in the group @Override public void onError int code, String error // Failed to query membership status , groupID, candidateUserIDs ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | base | OnBase | Yes | Callback handler for the asynchronous request. | | groupID | String | Yes | Globally unique ID of the target group. | | candidateUserIDs | List | Yes | List of candidate user IDs to check. Ensure duplicate or empty strings are removed before calling. | Return value Upon success, onSuccess returns a list of user IDs List that are already members of the group. State changes after the call 1. Snapshot check : This is a read only query that checks user membership and does not alter group state. 2. Detailed profiles : This method only returns user IDs. To retrieve detailed in group profiles such as nicknames, roles, or mute times , see Get group member profiles /sdk/android/group/retrieving group members/get specified group members info .

title: Get group owners and admins
description: Use getGroupMemberOwnerAndAdmin to retrieve the group owner and administrator profiles.
keywords: sdk android v4 sdk android group retrieving-group-members get-group-member-owner-and-admin
content: Retrieve member profile records for the group owner and all group administrators in a specified group. This is typically used for group settings displays, permission checks, and administrative approval workflows. Code example String groupID = "group 123"; OpenIMClient.getInstance .groupManager.getGroupMemberOwnerAndAdmin new OnBase @Override public void onSuccess List members // members contains profiles for the group owner and all administrators @Override public void onError int code, String error // Failed to retrieve administrative members , groupID ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | base | OnBase | Yes | Callback handler for the asynchronous request. | | groupID | String | Yes | Globally unique ID of the target group. | Return value Upon success, onSuccess returns a list of administrative member profiles List . Administrative roles can be distinguished by roleLevel : 100 GroupRole.OWNER represents the group owner, and 60 GroupRole.ADMIN represents an administrator. State changes after the call 1. Snapshot retrieval : This is a read only query that returns the current administrative roster without mutating group state. 2. Local cache maintenance : Clients should cache and merge administrative members using groupID:userID as the unique key. 3. Role changes : When administrator roles change, the SDK emits onGroupMemberInfoChanged . To assign or revoke administrator privileges, see Set group member role level /sdk/android/group/managing group members/set group member role level .

title: Search group members
description: Use searchGroupMembers to search group members by user ID or group nickname.
keywords: sdk android v4 sdk android group retrieving-group-members search-group-members
content: Search for group members in a specified group using keywords. You can search across member user IDs and in group nicknames, making this useful for quick member lookups, administrative filtering, and mention selection. Code example String groupID = "group 123"; List keywordList = Collections.singletonList "Tech" ; boolean isSearchUserID = true; boolean isSearchMemberNickname = true; int offset = 0; int count = 20; OpenIMClient.getInstance .groupManager.searchGroupMembers new OnBase @Override public void onSuccess List members // members contains matching group member profiles @Override public void onError int code, String error // Failed to search group members , groupID, keywordList, isSearchUserID, isSearchMemberNickname, offset, count ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | base | OnBase | Yes | Callback handler for the asynchronous request. | | groupID | String | Yes | Globally unique ID of the target group. | | keywordList | List | Yes | List of search keywords. The search should not be executed if the list is empty. | | isSearchUserID | boolean | Yes | Whether to search by user ID true to match, false to ignore . | | isSearchMemberNickname | boolean | Yes | Whether to search by in group nickname true to match, false to ignore . | | offset | int | Yes | Starting offset for pagination, starting from 0 . | | count | int | Yes | Maximum number of records to retrieve in this batch. | Return value Upon success, onSuccess returns a list of matching member profiles List . State changes after the call 1. Snapshot retrieval : This is a read only search query that returns matching records at query time without altering group state. 2. Display results : Render search results using groupID:userID as the unique identifier for each item.

title: Invite users to a group
description: Use the Android SDK to invite a list of users to a group.
keywords: sdk android v4 sdk android group managing-group-members invite-user-to-group
content: Invite one or more users to join a specified group. The group's join verification policy configured via Set group join verification /sdk/android/group/set group join verification determines the invitation outcome: if the group requires verification, invited users may need administrator approval; if set to direct join or verification free, users are added immediately. Code example String groupID = "group 123"; List inviteeUserIDs = Arrays.asList "user a", "user b" ; String reqMsg = "Inviting you to the tech discussion group"; OpenIMClient.getInstance .groupManager.inviteUserToGroup new OnBase @Override public void onSuccess String data // Invitation request submitted successfully @Override public void onError int code, String error // Failed to send group invitation , groupID, inviteeUserIDs, reqMsg ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | base | OnBase | Yes | Callback handler for the asynchronous request. | | groupID | String | Yes | Globally unique ID of the target group. | | inviteeUserIDs | List | Yes | List of user IDs to invite. Ensure empty strings and duplicates are removed. | | reqMsg | String | No | Optional invitation message or note. Pass an empty string if not needed. | Return value Upon success, data in onSuccess returns a confirmation message. State changes after the call 1. Callback confirmation : The onSuccess callback indicates that the invitation request was accepted by the server. 2. Asynchronous event delivery : When users join successfully, group members receive the onGroupMemberAdded event containing the newly joined GroupMembersInfo . The client should merge new members into the member roster using groupID:userID as the unique key. If verification is required, administrators receive onGroupApplicationAdded . 3. Re query calibration : To reconcile member rosters and member counts after intermittent connection loss, call getGroupMemberList or getSpecifiedGroupsInfo . For complete listener registration and lifecycle management, see Group overview /sdk/android/group/overview group .

title: Remove group members
description: Use the Android SDK to remove specified members from a group.
keywords: sdk android v4 sdk android group managing-group-members kick-group-member
content: Group owners and administrators can remove specified members from a group. Removed members lose access to group messaging and are no longer part of the conversation. Code example String groupID = "group 123"; List memberUserIDs = Arrays.asList "user a", "user b" ; String reason = "Violation of group communication rules"; OpenIMClient.getInstance .groupManager.kickGroupMember new OnBase @Override public void onSuccess String data // Group members removed successfully @Override public void onError int code, String error // Failed to remove group members , groupID, memberUserIDs, reason ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | base | OnBase | Yes | Callback handler for the asynchronous request. | | groupID | String | Yes | Globally unique ID of the target group. | | memberUserIDs | List | Yes | List of member user IDs to remove from the group. | | reason | String | No | Optional explanation or reason for removal. Pass an empty string if not needed. | Return value Upon success, data in onSuccess returns a confirmation message. State changes after the call 1. Callback confirmation : The onSuccess callback indicates that the server has removed the specified members from the group. 2. Asynchronous event delivery : Affected clients and group members receive the onGroupMemberDeleted event delivering the removed GroupMembersInfo . The client should remove the corresponding member records from the local roster cache using groupID:userID as the unique key. If the local user was removed, onGroupDismissed or membership synchronization removes the group conversation. 3. Re query calibration : If member counts or rosters become inconsistent, call getGroupMemberList or getSpecifiedGroupsInfo to refresh data from the server. For complete listener registration and lifecycle management, see Group overview /sdk/android/group/overview group .

title: Update a group nickname
description: Use SetGroupMemberInfo.nickname to update a member’s display name in a group.
keywords: sdk android v4 sdk android group managing-group-members set-group-member-nickname
content: Update a member's display nickname in group business card within a specified group. This display name applies only within the group and does not modify the user's global profile nickname. Code example SetGroupMemberInfo update = new SetGroupMemberInfo ; update.setGroupID "group 123" ; update.setUserID "user a" ; update.setNickname "Alex" ; OpenIMClient.getInstance .groupManager.setGroupMemberInfo update, new OnBase @Override public void onSuccess String data // Group member nickname updated successfully @Override public void onError int code, String error // Failed to update group member nickname ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | groupMemberInfo | SetGroupMemberInfo | Yes | Member update object. Must specify groupID , member userID , and the new in group nickname . | | base | OnBase | Yes | Callback handler for the asynchronous request. | Return value Upon success, data in onSuccess returns a confirmation message. State changes after the call 1. Callback confirmation : The onSuccess callback confirms that the nickname change was committed on the server. 2. Asynchronous event delivery : Members in the group receive the onGroupMemberInfoChanged event delivering the updated GroupMembersInfo . The client should merge the updated nickname into the cached member record using groupID:userID as the unique key. 3. Re query calibration : If member caches fall out of sync, call Get group member profiles /sdk/android/group/retrieving group members/get specified group members info to reload the latest member attributes. For complete listener registration and lifecycle management, see Group overview /sdk/android/group/overview group .

title: Manage group administrators
description: Use SetGroupMemberInfo.roleLevel to change a member’s role in a group.
keywords: sdk android v4 sdk android group managing-group-members set-group-member-role-level
content: Update the administrative role level of a specified group member. Group owners can promote regular members to administrators or demote administrators back to regular members. To transfer group ownership, see Transfer group ownership /sdk/android/group/managing group members/transfer group owner . Code example SetGroupMemberInfo update = new SetGroupMemberInfo ; update.setGroupID "group 123" ; update.setUserID "user b" ; update.setRoleLevel GroupRole.ADMIN ; OpenIMClient.getInstance .groupManager.setGroupMemberInfo update, new OnBase @Override public void onSuccess String data // Group member role updated successfully @Override public void onError int code, String error // Failed to update group member role ; Role constants Use constants defined in GroupRole to set the roleLevel : | Constant | Value | Description | | | | | | GroupRole.MEMBER | 20 | Regular group member. | | GroupRole.ADMIN | 60 | Group administrator with member management and mute privileges. | Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | groupMemberInfo | SetGroupMemberInfo | Yes | Member update object. Must specify groupID , member userID , and the new role level constant roleLevel . | | base | OnBase | Yes | Callback handler for the asynchronous request. | Return value Upon success, data in onSuccess returns a confirmation message. State changes after the call 1. Callback confirmation : The onSuccess callback indicates that the role change was committed on the server. 2. Asynchronous event delivery : Group members receive the onGroupMemberInfoChanged event delivering the updated GroupMembersInfo . The client should merge the updated roleLevel into the cached member record using groupID:userID as the unique key. 3. Re query calibration : If administrator rosters diverge, call Get group owners and admins /sdk/android/group/retrieving group members/get group member owner and admin to reload the verified administrative list. For complete listener registration and lifecycle management, see Group overview /sdk/android/group/overview group .

title: Update a group member avatar
description: Use SetGroupMemberInfo.faceURL to update the avatar displayed for a member in a group.
keywords: sdk android v4 sdk android group managing-group-members set-group-member-avatar
content: Update the dedicated avatar displayed for a specific member within a group. This avatar change applies exclusively inside the target group and does not modify the user's global profile avatar. Code example SetGroupMemberInfo update = new SetGroupMemberInfo ; update.setGroupID "group 123" ; update.setUserID "user a" ; update.setFaceURL "https://example.com/member avatar.png" ; OpenIMClient.getInstance .groupManager.setGroupMemberInfo update, new OnBase @Override public void onSuccess String data // Group member avatar updated successfully @Override public void onError int code, String error // Failed to update group member avatar ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | groupMemberInfo | SetGroupMemberInfo | Yes | Member update object. Must specify groupID , member userID , and the new avatar URL faceURL . | | base | OnBase | Yes | Callback handler for the asynchronous request. | Return value Upon success, data in onSuccess returns a confirmation message. State changes after the call 1. Callback confirmation : The onSuccess callback indicates that the member avatar URL has been persisted on the server. 2. Asynchronous event delivery : Group members receive the onGroupMemberInfoChanged event delivering the updated GroupMembersInfo . The client should update the member avatar in its cache using groupID:userID as the unique key. 3. Re query calibration : If avatar caches become inconsistent, call Get group member profiles /sdk/android/group/retrieving group members/get specified group members info to reload up to date member records. For complete listener registration and lifecycle management, see Group overview /sdk/android/group/overview group .

title: Set group member extra data
description: Store application-defined group member data in SetGroupMemberInfo.ex.
keywords: sdk android v4 sdk android group managing-group-members set-group-member-extension
content: Store custom business extension attributes on a group member record. By setting the ex string field typically a JSON string on SetGroupMemberInfo , you can store application specific metadata such as internal duties, points, or custom tags . The server replaces the existing string entirely. Code example SetGroupMemberInfo update = new SetGroupMemberInfo ; update.setGroupID "group 123" ; update.setUserID "user a" ; update.setEx " \"duty\":\"reviewer\",\"tag\":\"expert\" " ; OpenIMClient.getInstance .groupManager.setGroupMemberInfo update, new OnBase @Override public void onSuccess String data // Group member extra data updated successfully @Override public void onError int code, String error // Failed to update group member extra data ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | groupMemberInfo | SetGroupMemberInfo | Yes | Member update object. Must specify groupID , member userID , and the new extension string ex . | | base | OnBase | Yes | Callback handler for the asynchronous request. | Return value Upon success, data in onSuccess returns a confirmation message. State changes after the call 1. Callback confirmation : The onSuccess callback indicates that the extension data was saved to the server. 2. Asynchronous event delivery : Group members receive the onGroupMemberInfoChanged event delivering the updated GroupMembersInfo . The client should merge the updated ex payload into the local member cache using groupID:userID as the unique key. 3. Re query calibration : If member extension data diverges, call Get group member profiles /sdk/android/group/retrieving group members/get specified group members info to refresh data from the server. For complete listener registration and lifecycle management, see Group overview /sdk/android/group/overview group .

title: Transfer group ownership
description: Use the Android SDK to transfer group ownership to a specified member.
keywords: sdk android v4 sdk android group managing-group-members transfer-group-owner
content: Transfer group ownership to another member in the group. After the transfer succeeds, the original owner becomes a regular group member, and the new owner gains full administrative control, including the authority to dismiss the group. Code example String groupID = "group 123"; String newOwnerUserID = "user b"; OpenIMClient.getInstance .groupManager.transferGroupOwner new OnBase @Override public void onSuccess String data // Group ownership transferred successfully @Override public void onError int code, String error // Failed to transfer group ownership , groupID, newOwnerUserID ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | base | OnBase | Yes | Callback handler for the asynchronous request. | | groupID | String | Yes | Globally unique ID of the target group. | | newOwnerUserID | String | Yes | User ID of the new owner. The user must already be an existing member of the group. | Return value Upon success, data in onSuccess returns a confirmation message. State changes after the call 1. Callback confirmation : The onSuccess callback indicates that the group ownership transition has been committed on the server. 2. Asynchronous event delivery : Members in the group receive synchronization events: onGroupMemberInfoChanged : Delivered for both the former owner and the new owner with their updated roleLevel values. Merge using groupID:userID . onGroupInfoChanged : Delivers the updated GroupInfo reflecting the new ownerUserID . Merge using groupID . 3. Re query calibration : To calibrate administrative roles or group details, call Get group owners and admins /sdk/android/group/retrieving group members/get group member owner and admin or Get group profiles /sdk/android/group/retrieving groups/get specified groups info . For complete listener registration and lifecycle management, see Group overview /sdk/android/group/overview group .

title: Mute or unmute a group member
description: Use the Android SDK to set the mute duration for a specified group member.
keywords: sdk android v4 sdk android group managing-group-members change-group-member-mute
content: Set the mute duration for a specified group member or unmute them. Group owners and administrators can mute a member for a specified number of seconds; passing 0 seconds removes the mute immediately. This setting applies solely to the individual member and operates independently of Mute or unmute a group /sdk/android/group/change group mute . Code example String groupID = "group 123"; String userID = "user b"; long seconds = 3600L; // Mute for 1 hour; pass 0L to unmute OpenIMClient.getInstance .groupManager.changeGroupMemberMute new OnBase @Override public void onSuccess String data // Member mute status updated successfully @Override public void onError int code, String error // Failed to update member mute status , groupID, userID, seconds ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | base | OnBase | Yes | Callback handler for the asynchronous request. | | groupID | String | Yes | Globally unique ID of the target group. | | userID | String | Yes | User ID of the target group member. | | seconds | long | Yes | Mute duration in seconds. Pass 0 to unmute the member. | Return value Upon success, data in onSuccess returns a confirmation message. State changes after the call 1. Callback confirmation : The onSuccess callback confirms that the mute status was persisted on the server. 2. Asynchronous event delivery : Members in the group receive the onGroupMemberInfoChanged event delivering the updated GroupMembersInfo with the new muteEndTime timestamp. The client should merge this state into the cached member record using groupID:userID as the unique key. 3. Re query calibration : If mute expiration or state falls out of sync, call Get group member profiles /sdk/android/group/retrieving group members/get specified group members info to reload member data. For complete listener registration and lifecycle management, see Group overview /sdk/android/group/overview group .

title: Message overview
description: Learn about the Android SDK Message model, message lifecycle, and message listener.
keywords: sdk android v4 sdk android message overview-message
content: The Android SDK uses the Message model to represent an individual message. Creating, sending, receiving, querying, and updating message states are distinct stages in the messaging lifecycle: creating a Message object does not transmit it to the server, and a successful send callback indicates server ingestion, not immediate receipt by recipient clients. Message lists use clientMsgID as the client side deduplication and update key, combined with the conversation context to distinguish between single C2C and group chats. The Message entity itself does not store a conversationID ; the conversation context is derived from the active conversation, query arguments, or message event context. Message lifecycle stages | Stage | Android API or callback | Description | | | | | | Create | Message construction methods such as Create a text message /sdk/android/message/creating messages/create text message | Constructs a local Message entity. Does not upload data to the server or trigger new message callbacks. | | Send | Send a message /sdk/android/message/sending messages/send message or Send a message without OSS upload /sdk/android/message/sending messages/send message not oss | Pass recvUid for single chat or recvGid for group chat. | | Receive | OnAdvanceMsgListener | Handles incoming real time, offline, and online messages, as well as revokes, deletions, and read receipts. | | Query | History retrieval, search, or find by ID APIs | Retrieves a point in time snapshot of stored messages; does not replace real time event listeners. | | Update | Revoke, delete, modify, pin, read receipts, and local extension APIs | Updates individual messages via API callbacks, async events, and list re queries. | Incoming message events are documented in detail on the Receive messages /sdk/android/message/receiving messages/receive messages page. Applications should configure OnAdvanceMsgListener once within a shared messaging repository or service layer and dispatch updates to active UI controllers. Message model fields All creation, transmission, reception, and retrieval operations interact with Message objects. Common fields include: | Field | Type | Description | | | | | | clientMsgID | String | Client generated unique message identifier, used for local deduplication and state updates. | | serverMsgID | String | Server assigned message ID. May be empty until the message is acknowledged by the server. | | sessionType | int | Session type, used with recvID and groupID to determine single or group chat. | | sendID | String | Sender user ID. | | recvID | String | Recipient user ID for single chat conversations. | | groupID | String | Group ID for group chat conversations. | | msgFrom | int | Distinguishes between user generated and system generated messages. | | contentType | int | Message content type, matching constants in MessageType . | | createTime | long | Timestamp in nanoseconds when the message object was created. | | sendTime | long | Timestamp in milliseconds when the message was sent. | | seq | int | Server assigned sequence number. | | status | int | Message delivery status, matching constants in MessageStatus . | | isRead | boolean | Local read status on the current client. | | platformID | int | Platform identifier of the sending client. | | senderNickname | String | Sender nickname recorded when the message was created or sent. | | senderFaceUrl | String | Sender avatar URL recorded when the message was created or sent. | | offlinePush | OfflinePushInfo | Push notification configuration for offline recipients. | | attachedInfo | String | SDK internal attachment string. | | ext | Object | Additional message extension attributes. | | ex | Object | Custom business extension attributes. | | localEx | Object | Local extension attributes persisted only on the local device. | Message content payloads are stored in specific element fields corresponding to contentType : | Content type | Element field | | | | | Text, rich text | textElem , advancedTextElem | | Image, sound, video, file | pictureElem , soundElem , videoElem , fileElem | | @ mentions, replies | atTextElem , quoteElem | | Merged forward | mergeElem | | Contact card, location, custom faces | cardElem , locationElem , faceElem | | Custom business message | customElem | | Notifications, typing indicator, attached status | notificationElem , typingElem , attachedInfoElem | Creating and sending messages Sending any message requires two steps: 1. Call the corresponding message creation method such as Create a text message /sdk/android/message/creating messages/create text message to generate a Message object. 2. Pass the Message instance to Send a message /sdk/android/message/sending messages/send message , specifying recvUid for single chat or recvGid for group chat. Supported message creation guides: | Content type | Guide | | | | | Plain text & Rich text | Create a text message /sdk/android/message/creating messages/create text message , Create an advanced text message /sdk/android/message/creating messages/create advanced text message | | @ Mention messages | Create a text at message /sdk/android/message/creating messages/create text at message | | Media Image, Audio, Video, File | Create an image message /sdk/android/message/creating messages/create image message , Create a sound message /sdk/android/message/creating messages/create sound message , Create a video message /sdk/android/message/creating messages/create video message , Create a file message /sdk/android/message/creating messages/create file message | | Contact cards, Location, Custom faces | Create a card message /sdk/android/message/creating messages/create card message , Create a location message /sdk/android/message/creating messages/create location message , Create a face message /sdk/android/message/creating messages/create face message | | Replies, Forwarding, Merged forwarding | Create a quote message /sdk/android/message/creating messages/create quote message , Create a forward message /sdk/android/message/creating messages/create forward message , Create a merger message /sdk/android/message/creating messages/create merger message | | Custom business payloads | Create a custom message /sdk/android/message/creating messages/create custom message | When sending media messages initialized from a local file path, use Send a message /sdk/android/message/sending messages/send message so the SDK automatically uploads the binary payload. When creating media messages with pre uploaded remote URLs, use the corresponding URL creation method and send with Send a message without OSS upload /sdk/android/message/sending messages/send message not oss to skip redundant file uploads. title: Create a text message
description: Use createTextMessage to create a text Message.
keywords: sdk android v4 sdk android message creating-messages create-text-message
content: Construct a standard plain text message object. This method initializes a local Message instance and populates its textElem field; it does not trigger a network request or transmit the message to the server. Code example String text = "Hello, this is a plain text message."; Message message = OpenIMClient.getInstance .messageManager.createTextMessage text ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | text | String | Yes | The text content of the message. Validate text length on the client before calling. | Return value Returns the newly initialized Message object with contentType set to MessageType.TEXT . State changes after the call 1. Local initialization : The method constructs a local Message instance without emitting network calls or SDK events. 2. Sending the message : Append the returned Message to the local chat UI with a sending status, then call Send a message /sdk/android/message/sending messages/send message to deliver it to a single user or group.

title: Create a mention message
description: Use createTextAtMessage to create a text message that mentions group members.
keywords: sdk android v4 sdk android message creating-messages create-text-at-message
content: Construct a text message with @ mentions targeting specific group members, with optional quoting of a previous message. When delivered, recipient clients display high priority mention notifications and badges in the conversation list. Code example String text = "@Alex Please review the latest proposal"; List userIDs = Collections.singletonList "user alex" ; AtUserInfo atUserInfo = new AtUserInfo ; atUserInfo.setAtUserID "user alex" ; atUserInfo.setGroupNickname "Alex" ; List atUserInfos = Collections.singletonList atUserInfo ; Message quoteMessage = null; // Pass an existing Message object to quote reply, or null Message message = OpenIMClient.getInstance .messageManager.createTextAtMessage text, userIDs, atUserInfos, quoteMessage ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | text | String | Yes | The complete text of the message, including @ mention labels. | | userIDs | List | Yes | List of user IDs of the mentioned group members deduplicated . | | atUserInfos | List | Yes | List of user details corresponding to userIDs , containing display names and identifiers. | | quoteMessage | Message | No | Optional reference to a previous message to quote reply. Pass null if not quoting. | Return value Returns the newly initialized Message object ready for transmission. State changes after the call 1. Local initialization : Initializes the local Message structure without sending data to the server. 2. Sending to the group : Mention messages are typically used in group conversations. Call Send a message /sdk/android/message/sending messages/send message passing the target group ID recvGid .

title: Create a custom message
description: Use createCustomMessage to carry application-defined JSON content.
keywords: sdk android v4 sdk android message creating-messages create-custom-message
content: Construct a custom message object carrying application specific business payloads. By passing structured JSON data, optional extension metadata, and a fallback preview description, you can build custom interactive components such as red packets, polls, business cards, and order updates. Code example String dataJson = " \"action\":\"red packet\",\"packetID\":\"rp 888\",\"amount\":100 "; String extensionJson = " \"theme\":\"festive\" "; String description = " Received a red packet "; Message message = OpenIMClient.getInstance .messageManager.createCustomMessage dataJson, extensionJson, description ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | data | String | Yes | The primary custom payload, typically a serialized JSON string. | | extension | String | No | Additional business extension metadata. Pass an empty string if not needed. | | description | String | Yes | Summary preview text displayed in the conversation list or push notifications. | Return value Returns the created Message object with contentType set to MessageType.CUSTOM . State changes after the call 1. Local initialization : Initializes the local Message structure without sending data to the server. 2. Schema agreement : Senders and receivers should negotiate schema conventions and implement graceful degradation for unrecognized versions. 3. Transmission : Call Send a message /sdk/android/message/sending messages/send message to deliver the message.

title: Create an image message
description: Create an image message from a path relative to the SDK data directory.
keywords: sdk android v4 sdk android message creating-messages create-image-message
content: Construct an image message object from a file path relative to the SDK initialization data directory. When sending via Send a message /sdk/android/message/sending messages/send message , the SDK automatically compresses the image and uploads the file. Code example String imagePath = "images/pic 001.jpg"; // Path relative to SDK data directory Message message = OpenIMClient.getInstance .messageManager.createImageMessage imagePath ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | imagePath | String | Yes | File path of the image relative to the SDK initialization data directory. | Return value Returns the created Message object with contentType set to MessageType.PICTURE . State changes after the call 1. Local initialization : Initializes the local Message structure without initiating network uploads. 2. Transmission : Call Send a message /sdk/android/message/sending messages/send message to upload and send the image. For absolute local file paths, see Create an image message from a local path /sdk/android/message/creating messages/create image message by file .

title: Create an image message from a local path
description: Create an image message from an absolute path.
keywords: sdk android v4 sdk android message creating-messages create-image-message-by-file
content: Construct an image message object from an absolute filesystem path on the local device such as an image picked from the photo gallery or captured by the camera . When sending via Send a message /sdk/android/message/sending messages/send message , the SDK reads the local file and automatically performs compression and upload. Code example String absolutePath = "/storage/emulated/0/Pictures/chat image.png"; Message message = OpenIMClient.getInstance .messageManager.createImageMessageFromFullPath absolutePath ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | imagePath | String | Yes | Absolute filesystem path of the image file on the local device. Ensure read permissions are granted. | Return value Returns the created Message object with contentType set to MessageType.PICTURE . State changes after the call 1. Local initialization : Initializes the local Message structure without initiating network uploads. 2. Transmission : Call Send a message /sdk/android/message/sending messages/send message to upload and deliver the image to a single user or group.

title: Create an image message from URLs
description: Use createImageMessageByURL to create an image message for an uploaded resource.
keywords: sdk android v4 sdk android message creating-messages create-image-message-by-url
content: Construct an image message object using remote image URLs hosted on external cloud storage or a CDN. The SDK does not re upload the image, making this suitable for applications managing their own file storage pipelines. Code example String sourceURL = "https://example.com/images/origin.jpg"; PictureInfo sourcePicture = new PictureInfo ; sourcePicture.setUrl sourceURL ; sourcePicture.setWidth 1080 ; sourcePicture.setHeight 1920 ; PictureInfo bigPicture = sourcePicture; PictureInfo snapshotPicture = new PictureInfo ; snapshotPicture.setUrl "https://example.com/images/thumb.jpg" ; snapshotPicture.setWidth 200 ; snapshotPicture.setHeight 355 ; Message message = OpenIMClient.getInstance .messageManager.createImageMessageByURL sourceURL, sourcePicture, bigPicture, snapshotPicture ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | sourceURL | String | Yes | Accessible remote URL of the original image. | | sourcePicture | PictureInfo | Yes | Original image metadata object containing URL, width, height, and size. | | bigPicture | PictureInfo | Yes | High resolution image metadata object. Pass the original picture metadata if a separate high res variant is not generated. | | snapshotPicture | PictureInfo | Yes | Thumbnail image metadata object used for fast preview in the message list. | Return value Returns the created Message object ready for transmission, with contentType set to MessageType.PICTURE . State changes after the call 1. Local initialization : Initializes the local Message structure without issuing network requests. 2. Transmission : Because the media asset is pre hosted, call Send a message without OSS upload /sdk/android/message/sending messages/send message not oss to deliver the message without redundant uploads.

title: Create an audio message

title: Create a video message

title: Create a contact card message
description: Use createCardMessage to create a contact card message.

content: Construct a personal contact card message to share user profiles with other chat participants. Use CardElem to package the target user's userID , nickname, and avatar URL. Transmission : Call Send a message /sdk/android/message/sending messages/send message to deliver the card message to a single user or group.

title: Create a location message

Code example RichMessage link = new RichMessage ; link.setType "link" ; link.setOffset 0 ; link.setLength 6 ; link.setUrl "https://docs.openim.io" ; link.setInfo " \"title\":\"OpenIM documentation\" " ; Message message = OpenIMClient.getInstance .messageManager.createAdvancedTextMessage "OpenIM documentation link", Collections.singletonList link ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | text | String | Yes | Complete plain text content of the rich text message. | | richMessages | List | Yes | List of structured rich text entities. title: Create a forwarded message
description: Use createForwardMessage to create a forwarded copy of a message.
keywords: sdk android v4 sdk android message creating-messages create-forward-message
content: Wrap an existing historical message into a new forwarded message object. The SDK clones the original message payload and resets its delivery state to pending, making it ready to forward to another conversation. Code example Message message = OpenIMClient.getInstance .messageManager.createForwardMessage sourceMessage ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | message | Message | Yes | The original historical Message object to forward. | Return value Returns a new Message object cloned from the source message and prepared for forwarding. State changes after the call 1. Local initialization : Initializes the local cloned Message structure without sending data to the server. 2. Transmission : Call Send a message /sdk/android/message/sending messages/send message to forward the message to a new recipient or group. To forward multiple messages as a single bundle, see Create a merged message /sdk/android/message/creating messages/create merger message .

title: Create a merged message
description: Use createMergerMessage to combine multiple messages into one summary message.
keywords: sdk android v4 sdk android message creating-messages create-merger-message
content: Combine multiple historical messages into a single merged forward card message. The resulting message displays as a preview card with a title and summary lines in the chat stream, which recipients can tap to expand and view the full conversation history. Code example List messages = Arrays.asList msg1, msg2, msg3 ; String title = "Chat history from Project Team"; List summaries = Arrays.asList "Alex: We deployed the latest release", "Bob: Understood, running verification tests" ; Message message = OpenIMClient.getInstance .messageManager.createMergerMessage messages, title, summaries ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | messages | List | Yes | The list of original messages to bundle, ordered chronologically. | | title | String | Yes | Title displayed on the merged message card such as "Chat history from Project Team" . | | summaries | List | Yes | Summary preview lines displayed on the card typically formatted as "Sender: Message snippet" . | Return value Returns the created Message object with contentType set to MessageType.MERGER . State changes after the call 1. Local initialization : Initializes the local Message structure without sending data to the server. 2. Transmission : Call Send a message /sdk/android/message/sending messages/send message to deliver the merged message to a single user or group.

title: Send a message
description: Use sendMessage to send a Message to a one-to-one or group conversation.
keywords: sdk android v4 sdk android message sending-messages send-message
content: Transmit a previously constructed Message object to a single chat C2C or group chat. For single chat, specify the recipient user ID recvUid and pass null for recvGid . For group chat, specify the target group ID recvGid and pass null for recvUid . These two parameters are mutually exclusive. The OnMsgSendCallback provides granular callbacks for upload progress, success, and delivery failure. Code example String peerUserID = "user b"; OfflinePushInfo offlinePushInfo = new OfflinePushInfo ; offlinePushInfo.setTitle "New Message Notification" ; offlinePushInfo.setDesc "You received a new message. Tap to view." ; OpenIMClient.getInstance .messageManager.sendMessage new OnMsgSendCallback @Override public void onProgress long progress // progress indicates media upload percentage 0 100 @Override public void onSuccess Message sentMessage // Message sent successfully, update local state using sentMessage.getClientMsgID @Override public void onError int code, String error // Mark message delivery failed in UI and provide retry option , message, peerUserID, null, offlinePushInfo ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | callback | OnMsgSendCallback | Yes | Lifecycle callback for message transmission progress, success, error . | | message | Message | Yes | The message object to transmit, created by the corresponding factory method. | | recvUid | String | Conditional | Recipient user ID for single chat. Must be null when sending to a group. | | recvGid | String | Conditional | Target group ID for group chat. Must be null when sending to a single user. | | offlinePushInfo | OfflinePushInfo | No | Custom offline push notification payload. Pass null for default push configuration. | Return value Upon success, onSuccess returns the transmitted Message object. Key populated attributes include serverMsgID , timestamp sendTime , and updated status status . State changes after the call 1. Callback confirmation : The onSuccess callback indicates that the server accepted and stored the message. The client should update the message status in the UI from "sending" to "sent" using clientMsgID . 2. Asynchronous event delivery : Delivery to recipient devices occurs asynchronously. The receiving client receives the message through OnAdvanceMsgListener.onRecvNewMessage . 3. Re query calibration : If delivery status is uncertain due to network timeout or client disconnection, query message history via Load older messages /sdk/android/message/retrieving messages/load older messages to verify whether the message was persisted.

title: Send a message without OSS
description: Use sendMessageNotOss to send a media message whose resources were uploaded by your application.
keywords: sdk android v4 sdk android message sending-messages send-message-not-oss
content: Transmit a media message that already contains valid remote URLs, bypassing the SDK's built in OSS upload pipeline. This method is typically used in conjunction with messages created from remote URLs such as images, audio, video, or files created with create MessageByURL . If the message was initialized from a local filesystem path, call the standard Send a message /sdk/android/message/sending messages/send message method instead. Code example String peerUserID = "user b"; OfflinePushInfo offlinePushInfo = new OfflinePushInfo ; OpenIMClient.getInstance .messageManager.sendMessageNotOss new OnMsgSendCallback @Override public void onProgress long progress // Upload progress is typically not triggered since resources are already hosted @Override public void onSuccess Message sentMessage // Update local message state using sentMessage.getClientMsgID @Override public void onError int code, String error // Handle send error and allow retry , message, peerUserID, null, offlinePushInfo ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | callback | OnMsgSendCallback | Yes | Callback handler for message delivery events. | | message | Message | Yes | The message object to transmit, typically generated by a create MessageByURL method. | | recvUid | String | Conditional | Recipient user ID for single chat. Pass null for group chat. | | recvGid | String | Conditional | Target group ID for group chat. Pass null for single chat. | | offlinePushInfo | OfflinePushInfo | No | Custom offline push notification payload. Pass null for default push configuration. | Return value Upon success, onSuccess returns the transmitted Message object. State changes after the call 1. Callback confirmation : The onSuccess callback indicates that the server accepted the message. The client should update the message status in the UI using clientMsgID . 2. Asynchronous event delivery : Receiving clients receive the message asynchronously via OnAdvanceMsgListener.onRecvNewMessage . See Receive messages /sdk/android/message/receiving messages/receive messages for details.

title: Track message sending progress
description: Use the progress callback on OnMsgSendCallback to update media sending progress.
keywords: sdk android v4 sdk android message sending-messages set-msg-send-progress-listener
content: Monitor underlying file upload progress in real time when sending media messages such as images, audio, video, or files using the onProgress callback of OnMsgSendCallback . This is ideal for updating upload progress bars or percentage indicators on the chat UI. Code example OpenIMClient.getInstance .messageManager.sendMessage new OnMsgSendCallback @Override public void onProgress long progress // progress is the upload percentage 0 to 100 // Update UI progress indicators or percentage text @Override public void onSuccess Message sentMessage // Sent successfully, update local message status @Override public void onError int code, String error // Handle send error , message, peerUserID, null, offlinePushInfo ; Callback parameters progress long : Current upload completion percentage, ranging from 0 to 100 . Return value onProgress fires during the upload phase of local media files. Plain text messages, custom messages, and pre uploaded URL messages do not trigger upload progress callbacks. State changes after the call 1. Upload lifecycle : The SDK streams upload progress via onProgress . Once uploading completes, the SDK submits the message payload to the server. 2. Terminal callback : The request concludes when either onSuccess or onError is invoked.

title: Receive messages
description: Use OnAdvanceMsgListener to receive new, offline, and online-only messages.
keywords: sdk android v4 sdk android message receiving-messages receive-messages
content: Configure the advanced message listener to receive incoming real time messages, batched offline messages, online only transient messages, and message status updates. The Android SDK maintains a single global advanced message listener; register it once during SDK initialization or user authentication in your application's shared messaging service layer to avoid accidental overwrites across activities or fragments. Code example private final OnAdvanceMsgListener messageListener = new OnAdvanceMsgListener @Override public void onRecvNewMessage Message message // Handle incoming real time message; merge by clientMsgID mergeMessage message ; @Override public void onRecvOfflineNewMessage List messages // Handle batched offline messages upon reconnection for Message message : messages mergeMessage message ; @Override public void onRecvOnlineOnlyMessage Message message // Handle transient online only message not persisted locally handleOnlineOnlyMessage message ; ; public void registerMessageListener OpenIMClient.getInstance .messageManager.setAdvancedMsgListener messageListener ; Callback methods | Method | Parameter | Description | | | | | | onRecvNewMessage | Message | Delivers an individual real time incoming message. | | onRecvOfflineNewMessage | List | Delivers a batch of offline messages synchronized after reconnecting or logging in. | | onRecvOnlineOnlyMessage | Message | Delivers a transient online only message not counted in unread counts or persisted to disk . | State synchronization model When receiving real time or offline messages, first resolve the target conversation context using sessionType , sendID , recvID , and groupID . Then deduplicate and update the message list using clientMsgID as the unique key. Messages delivered through onRecvOnlineOnlyMessage represent temporary status updates or ephemeral signals and typically should not be written to the local message database. Detailed message lifecycle events such as revokes, deletions, modifications, and read receipts are documented in their respective guides and summarized in the Message overview /sdk/android/message/overview message .

title: Receive custom business messages
description: Use setCustomBusinessListener to receive business callbacks that are separate from regular chat messages.
keywords: sdk android v4 sdk android message receiving-messages receive-custom-business-messages
content: Listen for custom business messages dispatched independently of regular conversation chat streams. Data received by this listener arrives as a raw string or JSON payload, making it ideal for call signaling, transparent command dispatches, and custom business workflows that should not render as chat bubbles in the conversation message list. Code example OpenIMClient.getInstance .messageManager.setCustomBusinessListener new OnCustomBusinessListener @Override public void onRecvCustomBusinessMessage String payload // payload contains the custom business JSON string or command data ; Callback parameters payload String : Raw custom business data string. The application should deserialize this string according to its negotiated JSON schema and dispatch to the appropriate business module. Usage guidelines Register this listener once within a centralized signaling service after SDK initialization. Custom business messages do not alter conversation unread counts or update the latest message preview in the conversation list. To construct and send custom business messages within conversations, see Create a custom message /sdk/android/message/creating messages/create custom message .

title: Load older messages
description: Use getAdvancedHistoryMessageList to load conversation history by page.
keywords: sdk android v4 sdk android message retrieving-messages load-older-messages
content: Retrieve historical messages backwards in time towards older messages within a specified conversation. For the initial page load, pass null for startMsg . For subsequent pages, pass the oldest message from the previous batch as the new startMsg . Code example String conversationID = "si user a user b"; Message startMessage = null; // Pass null for the initial page, or the oldest message from the last batch int count = 20; OpenIMClient.getInstance .messageManager.getAdvancedHistoryMessageList new OnBase @Override public void onSuccess AdvancedMessage result List messages = result.getMessageList ; boolean reachedBeginning = result.isEnd ; // Prepend deduplicated messages to the top of the chat timeline using clientMsgID @Override public void onError int code, String error // Failed to load historical messages , conversationID, startMessage, count, ViewType.History ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | base | OnBase | Yes | Callback handler for the asynchronous request. | | conversationID | String | Yes | Globally unique ID of the target conversation. | | startMsg | Message | No | Anchor message for pagination. Pass null for initial load, or the oldest message from the preceding batch. | | count | int | Yes | Maximum number of messages to retrieve in this batch. | | viewType | ViewType | Yes | View mode enum. Pass ViewType.History for regular history loads. | Return value Upon success, onSuccess returns an AdvancedMessage object: | Field | Description | | | | | messageList | List of retrieved messages List for the current page. | | isEnd | Indicates whether the beginning of history has been reached true means no earlier messages exist, false means more can be loaded . | | errCode | Result error code. | | errMsg | Result error description. | State changes after the call 1. Snapshot retrieval : This is a read only query that loads point in time message records without emitting new message events. 2. UI integration : Prepend messages to the chat view, deduplicating records using clientMsgID .

title: Load newer messages
description: Use getAdvancedHistoryMessageListReverse to load messages after a starting point.
keywords: sdk android v4 sdk android message retrieving-messages load-newer-messages
content: Retrieve historical messages forward in time towards newer messages starting from a specific anchor message. This is commonly used when jumping to a search result, navigating from a quoted reply, or restoring deep linked message contexts. This method queries stored messages and is not used for real time message streaming. Code example String conversationID = "si user a user b"; int count = 20; OpenIMClient.getInstance .messageManager.getAdvancedHistoryMessageListReverse new OnBase @Override public void onSuccess AdvancedMessage result List messages = result.getMessageList ; boolean reachedLatest = result.isEnd ; // Deduplicate by clientMsgID and append messages to the bottom of the active timeline @Override public void onError int code, String error // Failed to load newer messages , conversationID, startMessage, count, ViewType.History ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | base | OnBase | Yes | Callback handler for the asynchronous request. | | conversationID | String | Yes | Globally unique ID of the target conversation. | | startMsg | Message | Yes | Anchor starting message from which forward loading begins. | | count | int | Yes | Maximum number of messages to retrieve in this batch. | | viewType | ViewType | Yes | View mode enum. Pass ViewType.History for regular history loads. | Return value Upon success, onSuccess returns an AdvancedMessage object. messageList contains messages chronologically after the anchor message, and isEnd indicates whether the newest stored message boundary has been reached. State changes after the call 1. Snapshot retrieval : This is a read only query that loads point in time message records without emitting new message events. 2. Timeline update : Append deduplicated messages to the bottom of the chat list using clientMsgID . Real time incoming messages continue to be received via Receive messages /sdk/android/message/receiving messages/receive messages .

title: Find messages by ID
description: Use findMessageList to retrieve message records with SearchParams.
keywords: sdk android v4 sdk android message retrieving-messages find-messages-by-id
content: Retrieve specific message records using conversation IDs and client message IDs clientMsgID . This is typically used when handling notification clicks, business deep links, or specific read receipt updates where exact message identifiers are known. Code example SearchParams params = new SearchParams ; params.setConversationID "si user a user b" ; params.setClientMsgIDList Arrays.asList "msg 001", "msg 002" ; List searchParamsList = Collections.singletonList params ; OpenIMClient.getInstance .messageManager.findMessageList new OnBase @Override public void onSuccess SearchResult result // result contains matching message records @Override public void onError int code, String error // Failed to find messages , searchParamsList ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | base | OnBase | Yes | Callback handler for the asynchronous request. | | searchParams | List | Yes | List of query parameter objects. Each SearchParams specifies a conversationID and a list of target clientMsgIDList values. | Return value Upon success, onSuccess returns a SearchResult object containing matching messages across the specified conversations. The client should locate or update local records using clientMsgID as the unique key. State changes after the call 1. Snapshot lookup : This is a read only query that loads matching message snapshots without altering message delivery states. 2. Text search alternative : To search message content by keyword instead of exact ID, see Search messages /sdk/android/message/searching messages/search messages .

title: Load message context
description: Retrieve messages before and after a specified message with the Android SDK.
keywords: sdk android v4 sdk android message retrieving-messages load-message-context
content: Retrieve context messages surrounding a designated anchor message in both earlier and later directions simultaneously. This is commonly used when jumping into a chat from global search results, quoted replies, or push notifications to reconstruct the surrounding conversation thread. Code example String conversationID = "si user a user b"; int before = 20; // Number of earlier messages to load int after = 20; // Number of later messages to load OpenIMClient.getInstance .messageManager.fetchSurroundingMessages new OnBase @Override public void onSuccess Messages messages List surrounding = messages.getData ; // surrounding contains the target anchor message and surrounding context messages @Override public void onError int code, String error // Failed to load surrounding messages , conversationID, targetMessage, ViewType.Search, before, after ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | base | OnBase | Yes | Callback handler for the asynchronous request. | | conversationID | String | Yes | Globally unique ID of the conversation containing the anchor message. | | startMsg | Message | Yes | Anchor message object used as the center reference point. | | type | ViewType | Yes | Context query view type: pass ViewType.History when jumping from quotes, or ViewType.Search when jumping from search. | | before | int | Yes | Maximum number of messages to retrieve before earlier than the anchor. | | after | int | Yes | Maximum number of messages to retrieve after later than the anchor. | Return value Upon success, onSuccess returns a list of context messages List , including the anchor message itself. State changes after the call 1. Snapshot retrieval : This is a read only query that loads point in time message records without altering message delivery states. 2. UI positioning : Populate the chat timeline and scroll to the anchor message, using clientMsgID for deduplication and focus highlighting.

title: Search messages
description: Use searchLocalMessages to search messages synchronized to the current account’s local storage.
keywords: sdk android v4 sdk android message searching-messages search-messages
content: Perform keyword searches across messages stored in the current account's local database. You can scope searches to a specific conversation, filter by sender, restrict message types such as text or files , and bound results by time ranges. Passing null for conversationID executes a global search across all local conversations. Code example String conversationID = null; // Pass null for global search across all conversations, or a specific ID List keywords = Collections.singletonList "proposal review" ; int keywordMatchType = 1; // 1: match any keyword OR , 0: match all keywords AND List senderIDs = null; List messageTypes = null; int searchTimePosition = 0; int searchTimePeriod = 0; int pageIndex = 0; int count = 20; OpenIMClient.getInstance .messageManager.searchLocalMessages new OnBase @Override public void onSuccess SearchResult result // result.getSearchResultItems groups matching messages by conversation @Override public void onError int code, String error // Failed to search messages , conversationID, keywords, keywordMatchType, senderIDs, messageTypes, searchTimePosition, searchTimePeriod, pageIndex, count ; Keyword match modes The keywordListMatchType parameter controls boolean keyword logic: | Mode | Value | Description | | | | | | Match all AND | 0 | Message content must contain all terms in the keyword list. | | Match any OR | 1 | Message content must contain at least one term in the keyword list. | Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | base | OnBase | Yes | Callback handler for the asynchronous request. | | conversationID | String | No | Target conversation ID to scope search. Pass null to search globally across all conversations. | | keywordList | List | Yes | List of search keywords. The search should not be initiated if keywords are empty. | | keywordListMatchType | int | Yes | Match logic: 0 for AND, 1 for OR. | | senderUserIDList | List | No | Restrict search to messages sent by specified user IDs. Pass null or empty list for all senders. | | messageTypeList | List | No | Restrict search to specific message types such as text, image, etc. . Pass null or empty list for all types. | | searchTimePosition | int | Yes | Anchor start timestamp in seconds; pass 0 to search backward from current time. | | searchTimePeriod | int | Yes | Time span in seconds to search backward from the anchor; pass 0 for unbounded time. | | pageIndex | int | Yes | Page index for pagination, starting from 0 . | | count | int | Yes | Maximum number of results to return per page. | Return value Upon success, onSuccess returns a SearchResult object containing: | Field | Description | | | | | totalCount | Total number of matching message records found. | | searchResultItems | List of result items grouped by conversation List . | Each SearchResultItem contains the conversation's conversationID , display name, avatar, matched messageCount , and matched messageList . When the user selects a search result, call Load message context /sdk/android/message/retrieving messages/load message context to locate the message and reconstruct its surrounding conversation thread. State changes after the call 1. Local search execution : This is a read only query executed entirely against local SQLite storage without issuing network calls.

title: Update typing status
description: Report the current conversation typing state with the Android SDK.
keywords: sdk android v4 sdk android message composing-messages update-typing-status
content: Report the user's typing status within a conversation. When the user starts editing text in the input box, call this method with focus set to true to signal "typing". When the user sends the message, clears the input box, blurs the input focus, or navigates away from the chat screen, call this method with focus set to false to clear the typing status immediately. Debouncing input changes is strongly recommended to avoid sending duplicate events too frequently. Code example String conversationID = "si user a user b"; // Report when user starts typing OpenIMClient.getInstance .conversationManager.changeInputState new OnBase @Override public void onSuccess String data // Typing state reported successfully @Override public void onError int code, String error // Failed to report typing state , conversationID, true ; // Clear typing state when user stops typing or navigates away OpenIMClient.getInstance .conversationManager.changeInputState null, conversationID, false ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | base | OnBase | Yes | Callback handler for the asynchronous request. Pass null if no callback confirmation is needed. | | conversationID | String | Yes | Globally unique ID of the target conversation. | | focus | boolean | Yes | Whether the user is actively typing: true to report typing, false to clear typing. | Return value Upon success, data in onSuccess returns a confirmation message. State changes after the call 1. Callback confirmation : The onSuccess callback confirms that the typing status was transmitted to the server. Pass null as the callback if confirmation is not required. 2. Asynchronous event delivery : Peers in the conversation receive typing notifications through OnConversationListener.onConversationUserInputStatusChanged .
