Code example import getFriendListPage from '@/uni modules/unix openim sdk' const result = await getFriendListPage offset: 0, count: 50, const friends = result?.friends ?? replaceFriends friends Return value The Promise resolves with an OpenIMFriendListResult | null object containing an array of OpenIMFriendUserItem elements in friends : | Property | Type | Description | | | | | | userID | string | The friend's user ID; serves as the primary merge key for relationship updates. | | nickname | string | The friend's account level display nickname. | | faceURL | string | The friend's account level avatar URL. | | remark | string | Custom friend alias or remark set by the current account. | | isPinned | boolean | Whether this friend is pinned in the contact list. | | ownerUserID | string | The user ID owning this friendship record the active account . | | operatorUserID | string | The user ID that created or last updated this friendship. | | addSource | number | Numeric source code describing how this friendship was initiated. | | createTime | number | Timestamp when the friendship was formed, in Unix milliseconds. | | ex | string | Custom relationship extension string. | | attachedInfo | string | SDK internal metadata. | The nickname and faceURL fields reflect account data, while remark , isPinned , and ex are specific to this friendship. Do not write remarks back into account nicknames, and do not overwrite public stranger profiles with friend records. Monitor friend updates Friendship lifecycle events are centrally managed here. Use queries to populate initial state, and stream incremental updates via events. Merge items into your local state using userID : import OpenIMFriendUserItem, off, onFriendAdded, onFriendDeleted, onFriendInfoChanged, from '@/uni modules/unix openim sdk' const handleFriendChanged = friend: OpenIMFriendUserItem | null = if friend == null return mergeFriend friend const handleFriendDeleted = friend: OpenIMFriendUserItem | null = if friend == null return removeFriend friend.userID const friendAddedSubscription = onFriendAdded handleFriendChanged const friendChangedSubscription = onFriendInfoChanged handleFriendChanged const friendDeletedSubscription = onFriendDeleted handleFriendDeleted function removeFriendListeners off friendAddedSubscription off friendChangedSubscription off friendDeletedSubscription Unsubscribe from these listeners when logging out, switching accounts, or tearing down the contact store. If event delivery might have been interrupted during connection loss, re query the full list to restore accuracy.

title: Search friends
description: Search the authenticated user’s friends by user ID, nickname, or remark.
keywords: sdk uniapp v4 sdk uniapp user friends search-friends
content: Invoke searchFriends to search through the authenticated user's local friend records using matching criteria. The SDK consumes the first non empty keyword in the array; trim whitespace and enable at least one search dimension. Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | keywordList | string | Yes | An array of search strings. The SDK utilizes the first non empty keyword. | | isSearchUserID | boolean | Yes | Whether to match against friend user IDs. | | isSearchNickname | boolean | Yes | Whether to match against friend account nicknames. | | isSearchRemark | boolean | Yes | Whether to match against custom friend remarks. | Code example import searchFriends from '@/uni modules/unix openim sdk' const result = await searchFriends keywordList: keyword.trim , isSearchUserID: true, isSearchNickname: true, isSearchRemark: true, const matchedFriends = result?.friends ?? Return value The Promise resolves with an OpenIMFriendListResult | null object, containing matched friends in the friends property as OpenIMFriendUserItem . For field definitions, see Get the friend list /sdk/uniapp/user/friends/get friend list page . State changes after the call Search results represent a transient filtered subset. Map items by userID rather than overwriting your primary friend roster with search results. This method is read only and does not trigger friend events.

title: Get friend profiles
description: Batch query relationship profiles for specified friends by user ID.
keywords: sdk uniapp v4 sdk uniapp user friends get-specified-friends-info
content: Invoke getSpecifiedFriendsInfo to retrieve friendship records for users with whom you maintain an established friendship. Pass an array of user IDs via userIDList , and optionally filter out blacklisted contacts via filterBlack . Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | userIDList | string | Yes | An array of friend user IDs to query. | | filterBlack | boolean | No | Whether to exclude blacklisted users from the returned results. | Code example import getSpecifiedFriendsInfo from '@/uni modules/unix openim sdk' const result = await getSpecifiedFriendsInfo userIDList: 'user a', 'user b' , filterBlack: true, const friends = result?.friends ?? Return value The Promise resolves with an OpenIMFriendListResult | null object containing an array of OpenIMFriendUserItem elements in friends . Returned elements are not guaranteed to match the order of userIDList ; map records by matching each item's userID . For data field definitions, see Get the friend list /sdk/uniapp/user/friends/get friend list page . State changes after the call To query public profiles for non friend users, call Get user profiles /sdk/uniapp/user/profile/get users info . This query returns a point in time snapshot and does not trigger friend events.

title: Check friendship status
description: Verify whether the authenticated user maintains a friendship with a specified set of users.
keywords: sdk uniapp v4 sdk uniapp user friends check-friend
content: Invoke checkFriend to batch verify friendship relationships between the authenticated user and one or more target users before displaying profile cards or initiating interactions. Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | userIDs | string | Yes | An array of user IDs to check. | Code example import checkFriend from '@/uni modules/unix openim sdk' const response = await checkFriend 'user a', 'user b' const checks = response?.result ?? Return value The Promise resolves with an OpenIMCheckFriendResult | null object containing an array of friendship status records in result : | Property | Type | Description | | | | | | userID | string | The user ID checked. | | result | number | 1 indicates that the users are friends; 0 indicates that they are not friends. | State changes after the call This is a read only check that retrieves current local status without triggering friend events. Friendships and blacklists are distinct relationship models; to check blacklist status, call Get the blacklist /sdk/uniapp/user/blacklist/get black list .

title: Update friend information
description: Batch update friend remarks, pin states, or custom extension strings.
keywords: sdk uniapp v4 sdk uniapp user friends update-friends
content: Invoke updateFriends to update friendship metadata across one or more friend records. Changes specified in the parameters are applied uniformly to all users listed in friendUserIDs . To configure unique values for different friends, execute separate calls. Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | friendUserIDs | string | Yes | An array of friend user IDs to update. | | remark | string | No | New custom friend remark or alias. | | isPinned | boolean | No | Whether to pin this friend in the contact list. | | ex | string | No | New custom relationship extension string; completely overwrites existing data. | Supply at least one modification field in addition to friendUserIDs . Code example import updateFriends from '@/uni modules/unix openim sdk' await updateFriends friendUserIDs: friendUserID , remark: remark.trim , isPinned: true, Return value The Promise resolves with void once OpenIMServer accepts the friendship modification request. State changes after the call A resolved Promise confirms that the request completed successfully. It does not mean the onFriendInfoChanged event has arrived at all listening clients. When the event arrives, clients merge the updated record into their store by userID . To calibrate immediately, re query the friend record using Get friend profiles /sdk/uniapp/user/friends/get specified friends info . The ex property is an opaque string and is not merged automatically by the SDK.

title: Delete a friend
description: Remove an established friendship between the authenticated user and a specified contact.
keywords: sdk uniapp v4 sdk uniapp user friends delete-friend
content: Invoke deleteFriend to delete the friendship between the authenticated user and a specified contact. Pass the target friend's user ID directly. Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | friendUserID | string | Yes | The user ID of the friend to remove. | Code example import deleteFriend from '@/uni modules/unix openim sdk' await deleteFriend friendUserID Return value The Promise resolves with void once OpenIMServer processes the deletion request. State changes after the call A resolved Promise confirms that the deletion request succeeded on OpenIMServer; it does not indicate that the deletion event has been processed on all devices. Upon receiving onFriendDeleted , the client removes the friendship record matching userID from the active friend roster and related caches. For complete event registration and cleanup logic, see Get the friend list /sdk/uniapp/user/friends/get friend list page . If events might have been missed during a network interruption, re query the friend list to calibrate state.

title: Send a friend application
description: Submit an outgoing friend request to a specified user.
keywords: sdk uniapp v4 sdk uniapp user friend-applications add-friend
content: Invoke addFriend to submit a friend application to a target user. Before sending, ensure the target is not the current user's own account or an existing friend. Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | toUserID | string | Yes | The recipient user ID for the friend request. | | reqMsg | string | Yes | Verification greeting or justification message; pass an empty string if no message is required. | | ex | string | No | Optional business extension string agreed upon by application conventions. | Code example import addFriend from '@/uni modules/unix openim sdk' await addFriend toUserID, reqMsg: verificationMessage, Return value The Promise resolves with void once OpenIMServer receives the application. State changes after the call A resolved Promise confirms that the friend request was dispatched; it does not indicate that the recipient has accepted, nor should it trigger adding the user to the local friend list. Outgoing application logs are tracked via application events, while new friendships are established only after acceptance arrives via onFriendAdded . For application events, see Get received friend applications /sdk/uniapp/user/friend applications/get friend application list as recipient ; for friend roster synchronization, see Get the friend list /sdk/uniapp/user/friends/get friend list page .

title: Get received friend applications
description: Query friend applications received by the authenticated user with pagination.
keywords: sdk uniapp v4 sdk uniapp user friend-applications get-friend-application-list-as-recipient
content: Invoke getFriendApplicationListAsRecipient to retrieve a paginated list of incoming friend requests sent to the authenticated user. While offset and count can be omitted, specify them explicitly starting with offset: 0 for predictable pagination. Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | offset | number | No | Pagination offset index; pass 0 for the first page. | | count | number | No | Number of application records to fetch per page. | This API does not accept a handleResults filter parameter. If your UI needs to display only pending, accepted, or rejected applications, filter the fetched array in your application layer using handleResult . Code example import getFriendApplicationListAsRecipient from '@/uni modules/unix openim sdk' const result = await getFriendApplicationListAsRecipient offset: 0, count: 20, const applications = result?.applications ?? Return value The Promise resolves with an OpenIMFriendApplicationListResult | null object containing an array of OpenIMFriendApplicationItem elements in applications : | Property | Type | Description | | | | | | fromUserID | string | The user ID of the applicant who submitted the request. | | fromNickname | string | The applicant's display nickname saved with the application. | | fromFaceURL | string | The applicant's avatar URL saved with the application. | | toUserID | string | The user ID of the recipient the active account . | | toNickname | string | The recipient's display nickname saved with the application. | | toFaceURL | string | The recipient's avatar URL saved with the application. | | reqMsg | string | The greeting or application message text. | | handleResult | OpenIMApplicationHandleResult | Review state: OpenIMApplicationHandleResultUnprocessed pending , OpenIMApplicationHandleResultAccepted approved , or OpenIMApplicationHandleResultRejected declined . | | handlerUserID | string | The user ID who processed the request; may be empty while pending. | | handleMsg | string | Notes or reasons entered when processing the application. | | handleTime | number | Processing timestamp in Unix milliseconds; invalid while pending. | | createTime | number | Application creation timestamp in Unix milliseconds. | | ex | string | Application extension string. | | attachedInfo | string | SDK internal metadata. | Identify a unique application record using the composite key fromUserID:toUserID . Profile attributes stored on the record represent snapshot values at the time of creation; query Get user profiles /sdk/uniapp/user/profile/get users info if you require the contact's live account profile. Monitor friend application updates Friend application lifecycle events are centrally registered here. Queries establish initial views, while events merge incremental updates. Update incoming or outgoing application lists depending on whether the current user matches toUserID or fromUserID : import OpenIMFriendApplicationItem, off, onFriendApplicationAccepted, onFriendApplicationAdded, onFriendApplicationDeleted, onFriendApplicationRejected, from '@/uni modules/unix openim sdk' const handleApplicationChanged = application: OpenIMFriendApplicationItem | null, = if application == null return mergeFriendApplication application const handleApplicationDeleted = application: OpenIMFriendApplicationItem | null, = if application == null return removeFriendApplication application.fromUserID, application.toUserID, const applicationAddedSubscription = onFriendApplicationAdded handleApplicationChanged, const applicationAcceptedSubscription = onFriendApplicationAccepted handleApplicationChanged, const applicationRejectedSubscription = onFriendApplicationRejected handleApplicationChanged, const applicationDeletedSubscription = onFriendApplicationDeleted handleApplicationDeleted, function removeFriendApplicationListeners off applicationAddedSubscription off applicationAcceptedSubscription off applicationRejectedSubscription off applicationDeletedSubscription If application records change during active paging, reset the pagination index and re query. When an application is approved, also update your contact roster via Get the friend list /sdk/uniapp/user/friends/get friend list page . Unregister these listeners when logging out, switching accounts, or tearing down the application view model.

title: Get sent friend applications
description: Query friend applications submitted by the authenticated user with pagination.
keywords: sdk uniapp v4 sdk uniapp user friend-applications get-friend-application-list-as-applicant
content: Invoke getFriendApplicationListAsApplicant to retrieve a paginated record of outgoing friend requests sent by the authenticated user. While offset and count are optional, specify them explicitly starting from offset: 0 for stable paging. Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | offset | number | No | Pagination offset index; pass 0 for the initial page. | | count | number | No | Number of application records to fetch per page. | Code example import getFriendApplicationListAsApplicant from '@/uni modules/unix openim sdk' const result = await getFriendApplicationListAsApplicant offset: 0, count: 20, const applications = result?.applications ?? Return value The Promise resolves with an OpenIMFriendApplicationListResult | null object containing OpenIMFriendApplicationItem elements in applications . For property definitions and review status constants, see Get received friend applications /sdk/uniapp/user/friend applications/get friend application list as recipient . This API does not filter by status; apply client side filtering via handleResult as needed. State changes after the call This is a read only query that retrieves local snapshot records without emitting events. When incoming lifecycle changes arrive during active pagination, merge records using the composite key fromUserID:toUserID . For complete event registration logic, see Get received friend applications /sdk/uniapp/user/friend applications/get friend application list as recipient .

title: Get pending application count
description: Query the total count of unhandled friend requests.
keywords: sdk uniapp v4 sdk uniapp user friend-applications get-friend-application-unhandled-count
content: Invoke getFriendApplicationUnhandledCount to retrieve the number of pending, unprocessed incoming friend requests. This count is typically used to render contact badge indicators and notification badges. Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | offset | number | No | Pagination offset index; pass 0 for the initial query. | | count | number | No | Maximum number of records to evaluate during this count query. | Code example import getFriendApplicationUnhandledCount from '@/uni modules/unix openim sdk' const pendingCount = await getFriendApplicationUnhandledCount offset: 0, count: 100, Return value The Promise resolves with a number | null indicating the count of pending requests evaluated. State changes after the call This is a read only query that reads local snapshot data without altering records or triggering events. To maintain real time unhandled badge counters, initialize state using this query and adjust counters dynamically as friend application events arrive. Re query upon re authentication or network recovery. For event listeners, see Get received friend applications /sdk/uniapp/user/friend applications/get friend application list as recipient .

title: Accept a friend application
description: Approve an incoming friend request from a specified user.
keywords: sdk uniapp v4 sdk uniapp user friend-applications accept-friend-application
content: Invoke acceptFriendApplication to accept an incoming friend request. When processing an incoming application, pass the applicant's user ID as toUserID rather than your own ID. Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | toUserID | string | Yes | The user ID of the applicant whose request is being accepted. | | handleMsg | string | Yes | Optional response message or approval note; pass an empty string if not required. | Code example import acceptFriendApplication from '@/uni modules/unix openim sdk' await acceptFriendApplication toUserID: applicantUserID, handleMsg: '', Return value The Promise resolves with void once OpenIMServer processes the approval. State changes after the call A resolved Promise indicates that the server accepted the request; it does not mean events have completed local state updates. Friend applications and friend rosters represent two separate data collections: upon receiving onFriendApplicationAccepted , update the application status in the request list; upon receiving onFriendAdded , merge the new friend into your contact roster by userID . To calibrate state, re query both lists. For event listener patterns, see Get received friend applications /sdk/uniapp/user/friend applications/get friend application list as recipient and Get the friend list /sdk/uniapp/user/friends/get friend list page .

title: Reject a friend application
description: Decline an incoming friend request from a specified user.
keywords: sdk uniapp v4 sdk uniapp user friend-applications refuse-friend-application
content: Invoke refuseFriendApplication to reject an incoming friend request. When processing an incoming application, pass the applicant's user ID as toUserID . Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | toUserID | string | Yes | The user ID of the applicant whose request is being rejected. | | handleMsg | string | Yes | Reason or note explaining the rejection; pass an empty string if omitted. | Code example import refuseFriendApplication from '@/uni modules/unix openim sdk' await refuseFriendApplication toUserID: applicantUserID, handleMsg: '', Return value The Promise resolves with void once OpenIMServer processes the rejection. State changes after the call A resolved Promise indicates that the server accepted the rejection; it does not indicate that the rejection event has arrived at all clients. Upon receiving onFriendApplicationRejected , update the application status indexed by fromUserID:toUserID . Rejecting an application does not form a friendship or remove the application log from history. For complete event registration logic, see Get received friend applications /sdk/uniapp/user/friend applications/get friend application list as recipient .

title: Delete friend applications
description: Batch remove friend application records using composite applicant and recipient user IDs.
keywords: sdk uniapp v4 sdk uniapp user friend-applications delete-friend-requests
content: Invoke deleteFriendRequests to purge one or more friend request records from application logs. Each element in friendRequests is identified by the composite pair of applicant and recipient user IDs. Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | friendRequests | OpenIMSimpleFriendRequest | Yes | An array of friend requests to delete. | | friendRequests .fromUserID | string | Yes | The applicant's user ID. | | friendRequests .toUserID | string | Yes | The recipient's user ID. | Code example import deleteFriendRequests from '@/uni modules/unix openim sdk' await deleteFriendRequests friendRequests: fromUserID, toUserID, , Return value The Promise resolves with void once OpenIMServer removes the specified application entries. State changes after the call Deleting an application record from history is distinct from rejecting a pending request; it does not alter friendship status between users. A resolved Promise confirms that the deletion request succeeded. Upon receiving onFriendApplicationDeleted , clients remove the record matching fromUserID:toUserID . For complete event registration logic, see Get received friend applications /sdk/uniapp/user/friend applications/get friend application list as recipient .

title: Get the blacklist
description: Query the list of users blocked by the authenticated user.
keywords: sdk uniapp v4 sdk uniapp user blacklist get-black-list
content: The blacklist records users blocked by the current account, suitable for rendering blacklist configuration screens, determining contact relationship states on profile cards, and managing chat entry points. Blacklisting is independent of friendships, group memberships, or platform wide bans. Invoke getBlackList without parameters. An empty array indicates that no users are currently blocked. Code example import getBlackList from '@/uni modules/unix openim sdk' const result = await getBlackList const blockedUsers = result?.blackUsers ?? replaceBlockedUsers blockedUsers In profile dialogs, conversation menus, and contact lists, checking whether a userID exists in a local blacklist set is usually sufficient. Maintain a set of blocked user IDs for fast checks, using nicknames and avatars for display purposes only. Return value The Promise resolves with an OpenIMBlackListResult | null object containing an array of OpenIMBlackUserItem elements in blackUsers : | Property | Type | Description | | | | | | userID | string | The user ID of the blocked user; serves as the merge key for blacklist updates. | | nickname | string | Display nickname of the blocked user. | | faceURL | string | Avatar URL of the blocked user. | | ownerUserID | string | Owner of this blacklist record the authenticated user . | | operatorUserID | string | User ID that performed the blacklist operation. | | createTime | number | Timestamp when the user was blacklisted, in Unix milliseconds. | | addSource | number | Numeric source code indicating how the user was added to the blacklist. | | ex | string | Custom blacklist extension string. | | attachedInfo | string | SDK internal metadata. | If a screen also renders public profiles or friend remarks, join data by userID , distinguishing between OpenIMBlackUserItem , OpenIMFriendUserItem , and OpenIMPublicUserItem . Monitor blacklist updates Blacklist additions and removals are centrally handled here. Queries establish the initial snapshot, while events stream incremental changes: import OpenIMBlackUserItem, off, onBlackAdded, onBlackDeleted, from '@/uni modules/unix openim sdk' const handleBlackAdded = user: OpenIMBlackUserItem | null = if user == null return mergeBlockedUser user const handleBlackDeleted = user: OpenIMBlackUserItem | null = if user == null return removeBlockedUser user.userID const blackAddedSubscription = onBlackAdded handleBlackAdded const blackDeletedSubscription = onBlackDeleted handleBlackDeleted function removeBlacklistListeners off blackAddedSubscription off blackDeletedSubscription When a user is blacklisted, they cannot send messages to the authenticated account, though the authenticated account can still message them; if bidirectional restrictions are required, implement them in your application logic. Unregister these listeners when logging out, switching accounts, or tearing down the blacklist manager.

title: Add a user to the blacklist
description: Block a specified user by adding them to the authenticated account’s blacklist.
keywords: sdk uniapp v4 sdk uniapp user blacklist add-black
content: Invoke addBlack to add a target user to the current account's blacklist. Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | toUserID | string | Yes | The user ID of the target user to block. | | ex | string | No | Optional business extension string. | Code example import addBlack from '@/uni modules/unix openim sdk' await addBlack toUserID, ex: JSON.stringify source: 'profile' , Return value The Promise resolves with void once OpenIMServer processes the blacklist operation. State changes after the call A resolved Promise confirms that the request succeeded on OpenIMServer; it does not indicate that the onBlackAdded event has arrived across all devices. Upon receiving the event, merge the new record into local state using userID . To calibrate state, re query the blacklist via Get the blacklist /sdk/uniapp/user/blacklist/get black list . Handle errors like duplicate blocking or permission errors via the rejected Promise.

title: Remove a user from the blacklist
description: Unblock a specified user by removing them from the authenticated account’s blacklist.
keywords: sdk uniapp v4 sdk uniapp user blacklist remove-black
content: Invoke removeBlack to unblock a user by removing them from the authenticated account's blacklist. This operation alters only the blacklist record; it does not automatically re establish a friendship or restore other application specific relationship states. Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | toUserID | string | Yes | The user ID of the target user to unblock. | Code example import removeBlack from '@/uni modules/unix openim sdk' await removeBlack toUserID Return value The Promise resolves with void once OpenIMServer processes the removal. State changes after the call A resolved Promise confirms that the request completed successfully on OpenIMServer; it does not indicate that the onBlackDeleted event has arrived across all devices. Upon receiving the event, remove the record matching userID from your blacklist cache. For event listener setup, see Get the blacklist /sdk/uniapp/user/blacklist/get black list . To verify state immediately, re query the blacklist via getBlackList .

title: Conversation overview
description: Understand conversation records, chat targets, conversation IDs, and list synchronization workflows.
keywords: sdk uniapp v4 sdk uniapp conversation overview-conversation
content: In the OpenIM SDK, a conversation represents the client side chat session state maintained by the currently authenticated user for a direct single chat or group chat. Each OpenIMConversationItem record preserves unread counts, the latest message summary, pinned status, draft text, notification options, and message lifecycle policies. A conversation record uses distinct identifiers from its chat target: conversationID identifies a specific conversation session for the authenticated user, whereas a single chat target is identified by the peer userID , and a group chat target is identified by groupID . A group chat UI typically needs groupID to access group profile and member capabilities, while using conversationID to manage conversation settings, unread counts, and message history. Conversation identifiers When retrieving a conversation or generating its identifier by target, pass the peer user ID as sourceID with OpenIMSessionTypeSingle for single chats, or pass the group ID as sourceID with OpenIMSessionTypeWriteGroup for group chats. Never manually concatenate or forge conversation ID strings in your application code. | Identifier | Purpose | | | | | conversationID | The conversation record ID for the authenticated account, used for conversation settings, message history, and unread state. | | userID | The user ID of the peer user in a single chat. | | groupID | The group ID corresponding to a group chat, also used as the target identifier for group APIs. | | sourceID | The target identifier passed when querying by session type: userID for single chats, and groupID for group chats. | Conversation record responsibilities The fields in OpenIMConversationItem serve several key responsibilities: | Responsibility | Relevant fields | Description | | | | | | Identity and type | conversationID , conversationType , userID , groupID | Identify the conversation session and associate it with the concrete chat target. | | List presentation | showName , faceURL , latestMsg , latestMsgSendTime | Render conversation title, avatar, and latest message snippet. | | Unread and notifications | unreadCount , groupAtType , recvMsgOpt | Display unread message counts, group @ mention indicators, and message notification modes. | | Local organization | isPinned , draftText , draftTextTime , isMarked Commercial , remark Commercial | Maintain pinned position, custom markers, alias remarks, and locally saved draft text. | | Message policies | isPrivateChat Commercial , burnDuration Commercial , isMsgDestruct Commercial , msgDestructTime Commercial | Control self destructing private chat duration and periodic server side message cleanup. | | Sync boundaries | minSeq , maxSeq , updateUnreadCountTime | Record message synchronization checkpoints and unread calculation timestamps. | | Business extensions | ex , attachedInfo | Store custom application metadata and internal SDK extension payloads. | Querying and synchronization When entering a chat view from a contact card or group profile, use Open a conversation /sdk/uniapp/conversation/retrieving conversations/get conversation by target . When you only require a stable identifier without fetching message content, use Get conversation ID /sdk/uniapp/conversation/retrieving conversations/get conversation id . When you already hold a list of conversation IDs, use Get conversations by ID /sdk/uniapp/conversation/retrieving conversations/get conversations by id . When constructing the conversation list UI, use Retrieve conversation list /sdk/uniapp/conversation/retrieving conversations/retrieve conversation list and register new conversation and update events on that page. When filtering locally cached conversations, use Search conversations /sdk/uniapp/conversation/retrieving conversations/search conversations . To organize conversations, use Pin or unpin a conversation /sdk/uniapp/conversation/managing conversations/pin conversation , Mark a conversation /sdk/uniapp/conversation/managing conversations/mark conversation , or Set a conversation remark /sdk/uniapp/conversation/managing conversations/set conversation remark . To configure message retention policies, use Set message destruct /sdk/uniapp/conversation/managing conversations/set message destruct . Queries obtain a point in time local snapshot, while event callbacks deliver subsequent incremental updates. A successful mutation Promise resolution, event arrival, and a re query snapshot represent three distinct lifecycle stages. Always merge incoming state updates using conversationID as the primary key, and re query the latest conversation snapshot whenever event continuity may have been interrupted.

title: Open a conversation
description: Query a single conversation record by single-chat user ID or group ID.
keywords: sdk uniapp v4 sdk uniapp conversation retrieving-conversations get-conversation-by-target
content: When transitioning into a chat interface from a contact profile, user detail view, or group info card, query the conversation directly using its concrete target identifier. Supply the peer userID as sourceID for single chats, or the groupID as sourceID for group chats. Always use the SDK query method rather than attempting to concatenate conversationID strings or manually construct conversation objects. Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | sourceID | string | Yes | Target identifier: peer user ID for single chats, or group ID for group chats. | | sessionType | OpenIMSessionType | Yes | Use OpenIMSessionTypeSingle for single chats, or OpenIMSessionTypeWriteGroup for standard group chats. | Code example import OpenIMSessionTypeSingle, getOneConversation, from '@/uni modules/unix openim sdk' const conversation = await getOneConversation sourceID: targetUserID, sessionType: OpenIMSessionTypeSingle, if conversation = null openChatPage conversation Return value The Promise resolves with an OpenIMConversationItem | null object. For a detailed breakdown of returned conversation fields, see Retrieve conversation list /sdk/uniapp/conversation/retrieving conversations/retrieve conversation list . State changes after the call This query returns the local snapshot at the moment of invocation and does not trigger conversation events. Merge subsequent incremental updates using conversationID as the primary key. For complete event subscription and state merging patterns, see Retrieve conversation list /sdk/uniapp/conversation/retrieving conversations/retrieve conversation list .

title: Get conversation ID
description: Compute a stable conversation identifier from a target user or group identifier and session type.
keywords: sdk uniapp v4 sdk uniapp conversation retrieving-conversations get-conversation-id
content: When you only need to determine a stable conversationID without fetching the full conversation data object, compute it directly using the chat target identifier and session type. Supply the peer user ID for single chats or the group ID for group chats. Always invoke this SDK method rather than attempting to concatenate or format conversation IDs manually. Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | sourceID | string | Yes | Target identifier: peer user ID for single chats, or group ID for group chats. | | sessionType | OpenIMSessionType | Yes | Use OpenIMSessionTypeSingle for single chats, or OpenIMSessionTypeWriteGroup for standard group chats. | Code example import OpenIMSessionTypeSingle, getConversationIDBySessionType, from '@/uni modules/unix openim sdk' const conversationID = await getConversationIDBySessionType sourceID: targetUserID, sessionType: OpenIMSessionTypeSingle, Return value The Promise resolves with a string representing the unique, deterministic conversation identifier. Use this ID for conversation configuration, message history queries, read receipt operations, hiding, or deletion. State changes after the call This call computes the identifier deterministically from local and SDK parameters without making network requests or modifying local database state. It does not trigger conversation events.

title: Get conversations by ID
description: Batch query conversation records using an array of conversation IDs.
keywords: sdk uniapp v4 sdk uniapp conversation retrieving-conversations get-conversations-by-id
content: When your application already holds a collection of conversationID values, invoke getMultipleConversation to query their current conversation records in a single batch operation. Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | conversationIDs | string | Yes | An array of conversation identifiers to query. | Code example import getMultipleConversation from '@/uni modules/unix openim sdk' const result = await getMultipleConversation conversationIDs const conversations = result?.conversations ?? conversations.forEach conversation = conversationByID.set conversation.conversationID, conversation Return value The Promise resolves with an OpenIMConversationListResult | null object. The returned records are available in the conversations array OpenIMConversationItem . Map and merge records into your view models using conversationID as the key. If a requested conversation ID does not exist locally, it will be omitted from the results; do not assume the returned array matches the positional order or length of the input array. For field definitions, see Retrieve conversation list /sdk/uniapp/conversation/retrieving conversations/retrieve conversation list . State changes after the call This call is a read only snapshot retrieval and does not trigger conversation update events. Continue monitoring conversation events as described in Retrieve conversation list /sdk/uniapp/conversation/retrieving conversations/retrieve conversation list .

title: Retrieve conversation list
description: Query the authenticated user’s conversation list with pagination and listen for ongoing conversation updates.
keywords: sdk uniapp v4 sdk uniapp conversation retrieving-conversations retrieve-conversation-list
content: The conversation list belongs to the currently authenticated account. Load conversation items using pagination to avoid memory and rendering bottlenecks associated with fetching the entire database at once. Begin the first page at offset: 0 and increment the offset by the cumulative number of items fetched so far. Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | offset | number | Yes | Starting pagination offset; supply 0 for the first page. | | count | number | Yes | Maximum number of conversations to retrieve in this page. | Code example import getConversationListSplit from '@/uni modules/unix openim sdk' const result = await getConversationListSplit offset: 0, count: 50, const conversations = result?.conversations ?? mergeConversations conversations Return value The Promise resolves with an OpenIMConversationListResult | null object. The retrieved page items are stored in conversations OpenIMConversationItem . Deduplicate and merge items into your application state using conversationID . When the returned array contains fewer items than count , the end of the cached conversation list has been reached. Upon re login, account switching, or manual pull to refresh, clear local paginated state and query again starting from offset 0. Conversation fields The OpenIMConversationItem object consolidates target identification, list rendering metadata, and account specific conversation configuration: | Field | Type | Description | | | | | | conversationID | string | Stable unique conversation identifier; serves as the primary key for queries and event merging. | | conversationType | OpenIMSessionType | Session type, such as single chat OpenIMSessionTypeSingle or group chat OpenIMSessionTypeWriteGroup . | | userID | string \| null | Peer user ID in a single chat; empty string or null in group chats. | | groupID | string \| null | Target group ID in a group chat; empty string or null in single chats. | | showName | string | Display name of the conversation for UI rendering. | | faceURL | string | Avatar image URL of the conversation. | | latestMsg | string \| null | Serialized JSON string of the latest message, or null if no displayable message exists. | | latestMsgSendTime | number | Send timestamp of the latest message in Unix milliseconds. | | unreadCount | number | Total unread message count for the authenticated account in this conversation. | | recvMsgOpt | OpenIMMessageReceiveOption | Message receive option, such as normal reception, muting, or suppressing notifications. | | groupAtType | OpenIMGroupMentionType | Group @ mention status; not applicable to single chats. | | draftText | string | Locally saved message draft string. | | draftTextTime | number | Timestamp when the draft was last updated, in Unix milliseconds. | | isPinned | boolean | Whether the conversation is pinned to the top of the list. | | isMarked Commercial | boolean \| null | Whether the authenticated user marked this conversation. Marked conversations are grouped into built in tag views. | | remark Commercial | string \| null | Custom alias remark set for this conversation by the authenticated user; null if unset. | | isPrivateChat Commercial | boolean | Whether burn after reading private chat mode is enabled. | | burnDuration Commercial | number | Private chat burn after reading countdown duration in seconds. | | isMsgDestruct Commercial | boolean | Whether periodic server side message self destruction is enabled. | | msgDestructTime Commercial | number | Server side message destruction interval in seconds. | | isNotInGroup | boolean | Indicates whether the current account is no longer a member of the group. | | updateUnreadCountTime | number | Timestamp when the unread count was last updated, in Unix milliseconds. | | minSeq | number | Smallest synchronized message sequence number in this conversation. | | maxSeq | number | Largest synchronized message sequence number in this conversation. | | ex | string | Custom extension string attached to the conversation record. | | attachedInfo | string | SDK internal auxiliary string; parse only according to confirmed business protocols. | Render conversation titles and avatars with showName and faceURL . When contact or group details change, refresh them through profile event listeners or re queries; never compute conversation IDs from display names. State changes after the call New conversations and incremental updates are synchronized via event subscriptions. Both events deliver an OpenIMConversationListResult | null payload containing one or more updated conversations; iterate over conversations and merge updates by conversationID . import OpenIMConversationListResult, off, onConversationChanged, onNewConversation, from '@/uni modules/unix openim sdk' const handleConversationUpdates = result: OpenIMConversationListResult | null, = if result == null return mergeConversations result.conversations const newConversationSubscription = onNewConversation handleConversationUpdates, const conversationChangedSubscription = onConversationChanged handleConversationUpdates, function removeConversationListListeners off newConversationSubscription off conversationChangedSubscription Invoke removeConversationListListeners when the component unmounts, or when logging out or switching accounts. Do not substitute the joined group list for the conversation list: a user may belong to groups that have not yet generated a conversation item, and historical conversation entries may persist even after leaving a group.

title: Search conversations
description: Perform a fuzzy keyword search across locally synchronized conversations by display name.
keywords: sdk uniapp v4 sdk uniapp conversation retrieving-conversations search-conversations
content: Invoke searchConversation to perform a fuzzy search across the display names showName of conversations currently synchronized into the local database. Pass a non empty keyword string; this method searches local storage and does not query remote server history for conversations not yet downloaded. Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | searchKeyword | string | Yes | Non empty text string matched against conversation display names. | Code example import searchConversation from '@/uni modules/unix openim sdk' const result = await searchConversation searchKeyword.trim const matchedConversations = result?.conversations ?? renderConversationResults matchedConversations Return value The Promise resolves with an OpenIMConversationListResult | null object. Matching conversation records are available in the conversations array OpenIMConversationItem . State changes after the call This call is a local read only query that reflects data stored at the time of invocation and does not trigger conversation events. If your search results UI needs to reflect ongoing conversation updates, listen to conversation events as shown in Retrieve conversation list /sdk/uniapp/conversation/retrieving conversations/retrieve conversation list and merge updates or deletions by conversationID .

title: Pin or unpin a conversation
description: Set or clear the pinned state of a conversation in the authenticated user’s conversation list.
keywords: sdk uniapp v4 sdk uniapp conversation managing-conversations pin-conversation
content: Invoke setConversation to pin or unpin a conversation in the authenticated user's local conversation list. The isPinned property affects list ordering only for the current account; it does not alter the view for other group members or the peer user in a single chat. Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | conversationID | string | Yes | Identifier of the target conversation. | | isPinned | boolean | Yes | Set to true to pin the conversation to the top, or false to unpin it. | Code example import setConversation from '@/uni modules/unix openim sdk' await setConversation conversationID, isPinned: true, Return value The Promise resolves with void upon successful completion. State changes after the call Promise resolution indicates that the SDK updated local storage and dispatched the request to the server. You can immediately update the pinned state of the target conversation in your local UI model. The SDK then emits onConversationChanged , where you can confirm the latest state using conversationID as the primary key. If state verification is required, re query the conversation record as described in Retrieve conversation list /sdk/uniapp/conversation/retrieving conversations/retrieve conversation list .

title: Mark a conversation
description: Set or clear the commercial marked tag on a conversation for the authenticated user.
keywords: sdk uniapp v4 sdk uniapp conversation managing-conversations mark-conversation
content: Marking conversations is a Commercial Edition capability. The isMarked property alters the marked indicator exclusively for the currently authenticated user. When marked, the conversation is automatically included in the built in marked group; when unmarked, it is automatically removed without requiring explicit conversation group member management API calls. Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | conversationID | string | Yes | Identifier of the target conversation. | | isMarked | boolean | Yes | Set to true to mark the conversation, or false to remove the mark. | Code example import setConversation from '@/uni modules/unix openim sdk' await setConversation conversationID, isMarked: true, The marked status operates independently from the pinned status and does not modify group profiles or chat message content. For details on conversation group architectures, see Conversation group overview /sdk/uniapp/conversation/managing conversation groups/overview conversation groups . Return value The Promise resolves with void upon successful completion. State changes after the call Promise resolution indicates that the SDK updated local storage and dispatched the request to the server. You can immediately reflect the updated isMarked value in your local UI state. The SDK then delivers onConversationChanged , where you can verify the persisted state using conversationID as the primary key. If state verification is required, re query the conversation record as described in Retrieve conversation list /sdk/uniapp/conversation/retrieving conversations/retrieve conversation list .

title: Set a conversation remark
description: Set a custom conversation-level alias remark for the authenticated user.
keywords: sdk uniapp v4 sdk uniapp conversation managing-conversations set-conversation-remark
content: Setting a conversation remark is a Commercial Edition capability. The remark is a client side alias maintained exclusively by the currently authenticated user for this conversation session; it does not change the peer's actual nickname, friend remark, or group name. Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | conversationID | string | Yes | Identifier of the target conversation. | | remark | string | Yes | Custom remark string; pass an empty string "" to clear the remark. | Code example import setConversation from '@/uni modules/unix openim sdk' await setConversation conversationID, remark: 'Project Discussion', When rendering the conversation title in the UI, choose between remark and the conversation's default showName according to your application design rules. Never persist conversation remarks back to user profiles, friend records, or group metadata. Return value The Promise resolves with void upon successful completion. State changes after the call Promise resolution indicates that the SDK persisted the remark locally and synchronized it with the server. You can immediately update the remark property of the target conversation in local memory. The SDK subsequently emits onConversationChanged , where you can verify the persisted state using conversationID as the primary key. If state verification is required, re query the conversation record as described in Retrieve conversation list /sdk/uniapp/conversation/retrieving conversations/retrieve conversation list .

title: Set a conversation draft
description: Save or clear draft input text for a conversation.
keywords: sdk uniapp v4 sdk uniapp conversation managing-conversations set-conversation-draft
content: Save a conversation draft when the user navigates away from a chat view, switches to another conversation, or stops typing. Maintain keystrokes in component state with debouncing during active composition, and persist the draft to the SDK upon page exit to avoid high frequency database writes on every character entered. Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | conversationID | string | Yes | Identifier of the target conversation. | | draftText | string | Yes | Draft text to store; pass an empty string "" to clear the draft. | Code example import setConversationDraft from '@/uni modules/unix openim sdk' await setConversationDraft conversationID, draftText: editorValue, Return value The Promise resolves with void upon successful local persistence. State changes after the call Promise resolution confirms that the draft text was saved to local storage. You can immediately update the local conversation item's draft fields. The SDK then emits onConversationChanged , where you can verify draftText and draftTextTime using conversationID as the primary key. For the centralized conversation listener implementation, see Retrieve conversation list /sdk/uniapp/conversation/retrieving conversations/retrieve conversation list . Clear in memory input states when logging out or switching accounts to prevent drafts from leaking across sessions.

title: Set a conversation extension
description: Set a custom business extension string on a conversation for the authenticated user.
keywords: sdk uniapp v4 sdk uniapp conversation managing-conversations set-conversation-extension
content: The ex field stores custom application defined metadata attached to a conversation. Because ex is persisted as an opaque string, the SDK does not automatically merge JSON properties; when multiple application modules share this field, define stable namespaces and preserve existing values prior to serializing the updated payload. Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | conversationID | string | Yes | Identifier of the target conversation. | | ex | string | Yes | Custom extension string to persist. | Code example import setConversation from '@/uni modules/unix openim sdk' await setConversation conversationID, ex: JSON.stringify category: 'work' , If existing extension data is already stored on the conversation, parse the current value, merge your new fields, and serialize the complete object before calling setConversation . Return value The Promise resolves with void upon successful completion. State changes after the call Promise resolution indicates that the SDK persisted the extension locally and dispatched the update to the server. You can immediately update the local conversation object's ex field. The SDK then emits onConversationChanged , where you can verify the persisted state using conversationID as the primary key. If state verification is required, re query the conversation record as described in Retrieve conversation list /sdk/uniapp/conversation/retrieving conversations/retrieve conversation list .

title: Set message receive option
description: Configure message reception and notification behavior for a specific conversation.
keywords: sdk uniapp v4 sdk uniapp conversation managing-conversations set-message-receive-option
content: The recvMsgOpt property controls message reception and alerting for an individual conversation, commonly used to implement per chat Do Not Disturb DND or muting. Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | conversationID | string | Yes | Identifier of the target conversation. | | recvMsgOpt | OpenIMMessageReceiveOption | Yes | Target message reception policy enum. | Message receive options | Enum value | Numeric value | Description | | | | | | OpenIMMessageReceiveOptionReceive | 0 | Receive messages normally and trigger notifications. | | OpenIMMessageReceiveOptionDoNotReceive | 1 | Block and reject incoming messages for this conversation. | | OpenIMMessageReceiveOptionReceiveWithoutNotification | 2 | Receive incoming messages silently without sound or notification alerts Mute . | Code example import OpenIMMessageReceiveOptionReceiveWithoutNotification, setConversation, from '@/uni modules/unix openim sdk' await setConversation conversationID, recvMsgOpt: OpenIMMessageReceiveOptionReceiveWithoutNotification, Conversation level reception options operate independently from the global user notification policy configured in Set global message reception /sdk/uniapp/user/profile/set global message reception . Return value The Promise resolves with void upon successful completion. State changes after the call Promise resolution, conversation change event arrival, and re querying the conversation are three distinct lifecycle stages. Update your local state optimistically or wait for onConversationChanged , merging the updated recvMsgOpt by conversationID . For the centralized conversation listener implementation, see Retrieve conversation list /sdk/uniapp/conversation/retrieving conversations/retrieve conversation list .

title: Clear group mentions
description: Reset group @ mention notification status to normal after processing relevant messages.
keywords: sdk uniapp v4 sdk uniapp conversation managing-conversations clear-group-mentions
content: After a user reviews and handles @ mention alerts in a group conversation, reset groupAtType to OpenIMGroupMentionTypeNormal to clear the unhandled mention banner or badge. Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | conversationID | string | Yes | Identifier of the target group conversation. | | groupAtType | OpenIMGroupMentionType | Yes | Supply OpenIMGroupMentionTypeNormal to reset the mention badge. | Code example import OpenIMGroupMentionTypeNormal, setConversation, from '@/uni modules/unix openim sdk' await setConversation conversationID, groupAtType: OpenIMGroupMentionTypeNormal, The groupAtType property is maintained automatically by the SDK as incoming group messages arrive. Use this method strictly to reset the status back to normal; do not manually forge mention states such as @Me or @All . Clearing @ mentions is distinct from marking conversation messages as read. Return value The Promise resolves with void upon successful completion. State changes after the call Promise resolution indicates that the mention status was reset locally and sent to the server. You can immediately clear the mention indicator from your local UI model. The SDK then delivers onConversationChanged , where you can verify the persisted groupAtType using conversationID as the primary key. For the centralized conversation listener implementation, see Retrieve conversation list /sdk/uniapp/conversation/retrieving conversations/retrieve conversation list .

title: Mark a conversation as read
description: Mark all received messages in a conversation as read and listen for peer C2C read receipts.
keywords: sdk uniapp v4 sdk uniapp conversation managing-conversations mark-conversation-read
content: When the user enters a chat screen and views incoming messages, invoke markConversationMessageAsRead to mark all currently received messages in that conversation as read. Avoid triggering this call prematurely when the app is in the background or when merely previewing system banner notifications. Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | conversationID | string | Yes | Identifier of the target conversation. | Code example import markConversationMessageAsRead from '@/uni modules/unix openim sdk' await markConversationMessageAsRead conversationID Return value The Promise resolves with void upon successful completion. State changes after the call Promise resolution indicates that the read status request was processed. You can optimistically set the local conversation's unreadCount to 0 . The SDK then emits onConversationChanged , where you can confirm the updated unread count by conversationID . For the centralized conversation list listener, see Retrieve conversation list /sdk/uniapp/conversation/retrieving conversations/retrieve conversation list . In group chats, calling this method only resets the unread count for the authenticated account; for member level message read receipt tracking, see Send group read receipts /sdk/uniapp/message/managing read status/send group read receipts and Get group message readers /sdk/uniapp/message/managing read status/get group message readers . Receive single chat read receipts When the authenticated user marks a single chat conversation as read, the peer user's device receives a single chat C2C read receipt. Centrally register onRecvC2CReadReceipt to monitor incoming read confirmations from conversation peers. The callback receives an OpenIMMessageReceiptListResult | null object containing receipt items in receipts . import OpenIMMessageReceiptListResult, off, onRecvC2CReadReceipt, from '@/uni modules/unix openim sdk' const handleC2CReadReceipts = result: OpenIMMessageReceiptListResult | null, = if result == null return result.receipts.forEach receipt = mergeC2CReadReceipt receipt.userID, receipt.msgIDList, receipt.readTime, const c2cReadReceiptSubscription = onRecvC2CReadReceipt handleC2CReadReceipts, function removeC2CReadReceiptListener off c2cReadReceiptSubscription In the receipt payload, userID identifies the peer user who read the messages, msgIDList contains the clientMsgID array of marked messages, and readTime is the Unix millisecond timestamp of the read action. Unregister the listener by calling off when logging out, switching accounts, or tearing down the message store layer.

title: Mark all conversations as read
description: Clear unread message counts across all conversations for the authenticated user.
keywords: sdk uniapp v4 sdk uniapp conversation managing-conversations mark-all-conversations-read
content: When a user taps a "Mark all as read" button in the conversation list, invoke markAllConversationMessageAsRead to clear all unread message counts across all conversations for the currently authenticated account. This method accepts no parameters. Code example import markAllConversationMessageAsRead from '@/uni modules/unix openim sdk' await markAllConversationMessageAsRead Return value The Promise resolves with void upon successful completion. State changes after the call Promise resolution indicates that the SDK processed the read state for all currently identified unread conversations. It does not imply that all subsequent conversation events have arrived or that other logged in clients have finished rendering updates. Update your local list state as onConversationChanged events deliver the zeroed unreadCount values indexed by conversationID , and update global tab badges via onTotalUnreadMessageCountChanged . For listener implementations, see Retrieve conversation list /sdk/uniapp/conversation/retrieving conversations/retrieve conversation list and Get total unread count /sdk/uniapp/conversation/managing conversations/get total unread count . To calibrate state after network reconnects, re query the conversation list and total unread count.

title: Get total unread count
description: Query and listen for changes to the total unread message count across all conversations.
keywords: sdk uniapp v4 sdk uniapp conversation managing-conversations get-total-unread-count
content: Query the aggregate unread message count across all conversations belonging to the authenticated account. This method accepts no parameters. Avoid summing only the unreadCount values of conversations currently loaded in your visible paginated list, as conversations that have not yet been paged into memory may also hold unread messages. Code example import getTotalUnreadMsgCount from '@/uni modules/unix openim sdk' const totalUnread = await getTotalUnreadMsgCount if totalUnread = null updateApplicationBadge totalUnread Return value The Promise resolves with a number | null value representing the aggregate unread message count at the time of invocation. State changes after the call This call is a local read only query that retrieves the current unread total without triggering events. Listen for total unread count changes Subscribe centrally to total unread count transitions. The callback receives the newly computed aggregate unread count directly as a number . import off, onTotalUnreadMessageCountChanged, from '@/uni modules/unix openim sdk' const handleTotalUnreadChanged = count: number = updateApplicationBadge count const totalUnreadSubscription = onTotalUnreadMessageCountChanged handleTotalUnreadChanged, function removeTotalUnreadListener off totalUnreadSubscription Invoke removeTotalUnreadListener when the component unmounts, when logging out, or when switching accounts. Upon re logging in or network reconnection, invoke getTotalUnreadMsgCount to calibrate badges against the latest server state. To synchronize this count with operating system application icons, see Set app badge /sdk/uniapp/message/set app badge .

title: Enable or disable private chat
description: Enable or disable burn-after-reading private chat mode for a conversation.
keywords: sdk uniapp v4 sdk uniapp conversation managing-conversations set-private-chat
content: Private chat mode burn after reading is a Commercial Edition capability. The isPrivateChat property toggles this behavior for a specified conversation; it is independent from periodic server side message destruction policies. Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | conversationID | string | Yes | Identifier of the target conversation. | | isPrivateChat | boolean | Yes | Set to true to enable private chat mode, or false to disable it. | Code example import setConversation from '@/uni modules/unix openim sdk' await setConversation conversationID, isPrivateChat: true, Pass false to disable private chat mode. To configure how long messages survive after being viewed, set burnDuration as documented in Set burn duration /sdk/uniapp/conversation/managing conversations/set burn duration . Return value The Promise resolves with void upon successful completion. State changes after the call Promise resolution indicates that the private chat setting was saved locally and dispatched to the server. You can immediately update the local conversation object's isPrivateChat property. The SDK then delivers onConversationChanged , where you can verify the persisted state using conversationID as the primary key. For the centralized conversation list listener, see Retrieve conversation list /sdk/uniapp/conversation/retrieving conversations/retrieve conversation list .

title: Set burn duration
description: Configure the countdown duration in seconds for burn-after-reading private chat mode.
keywords: sdk uniapp v4 sdk uniapp conversation managing-conversations set-burn-duration
content: Configuring burn duration is a Commercial Edition capability. The burnDuration parameter defines the countdown lifespan of messages in seconds once read within private chat mode. Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | conversationID | string | Yes | Identifier of the target conversation. | | burnDuration | number | Yes | Retention countdown duration in seconds for example, 30 . | Code example import setConversation from '@/uni modules/unix openim sdk' await setConversation conversationID, burnDuration: 30, Activating or deactivating burn after reading mode requires toggling isPrivateChat separately as documented in Set private chat /sdk/uniapp/conversation/managing conversations/set private chat . Do not confuse burnDuration with periodic server side message destruction settings. Return value The Promise resolves with void upon successful completion. State changes after the call Promise resolution indicates that the burn duration was saved locally and dispatched to the server. You can immediately update the local conversation object's burnDuration property. The SDK then emits onConversationChanged , where you can verify the persisted setting using conversationID as the primary key. For the centralized conversation list listener, see Retrieve conversation list /sdk/uniapp/conversation/retrieving conversations/retrieve conversation list .

title: Set message destruct
description: Enable, disable, and configure the periodic server-side message self-destruction policy for a conversation.
keywords: sdk uniapp v4 sdk uniapp conversation managing-conversations set-message-destruct
content: Periodic server side message self destruction is a Commercial Edition capability. The policy is controlled by two complementary properties: isMsgDestruct toggles the feature, and msgDestructTime specifies the destruction interval in seconds. Both properties belong to the same logical operation and can be committed in a single invocation. Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | conversationID | string | Yes | Identifier of the target conversation. | | isMsgDestruct | boolean | Yes | Set to true to enable server side message self destruction, or false to disable it. | | msgDestructTime | number | Yes | Self destruction retention interval in seconds for example, 3600 for one hour . | Code example import setConversation from '@/uni modules/unix openim sdk' await setConversation conversationID, isMsgDestruct: true, msgDestructTime: 3600, To disable the policy, pass isMsgDestruct: false . This mechanism governs message retention on OpenIMServer; it does not replace or interfere with single chat burn after reading mode, which is configured in Set private chat /sdk/uniapp/conversation/managing conversations/set private chat and Set burn duration /sdk/uniapp/conversation/managing conversations/set burn duration . When messages reach the expiration interval, the server purges them from remote storage. Messages that have already synchronized to local device databases are not deleted automatically. However, new client installations, devices that clear local cache, or newly logged in sessions cannot retrieve purged messages from the server. Return value The Promise resolves with void upon successful completion. State changes after the call Promise resolution indicates that the configuration was updated locally and saved to the server. You can immediately update the local conversation item's isMsgDestruct and msgDestructTime fields. The SDK then emits onConversationChanged , where you can verify the persisted state using conversationID as the primary key. For the centralized conversation list listener, see Retrieve conversation list /sdk/uniapp/conversation/retrieving conversations/retrieve conversation list .

title: Hide a conversation
description: Hide a conversation entry from the authenticated user’s active conversation list.
keywords: sdk uniapp v4 sdk uniapp conversation managing-conversations hide-a-conversation
content: Invoke hideConversation to hide a conversation from the authenticated user's active conversation list without deleting messages, leaving the group, or modifying relationship states for either party. Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | conversationID | string | Yes | Identifier of the conversation to hide. | Code example import hideConversation from '@/uni modules/unix openim sdk' await hideConversation conversationID Hiding a conversation is ideal for temporarily dismissing a chat from the visible list. When new incoming messages arrive for this conversation or full synchronization runs, the conversation reappears in the list. Return value The Promise resolves with void upon successful completion. State changes after the call Promise resolution indicates that the hide request was committed. Immediately remove the conversation item matching conversationID from your visible list. When subsequent conversation events arrive, merge updates using conversationID . For the centralized conversation list listener, see Retrieve conversation list /sdk/uniapp/conversation/retrieving conversations/retrieve conversation list .

title: Hide all conversations
description: Hide all conversation entries from the authenticated user’s active conversation list.
keywords: sdk uniapp v4 sdk uniapp conversation managing-conversations hide-all-conversations
content: Invoke hideAllConversations to clear list visibility, unread counts, latest message summaries, and drafts across all conversations on the current client, removing them from the active paginated conversation list. This method accepts no parameters. Code example import hideAllConversations from '@/uni modules/unix openim sdk' await hideAllConversations Return value The Promise resolves with void upon successful completion. State changes after the call Promise resolution indicates that local conversation visibility flags were reset. This call does not delete local message records or server side messages, nor does it affect friendships, group memberships, or conversation state on other devices. When new messages arrive for any of these conversations, they will reappear in the active list. After the call resolves, refresh your UI by re querying the conversation list and total unread count as described in Retrieve conversation list /sdk/uniapp/conversation/retrieving conversations/retrieve conversation list and Get total unread count /sdk/uniapp/conversation/managing conversations/get total unread count .

title: Delete a conversation
description: Delete a conversation entry from the authenticated user’s list while retaining underlying message history.
keywords: sdk uniapp v4 sdk uniapp conversation managing-conversations delete-conversation
content: Invoke deleteConversation to delete a conversation entry from the authenticated user's conversation list while preserving its local message history. Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | conversationID | string | Yes | Identifier of the conversation to delete. | Code example import deleteConversation from '@/uni modules/unix openim sdk' await deleteConversation conversationID Return value The Promise resolves with void upon successful completion. State changes after the call Promise resolution indicates that the conversation record was deleted locally and remotely. Immediately remove the item with matching conversationID from your visible conversation list. This operation does not affect friend status, nor does it quit or dismiss groups. If new incoming or outgoing messages occur for this chat target later, the SDK regenerates the conversation record. For conversation list state synchronization, see Retrieve conversation list /sdk/uniapp/conversation/retrieving conversations/retrieve conversation list .

title: Delete a conversation with messages
description: Permanently remove a conversation entry and all its locally stored messages for the authenticated user.
keywords: sdk uniapp v4 sdk uniapp conversation managing-conversations delete-conversation-with-messages
content: Invoke deleteConversationAndDeleteAllMsg to permanently delete a conversation record and all messages stored locally for that conversation by the current account. Once executed, the SDK cannot recover these purged messages from local database storage. Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | conversationID | string | Yes | Identifier of the target conversation. | Code example import deleteConversationAndDeleteAllMsg from '@/uni modules/unix openim sdk' await deleteConversationAndDeleteAllMsg conversationID If you only want to remove the conversation list entry while preserving local message records, use Delete a conversation /sdk/uniapp/conversation/managing conversations/delete conversation . Return value The Promise resolves with void upon successful completion. State changes after the call Upon Promise resolution, remove the conversation item and its cached messages from local view models using conversationID as the key. This operation does not remove friend relations, quit groups, or modify data on other users' devices. If necessary, re query the conversation list as described in Retrieve conversation list /sdk/uniapp/conversation/retrieving conversations/retrieve conversation list to calibrate state.

title: Clear conversation messages
description: Retain the conversation entry while clearing all stored messages and message summaries for the authenticated account.
keywords: sdk uniapp v4 sdk uniapp conversation managing-conversations clear-conversation-messages
content: Invoke clearConversationAndDeleteAllMsg to retain the conversation entry in the list while wiping all locally stored messages and message summaries for the current account. Once executed, the SDK cannot recover these deleted messages from local storage. Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | conversationID | string | Yes | Identifier of the target conversation. | Code example import clearConversationAndDeleteAllMsg from '@/uni modules/unix openim sdk' await clearConversationAndDeleteAllMsg conversationID To remove both the conversation record and its messages simultaneously, see Delete conversation with messages /sdk/uniapp/conversation/managing conversations/delete conversation with messages . Return value The Promise resolves with void upon successful completion. State changes after the call Upon Promise resolution, immediately empty the active chat message view model. The SDK then emits onConversationChanged , where you should update the conversation's latestMsg , latestMsgSendTime , and unread indicators using conversationID as the primary key. For the centralized conversation list listener, see Retrieve conversation list /sdk/uniapp/conversation/retrieving conversations/retrieve conversation list .

title: Conversation group overview
description: Understand conversation group models, capabilities, and event synchronization workflows.
keywords: sdk uniapp v4 sdk uniapp conversation managing-conversation-groups overview-conversation-groups
content: Conversation groups tabs / custom categories are a Commercial Edition feature used to organize the authenticated user's conversation list into segmented categories such as "Work", "Unread", or "Follow up". A conversation group manages the mapping between a category and a collection of conversationID entries; it does not create chat groups, invite members, or change message destinations. Group types Creating and querying conversation groups use different enums and values: | Enum value | Numeric value | Description | | | | | | OpenIMConversationGroupTypeNormal | 0 | Standard custom conversation group created and managed by the user corresponds to OpenIMConversationGroupQueryTypeNormal during queries . | | OpenIMConversationGroupTypeFilter | 1 | Filtered group maintained by server or SDK rules corresponds to OpenIMConversationGroupQueryTypeFilter during queries . | | OpenIMConversationGroupQueryTypeAll | 2 | Used strictly when querying all group types; cannot be passed when creating groups. | When creating a group, conversationGroupType accepts 0 | 1 ; when querying groups, pass 0 | 1 | 2 . Filtered group rules depend on your server deployment; do not fabricate synthetic system groups on the client based solely on name strings. Group data fields The OpenIMConversationGroupItem structure represents a conversation category. Fields may be null; always check for existence before accessing, and use conversationGroupID as the stable merge key: | Field | Type | Description | | | | | | conversationGroupID | string \| null | Unique identifier of the conversation group. | | name | string \| null | Display name of the group. | | order | number \| null | Sequence order index;
