sorting criteria is defined by application convention. | | conversationGroupType | OpenIMConversationGroupQueryType \| null | Conversation group category type. | | hidden | boolean \| null | Whether the group tab is hidden. | | unreadCount | number \| null | Aggregate unread count across all conversations within this group at query time. | | conversationIDs | string \| null | Array of conversation IDs currently assigned to this group. | | createTime | number \| null | Creation timestamp in Unix milliseconds. | | ex | string \| null | Custom application extension string. | Available operations Create a conversation group /sdk/uniapp/conversation/managing conversation groups/create conversation group Get conversation groups /sdk/uniapp/conversation/managing conversation groups/get conversation groups Get conversations in a group /sdk/uniapp/conversation/managing conversation groups/get conversation group info with conversations Get groups for a conversation /sdk/uniapp/conversation/managing conversation groups/get conversation group ids by conversation id Update a conversation group /sdk/uniapp/conversation/managing conversation groups/update conversation group Reorder conversation groups /sdk/uniapp/conversation/managing conversation groups/set conversation group order Add conversations to groups /sdk/uniapp/conversation/managing conversation groups/add conversations to groups Remove conversations from groups /sdk/uniapp/conversation/managing conversation groups/remove conversations from groups Delete a conversation group /sdk/uniapp/conversation/managing conversation groups/delete conversation group Listen for group changes Subscribe centrally to the five conversation group lifecycle events. All five callbacks receive a string signal payload. Treat these events as invalidation triggers to re query the latest group data and merge updates using conversationGroupID . import off, onConversationGroupAdded, onConversationGroupChanged, onConversationGroupDeleted, onConversationGroupMemberAdded, onConversationGroupMemberDeleted, from '@/uni modules/unix openim sdk' const handleConversationGroupRefresh = payload: string = reloadConversationGroups const groupAddedSubscription = onConversationGroupAdded handleConversationGroupRefresh, const groupChangedSubscription = onConversationGroupChanged handleConversationGroupRefresh, const groupDeletedSubscription = onConversationGroupDeleted handleConversationGroupRefresh, const groupMemberAddedSubscription = onConversationGroupMemberAdded handleConversationGroupRefresh, const groupMemberDeletedSubscription = onConversationGroupMemberDeleted handleConversationGroupRefresh, function removeConversationGroupListeners off groupAddedSubscription off groupChangedSubscription off groupDeletedSubscription off groupMemberAddedSubscription off groupMemberDeletedSubscription Debounce or coalesce query requests triggered by these events to avoid redundant database lookups under burst event conditions. Unregister the listeners when unmounting components, logging out, or destroying the conversation group state controller.

title: Create a conversation group
description: Create a new conversation group and optionally assign an initial conversation to it.
keywords: sdk uniapp v4 sdk uniapp conversation managing-conversation-groups create-conversation-group
content: Creating conversation groups is a Commercial Edition capability. When creating a custom group, supply the group name, order index, and group type. To associate an initial conversation with the new group immediately upon creation, supply conversationID . Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | name | string | Yes | Name of the conversation group. | | order | number | Yes | Sequence order index used for tab or list sorting. | | conversationGroupType | OpenIMConversationGroupType | Yes | Use OpenIMConversationGroupTypeNormal for custom user groups, or OpenIMConversationGroupTypeFilter for rule filtered groups. | | conversationID | string \| null | No | Identifier of a conversation to add to the group immediately upon creation. | | ex | string \| null | No | Custom application defined extension string. | Code example import OpenIMConversationGroupTypeNormal, createConversationGroup, from '@/uni modules/unix openim sdk' const result = await createConversationGroup name: 'Work', order: 100, conversationGroupType: OpenIMConversationGroupTypeNormal, conversationID, const group = result?.conversationGroup Return value The Promise resolves with an OpenIMCreateConversationGroupResult | null object. The newly created group item is located in conversationGroup OpenIMConversationGroupItem . State changes after the call Upon Promise resolution, insert or update the conversation group in your local view models using conversationGroupID as the merge key. When group events arrive or upon reconnecting, re query the full group list to calibrate state as shown in Conversation group overview /sdk/uniapp/conversation/managing conversation groups/overview conversation groups .

title: Get conversation groups
description: Query the authenticated user’s conversation groups filtered by group type.
keywords: sdk uniapp v4 sdk uniapp conversation managing-conversation-groups get-conversation-groups
content: Querying conversation groups is a Commercial Edition capability. Filter conversation groups by passing conversationGroupType : use OpenIMConversationGroupQueryTypeNormal for custom user groups, OpenIMConversationGroupQueryTypeFilter for rule filtered groups, or OpenIMConversationGroupQueryTypeAll to retrieve all groups. Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | conversationGroupType | OpenIMConversationGroupQueryType | Yes | Query filter: OpenIMConversationGroupQueryTypeNormal 0 , OpenIMConversationGroupQueryTypeFilter 1 , or OpenIMConversationGroupQueryTypeAll 2 . | Code example import OpenIMConversationGroupQueryTypeAll, getConversationGroups, from '@/uni modules/unix openim sdk' const result = await getConversationGroups conversationGroupType: OpenIMConversationGroupQueryTypeAll, const groups = result?.conversationGroups ?? Return value The Promise resolves with an OpenIMGetConversationGroupsResult | null object. The returned categories are stored in conversationGroups OpenIMConversationGroupItem . Process only items with a non null conversationGroupID , using it as the stable merge key. For property definitions, see Conversation group overview /sdk/uniapp/conversation/managing conversation groups/overview conversation groups . State changes after the call This call returns a point in time snapshot of locally synchronized groups and does not trigger events. When conversation group update events arrive, re query the list and merge group state by conversationGroupID as documented in Conversation group overview /sdk/uniapp/conversation/managing conversation groups/overview conversation groups .

title: Get conversations in a group
description: Query detailed metadata and paginated conversation items within a specific conversation group.
keywords: sdk uniapp v4 sdk uniapp conversation managing-conversation-groups get-conversation-group-info-with-conversations
content: Retrieving conversation group details is a Commercial Edition capability. Query a conversation group along with its member conversations using page based pagination. Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | conversationGroupID | string | Yes | Identifier of the target conversation group. | | pagination.pageNumber | number | Yes | Page number starting from 1 . | | pagination.showNumber | number | Yes | Number of conversation items to fetch per page. | Code example import getConversationGroupInfoWithConversations from '@/uni modules/unix openim sdk' const result = await getConversationGroupInfoWithConversations conversationGroupID, pagination: pageNumber: 1, showNumber: 20, , if result = null renderConversationGroup result.conversationGroup, result.conversations, result.ConversationTotal ?? 0, Return value The Promise resolves with an OpenIMConversationGroupInfoWithConversationsResult | null object: | Field | Type | Description | | | | | | conversationGroup | OpenIMConversationGroupItem \| null | Metadata of the requested conversation group. | | ConversationTotal | number \| null | Total count of conversations in this group; note the initial capital letter. | | conversations | OpenIMConversationItem | Array of conversation items for the requested page. | Determine whether pagination is exhausted by comparing the accumulated loaded items against ConversationTotal . State changes after the call This call returns a point in time snapshot and does not trigger events. Merge group metadata using conversationGroupID and conversation items using conversationID . When conversation group events arrive, reset the pagination offset and re query as outlined in Conversation group overview /sdk/uniapp/conversation/managing conversation groups/overview conversation groups .

title: Get groups for a conversation
description: Query all conversation groups associated with a specific conversation ID.
keywords: sdk uniapp v4 sdk uniapp conversation managing-conversation-groups get-conversation-group-ids-by-conversation-id
content: Querying group associations is a Commercial Edition capability. A single conversation can belong to multiple conversation groups simultaneously. Invoke getConversationGroupByConversationID to retrieve the complete list of group objects containing the specified conversation. Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | conversationID | string | Yes | Identifier of the conversation whose group memberships are being queried. | Code example import getConversationGroupByConversationID from '@/uni modules/unix openim sdk' const result = await getConversationGroupByConversationID conversationID, const groups = result?.conversationGroups ?? Ensure conversationID is an OpenIM conversation session ID, not a group chat groupID . When building group ID lists, extract non null conversationGroupID values from the returned items. Return value The Promise resolves with an OpenIMGetConversationGroupByConversationIDResult | null object. The assigned groups are stored in conversationGroups OpenIMConversationGroupItem . State changes after the call This call returns a point in time snapshot and does not trigger events. When conversation group member assignments change, re query the group list and merge results by conversationGroupID as documented in Conversation group overview /sdk/uniapp/conversation/managing conversation groups/overview conversation groups .

title: Update a conversation group
description: Update a conversation group’s name, extension string, or visibility status.
keywords: sdk uniapp v4 sdk uniapp conversation managing-conversation-groups update-conversation-group
content: Updating conversation groups is a Commercial Edition capability. Supply conversationGroupID along with only the specific fields you wish to modify. At least one updatable property must be provided in addition to the identifier. Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | conversationGroupID | string | Yes | Identifier of the conversation group to modify. | | name | string | No | New display name for the group. | | ex | string | No | New complete application extension string. | | hidden | boolean | No | Whether to hide this conversation group tab from display. | Code example import updateConversationGroup from '@/uni modules/unix openim sdk' const result = await updateConversationGroup conversationGroupID, name: 'Priority Work', hidden: false, const updatedGroup = result?.conversationGroup Return value The Promise resolves with an OpenIMUpdateConversationGroupResult | null object. The updated group object is contained in conversationGroup OpenIMConversationGroupItem . State changes after the call Promise resolution indicates that the group was modified. Merge the updated properties into local UI state using conversationGroupID as the key. When onConversationGroupChanged arrives or after reconnecting, re query the group list as described in Conversation group overview /sdk/uniapp/conversation/managing conversation groups/overview conversation groups .

title: Reorder conversation groups
description: Batch update the display sort order indices for multiple conversation groups.
keywords: sdk uniapp v4 sdk uniapp conversation managing-conversation-groups set-conversation-group-order
content: Reordering conversation groups is a Commercial Edition capability. Batch update group display sequences by supplying an array of group identifiers paired with their corresponding sort order values. Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | conversationGroupOrders | OpenIMConversationGroupOrderItem | Yes | Array of group ordering objects. | | conversationGroupOrders .conversationGroupID | string | Yes | Identifier of the conversation group to position. | | conversationGroupOrders .order | number | Yes | Sequence sorting index value. | Code example import setConversationGroupOrder from '@/uni modules/unix openim sdk' await setConversationGroupOrder conversationGroupOrders: conversationGroupID: firstGroupID, order: 100 , conversationGroupID: secondGroupID, order: 200 , , The sorting direction ascending or descending is established by application UI conventions. Return value The Promise resolves with void upon successful completion. State changes after the call Promise resolution indicates that the updated order indices were applied. Immediately re sort your local group tabs using the new order values indexed by conversationGroupID . When group change events arrive, re query the group list to calibrate order as documented in Conversation group overview /sdk/uniapp/conversation/managing conversation groups/overview conversation groups .

title: Add conversations to groups
description: Assign one or more conversations to one or more conversation groups.
keywords: sdk uniapp v4 sdk uniapp conversation managing-conversation-groups add-conversations-to-groups
content: Managing conversation group membership is a Commercial Edition capability. This operation creates an association between the specified conversation IDs and group IDs; it does not generate new conversations or alter chat targets. Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | conversationIDs | string | Yes | Array of OpenIM conversation identifiers to assign. | | conversationGroupIDs | string | Yes | Array of target conversation group identifiers. | Code example import addConversationsToGroups from '@/uni modules/unix openim sdk' await addConversationsToGroups conversationIDs: conversationID , conversationGroupIDs: conversationGroupID , Return value The Promise resolves with void upon successful completion. State changes after the call Promise resolution indicates that the association request succeeded. You can immediately reflect the new group assignment in local UI mappings using conversationGroupID and conversationID . Promise resolution does not guarantee that member change events have reached all client devices. When member update events arrive, re query the affected groups as detailed in Conversation group overview /sdk/uniapp/conversation/managing conversation groups/overview conversation groups .

title: Remove conversations from groups
description: Disassociate one or more conversations from one or more conversation groups.
keywords: sdk uniapp v4 sdk uniapp conversation managing-conversation-groups remove-conversations-from-groups
content: Removing conversations from groups is a Commercial Edition capability. This operation deletes the association between the specified conversation IDs and group IDs; it does not delete conversations or clear messages. Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | conversationIDs | string | Yes | Array of OpenIM conversation identifiers to remove. | | conversationGroupIDs | string | Yes | Array of target conversation group identifiers. | Code example import removeConversationsFromGroups from '@/uni modules/unix openim sdk' await removeConversationsFromGroups conversationIDs: conversationID , conversationGroupIDs: conversationGroupID , Return value The Promise resolves with void upon successful completion. State changes after the call Promise resolution indicates that the disassociation request was processed. You can immediately remove the conversation mapping from local UI state using conversationGroupID and conversationID . When group member update events arrive on this or other connected clients, re query the affected groups as shown in Conversation group overview /sdk/uniapp/conversation/managing conversation groups/overview conversation groups .

title: Delete a conversation group
description: Delete a conversation group and its member associations without affecting conversations or messages.
keywords: sdk uniapp v4 sdk uniapp conversation managing-conversation-groups delete-conversation-group
content: Deleting conversation groups is a Commercial Edition capability. This operation deletes the conversation group and its membership associations; it does not delete member conversations or chat messages. Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | conversationGroupID | string | Yes | Identifier of the conversation group to delete. | Code example import deleteConversationGroup from '@/uni modules/unix openim sdk' await deleteConversationGroup conversationGroupID, The conversationGroupID parameter refers to the conversation category ID, not an OpenIM chat groupID . Return value The Promise resolves with void upon successful completion. State changes after the call Promise resolution indicates that the deletion was committed. Remove the group and its tab views from local state using conversationGroupID as the key. For event listeners and state synchronization upon reconnecting, see Conversation group overview /sdk/uniapp/conversation/managing conversation groups/overview conversation groups .

title: Group overview
description: Understand the relationship between group profiles, member roles, join requests, and group events.
keywords: sdk uniapp v4 sdk uniapp group overview-group
content: OpenIMSDK organizes multi user chats, shared profiles, member rosters, and permissions through groups. When sending group messages, managing group settings, inviting members, and reviewing join applications, supply the groupID . In contrast, the authenticated user's conversation list entry for that group chat is identified by conversationID ; do not conflate the two identifiers. Core data structures | Structure | Purpose | | | | | OpenIMGroupItem | Group name, avatar, announcement, owner, verification mode, member count, and extension fields. | | OpenIMGroupMemberItem | A member's group specific nickname, role level, mute status, and join metadata. | | OpenIMGroupApplicationItem | A group join application along with its current review status. | Group member role levels are evaluated using OpenIMGroupMemberRoleNormal , OpenIMGroupMemberRoleAdmin , and OpenIMGroupMemberRoleOwner . While the client can conditionally reveal management actions based on role, OpenIMServer authoritative verification always enforces final permissions. Group profile fields The OpenIMGroupItem structure contains the following core fields: | Field | Type | Description | | | | | | groupID | string | The persistent group identifier; serves as the merge key for group events. | | groupName | string | Display name of the group. | | faceURL | string | Avatar image URL for the group. | | notification | string | Group announcement text. | | introduction | string | Group description text. | | ownerUserID | string | The user ID of the current group owner. | | creatorUserID | string | The user ID of the member who created the group. | | memberCount | number | Member count at the time of query. | | groupType | OpenIMGroupType | Group type; standard working groups use OpenIMGroupTypeWorkingGroup . | | needVerification | OpenIMGroupVerificationType | Group join verification policy. | | lookMemberInfo | OpenIMGroupAllowType | Whether members are permitted to view fellow member profiles. | | applyMemberFriend | OpenIMGroupAllowType | Whether members are permitted to send friend requests to fellow members. | | notificationUpdateTime | number | Announcement update timestamp in Unix milliseconds. | | notificationUserID | string | User ID of the member who last updated the announcement. | | createTime | number | Group creation timestamp in Unix milliseconds. | | status | OpenIMGroupStatus | Group operational state OpenIMGroupStatusNormal , OpenIMGroupStatusBanned , OpenIMGroupStatusDismissed , OpenIMGroupStatusMuted . | | ex | string | Custom group extension string. | | attachedInfo | string | Internal SDK metadata. | | displayIsRead Commercial | boolean \| null | Server configuration controlling read receipt visibility; read only from the client. | Group configuration guides Create a group /sdk/uniapp/group/create group Update group profile /sdk/uniapp/group/update group profile Set group announcement /sdk/uniapp/group/set group announcement Set group extension data /sdk/uniapp/group/set group extension Set group join verification /sdk/uniapp/group/set group join verification Set member profile access /sdk/uniapp/group/set group member profile access Set member friend request permissions /sdk/uniapp/group/set group member friend permission Mute or unmute a group /sdk/uniapp/group/change group mute Group membership and queries Join a group /sdk/uniapp/group/join group Quit a group /sdk/uniapp/group/quit group Dismiss a group /sdk/uniapp/group/dismiss group Get specified group profiles /sdk/uniapp/group/retrieving groups/get specified groups info Get joined groups /sdk/uniapp/group/retrieving groups/get joined group list Get joined groups with pagination /sdk/uniapp/group/retrieving groups/get joined group list page Check group membership /sdk/uniapp/group/retrieving groups/is join group Search joined groups /sdk/uniapp/group/retrieving groups/search groups Group join applications Get received group applications /sdk/uniapp/group/group applications/get group application list as recipient Get sent group applications /sdk/uniapp/group/group applications/get group application list as applicant Get unhandled group application count /sdk/uniapp/group/group applications/get group application unhandled count Accept a group application /sdk/uniapp/group/group applications/accept group application Reject a group application /sdk/uniapp/group/group applications/refuse group application Group members Get group member list /sdk/uniapp/group/retrieving group members/get group member list Get specified group member info /sdk/uniapp/group/retrieving group members/get specified group members info Get user group membership /sdk/uniapp/group/retrieving group members/get users in group Search group members /sdk/uniapp/group/retrieving group members/search group members Invite users to a group /sdk/uniapp/group/managing group members/invite user to group Kick a group member /sdk/uniapp/group/managing group members/kick group member Set group member nickname /sdk/uniapp/group/managing group members/set group member nickname Set group member role level /sdk/uniapp/group/managing group members/set group member role level Set group member avatar /sdk/uniapp/group/managing group members/set group member avatar Set group member extension data /sdk/uniapp/group/managing group members/set group member extension Transfer group ownership /sdk/uniapp/group/managing group members/transfer group owner Mute or unmute a group member /sdk/uniapp/group/managing group members/change group member mute Monitor group updates Group profile changes, join/leave transitions, and group dismissal events are centrally monitored here. The callback handlers receive an OpenIMGroupItem | null object; when non null, update your cached records by matching groupID : import OpenIMGroupItem, off, onGroupDismissed, onGroupInfoChanged, onJoinedGroupAdded, onJoinedGroupDeleted, from '@/uni modules/unix openim sdk' const handleGroupChanged = group: OpenIMGroupItem | null = if group == null return mergeGroup group const handleJoinedGroupDeleted = group: OpenIMGroupItem | null = if group == null return removeJoinedGroup group.groupID const handleGroupDismissed = group: OpenIMGroupItem | null = if group == null return markGroupDismissed group.groupID const joinedGroupAddedSubscription = onJoinedGroupAdded handleGroupChanged const joinedGroupDeletedSubscription = onJoinedGroupDeleted handleJoinedGroupDeleted, const groupInfoChangedSubscription = onGroupInfoChanged handleGroupChanged const groupDismissedSubscription = onGroupDismissed handleGroupDismissed function removeGroupListeners off joinedGroupAddedSubscription off joinedGroupDeletedSubscription off groupInfoChangedSubscription off groupDismissedSubscription Unsubscribe from these listeners when logging out, switching user accounts, or tearing down the group store. Promise resolution, event delivery, and state re queries represent distinct phases; when addition or removal events occur during pagination, reset the offset and reload the list.

title: Create a group
description: Create a new group and configure initial administrators and regular members.
keywords: sdk uniapp v4 sdk uniapp group create-group
content: Invoke createGroup to initialize a new group with specified profile data, regular members, and optional initial administrators. You cannot explicitly designate an arbitrary owner during creation; OpenIMServer automatically sets the creator as the group owner ownerUserID . Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | groupInfo | OpenIMCreateGroupInfo | Yes | Initial group profile configuration object. | | groupInfo.groupName | string | Yes | Display name of the new group. | | groupInfo.groupType | OpenIMGroupType | Yes | Group type constant; pass OpenIMGroupTypeWorkingGroup for standard working groups. | | groupInfo.notification | string | No | Initial group announcement string. | | groupInfo.introduction | string | No | Initial group introduction or description. | | groupInfo.faceURL | string | No | Avatar image URL for the group. | | groupInfo.ex | string | No | Custom group extension string. | | memberUserIDs | string | Yes | Array of user IDs to add as initial regular members. | | adminUserIDs | string | No | Array of user IDs to designate as initial administrators. | Deduplicate both user ID arrays and ensure there is no overlap between memberUserIDs and adminUserIDs . Code example import OpenIMGroupTypeWorkingGroup, createGroup, from '@/uni modules/unix openim sdk' const group = await createGroup groupInfo: groupName: 'Project Discussion Group', groupType: OpenIMGroupTypeWorkingGroup, faceURL: 'https://example.com/group.png', , memberUserIDs: 'user 003', 'user 004' , adminUserIDs: 'user 002' , if group = null openGroupPage group.groupID Return value The Promise resolves with an OpenIMGroupItem | null object containing the newly created group record. A non null return value provides the new groupID and initial metadata. State changes after the call A resolved Promise confirms that the group was created on OpenIMServer. The active user's joined group roster is updated via the onJoinedGroupAdded event using groupID . For complete group event listener registration, see Group overview /sdk/uniapp/group/overview group .

title: Update group profile
description: Update group display properties including group name, introduction, and avatar URL.
keywords: sdk uniapp v4 sdk uniapp group update-group-profile
content: Invoke setGroupInfo to modify primary display metadata for a group. Pass only the properties being updated; announcements, verification settings, and member permissions should be managed through their dedicated APIs. Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | groupID | string | Yes | The ID of the target group. | | groupName | string | No | New display name for the group. | | introduction | string | No | New introduction or description for the group. | | faceURL | string | No | New avatar URL for the group. | Supply at least one modification field in addition to groupID . Code example import setGroupInfo from '@/uni modules/unix openim sdk' await setGroupInfo groupID, groupName: groupName.trim , introduction: introduction.trim , faceURL, Return value The Promise resolves with void once OpenIMServer updates the group profile. State changes after the call A resolved Promise confirms that the profile update was accepted by the server. Update the local group record optimistically, then confirm final state when onGroupInfoChanged arrives matching groupID . To calibrate state immediately, invoke Get specified group profiles /sdk/uniapp/group/retrieving groups/get specified groups info . For complete group event listener registration, see Group overview /sdk/uniapp/group/overview group .

title: Set group announcement
description: Publish, update, or clear group announcement text.
keywords: sdk uniapp v4 sdk uniapp group set-group-announcement
content: The notification property represents the group announcement, distinct from the introduction description field. While clients can conditionally reveal the edit interface based on member role, OpenIMServer authoritative verification always enforces modification permissions. Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | groupID | string | Yes | Target group identifier. | | notification | string | Yes | New group announcement text; pass an empty string to clear the announcement. | Code example import setGroupInfo from '@/uni modules/unix openim sdk' await setGroupInfo groupID, notification: announcement.trim , Return value The Promise resolves with void once OpenIMServer updates the group announcement. State changes after the call A resolved Promise confirms that the announcement was accepted. Connected clients receive onGroupInfoChanged , at which point the UI updates the announcement matching groupID . To calibrate state, invoke Get specified group profiles /sdk/uniapp/group/retrieving groups/get specified groups info . For complete group event listener registration, see Group overview /sdk/uniapp/group/overview group .

title: Set group extension data
description: Store custom application-level extension strings on a specified group.
keywords: sdk uniapp v4 sdk uniapp group set-group-extension
content: The ex property stores an opaque string; the SDK does not perform automatic JSON merging. When multiple application modules share this attribute, structure namespaces carefully and retain other fields before writing. Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | groupID | string | Yes | Target group identifier. | | ex | string | Yes | Custom extension string; completely overwrites existing group extension data. | Code example import setGroupInfo from '@/uni modules/unix openim sdk' await setGroupInfo groupID, ex: JSON.stringify projectID: 'project 42' , If the group already contains extension data, retrieve the current value, merge changes within your application layer, and submit the entire serialized string. Return value The Promise resolves with void once OpenIMServer updates the group extension data. State changes after the call A resolved Promise confirms that the extension string was saved. Update the local group's ex field optimistically, and confirm final state when onGroupInfoChanged arrives matching groupID . For complete group event listener registration, see Group overview /sdk/uniapp/group/overview group .

title: Set group join verification
description: Configure approval policies for user join requests and member invitations.
keywords: sdk uniapp v4 sdk uniapp group set-group-join-verification
content: The needVerification property configures the group's admission policy using OpenIMGroupVerificationType . Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | groupID | string | Yes | Target group identifier. | | needVerification | OpenIMGroupVerificationType | Yes | The admission verification policy constant. | | Enum constant | Numeric value | Description | | | | | | OpenIMGroupVerificationTypeApplyNeedInviteNot | 0 | Join requests require admin review; member invitations add contacts immediately. | | OpenIMGroupVerificationTypeAllNeed | 1 | Both join requests and invitations by regular members require approval; owner and admin invitations join directly. | | OpenIMGroupVerificationTypeAllNot | 2 | Anyone can join or be invited without approval. | Code example import OpenIMGroupVerificationTypeAllNeed, setGroupInfo, from '@/uni modules/unix openim sdk' await setGroupInfo groupID, needVerification: OpenIMGroupVerificationTypeAllNeed, Return value The Promise resolves with void once OpenIMServer updates the verification mode. State changes after the call A resolved Promise confirms that the verification setting was saved. Update the local group's needVerification field optimistically, and confirm final state when onGroupInfoChanged arrives matching groupID . For complete group event listener registration, see Group overview /sdk/uniapp/group/overview group .

title: Set member profile access
description: Control whether group members are permitted to view fellow member profiles.
keywords: sdk uniapp v4 sdk uniapp group set-group-member-profile-access
content: The lookMemberInfo property configures member profile visibility using OpenIMGroupAllowType . Note the numeric definitions for this enum: Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | groupID | string | Yes | Target group identifier. | | lookMemberInfo | OpenIMGroupAllowType | Yes | Member profile access permission constant. | | Enum constant | Numeric value | Description | | | | | | OpenIMGroupAllowTypeAllowed | 0 | Members are permitted to view fellow member profiles. | | OpenIMGroupAllowTypeNotAllowed | 1 | Members are not permitted to view fellow member profiles. | Code example import OpenIMGroupAllowTypeNotAllowed, setGroupInfo, from '@/uni modules/unix openim sdk' await setGroupInfo groupID, lookMemberInfo: OpenIMGroupAllowTypeNotAllowed, Return value The Promise resolves with void once OpenIMServer updates the permission. State changes after the call A resolved Promise confirms that the setting was saved. Update the local group's lookMemberInfo field optimistically, and confirm final state when onGroupInfoChanged arrives matching groupID . This setting is independent of whether members can add each other as friends. For complete group event listener registration, see Group overview /sdk/uniapp/group/overview group .

title: Set member friend request permissions
description: Control whether members can send friend requests to fellow group members.
keywords: sdk uniapp v4 sdk uniapp group set-group-member-friend-permission
content: The applyMemberFriend property configures whether group members can send friend requests to each other using OpenIMGroupAllowType . Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | groupID | string | Yes | Target group identifier. | | applyMemberFriend | OpenIMGroupAllowType | Yes | Friend request permission constant. | | Enum constant | Numeric value | Description | | | | | | OpenIMGroupAllowTypeAllowed | 0 | Members are permitted to initiate friend requests from the group roster. | | OpenIMGroupAllowTypeNotAllowed | 1 | Members are not permitted to initiate friend requests from the group roster. | Code example import OpenIMGroupAllowTypeNotAllowed, setGroupInfo, from '@/uni modules/unix openim sdk' await setGroupInfo groupID, applyMemberFriend: OpenIMGroupAllowTypeNotAllowed, Return value The Promise resolves with void once OpenIMServer updates the permission. State changes after the call A resolved Promise confirms that the setting was saved. Update the local group's applyMemberFriend field optimistically, and confirm final state when onGroupInfoChanged arrives matching groupID . This field controls only friendship request initiation within the group; it does not block viewing profiles or affect existing friendships. For complete group event listener registration, see Group overview /sdk/uniapp/group/overview group .

title: Mute or unmute a group
description: Enable or disable group-wide mute to restrict regular members from sending messages.
keywords: sdk uniapp v4 sdk uniapp group change-group-mute
content: Invoke changeGroupMute as a group owner or administrator to enable or disable group wide mute. Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | groupID | string | Yes | Target group identifier. | | isMute | boolean | Yes | Set to true to mute all regular members; set to false to lift the mute. | Setting isMute to true mutes regular members; the owner and administrators typically retain speaking permissions based on server rules. This method accepts only groupID and isMute , and does not support an exception list. Code example import changeGroupMute from '@/uni modules/unix openim sdk' await changeGroupMute groupID, isMute: true, Return value The Promise resolves with void once OpenIMServer updates the group mute setting. State changes after the call A resolved Promise confirms that the request completed on the server. Update the local group's mute state optimistically, then confirm final state when onGroupInfoChanged arrives matching groupID . To calibrate state, invoke Get specified group profiles /sdk/uniapp/group/retrieving groups/get specified groups info . For complete group event listener registration, see Group overview /sdk/uniapp/group/overview group .

title: Join a group
description: Submit an application to join a group, or join directly if verification is disabled.
keywords: sdk uniapp v4 sdk uniapp group join-group
content: Invoke joinGroup to request membership in a specified group. Whether approval is required depends on the group's needVerification setting, while joinSource records how the user discovered and joined the group. Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | groupID | string | Yes | Target group identifier. | | reqMsg | string | Yes | Application greeting or note; pass an empty string if omitted. | | joinSource | OpenIMGroupJoinSource | Yes | Channel through which the user joined or applied. | | ex | string | No | Optional business extension string. | | Enum constant | Numeric value | Description | | | | | | OpenIMGroupJoinSourceAdmin | 1 | Added by an administrator; typically reserved for administrative workflows. | | OpenIMGroupJoinSourceInvitation | 2 | Joined via direct invitation. | | OpenIMGroupJoinSourceSearch | 3 | Joined via group search. | | OpenIMGroupJoinSourceQRCode | 4 | Joined by scanning a group QR code. | Code example import OpenIMGroupJoinSourceSearch, joinGroup, from '@/uni modules/unix openim sdk' await joinGroup groupID: groupID, reqMsg: 'Requesting to join the project team', joinSource: OpenIMGroupJoinSourceSearch, Return value The Promise resolves with void once the join request is submitted to OpenIMServer. State changes after the call A resolved Promise confirms that the request reached the server. If the group enforces verification, resolution does not mean the user is an active member; membership is established only after an administrator approves the application. When approved, the client receives onJoinedGroupAdded and adds the group indexed by groupID to its joined group list. For event handling, see Group overview /sdk/uniapp/group/overview group . Even if verification is disabled, rely on incoming events or re querying Check group membership /sdk/uniapp/group/retrieving groups/is join group to confirm membership before unlocking messaging features.

title: Quit a group
description: Leave a group in which the authenticated user is currently a member.
keywords: sdk uniapp v4 sdk uniapp group quit-group
content: Invoke quitGroup to leave an active group as a regular member or administrator. The group owner cannot leave the group directly; they must transfer ownership to another member using Transfer group ownership /sdk/uniapp/group/managing group members/transfer group owner before exiting. Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | groupID | string | Yes | The ID of the group to leave. | Code example import quitGroup from '@/uni modules/unix openim sdk' await quitGroup groupID Return value The Promise resolves with void once OpenIMServer processes the departure request. State changes after the call A resolved Promise confirms that the exit request completed. The client removes the group from its joined group list using groupID , confirming removal when onJoinedGroupDeleted arrives. For complete group event listener registration, see Group overview /sdk/uniapp/group/overview group . Leaving a group does not automatically delete or hide local conversation records. The conversation entry may remain in the history list; do not infer active group membership from conversation existence alone.

title: Dismiss a group
description: Disband and permanently dismiss a specified group as the group owner.
keywords: sdk uniapp v4 sdk uniapp group dismiss-group
content: Invoke dismissGroup as the group owner to disband a group permanently. Dismissing a group terminates the group for all members, which differs from an individual member quitting, or deleting/hiding a conversation. Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | groupID | string | Yes | The ID of the group to dismiss. | Code example import dismissGroup from '@/uni modules/unix openim sdk' await dismissGroup groupID Return value The Promise resolves with void once OpenIMServer accepts the dismissal request. State changes after the call A resolved Promise confirms that the disband request was accepted. Connected clients receive onGroupDismissed , at which point the UI marks the group indexed by groupID as dismissed, disabling message input and membership actions. For group event handling, see Group overview /sdk/uniapp/group/overview group . Conversation retention policies belong to the conversation domain; the group dismissal handler should not unilaterally purge local conversation history.

title: Get specified group profiles
description: Batch query group metadata for targeted groups by group ID.
keywords: sdk uniapp v4 sdk uniapp group retrieving-groups get-specified-groups-info
content: Invoke getSpecifiedGroupsInfo to batch retrieve latest group metadata for known group IDs. This method queries existing group profiles; it is not a discovery directory for browsing unfamiliar public groups. Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | groupIDs | string | Yes | An array of group IDs to query. | When querying a single group, wrap the groupID in a single element array. Code example import getSpecifiedGroupsInfo from '@/uni modules/unix openim sdk' const result = await getSpecifiedGroupsInfo groupIDs const groups = result = null ? result.groups : Return value The Promise resolves with an OpenIMGroupListResult | null object containing an array of OpenIMGroupItem elements in groups . Returned elements are not guaranteed to match the array order of groupIDs ; match records using groupID . For field definitions, see Group overview /sdk/uniapp/group/overview group . State changes after the call This query retrieves a local snapshot without modifying data or triggering events. While views are active, observe subsequent updates through onGroupInfoChanged as described in Group overview /sdk/uniapp/group/overview group . Re query after network reconnections to verify current values.

title: Get joined groups
description: Retrieve the complete list of groups joined by the authenticated user.
keywords: sdk uniapp v4 sdk uniapp group retrieving-groups get-joined-group-list
content: When the authenticated user belongs to a moderate number of groups, invoke getJoinedGroupList without parameters to load the joined group collection directly. Code example import getJoinedGroupList from '@/uni modules/unix openim sdk' const result = await getJoinedGroupList const groups = result = null ? result.groups : Return value The Promise resolves with an OpenIMGroupListResult | null object containing an array of OpenIMGroupItem elements in groups . Maintain your local group cache by matching groupID . For primary group fields, see Group overview /sdk/uniapp/group/overview group . State changes after the call For accounts with large group rosters, use Get joined groups with pagination /sdk/uniapp/group/retrieving groups/get joined group list page to avoid loading all records into memory at once. This query retrieves an initial snapshot without modifying data or triggering events; subsequent additions, departures, and profile changes are delivered via events documented in Group overview /sdk/uniapp/group/overview group .

title: Get joined groups with pagination
description: Query groups joined by the authenticated user with pagination support.
keywords: sdk uniapp v4 sdk uniapp group retrieving-groups get-joined-group-list-page
content: Invoke getJoinedGroupListPage to query joined groups with pagination, ideal for contact books or group selector views with large group memberships. Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | offset | number | Yes | Pagination starting offset; pass 0 for the first page. | | count | number | Yes | Number of groups to fetch in this page. | Code example import getJoinedGroupListPage from '@/uni modules/unix openim sdk' const result = await getJoinedGroupListPage offset: 0, count: 50, const groups = result = null ? result.groups : Return value The Promise resolves with an OpenIMGroupListResult | null object. When non null, groups contains OpenIMGroupItem objects for the requested page. Deduplicate and merge records into your view models using groupID . This response does not return total count or cursor tokens; when the returned array contains fewer elements than count , you have reached the end of the list. When loading subsequent pages, increment offset by the fixed count of queried records rather than the active UI list length. For group structure fields, see Group overview /sdk/uniapp/group/overview group . State changes after the call This is a read only query that establishes a local snapshot. If group join or quit events arrive during active paging, reset the pagination offset and reload from the beginning as described in Group overview /sdk/uniapp/group/overview group .

title: Check group membership
description: Verify whether the authenticated user has joined a specified group.
keywords: sdk uniapp v4 sdk uniapp group retrieving-groups is-join-group
content: Invoke isJoinGroup to quickly verify whether the authenticated user is an active member of a specified group before displaying group actions or unlocking messaging interfaces. Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | groupID | string | Yes | Target group identifier. | Code example import isJoinGroup from '@/uni modules/unix openim sdk' const joined = await isJoinGroup groupID if joined == true showGroupMemberActions Return value The Promise resolves with a boolean | null value: true indicates the user is a member, while false indicates non membership. Do not treat null as confirmed membership. State changes after the call This is a local snapshot check that does not emit events. Maintain live membership state across screens by monitoring group addition, quit, and dismissal events indexed by groupID as documented in Group overview /sdk/uniapp/group/overview group . Re query after network recovery to calibrate.

title: Search joined groups
description: Search groups joined by the authenticated user and persisted locally.
keywords: sdk uniapp v4 sdk uniapp group retrieving-groups search-groups
content: Invoke searchGroups to search through the authenticated user's joined groups cached in the local database by matching group names or group IDs. The SDK utilizes the first non empty keyword in keywordList ; this API does not search across unjoined public groups. Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | keywordList | string | Yes | An array of search strings. Supply a trimmed, non empty keyword. | | isSearchGroupID | boolean | Yes | Whether to match against groupID . | | isSearchGroupName | boolean | Yes | Whether to match against group display names. | Code example import searchGroups from '@/uni modules/unix openim sdk' const result = await searchGroups keywordList: keyword.trim , isSearchGroupID: true, isSearchGroupName: true, const groups = result = null ? result.groups : Return value The Promise resolves with an OpenIMGroupListResult | null object containing an array of matched OpenIMGroupItem elements in groups . Render these matches as an independent search result set keyed by groupID ; do not overwrite your full joined group cache. State changes after the call This is a local read only query that does not emit events. To search across public server directories or perform category filtering, execute queries through your application backend services.

title: Get received group applications
description: Query group join applications that the authenticated user has authority to review.
keywords: sdk uniapp v4 sdk uniapp group group-applications get-group-application-list-as-recipient
content: Group owners and administrators invoke getGroupApplicationListAsRecipient to query incoming join applications requiring review or previously handled. This API provides offset based pagination; it does not filter by groupID or review outcome. Parameters The parameters object can be omitted. When paginating, supply the following fields: | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | offset | number | No | Pagination offset index; pass 0 for the first page. | | count | number | No | Number of application records to fetch. | Code example import getGroupApplicationListAsRecipient, from '@/uni modules/unix openim sdk' const result = await getGroupApplicationListAsRecipient offset: 0, count: 20, const applications = result = null ? result.applications : Return value The Promise resolves with an OpenIMGroupApplicationListResult | null object containing OpenIMGroupApplicationItem elements in applications . Group application fields | Field | Type | Description | | | | | | groupID | string | Target group identifier. | | userID | string | Applicant user ID; forms a composite key with groupID . | | nickname | string | Applicant nickname preserved in the application log. | | userFaceURL | string | Applicant avatar URL preserved in the application log. | | reqMsg | string | Join application greeting or justification text. | | reqTime | number | Application timestamp in Unix milliseconds. | | joinSource | OpenIMGroupJoinSource | How the applicant requested to join. | | inviterUserID | string | User ID of the inviter; empty for direct self applications. | | handleResult | OpenIMApplicationHandleResult | Review status: OpenIMApplicationHandleResultUnprocessed pending , OpenIMApplicationHandleResultAccepted approved , or OpenIMApplicationHandleResultRejected declined . | | handleUserID | string | User ID of the administrator who handled the request. | | handledMsg | string | Reviewer notes or explanation. | | handledTime | number | Processing timestamp; invalid while pending. | | groupName | string | Group name preserved in the application log. | | groupFaceURL | string | Group avatar preserved in the application log. | | groupType | OpenIMGroupType \| null | Group type code. | | ownerUserID | string | Group owner user ID. | | creatorUserID | string | Group creator user ID. | | introduction | string | Group description preserved in the record. | | notification | string | Group announcement preserved in the record. | | memberCount | number | Group member count preserved in the record. | | status | OpenIMGroupStatus | Group status preserved in the record. | | createTime | number | Application record creation timestamp in Unix milliseconds. | | ex | string | Custom extension string. | | attachedInfo | string | SDK internal metadata. | Fields stored on application records represent point in time snapshots. When current user or group data is required, query those entities through their dedicated APIs. Monitor group application updates Group join application events and badge updates are centrally managed here. Application events return OpenIMGroupApplicationItem | null objects merged by groupID:userID ; the badge event returns the total pending count: import OpenIMGroupApplicationItem, off, onGroupApplicationAccepted, onGroupApplicationAdded, onGroupApplicationBadgeCountChanged, onGroupApplicationDeleted, onGroupApplicationRejected, from '@/uni modules/unix openim sdk' const mergeApplication = application: OpenIMGroupApplicationItem | null = if application == null return mergeGroupApplication application const deleteApplication = application: OpenIMGroupApplicationItem | null = if application == null return removeGroupApplication application.groupID, application.userID const updateBadge = count: number = setGroupApplicationBadge count const addedSubscription = onGroupApplicationAdded mergeApplication const acceptedSubscription = onGroupApplicationAccepted mergeApplication const rejectedSubscription = onGroupApplicationRejected mergeApplication const deletedSubscription = onGroupApplicationDeleted deleteApplication const badgeSubscription = onGroupApplicationBadgeCountChanged updateBadge function removeGroupApplicationListeners off addedSubscription off acceptedSubscription off rejectedSubscription off deletedSubscription off badgeSubscription If applications change during pagination, reset the offset and reload from the beginning. Unregister these listeners when unmounting views, logging out, or switching user accounts.

title: Get sent group applications
description: Query group join applications submitted by the authenticated user with pagination.
keywords: sdk uniapp v4 sdk uniapp group group-applications get-group-application-list-as-applicant
content: Invoke getGroupApplicationListAsApplicant to retrieve a paginated record of outgoing group join applications submitted by the authenticated user. This API provides offset based pagination; it does not filter by groupID or review outcome. Parameters The parameters object can be omitted. When paginating, supply the following fields: | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | offset | number | No | Pagination offset index; pass 0 for the first page. | | count | number | No | Number of application records to fetch. | Code example import getGroupApplicationListAsApplicant, from '@/uni modules/unix openim sdk' const result = await getGroupApplicationListAsApplicant offset: 0, count: 20, const applications = result = null ? result.applications : Return value The Promise resolves with an OpenIMGroupApplicationListResult | null object containing OpenIMGroupApplicationItem elements in applications . For property definitions, see Get received group applications /sdk/uniapp/group/group applications/get group application list as recipient . State changes after the call This is a read only query that retrieves local snapshot records. When application status changes occur during active paging, merge records using the composite key groupID:userID or reload the query. For full event listener patterns, see Get received group applications /sdk/uniapp/group/group applications/get group application list as recipient .

title: Get unhandled group application count
description: Query the total count of pending group join applications awaiting review.
keywords: sdk uniapp v4 sdk uniapp group group-applications get-group-application-unhandled-count
content: Invoke getGroupApplicationUnhandledCount to retrieve the number of pending group join requests awaiting review, typically used to display badges or notification dots on group administration entry points. Parameters The UTS signature requires offset and count parameters: | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | offset | number | Yes | Pagination offset; pass 0 for initial counts. | | count | number | Yes | Page limit for evaluating records. | Code example import getGroupApplicationUnhandledCount, from '@/uni modules/unix openim sdk' const count = await getGroupApplicationUnhandledCount offset: 0, count: 20, setPendingApplicationCount count = null ? count : 0 Return value The Promise resolves with a number | null indicating the unhandled count. A null return value indicates that no result could be obtained and should not be treated as a confirmed count of zero. State changes after the call This is a read only query that does not modify records or clear badge indicators. To maintain a real time badge count, monitor onGroupApplicationBadgeCountChanged as detailed in Get received group applications /sdk/uniapp/group/group applications/get group application list as recipient .

title: Accept a group application
description: Approve a pending request from a user to join a group.
keywords: sdk uniapp v4 sdk uniapp group group-applications accept-group-application
content: Invoke acceptGroupApplication as a group owner or administrator to approve a pending group join request. Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | groupID | string | Yes | Target group identifier. | | fromUserID | string | Yes | The applicant's user ID matching userID in the application record . | | handleMsg | string | Yes | Approval comment or note; pass an empty string if omitted. | Code example import acceptGroupApplication from '@/uni modules/unix openim sdk' await acceptGroupApplication groupID: application.groupID, fromUserID: application.userID, handleMsg: 'Approved', Return value The Promise resolves with void once OpenIMServer processes the approval. State changes after the call A resolved Promise confirms that the approval was accepted by the server. Do not construct member records manually based on Promise resolution. When onGroupApplicationAccepted fires, update the review status of the application record matching groupID:userID . When the member officially enters the group, onGroupMemberAdded arrives to update the active member roster. For complete event registration logic, see Get received group applications /sdk/uniapp/group/group applications/get group application list as recipient .

title: Reject a group application
description: Decline a pending request from a user to join a group.
keywords: sdk uniapp v4 sdk uniapp group group-applications refuse-group-application
content: Invoke refuseGroupApplication as a group owner or administrator to decline a pending group join request. Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | groupID | string | Yes | Target group identifier. | | fromUserID | string | Yes | The applicant's user ID matching userID in the application record . | | handleMsg | string | Yes | Rejection comment or explanation; pass an empty string if omitted. | Code example import refuseGroupApplication from '@/uni modules/unix openim sdk' await refuseGroupApplication groupID: application.groupID, fromUserID: application.userID, handleMsg: 'Application declined at this time', Return value The Promise resolves with void once OpenIMServer processes the rejection. State changes after the call A resolved Promise confirms that the rejection was accepted by OpenIMServer. When onGroupApplicationRejected fires, update the review status of the application record matching groupID:userID . Rejecting a request does not remove the application log from history. For complete event registration logic, see Get received group applications /sdk/uniapp/group/group applications/get group application list as recipient .

title: Delete group applications
description: Batch remove group join application records using composite group and applicant identifiers.
keywords: sdk uniapp v4 sdk uniapp group group-applications delete-group-requests
content: Invoke deleteGroupRequests to delete historical group join applications identified by their composite groupID and fromUserID pairs, ideal for purging processed records from audit lists. Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | groupRequests | OpenIMSimpleGroupRequest | Yes | An array of group application objects to remove. | | groupRequests .groupID | string | Yes | Target group identifier. | | groupRequests .fromUserID | string | Yes | Applicant user ID matching userID in the application record . | Code example import deleteGroupRequests from '@/uni modules/unix openim sdk' await deleteGroupRequests groupRequests: groupID: application.groupID, fromUserID: application.userID, , , Deleting application history is distinct from declining a request. If a formal resolution is required, invoke Accept a group application /sdk/uniapp/group/group applications/accept group application or Reject a group application /sdk/uniapp/group/group applications/refuse group application before deleting the record. Once deleted, the application can no longer be reviewed. Return value The Promise resolves with void once OpenIMServer removes the application entries. State changes after the call A resolved Promise confirms that the records were deleted. When onGroupApplicationDeleted fires, the client removes the record matching groupID:userID from its application lists. For complete event registration logic, see Get received group applications /sdk/uniapp/group/group applications/get group application list as recipient .

title: Get group member list
description: Query group members by role and pagination offset.
keywords: sdk uniapp v4 sdk uniapp group retrieving-group-members get-group-member-list
content: Invoke getGroupMemberList to build a paginated group member roster, optionally filtering members by role level using filter . Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | groupID | string | Yes | Target group identifier. | | filter | OpenIMGroupMemberFilter | Yes | Member role filter code; see table below. | | offset | number | Yes | Pagination starting offset; pass 0 for the first page. | | count | number | Yes | Number of member records to retrieve. | | Enum constant | Numeric value | Description | | | | | | OpenIMGroupMemberFilterAll | 0 | All group members. | | OpenIMGroupMemberFilterOwner | 1 | Group owner only. | | OpenIMGroupMemberFilterAdmin | 2 | Group administrators only. | | OpenIMGroupMemberFilterNormal | 3 | Regular members only. | | OpenIMGroupMemberFilterAdminAndNormal | 4 | Administrators and regular members. | | OpenIMGroupMemberFilterAdminAndOwner | 5 | Group owner and administrators. | Code example import OpenIMGroupMemberFilterAll, getGroupMemberList, from '@/uni modules/unix openim sdk' const result = await getGroupMemberList groupID: groupID, filter: OpenIMGroupMemberFilterAll, offset: 0, count: 50, const members = result = null ? result.members : Return value The Promise resolves with an OpenIMGroupMemberListResult | null object containing OpenIMGroupMemberItem elements in members . Deduplicate and merge members using the composite key groupID:userID . When paginating, advance offset by the fixed batch size rather than active UI roster count. Group member fields | Field | Type | Description | | | | | | groupID | string | Group ID to which the member belongs. | | userID | string | Member user ID; forms a composite key with groupID . | | nickname | string | Group specific display nickname. | | faceURL | string | Group specific avatar URL. | | roleLevel | OpenIMGroupMemberRole | Member role level OpenIMGroupMemberRoleNormal , OpenIMGroupMemberRoleAdmin , OpenIMGroupMemberRoleOwner . | | muteEndTime | number | Mute expiration timestamp in Unix milliseconds; compare with Date.now to determine active mute status. | | joinTime | number | Member join timestamp in Unix milliseconds. | | joinSource | OpenIMGroupJoinSource | How the member joined the group. | | inviterUserID | string | User ID of the inviter; empty string if not invited. | | operatorUserID | string | User ID that performed the latest membership modification. | | ex | string | Custom member extension string. | | attachedInfo | string | SDK internal metadata. | Group nicknames, avatars, and mute statuses are local to the group; do not overwrite account level user profiles with member data. The SDK does not provide a dedicated query for muted members; paginate all members and filter by muteEndTime Date.now . Monitor member updates Group member lifecycle events are centrally observed here. The callback delivers an OpenIMGroupMemberItem | null object. Merge or remove records using groupID:userID : import OpenIMGroupMemberItem, off, onGroupMemberAdded, onGroupMemberDeleted, onGroupMemberInfoChanged, from '@/uni modules/unix openim sdk' const upsertMember = member: OpenIMGroupMemberItem | null = if member == null return upsertGroupMember member const deleteMember = member: OpenIMGroupMemberItem | null = if member == null return removeGroupMember member.groupID, member.userID const addedSubscription = onGroupMemberAdded upsertMember const deletedSubscription = onGroupMemberDeleted deleteMember const changedSubscription = onGroupMemberInfoChanged upsertMember function removeGroupMemberListeners off addedSubscription off deletedSubscription off changedSubscription If member addition or deletion events occur during active pagination, reset the offset and reload from the first page. Unsubscribe when unmounting views, logging out, or switching accounts.

title: Get specified group member info
description: Batch query group member profiles within a target group by user ID.
keywords: sdk uniapp v4 sdk uniapp group retrieving-group-members get-specified-group-members-info
content: Invoke getSpecifiedGroupMembersInfo to batch retrieve member details such as group specific nickname, role, avatar, and mute expiration for known user IDs within a group. Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | groupID | string | Yes | Target group identifier. | | userIDList | string | Yes | Array of member user IDs to query. | Code example import getSpecifiedGroupMembersInfo, from '@/uni modules/unix openim sdk' const result = await getSpecifiedGroupMembersInfo groupID: groupID, userIDList: userIDList, const members = result = null ? result.members : Return value The Promise resolves with an OpenIMGroupMemberListResult | null object containing matched OpenIMGroupMemberItem elements in members . Returned records are not guaranteed to match the order of userIDList ; map and cache members using the composite key groupID:userID . For data field definitions, see Get group member list /sdk/uniapp/group/retrieving group members/get group member list . State changes after the call This is a read only query that retrieves a local snapshot without emitting events. For active views, observe subsequent member changes via onGroupMemberInfoChanged as detailed in Get group member list /sdk/uniapp/group/retrieving group members/get group member list .

title: Get user group membership
description: Determine which users from a specified candidate list remain active members of a group.
keywords: sdk uniapp v4 sdk uniapp group retrieving-group-members get-users-in-group
content: Invoke getUsersInGroup to check which users from a candidate list currently belong to a specified group without loading full member profile objects. Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | groupID | string | Yes | Target group identifier. | | userIDList | string | Yes | Array of user IDs to check. | Code example import getUsersInGroup from '@/uni modules/unix openim sdk' const presentUserIDs = await getUsersInGroup groupID: groupID, userIDList: candidateUserIDs, const confirmedUserIDs = presentUserIDs = null ? presentUserIDs : Return value The Promise resolves with a string | null array containing strictly the subset of requested user IDs who are active members of the group. State changes after the call This is a local snapshot check that does not emit events. If you need complete member details or ongoing synchronization, consult Get group member list /sdk/uniapp/group/retrieving group members/get group member list .

title: Search group members
description: Search members within a specified group by user ID or group nickname.
keywords: sdk uniapp v4 sdk uniapp group retrieving-group-members search-group-members
content: Invoke searchGroupMembers to search members within a group by user ID or group specific nickname, ideal for member filtering and @mention candidate pickers. The SDK utilizes the first non empty keyword in keywordList . Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | groupID | string | Yes | Target group identifier. | | keywordList | string | Yes | Array of search strings. Supply a trimmed, non empty keyword. | | isSearchUserID | boolean | Yes | Whether to match against member user IDs. | | isSearchMemberNickname | boolean | Yes | Whether to match against member group nicknames. | Code example import searchGroupMembers from '@/uni modules/unix openim sdk' const result = await searchGroupMembers groupID: groupID, keywordList: keyword.trim , isSearchUserID: true, isSearchMemberNickname: true, const members = result = null ? result.members : Return value The Promise resolves with an OpenIMGroupMemberListResult | null object containing an array of matched OpenIMGroupMemberItem elements in members . Track matched records using the composite key groupID:userID . For data property definitions, see Get group member list /sdk/uniapp/group/retrieving group members/get group member list . State changes after the call Search results represent a transient subset and should not overwrite your complete cached group member roster. When the keyword or filter dimensions change, execute a new search query and replace the search result set.

title: Invite users to a group
description: Invite one or more users to join a specified group.
keywords: sdk uniapp v4 sdk uniapp group managing-group-members invite-user-to-group
content: Invoke inviteUserToGroup as a group owner or administrator with invitation privileges to invite target users into a group. While clients can conditionally show the action based on member roleLevel , OpenIMServer authoritative verification always enforces final permissions. Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | groupID | string | Yes | Target group identifier. | | reason | string | Yes | Invitation description or greeting; pass an empty string if omitted. | | userIDList | string | Yes | An array of user IDs to invite; deduplicate before invoking. | Code example import inviteUserToGroup from '@/uni modules/unix openim sdk' await inviteUserToGroup groupID: groupID, reason: 'Inviting to project discussion group', userIDList: 'user 002', 'user 003' , Return value The Promise resolves with void once OpenIMServer accepts the invitation request. State changes after the call A resolved Promise indicates that the invitation request was submitted; it does not guarantee that the invited users appear immediately in the member roster. Depending on the group's needVerification policy, invitations may require callee acceptance or admin review. Only when members successfully join and the onGroupMemberAdded event fires should you add them to the local roster using the composite key groupID:userID . For complete member event handling, see Get group member list /sdk/uniapp/group/retrieving group members/get group member list .

title: Kick a group member
description: Remove one or more members from a specified group.
keywords: sdk uniapp v4 sdk uniapp group managing-group-members kick-group-member
content: Invoke kickGroupMember as a group owner or administrator to expel one or more members from a group. This method cannot be used to remove the group owner; transfer ownership first via Transfer group ownership /sdk/uniapp/group/managing group members/transfer group owner . Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | groupID | string | Yes | Target group identifier. | | reason | string | Yes | Explanation for kicking the members; pass an empty string if omitted. | | userIDList | string | Yes | Array of user IDs of members to kick; deduplicate before invoking. | Code example import kickGroupMember from '@/uni modules/unix openim sdk' await kickGroupMember groupID: groupID, reason: 'Departed from the project', userIDList: targetUserID , Return value The Promise resolves with void once OpenIMServer processes the expulsion request. State changes after the call A resolved Promise confirms that the request was processed by OpenIMServer. Connected clients receive onGroupMemberDeleted , at which point the UI removes the member records using the composite key groupID:userID . For complete member event handling, see Get group member list /sdk/uniapp/group/retrieving group members/get group member list .

title: Set group member nickname
description: Modify a member’s group-specific nickname within a designated group.
keywords: sdk uniapp v4 sdk uniapp group managing-group-members set-group-member-nickname
content: Invoke setGroupMemberInfo to update a member's group specific nickname. This alias applies strictly within the target group and does not modify the user's account wide profile nickname. Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | groupID | string | Yes | Target group identifier. | | userID | string | Yes | Target member user ID. | | nickname | string | Yes | New group specific nickname. | Code example import setGroupMemberInfo from '@/uni modules/unix openim sdk' await setGroupMemberInfo groupID: groupID, userID: targetUserID, nickname: 'Project Lead', Return value The Promise resolves with void once OpenIMServer updates the member nickname. State changes after the call A resolved Promise confirms that the request completed on OpenIMServer. Connected clients receive onGroupMemberInfoChanged , at which point the UI updates the member's group nickname matching groupID:userID . For complete member event handling, see Get group member list /sdk/uniapp/group/retrieving group members/get group member list .

title: Set group member role level
description: Promote a regular group member to administrator or demote an administrator to regular member.
keywords: sdk uniapp v4 sdk uniapp group managing-group-members set-group-member-role-level
content: Invoke setGroupMemberInfo to promote a regular member to administrator or demote an administrator to regular status. Only the group owner has permission to perform role adjustments. Parameters The roleLevel property accepts values of type OpenIMGroupMemberRole : | Enum constant | Numeric value | Description | | | | | | OpenIMGroupMemberRoleNormal | 20 | Regular member used to demote an administrator . | | OpenIMGroupMemberRoleAdmin | 60 | Administrator used to promote a member . | | OpenIMGroupMemberRoleOwner | 100 | Group owner used for role identification only; cannot be passed to this API . | Do not attempt to transfer group ownership by passing OpenIMGroupMemberRoleOwner ; invoke Transfer group ownership /sdk/uniapp/group/managing group members/transfer group owner instead. Code example import OpenIMGroupMemberRoleAdmin, setGroupMemberInfo, from '@/uni modules/unix openim sdk' await setGroupMemberInfo groupID: groupID, userID: targetUserID, roleLevel: OpenIMGroupMemberRoleAdmin, Return value The Promise resolves with void once OpenIMServer updates the member role. State changes after the call A resolved Promise confirms that the role update completed. Connected clients receive onGroupMemberInfoChanged , at which point the UI updates the member's roleLevel matching groupID:userID . For complete member event handling, see Get group member list /sdk/uniapp/group/retrieving group members/get group member list .

title: Set group member avatar
description: Update a member’s group-specific avatar URL within a designated group.
keywords: sdk uniapp v4 sdk uniapp group managing-group-members set-group-member-avatar
content: Invoke setGroupMemberInfo to update a member's group specific avatar image URL. This avatar applies strictly within the designated group and does not modify the user's primary account avatar. Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | groupID | string | Yes | Target group identifier. | | userID | string | Yes | Target member user ID. | | faceURL | string | Yes | New avatar image URL for the group member. | To update the authenticated user's account wide profile avatar, call Update your profile /sdk/uniapp/user/profile/set self info . Code example import setGroupMemberInfo from '@/uni modules/unix openim sdk' await setGroupMemberInfo groupID: groupID, userID: targetUserID, faceURL: avatarURL, Return value The Promise resolves with void once OpenIMServer updates the member avatar. State changes after the call A resolved Promise confirms that the avatar change was accepted. Connected clients receive onGroupMemberInfoChanged , at which point the UI updates the member avatar matching groupID:userID . For complete member event handling, see Get group member list /sdk/uniapp/group/retrieving group members/get group member list .

title: Set group member extension data
description: Store custom application-level extension strings on a designated group member.
keywords: sdk uniapp v4 sdk uniapp group managing-group-members set-group-member-extension
content: Invoke setGroupMemberInfo to set a custom extension string on a group member record. The ex property stores an opaque string; the SDK does not perform automatic JSON merging. When multiple modules share this attribute, structure namespaces carefully and retain other fields before writing. Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | groupID | string | Yes | Target group identifier. | | userID | string | Yes | Target member user ID. | | ex | string | Yes | Custom extension string; completely overwrites existing member extension data. | Code example import setGroupMemberInfo from '@/uni modules/unix openim sdk' await setGroupMemberInfo groupID: groupID, userID: targetUserID, ex: JSON.stringify title: 'maintainer', , If the member already contains extension data, retrieve the current value, merge changes within your application layer, and submit the entire serialized string. Return value The Promise resolves with void once OpenIMServer updates the member extension data. State changes after the call A resolved Promise confirms that the extension string was saved. Connected clients receive onGroupMemberInfoChanged , at which point the UI updates the member's ex field matching groupID:userID . For complete member event handling, see Get group member list /sdk/uniapp/group/retrieving group members/get group member list .

title: Transfer group ownership
description: Transfer group owner status to another active group member.
keywords: sdk uniapp v4 sdk uniapp group managing-group-members transfer-group-owner
content: Invoke transferGroupOwner to transfer group ownership to another active member. Only the current group owner has permission to perform this action.
