Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | groupID | string | Yes | Target group identifier. | | newOwnerUserID | string | Yes | User ID of the member assuming ownership. | Code example import transferGroupOwner from '@/uni modules/unix openim sdk' await transferGroupOwner groupID: groupID, newOwnerUserID: targetUserID, Return value The Promise resolves with void once OpenIMServer transfers group ownership. State changes after the call A resolved Promise confirms that the ownership transfer completed on OpenIMServer. The roles of both the former owner and the new owner change simultaneously. When onGroupMemberInfoChanged fires, update the role records of both members using their respective groupID:userID keys. To re calibrate leadership roles, call Get group member list /sdk/uniapp/group/retrieving group members/get group member list with filter: OpenIMGroupMemberFilterAdminAndOwner . When a group owner wishes to leave a group, they must transfer ownership first before calling Quit a group /sdk/uniapp/group/quit group .

title: Mute or unmute a group member
description: Mute or unmute a specific group member for a specified duration.
keywords: sdk uniapp v4 sdk uniapp group managing-group-members change-group-member-mute
content: Invoke changeGroupMemberMute to mute or unmute a specific group member. Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | groupID | string | Yes | Target group identifier. | | userID | string | Yes | Target member user ID. | | mutedSeconds | number | Yes | Mute duration in seconds; pass 0 to lift the mute. | The group owner can mute administrators and regular members; administrators can mute only regular members. Final permissions are authoritatively enforced by OpenIMServer. Code example import changeGroupMemberMute from '@/uni modules/unix openim sdk' await changeGroupMemberMute groupID: groupID, userID: targetUserID, mutedSeconds: 3600, Return value The Promise resolves with void once OpenIMServer updates the member mute duration. State changes after the call A resolved Promise confirms that the request completed on the server. The member's final mute state is determined by the muteEndTime Unix timestamp in their member profile rather than local seconds calculations. Connected clients receive onGroupMemberInfoChanged , at which point the UI updates the member's mute expiration matching groupID:userID . For complete member event handling, see Get group member list /sdk/uniapp/group/retrieving group members/get group member list .

title: Message overview
description: Understand message creation, transmission, reception, querying, and lifecycle synchronization workflows.
keywords: sdk uniapp v4 sdk uniapp message overview-message
content: The OpenIM UniApp SDK represents each message record using the OpenIMMessageItem interface. Message transmission operates in two distinct phases: first, construct an outgoing message data object using the appropriate creation method, and then transmit that object to a target user or group. Message creation methods do not send data over the network; likewise, Promise resolution from a send invocation does not guarantee that other devices have rendered the incoming message. In message lists, locate individual messages using their owning conversation and clientMsgID . The conversationID is derived from the active conversation context, query filter, search result, or event payload, rather than being an intrinsic property of OpenIMMessageItem . Message processing phases | Phase | Core operations | Description | | | | | | Create | Invoke the corresponding message creation method | Returns an OpenIMMessageItem or null . Generates the local message data structure without transmitting data or triggering new message events. | | Send | Invoke Send a message /sdk/uniapp/message/sending messages/send message or Send a non OSS message /sdk/uniapp/message/sending messages/send message not oss | Supply recvID for single chats, or groupID for group chats; pass an empty string "" for the unneeded target field. | | Receive | Listen for incoming message events | Identify the destination conversation and merge items by clientMsgID ; ignore duplicate event deliveries. | | Query | Load message history, search, or look up by ID | Retrieves messages stored locally at the time of invocation without emitting message events. | | Update | Delete, revoke, edit, pin, or report read receipts | Manage Promise resolution, incoming update events, and state re queries independently. | For local image, audio, video, and file media, Send a message /sdk/uniapp/message/sending messages/send message handles automated upload to storage before message transmission. If assets are already uploaded to your business server and possess public remote URLs, create URL based message items and transmit them via Send a non OSS message /sdk/uniapp/message/sending messages/send message not oss to bypass duplicate file uploads. Common message fields | Field | Type | Description | | | | | | clientMsgID | string \| null | Client generated message ID used for list deduplication and state tracking; verify existence in created objects. | | serverMsgID | string \| null | Server assigned message ID; null or empty while pending or if sending failed. | | sessionType | OpenIMSessionType | Chat session type, such as single chat or group chat. | | sendID | string \| null | User ID of the message sender. | | recvID | string \| null | Recipient user ID for single chats; empty string in group chats. | | groupID | string \| null | Target group ID for group chats; empty string in single chats. | | msgFrom | number | Message origin indicator. | | contentType | OpenIMMessageType | Message content type enum, determining which element field contains the payload. | | createTime | number | Timestamp when the message object was created locally, in Unix milliseconds. | | sendTime | number | Timestamp when the message was sent, in Unix milliseconds. | | seq | number | Authoritative sequence number assigned by OpenIMServer; absent before transmission succeeds. | | senderPlatformID | OpenIMPlatform | Operating platform constant of the sender device. | | senderNickname | string \| null | Sender nickname recorded in the message snapshot. | | senderFaceUrl | string \| null | Sender avatar URL recorded in the message snapshot. | | status | OpenIMMessageStatus | Message dispatch status sending, success, or failed . | | isRead | boolean | Read receipt status at the time of receipt or query. | | offlinePush | OpenIMOfflinePush \| null | Offline push notification configuration applied to this message. | | content | string \| null | Serialized message body preserved by the SDK; prefer rendering the dedicated element property. | | attachedInfo | string \| null | SDK internal auxiliary string; parse only according to confirmed business protocols. | | ex | string \| null | Custom extension string synchronized with other participants across all clients. | | localEx | string \| null | Extension string preserved exclusively in the local database of the current device. | The message body resides in the dedicated element property matching contentType : | Content payload | Dedicated property | | | | | Text | textElem | | Image, audio, video, file | pictureElem , soundElem , videoElem , fileElem | | @ mentions, quote replies | atTextElem , quoteElem | | Merged forward, custom | mergeElem , customElem | | Contact card, location, face | cardElem , locationElem , faceElem | | Advanced text, typing status | advancedTextElem , typingElem | | System notifications, auxiliary state | notificationElem , attachedInfoElem | The constants OpenIMMessageTypeUserCommandAdded , OpenIMMessageTypeUserCommandDeleted , and OpenIMMessageTypeUserCommandUpdated are OpenIMMessageType values used to recognize UserCommand business notifications. They are identified by evaluating contentType , not through separate event names. Never evaluate message identity using display strings, array indices, or paginated list offsets. Always merge message states using conversationID:clientMsgID . Write device specific display flags to localEx , while using ex or message payloads for business data that must synchronize across participants. title: Create a text message
description: Construct a pending text message object from a string.
keywords: sdk uniapp v4 sdk uniapp message creating-messages create-text-message
content: Invoke createTextMessage to construct a pending text message object from a string. Validate length, whitespace, and compliance constraints in your UI layer prior to invocation. Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | text | string | Yes | Text content string to transmit. | Code example import createTextMessage from '@/uni modules/unix openim sdk' const text = input.trim if text.length == 0 return const message = await createTextMessage text if message == null return Return value The Promise resolves with an OpenIMMessageItem | null object. Message creation only instantiates the message structure in local memory; it does not persist data to the server or emit incoming message events. State changes after the call Pass the returned message item to Send a message /sdk/uniapp/message/sending messages/send message . Track and update the message status in your UI state using the returned clientMsgID .

title: Create an @ message
description: Construct an @ mention text message for group conversations.
keywords: sdk uniapp v4 sdk uniapp message creating-messages create-text-at-message
content: Invoke createTextAtMessage to create an @ mention text message for group chats. Keep the visible text in text synchronized with the identifiers listed in atUserIDList , using stable user IDs rather than nicknames to track mentioned members. Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | text | string | Yes | Message text content including @ display text. | | atUserIDList | string | Yes | Array of mentioned user IDs or the mention all tag token. | | atUsersInfo | OpenIMAtUsersInfoItem | No | Array of objects mapping user IDs to their group nicknames. | | quoteMessage | OpenIMMessageItem | No | Original message to quote if creating a combined mention and reply message. | Code example import createTextAtMessage from '@/uni modules/unix openim sdk' const message = await createTextAtMessage text: '@Alex please review', atUserIDList: 'user a' , atUsersInfo: atUserID: 'user a', groupNickname: 'Alex', , if message == null return Mention all group members Never hardcode the mention all string in application logic. Invoke getAtAllTag to retrieve the authoritative token configured for your SDK, and place result.tag into both text and atUserIDList : import createTextAtMessage, getAtAllTag, from '@/uni modules/unix openim sdk' const result = await getAtAllTag if result == null || result.tag.length == 0 return const message = await createTextAtMessage text: result.tag + ' Please review the announcement', atUserIDList: result.tag , getAtAllTag retrieves the tag token only; it does not construct or transmit messages. Return value The Promise resolves with an OpenIMMessageItem | null object. State changes after the call Creating an @ message generates a local object without triggering new message events or altering conversation unread counters. Pass the created message to Send a message /sdk/uniapp/message/sending messages/send message , specifying the target groupID . Track the message lifecycle in your UI state using clientMsgID .

title: Create a custom message
description: Construct a custom message containing structured business payloads.
keywords: sdk uniapp v4 sdk uniapp message creating-messages create-custom-message
content: Invoke createCustomMessage to encapsulate structured business payloads such as orders, tasks, invites, or polls into messages synchronized across chat participants. Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | data | string | Yes | Serialized business payload string typically JSON . | | extension | string | Yes | Supplementary extension metadata string. | | descriptionText | string | Yes | Fallback summary text displayed when a client does not support rendering this custom message type. | Code example import createCustomMessage from '@/uni modules/unix openim sdk' const message = await createCustomMessage data: JSON.stringify type: 'task', taskID: 'task 42', , extension: JSON.stringify schemaVersion: 1 , descriptionText: 'Task Card', if message == null return All three parameters must be complete strings; the SDK does not parse or merge JSON schemas internally. Receiving clients should parse the protocol version and payload fields carefully, rendering descriptionText if an unsupported schema is encountered. Return value The Promise resolves with an OpenIMMessageItem | null object. State changes after the call Pass the constructed message item to Send a message /sdk/uniapp/message/sending messages/send message . Track the message lifecycle in your UI state using clientMsgID .

title: Create an image message from a local file
description: Create a pending image message from an accessible local image file path.
keywords: sdk uniapp v4 sdk uniapp message creating-messages create-image-message-by-file
content: Invoke createImageMessageFromFullPath to construct a pending image message from a local filesystem path accessible to the native application engine. This method does not accept browser File objects or require pre populating thumbnail dimensions. Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | imageFullPath | string | Yes | Absolute POSIX file path or unifile:// URI accessible to the native runtime. | Code example import createImageMessageFromFullPath, from '@/uni modules/unix openim sdk' const message = await createImageMessageFromFullPath imageFullPath if message == null return Ensure imageFullPath points to a permanent local path, such as one resolved within uni.env.USER DATA PATH . Temporary gallery picker paths or sandbox restricted locations may become inaccessible; copy picker results to your application's data directory before calling this method. Return value The Promise resolves with an OpenIMMessageItem | null object containing the local image message representation. State changes after the call Pass the created message to Send a message /sdk/uniapp/message/sending messages/send message . The SDK will automatically handle binary upload and remote dispatch, allowing you to monitor upload progress via onSendMessageProgress and index items by clientMsgID .

title: Create an image message from a URL
description: Construct a pending image message from existing remote image URLs and metadata.
keywords: sdk uniapp v4 sdk uniapp message creating-messages create-image-message-by-url
content: Invoke createImageMessageByURL when image files have already been uploaded to your application server or content delivery network, avoiding the SDK's built in file upload workflow. Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | sourcePath | string | No | Original local file path; pass an empty string "" when only remote URLs exist. | | sourcePicture | OpenIMPicture | Yes | Information regarding the original high resolution image asset. | | bigPicture | OpenIMPicture | Yes | Information regarding the display preview image asset. | | snapshotPicture | OpenIMPicture | Yes | Information regarding the thumbnail preview image asset. | Each OpenIMPicture object contains the following fields: | Field | Type | Description | | | | | | uuid | string | Unique asset identifier returned by the upload service. | | type | string | MIME type of the image for example, 'image/jpeg' . | | size | number | File size in bytes. | | width | number | Image width in pixels. | | height | number | Image height in pixels. | | url | string | Publicly accessible remote URL of the image. | Code example import createImageMessageByURL from '@/uni modules/unix openim sdk' const picture = uuid: uploaded.uuid, type: 'image/jpeg', size: uploaded.size, width: 1280, height: 720, url: uploaded.url, const message = await createImageMessageByURL sourcePath: '', sourcePicture: picture, bigPicture: picture, snapshotPicture: picture, if message == null return All dimensions, sizes, and URLs must reflect actual server upload responses. Return value The Promise resolves with an OpenIMMessageItem | null object. State changes after the call Pass the returned message item to Send a non OSS message /sdk/uniapp/message/sending messages/send message not oss to transmit the payload without re uploading the file. Track message state using clientMsgID .

title: Create an audio message from a local file
description: Create a pending audio message from an accessible local sound file path and duration.
keywords: sdk uniapp v4 sdk uniapp message creating-messages create-sound-message-by-file
content: Invoke createSoundMessageFromFullPath to construct a pending audio/voice message from a local audio file and its playback duration. File size and headers are resolved automatically by the SDK during the upload process. Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | soundPath | string | Yes | Absolute POSIX file path or unifile:// URI accessible to the native runtime. | | duration | number | Yes | Audio playback duration in seconds do not pass milliseconds . | Code example import createSoundMessageFromFullPath, from '@/uni modules/unix openim sdk' const message = await createSoundMessageFromFullPath soundPath: $ uni.env.USER DATA PATH /voice.m4a , duration: 12, if message == null return Temporary recording paths returned by capture APIs may be cleared by the OS. When deferring transmission or caching recordings, persist the file into uni.env.USER DATA PATH before supplying the path to the SDK. Return value The Promise resolves with an OpenIMMessageItem | null object. State changes after the call Pass the returned message object to Send a message /sdk/uniapp/message/sending messages/send message . The SDK uploads the audio file, transmits the message, and triggers progress events tracked by clientMsgID .

title: Create an audio message from a URL
description: Construct a pending audio message from an already-uploaded audio URL and metadata.
keywords: sdk uniapp v4 sdk uniapp message creating-messages create-sound-message-by-url
content: Invoke createSoundMessageByURL when an audio file has already been uploaded to your application server or storage provider and has a publicly accessible remote URL. Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | uuid | string | No | Unique audio identifier returned by the upload service. | | soundPath | string | No | Original local file path; pass an empty string "" when only remote URLs exist. | | sourceUrl | string | Recommended | Publicly accessible remote URL for audio playback. | | dataSize | number | Recommended | File size in bytes. | | duration | number | Recommended | Audio playback duration in seconds. | Code example import createSoundMessageByURL from '@/uni modules/unix openim sdk' const message = await createSoundMessageByURL uuid: uploaded.uuid, soundPath: '', sourceUrl: uploaded.url, dataSize: uploaded.size, duration: 12, if message == null return While individual fields are typed as optional, creating a functional audio message requires a valid sourceUrl alongside the actual file size and playback duration. Avoid using transient URLs that expire quickly. Return value The Promise resolves with an OpenIMMessageItem | null object. State changes after the call Pass the constructed message item to Send a non OSS message /sdk/uniapp/message/sending messages/send message not oss to transmit the audio message without repeating the upload process. Track message lifecycle using clientMsgID .

title: Create a video message from a local file
description: Create a pending video message from accessible local video and cover thumbnail file paths.
keywords: sdk uniapp v4 sdk uniapp message creating-messages create-video-message-by-file
content: Invoke createVideoMessageFromFullPath to construct a pending video message using local file paths for both the video and its cover thumbnail snapshot. Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | videoPath | string | Yes | Local video file path accessible to the native runtime. | | videoType | string | Yes | Video MIME type for example, 'video/mp4' . | | duration | number | Yes | Video duration in seconds. | | snapshotPath | string | Yes | Local thumbnail cover image path accessible to the native runtime. | Code example import createVideoMessageFromFullPath, from '@/uni modules/unix openim sdk' const message = await createVideoMessageFromFullPath videoPath: $ uni.env.USER DATA PATH /demo.mp4 , videoType: 'video/mp4', duration: 18, snapshotPath: $ uni.env.USER DATA PATH /demo cover.jpg , if message == null return Both paths should be POSIX absolute paths or unifile:// URIs. When handling files generated by video recorders or camera pickers, persist them in uni.env.USER DATA PATH if they will not be transmitted immediately. Specify duration in seconds and ensure the cover image accurately reflects the video content. Return value The Promise resolves with an OpenIMMessageItem | null object. State changes after the call Pass the constructed message item to Send a message /sdk/uniapp/message/sending messages/send message . The SDK automatically uploads the video and thumbnail before delivering the message payload. Monitor upload progress with onSendMessageProgress and index updates by clientMsgID .

title: Create a video message from a URL
description: Construct a pending video message from uploaded video and cover thumbnail URLs.
keywords: sdk uniapp v4 sdk uniapp message creating-messages create-video-message-by-url
content: Invoke createVideoMessageByURL when video and thumbnail cover assets have already been uploaded to your application server or object storage and possess publicly accessible remote URLs. Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | videoPath | string | No | Original local video file path; pass an empty string "" when only remote URLs exist. | | videoUUID | string | No | Unique video asset identifier returned by the upload service. | | videoUrl | string | Recommended | Remote playback URL of the video. | | videoType | string | Recommended | Video MIME type for example, 'video/mp4' . | | videoSize | number | Recommended | Video file size in bytes. | | duration | number | Recommended | Video playback duration in seconds. | | snapshotPath | string | No | Original local thumbnail path; pass an empty string "" when using remote URLs. | | snapshotUUID | string | No | Unique thumbnail image identifier. | | snapshotSize | number | Recommended | Thumbnail image file size in bytes. | | snapshotUrl | string | Recommended | Remote image URL of the video cover snapshot. | | snapshotWidth | number | Recommended | Thumbnail cover width in pixels. | | snapshotHeight | number | Recommended | Thumbnail cover height in pixels. | | snapshotType | string | Recommended | Thumbnail MIME type for example, 'image/jpeg' . | Code example import createVideoMessageByURL from '@/uni modules/unix openim sdk' const message = await createVideoMessageByURL videoPath: '', videoUUID: uploadedVideo.uuid, videoUrl: uploadedVideo.url, videoType: 'video/mp4', videoSize: uploadedVideo.size, duration: 18, snapshotPath: '', snapshotUUID: uploadedCover.uuid, snapshotSize: uploadedCover.size, snapshotUrl: uploadedCover.url, snapshotWidth: 1280, snapshotHeight: 720, snapshotType: 'image/jpeg', if message == null return While individual fields are typed as optional, practical video playback and preview rendering require valid videoUrl and snapshotUrl values, alongside accurate dimensions and durations. Return value The Promise resolves with an OpenIMMessageItem | null object. State changes after the call Pass the constructed message item to Send a non OSS message /sdk/uniapp/message/sending messages/send message not oss to transmit the payload without re uploading the video or snapshot. Track message state using clientMsgID .

title: Create a file message from a local file
description: Create a pending file attachment message from an accessible local filesystem path.
keywords: sdk uniapp v4 sdk uniapp message creating-messages create-file-message-by-file
content: Invoke createFileMessageFromFullPath to construct a pending file attachment message from a local file path. Supply the local filesystem path in filePath , and provide the file name and extension in fileName . Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | filePath | string | Yes | Absolute POSIX file path or unifile:// URI accessible to the native runtime. | | fileName | string | Yes | Display file name presented to recipients for example, 'project plan.pdf' . | Code example import createFileMessageFromFullPath, from '@/uni modules/unix openim sdk' const message = await createFileMessageFromFullPath filePath: $ uni.env.USER DATA PATH /project plan.pdf , fileName: 'project plan.pdf', if message == null return Ensure fileName includes the appropriate extension for proper file association on recipient devices. If obtaining files via system pickers, copy them into uni.env.USER DATA PATH if transmission might occur asynchronously. Return value The Promise resolves with an OpenIMMessageItem | null object. State changes after the call Pass the constructed message item to Send a message /sdk/uniapp/message/sending messages/send message . The SDK automatically handles binary upload and delivery, emitting upload progress events via onSendMessageProgress . Track items in your UI using clientMsgID .

title: Create a file message from a URL
description: Construct a pending file attachment message from an uploaded file URL and metadata.
keywords: sdk uniapp v4 sdk uniapp message creating-messages create-file-message-by-url
content: Invoke createFileMessageByURL when a file attachment has already been uploaded to your application server or cloud storage provider and has a publicly accessible remote URL. Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | filePath | string | No | Original local file path; pass an empty string "" when using remote assets. | | uuid | string | No | Unique asset identifier returned by the upload service. | | sourceUrl | string | Recommended | Remote download URL of the file. | | fileName | string | Recommended | File name and extension presented to recipients. | | fileSize | number | Recommended | File size in bytes. | Code example import createFileMessageByURL from '@/uni modules/unix openim sdk' const message = await createFileMessageByURL filePath: '', uuid: uploaded.uuid, sourceUrl: uploaded.url, fileName: 'project plan.pdf', fileSize: uploaded.size, if message == null return While individual properties are typed as optional, constructing a usable file message requires a valid sourceUrl , accurate fileName , and correct fileSize . Return value The Promise resolves with an OpenIMMessageItem | null object. State changes after the call Pass the constructed message item to Send a non OSS message /sdk/uniapp/message/sending messages/send message not oss to deliver the payload without re uploading the file. Track message state using clientMsgID .

title: Create a card message
description: Construct a contact business card message to share a user’s profile information.
keywords: sdk uniapp v4 sdk uniapp message creating-messages create-card-message
content: Invoke createCardMessage to produce a contact card message sharing a user's profile details. The embedded profile attributes represent a snapshot at creation time and do not update automatically if the target user modifies their profile later. Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | userID | string | Recommended | Stable user ID of the shared user profile. | | nickname | string | Recommended | Display name shown on the contact card. | | faceURL | string | No | Avatar URL for the shared contact. | | ex | string | No | Custom extension string; the SDK preserves this as an unparsed string. | Code example import createCardMessage from '@/uni modules/unix openim sdk' const message = await createCardMessage userID: 'user 42', nickname: 'Alex', faceURL: 'https://example.com/avatar/user 42.png', ex: JSON.stringify source: 'team directory' , if message == null return While individual fields are typed as optional, constructing a meaningful card requires a valid userID and display name. When recipients initiate actions such as sending a friend request or opening a chat from a card, re query user information through Get user profiles /sdk/uniapp/user/profile/get users info rather than treating card fields as live authorization credentials. Return value The Promise resolves with an OpenIMMessageItem | null object. State changes after the call Pass the constructed message item to Send a message /sdk/uniapp/message/sending messages/send message . Track message status updates in your UI using clientMsgID .

title: Create a location message
description: Construct a location message from geographical coordinates and a location description.
keywords: sdk uniapp v4 sdk uniapp message creating-messages create-location-message
content: Invoke createLocationMessage to embed location metadata and GPS coordinates into a pending message object. The SDK persists coordinates and descriptive text; it does not handle GPS sensor polling, reverse geocoding, or map rendering. Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | descriptionText | string | Yes | Human readable location name or address description. | | longitude | number | Yes | Longitude coordinate in the range 180, 180 . | | latitude | number | Yes | Latitude coordinate in the range 90, 90 . | Code example import createLocationMessage from '@/uni modules/unix openim sdk' const message = await createLocationMessage descriptionText: 'Shenzhen Bay Park', longitude: 113.9516, latitude: 22.4864, if message == null return Ensure coordinates are obtained from a validated location provider using a consistent coordinate reference system such as WGS 84 or GCJ 02 according to your app's map SDK . Return value The Promise resolves with an OpenIMMessageItem | null object. State changes after the call Pass the constructed message item to Send a message /sdk/uniapp/message/sending messages/send message . Track message status using clientMsgID .

title: Create a face message
description: Construct an animated sticker or custom emoji face message from an index and data string.
keywords: sdk uniapp v4 sdk uniapp message creating-messages create-face-message
content: Invoke createFaceMessage to send pre defined stickers or custom emojis. The index property identifies the sticker index, while data carries an application defined serialized payload string such as sticker pack details . The SDK does not download or render custom sticker graphic assets. Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | index | number | Yes | Numeric index identifying the specific emoji or sticker. | | data | string | Yes | Application defined string payload associated with this sticker. | Code example import createFaceMessage from '@/uni modules/unix openim sdk' const message = await createFaceMessage index: 1001, data: JSON.stringify packID: 'default', name: 'wave' , if message == null return Senders and receivers must agree on sticker index conventions and data schemas. Provide fallback UI rendering when receiving unknown indices or unrecognized payload formats. Return value The Promise resolves with an OpenIMMessageItem | null object. State changes after the call Pass the constructed message item to Send a message /sdk/uniapp/message/sending messages/send message . Track message status using clientMsgID .

title: Create a quote message
description: Reference an existing message to create a quoted reply message.
keywords: sdk uniapp v4 sdk uniapp message creating-messages create-quote-message
content: Invoke createQuoteMessage to reference an existing message and produce a quoted reply message item. Supply the reply body in text , and pass the serialized JSON representation of the target message in message . Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | text | string | Yes | Body text of your reply. | | message | string | Yes | Serialized JSON string of the original OpenIMMessageItem being quoted. | Code example import createQuoteMessage from '@/uni modules/unix openim sdk' const message = await createQuoteMessage text: 'Acknowledged, handling today.', message: JSON.stringify originalMessage , if message == null return The originalMessage must originate from SDK history queries or incoming message events; do not use incomplete manually assembled objects. Confirm that the quoted message belongs to the active conversation, and provide fallback UI rendering if the referenced message was subsequently deleted or revoked. Return value The Promise resolves with an OpenIMMessageItem | null object. Quoting does not alter or re transmit the original message record. State changes after the call Pass the constructed message item to Send a message /sdk/uniapp/message/sending messages/send message . Track message status updates in your UI state using the returned clientMsgID .

title: Create a Markdown message
description: Construct a pending message containing Markdown-formatted source text.
keywords: sdk uniapp v4 sdk uniapp message creating-messages create-markdown-message
content: Invoke createMarkdownMessage to construct a pending message containing Markdown source text. The content parameter expects unrendered Markdown markup, not compiled HTML. Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | content | string | Yes | Unrendered Markdown source text string. | Code example import createMarkdownMessage from '@/uni modules/unix openim sdk' const message = await createMarkdownMessage content: ' Release complete \n\nPlease review the release notes.', if message == null return Receiving clients should use a secure, sandboxed Markdown parser, restricting untrusted links, images, or script execution. Clients that do not support rich rendering should display the raw text content gracefully. Return value The Promise resolves with an OpenIMMessageItem | null object. State changes after the call Pass the constructed message item to Send a message /sdk/uniapp/message/sending messages/send message . Track message status updates in your UI state using clientMsgID .

title: Create a forward message
description: Construct a forwarded message from an existing sent message.
keywords: sdk uniapp v4 sdk uniapp message creating-messages create-forward-message
content: Invoke createForwardMessage with an existing OpenIMMessageItem to duplicate its payload into a new pending message that can be transmitted to a different recipient or group. Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | sourceMessage | OpenIMMessageItem | Yes | Existing message item to be forwarded. | Code example import createForwardMessage from '@/uni modules/unix openim sdk' const message = await createForwardMessage sourceMessage if message == null return The sourceMessage must be a valid sent message obtained from history queries or message events. Ensure the user retains permission to view and propagate the content. Device specific attributes or expired temporary URLs may not function when forwarded. Return value The Promise resolves with an OpenIMMessageItem | null object. Forwarding does not mutate the source message or automatically transmit data to the target chat. State changes after the call Pass the constructed message item to Send a message /sdk/uniapp/message/sending messages/send message , supplying the destination recvID or groupID . If you prefer to combine multiple selected messages into a single chat history card, use Create a merger message /sdk/uniapp/message/creating messages/create merger message .

title: Create a merger message
description: Consolidate multiple existing messages into a single merged forward card message.
keywords: sdk uniapp v4 sdk uniapp message creating-messages create-merger-message
content: Invoke createMergerMessage to bundle multiple existing message records into a single merged forward card. Recipients typically see the card title and preview summary snippets in the chat view, tapping the card to review the full merged message timeline. Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | messageList | OpenIMMessageItem | Yes | Array of existing message records to merge; array ordering determines display sequence. | | title | string | Yes | Title rendered on the merger preview card for example, 'Chat History' . | | abstractList | string | Yes | Array of summary preview lines generated from message content. | Code example import createMergerMessage from '@/uni modules/unix openim sdk' const message = await createMergerMessage messageList: selectedMessages, title: 'Project Discussion History', abstractList: 'Alex: Please confirm deployment time', 'Morgan: Scheduled for Friday release', , if message == null return Ensure messageList contains fully populated message records that were previously sent. The SDK does not automatically synthesize abstractList ; compile preview lines in your application layer. Return value The Promise resolves with an OpenIMMessageItem | null object. Merging does not modify or delete the original source messages. State changes after the call Pass the constructed message item to Send a message /sdk/uniapp/message/sending messages/send message . If you want each selected message to appear as a standalone forward item in the destination chat rather than a merged digest, use Create a forward message /sdk/uniapp/message/creating messages/create forward message instead.

title: Send a message
description: Transmit a prepared message object to a single-chat recipient or group.
keywords: sdk uniapp v4 sdk uniapp message sending-messages send-message
content: Invoke sendMessage to transmit an OpenIMMessageItem constructed by one of the message creation methods. Supply recvID for single chats, or groupID for group chats; provide an empty string "" for the unused destination property. Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | message | OpenIMMessageItem | Yes | Non null message object generated by a creation method. | | recvID | string | Conditionally | Peer user ID for single chats; pass an empty string "" for group chats. | | groupID | string | Conditionally | Target group ID for group chats; pass an empty string "" for single chats. | | offlinePushInfo | OpenIMOfflinePush \| null | No | Offline push title, description, and sound configuration; pass null for defaults. | | isOnlineOnly | boolean | No | When true , delivers exclusively to currently connected online devices without saving to local history. | Code example import sendMessage from '@/uni modules/unix openim sdk' const sentMessage = await sendMessage message: message, recvID: receiverUserID, groupID: '', offlinePushInfo: null, isOnlineOnly: false, if sentMessage.clientMsgID = null replacePendingMessage sentMessage.clientMsgID, sentMessage Return value The Promise resolves with the sent OpenIMMessageItem . On the sending device, replace the pending local optimistic item with the resolved message object using clientMsgID . Arrival of the message on remote recipient devices is governed by subsequent network events and cannot be inferred solely from Promise resolution. Listen for upload progress When sending local image, audio, video, or file media, centrally register onSendMessageProgress to receive real time upload progress updates. The callback receives an OpenIMSendMessageProgressEvent | null object containing clientMsgID and the upload percentage in progress . import OpenIMSendMessageProgressEvent, off, onSendMessageProgress, from '@/uni modules/unix openim sdk' const handleSendProgress = progress: OpenIMSendMessageProgressEvent | null, = if progress == null return updateMessageProgress progress.clientMsgID, progress.progress const progressSubscription = onSendMessageProgress handleSendProgress function removeSendProgressListener off progressSubscription Always index progress updates in your UI state by clientMsgID rather than relying on list indices. Reaching 100% progress signifies that the binary upload to storage completed; final message delivery confirmation remains dependent on the resolution of the sendMessage Promise. Unregister the listener when unmounting components, logging out, or switching accounts.

title: Send a non-OSS message
description: Send an image, audio, video, or file message whose media asset has already been uploaded to a remote URL.
keywords: sdk uniapp v4 sdk uniapp message sending-messages send-message-not-oss
content: Invoke sendMessageNotOss to transmit media messages whose binary files have already been uploaded to your own application server or third party storage, bypassing the SDK's built in storage upload workflow. For plain text messages or media messages that reference local filesystem paths, use standard Send a message /sdk/uniapp/message/sending messages/send message . Parameters The parameters match Send a message /sdk/uniapp/message/sending messages/send message : | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | message | OpenIMMessageItem | Yes | Non null message object generated by a URL based creation method. | | recvID | string | Conditionally | Peer user ID for single chats; pass an empty string "" for group chats. | | groupID | string | Conditionally | Target group ID for group chats; pass an empty string "" for single chats. | | offlinePushInfo | OpenIMOfflinePush \| null | No | Offline push title, description, and sound configuration; pass null for defaults. | | isOnlineOnly | boolean | No | When true , delivers exclusively to currently connected online devices without saving to local history. | Code example import sendMessageNotOss from '@/uni modules/unix openim sdk' const sentMessage = await sendMessageNotOss message: urlMessage, recvID: receiverUserID, groupID: '', offlinePushInfo: null, isOnlineOnly: false, if sentMessage.clientMsgID = null replacePendingMessage sentMessage.clientMsgID, sentMessage The media URL, file size, dimensions, and duration must reflect actual remote storage metadata. This method does not upload binary data and fails if passed messages referencing un uploaded local paths. Return value The Promise resolves with the sent OpenIMMessageItem . Update local optimistic state using clientMsgID . Delivery across remote devices and subsequent history queries represent separate phases and cannot be inferred solely from this call's success. State changes after the call This call sends the message directly to OpenIMServer without triggering local media progress events. Merge the returned OpenIMMessageItem into the local UI using clientMsgID .

title: Receive messages
description: Listen for incoming real-time, offline, and online-only messages, and merge them into conversations.
keywords: sdk uniapp v4 sdk uniapp message receiving-messages receive-messages
content: Message event subscriptions deliver newly arrived messages in real time. When first opening a conversation, scrolling upward, or reconnecting after a network disruption, query history actively using Load older messages /sdk/uniapp/message/retrieving messages/load older messages . Because queries and events may encounter the same message instance, always determine the target conversation and deduplicate entries using clientMsgID . The OpenIMMessageItem struct does not contain a conversationID property. For single chats, identify the conversation using sessionType , sendID , and recvID . For group chats, identify it using groupID . Compute the conversation ID or look up the conversation object using SDK APIs. Never identify messages by display text or visual list offsets. Listen for new messages The callbacks for onRecvNewMessages and onRecvOfflineNewMessages receive an OpenIMMessageListResult | null payload, with message items contained in messages . In contrast, onRecvOnlineOnlyMessage receives an individual OpenIMMessageItem | null . import OpenIMMessageItem, OpenIMMessageListResult, off, onRecvNewMessages, onRecvOfflineNewMessages, onRecvOnlineOnlyMessage, from '@/uni modules/unix openim sdk' const handleNewMessages = result: OpenIMMessageListResult | null = if result == null return mergeMessagesByClientMsgID result.messages const handleOfflineMessages = result: OpenIMMessageListResult | null = if result == null return mergeMessagesByClientMsgID result.messages const handleOnlineOnlyMessage = message: OpenIMMessageItem | null = if message == null return showTransientMessage message const newMessagesSubscription = onRecvNewMessages handleNewMessages const offlineMessagesSubscription = onRecvOfflineNewMessages handleOfflineMessages const onlineOnlySubscription = onRecvOnlineOnlyMessage handleOnlineOnlyMessage function removeMessageListeners off newMessagesSubscription off offlineMessagesSubscription off onlineOnlySubscription When an application wakes from background execution, caught up messages are typically delivered through onRecvOfflineNewMessages . The SDK layer handles lifecycle transitions and network reconnects automatically; UI views only need to react to these message events. Online only messages are dispatched when the sender sets isOnlineOnly: true . They are not persisted to the SDK's local database and are suited for transient indicators like typing alerts. Never use online only messages for critical business data that requires historical replay. Merge message states Incoming message events may contain messages for conversations other than the one currently displayed. Route messages to their respective conversation containers first, then update or insert items using the composite key of target conversation plus clientMsgID . Real time messages, offline batches, and historical query results must apply the exact same deduplication logic to prevent duplicate chat bubbles. For message revocation, deletion, and editing events, consult their respective guide pages. Event delivery does not indicate that history loading has concluded, and query completion does not preclude incremental incoming events.

title: Receive custom business messages
description: Listen for custom application-level business notifications dispatched directly by the server.
keywords: sdk uniapp v4 sdk uniapp message receiving-messages receive-custom-business-messages
content: The custom business message event listens for arbitrary application level notifications pushed directly by the backend server. The callback receives a raw string payload rather than an OpenIMMessageItem structure. In contrast, custom peer to peer chat messages created with Create a custom message /sdk/uniapp/message/creating messages/create custom message are delivered through the standard message events in Receive messages /sdk/uniapp/message/receiving messages/receive messages . Listen for custom business notifications Subscribe to backend notifications using onRecvCustomBusinessMessage . Parse and validate the payload before dispatching it to local business stores. import off, onRecvCustomBusinessMessage, from '@/uni modules/unix openim sdk' const handleCustomBusinessMessage = payload: string = const businessMessage = parseAndValidateBusinessPayload payload applyBusinessPayload businessMessage const businessMessageSubscription = onRecvCustomBusinessMessage handleCustomBusinessMessage function removeBusinessMessageListener off businessMessageSubscription State changes after the call Validate the string format, schema version, and required business identifiers before updating state. Maintain a stable notification ID in your custom protocol to deduplicate events on the client; never rely on arrival order and avoid evaluating untrusted expressions received in payloads. Unregister the listener using removeBusinessMessageListener when unmounting components, logging out, or switching accounts. To establish initial application state, query authoritative business REST APIs; events serve strictly as incremental notifications.

title: Set app badge
description: Synchronize the unread message count with the SDK’s push notification badge counter.
keywords: sdk uniapp v4 sdk uniapp message set-app-badge
content: Invoke setAppBadge to synchronize the current aggregate unread message count with the OpenIM SDK's internal push badge counter. Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | count | number | Yes | Non negative integer representing the aggregate unread message count. | Code example import setAppBadge from '@/uni modules/unix openim sdk' await setAppBadge totalUnreadCount Supply a non negative integer for totalUnreadCount . Typically invoke this method whenever the total unread count changes, after login synchronization concludes, or when all messages are marked as read. Do not pass the unread count of an individual conversation as the application badge. Return value The Promise resolves with void upon successful acceptance by the SDK. State changes after the call Promise resolution indicates that the SDK accepted the badge value for push notifications; it does not alter conversation unread counts stored locally. To reflect the badge number on the mobile OS app launcher icon, update the platform badge using the appropriate OS notification APIs. For calculating and tracking the global unread count, see Get total unread count /sdk/uniapp/conversation/managing conversations/get total unread count .

title: Load older messages
description: Paginate backward to retrieve older historical messages in a conversation.
keywords: sdk uniapp v4 sdk uniapp message retrieving-messages load-older-messages
content: When entering a chat view or scrolling upward toward older history, invoke getAdvancedHistoryMessageList to load messages backward in time. Pass an empty string "" for startClientMsgID on the initial request, and pass the oldest message's clientMsgID for subsequent pages. Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | conversationID | string | Yes | Identifier of the conversation whose history is being queried. | | startClientMsgID | string | Yes | Anchor message ID; pass an empty string "" for the first page. | | count | number | Yes | Maximum number of messages to retrieve in this page. | Code example import getAdvancedHistoryMessageList, from '@/uni modules/unix openim sdk' const page = await getAdvancedHistoryMessageList conversationID: conversationID, startClientMsgID: oldestClientMsgID, count: 30, if page = null && page.errCode == 0 prependMessages page.messageList For the initial query, initialize oldestClientMsgID as an empty string "" . When paginating further backward, supply the clientMsgID of the earliest message in the current list as the new startClientMsgID . When isEnd is true , stop requesting older messages. Return value The Promise resolves with an OpenIMAdvancedHistoryMessageListResult | null object: | Field | Type | Description | | | | | | messageList | OpenIMMessageItem | Messages retrieved for this page. | | isEnd | boolean | Indicates whether the earliest boundary of conversation history has been reached. | | errCode | number | Result status code; 0 indicates successful retrieval. | | errMsg | string | Diagnostic description accompanying errCode . | State changes after the call Both Promise rejection and a non zero errCode indicate a failed query. This call performs a read only query and does not emit new message events. Prepend retrieved messages to your conversation store scoped strictly to the current conversationID , deduplicating items by clientMsgID .

title: Load newer messages
description: Paginate forward from an anchor message toward newer historical messages.
keywords: sdk uniapp v4 sdk uniapp message retrieving-messages load-newer-messages
content: When navigating to a specific message from search results, quoted replies, or deep links, invoke getHistoryMessageList with isReverse: true to load subsequent messages toward the present. This method queries stored history forward in time; subsequent live incoming messages continue to be delivered via the event listeners in Receive messages /sdk/uniapp/message/receiving messages/receive messages . Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | conversationID | string | Yes | Identifier of the conversation containing the anchor message. | | startClientMsgID | string | Yes | Non empty clientMsgID of the anchor message from which to read forward. | | count | number | Yes | Maximum number of messages to retrieve in this page. | | isReverse | boolean | Yes | Supply true to paginate forward toward newer messages. | | viewType | OpenIMMessageViewType | No | Use OpenIMMessageViewTypeHistory ; defaults to standard history view when omitted. | Code example import OpenIMMessageViewTypeHistory, getHistoryMessageList, from '@/uni modules/unix openim sdk' const page = await getHistoryMessageList conversationID: conversationID, startClientMsgID: anchorMessage.clientMsgID ?? '', count: 30, isReverse: true, viewType: OpenIMMessageViewTypeHistory, if page = null && page.errCode == 0 appendMessages page.messageList The anchor message must possess a non null clientMsgID . If the identifier is unavailable, locate the message using Find messages by ID /sdk/uniapp/message/retrieving messages/find messages by id before invoking reverse pagination. Update startClientMsgID with the newest message in the retrieved page for subsequent requests; isEnd signifies that the latest boundary of local history has been reached. Return value The Promise resolves with an OpenIMAdvancedHistoryMessageListResult | null object containing messageList OpenIMMessageItem , isEnd boolean , errCode number , and errMsg string . State changes after the call This call performs a read only local query and does not emit message events. Append results to your UI model scoped to conversationID , deduplicating items by clientMsgID . Avoid flipping pagination directions interchangeably at the same scroll boundary.

title: Find messages by ID
description: Retrieve specific local messages by conversation ID and client message IDs.
keywords: sdk uniapp v4 sdk uniapp message retrieving-messages find-messages-by-id
content: When navigating to messages from search hits, quote reply references, or push notification intents, retain both conversationID and clientMsgID . Invoke findMessageList with an array of query descriptors to look up exact message records stored in the local database. Parameters The method accepts an array of query objects, each scoped to a single conversation: | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | conversationID | string | Yes | Identifier of the conversation containing the target messages. | | clientMsgIDList | string | Yes | Array of clientMsgID values to locate within that conversation. | Code example import findMessageList from '@/uni modules/unix openim sdk' const result = await findMessageList conversationID: conversationID, clientMsgIDList: clientMsgID , if result = null && result.findResultItems.length 0 && result.findResultItems 0 .messageList.length 0 const targetMessage = result.findResultItems 0 .messageList 0 showMessage targetMessage Return value The Promise resolves with an OpenIMFindMessageResult | null object. The totalCount property indicates total matches found across all requested conversations. The findResultItems array OpenIMFindResultItem groups returned messages by conversation, providing conversationID , display metadata, messageCount , and messageList OpenIMMessageItem . A single invocation can query multiple conversations concurrently. Do not assume positional correspondence between the input array and findResultItems ; always match entries using conversationID and locate individual items using clientMsgID . State changes after the call If a message has not yet synchronized locally, was permanently deleted, or was never created, the returned list for that entry is empty. This call performs a read only query and does not emit message events.

title: Load message context
description: Retrieve surrounding messages before and after an anchor message.
keywords: sdk uniapp v4 sdk uniapp message retrieving-messages load-message-context
content: When navigating into a conversation context from search results, quoted message clicks, or deep links, invoke fetchSurroundingMessages to load adjacent messages preceding and following an anchor message simultaneously. Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | startMessage | OpenIMMessageItem | Yes | Fully populated anchor message object. | | viewType | OpenIMMessageViewType | Yes | Use OpenIMMessageViewTypeHistory for chat timeline contexts. | | before | number | Yes | Maximum number of messages to fetch before the anchor. | | after | number | Yes | Maximum number of messages to fetch after the anchor. | Code example import OpenIMMessageViewTypeHistory, fetchSurroundingMessages, from '@/uni modules/unix openim sdk' const result = await fetchSurroundingMessages startMessage: targetMessage, viewType: OpenIMMessageViewTypeHistory, before: 20, after: 20, if result = null renderMessages result.messages Return value The Promise resolves with an OpenIMFetchSurroundingMessagesResult | null object. Retrieved context messages are stored in messages OpenIMMessageItem . The total count may be less than before + after if the anchor is close to the beginning or end of history, or if intervening messages were deleted. State changes after the call The anchor startMessage must be a valid OpenIMMessageItem instance obtained from a query or message event; do not supply hand crafted partial objects. Merge the surrounding messages into your view model using clientMsgID . If you need to retrieve the anchor message item first, see Find messages by ID /sdk/uniapp/message/retrieving messages/find messages by id . This call is a local read only query and does not emit message events.

title: Search messages
description: Search messages stored in the local database by keywords, sender, message type, and time range.
keywords: sdk uniapp v4 sdk uniapp message searching-messages search-messages
content: Invoke searchLocalMessages to search through messages synchronized into the current device's local database. This call does not perform full text indexing queries against backend servers. When searching within a group, supply the group's conversationID rather than its groupID ; omitting conversationID or passing null searches across all conversations stored locally. Global cross user auditing, server wide message retrieval, and complex server side ranking should be performed via backend services, returning matched conversation IDs and message IDs to the client for local navigation. Parameters The UTS signature requires all properties in the search options object. Provide an empty array for unused array filters and 0 for disabled timestamp criteria: | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | conversationID | string \| null | No | Scope query to a specific conversation; pass null or omit to search across all local conversations. | | keywordList | string | Yes | Non empty array of keyword strings to match. | | keywordListMatchType | number | Yes | Matching mode: 0 matches any keyword OR ; 1 requires all keywords AND . | | senderUserIDList | string | Yes | Filter by sender user IDs; supply for no sender restriction. | | messageTypeList | OpenIMMessageType | Yes | Filter by message types; supply for all message types. | | searchTimePosition | number | Yes | UTC second level starting timestamp; supply 0 to start from current time. | | searchTimePeriod | number | Yes | Number of seconds to look backward from searchTimePosition ; supply 0 for unlimited time span. | | pageIndex | number | Yes | Page index starting from 1 . | | count | number | Yes | Maximum number of results to retrieve per page. | Code example import OpenIMMessageTypeAtText, OpenIMMessageTypeText, searchLocalMessages, from '@/uni modules/unix openim sdk' const keyword = searchText.trim if keyword.length == 0 return const result = await searchLocalMessages conversationID: conversationID, keywordList: keyword , keywordListMatchType: 0, senderUserIDList: , messageTypeList: OpenIMMessageTypeText, OpenIMMessageTypeAtText , searchTimePosition: 0, searchTimePeriod: 0, pageIndex: 1, count: 20, Return value The Promise resolves with an OpenIMSearchMessageResult | null object: | Field | Type | Description | | | | | | totalCount | number | Total number of matching messages under the given criteria. | | searchResultItems | OpenIMSearchMessageResultItem | Search results grouped by conversation. | Each item in searchResultItems contains conversationID , conversationType , showName , faceURL , messageCount , and messageList OpenIMMessageItem . When navigating to a search hit, navigate using conversationID and the message's clientMsgID . State changes after the call This call is a local read only database query and does not trigger message events.

title: Update typing status
description: Report whether the current user is actively typing in a conversation.
keywords: sdk uniapp v4 sdk uniapp message composing-messages update-typing-status
content: Invoke changeInputStates with focus: true when a user begins typing in the chat composer, and pass focus: false when they send the message, blur the input field, switch chats, or remain idle. Typing indicators are transient session states; they are not saved as message drafts or logged in history. Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | conversationID | string | Yes | Identifier of the active conversation. | | focus | boolean | Yes | Typing focus indicator; true indicates active composition, and false indicates stopped. | | userID | string \| null | No | Target user ID; typically omitted or null , allowing the SDK to automatically default to the authenticated user. | Throttle and deduplicate typing events in your composer view model rather than triggering this method on every raw keystroke. Implement a client side timeout fallback: if a user navigates away or network drops before focus: false is sent, automatically clear the indicator on recipient devices after a few seconds. Code example import changeInputStates from '@/uni modules/unix openim sdk' await changeInputStates conversationID, focus: true, // When typing ceases or input loses focus: await changeInputStates conversationID, focus: false, Return value The Promise resolves with void upon successful completion. State changes after the call Promise resolution indicates that the typing status was transmitted to the server; it does not guarantee that peer devices have rendered the typing notice. For receiving incoming typing signals and querying peer typing states, see Get typing status /sdk/uniapp/message/composing messages/get typing status .

title: Get typing status
description: Query and listen for member typing status across platforms within a conversation.
keywords: sdk uniapp v4 sdk uniapp message composing-messages get-typing-status
content: When entering a conversation or reconnecting after a connection drop, invoke getInputStates to determine which client platforms a specific chat member is actively typing on. Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | conversationID | string | Yes | Target conversation ID. | | userID | string | Yes | User ID of the member whose typing status is being queried. | Code example import getInputStates from '@/uni modules/unix openim sdk' const result = await getInputStates conversationID, userID: memberUserID, const platformIDs = result?.platforms ?? setTyping memberUserID, platformIDs.length 0 Return value The Promise resolves with an OpenIMGetInputStatesResult | null object. The platforms property contains an array of OpenIMPlatform values indicating active platforms for that user. An empty array indicates that the member is not actively typing on any platform. Listen for incoming typing indicators Centrally register onConversationUserInputStatusChanged to observe incoming typing indicators. The event delivers an OpenIMConversationInputStatusItem | null containing conversationID , userID , and platformIDs . Merge typing states using conversationID:userID as the key. import OpenIMConversationInputStatusItem, off, onConversationUserInputStatusChanged, from '@/uni modules/unix openim sdk' const handleInputStatusChanged = status: OpenIMConversationInputStatusItem | null, = if status == null return updateTypingState status.conversationID, status.userID, status.platformIDs, const inputStatusSubscription = onConversationUserInputStatusChanged handleInputStatusChanged function removeTypingStatusListener off inputStatusSubscription Unregister the listener when closing the chat view or switching accounts.

title: Check speech-to-text availability
description: Query supported audio formats, sample rates, and limits for the speech-to-text engine.
keywords: sdk uniapp v4 sdk uniapp message composing-messages check-speech-to-text
content: Speech to text transcription is a Commercial Edition capability. Prior to exposing a transcription button or capturing audio for transcription, invoke getSpeechToTextCapabilities to query the formats and size limits supported by the backend speech service. This method accepts no parameters. Code example import getSpeechToTextCapabilities from '@/uni modules/unix openim sdk' const capabilities = await getSpeechToTextCapabilities if capabilities == null disableSpeechToText Return value The Promise resolves with an OpenIMSpeechToTextCapabilitiesResult | null object: | Field | Type | Description | | | | | | format | string \| null | Audio container and codec formats supported by the service for example, 'm4a', 'wav' . | | sampleRateHz | number \| null | List of supported sample rates in Hertz. | | maxRecordTimeMs | number \| null | Maximum allowable recording duration in milliseconds. | | maxFileSize | number \| null | Maximum audio file size in bytes. | | provider | string \| null | Active transcription provider identifier. | | requestType | string \| null | Protocol request type used by the transcription engine. | | crossDomain | boolean \| null | Whether the provider supports cross domain requests. | All fields are optional in the public type declarations. Validate only those restrictions explicitly returned by the server. When the call returns null , fails, or lacks critical capabilities, hide or disable the transcription entry point rather than guessing support boundaries. State changes after the call This call is a read only capability query and does not record audio, transcribe speech, or emit message events.

title: Transcribe audio
description: Convert audio recordings into transcribed text using the speech-to-text service.
keywords: sdk uniapp v4 sdk uniapp message composing-messages transcribe-audio
content: Audio transcription is a Commercial Edition capability. Invoke speechToText with the audio filename and the audio binary encoded as a pure Base64 string. Do not pass temporary filesystem paths, ArrayBuffer objects, or Data URLs containing data: ;base64, headers. Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | filename | string | Yes | Audio filename with an extension matching the audio format for example, 'voice.m4a' . | | data | string | Yes | Raw Base64 encoded audio payload string without data URI prefixes. | Verify that your audio adheres to format, sample rate, and size limits beforehand by invoking Check speech to text availability /sdk/uniapp/message/composing messages/check speech to text . Read recording files immediately before the OS sweeps temporary directories, or copy them to uni.env.USER DATA PATH . Code example import speechToText from '@/uni modules/unix openim sdk' const result = await speechToText filename: 'voice.m4a', data: audioBase64, const transcript = result?.text ?? '' showTranscript transcript Return value The Promise resolves with an OpenIMSpeechToTextResult | null object. The transcribed text string is located in text . State changes after the call Transcription output is returned solely as the response to this call; it does not alter the original voice message or emit message events. To cache this transcription text locally on the current device, merge it into the message's localEx via Set message local extension /sdk/uniapp/message/managing messages/set message local ex .

title: Save local transcript
description: Replace the content payload of a message directly in the local device database.
keywords: sdk uniapp v4 sdk uniapp message composing-messages save-local-transcript
content: Updating local message content is a Commercial Edition capability used to replace message payload content stored in the device's local database. It accepts a complete OpenIMMessageItem struct rather than updating individual string fields in isolation. The following example demonstrates updating a local message's text element. Retain all original message headers and update the element matching contentType : import OpenIMMessageItem, setMessageLocalContent, from '@/uni modules/unix openim sdk' const updatedMessage = JSON.parse JSON.stringify message , const textElem = updatedMessage.textElem if textElem == null return textElem.content = 'Text displayed exclusively on this device' updatedMessage.textElem = textElem await setMessageLocalContent conversationID, message: updatedMessage, Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | conversationID | string | Yes | Identifier of the conversation containing the message. | | message | OpenIMMessageItem | Yes | Full message struct retaining original identifiers and updated content elements. | Clone the object via serialization to avoid modifying in memory references directly, and avoid passing abbreviated objects that omit mandatory message properties. Return value The Promise resolves with void upon successful local database persistence. State changes after the call Promise resolution indicates that the local database record was updated. This change is never transmitted to OpenIMServer, does not synchronize to other participants, and does not emit shared network message events. Update your local UI state using conversationID:clientMsgID . Note that OpenIMSoundElem in the UniApp SDK does not expose a dedicated voice transcription property. If your application needs to persist voice transcriptions or auxiliary presentation flags without modifying the message element itself, see Set message local extension /sdk/uniapp/message/managing messages/set message local ex to store data in localEx .

title: Modify a message
description: Edit the content of an already-sent message and synchronize edits with chat participants.
keywords: sdk uniapp v4 sdk uniapp message managing-messages modify-a-message
content: Modifying messages is a Commercial Edition capability. It updates the content of an existing message in place and synchronizes changes across all chat participants. This differs from deleting a message which affects visibility for specific users and revoking a message which converts the item into a revocation notice . Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | conversationID | string | Yes | Identifier of the conversation containing the message. | | message | OpenIMMessageItem | Yes | Modified message object; must preserve original clientMsgID and mandatory headers. | This method is not a partial field patch. Clone the original message record, modify only the payload element corresponding to contentType , and pass the complete message struct. In UTS, avoid TypeScript object spread syntax ...obj ; clone using JSON serialization instead. Permission rules, editable message types, and edit time windows are strictly validated by OpenIMServer. Code example import OpenIMMessageItem, modifyMessage, from '@/uni modules/unix openim sdk' const updatedMessage = JSON.parse JSON.stringify message , const textElem = updatedMessage.textElem if textElem == null return textElem.content = editedText updatedMessage.textElem = textElem const result = await modifyMessage conversationID, message: updatedMessage, const modifiedMessage = result?.message if modifiedMessage = null replaceMessage conversationID, modifiedMessage Return value The Promise resolves with an OpenIMModifyMessageResult | null object. The updated message record is contained in message OpenIMMessageItem | null . Replace the existing message in your local list using conversationID:clientMsgID . Listen for message modifications Centrally register onMessageModified to listen for message modifications. The event delivers an opaque string notification signal. Treat this signal as an invalidation trigger to re query currently visible messages rather than assuming an undocumented JSON schema. import off, onMessageModified from '@/uni modules/unix openim sdk' const handleMessageModified = payload: string = reloadVisibleMessages const messageModifiedSubscription = onMessageModified handleMessageModified function removeMessageModifiedListener off messageModifiedSubscription Unregister the listener when unmounting views, logging out, or switching accounts.

title: Revoke a message
description: Revoke a previously sent message across chat participants and handle revocation events.
keywords: sdk uniapp v4 sdk uniapp message managing-messages revoke-a-message
content: Invoke revokeMessage when a message needs to be withdrawn so that participants see a "Message was revoked" placeholder. Never substitute local or bulk deletion when the intent is to revoke the message for all chat participants. Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | conversationID | string | Yes | Identifier of the conversation containing the message. | | clientMsgID | string | Yes | The clientMsgID of the message to revoke. | Code example import revokeMessage from '@/uni modules/unix openim sdk' const clientMsgID = message.clientMsgID if clientMsgID == null return await revokeMessage conversationID, clientMsgID, Allowed revoking roles, time windows, and supported message types are authoritatively enforced by OpenIMServer. If the request fails, do not maintain a revoked placeholder in local state. Return value The Promise resolves with a confirmation string upon successful processing. It does not return a full updated message object; update your local UI model using the original clientMsgID optimistically, confirming state via subsequent queries if necessary. Listen for revoked messages Centrally register onNewRecvMessageRevoked to observe message revocations. When another user or device revokes a message, the SDK triggers onNewRecvMessageRevoked . Update the existing message bubble in your view model to its revoked placeholder state using conversationID:clientMsgID , rather than removing the message item completely from the list. import OpenIMMessageRevokedItem, off, onNewRecvMessageRevoked, from '@/uni modules/unix openim sdk' const handleMessageRevoked = revoked: OpenIMMessageRevokedItem | null, = if revoked == null return markMessageRevoked revoked.clientMsgID, revoked const revokedSubscription = onNewRecvMessageRevoked handleMessageRevoked function removeMessageRevokedListener off revokedSubscription The OpenIMMessageRevokedItem object supplies revoker information, revocation timestamp, and revoker role, allowing you to format contextual system notices for example, "Admin revoked a message" . Unregister the listener when the page unmounts or upon switching accounts.

title: Delete saved messages
description: Batch delete multiple messages from a conversation and listen for synchronization events across devices.
keywords: sdk uniapp v4 sdk uniapp message managing-messages delete-saved-messages
content: Batch deleting messages is a Commercial Edition capability. All messages specified in a single call must belong to the exact same conversation. Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | conversationID | string | Yes | Identifier of the conversation containing the target messages. | | clientMsgIDs | string | Yes | Array of clientMsgID values belonging to this conversation. | | IsSync | boolean | Yes | Whether to synchronize the deletion across other devices logged into the current account; note the PascalCase capitalization. | Code example import deleteMessages from '@/uni modules/unix openim sdk' await deleteMessages conversationID, clientMsgIDs: selectedMessageIDs, IsSync: true, Passing IsSync: false deletes the records from the local device and server for the current account. Passing IsSync: true additionally dispatches deletion notifications to other client instances logged into the same account. It does not delete message copies stored by other chat participants or create a revocation notice. Return value The Promise resolves with void upon successful completion. Listen for synchronized message deletions Centrally subscribe to onMsgDeleted to handle synchronized message deletions. The callback directly receives the deleted OpenIMMessageItem | null object. Determine the owning conversation and remove the item from local state using conversationID:clientMsgID . Duplicate event deliveries should be handled idempotently. import OpenIMMessageItem, off, onMsgDeleted, from '@/uni modules/unix openim sdk' const handleMessageDeleted = message: OpenIMMessageItem | null = if message == null || message.clientMsgID == null return const messageConversationID = resolveMessageConversationID message removeMessage messageConversationID, message.clientMsgID const messageDeletedSubscription = onMsgDeleted handleMessageDeleted function removeMessageDeletedListener off messageDeletedSubscription Unregister the listener when unmounting the view, logging out, or switching accounts. To calibrate message state after network reconnects, re query the conversation's history list.

title: Delete user messages
description: Purge all messages sent by a specific user within a group chat.
keywords: sdk uniapp v4 sdk uniapp message managing-messages delete-user-messages
content: Invoke deleteUserAllMessagesInConv to purge all messages sent by a specific member in a group conversation. This is an administrative moderation action; caller permissions are verified authoritatively by OpenIMServer. Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | conversationID | string | Yes | Target group conversation ID. | | userID | string | Yes | User ID of the member whose messages are being purged. | Code example import deleteUserAllMessagesInConv from '@/uni modules/unix openim sdk' await deleteUserAllMessagesInConv conversationID, userID: targetUserID, Return value The Promise resolves with void upon successful server processing. Listen for user message purge events Centrally register onDeleteUserAllMsgsInConv to capture group message purge notifications. The event provides an opaque string signal.
