This method queries explicitly by userID ; if you need to search users by phone number, nickname, organization, or email, perform that lookup on your business backend to obtain candidate userID lists first: Code example import sdk, GetUsersInfoReq, GetUsersInfoResp from '@openimsdk/imsdk'; const request: GetUsersInfoReq = userIDs: 'user a', 'user b' , ; const response: GetUsersInfoResp = await sdk.getUsersInfo request ; for let index = 0; index < response.users.length; index += 1 const user = response.users index ; usersByID.set user.userID, user ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | userIDs | string | Yes | List of user IDs to retrieve. Deduplicate and remove empty values before calling. | Return value Returns a Promise that resolves to a GetUsersInfoResp object containing users: IMUser : | Property | Type | Description | | | | | | userID | string | Unique user identifier. | | nickname | string | Public account level nickname. | | faceURL | string | Avatar URL. | | ex | string | Custom metadata extension string. | | createTime | number | Account creation timestamp in Unix milliseconds. | | globalRecvMsgOpt | GlobalRecvMsgOpt | Account message reception preference. | | attached | string | Additional engine metadata. | | addFriendPermission | AddFriendPermission | Friend request verification policy. | State changes after the call The returned array may not match the order of input IDs; map records by userID . When rendering user profiles, maintain separate fields for account nickname, friend remark, group member nickname, and conversation display name rather than overriding one with another. This query does not trigger events; re query when updated snapshots are required.

title: Retrieve current user profile
description: Fetch the account profile and global preferences of the currently signed-in user.
keywords: sdk harmony v4 sdk harmony user profile get-self-user-info
content: Query the current user profile without passing parameters to retrieve the signed in account's IMUser record: Code example import sdk, GetSelfUserInfoResp from '@openimsdk/imsdk'; const response: GetSelfUserInfoResp = await sdk.getSelfUserInfo ; setCurrentUser response.user ; Return value Returns a Promise that resolves to a GetSelfUserInfoResp object containing the user's account details: | Property | Type | Description | | | | | | userID | string | Unique identifier of the signed in user. | | nickname | string | Account level nickname. | | faceURL | string | Avatar image URL. | | ex | string | Application defined custom user metadata string. | | globalRecvMsgOpt | GlobalRecvMsgOpt | Global default message reception preference. | | addFriendPermission | AddFriendPermission | Verification rule when other users send friend requests. | | createTime | number | Account creation timestamp in Unix milliseconds. | | attached | string | Additional engine metadata; parse only under explicit backend agreements. | State changes after the call This method returns a point in time snapshot and does not emit events. For listening to profile updates, see Update current user profile /sdk/harmony/user/profile/set self info . Always clear cached profile data when signing out or switching accounts.

title: Update current user profile
description: Modify the nickname, avatar URL, or custom metadata string for the currently signed-in user.
keywords: sdk harmony v4 sdk harmony user profile set-self-info
content: Submit only the fields you wish to modify. The userID must match the signed in account. Do not mix profile fields like nickname and avatar with global notification settings in a single operation: Code example import sdk, EventOnSelfInfoUpdatedData, OpenIMSDKEvent, SetSelfInfoReq from '@openimsdk/imsdk'; const request: SetSelfInfoReq = userID: currentUserID, nickname: nickname.trim , faceURL: avatarURL, ex: mergedExtra, ; await sdk.setSelfInfo request ; const handleSelfInfoUpdated = data: EventOnSelfInfoUpdatedData : void = setCurrentUser data.user ; ; const unsubscribeSelfInfo = sdk.on OpenIMSDKEvent.EventOnSelfInfoUpdated, handleSelfInfoUpdated ; export function removeSelfInfoListener : void unsubscribeSelfInfo ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | userID | string | Yes | Signed in user identifier. | | nickname | string | No | New user nickname. | | faceURL | string | No | New avatar URL. | | ex | string | No | Updated complete custom metadata string. | Return value Returns a Promise that resolves to void upon updating the profile on the server. State changes after the call The ex field is an opaque string; the SDK does not automatically merge nested JSON schemas. If multiple features share this field, merge namespaced keys in application memory before saving. Promise resolution indicates that the server accepted the changes. Listen for EventOnSelfInfoUpdated to update reactive UI state across devices. Remove the listener via removeSelfInfoListener upon sign out. For manual reconciliation, re query Retrieve current user profile /sdk/harmony/user/profile/get self user info . For notification and permission settings, see Set global message reception /sdk/harmony/user/profile/set global message reception and Set friend request permission /sdk/harmony/user/profile/set friend add permission .

title: Set global message reception
description: Configure the account-wide default message receiving and notification option.
keywords: sdk harmony v4 sdk harmony user profile set-global-message-reception
content: The globalRecvMsgOpt field governs the account wide default notification policy, operating independently of user nicknames or avatars. Standard interfaces provide the following two options: Code example import sdk, GlobalRecvMsgOpt, SetSelfInfoReq from '@openimsdk/imsdk'; const request: SetSelfInfoReq = userID: currentUserID, globalRecvMsgOpt: GlobalRecvMsgOpt.NotNotify, ; await sdk.setSelfInfo request ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | userID | string | Yes | Signed in user identifier. | | globalRecvMsgOpt | GlobalRecvMsgOpt | Yes | Global notification preference enum value. | | Option | Value | Description | | | | | | GlobalRecvMsgOpt.Normal | 0 | Normal message reception with push notifications. | | GlobalRecvMsgOpt.NotNotify | 2 | Receive messages silently without notifications account wide DND . | To disable global DND, reset the property back to GlobalRecvMsgOpt.Normal . Return value Returns a Promise that resolves to void when the setting is updated. State changes after the call Per conversation reception settings provide finer granularity; see Set message receive option /sdk/harmony/conversation/managing conversations/set message receive option . When both global and conversation settings exist, evaluate the final delivery behavior from the conversation's recvMsgOpt . After the Promise resolves, await EventOnSelfInfoUpdated or re query via Retrieve current user profile /sdk/harmony/user/profile/get self user info .

title: Set friend request permission
description: Configure the verification policy applied when other users send friend requests to the current account.
keywords: sdk harmony v4 sdk harmony user profile set-friend-add-permission
content: This account level policy governs incoming friend requests. It only affects subsequent friend applications and does not alter existing friendships or pending requests: Code example import sdk, AddFriendPermission, SetSelfInfoReq from '@openimsdk/imsdk'; const request: SetSelfInfoReq = userID: currentUserID, addFriendPermission: AddFriendPermission.AddFriendAllowed, ; await sdk.setSelfInfo request ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | userID | string | Yes | Signed in user identifier. | | addFriendPermission | AddFriendPermission | Yes | Friend request verification policy. | | Option | Value | Description | | | | | | AddFriendPermission.AddFriendAllowed | 0 | Allow applications; requires manual approval by the current user. | | AddFriendPermission.AddFriendAllowedNoReview | 1 | Automatically accept friend requests without manual review. | | AddFriendPermission.AddFriendDenied | 2 | Reject all incoming friend requests. | Return value Returns a Promise that resolves to void when the setting is saved on the server. State changes after the call Resolving the Promise confirms that the permission policy has been updated. To verify the active policy, call Retrieve current user profile /sdk/harmony/user/profile/get self user info and inspect addFriendPermission on the returned IMUser record.

title: Subscribe to user online status
description: Subscribe to online platform presence for specific users and handle real-time status transitions.
keywords: sdk harmony v4 sdk harmony user online-status subscribe-users-status
content: Online status indicates whether a user maintains an active connection to OpenIMServer; it does not indicate whether they are currently viewing a particular conversation or foreground app window. Subscribe only to users currently visible on the screen, and keep the total active subscription count under 3,000 users per account: Code example import sdk, EventOnUserOnlineStatusChangedData, OpenIMSDKEvent, SubscribeUsersOnlineStatusReq, SubscribeUsersOnlineStatusResp, from '@openimsdk/imsdk'; const request: SubscribeUsersOnlineStatusReq = userIDs: 'user a', 'user b' , ; const response: SubscribeUsersOnlineStatusResp = await sdk.subscribeUsersOnlineStatus request ; for let index = 0; index presenceByUserID.set data.userID, data.platforms ; ; const unsubscribeStatusEvent = sdk.on OpenIMSDKEvent.EventOnUserOnlineStatusChanged, handleStatusChanged, ; export function removeOnlineStatusListener : void unsubscribeStatusEvent ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | userIDs | string | Yes | List of user IDs to subscribe to. Limit to active UI contacts. | Return value Returns a Promise that resolves to a SubscribeUsersOnlineStatusResp object containing initial presence states: | Property | Type | Description | | | | | | userID | string | Monitored user identifier. | | platforms | Platform | Array of platforms where the user is currently connected. Empty if offline. | State changes after the call Resolving the Promise yields the current online platform snapshot. Incremental online/offline status changes arrive via EventOnUserOnlineStatusChanged ; update your state map by userID . Detach the listener with removeOnlineStatusListener upon sign out. When views unmount and presence for those users is no longer needed, call Unsubscribe from user online status /sdk/harmony/user/online status/unsubscribe users status to release server subscription quotas.

title: Unsubscribe from user online status
description: Stop receiving online status notifications for specific user IDs.
keywords: sdk harmony v4 sdk harmony user online-status unsubscribe-users-status
content: When views unmount, paginated lists scroll away, or search results change, unsubscribe from unneeded user status updates to free server quota: Code example import sdk, UnsubscribeUsersOnlineStatusReq from '@openimsdk/imsdk'; const request: UnsubscribeUsersOnlineStatusReq = userIDs: 'user a', 'user b' , ; await sdk.unsubscribeUsersOnlineStatus request ; for let index = 0; index < request.userIDs.length; index += 1 presenceByUserID.delete request.userIDs index ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | userIDs | string | Yes | List of user IDs to unsubscribe from. | Return value Returns a Promise that resolves to void when the unsubscription instruction is processed. State changes after the call Once the Promise resolves, delete the corresponding userID entries from your local presence cache; you do not need to wait for status change events. Unsubscribing specific user IDs and removing global event listeners are separate operations; for subscription workflows and listener details, see Subscribe to user online status /sdk/harmony/user/online status/subscribe users status .

title: Paginate friend list
description: Paginate friend relationships for the signed-in user and listen for real-time friend updates.
keywords: sdk harmony v4 sdk harmony user friends get-friend-list-page
content: Initialize contact lists by starting with pageNumber: 1 . When friends are added or deleted, reset the pagination offset to page 1 to prevent duplicated or missing rows across page boundaries: Code example import sdk, EventOnFriendAddedData, EventOnFriendDeletedData, EventOnFriendInfoChangedData, GetFriendsPageReq, GetFriendsPageResp, OpenIMSDKEvent, from '@openimsdk/imsdk'; const request: GetFriendsPageReq = filterBlack: true, pagination: pageNumber: 1, showNumber: 50, , ; const response: GetFriendsPageResp = await sdk.getFriendsPage request ; replaceFriends response.friends ; const handleFriendAdded = data: EventOnFriendAddedData : void = mergeFriend data.friend ; ; const handleFriendChanged = data: EventOnFriendInfoChangedData : void = mergeFriend data.friend ; ; const handleFriendDeleted = data: EventOnFriendDeletedData : void = removeFriend data.friend.friendUserID ; ; const unsubscribeAdded = sdk.on OpenIMSDKEvent.EventOnFriendAdded, handleFriendAdded ; const unsubscribeChanged = sdk.on OpenIMSDKEvent.EventOnFriendInfoChanged, handleFriendChanged ; const unsubscribeDeleted = sdk.on OpenIMSDKEvent.EventOnFriendDeleted, handleFriendDeleted ; export function removeFriendListListeners : void unsubscribeAdded ; unsubscribeChanged ; unsubscribeDeleted ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | filterBlack | boolean | Yes | Set to true to exclude blocked users from the returned list. | | pagination.pageNumber | number | Yes | Page index, starting from 1 . | | pagination.showNumber | number | Yes | Number of friend items to fetch per page. | Return value Returns a Promise that resolves to a GetFriendsPageResp object containing friends: IMFriend : | Property | Type | Description | | | | | | friendUserID | string | Unique user identifier of the friend. | | nickname | string | Friend's public nickname. | | faceURL | string | Friend's avatar URL. | | remark | string | Private remark note set by the current account. | | isPinned | boolean | Whether this friend is pinned in the contact directory. | | ex | string | Application defined relationship metadata string. | | ownerUserID | string | Current signed in user ID owning this friendship record. | | createTime | number | Friendship creation timestamp in Unix milliseconds. | State changes after the call Resolving the Promise populates the initial friend snapshot. Real time changes arrive through EventOnFriendAdded , EventOnFriendInfoChanged , and EventOnFriendDeleted ; correlate updates using friendUserID . Invoke removeFriendListListeners when signing out or unmounting contact components. Re query whenever network synchronization completes or page boundaries require reconciliation.

title: Get friend count
description: Retrieve the total number of friend relationships established by the current account.
keywords: sdk harmony v4 sdk harmony user friends get-friend-count
content: Query the aggregate friend relationship count without supplying parameters. This count is useful for contact statistics or determining whether to continue paging: Code example import sdk, GetFriendListCountResp from '@openimsdk/imsdk'; const response: GetFriendListCountResp = await sdk.getFriendListCount ; showFriendCount response.count ; Return value Returns a Promise that resolves to a GetFriendListCountResp object: | Property | Type | Description | | | | | | count | number | The total count of active friends in the local SDK database. | State changes after the call The returned count reflects a point in time total and does not emit events. Maintain the count incrementally when friends are added or removed using the events documented in Paginate friend list /sdk/harmony/user/friends/get friend list page , and re query whenever calibration is required.

title: Search friends
description: Search friends locally by user ID, nickname, or remark note.
keywords: sdk harmony v4 sdk harmony user friends search-friends
content: Trim leading and trailing whitespace from the search keyword, and enable at least one matching dimension: Code example import sdk, SearchFriendsReq, SearchFriendsResp from '@openimsdk/imsdk'; const request: SearchFriendsReq = keyword: keyword.trim , searchUserID: true, searchNickname: true, searchRemark: true, ; const response: SearchFriendsResp = await sdk.searchFriends request ; showSearchResults response.friends ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | keyword | string | Yes | Search query string. | | searchUserID | boolean | Yes | Whether to match user IDs. | | searchNickname | boolean | Yes | Whether to match public nicknames. | | searchRemark | boolean | Yes | Whether to match private friend remarks. | Return value Returns a Promise that resolves to a SearchFriendsResp object containing friends: SearchFriendsInfo : | Property | Type | Description | | | | | | friend | IMFriend | Matched friend relationship object. | | relationship | number | Numerical indicator representing relationship type. | State changes after the call Search results represent filtered views and must not overwrite the baseline friend cache loaded via Paginate friend list /sdk/harmony/user/friends/get friend list page . Correlate results with cached items using friend.friendUserID . This query runs locally and does not emit events.

title: Retrieve specified friend profiles
description: Batch query detailed friendship records for a list of friend user IDs.
keywords: sdk harmony v4 sdk harmony user friends get-specified-friends-info
content: Query friendship records for specific user IDs. This method only returns users with whom you have an established friendship; to retrieve public profiles for strangers, see Retrieve user profiles /sdk/harmony/user/profile/get users info : Code example import sdk, GetSpecifiedFriendsReq, GetSpecifiedFriendsResp from '@openimsdk/imsdk'; const request: GetSpecifiedFriendsReq = friendUserIDs: 'user a', 'user b' , filterBlack: true, ; const response: GetSpecifiedFriendsResp = await sdk.getSpecifiedFriends request ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | friendUserIDs | string | Yes | List of user IDs to look up. | | filterBlack | boolean | Yes | Set to true to omit users currently present in the blocklist. | Return value Returns a Promise that resolves to a GetSpecifiedFriendsResp object: | Property | Type | Description | | | | | | friendsInfo | IMFriend | Array of found friendship records. | State changes after the call The returned array might contain fewer items than requested if some user IDs are not friends. Order is not guaranteed to match the input list; map items using friendUserID . For friend event listening and complete field definitions, see Paginate friend list /sdk/harmony/user/friends/get friend list page .

title: Check friend relationship
description: Batch verify whether specific users are mutual friends with the current account.
keywords: sdk harmony v4 sdk harmony user friends check-friend
content: Batch check friendship status for an array of candidate user IDs: Code example import sdk, CheckFriendReq, CheckFriendResp from '@openimsdk/imsdk'; const request: CheckFriendReq = friendUserIDs: 'user a', 'user b' , ; const response: CheckFriendResp = await sdk.checkFriend request ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | friendUserIDs | string | Yes | List of user IDs to check. | Return value Returns a Promise that resolves to a CheckFriendResp object containing check results: | Property | Type | Description | | | | | | userID | string | Evaluated user ID. | | result | CheckFriendResult | Friendship status: CheckFriendResult.IsFriend 1 or CheckFriendResult.NotFriend 0 . | State changes after the call This method only inspects friendship status; it does not evaluate blocklist records see Retrieve blocklist /sdk/harmony/user/blacklist/get black list or emit real time events. For contact directory maintenance, see Paginate friend list /sdk/harmony/user/friends/get friend list page .

title: Update friend profile
description: Modify a friend’s remark note, pinned status, or custom relationship metadata.
keywords: sdk harmony v4 sdk harmony user friends update-friends
content: Update friend information one friend at a time. Include only the fields you wish to change. The ex parameter is an opaque replacement string; the engine does not automatically merge existing JSON attributes: Code example import sdk, UpdateFriendReq from '@openimsdk/imsdk'; const request: UpdateFriendReq = userID: friendUserID, remark: remark.trim , pinned: true, ; await sdk.updateFriend request ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | userID | string | Yes | Target friend's user identifier. | | remark | string | No | Private remark note for this friend. | | pinned | boolean | No | Whether to pin this friend in contact listings. | | ex | string | No | Updated complete relationship metadata string. | Return value Returns a Promise that resolves to void upon updating the friend record on the server. State changes after the call Resolving the Promise confirms that the request reached the server; it does not guarantee that asynchronous friend events have arrived. When EventOnFriendInfoChanged arrives, update local state keyed by friendUserID matching the target userID . For listener setup, see Paginate friend list /sdk/harmony/user/friends/get friend list page .

title: Delete friend
description: Remove a user from the current account’s friend relationships.
keywords: sdk harmony v4 sdk harmony user friends delete-friend
content: Remove an active friend relationship for the signed in account: Code example import sdk, DeleteFriendReq from '@openimsdk/imsdk'; const request: DeleteFriendReq = userID: friendUserID, ; await sdk.deleteFriend request ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | userID | string | Yes | Target user identifier to remove from friends. | Return value Returns a Promise that resolves to void upon deletion. State changes after the call Promise resolution indicates that the deletion request was processed on the server. Remove the record from your local friend directory matched by friendUserID matching the target userID . Real time event handling is detailed in Paginate friend list /sdk/harmony/user/friends/get friend list page . Deleting a friend does not block the user or delete chat history; to block a user, see Add user to blocklist /sdk/harmony/user/blacklist/add black .

title: Send friend application
description: Send a friend request to a designated user with an optional verification message.
keywords: sdk harmony v4 sdk harmony user friend-applications add-friend
content: Do not send friend requests to your own userID or to users who are already friends. The reqMsg parameter provides greeting or verification notes, while ex contains custom application metadata: Code example import sdk, AddFriendReq from '@openimsdk/imsdk'; const request: AddFriendReq = userID: targetUserID, reqMsg: verificationMessage, ex: '', ; await sdk.addFriend request ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | userID | string | Yes | Target recipient user ID. | | reqMsg | string | No | Optional verification note or greeting message. | | ex | string | No | Custom application metadata string. | Return value Returns a Promise that resolves to void when the request has been submitted to the server. State changes after the call Promise resolution confirms that the application has been queued on the server; it does not mean that the target user has approved the request or that friendship has been established. To track outgoing applications, see Retrieve sent friend applications /sdk/harmony/user/friend applications/get friend application list as applicant . For incoming request events, see Retrieve received friend applications /sdk/harmony/user/friend applications/get friend application list as recipient .

title: Retrieve received friend applications
description: Paginate incoming friend applications received by the current account and listen for application lifecycle events.
keywords: sdk harmony v4 sdk harmony user friend-applications get-friend-application-list-as-recipient
content: Pass send: false to query incoming friend requests received by the signed in user. Passing an empty array in handleResults retrieves requests across all review states: Code example import sdk, EventOnFriendApplicationAcceptedData, EventOnFriendApplicationAddedData, EventOnFriendApplicationDeletedData, EventOnFriendApplicationRejectedData, GetFriendApplicationReq, GetFriendApplicationResp, HandleResult, OpenIMSDKEvent, from '@openimsdk/imsdk'; const request: GetFriendApplicationReq = send: false, handleResults: HandleResult.ResultDefault , pagination: pageNumber: 1, showNumber: 20, , ; const response: GetFriendApplicationResp = await sdk.getFriendApplication request ; replaceReceivedApplications response.applications ; const handleAdded = data: EventOnFriendApplicationAddedData : void = mergeFriendApplication data.application ; ; const handleAccepted = data: EventOnFriendApplicationAcceptedData : void = mergeFriendApplication data.application ; ; const handleRejected = data: EventOnFriendApplicationRejectedData : void = mergeFriendApplication data.application ; ; const handleDeleted = data: EventOnFriendApplicationDeletedData : void = removeFriendApplication data.application.fromUserID, data.application.toUserID ; ; const unsubscribeAdded = sdk.on OpenIMSDKEvent.EventOnFriendApplicationAdded, handleAdded ; const unsubscribeAccepted = sdk.on OpenIMSDKEvent.EventOnFriendApplicationAccepted, handleAccepted ; const unsubscribeRejected = sdk.on OpenIMSDKEvent.EventOnFriendApplicationRejected, handleRejected ; const unsubscribeDeleted = sdk.on OpenIMSDKEvent.EventOnFriendApplicationDeleted, handleDeleted ; export function removeReceivedFriendApplicationListeners : void unsubscribeAdded ; unsubscribeAccepted ; unsubscribeRejected ; unsubscribeDeleted ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | send | boolean | Yes | Set to false to query incoming applications received from other users. | | handleResults | HandleResult | Yes | Filter by review status: ResultDefault pending , ResultAccept accepted , or ResultDecline declined . Pass for all. | | pagination.pageNumber | number | Yes | Page index, starting from 1 . | | pagination.showNumber | number | Yes | Number of application records to fetch per page. | Return value Returns a Promise that resolves to a GetFriendApplicationResp object containing applications: IMFriendApplication : | Property | Type | Description | | | | | | fromUserID | string | Applicant user ID. | | toUserID | string | Recipient user ID current user . | | handleResult | HandleResult | Review outcome status. | | reqMsg | string | Application greeting or verification message. | | createTime | number | Application creation timestamp in Unix milliseconds. | State changes after the call Identify unique application records using the composite key fromUserID:toUserID . If application events arrive while paging, reset the pagination offset to page 1 and reload. When an application is accepted, the resulting friendship is synchronized separately through friend events; see Paginate friend list /sdk/harmony/user/friends/get friend list page . Clean up listeners using removeReceivedFriendApplicationListeners when unmounting components or signing out.

title: Retrieve sent friend applications
description: Paginate friend requests dispatched by the current signed-in user.
keywords: sdk harmony v4 sdk harmony user friend-applications get-friend-application-list-as-applicant
content: Pass send: true to paginate friend requests initiated by the signed in account: Code example import sdk, GetFriendApplicationReq, GetFriendApplicationResp from '@openimsdk/imsdk'; const request: GetFriendApplicationReq = send: true, handleResults: , pagination: pageNumber: 1, showNumber: 20, , ; const response: GetFriendApplicationResp = await sdk.getFriendApplication request ; showSentApplications response.applications ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | send | boolean | Yes | Set to true to query outgoing requests sent by the current user. | | handleResults | HandleResult | Yes | Filter array by review status; pass to query all states. | | pagination.pageNumber | number | Yes | Page index, starting from 1 . | | pagination.showNumber | number | Yes | Number of requests to fetch per page. | Return value Returns a Promise that resolves to a GetFriendApplicationResp object containing applications: IMFriendApplication : | Property | Type | Description | | | | | | fromUserID | string | Current user ID sender . | | toUserID | string | Target user ID recipient . | | handleResult | HandleResult | Current review status ResultDefault , ResultAccept , or ResultDecline . | | reqMsg | string | Verification note attached by the sender. | | handleMsg | string | Note returned by the reviewer. | | createTime | number | Request dispatch timestamp in Unix milliseconds. | State changes after the call Track application records locally using the composite key fromUserID:toUserID . This query executes locally and does not emit events. For incoming request event listeners, see Retrieve received friend applications /sdk/harmony/user/friend applications/get friend application list as recipient .

title: Get unhandled friend application count
description: Query the number of pending friend applications created after a specific timestamp.
keywords: sdk harmony v4 sdk harmony user friend-applications get-friend-application-unhandled-count
content: Query the count of unhandled friend requests since a specific point in time: Code example import sdk, GetFriendApplicationUnhandledCountReq, GetFriendApplicationUnhandledCountResp, from '@openimsdk/imsdk'; const request: GetFriendApplicationUnhandledCountReq = time: lastViewedAt, ; const response: GetFriendApplicationUnhandledCountResp = await sdk.getFriendApplicationUnhandledCount request ; showPendingFriendCount response.unhandledCount ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | time | number | Yes | Unix timestamp in milliseconds as the starting filter point. Pass 0 to count all unhandled requests. | Return value Returns a Promise that resolves to a GetFriendApplicationUnhandledCountResp object: | Property | Type | Description | | | | | | unhandledCount | number | Number of unhandled friend requests created after time . | State changes after the call This query does not modify application records or emit events. To view and process incoming requests, see Retrieve received friend applications /sdk/harmony/user/friend applications/get friend application list as recipient .

title: Accept friend application
description: Approve a pending friend request from a designated user.
keywords: sdk harmony v4 sdk harmony user friend-applications accept-friend-application
content: Accept an incoming friend request by supplying the applicant's user ID: Code example import sdk, ApprovalStatus, HandleFriendApplicationReq from '@openimsdk/imsdk'; const request: HandleFriendApplicationReq = userID: applicantUserID, handleMsg: '', status: ApprovalStatus.Approved, ; await sdk.handleFriendApplication request ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | userID | string | Yes | Applicant's user identifier. | | handleMsg | string | No | Optional acceptance note or greeting message. | | status | ApprovalStatus | Yes | Use ApprovalStatus.Approved 1 to accept the request. | Return value Returns a Promise that resolves to void when the approval is processed on the server. State changes after the call Resolving the Promise confirms approval on the server. Update the application status in your request view via EventOnFriendApplicationAccepted correlated by fromUserID:toUserID , as described in Retrieve received friend applications /sdk/harmony/user/friend applications/get friend application list as recipient . The newly established friendship triggers EventOnFriendAdded ; see Paginate friend list /sdk/harmony/user/friends/get friend list page for directory synchronization.

title: Reject friend application
description: Decline a pending friend request from a designated user.
keywords: sdk harmony v4 sdk harmony user friend-applications refuse-friend-application
content: Decline an incoming friend application with an optional rejection reason note: Code example import sdk, ApprovalStatus, HandleFriendApplicationReq from '@openimsdk/imsdk'; const request: HandleFriendApplicationReq = userID: applicantUserID, handleMsg: rejectReason, status: ApprovalStatus.Rejected, ; await sdk.handleFriendApplication request ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | userID | string | Yes | Applicant's user identifier. | | handleMsg | string | No | Optional rejection explanation note. | | status | ApprovalStatus | Yes | Use ApprovalStatus.Rejected 1 to decline the request. | Return value Returns a Promise that resolves to void upon submission of the rejection. State changes after the call Resolving the Promise submits the rejection to the server. Listen for EventOnFriendApplicationRejected to update the application item in your list matching fromUserID:toUserID , as described in Retrieve received friend applications /sdk/harmony/user/friend applications/get friend application list as recipient . Declining does not establish a friendship or delete the application record from history.

title: Delete friend applications
description: Batch remove friend application records identified by applicant and recipient user IDs.
keywords: sdk harmony v4 sdk harmony user friend-applications delete-friend-requests
content: Batch remove application history records using applicant and recipient user ID pairs: Code example import sdk, DeleteFriendRequestsReq, SimpleFriendRequest from '@openimsdk/imsdk'; const item: SimpleFriendRequest = fromUserID: applicantUserID, toUserID: currentUserID, ; const request: DeleteFriendRequestsReq = friendRequests: item , ; await sdk.deleteFriendRequests request ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | friendRequests | SimpleFriendRequest | Yes | List of objects each containing fromUserID and toUserID . | Return value Returns a Promise that resolves to void when records are deleted. State changes after the call Deleting an application record purges the request history entry; it does not decline the application or remove established friendships. To reject an application, see Reject friend application /sdk/harmony/user/friend applications/refuse friend application . Update list views upon receiving EventOnFriendApplicationDeleted correlated by fromUserID:toUserID , or re query via Retrieve received friend applications /sdk/harmony/user/friend applications/get friend application list as recipient .

title: Retrieve blocklist
description: Query users blocked by the current account and listen for blocklist events.
keywords: sdk harmony v4 sdk harmony user blacklist get-black-list
content: Blocklist state is maintained independently of friendships, group memberships, and administrative bans. Query the blocklist without passing parameters: Code example import sdk, EventOnBlackAddedData, EventOnBlackDeletedData, GetBlacksResp, OpenIMSDKEvent, from '@openimsdk/imsdk'; const response: GetBlacksResp = await sdk.getBlacks ; replaceBlockedUsers response.blacks ; const handleBlackAdded = data: EventOnBlackAddedData : void = mergeBlockedUser data.black ; ; const handleBlackDeleted = data: EventOnBlackDeletedData : void = removeBlockedUser data.black.blockUserID ; ; const unsubscribeAdded = sdk.on OpenIMSDKEvent.EventOnBlackAdded, handleBlackAdded ; const unsubscribeDeleted = sdk.on OpenIMSDKEvent.EventOnBlackDeleted, handleBlackDeleted ; export function removeBlacklistListeners : void unsubscribeAdded ; unsubscribeDeleted ; Return value Returns a Promise that resolves to a GetBlacksResp object containing blacks: IMBlack : | Property | Type | Description | | | | | | blockUserID | string | Blocked user identifier. | | nickname | string | Blocked user's nickname. | | faceURL | string | Blocked user's avatar URL. | | ownerUserID | string | User ID of the account owning this blocklist entry. | | createTime | number | Block action timestamp in Unix milliseconds. | | ex | string | Custom metadata extension string. | State changes after the call Resolving the Promise provides the blocklist snapshot. Incoming real time events fire through EventOnBlackAdded and EventOnBlackDeleted ; correlate updates using blockUserID . Release listeners with removeBlacklistListeners when signing out or unmounting views. Re query whenever network reconnection completes.

title: Add user to blocklist
description: Add a designated user to the current account’s blocklist.
keywords: sdk harmony v4 sdk harmony user blacklist add-black
content: Block a specific user ID to prevent unwanted contact: Code example import sdk, AddBlackReq from '@openimsdk/imsdk'; const request: AddBlackReq = userID: targetUserID, ex: '', ; await sdk.addBlack request ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | userID | string | Yes | Target user identifier to block. | | ex | string | No | Custom application metadata string. | Return value Returns a Promise that resolves to void upon saving the blocklist record on the server. State changes after the call Resolving the Promise initiates the blocklist update. Correlate local blocklist records using blockUserID matching the target userID when EventOnBlackAdded arrives; see Retrieve blocklist /sdk/harmony/user/blacklist/get black list for listener patterns. Adding a user to the blocklist does not automatically purge chat history; manage conversation visibility separately in application code.

title: Remove user from blocklist
description: Unblock a previously blocked user from the current account’s blocklist.
keywords: sdk harmony v4 sdk harmony user blacklist remove-black
content: Remove a user from the active blocklist: Code example import sdk, DeleteBlackReq from '@openimsdk/imsdk'; const request: DeleteBlackReq = userID: targetUserID, ; await sdk.deleteBlack request ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | userID | string | Yes | Target user identifier to unblock. | Return value Returns a Promise that resolves to void upon unblocking on the server. State changes after the call Unblocking a user does not automatically restore a friendship if it was previously severed. Once the Promise resolves, update your local blocklist store by removing the record matched on blockUserID matching target userID when EventOnBlackDeleted arrives, or re query via Retrieve blocklist /sdk/harmony/user/blacklist/get black list .

title: Conversation overview
description: Understand the relationship between conversation records, target entities, conversation IDs, and list synchronization.
keywords: sdk harmony v4 sdk harmony conversation overview-conversation
content: A conversation represents the client side chat record maintained by the signed in user for a specific one to one peer or group. The IMConversation object encapsulates the target entity, display name, latest message summary, unread badge count, draft content, and user specific conversation preferences. | Identifier | Description | | | | | conversationID | Stable conversation identifier used across message retrieval, read receipts, and conversation preferences. | | userID | Target peer user ID for one to one chats. | | groupID | Target group ID for group chats. | | sourceID | Target entity identifier when querying by target: peer user ID for direct chats, group ID for group chats. | Use SessionType.Single for direct chats and SessionType.WriteGroup for group chats. Do not manually format or concatenate string patterns to generate a conversationID ; obtain it from the SDK. Initialize the conversation list by fetching a snapshot with Retrieve conversation list /sdk/harmony/conversation/retrieving conversations/retrieve conversation list , then apply incremental updates received from new and changed conversation events. Merge updates into your client store using conversationID . After reconnection, account synchronization, or when updates may have been missed, re query the list to reconcile state. Conversation settings—such as pinning, flags, remarks, drafts, message receive options, burn after reading timers, and server destruction policies—operate independently. Each capability is documented under its specific operation guide to prevent accidental field overwrites.

title: Retrieve conversation by target
description: Look up an individual conversation record by target user ID or group ID.
keywords: sdk harmony v4 sdk harmony conversation retrieving-conversations get-conversation-by-target
content: When navigating into a chat interface from a user profile, contact card, or group information view, query the corresponding conversation record by its target entity: Code example import sdk, GetOneConversationReq, GetOneConversationResp, SessionType from '@openimsdk/imsdk'; const request: GetOneConversationReq = sourceID: targetUserID, sessionType: SessionType.Single, ; const response: GetOneConversationResp = await sdk.getOneConversation request ; openChatPage response.conversation ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | sourceID | string | Yes | Target entity identifier: the peer userID for direct chats, or groupID for group chats. | | sessionType | SessionType | Yes | SessionType.Single for direct chats or SessionType.WriteGroup for group chats. | Return value Returns a Promise that resolves to a GetOneConversationResp object: | Property | Type | Description | | | | | | conversation | IMConversation | The matched conversation record. | State changes after the call Resolving the Promise yields the current snapshot of the target conversation without triggering events. Subsequent unread badge changes, drafts, and message summaries are delivered through the conversation events documented in Retrieve conversation list /sdk/harmony/conversation/retrieving conversations/retrieve conversation list .

title: Get conversation ID
description: Derive a stable conversation ID based on the chat target and session type.
keywords: sdk harmony v4 sdk harmony conversation retrieving-conversations get-conversation-id
content: Use getConversationIDBySessionType when your application needs only the canonical conversationID string rather than the full conversation object: Code example import sdk, GetConversationIDBySessionTypeReq, GetConversationIDBySessionTypeResp, SessionType, from '@openimsdk/imsdk'; const request: GetConversationIDBySessionTypeReq = sourceID: targetUserID, sessionType: SessionType.Single, ; const response: GetConversationIDBySessionTypeResp = await sdk.getConversationIDBySessionType request ; useConversationID response.conversationID ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | sourceID | string | Yes | Target identifier: userID for direct chats, or groupID for group chats. | | sessionType | SessionType | Yes | SessionType.Single for direct chats or SessionType.WriteGroup for group chats. | Return value Returns a Promise that resolves to a GetConversationIDBySessionTypeResp object: | Property | Type | Description | | | | | | conversationID | string | The authoritative conversation identifier derived by the native SDK engine. | State changes after the call For group chats, set sourceID to the group ID and use SessionType.WriteGroup . The SDK calculates conversationID deterministically using internal hashing algorithms; never synthesize conversation IDs by manually concatenating strings. If you require the full conversation record containing drafts and unread counts, see Retrieve conversation by target /sdk/harmony/conversation/retrieving conversations/get conversation by target .

title: Retrieve conversations by ID
description: Batch query conversation records for an array of conversation IDs.
keywords: sdk harmony v4 sdk harmony conversation retrieving-conversations get-conversations-by-id
content: Query a batch of conversation records by supplying a list of conversation IDs: Code example import sdk, GetMultipleConversationReq, GetMultipleConversationResp from '@openimsdk/imsdk'; const request: GetMultipleConversationReq = conversationIDList: conversationIDs, ; const response: GetMultipleConversationResp = await sdk.getMultipleConversation request ; mergeConversations response.conversationList ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | conversationIDList | string | Yes | List of target conversation IDs to retrieve. | Return value Returns a Promise that resolves to a GetMultipleConversationResp object: | Property | Type | Description | | | | | | conversationList | IMConversation | Array of found conversation records. Unmatched IDs are omitted. | State changes after the call If a requested ID does not correspond to an existing conversation record, it is silently omitted from the returned array. The order of returned conversations is not guaranteed to match the order of input IDs; correlate and merge records into local stores using conversationID . To listen for subsequent changes, see Retrieve conversation list /sdk/harmony/conversation/retrieving conversations/retrieve conversation list .

title: Retrieve conversation list
description: Paginate conversations for the signed-in user and listen for real-time conversation updates.
keywords: sdk harmony v4 sdk harmony conversation retrieving-conversations retrieve-conversation-list
content: Use the paginated conversation API to build the current user's conversation list; do not use unpaginated full list retrieval. Code example import sdk, EventOnConversationChangedData, EventOnNewConversationData, GetConversationListSplitReq, GetConversationListSplitResp, OpenIMSDKEvent, from '@openimsdk/imsdk'; const request: GetConversationListSplitReq = pagination: pageNumber: 1, showNumber: 50, , ; const response: GetConversationListSplitResp = await sdk.getConversationListSplit request ; mergeConversations response.conversationList ; const handleNewConversation = data: EventOnNewConversationData : void = mergeConversations data.conversationList ; ; const handleConversationChanged = data: EventOnConversationChangedData : void = mergeConversations data.conversationList ; ; const unsubscribeNew = sdk.on OpenIMSDKEvent.EventOnNewConversation, handleNewConversation ; const unsubscribeChanged = sdk.on OpenIMSDKEvent.EventOnConversationChanged, handleConversationChanged, ; export function removeConversationListListeners : void unsubscribeNew ; unsubscribeChanged ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | pagination.pageNumber | number | Yes | Page index, starting from 1 . | | pagination.showNumber | number | Yes | Number of conversations to fetch per page. | Return value Returns a Promise that resolves to a GetConversationListSplitResp object containing conversationList: IMConversation . Deduplicate and merge items using conversationID : | Property | Type | Description | | | | | | conversationID | string | Unique conversation ID, also used as the incremental merge key. | | conversationType | SessionType | Conversation category Single or WriteGroup . | | userID , groupID | string | Peer user ID or group ID according to the conversation type. | | showName , faceURL | string | Display title and avatar URL for the conversation. | | recvMsgOpt | ConvRecvMsgOpt | Message notification delivery preference. | | unreadCount | number | Current unread message badge count. | | groupAtType | ConvGroupAtType | Group mention notification flag. | | latestMsg | IMMessage | Latest message summary object. | | latestMsgSendTime | number | Unix timestamp in milliseconds of the latest message. | | draftText , draftTextTime | string , number | Draft content string and draft save timestamp. | | isPinned | boolean | Whether the conversation is pinned to the top. | | isPrivateChat | boolean | Whether burn after reading mode is enabled. | | burnDuration | number | Burn after reading countdown duration in seconds. | | isMsgDestruct | boolean | Whether periodic message destruction is enabled on the server. | | msgDestructTime | number | Server retention window in seconds before destruction. | | remark | string | User specific remark note for this conversation. | | isMarked | boolean | Whether this conversation is flagged. | | ex | string | Custom metadata extension string. | State changes after the call Detach listeners using removeConversationListListeners when signing out or unmounting the conversation list view. Receiving an incremental change event does not guarantee that previous unread pagination pages are complete; after reconnection or synchronization completes, re query starting from page 1 to calibrate local view state.

title: Get active conversation count
description: Query the total count of active conversations currently stored in the local SDK database.
keywords: sdk harmony v4 sdk harmony conversation retrieving-conversations get-active-conversation-count
content: Query the total count of active conversation records cached by the local SDK engine: Code example import sdk, GetActiveConversationCountResp from '@openimsdk/imsdk'; const response: GetActiveConversationCountResp = await sdk.getActiveConversationCount ; showActiveConversationCount response.count ; Return value Returns a Promise that resolves to a GetActiveConversationCountResp object: | Property | Type | Description | | | | | | count | number | Total number of active conversation records in local storage. | State changes after the call The returned count reflects local cached records; it is not equivalent to joined group counts, unread conversation counts, or the length of a single paginated slice. This query executes purely read only and does not emit events. For conversation lifecycle listening, see Retrieve conversation list /sdk/harmony/conversation/retrieving conversations/retrieve conversation list . Re query whenever an authoritative conversation count is required.

title: Search conversations
description: Search local conversation records matching keyword strings in display names.
keywords: sdk harmony v4 sdk harmony conversation retrieving-conversations search-conversations
content: Perform full text keyword searches across locally synchronized conversation titles and remarks: Code example import sdk, SearchConversationReq, SearchConversationResp from '@openimsdk/imsdk'; const request: SearchConversationReq = searchParam: keyword.trim , ; const response: SearchConversationResp = await sdk.searchConversation request ; renderConversationResults response.conversationList ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | searchParam | string | Yes | Search keyword string. | Return value Returns a Promise that resolves to a SearchConversationResp object: | Property | Type | Description | | | | | | conversationList | IMConversation | List of matched conversation records from local storage. | State changes after the call Search executes purely against the local SQLite database; it does not issue remote server requests. Update matching search results when real time conversation changes arrive by checking conversationID . For conversation event listeners, see Retrieve conversation list /sdk/harmony/conversation/retrieving conversations/retrieve conversation list .

title: Pin conversation
description: Pin or unpin a conversation to the top of the current user’s conversation list.
keywords: sdk harmony v4 sdk harmony conversation managing-conversations pin-conversation
content: Toggle the pinned status of a conversation at the top of the signed in user's conversation list: Code example import sdk, SetConversationReq from '@openimsdk/imsdk'; const request: SetConversationReq = conversationID: conversationID, isPinned: true, ; await sdk.setConversation request ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | conversationID | string | Yes | Target conversation identifier. | | isPinned | boolean | Yes | Set to true to pin the conversation to the top; set to false to unpin. | Return value Returns a Promise that resolves to void when the pinned state is updated on the server. State changes after the call Pinned state only alters conversation sorting for the current user session; it does not affect peer users or group members. Resolving the Promise confirms the update. When EventOnConversationChanged arrives, locate the matching item by conversationID , update its isPinned property, and re sort the conversation list. For complete event handling, see Retrieve conversation list /sdk/harmony/conversation/retrieving conversations/retrieve conversation list .

title: Mark or unmark conversation
description: Set or clear the flagged marker on a conversation for the current user.
keywords: sdk harmony v4 sdk harmony conversation managing-conversations mark-conversation
content: Marking a conversation automatically places it in the built in marked filter group without requiring explicit conversation group management calls: Code example import sdk, SetConversationReq from '@openimsdk/imsdk'; const request: SetConversationReq = conversationID: conversationID, isMarked: true, ; await sdk.setConversation request ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | conversationID | string | Yes | Target conversation identifier. | | isMarked | boolean | Yes | Set to true to flag the conversation; set to false to unflag. | Return value Returns a Promise that resolves to void when the marked flag is saved. State changes after the call Marking and pinning are independent states. Once the Promise resolves, the SDK fires EventOnConversationChanged . Match the item by conversationID and update its isMarked boolean property in the UI, as documented in Retrieve conversation list /sdk/harmony/conversation/retrieving conversations/retrieve conversation list .

title: Set conversation remark
description: Set a private user remark on a specific conversation record.
keywords: sdk harmony v4 sdk harmony conversation managing-conversations set-conversation-remark
content: Assign a private remark note to a conversation for the signed in user. This does not change the friend remark, contact nickname, or group title: Code example import sdk, SetConversationReq from '@openimsdk/imsdk'; const request: SetConversationReq = conversationID: conversationID, remark: 'Project Planning', ; await sdk.setConversation request ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | conversationID | string | Yes | Target conversation identifier. | | remark | string | Yes | Custom remark string. Pass an empty string to clear the remark. | Return value Returns a Promise that resolves to void when the remark is saved. State changes after the call Pass an empty string to clear the remark. After the Promise resolves, the SDK emits EventOnConversationChanged . Match the item by conversationID and update its remark attribute in local storage, as shown in Retrieve conversation list /sdk/harmony/conversation/retrieving conversations/retrieve conversation list .

title: Set conversation draft
description: Persist or clear in-progress message draft text for a specific conversation.
keywords: sdk harmony v4 sdk harmony conversation managing-conversations set-conversation-draft
content: Debounce draft updates while the user types in the input editor, and commit the latest value when unmounting or navigating away from the chat screen: Code example import sdk, SetConversationDraftReq from '@openimsdk/imsdk'; const request: SetConversationDraftReq = conversationID: conversationID, draftText: editorValue, ; await sdk.setConversationDraft request ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | conversationID | string | Yes | Target conversation identifier. | | draftText | string | Yes | Draft text string. Pass an empty string to clear the saved draft. | Return value Returns a Promise that resolves to void when the draft is stored. State changes after the call Passing an empty string clears the active draft. After the Promise resolves, the SDK emits EventOnConversationChanged . Match the item by conversationID and update both draftText and draftTextTime in your conversation list model, as described in Retrieve conversation list /sdk/harmony/conversation/retrieving conversations/retrieve conversation list . Clear in memory editor buffers when signing out or switching accounts.

title: Set conversation extension
description: Store application-defined custom metadata strings on a specific conversation.
keywords: sdk harmony v4 sdk harmony conversation managing-conversations set-conversation-extension
content: The ex field stores an opaque string; the SDK does not parse or merge nested JSON keys automatically. If multiple features share the extension field, merge JSON namespaces at the application layer before calling this method: Code example import sdk, SetConversationReq from '@openimsdk/imsdk'; const request: SetConversationReq = conversationID: conversationID, ex: JSON.stringify conversationExtra , ; await sdk.setConversation request ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | conversationID | string | Yes | Target conversation identifier. | | ex | string | Yes | The complete custom metadata string to assign. | Return value Returns a Promise that resolves to void when the extension is committed. State changes after the call Resolving the Promise triggers EventOnConversationChanged . Match the item by conversationID and update its ex string property, as detailed in Retrieve conversation list /sdk/harmony/conversation/retrieving conversations/retrieve conversation list . Maintain backwards compatible parsing logic in client code to handle unknown JSON schemas gracefully.

title: Set message receive option
description: Configure message reception and notification behavior for an individual conversation.
keywords: sdk harmony v4 sdk harmony conversation managing-conversations set-message-receive-option
content: Use recvMsgOpt to configure the notification and message delivery behavior for a specific conversation, commonly used for per chat Do Not Disturb DND : Code example import sdk, ConvRecvMsgOpt, SetConversationReq from '@openimsdk/imsdk'; const request: SetConversationReq = conversationID: conversationID, recvMsgOpt: ConvRecvMsgOpt.ReceiveNotNotifyMessage, ; await sdk.setConversation request ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | conversationID | string | Yes | Target conversation identifier. | | recvMsgOpt | ConvRecvMsgOpt | Yes | Notification policy enum value. | | Option | Value | Description | | | | | | ConvRecvMsgOpt.ReceiveMessage | 0 | Receive messages and display push notifications. | | ConvRecvMsgOpt.NotReceiveMessage | 1 | Do not receive messages for this conversation. | | ConvRecvMsgOpt.ReceiveNotNotifyMessage | 2 | Receive messages silently without alerting the user Do Not Disturb . | To configure the account level default policy, see Set global message reception /sdk/harmony/user/profile/set global message reception . Return value Returns a Promise that resolves to void when the option is updated. State changes after the call Once the Promise resolves, the SDK emits EventOnConversationChanged . Match the item by conversationID and update its recvMsgOpt property in your UI model, as documented in Retrieve conversation list /sdk/harmony/conversation/retrieving conversations/retrieve conversation list .

title: Clear group mentions
description: Reset the @ mention badge status on a group conversation after the user reviews mentions.
keywords: sdk harmony v4 sdk harmony conversation managing-conversations clear-group-mentions
content: Reset the group mention notification state back to normal after the user handles @ mentions in a group conversation: Code example import sdk, ConvGroupAtType, SetConversationReq from '@openimsdk/imsdk'; const request: SetConversationReq = conversationID: conversationID, groupAtType: ConvGroupAtType.AtNormal, ; await sdk.setConversation request ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | conversationID | string | Yes | Target conversation identifier. | | groupAtType | ConvGroupAtType | Yes | Set to ConvGroupAtType.AtNormal to clear active mention indicators. | Return value Returns a Promise that resolves to void when the mention status is reset. State changes after the call This method only resets active mention flags; do not use it to synthesize artificial "@me" or "@all" notifications. After the Promise resolves, the SDK fires EventOnConversationChanged . Match the item by conversationID and update its groupAtType property in the UI, as described in Retrieve conversation list /sdk/harmony/conversation/retrieving conversations/retrieve conversation list . Resetting mention status is distinct from acknowledging unread messages; to clear unread counts, see Mark conversation as read /sdk/harmony/conversation/managing conversations/mark conversation read .

title: Mark conversation as read
description: Mark all received messages in a designated conversation as read.
keywords: sdk harmony v4 sdk harmony conversation managing-conversations mark-conversation-read
content: Invoke this method only after the user actively views the message history; do not prematurely clear unread badges during background push notifications or preview popups: Code example import sdk, EventOnRecvC2CReadReceiptData, MarkConversationMessageAsReadReq, OpenIMSDKEvent, from '@openimsdk/imsdk'; const request: MarkConversationMessageAsReadReq = conversationID: conversationID, ; await sdk.markConversationMessageAsRead request ; const handleC2CReceipt = data: EventOnRecvC2CReadReceiptData : void = for let index = 0; index < data.msgReceiptList.length; index += 1 mergeC2CReadReceipt data.msgReceiptList index ; ; const unsubscribeReceipt = sdk.on OpenIMSDKEvent.EventOnRecvC2CReadReceipt, handleC2CReceipt ; export function removeC2CReadReceiptListener : void unsubscribeReceipt ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | conversationID | string | Yes | Target conversation identifier. | Return value Returns a Promise that resolves to void when the read receipt is submitted. State changes after the call Resolving the Promise marks the conversation as read locally. The SDK emits EventOnConversationChanged to update the conversation's unread counter; match the item by conversationID to reset badges, as shown in Retrieve conversation list /sdk/harmony/conversation/retrieving conversations/retrieve conversation list . In direct chats, the remote peer receives EventOnRecvC2CReadReceipt to update checkmark indicators for sent messages. Group read receipts are handled separately via Send group read receipts /sdk/harmony/message/managing read status/send group read receipts . Remove the receipt listener with removeC2CReadReceiptListener on logout.

title: Mark all conversations as read
description: Reset the unread count to zero across all conversations for the current account.
keywords: sdk harmony v4 sdk harmony conversation managing-conversations mark-all-conversations-read
content: Mark all unread conversations as read in a single call: Code example import sdk from '@openimsdk/imsdk'; await sdk.markAllConversationMessageAsRead ; Return value Returns a Promise that resolves to void when the SDK processes all unread conversations. State changes after the call Promise resolution indicates that the local engine has processed unread conversations; it does not mean that all real time events have arrived or that other devices have completed synchronization. As conversation change events arrive, update each conversation's unreadCount matched by conversationID , and update your badge counter via the total unread event. For listener implementations, see Retrieve conversation list /sdk/harmony/conversation/retrieving conversations/retrieve conversation list and Get total unread message count /sdk/harmony/conversation/managing conversations/get total unread count .

title: Get total unread message count
description: Query and continuously synchronize the aggregate unread message count for the current account.
keywords: sdk harmony v4 sdk harmony conversation managing-conversations get-total-unread-count
content: Do not calculate the aggregate unread count simply by summing items in the visible pagination window; unread messages may exist in conversations not yet loaded into memory. Code example import sdk, EventOnTotalUnreadMessageCountChangedData, GetTotalUnreadMsgCountResp, OpenIMSDKEvent, from '@openimsdk/imsdk'; const response: GetTotalUnreadMsgCountResp = await sdk.getTotalUnreadMsgCount ; updateApplicationBadge response.totalUnreadCount ; const handleUnreadChanged = data: EventOnTotalUnreadMessageCountChangedData : void = updateApplicationBadge data.totalUnreadCount ; ; const unsubscribeUnread = sdk.on OpenIMSDKEvent.EventOnTotalUnreadMessageCountChanged, handleUnreadChanged, ; export function removeTotalUnreadListener : void unsubscribeUnread ; Return value Returns a Promise that resolves to a GetTotalUnreadMsgCountResp object: | Property | Type | Description | | | | | | totalUnreadCount | number | The aggregate unread message count across all conversations. | State changes after the call Resolving the Promise yields the current baseline unread total. Listen for EventOnTotalUnreadMessageCountChanged to receive incremental updates as conversations are marked read or new messages arrive. To synchronize the app icon badge count on HarmonyOS home screens, refer to Set application badge /sdk/harmony/message/set app badge . After reconnecting or completing background sync, re query this method to calibrate the badge count.

title: Set local conversation unread count
description: Override the local unread message count for one or more conversations.
keywords: sdk harmony v4 sdk harmony conversation managing-conversations set-conversation-unread-count
content: Use resetConversationUnread to calibrate local conversation badge counters. This method does not fabricate server unread records and should not substitute for Mark conversation as read /sdk/harmony/conversation/managing conversations/mark conversation read : Code example import sdk, ResetConversationUnreadReq from '@openimsdk/imsdk'; const request: ResetConversationUnreadReq = conversationIDs: conversationID , num: 0, ; await sdk.resetConversationUnread request ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | conversationIDs | string | Yes | List of conversation IDs to update. | | num | number | Yes | Target unread count value non negative integer . | Return value Returns a Promise that resolves to void when the local counter is reset. State changes after the call The specified num is applied to every conversation in conversationIDs . Resolving the Promise triggers both EventOnConversationChanged and EventOnTotalUnreadMessageCountChanged . Correlate conversation items by conversationID and update the badge totals, as detailed in Retrieve conversation list /sdk/harmony/conversation/retrieving conversations/retrieve conversation list and Get total unread message count /sdk/harmony/conversation/managing conversations/get total unread count .

title: Enable or disable burn-after-reading
description: Toggle private burn-after-reading mode for a specific conversation.
keywords: sdk harmony v4 sdk harmony conversation managing-conversations set-private-chat
content: Enable or disable burn after reading private mode for a conversation. This operates independently of Set periodic server message destruction /sdk/harmony/conversation/managing conversations/set message destruct : Code example import sdk, SetConversationReq from '@openimsdk/imsdk'; const request: SetConversationReq = conversationID: conversationID, isPrivateChat: true, ; await sdk.setConversation request ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | conversationID | string | Yes | Target conversation identifier. | | isPrivateChat | boolean | Yes | Set to true to enable burn after reading; set to false to disable. | Return value Returns a Promise that resolves to void when the setting is saved. State changes after the call Pass true to enable burn after reading and false to disable it. To set the lifespan of read messages, configure Set burn duration /sdk/harmony/conversation/managing conversations/set burn duration . After the Promise resolves, the SDK emits EventOnConversationChanged . Match the item by conversationID and update its isPrivateChat property in UI state, as described in Retrieve conversation list /sdk/harmony/conversation/retrieving conversations/retrieve conversation list .

title: Set burn duration
description: Configure the burn-after-reading countdown duration in seconds for a conversation.
keywords: sdk harmony v4 sdk harmony conversation managing-conversations set-burn-duration
content: Specify the lifespan in seconds that messages remain accessible after being read under burn after reading mode: Code example import sdk, SetConversationReq from '@openimsdk/imsdk'; const request: SetConversationReq = conversationID: conversationID, burnDuration: 30, ; await sdk.setConversation request ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | conversationID | string | Yes | Target conversation identifier. | | burnDuration | number | Yes | Countdown duration in seconds after which viewed messages are destroyed. | Return value Returns a Promise that resolves to void when the duration is updated. State changes after the call Activating burn after reading mode also requires enabling isPrivateChat via Enable or disable burn after reading /sdk/harmony/conversation/managing conversations/set private chat . Do not confuse burn duration with server side periodic retention configured in Set periodic server message destruction /sdk/harmony/conversation/managing conversations/set message destruct . After the Promise resolves, the SDK emits EventOnConversationChanged . Match the item by conversationID and update its burnDuration attribute in the local store, as shown in Retrieve conversation list /sdk/harmony/conversation/retrieving conversations/retrieve conversation list .

title: Set periodic server message destruction
description: Enable, disable, and configure the periodic message destruction window on the server for a conversation.
keywords: sdk harmony v4 sdk harmony conversation managing-conversations set-message-destruct
content: Configure server side retention policies to automatically delete aged messages from server stores after a specific expiration window: Code example import sdk, SetConversationReq from '@openimsdk/imsdk'; const request: SetConversationReq = conversationID: conversationID, isMsgDestruct: true, msgDestructTime: 3600, ; await sdk.setConversation request ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | conversationID | string | Yes | Target conversation identifier. | | isMsgDestruct | boolean | Yes | Set to true to enable automatic destruction; set to false to disable. | | msgDestructTime | number | Yes | Retention window in seconds before messages are purged on the server. | Return value Returns a Promise that resolves to void when the policy is applied. State changes after the call Set isMsgDestruct: false to disable server destruction. This setting deletes messages from server storage only; it does not purge messages already downloaded and cached locally on existing devices. Once deleted from the server, messages cannot be synchronized to newly installed devices or after clearing local caches. After the Promise resolves, the SDK emits EventOnConversationChanged . Match the item by conversationID and update isMsgDestruct and msgDestructTime , as detailed in Retrieve conversation list /sdk/harmony/conversation/retrieving conversations/retrieve conversation list .

title: Hide conversation
description: Hide a conversation entry from the current user’s conversation list.
keywords: sdk harmony v4 sdk harmony conversation managing-conversations hide-a-conversation
content: Hide a conversation from the active conversation list view without deleting history: Code example import sdk, HideConversationReq from '@openimsdk/imsdk'; const request: HideConversationReq = conversationID: conversationID, ; await sdk.hideConversation request ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | conversationID | string | Yes | Target conversation identifier. | Return value Returns a Promise that resolves to void when the conversation is hidden. State changes after the call Hiding a conversation does not delete friend relationships, group memberships, or chat history. The conversation automatically re appears in the conversation list as soon as a new message is received. Once the Promise resolves, remove the item from the visible list using conversationID . For conversation event listeners, see Retrieve conversation list /sdk/harmony/conversation/retrieving conversations/retrieve conversation list .

title: Hide all conversations
description: Hide every conversation entry from the current user’s conversation list.
keywords: sdk harmony v4 sdk harmony conversation managing-conversations hide-all-conversations
content: Because hiding all conversations significantly impacts user navigation, request explicit user confirmation before calling this method: Code example import sdk from '@openimsdk/imsdk'; await sdk.hideAllConversations ; Return value Returns a Promise that resolves to void when all conversation entries are hidden. State changes after the call Hiding all conversations does not delete friends, groups, or remote chat history. Conversations automatically re emerge whenever new incoming or outgoing messages occur. After the Promise resolves, clear the locally rendered conversation list, then re query Retrieve conversation list /sdk/harmony/conversation/retrieving conversations/retrieve conversation list and Get total unread message count /sdk/harmony/conversation/managing conversations/get total unread count to calibrate views.

title: Delete conversation and messages
description: Delete a conversation entry and purge all messages stored locally for the current account.
keywords: sdk harmony v4 sdk harmony conversation managing-conversations delete-conversation-with-messages
content: Use deleteConversationAndDeleteAllMsg when implementing "Delete chat" in your user interface. Prompt the user for explicit confirmation before proceeding: Code example import sdk, DeleteConversationAndDeleteAllMsgReq from '@openimsdk/imsdk'; const request: DeleteConversationAndDeleteAllMsgReq = conversationID: conversationID, ; await sdk.deleteConversationAndDeleteAllMsg request ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | conversationID | string | Yes | Target conversation identifier. | Return value Returns a Promise that resolves to void when the conversation and local message records are deleted. State changes after the call This method deletes the local conversation entry and message records stored for the signed in user; it does not remove friends, leave groups, or delete history from other participants' devices. Once the Promise resolves, remove the item from the local conversation list using conversationID . Receive the conversation change notification via EventOnConversationChanged to reconcile persistent state, as detailed in Retrieve conversation list /sdk/harmony/conversation/retrieving conversations/retrieve conversation list .

title: Clear conversation messages
description: Purge all messages in a conversation while retaining the conversation entry.
keywords: sdk harmony v4 sdk harmony conversation managing-conversations clear-conversation-messages
content: Clear chat history for a specific conversation while preserving its presence in the conversation list: Code example import sdk, ClearConversationAndDeleteAllMsgReq from '@openimsdk/imsdk'; const request: ClearConversationAndDeleteAllMsgReq = conversationID: conversationID, ; await sdk.clearConversationAndDeleteAllMsg request ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | conversationID | string | Yes | Target conversation identifier. | Return value Returns a Promise that resolves to void when messages are purged. State changes after the call Resolving the Promise purges messages locally. The conversation entry itself remains in the conversation list, and the SDK triggers EventOnConversationChanged to reset its latest message snippet, timestamp, and unread count. Correlate and update your conversation view using conversationID , as detailed in Retrieve conversation list /sdk/harmony/conversation/retrieving conversations/retrieve conversation list . To remove the conversation entry together with its messages, see Delete conversation and messages /sdk/harmony/conversation/managing conversations/delete conversation with messages .

title: Conversation groups overview
description: Understand conversation group models, functional boundaries, and real-time synchronization in the OpenIM HarmonyOS SDK.
keywords: sdk harmony v4 sdk harmony conversation managing-conversation-groups overview-conversation-groups
content: Conversation groups categorize conversation records for the signed in user, such as "Work", "Unread", or "Starred". They only manage associations between conversationID entries and group buckets; they do not create group chats, alter chat members, or change message recipients. Group categories | Enum value | Numeric value | Description | | | | | | ConversationGroupType.ConversationGroupTypeNormal | 0 | Standard custom group created and maintained by the user. | | ConversationGroupType.ConversationGroupTypeFilter | 1 | Filter group maintained automatically according to SDK or server business rules. | | ConversationGroupQueryType.ConversationGroupQueryAll | 2 | Query filter flag representing all group types. Cannot be used when creating a group. | The evaluation rules for filter groups depend on your server deployment; do not synthesize artificial system groups solely by matching names on the client. Data model The IMConversationGroup object represents an individual conversation group. Use conversationGroupID as the stable identifier when merging query snapshots and event payloads. | Property | Type | Description | | | | | | conversationGroupID | string | Unique conversation group identifier. | | name | string | Display name of the group. | | order | number | Numerical sorting rank determined by application conventions. | | conversationGroupType | ConversationGroupType | Group type enum value. | | hidden | boolean | Whether the group is hidden from display. | | unreadCount | number | Aggregated unread message count for conversations in this group. | | conversationIDs | string | List of conversation IDs currently assigned to this group. | | createTime | number | Optional Unix millisecond creation timestamp. | | ex | string | Application defined custom metadata string. | Listen for conversation group events Register listeners for group creation, deletion, property changes, and member conversation adjustments.
