Correlate incoming updates using conversationGroupID , and re query after network reconnections: Code example import sdk, EventOnConversationGroupAddedData, EventOnConversationGroupChangedData, EventOnConversationGroupDeletedData, EventOnConversationGroupMemberAddedData, EventOnConversationGroupMemberDeletedData, OpenIMSDKEvent, from '@openimsdk/imsdk'; const handleGroupAdded = data: EventOnConversationGroupAddedData : void = mergeConversationGroups data.conversationGroupList ; ; const handleGroupChanged = data: EventOnConversationGroupChangedData : void = mergeConversationGroups data.conversationGroupList ; ; const handleGroupDeleted = data: EventOnConversationGroupDeletedData : void = removeConversationGroups data.conversationGroupList ; ; const handleGroupMemberAdded = data: EventOnConversationGroupMemberAddedData : void = mergeConversationGroup data.conversationGroup, data.conversations ; ; const handleGroupMemberDeleted = data: EventOnConversationGroupMemberDeletedData : void = mergeConversationGroup data.conversationGroup, data.conversations ; ; const unsubscribeGroupAdded = sdk.on OpenIMSDKEvent.EventOnConversationGroupAdded, handleGroupAdded, ; const unsubscribeGroupChanged = sdk.on OpenIMSDKEvent.EventOnConversationGroupChanged, handleGroupChanged, ; const unsubscribeGroupDeleted = sdk.on OpenIMSDKEvent.EventOnConversationGroupDeleted, handleGroupDeleted, ; const unsubscribeGroupMemberAdded = sdk.on OpenIMSDKEvent.EventOnConversationGroupMemberAdded, handleGroupMemberAdded, ; const unsubscribeGroupMemberDeleted = sdk.on OpenIMSDKEvent.EventOnConversationGroupMemberDeleted, handleGroupMemberDeleted, ; export function removeConversationGroupListeners : void unsubscribeGroupAdded ; unsubscribeGroupChanged ; unsubscribeGroupDeleted ; unsubscribeGroupMemberAdded ; unsubscribeGroupMemberDeleted ; State changes after the call Detach all listeners using removeConversationGroupListeners when the user logs out or the conversation controller unmounts. Resolving a management Promise, receiving real time event updates, and executing a synchronization query represent three separate lifecycle phases; do not assume that a successful local request has reached every remote client. Related operations Create conversation group /sdk/harmony/conversation/managing conversation groups/create conversation group Retrieve conversation groups /sdk/harmony/conversation/managing conversation groups/get conversation groups Retrieve conversations in a group /sdk/harmony/conversation/managing conversation groups/get conversation group info with conversations Query group IDs by conversation ID /sdk/harmony/conversation/managing conversation groups/get conversation group ids by conversation id Update conversation group /sdk/harmony/conversation/managing conversation groups/update conversation group Set conversation group order /sdk/harmony/conversation/managing conversation groups/set conversation group order Add conversations to groups /sdk/harmony/conversation/managing conversation groups/add conversations to groups Remove conversations from groups /sdk/harmony/conversation/managing conversation groups/remove conversations from groups Delete conversation group /sdk/harmony/conversation/managing conversation groups/delete conversation group

title: Create conversation group
description: Create a new conversation group and optionally associate an initial conversation.
keywords: sdk harmony v4 sdk harmony conversation managing-conversation-groups create-conversation-group
content: When creating a standard conversation group, supply a name, display sort order, and group category. To immediately link an existing conversation, provide its conversationID . Code example import sdk, ConversationGroupType, CreateConversationGroupReq, CreateConversationGroupResp, from '@openimsdk/imsdk'; const request: CreateConversationGroupReq = name: 'Work', order: 100, conversationGroupType: ConversationGroupType.ConversationGroupTypeNormal, conversationID: conversationID, ; const response: CreateConversationGroupResp = await sdk.createConversationGroup request ; const group = response.conversationGroup; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | name | string | Yes | Display name for the group. | | order | number | Yes | Numerical sort index defined by application convention. | | conversationGroupType | ConversationGroupType | Yes | Group type ConversationGroupTypeNormal or ConversationGroupTypeFilter . | | conversationID | string | No | Initial conversation ID to add into the newly created group. | | ex | string | No | Custom application metadata string. | Return value Returns a Promise that resolves to a CreateConversationGroupResp object: | Property | Type | Description | | | | | | conversationGroup | IMConversationGroup | The newly created conversation group object. | State changes after the call Once the Promise resolves, update your local group list by merging the new record using conversationGroupID . Associated clients and other active devices observe changes via EventOnConversationGroupAdded . For complete event lifecycle details, see Conversation groups overview /sdk/harmony/conversation/managing conversation groups/overview conversation groups .

title: Retrieve conversation groups
description: Query conversation groups for the current account filtered by group category.
keywords: sdk harmony v4 sdk harmony conversation managing-conversation-groups get-conversation-groups
content: Filter conversation groups by custom groups, system filter groups, or all available types: Code example import sdk, ConversationGroupQueryType, GetConversationGroupsReq, GetConversationGroupsResp, from '@openimsdk/imsdk'; const request: GetConversationGroupsReq = conversationGroupType: ConversationGroupQueryType.ConversationGroupQueryAll, ; const response: GetConversationGroupsResp = await sdk.getConversationGroups request ; const groups = response.conversationGroups; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | conversationGroupType | ConversationGroupQueryType | Yes | Category filter: ConversationGroupTypeNormal , ConversationGroupTypeFilter , or ConversationGroupQueryAll . | Return value Returns a Promise that resolves to a GetConversationGroupsResp object: | Property | Type | Description | | | | | | conversationGroups | IMConversationGroup | Array of conversation group records matching the query criteria. | State changes after the call Resolving the Promise yields the current snapshot of conversation groups without triggering real time events. Store and render groups keyed by conversationGroupID . For real time updates across multiple clients, see Conversation groups overview /sdk/harmony/conversation/managing conversation groups/overview conversation groups . Re invoke this method when network connectivity is restored or when state discrepancies occur.

title: Retrieve conversations in a group
description: Paginate conversations belonging to a specific conversation group along with group details.
keywords: sdk harmony v4 sdk harmony conversation managing-conversation-groups get-conversation-group-info-with-conversations
content: Query conversation group details and its member conversations within a single paginated response. Code example import sdk, GetConversationGroupInfoWithConversationsReq, GetConversationGroupInfoWithConversationsResp, from '@openimsdk/imsdk'; const request: GetConversationGroupInfoWithConversationsReq = conversationGroupID: conversationGroupID, pagination: pageNumber: 1, showNumber: 20, , ; const response: GetConversationGroupInfoWithConversationsResp = await sdk.getConversationGroupInfoWithConversations request ; renderConversationGroup response.conversationGroup, response.conversations ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | conversationGroupID | string | Yes | Target conversation group identifier. | | pagination.pageNumber | number | Yes | Page index, starting from 1 . | | pagination.showNumber | number | Yes | Number of conversations to retrieve per page. | Return value Returns a Promise that resolves to a GetConversationGroupInfoWithConversationsResp object: | Property | Type | Description | | | | | | conversationGroup | IMConversationGroup | Profile metadata of the queried conversation group. | | conversations | IMConversation | List of conversation records for the current page. | | isEnd | boolean | Whether the final page of conversations has been reached. | State changes after the call If member association events arrive while paging through the list, reset the pagination offset and re query from the first page to prevent inconsistent page boundary snapshots. For event listeners, see Conversation groups overview /sdk/harmony/conversation/managing conversation groups/overview conversation groups .

title: Query group IDs by conversation ID
description: Retrieve all conversation groups currently associated with a specific conversation.
keywords: sdk harmony v4 sdk harmony conversation managing-conversation-groups get-conversation-group-ids-by-conversation-id
content: A conversation can belong to multiple groups simultaneously. This method returns complete conversation group objects rather than just raw string IDs. Code example import sdk, GetConversationGroupByConversationIDReq, GetConversationGroupByConversationIDResp, from '@openimsdk/imsdk'; const request: GetConversationGroupByConversationIDReq = conversationID: conversationID, ; const response: GetConversationGroupByConversationIDResp = await sdk.getConversationGroupByConversationID request ; const groups = response.conversationGroups; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | conversationID | string | Yes | Target OpenIM conversation identifier not a chat group ID . | Return value Returns a Promise that resolves to a GetConversationGroupByConversationIDResp object: | Property | Type | Description | | | | | | conversationGroups | IMConversationGroup | Array of complete conversation groups linked to this conversation. | State changes after the call Resolving the Promise provides the current group associations for this conversation without triggering real time events. Extract conversationGroupID from each item if you only need the IDs. When group associations change, synchronize state via the events described in Conversation groups overview /sdk/harmony/conversation/managing conversation groups/overview conversation groups or re invoke this query.

title: Update conversation group
description: Modify the display name, custom metadata, or hidden state of a conversation group.
keywords: sdk harmony v4 sdk harmony conversation managing-conversation-groups update-conversation-group
content: Specify the target group via conversationGroupID . Include only the fields you wish to update, providing at least one mutable property. Code example import sdk, UpdateConversationGroupReq, UpdateConversationGroupResp from '@openimsdk/imsdk'; const request: UpdateConversationGroupReq = conversationGroupID: conversationGroupID, name: 'Priority Work', hidden: false, ; const response: UpdateConversationGroupResp = await sdk.updateConversationGroup request ; const updatedGroup = response.conversationGroup; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | conversationGroupID | string | Yes | Target conversation group identifier. | | name | string | No | New group display name. | | ex | string | No | Updated complete metadata string. | | hidden | boolean | No | Whether to hide this group from the interface. | Return value Returns a Promise that resolves to an UpdateConversationGroupResp object: | Property | Type | Description | | | | | | conversationGroup | IMConversationGroup | The updated conversation group record. | State changes after the call Upon Promise resolution, update your local view by matching the returned group on conversationGroupID . The server broadcasts updates to other devices via EventOnConversationGroupChanged . For complete event handling and cleanup patterns, see Conversation groups overview /sdk/harmony/conversation/managing conversation groups/overview conversation groups .

title: Set conversation group order
description: Batch update the display sorting order of conversation groups.
keywords: sdk harmony v4 sdk harmony conversation managing-conversation-groups set-conversation-group-order
content: Supply pairs of conversation group identifiers and their corresponding integer order ranks to reorder conversation groups. Code example import sdk, SetConversationGroupOrderReq from '@openimsdk/imsdk'; const request: SetConversationGroupOrderReq = conversationGroupOrders: conversationGroupID: firstGroupID, order: 100 , conversationGroupID: secondGroupID, order: 200 , , ; await sdk.setConversationGroupOrder request ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | conversationGroupOrders | ConversationGroupOrderItem | Yes | List of objects containing conversationGroupID and its updated order value. | Return value Returns a Promise that resolves to void upon successful submission of the ordering request. State changes after the call Promise resolution indicates that the server accepted the sort order request without returning full conversation group payloads. Adjust local group sorting order by matching conversationGroupID . Remote clients receive updates via EventOnConversationGroupChanged . For complete event handling, see Conversation groups overview /sdk/harmony/conversation/managing conversation groups/overview conversation groups .

title: Add conversations to groups
description: Associate one or more conversations with designated conversation groups.
keywords: sdk harmony v4 sdk harmony conversation managing-conversation-groups add-conversations-to-groups
content: This method only manages the association between conversations and groups; it does not create conversations or alter message destinations. Code example import sdk, AddConversationsToGroupsReq from '@openimsdk/imsdk'; const request: AddConversationsToGroupsReq = conversationIDs: conversationID , conversationGroupIDs: conversationGroupID , ; await sdk.addConversationsToGroups request ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | conversationIDs | string | Yes | List of conversation IDs to add. | | conversationGroupIDs | string | Yes | Target conversation group IDs. | Return value Returns a Promise that resolves to void when the association request is processed. State changes after the call Resolving the Promise confirms that the request was processed by the server; it does not guarantee that asynchronous group member events have arrived across all devices. When EventOnConversationGroupMemberAdded arrives, merge updates using conversationGroupID and conversationID . For listener registration, see Conversation groups overview /sdk/harmony/conversation/managing conversation groups/overview conversation groups . Re query affected groups if you need authoritative reconciliation.

title: Remove conversations from groups
description: Remove one or more conversations from designated conversation groups.
keywords: sdk harmony v4 sdk harmony conversation managing-conversation-groups remove-conversations-from-groups
content: This method unlinks conversations from conversation groups; it does not delete the conversations or clear chat history. Code example import sdk, RemoveConversationsFromGroupsReq from '@openimsdk/imsdk'; const request: RemoveConversationsFromGroupsReq = conversationIDs: conversationID , conversationGroupIDs: conversationGroupID , ; await sdk.removeConversationsFromGroups request ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | conversationIDs | string | Yes | List of conversation IDs to unlink. | | conversationGroupIDs | string | Yes | Target conversation group IDs. | Return value Returns a Promise that resolves to void when the dissociation request completes. State changes after the call Resolving the Promise confirms that the unlinking instruction succeeded on the server. Update local state incrementally when receiving EventOnConversationGroupMemberDeleted , correlating by conversationGroupID and conversationID . For detailed event patterns, see Conversation groups overview /sdk/harmony/conversation/managing conversation groups/overview conversation groups . Re query affected groups to calibrate state when necessary.

title: Delete conversation group
description: Delete a conversation group and remove its conversation associations.
keywords: sdk harmony v4 sdk harmony conversation managing-conversation-groups delete-conversation-group
content: Deleting a conversation group disassociates its assigned conversations, but does not delete the underlying conversations or chat messages. Code example import sdk, DeleteConversationGroupReq from '@openimsdk/imsdk'; const request: DeleteConversationGroupReq = conversationGroupID: conversationGroupID, ; await sdk.deleteConversationGroup request ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | conversationGroupID | string | Yes | The identifier of the conversation group to delete not a chat group ID . | Return value Returns a Promise that resolves to void upon deletion. State changes after the call Once the Promise resolves, remove the group entry from local state using conversationGroupID . The server notifies connected clients via EventOnConversationGroupDeleted . See Conversation groups overview /sdk/harmony/conversation/managing conversation groups/overview conversation groups for complete listener setups.

title: Group overview
description: Understand group profiles, member relationships, applications, roles, and group events in the OpenIM HarmonyOS SDK.
keywords: sdk harmony v4 sdk harmony group overview-group
content: OpenIMSDK organizes multi user chats, shared profiles, memberships, and permissions through groups. Use groupID when sending group messages, updating group profiles, managing members, and processing group applications. The conversation record representing a group chat in the conversation list uses conversationID ; do not confuse the two identifiers. Core data models | Model | Purpose | | | | | IMGroup | Group name, avatar, announcement, owner, verification options, member count, and custom metadata. | | IMGroupMember | A user’s group specific nickname, role level, mute status, and join details. | | IMGroupApplication | Membership application records and their review outcomes. | Member roles are represented by GroupMemberRoleLevel : ordinary members are GroupOrdinaryUsers , administrators are GroupAdmin , and the group owner is GroupOwner . Use role levels to control client UI actions; the server strictly validates all permissions. Group profile fields | Field | Type | Description | | | | | | groupID | string | Stable group identifier and event merge key. | | groupName | string | Group display title. | | faceURL | string | Group avatar image URL. | | notification | string | Group announcement text. | | introduction | string | Brief group description. | | ownerUserID | string | User ID of the current group owner. | | creatorUserID | string | User ID of the group creator. | | memberCount | number | Total member count at query time. | | needVerification | GroupNeedVerification | Verification policy for new applicants joining the group. | | lookMemberInfo | GroupLookMemberInfo | Permission controlling member profile visibility. | | applyMemberFriend | GroupApplyMemberFriend | Permission controlling whether members can add each other as friends from within the group. | | status | GroupStatus | Group operational status e.g., active, dismissed, muted . | | createTime | number | Group creation timestamp in Unix milliseconds. | | ex | string | Application defined custom group metadata string. | | attachedInfo | string | Additional engine metadata. | | isShowGroupRead | boolean | Server configuration indicating whether message read receipts are displayed in this group. | Listen for group changes Listen for group property changes, joins, departures, and group dissolutions to keep UI views synchronized in real time: Code example import sdk, EventOnGroupDismissedData, EventOnGroupInfoChangedData, EventOnJoinedGroupAddedData, EventOnJoinedGroupDeletedData, OpenIMSDKEvent, from '@openimsdk/imsdk'; const handleJoinedGroupAdded = data: EventOnJoinedGroupAddedData : void = mergeGroup data.group ; ; const handleJoinedGroupDeleted = data: EventOnJoinedGroupDeletedData : void = removeJoinedGroup data.group.groupID ; ; const handleGroupInfoChanged = data: EventOnGroupInfoChangedData : void = mergeGroup data.group ; ; const handleGroupDismissed = data: EventOnGroupDismissedData : void = markGroupDismissed data.group.groupID ; ; const unsubscribeJoinedGroupAdded = sdk.on OpenIMSDKEvent.EventOnJoinedGroupAdded, handleJoinedGroupAdded, ; const unsubscribeJoinedGroupDeleted = sdk.on OpenIMSDKEvent.EventOnJoinedGroupDeleted, handleJoinedGroupDeleted, ; const unsubscribeGroupInfoChanged = sdk.on OpenIMSDKEvent.EventOnGroupInfoChanged, handleGroupInfoChanged, ; const unsubscribeGroupDismissed = sdk.on OpenIMSDKEvent.EventOnGroupDismissed, handleGroupDismissed, ; export function removeGroupListeners : void unsubscribeJoinedGroupAdded ; unsubscribeJoinedGroupDeleted ; unsubscribeGroupInfoChanged ; unsubscribeGroupDismissed ; State changes after the call Detach listeners using removeGroupListeners upon account sign out or when terminating the group manager. API Promise resolution, event notifications, and re querying snapshots represent three separate lifecycle phases. If membership changes occur during active pagination, reset the pagination offset and re query from page 1. Related capabilities Update group profile /sdk/harmony/group/update group profile Set group join verification /sdk/harmony/group/set group join verification Change group mute status /sdk/harmony/group/change group mute Paginate joined groups /sdk/harmony/group/retrieving groups/get joined group list page Retrieve received group applications /sdk/harmony/group/group applications/get group application list as recipient Paginate group members /sdk/harmony/group/retrieving group members/get group member list

title: Create group
description: Create a new chat group and configure initial administrators and regular members.
keywords: sdk harmony v4 sdk harmony group create-group
content: Supply initial group properties along with separate arrays of administrator and regular member user IDs. The current creator becomes the owner automatically, indicated by ownerUserID on the returned group object: Code example import sdk, CreateGroupReq, CreateGroupResp from '@openimsdk/imsdk'; const request: CreateGroupReq = groupName: 'Project Discussion', faceURL: 'https://example.com/group.png', adminUserIDs: 'user 002' , memberUserIDs: 'user 003', 'user 004' , ; const response: CreateGroupResp = await sdk.createGroup request ; openGroupPage response.groupInfo.groupID ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | groupName | string | Yes | Display name for the new group. | | adminUserIDs | string | Yes | Initial administrator user IDs. Pass an empty array if none. | | memberUserIDs | string | Yes | Initial regular member user IDs. Pass an empty array if none. | | groupID | string | No | Explicit group identifier pre allocated by the backend. Usually omitted for auto generation. | | notification | string | No | Initial group announcement text. | | introduction | string | No | Initial group introduction description. | | faceURL | string | No | Group avatar image URL. | | needVerification | GroupNeedVerification | No | Group join verification policy. | | lookMemberInfo | GroupLookMemberInfo | No | Member profile visibility permission. | | applyMemberFriend | GroupApplyMemberFriend | No | Member to member friend addition permission. | | ex | string | No | Custom metadata extension string. | Deduplicate all user IDs, and ensure that adminUserIDs and memberUserIDs do not contain overlapping accounts or the creator's ID. Return value Returns a Promise that resolves to a CreateGroupResp object containing groupInfo: IMGroup . State changes after the call Resolving the Promise yields the newly created IMGroup record. Connected clients receive EventOnJoinedGroupAdded ; merge the new group into your joined groups list keyed by groupID . For event listeners, see Group overview /sdk/harmony/group/overview group .

title: Update group profile
description: Modify a group’s display name, introduction summary, and avatar URL.
keywords: sdk harmony v4 sdk harmony group update-group-profile
content: Update basic group attributes from a profile editing form. Include only fields that have changed, and provide at least one mutable field alongside groupID . Do not mix announcements, join verification rules, or permission flags into this general profile update: Code example import sdk, SetGroupInfoReq from '@openimsdk/imsdk'; const request: SetGroupInfoReq = groupID: groupID, groupName: groupName.trim , introduction: introduction.trim , faceURL: faceURL, ; await sdk.setGroupInfo request ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | groupID | string | Yes | Target group identifier. | | groupName | string | No | New group display name. | | introduction | string | No | New group introduction text. | | faceURL | string | No | New group avatar image URL. | Return value Returns a Promise that resolves to void upon updating the group on the server. State changes after the call Resolving the Promise confirms that the server accepted the updates; it does not mean that the group change event has reached every member device yet. When EventOnGroupInfoChanged arrives, update local group state keyed by groupID . For event listener patterns, see Group overview /sdk/harmony/group/overview group . To fetch authoritative data immediately, call Retrieve specified group profiles /sdk/harmony/group/retrieving groups/get specified groups info .

title: Publish or update group announcement
description: Publish, modify, or clear group announcement notices.
keywords: sdk harmony v4 sdk harmony group set-group-announcement
content: The notification field contains the public group announcement, separate from the group's introduction description. Permissions are verified on the server; display editing controls according to the user's role level: Code example import sdk, SetGroupInfoReq from '@openimsdk/imsdk'; const request: SetGroupInfoReq = groupID: groupID, notification: announcement.trim , ; await sdk.setGroupInfo request ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | groupID | string | Yes | Target group identifier. | | notification | string | Yes | Announcement text. Pass an empty string to clear the announcement. | Return value Returns a Promise that resolves to void upon updating the announcement. State changes after the call Resolving the Promise confirms that the announcement was saved on the server. The SDK emits EventOnGroupInfoChanged ; match the group by groupID and update its notification property in the UI, as detailed in Group overview /sdk/harmony/group/overview group .

title: Set group extension
description: Store application-defined custom metadata strings on a specific group.
keywords: sdk harmony v4 sdk harmony group set-group-extension
content: The ex field stores an opaque string; the SDK does not automatically parse or merge nested JSON attributes. If multiple modules share this field, merge namespaced JSON properties in application memory before saving: Code example import sdk, SetGroupInfoReq from '@openimsdk/imsdk'; const request: SetGroupInfoReq = groupID: groupID, ex: JSON.stringify projectID: 'project 42' , ; await sdk.setGroupInfo request ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | groupID | string | Yes | Target group identifier. | | ex | string | Yes | The complete custom metadata string to assign. | Return value Returns a Promise that resolves to void upon saving the metadata on the server. State changes after the call Resolving the Promise confirms that the extension string was saved. The SDK emits EventOnGroupInfoChanged ; match the group by groupID and update its ex attribute in the local group cache, as detailed in Group overview /sdk/harmony/group/overview group .

title: Set group join verification
description: Configure the approval policy required when users apply or are invited to join a group.
keywords: sdk harmony v4 sdk harmony group set-group-join-verification
content: The GroupNeedVerification enum controls group join and invitation verification policies: Code example import sdk, GroupNeedVerification, SetGroupInfoReq from '@openimsdk/imsdk'; const request: SetGroupInfoReq = groupID: groupID, needVerification: GroupNeedVerification.AllNeedVerification, ; await sdk.setGroupInfo request ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | groupID | string | Yes | Target group identifier. | | needVerification | GroupNeedVerification | Yes | Group join verification policy enum value. | | Option | Value | Description | | | | | | GroupNeedVerification.ApplyNeedVerificationInviteDirectly | 0 | Applications require approval; member invitations join directly. | | GroupNeedVerification.AllNeedVerification | 1 | Applications and regular member invitations require approval; owner and admin invites join directly. | | GroupNeedVerification.DirectAccess | 2 | Anyone can join directly without review. | Return value Returns a Promise that resolves to void when the policy is saved. State changes after the call Client applications should adapt join buttons and prompts according to this policy, but the server always performs authoritative enforcement. Once the Promise resolves, the SDK fires EventOnGroupInfoChanged . Update the group's needVerification property matched by groupID , as detailed in Group overview /sdk/harmony/group/overview group .

title: Set group member profile access
description: Control whether group members can view the profiles of fellow members in the group.
keywords: sdk harmony v4 sdk harmony group set-group-member-profile-access
content: The GroupLookMemberInfo enum governs whether group members can inspect other members' profiles through the group roster. Do not treat this enum as a raw boolean value: Code example import sdk, GroupLookMemberInfo, SetGroupInfoReq from '@openimsdk/imsdk'; const request: SetGroupInfoReq = groupID: groupID, lookMemberInfo: GroupLookMemberInfo.AllowGroupLookMemberInfo, ; await sdk.setGroupInfo request ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | groupID | string | Yes | Target group identifier. | | lookMemberInfo | GroupLookMemberInfo | Yes | Member profile access policy enum value. | | Option | Value | Description | | | | | | GroupLookMemberInfo.AllowGroupLookMemberInfo | 0 | Members may view other members' profiles. | | GroupLookMemberInfo.ProhibitGroupLookMemberInfo | 1 | Members are prohibited from viewing other members' profiles. | Return value Returns a Promise that resolves to void when the setting is saved. State changes after the call Member profile visibility operates independently of friend request permissions. Resolving the Promise confirms the change on the server. The SDK emits EventOnGroupInfoChanged ; match the group by groupID and update lookMemberInfo in the client UI model, as detailed in Group overview /sdk/harmony/group/overview group .

title: Set group member friend permission
description: Control whether members can send friend requests to each other from within the group.
keywords: sdk harmony v4 sdk harmony group set-group-member-friend-permission
content: This setting governs whether group members can initiate friend applications to fellow members through the group interface. It does not hide member profile cards or affect existing friendships: Code example import sdk, GroupApplyMemberFriend, SetGroupInfoReq from '@openimsdk/imsdk'; const request: SetGroupInfoReq = groupID: groupID, applyMemberFriend: GroupApplyMemberFriend.AllowGroupApplyMemberFriend, ; await sdk.setGroupInfo request ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | groupID | string | Yes | Target group identifier. | | applyMemberFriend | GroupApplyMemberFriend | Yes | Member friend addition policy enum value. | | Option | Value | Description | | | | | | GroupApplyMemberFriend.AllowGroupApplyMemberFriend | 0 | Members may send friend requests to each other from the group. | | GroupApplyMemberFriend.ProhibitGroupApplyMemberFriend | 1 | Members are prohibited from sending friend requests to each other within the group. | Return value Returns a Promise that resolves to void upon updating the permission. State changes after the call Resolving the Promise updates the policy on the server. The SDK emits EventOnGroupInfoChanged ; match the group by groupID and update its applyMemberFriend property in UI state, as detailed in Group overview /sdk/harmony/group/overview group .

title: Change group mute status
description: Enable or disable group-wide muting, with optional bypass exemptions for designated members.
keywords: sdk harmony v4 sdk harmony group change-group-mute
content: Toggle group wide mute to restrict regular members from sending messages. The muteBypassUserIDs array specifies whitelist members who retain speaking privileges during group mute: Code example import sdk, ChangeGroupMuteReq from '@openimsdk/imsdk'; const request: ChangeGroupMuteReq = groupID: groupID, mute: true, muteBypassUserIDs: 'user 002' , ; await sdk.changeGroupMute request ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | groupID | string | Yes | Target group identifier. | | mute | boolean | Yes | Set to true to enable group wide muting; set to false to lift the mute. | | muteBypassUserIDs | string | Yes | List of user IDs exempt from the group mute. Pass if there are no exemptions. | Return value Returns a Promise that resolves to void upon updating the mute state on the server. State changes after the call Resolving the Promise confirms that the request reached the server. When EventOnGroupInfoChanged arrives, update local group state keyed by groupID . For complete event listening, see Group overview /sdk/harmony/group/overview group . To verify active settings immediately, see Retrieve specified group profiles /sdk/harmony/group/retrieving groups/get specified groups info .

title: Join group
description: Submit an application to join a group, or join directly if verification is disabled.
keywords: sdk harmony v4 sdk harmony group join-group
content: Whether joining requires administrator review depends on the group's needVerification setting; the joinSource parameter records the acquisition channel: Code example import sdk, GroupJoinSource, JoinGroupReq from '@openimsdk/imsdk'; const request: JoinGroupReq = groupID: groupID, reqMsg: 'Applying to join the project team', joinSource: GroupJoinSource.Search, ex: '', ; await sdk.joinGroup request ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | groupID | string | Yes | Target group identifier. | | reqMsg | string | Yes | Verification note or greeting string. Pass an empty string if none. | | joinSource | GroupJoinSource | Yes | Source channel enum e.g., search, QR code, invitation link . | | ex | string | Yes | Application metadata string. Pass an empty string if none. | Return value Returns a Promise that resolves to void when the request is processed by the server. State changes after the call Resolving the Promise indicates that the application was submitted. If the group requires approval, track review progress via Retrieve sent group applications /sdk/harmony/group/group applications/get group application list as applicant . If the group allows direct entry, the user joins immediately and the SDK triggers EventOnJoinedGroupAdded ; add the group to your joined groups list keyed by groupID , as detailed in Group overview /sdk/harmony/group/overview group .

title: Leave group
description: Depart from a group that the current account is currently a member of.
keywords: sdk harmony v4 sdk harmony group quit-group
content: Regular members and administrators can voluntarily leave a group. The group owner cannot leave directly without first transferring ownership to another member via Transfer group ownership /sdk/harmony/group/managing group members/transfer group owner : Code example import sdk, QuitGroupReq from '@openimsdk/imsdk'; const request: QuitGroupReq = groupID: groupID ; await sdk.quitGroup request ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | groupID | string | Yes | Identifier of the group to leave. | Return value Returns a Promise that resolves to void when the departure request succeeds on the server. State changes after the call Resolving the Promise confirms departure. When EventOnJoinedGroupDeleted fires, remove the group record matched by groupID from the joined groups list; see Group overview /sdk/harmony/group/overview group for listener patterns. Leaving a group does not automatically delete or hide local chat history; handle conversation lifecycle independently.

title: Dismiss group
description: Disband and permanently dismiss a group by its owner.
keywords: sdk harmony v4 sdk harmony group dismiss-group
content: Only the group owner possesses authority to disband a group. Dismissing a group terminates the community for all members, differing fundamentally from deleting or hiding a personal conversation: Code example import sdk, DismissGroupReq from '@openimsdk/imsdk'; const request: DismissGroupReq = groupID: groupID ; await sdk.dismissGroup request ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | groupID | string | Yes | Target group identifier to disband. | Return value Returns a Promise that resolves to void upon group dissolution. State changes after the call Resolving the Promise completes the dissolution request. When EventOnGroupDismissed arrives across connected devices, mark the group as dismissed keyed by groupID and disable message sending and management inputs, as described in Group overview /sdk/harmony/group/overview group . Dissolution events should not forcibly purge local conversation records without user consent.

title: Get specified groups info
description: Batch query the latest profile information for specified group IDs.
keywords: sdk harmony v4 sdk harmony group retrieving-groups get-specified-groups-info
content: Use this method when you already hold group IDs and need to fetch the latest group profile data. It is not intended as a public directory search or for discovering unknown groups by name. Code example import sdk, GetSpecifiedGroupsInfoReq, GetSpecifiedGroupsInfoResp from '@openimsdk/imsdk'; const request: GetSpecifiedGroupsInfoReq = groupIDs: 'group 001', 'group 002' , ; const response: GetSpecifiedGroupsInfoResp = await sdk.getSpecifiedGroupsInfo request ; const groups = response.groups; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | groupIDs | string | Yes | Array of group identifiers to query. | Return value Returns a Promise resolving to GetSpecifiedGroupsInfoResp : | Property | Type | Description | | | | | | groups | IMGroup | Array of group profile records. | State changes after the call Even when querying a single group, pass the ID inside an array. The returned array order is not guaranteed to correspond 1:1 with the input array index; match records using groupID . This is a read only query that does not trigger events. If the view remains active, handle group profile updates as described in Group overview /sdk/harmony/group/overview group .

title: Retrieve joined group list
description: Retrieve all groups that the current account has joined.
keywords: sdk harmony v4 sdk harmony group retrieving-groups get-joined-group-list
content: When the number of groups is small, retrieve the entire list of joined groups for the current account in a single call. Code example import sdk, GetJoinedGroupsResp from '@openimsdk/imsdk'; const response: GetJoinedGroupsResp = await sdk.getJoinedGroups ; const groups = response.groups; Parameters This method does not take any parameters. Return value Returns a Promise resolving to GetJoinedGroupsResp : | Property | Type | Description | | | | | | groups | IMGroup | Complete list of groups joined by the current account. | State changes after the call The returned IMGroup list represents the current account's joined groups, not a public group directory. When joined groups are numerous, use Retrieve joined group list with pagination /sdk/harmony/group/retrieving groups/get joined group list page instead. This call is a snapshot and does not trigger events; subsequent join, leave, and group profile updates should be maintained via events documented in Group overview /sdk/harmony/group/overview group .

title: Retrieve joined group list with pagination
description: Paginate through the list of groups that the current account has joined.
keywords: sdk harmony v4 sdk harmony group retrieving-groups get-joined-group-list-page
content: Use page based pagination to load joined groups incrementally when the user belongs to many groups. Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | pagination.pageNumber | number | Yes | Page number, starting from 1 . | | pagination.showNumber | number | Yes | Number of groups to fetch per page. | Code example import sdk, GetJoinedGroupsPageReq, GetJoinedGroupsPageResp from '@openimsdk/imsdk'; const request: GetJoinedGroupsPageReq = pagination: pageNumber: 1, showNumber: 50 , ; const response: GetJoinedGroupsPageResp = await sdk.getJoinedGroupsPage request ; const groups = response.groups; Return value Returns a Promise resolving to GetJoinedGroupsPageResp : | Property | Type | Description | | | | | | groups | IMGroup | List of group profile items for the current page. | State changes after the call The response does not include a total count or next page cursor; when groups.length < showNumber , the end of the list has been reached. If group creation, dismissal, or leave events occur as documented in Group overview /sdk/harmony/group/overview group , reset pagination and reload from page 1 to prevent inconsistent displays or duplicates.

title: Get joined group count
description: Query the total number of groups joined by the current account.
keywords: sdk harmony v4 sdk harmony group retrieving-groups get-joined-group-count
content: Queries the total number of groups that the current account is currently a member of. Code example import sdk, GetJoinedGroupCountResp from '@openimsdk/imsdk'; const response: GetJoinedGroupCountResp = await sdk.getJoinedGroupCount ; setJoinedGroupCount response.count ; Parameters This method does not take any parameters. Return value Returns a Promise resolving to GetJoinedGroupCountResp : | Property | Type | Description | | | | | | count | number | Number of groups joined by the current account. | State changes after the call count represents the total joined groups at query time. The query itself does not trigger events. When group join or leave events occur, perform incremental count updates see Group overview /sdk/harmony/group/overview group for full event listener setup , and recalibrate with this method upon reconnecting.

title: Check group membership
description: Check whether a specified user is a member of the target group.
keywords: sdk harmony v4 sdk harmony group retrieving-groups is-join-group
content: The HarmonyOS API accepts both group ID and user ID, allowing you to check either the current account or other users where permitted. Code example import sdk, IsJoinGroupReq, IsJoinGroupResp from '@openimsdk/imsdk'; const request: IsJoinGroupReq = groupID: groupID, userID: currentUserID, ; const response: IsJoinGroupResp = await sdk.isJoinGroup request ; if response.joined showGroupMemberActions ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | groupID | string | Yes | Target group identifier. | | userID | string | Yes | User ID to check for membership. | Return value Returns a Promise resolving to IsJoinGroupResp : | Property | Type | Description | | | | | | joined | boolean | true if the user is currently in the group; otherwise false . | State changes after the call This method checks membership snapshot status at the time of invocation and does not fire events. To continuously maintain membership state for the current account, listen to group joined, left, and dismissed events as described in Group overview /sdk/harmony/group/overview group , and recalibrate after reconnects or key lifecycle operations.

title: Search joined groups
description: Search through groups that the current account has joined and synced locally.
keywords: sdk harmony v4 sdk harmony group retrieving-groups search-groups
content: This method searches groups that the current account has already joined and synchronized locally; it does not discover public groups. Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | keyword | string | Yes | Non empty keyword trimmed of whitespace. | | searchGroupID | boolean | Yes | Whether to match against groupID . | | searchGroupName | boolean | Yes | Whether to match against the group name. | Code example import sdk, SearchGroupsReq, SearchGroupsResp from '@openimsdk/imsdk'; const request: SearchGroupsReq = keyword: keyword.trim , searchGroupID: true, searchGroupName: true, ; const response: SearchGroupsResp = await sdk.searchGroups request ; const groups = response.groups; Return value Returns a Promise resolving to SearchGroupsResp : | Property | Type | Description | | | | | | groups | IMGroup | Array of matching joined groups. | State changes after the call Display search results as a separate result set rather than overwriting the complete joined group list retrieved via Retrieve joined group list with pagination /sdk/harmony/group/retrieving groups/get joined group list page . Public group directories, category filtering, and complex permission checks should be provided by your backend service.

title: Check group data synchronization
description: Verify whether local group profile data has completed full synchronization with the server.
keywords: sdk harmony v4 sdk harmony group data-synchronization check-group-data-sync
content: Use checkLocalGroupFullSync to diagnose local synchronization completeness or decide whether to display a loading indicator. This method does not return group items or initiate a network synchronization cycle: Code example import sdk, CheckLocalGroupFullSyncResp from '@openimsdk/imsdk'; const response: CheckLocalGroupFullSyncResp = await sdk.checkLocalGroupFullSync ; if response.IsFullSync showGroupSyncingState ; Return value Returns a Promise that resolves to a CheckLocalGroupFullSyncResp object: | Property | Type | Description | | | | | | IsFullSync | boolean | true indicates local group data is fully synchronized; false indicates sync is pending or incomplete. | State changes after the call The fixed SDK field is capitalized as IsFullSync . Synchronization states progress asynchronously; listen for synchronization lifecycle events documented in Event listener overview /sdk/harmony/events/overview events rather than polling this endpoint in tight loops.

title: Check group member data synchronization
description: Verify whether local member roster data for a specific group has completed full synchronization.
keywords: sdk harmony v4 sdk harmony group data-synchronization check-group-member-data-sync
content: Check whether member records for a specific group are fully synchronized in local storage: Code example import sdk, CheckGroupMemberFullSyncReq, CheckGroupMemberFullSyncResp from '@openimsdk/imsdk'; const request: CheckGroupMemberFullSyncReq = groupID: groupID ; const response: CheckGroupMemberFullSyncResp = await sdk.checkGroupMemberFullSync request ; if response.IsFullSync showMemberSyncingState ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | groupID | string | Yes | Target group identifier. | Return value Returns a Promise that resolves to a CheckGroupMemberFullSyncResp object: | Property | Type | Description | | | | | | IsFullSync | boolean | true indicates all group members are fully synchronized locally; false indicates sync is in progress. | State changes after the call This method does not return member records or trigger synchronization. To load the group roster and track real time member events, see Paginate group members /sdk/harmony/group/retrieving group members/get group member list .

title: Retrieve received group applications
description: Paginate group join applications that the current user has authority to process, and listen for application lifecycle events.
keywords: sdk harmony v4 sdk harmony group group-applications get-group-application-list-as-recipient
content: When querying applications received by group owners or administrators, set send: false . Filter by group IDs and review states by supplying non empty arrays; pass empty arrays to query without restrictions: Code example import sdk, EventOnGroupApplicationAcceptedData, EventOnGroupApplicationAddedData, EventOnGroupApplicationBadgeCountChangedData, EventOnGroupApplicationDeletedData, EventOnGroupApplicationRejectedData, GetGroupApplicationReq, GetGroupApplicationResp, HandleResult, OpenIMSDKEvent, from '@openimsdk/imsdk'; const request: GetGroupApplicationReq = send: false, groupIDs: , handleResults: HandleResult.ResultDefault , pagination: pageNumber: 1, showNumber: 20 , ; const response: GetGroupApplicationResp = await sdk.getGroupApplication request ; const applications = response.applications; const handleApplicationAdded = data: EventOnGroupApplicationAddedData : void = mergeGroupApplication data.application ; ; const handleApplicationAccepted = data: EventOnGroupApplicationAcceptedData : void = mergeGroupApplication data.application ; ; const handleApplicationRejected = data: EventOnGroupApplicationRejectedData : void = mergeGroupApplication data.application ; ; const handleApplicationDeleted = data: EventOnGroupApplicationDeletedData : void = removeGroupApplication data.application.groupID, data.application.userID ; ; const handleApplicationBadge = data: EventOnGroupApplicationBadgeCountChangedData : void = setGroupApplicationBadge data.count ; ; const unsubscribeApplicationAdded = sdk.on OpenIMSDKEvent.EventOnGroupApplicationAdded, handleApplicationAdded, ; const unsubscribeApplicationAccepted = sdk.on OpenIMSDKEvent.EventOnGroupApplicationAccepted, handleApplicationAccepted, ; const unsubscribeApplicationRejected = sdk.on OpenIMSDKEvent.EventOnGroupApplicationRejected, handleApplicationRejected, ; const unsubscribeApplicationDeleted = sdk.on OpenIMSDKEvent.EventOnGroupApplicationDeleted, handleApplicationDeleted, ; const unsubscribeApplicationBadge = sdk.on OpenIMSDKEvent.EventOnGroupApplicationBadgeCountChanged, handleApplicationBadge, ; export function removeGroupApplicationListeners : void unsubscribeApplicationAdded ; unsubscribeApplicationAccepted ; unsubscribeApplicationRejected ; unsubscribeApplicationDeleted ; unsubscribeApplicationBadge ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | send | boolean | Yes | Fixed as false when querying incoming received applications. | | groupIDs | string | Yes | Target group IDs to filter. Pass for all administered groups. | | handleResults | HandleResult | Yes | Review status filter ResultDefault , ResultAccept , ResultDecline . Pass for all. | | pagination.pageNumber | number | Yes | Page index, starting from 1 . | | pagination.showNumber | number | Yes | Number of records to retrieve per page. | Return value Returns a Promise that resolves to a GetGroupApplicationResp object containing applications: IMGroupApplication . State changes after the call Identify unique applications using the composite key groupID:userID . The nickname, avatar, and group information embedded in an application record capture historical snapshots from when the application was created; query current user or group endpoints if real time profiles are needed. If application events arrive while paging, reset the pagination offset and re query. Release all subscriptions using removeGroupApplicationListeners upon signing out or unmounting application components.

title: Retrieve sent group applications
description: Paginate group join applications submitted by the current signed-in account.
keywords: sdk harmony v4 sdk harmony group group-applications get-group-application-list-as-applicant
content: Pass send: true to paginate group applications sent by the signed in user: Code example import sdk, GetGroupApplicationReq, GetGroupApplicationResp from '@openimsdk/imsdk'; const request: GetGroupApplicationReq = send: true, groupIDs: , handleResults: , pagination: pageNumber: 1, showNumber: 20 , ; const response: GetGroupApplicationResp = await sdk.getGroupApplication request ; const applications = response.applications; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | send | boolean | Yes | Set to true to query outgoing applications sent by the current user. | | groupIDs | string | Yes | Filter by group IDs. Pass for all groups. | | handleResults | HandleResult | Yes | Filter by review status. Pass for all states. | | pagination.pageNumber | number | Yes | Page index, starting from 1 . | | pagination.showNumber | number | Yes | Number of records to retrieve per page. | Return value Returns a Promise that resolves to a GetGroupApplicationResp object containing applications: IMGroupApplication . State changes after the call Pass empty arrays for groupIDs and handleResults to query across all groups and review statuses without restrictions. For application fields, composite key groupID:userID , and real time event listener patterns, see Retrieve received group applications /sdk/harmony/group/group applications/get group application list as recipient . If application state events arrive while scrolling, reset the pagination offset and re query from page 1.

title: Get unhandled group application count
description: Query the count of group join requests pending review by the current user after a specified timestamp.
keywords: sdk harmony v4 sdk harmony group group-applications get-group-application-unhandled-count
content: This count is ideal for displaying pending group management action items and is distinct from the unread badge count returned by Get group application badge count /sdk/harmony/group/group applications/get group application badge count . Code example import sdk, GetGroupApplicationUnhandledCountReq, GetGroupApplicationUnhandledCountResp, from '@openimsdk/imsdk'; const request: GetGroupApplicationUnhandledCountReq = time: 0 ; const response: GetGroupApplicationUnhandledCountResp = await sdk.getGroupApplicationUnhandledCount request ; setPendingApplicationCount response.unhandledCount ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | time | number | Yes | Unix millisecond timestamp threshold. Pass 0 to count all unhandled applications. | Return value Returns a Promise resolving to GetGroupApplicationUnhandledCountResp : | Property | Type | Description | | | | | | unhandledCount | number | Number of unhandled group applications pending review. | State changes after the call This is a read only query that does not modify application records or status. To clear the notification badge for group applications, see Clear group application badge count /sdk/harmony/group/group applications/clear group application badge count .

title: Get group application badge count
description: Query the entry badge count for group applications associated with the current account.
keywords: sdk harmony v4 sdk harmony group group-applications get-group-application-badge-count
content: Queries the unread group application entry badge count for the current account. Code example import sdk, GetGroupApplicationBadgeCountResp from '@openimsdk/imsdk'; const response: GetGroupApplicationBadgeCountResp = await sdk.getGroupApplicationBadgeCount ; setGroupApplicationBadge response.count ; Parameters This method does not take any parameters. Return value Returns a Promise resolving to GetGroupApplicationBadgeCountResp : | Property | Type | Description | | | | | | count | number | Unread badge count for group applications. | State changes after the call Badge counts are maintained on the server and are distinct from the unhandled application count filtered by timestamp. Calling this method does not clear the badge. For subsequent badge count changes, listen to application badge events as described in Retrieve received group applications /sdk/harmony/group/group applications/get group application list as recipient .

title: Clear group application badge count
description: Reset the entry badge count for group applications to zero for the current account.
keywords: sdk harmony v4 sdk harmony group group-applications clear-group-application-badge-count
content: Clear the entry badge count after the user actually navigates to and views the group applications screen, rather than automatically on application launch or background preloading. Code example import sdk from '@openimsdk/imsdk'; await sdk.clearGroupApplicationBadgeCount ; Parameters This method does not take any parameters. Return value Returns a Promise that resolves to void when the badge count has been cleared on the server. State changes after the call Clearing the badge count does not delete, approve, or reject any application records, nor does it change the number of unhandled applications. Promise resolution confirms the clear request has completed. Client badge displays should be calibrated by subsequent badge events or by calling Get group application badge count /sdk/harmony/group/group applications/get group application badge count .

title: Accept group application
description: Approve a pending group join request from a specific user.
keywords: sdk harmony v4 sdk harmony group group-applications accept-group-application
content: Group owners or administrators approve pending join requests using handleGroupApplication : Code example import sdk, ApprovalStatus, HandleGroupApplicationReq from '@openimsdk/imsdk'; const request: HandleGroupApplicationReq = groupID: application.groupID, fromUserID: application.userID, handledMsg: 'Approved to join', status: ApprovalStatus.Approved, ; await sdk.handleGroupApplication request ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | groupID | string | Yes | Target group identifier. | | fromUserID | string | Yes | Applicant user ID. | | handledMsg | string | No | Approval remark note. | | status | ApprovalStatus | Yes | Use ApprovalStatus.Approved 1 to approve the application. | Return value Returns a Promise that resolves to void upon server acceptance. State changes after the call Resolving the Promise confirms approval on the server. Do not manually fabricate the final member object locally; wait for EventOnGroupApplicationAccepted to update the application item, and rely on group member events for roster changes. For complete event listeners, see Retrieve received group applications /sdk/harmony/group/group applications/get group application list as recipient .

title: Reject group application
description: Decline a pending group join request from a specific user.
keywords: sdk harmony v4 sdk harmony group group-applications refuse-group-application
content: Decline an incoming group join request with an explanation note: Code example import sdk, ApprovalStatus, HandleGroupApplicationReq from '@openimsdk/imsdk'; const request: HandleGroupApplicationReq = groupID: application.groupID, fromUserID: application.userID, handledMsg: 'Application declined', status: ApprovalStatus.Rejected, ; await sdk.handleGroupApplication request ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | groupID | string | Yes | Target group identifier. | | fromUserID | string | Yes | Applicant user ID. | | handledMsg | string | No | Rejection explanation note. | | status | ApprovalStatus | Yes | Use ApprovalStatus.Rejected 1 to decline the request. | Return value Returns a Promise that resolves to void when the rejection is submitted. State changes after the call Resolving the Promise completes the rejection on the server. When EventOnGroupApplicationRejected arrives, update the application record identified by groupID:userID , as documented in Retrieve received group applications /sdk/harmony/group/group applications/get group application list as recipient .

title: Delete group applications
description: Batch delete specified group join application records.
keywords: sdk harmony v4 sdk harmony group group-applications delete-group-requests
content: This operation removes application records identified by group and applicant, making it suitable for cleaning up processed or obsolete entries from display lists. Code example import sdk, DeleteGroupRequestsReq from '@openimsdk/imsdk'; const request: DeleteGroupRequestsReq = groupRequests: groupID: application.groupID, fromUserID: application.userID , ; await sdk.deleteGroupRequests request ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | groupRequests | GroupRequestItem | Yes | List of group application records to delete, each containing groupID and fromUserID . | Return value Returns a Promise that resolves to void when the records have been deleted. State changes after the call Deleting application records does not reject the application. To submit a review decision, first use Accept group application /sdk/harmony/group/group applications/accept group application or Refuse group application /sdk/harmony/group/group applications/refuse group application . Once the Promise resolves, clients can remove local records matching groupID:userID . For complete event listeners, see Retrieve received group applications /sdk/harmony/group/group applications/get group application list as recipient .

title: Retrieve group member list
description: Paginate and filter group members by role within a specified group.
keywords: sdk harmony v4 sdk harmony group retrieving-group-members get-group-member-list
content: Use this method to build member rosters and optionally filter by member roles using filter . Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | groupID | string | Yes | Target group identifier. | | filter | GroupMemberFilter | Yes | Member role filter criteria. | | pagination.pageNumber | number | Yes | Page number, starting from 1 . | | pagination.showNumber | number | Yes | Number of records to return per page. | Code example import sdk, EventOnGroupMemberAddedData, EventOnGroupMemberDeletedData, EventOnGroupMemberInfoChangedData, GetGroupMembersReq, GetGroupMembersResp, GroupMemberFilter, OpenIMSDKEvent, from '@openimsdk/imsdk'; const request: GetGroupMembersReq = groupID: groupID, filter: GroupMemberFilter.All, pagination: pageNumber: 1, showNumber: 50 , ; const response: GetGroupMembersResp = await sdk.getGroupMembers request ; const members = response.members; const handleMemberAdded = data: EventOnGroupMemberAddedData : void = upsertGroupMember data.member ; ; const handleMemberDeleted = data: EventOnGroupMemberDeletedData : void = removeGroupMember data.member.groupID, data.member.userID ; ; const handleMemberChanged = data: EventOnGroupMemberInfoChangedData : void = upsertGroupMember data.member ; ; const unsubscribeMemberAdded = sdk.on OpenIMSDKEvent.EventOnGroupMemberAdded, handleMemberAdded ; const unsubscribeMemberDeleted = sdk.on OpenIMSDKEvent.EventOnGroupMemberDeleted, handleMemberDeleted, ; const unsubscribeMemberChanged = sdk.on OpenIMSDKEvent.EventOnGroupMemberInfoChanged, handleMemberChanged, ; export function removeGroupMemberListeners : void unsubscribeMemberAdded ; unsubscribeMemberDeleted ; unsubscribeMemberChanged ; GroupMemberFilter supports filtering by all members, owner, administrators, regular members, administrators with regular members, and owner with administrators. Member records use groupID:userID as their stable unique key. When members are added or removed during pagination, reset the pagination state and reload from the first page. Return value Returns a Promise resolving to GetGroupMembersResp . response.members contains an array of member records with the following primary fields: | Field | Type | Description | | | | | | groupID , userID | string | Jointly uniquely identify a member record. | | nickname , faceURL | string | In group member nickname and avatar URL. | | roleLevel | GroupMemberRoleLevel | Role level: ordinary member, administrator, or owner. | | muteEndTime | number | Mute expiration time as a Unix millisecond timestamp. | | joinTime | number | Member join time as a Unix millisecond timestamp. | | joinSource | GroupJoinSource | How the member joined the group. | | inviterUserID | string | User ID of the inviter. | | ex | string | Member custom extension string. | State changes after the call In group member profiles are scoped to the specific group; do not overwrite account level user profiles with them. Call removeGroupMemberListeners when logging out or disposing of the group member state layer.

title: Get group owner and administrators
description: Query group owner and administrator member profiles for a specified group.
keywords: sdk harmony v4 sdk harmony group retrieving-group-members get-group-member-owner-and-admin
content: This method directly retrieves the owner and administrators for a group, making it ideal for rendering admin panels or management team views without paginating through all members. Code example import sdk, GetGroupMemberOwnerAndAdminReq, GetGroupMemberOwnerAndAdminResp, from '@openimsdk/imsdk'; const request: GetGroupMemberOwnerAndAdminReq = groupID: groupID ; const response: GetGroupMemberOwnerAndAdminResp = await sdk.getGroupMemberOwnerAndAdmin request ; const managers = response.members; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | groupID | string | Yes | Target group identifier. | Return value Returns a Promise resolving to GetGroupMemberOwnerAndAdminResp : | Property | Type | Description | | | | | | members | GroupMemberItem | List of group members with owner or administrator roles. | State changes after the call Use the roleLevel property of each returned item to distinguish between group owner and administrator roles, merging records into local state using groupID:userID . This call is a read only snapshot that does not trigger events. If the management page remains open, listen for member changes as documented in Retrieve group member list /sdk/harmony/group/retrieving group members/get group member list .

title: Get specified group members info
description: Query group member profile information by user IDs in a target group.
keywords: sdk harmony v4 sdk harmony group retrieving-group-members get-specified-group-members-info
content: Queries member profiles for specified users within a particular group. Code example import sdk, GetSpecifiedGroupMembersInfoReq, GetSpecifiedGroupMembersInfoResp, from '@openimsdk/imsdk'; const request: GetSpecifiedGroupMembersInfoReq = groupID: groupID, userIDs: 'user 001', 'user 002' , ; const response: GetSpecifiedGroupMembersInfoResp = await sdk.getSpecifiedGroupMembersInfo request ; const members = response.members; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | groupID | string | Yes | Target group identifier. | | userIDs | string | Yes | Array of user IDs to query. | Return value Returns a Promise resolving to GetSpecifiedGroupMembersInfoResp : | Property | Type | Description | | | | | | members | GroupMemberItem | List of member profiles matching the requested user IDs. | State changes after the call The returned array order is not guaranteed to match the input ID sequence. Because nicknames, roles, and mute states differ across groups for the same user, clients should index and cache member data using groupID:userID . This query does not trigger events; to listen for member changes, see Retrieve group member list /sdk/harmony/group/retrieving group members/get group member list .

title: Check users in group
description: Verify which users from a given list are currently members of a specified group.
keywords: sdk harmony v4 sdk harmony group retrieving-group-members get-users-in-group
content: Use this method when you only need to verify group membership status without fetching full member profiles. Code example import sdk, GetUsersInGroupReq, GetUsersInGroupResp from '@openimsdk/imsdk'; const request: GetUsersInGroupReq = groupID: groupID, userIDs: candidateUserIDs, ; const response: GetUsersInGroupResp = await sdk.getUsersInGroup request ; const confirmedUserIDs = response.userIDs; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | groupID | string | Yes | Target group identifier. | | userIDs | string | Yes | Array of user IDs to check. | Return value Returns a Promise resolving to GetUsersInGroupResp : | Property | Type | Description | | | | | | userIDs | string | Array containing only user IDs from the input list who currently belong to the group. | State changes after the call The returned array contains only user IDs from the input list who are currently members of the group, omitting full profile details. This query reflects an instantaneous snapshot. To maintain an active member roster with real time updates, see Retrieve group member list /sdk/harmony/group/retrieving group members/get group member list .

title: Search group members
description: Paginate and search members in a specified group by user ID or member nickname.
keywords: sdk harmony v4 sdk harmony group retrieving-group-members search-group-members
content: Use this method to search members or build candidate selection lists when Creating @ mention messages /sdk/harmony/message/creating messages/create text at message . Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | groupID | string | Yes | Target group identifier. | | keyword | string | Yes | Non empty search keyword trimmed of whitespace. | | searchUserID | boolean | Yes | Whether to match member user IDs. | | searchMemberNickname | boolean | Yes | Whether to match in group member nicknames. | | pagination | RequestPagination | Yes | Pagination configuration containing page number and page size. | Code example import sdk, SearchGroupMembersReq, SearchGroupMembersResp from '@openimsdk/imsdk'; const request: SearchGroupMembersReq = groupID: groupID, keyword: keyword.trim , searchUserID: true, searchMemberNickname: true, pagination: pageNumber: 1, showNumber: 30 , ; const response: SearchGroupMembersResp = await sdk.searchGroupMembers request ; const members = response.members; Return value Returns a Promise resolving to SearchGroupMembersResp : | Property | Type | Description | | | | | | members | GroupMemberItem | Array of matching group member items. | State changes after the call Search results represent an isolated query view and should not replace your application's primary member roster. When search terms or field flags change, reset the page index and swap out search results. For managing the primary member roster, see Retrieve group member list /sdk/harmony/group/retrieving group members/get group member list .

title: Invite user to group
description: Invite one or more users to join a specified group.
keywords: sdk harmony v4 sdk harmony group managing-group-members invite-user-to-group
content: Clients can control UI actions based on current member roles, while final permissions are strictly enforced by OpenIMServer. Code example import sdk, InviteUserToGroupReq from '@openimsdk/imsdk'; const request: InviteUserToGroupReq = groupID: groupID, userIDs: 'user 002', 'user 003' , reason: 'Invited to join project team', ; await sdk.inviteUserToGroup request ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | groupID | string | Yes | Target group identifier. | | userIDs | string | Yes | Array of user IDs to invite. | | reason | string | No | Invitation reason or note. | Return value Returns a Promise that resolves to void when the invitation request is accepted by the server. State changes after the call Deduplicate userIDs before initiating the call. Promise resolution indicates that the invitation was submitted to the server; it does not guarantee immediate member list addition. Depending on group verification settings, invitations may require user confirmation or admin approval. When users actually join and member addition events fire, update local rosters using groupID:userID . For complete event listener setups, see Retrieve group member list /sdk/harmony/group/retrieving group members/get group member list .

title: Kick group member
description: Remove one or more members from a specified group.
keywords: sdk harmony v4 sdk harmony group managing-group-members kick-group-member
content: This method cannot be used to remove the group owner. To change the group owner, first use Transfer group ownership /sdk/harmony/group/managing group members/transfer group owner . Code example import sdk, KickGroupMemberReq from '@openimsdk/imsdk'; const request: KickGroupMemberReq = groupID: groupID, kickedUserIDs: targetUserID , reason: 'Left the project', ; await sdk.kickGroupMember request ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | groupID | string | Yes | Target group identifier. | | kickedUserIDs | string | Yes | Array of user IDs to kick out of the group. | | reason | string | No | Reason for removal. | Return value Returns a Promise that resolves to void when the removal request is accepted by the server. State changes after the call Deduplicate kickedUserIDs before invoking this method. Promise resolution confirms that the server accepted the kick request. The SDK triggers group member removed events; upon receiving the notification, clients remove the corresponding records by groupID:userID . For complete event listeners, see Retrieve group member list /sdk/harmony/group/retrieving group members/get group member list .

title: Set group member nickname
description: Modify the in-group nickname of a specific member.
keywords: sdk harmony v4 sdk harmony group managing-group-members set-group-member-nickname
content: The in group nickname applies solely within the specified group and does not modify the user's account profile nickname. Code example import sdk, SetGroupMemberInfoReq from '@openimsdk/imsdk'; const request: SetGroupMemberInfoReq = groupID: groupID, userID: targetUserID, nickname: 'Project Lead', ; await sdk.setGroupMemberInfo request ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | groupID | string | Yes | Target group identifier. | | userID | string | Yes | Target member user ID. | | nickname | string | Yes | New in group nickname. | Return value Returns a Promise that resolves to void when the nickname update succeeds on the server. State changes after the call Whether the current user has permission to modify their own or another member's in group nickname is validated by OpenIMServer based on group roles and policies. Once the Promise resolves, the SDK fires a group member info changed event; clients update the member record matching groupID:userID . For complete event listeners, see Retrieve group member list /sdk/harmony/group/retrieving group members/get group member list .

title: Set group member role level
description: Promote a regular group member to administrator or revoke their administrator role.
keywords: sdk harmony v4 sdk harmony group managing-group-members set-group-member-role-level
content: Only group owners have permission to assign or revoke administrator roles. Code example import sdk, GroupMemberRoleLevel, SetGroupMemberInfoReq from '@openimsdk/imsdk'; const request: SetGroupMemberInfoReq = groupID: groupID, userID: targetUserID, roleLevel: GroupMemberRoleLevel.GroupAdmin, ; await sdk.setGroupMemberInfo request ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | groupID | string | Yes | Target group identifier. | | userID | string | Yes | Target member user ID. | | roleLevel | GroupMemberRoleLevel | Yes | Target role level. See role level values below. | Role level values | Enum value | Value | Description | | | | | | GroupMemberRoleLevel.GroupOrdinaryUsers | 20 | Regular group member. Pass to demote an administrator. | | GroupMemberRoleLevel.GroupAdmin | 60 | Group administrator. Pass to promote a member. | | GroupMemberRoleLevel.GroupOwner | 100 | Group owner used for role identification only . | Return value Returns a Promise that resolves to void when the role update succeeds on the server. State changes after the call Pass GroupAdmin to grant administrator status or GroupOrdinaryUsers to revoke it. You cannot change group ownership by passing GroupOwner ; use Transfer group ownership /sdk/harmony/group/managing group members/transfer group owner instead. Once the Promise resolves, the SDK triggers a group member info changed event; clients update the member record matching groupID:userID . For complete event listeners, see Retrieve group member list /sdk/harmony/group/retrieving group members/get group member list .

title: Set group member avatar
description: Update the avatar URL of a specific member in a group.
keywords: sdk harmony v4 sdk harmony group managing-group-members set-group-member-avatar
content: faceURL specifies the avatar URL in the group member profile and applies solely within the target group. Code example import sdk, SetGroupMemberInfoReq from '@openimsdk/imsdk'; const request: SetGroupMemberInfoReq = groupID: groupID, userID: targetUserID, faceURL: avatarURL, ; await sdk.setGroupMemberInfo request ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | groupID | string | Yes | Target group identifier. | | userID | string | Yes | Target member user ID. | | faceURL | string | Yes | Member avatar image URL. | Return value Returns a Promise that resolves to void when the avatar update succeeds on the server. State changes after the call In group member avatars are distinct from account level profile avatars. To modify the account profile avatar, use Update current user profile /sdk/harmony/user/profile/set self info . After the Promise resolves, the SDK triggers a group member info changed event; clients update the member record matching groupID:userID . For complete event listeners, see Retrieve group member list /sdk/harmony/group/retrieving group members/get group member list .

title: Set group member extension
description: Set custom business extension data for a specified group member.
keywords: sdk harmony v4 sdk harmony group managing-group-members set-group-member-extension
content: ex is an opaque string; the SDK does not automatically merge JSON objects. When multiple business modules share this field, the application layer must preserve other namespaces. Code example import sdk, SetGroupMemberInfoReq from '@openimsdk/imsdk'; const request: SetGroupMemberInfoReq = groupID: groupID, userID: targetUserID, ex: JSON.stringify title: 'maintainer' , ; await sdk.setGroupMemberInfo request ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | groupID | string | Yes | Target group identifier. | | userID | string | Yes | Target member user ID. | | ex | string | Yes | Custom extension string. | Return value Returns a Promise that resolves to void when the extension field is updated on the server. State changes after the call Use JSON string serialization only if your business logic expects JSON; otherwise, treat ex as an arbitrary string.
