After the Promise resolves, the SDK triggers a group member info changed event; clients update the member record matching groupID:userID . For complete event listeners, see Retrieve group member list /sdk/harmony/group/retrieving group members/get group member list .

title: Transfer group ownership
description: Transfer group ownership to another active member in the group.
keywords: sdk harmony v4 sdk harmony group managing-group-members transfer-group-owner
content: Only the current group owner can transfer ownership. The target user must be an active member of the specified group. Code example import sdk, TransferGroupOwnerReq from '@openimsdk/imsdk'; const request: TransferGroupOwnerReq = groupID: groupID, ownerUserID: targetUserID, ; await sdk.transferGroupOwner request ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | groupID | string | Yes | Target group identifier. | | ownerUserID | string | Yes | User ID of the new group owner. | Return value Returns a Promise that resolves to void when ownership has transferred on the server. State changes after the call Once the Promise resolves, roles for both the former owner and the new owner are updated. The SDK triggers group info and group member info changed events; clients update the group owner matching groupID and update member roles matching groupID:userID . For complete event listeners, see Retrieve group member list /sdk/harmony/group/retrieving group members/get group member list . If the former owner intends to leave the group, transfer ownership first before calling Leave group /sdk/harmony/group/quit group .

title: Mute group member
description: Mute or unmute a specific member in a group.
keywords: sdk harmony v4 sdk harmony group managing-group-members change-group-member-mute
content: Mutes or unmutes a specific group member for a specified duration. Code example import sdk, ChangeGroupMemberMuteReq from '@openimsdk/imsdk'; const request: ChangeGroupMemberMuteReq = groupID: groupID, userID: targetUserID, mutedSeconds: 3600, ; await sdk.changeGroupMemberMute request ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | groupID | string | Yes | Target group identifier. | | userID | string | Yes | Target member user ID. | | mutedSeconds | number | Yes | Mute duration in seconds. Pass 0 to unmute. | Return value Returns a Promise that resolves to void when the mute status has been updated on the server. State changes after the call mutedSeconds is expressed in seconds; passing 0 lifts the mute. Group owners can mute administrators and regular members; administrators can only mute regular members. Permissions are validated by OpenIMServer. After the call succeeds, the SDK triggers a group member info changed event; clients update the member's muteEndTime matching groupID:userID . For complete event listeners, see Retrieve group member list /sdk/harmony/group/retrieving group members/get group member list .

title: Message overview
description: Understand message creation, transmission, reception, query patterns, and state synchronization boundaries.
keywords: sdk harmony v4 sdk harmony message overview-message
content: The OpenIM HarmonyOS SDK uses IMMessage to represent a chat message. Transmission follows a two stage pattern: first create the message object from local content, then dispatch it to a direct chat peer or group. Creation methods only build local message objects and do not perform network transmission; resolving the transmission Promise confirms local dispatch and server acceptance, but does not indicate that remote clients have rendered the message. Message lists locate and identify messages using conversationID and clientMsgID . conversationID originates from the current conversation, query filters, or event payloads; clientMsgID serves as the immutable client side identifier for deduplication and local state reconciliation. Message lifecycle stages | Stage | Primary operations | Description | | | | | | Create | Create text message /sdk/harmony/message/creating messages/create text message and other message factory methods | Returns an IMMessage object instantiated locally without network dispatch. | | Send | Send message /sdk/harmony/message/sending messages/send message | Specify recvID for direct chats or groupID for group chats. | | Receive | Receive messages /sdk/harmony/message/receiving messages/receive messages events | Merge incoming messages by conversationID:clientMsgID ; drop duplicate events. | | Query | History retrieval, keyword search, or lookup by ID | Returns snapshots available at invocation time without triggering new message events. | | Update | Delete, revoke, edit, pin, or mark as read | Process the Promise resolution, corresponding event notifications, and active query calibration separately. | Local image, audio, video, and file messages are uploaded by the SDK during transmission. For assets pre uploaded by application servers, use URL based factory methods. Both variants are dispatched via Send message /sdk/harmony/message/sending messages/send message . Common message properties | Property | Type | Description | | | | | | clientMsgID , serverMsgID | string | Client generated and server assigned message identifiers. | | sessionType | SessionType | Conversation category, such as single or group chat. | | sendID , recvID , groupID | string | Sender user ID and destination peer or group IDs. | | contentType | ContentType | Message type determining which content element field to read. | | createTime , sendTime , seq | number | Client creation timestamp, dispatch timestamp, and server sequence number. | | status | MsgStatus | Current message delivery status. | | isRead | boolean | Read receipt status. | | ex | string | Distributed extension string synchronized across clients. | | localEx | string | Device local extension string stored only on the current client. | Payload content resides in the property corresponding to contentType , such as textElem , pictureElem , soundElem , videoElem , fileElem , atTextElem , quoteElem , mergeElem , or customElem . Never identify or key messages by rendered text, array index, or paginated list length. Creating message objects and executing local queries do not fire shared message events. For state changing operations like sending or revoking messages, clearly separate the three distinct stages: Promise resolution, event notifications, and re query calibration. Use message event listeners to update conversations and message timeline interfaces reliably.

title: Create text message
description: Create a standard text message object ready to send.
keywords: sdk harmony v4 sdk harmony message creating-messages create-text-message
content: Handle whitespace, maximum length, and content policy checks in the application layer before calling this method. Code example import sdk, CreateTextMessageReq, CreateTextMessageResp from '@openimsdk/imsdk'; const text = input.trim ; if text.length 0 const request: CreateTextMessageReq = text: text ; const response: CreateTextMessageResp = await sdk.createTextMessage request ; const message = response.message; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | text | string | Yes | Message text content. | Return value Returns a Promise resolving to CreateTextMessageResp : | Property | Type | Description | | | | | | message | IMMessage | Locally instantiated text message object. | State changes after the call Promise resolution returns only the local IMMessage object ready for transmission; it does not write to OpenIMServer or trigger message events. Pass the returned object to Send message /sdk/harmony/message/sending messages/send message as the next step.

title: Create advanced text message
description: Create a text message containing entity spans and business link metadata.
keywords: sdk harmony v4 sdk harmony message creating-messages create-advanced-text-message
content: Advanced text messages use MessageEntity to mark ranges within the body text, suitable for links, topics, or custom business entities. Entity offsets and lengths must match the character indexing rules used in text . Code example import sdk, CreateAdvancedTextMessageReq, CreateAdvancedTextMessageResp, MessageEntity, from '@openimsdk/imsdk'; const entity: MessageEntity = type: 'url', offset: 3, length: 4, url: 'https://example.com/releases', ex: '', ; const request: CreateAdvancedTextMessageReq = text: 'See release notes', messageEntities: entity , ; const response: CreateAdvancedTextMessageResp = await sdk.createAdvancedTextMessage request ; const message = response.message; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | text | string | Yes | Message text content. | | messageEntities | MessageEntity | Yes | List of entity metadata defining character spans within text . | Return value Returns a Promise resolving to CreateAdvancedTextMessageResp : | Property | Type | Description | | | | | | message | IMMessage | Locally instantiated message object. | State changes after the call Receiving clients should verify that each entity span does not exceed string length boundaries, and validate URLs and extension data for security. Promise resolution confirms local message object creation without dispatching messages or opening URLs. Use Send message /sdk/harmony/message/sending messages/send message to send it.

title: Create @ mention message
description: Create an @ mention text message for group chats.
keywords: sdk harmony v4 sdk harmony message creating-messages create-text-at-message
content: The HarmonyOS SDK method requires providing message body text, up to 10 mentioned group members, and a quoted source message. Mentioned members require stable user IDs and their current in group nicknames. Code example import sdk, AtInfo, CreateTextAtMessageReq, CreateTextAtMessageResp from '@openimsdk/imsdk'; const mentionedUser: AtInfo = atUserID: 'user a', groupNickname: 'Alex', ; const request: CreateTextAtMessageReq = text: '@Alex Please confirm', usersInfo: mentionedUser , quoteMessage: sourceMessage, ; const response: CreateTextAtMessageResp = await sdk.createTextAtMessage request ; const message = response.message; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | text | string | Yes | Body text containing @ mention strings. | | usersInfo | AtInfo | Yes | List of mentioned users up to 10 , each specifying atUserID and groupNickname . | | quoteMessage | IMMessage | Yes | A quoted source message from the same group conversation. | Return value Returns a Promise resolving to CreateTextAtMessageResp : | Property | Type | Description | | | | | | message | IMMessage | Locally instantiated @ mention message object. | State changes after the call sourceMessage must come from the same group chat via queries or events. Creating this message operates locally without altering conversation mention reminders or firing new message events. When sending the message via Send message /sdk/harmony/message/sending messages/send message , specify the destination groupID . Mention all members Do not hardcode mention all tokens in application code. Retrieve the SDK defined token first, then build the message: import sdk, AtInfo, CreateTextAtMessageReq, CreateTextAtMessageResp, GetAtAllTagResp, from '@openimsdk/imsdk'; const atAllResult: GetAtAllTagResp = await sdk.getAtAllTag ; const atAllUser: AtInfo = atUserID: atAllResult.tag, groupNickname: 'Everyone', ; const request: CreateTextAtMessageReq = text: $ atAllResult.tag Please check the group announcement , usersInfo: atAllUser , quoteMessage: sourceMessage, ; const response: CreateTextAtMessageResp = await sdk.createTextAtMessage request ; const message = response.message; getAtAllTag returns tag string identifying the internal mention all symbol. It is a read only query that does not create messages or emit events.

title: Create custom message
description: Create a custom message containing structured business payload data.
keywords: sdk harmony v4 sdk harmony message creating-messages create-custom-message
content: Custom messages are ideal for business content such as orders, tasks, invites, or polls that need to be synchronized with conversation members. Code example import sdk, CreateCustomMessageReq, CreateCustomMessageResp from '@openimsdk/imsdk'; const request: CreateCustomMessageReq = data: JSON.stringify type: 'task', taskID: 'task 42' , extension: JSON.stringify schemaVersion: 1 , description: 'Task Card', searchText: 'Project Task', ; const response: CreateCustomMessageResp = await sdk.createCustomMessage request ; const message = response.message; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | data | string | Yes | Custom payload data string. | | extension | string | Yes | Supplementary extension string. | | description | string | Yes | Summary or fallback description for legacy clients. | | searchText | string | Yes | Searchable text string for local message indexing. | Return value Returns a Promise resolving to CreateCustomMessageResp : | Property | Type | Description | | | | | | message | IMMessage | Locally instantiated custom message object. | State changes after the call Both data and extension are opaque strings; the SDK does not parse or merge JSON keys automatically. description serves as a fallback or concise summary, while searchText enables local keyword search. Receiving clients parse the payload according to agreed data contracts, falling back to description when encountering unknown schema versions. This method constructs the message object locally without dispatching it; call Send message /sdk/harmony/message/sending messages/send message to send it. To listen for server originated business notifications, see Receive server business notifications /sdk/harmony/message/receiving messages/receive custom business messages .

title: Create image message from local file
description: Create an image message from local filesystem image paths accessible to the application.
keywords: sdk harmony v4 sdk harmony message creating-messages create-image-message-by-file
content: sourcePath must point to a stable local path accessible to the native HarmonyOS application. The optional bigPath and snapshotPath specify high resolution and thumbnail images respectively; when omitted, the SDK falls back to the original image. Code example import sdk, CreateImageMessageReq, CreateImageMessageResp from '@openimsdk/imsdk'; const request: CreateImageMessageReq = sourcePath: imagePath, bigPath: bigImagePath, snapshotPath: thumbnailPath, ; const response: CreateImageMessageResp = await sdk.createImageMessage request ; const message = response.message; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | sourcePath | string | Yes | Local filesystem path to the original image. | | bigPath | string | No | Optional local filesystem path to a compressed or high res image variant. | | snapshotPath | string | No | Optional local filesystem path to a thumbnail snapshot image. | Return value Returns a Promise resolving to CreateImageMessageResp : | Property | Type | Description | | | | | | message | IMMessage | Locally instantiated image message object. | State changes after the call Temporary paths may be purged by the system. If sending is deferred, copy files into persistent application sandbox storage first. Promise resolution creates the message object locally; calling Send message /sdk/harmony/message/sending messages/send message subsequently triggers upload and transmission by the SDK.

title: Create image message from URL
description: Create an image message from pre-uploaded image resource metadata.
keywords: sdk harmony v4 sdk harmony message creating-messages create-image-message-by-url
content: Original, high resolution, and thumbnail variants can reference different URLs. Reuse identical metadata only when all three images actually share the same asset. Code example import sdk, CreateImageMessageByURLReq, CreateImageMessageResp, PictureBaseInfo, from '@openimsdk/imsdk'; const picture: PictureBaseInfo = uuid: uploaded.uuid, type: 'image/jpeg', size: uploaded.size, width: 1280, height: 720, url: uploaded.url, ; const request: CreateImageMessageByURLReq = sourcePicture: picture, bigPicture: picture, snapshotPicture: picture, ; const response: CreateImageMessageResp = await sdk.createImageMessageByURL request ; const message = response.message; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | sourcePicture | PictureBaseInfo | Yes | Original image metadata including URL, dimensions, and size. | | bigPicture | PictureBaseInfo | Yes | High resolution or compressed image variant metadata. | | snapshotPicture | PictureBaseInfo | Yes | Thumbnail image metadata. | Return value Returns a Promise resolving to CreateImageMessageResp : | Property | Type | Description | | | | | | message | IMMessage | Locally instantiated image message object referencing remote URLs. | State changes after the call URL, MIME type, size, and dimensions must originate from verified upload responses. sourcePath , bigPath , and snapshotPath inside PictureBaseInfo are optional and only needed if retaining local paths. Call Send message /sdk/harmony/message/sending messages/send message after creation; the SDK automatically recognizes pre existing remote asset URLs.

title: Create voice message from local file
description: Create a voice message from local audio file paths accessible to the application.
keywords: sdk harmony v4 sdk harmony message creating-messages create-sound-message-by-file
content: Creates a voice audio message using a local audio recording path. Code example import sdk, CreateSoundMessageReq, CreateSoundMessageResp from '@openimsdk/imsdk'; const request: CreateSoundMessageReq = soundPath: audioPath, duration: 12, ; const response: CreateSoundMessageResp = await sdk.createSoundMessage request ; const message = response.message; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | soundPath | string | Yes | Local filesystem path to the audio file readable by the native SDK. | | duration | number | Yes | Audio duration in seconds. | Return value Returns a Promise resolving to CreateSoundMessageResp : | Property | Type | Description | | | | | | message | IMMessage | Locally instantiated voice message object. | State changes after the call soundPath must be accessible to the native SDK, and duration is expressed in seconds. Temporary paths returned by recorder components may be deleted by the operating system; copy audio files into a persistent sandbox path if sending is delayed. Promise resolution confirms local creation; call Send message /sdk/harmony/message/sending messages/send message to initiate upload and dispatch.

title: Create voice message from URL
description: Create a voice audio message from pre-uploaded remote audio resource metadata.
keywords: sdk harmony v4 sdk harmony message creating-messages create-sound-message-by-url
content: Creates a voice audio message using pre uploaded remote audio metadata. Code example import sdk, CreateSoundMessageByURLReq, CreateSoundMessageResp from '@openimsdk/imsdk'; const request: CreateSoundMessageByURLReq = uuid: uploaded.uuid, soundPath: '', sourceURL: uploaded.url, dataSize: uploaded.size, duration: 12, soundType: 'audio/mp4', ; const response: CreateSoundMessageResp = await sdk.createSoundMessageByURL request ; const message = response.message; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | uuid | string | Yes | Unique identifier for the audio asset. | | soundPath | string | Yes | Local file path if retained, or empty string "" for remote files. | | sourceURL | string | Yes | Remote audio download URL. | | dataSize | number | Yes | Audio payload size in bytes. | | duration | number | Yes | Audio playback duration in seconds. | | soundType | string | Yes | Audio MIME type for example, audio/mp4 . | Return value Returns a Promise resolving to CreateSoundMessageResp : | Property | Type | Description | | | | | | message | IMMessage | Locally instantiated voice message object referencing remote URLs. | State changes after the call All fields are required. dataSize is in bytes, duration is in seconds, and soundType represents the true MIME type. Do not supply short lived temporary URLs that receiving clients cannot access. This method creates the message object locally; call Send message /sdk/harmony/message/sending messages/send message to dispatch it.

title: Create video message from local file
description: Create a video message from local video and thumbnail image filesystem paths.
keywords: sdk harmony v4 sdk harmony message creating-messages create-video-message-by-file
content: Creates a video message object using local filesystem paths for both the video file and cover thumbnail image. Code example import sdk, CreateVideoMessageReq, CreateVideoMessageResp from '@openimsdk/imsdk'; const request: CreateVideoMessageReq = videoSourcePath: videoPath, videoType: 'video/mp4', duration: 18, snapshotSourcePath: coverPath, ; const response: CreateVideoMessageResp = await sdk.createVideoMessage request ; const message = response.message; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | videoSourcePath | string | Yes | Local filesystem path to the video file readable by the native SDK. | | videoType | string | Yes | Video MIME type such as video/mp4 . | | duration | number | Yes | Video playback duration in seconds. | | snapshotSourcePath | string | Yes | Local filesystem path to the cover thumbnail image. | Return value Returns a Promise resolving to CreateVideoMessageResp : | Property | Type | Description | | | | | | message | IMMessage | Locally instantiated video message object. | State changes after the call Both video and cover snapshot paths must be readable by the native SDK. duration is in seconds, and videoType represents the true MIME type. Promise resolution creates the message object locally; calling Send message /sdk/harmony/message/sending messages/send message subsequently uploads both files through the SDK and transmits the message.

title: Create video message from URL
description: Create a video message from pre-uploaded video and cover thumbnail resource metadata.
keywords: sdk harmony v4 sdk harmony message creating-messages create-video-message-by-url
content: Creates a video message object using remote URLs and metadata for both video and thumbnail cover assets. Code example import sdk, CreateVideoMessageByURLReq, CreateVideoMessageResp from '@openimsdk/imsdk'; const request: CreateVideoMessageByURLReq = videoPath: '', videoUUID: uploadedVideo.uuid, videoURL: uploadedVideo.url, videoType: 'video/mp4', videoSize: uploadedVideo.size, duration: 18, snapshotPath: '', snapshotUUID: uploadedCover.uuid, snapshotSize: uploadedCover.size, snapshotURL: uploadedCover.url, snapshotWidth: 1280, snapshotHeight: 720, snapshotType: 'image/jpeg', ; const response: CreateVideoMessageResp = await sdk.createVideoMessageByURL request ; const message = response.message; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | videoPath | string | Yes | Local video path if retained, or empty string "" for remote files. | | videoUUID | string | Yes | Unique identifier for the video asset. | | videoURL | string | Yes | Remote video download URL. | | videoType | string | Yes | Video MIME type such as video/mp4 . | | videoSize | number | Yes | Video file size in bytes. | | duration | number | Yes | Video playback duration in seconds. | | snapshotPath | string | Yes | Local thumbnail path if retained, or empty string "" . | | snapshotUUID | string | Yes | Unique identifier for the cover thumbnail asset. | | snapshotSize | number | Yes | Cover thumbnail file size in bytes. | | snapshotURL | string | Yes | Remote thumbnail download URL. | | snapshotWidth | number | Yes | Thumbnail pixel width. | | snapshotHeight | number | Yes | Thumbnail pixel height. | | snapshotType | string | Yes | Thumbnail MIME type such as image/jpeg . | Return value Returns a Promise resolving to CreateVideoMessageResp : | Property | Type | Description | | | | | | message | IMMessage | Locally instantiated video message object referencing remote URLs. | State changes after the call Note that property names use uppercase URL . All sizes, dimensions, types, and durations must match actual resource attributes; even if no local files exist, pass empty strings "" for videoPath and snapshotPath . This method instantiates the message object locally; call Send message /sdk/harmony/message/sending messages/send message to dispatch it.

title: Create file message from local file
description: Create a file message from an accessible local filesystem path.
keywords: sdk harmony v4 sdk harmony message creating-messages create-file-message-by-file
content: Creates a file message object using a local filesystem path accessible to the application. Code example import sdk, CreateFileMessageReq, CreateFileMessageResp from '@openimsdk/imsdk'; const request: CreateFileMessageReq = fileSourcePath: filePath, fileName: 'ProjectPlan.pdf', ; const response: CreateFileMessageResp = await sdk.createFileMessage request ; const message = response.message; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | fileSourcePath | string | Yes | Local filesystem path readable by the native SDK. | | fileName | string | Yes | File display name shown to receiving users, including extension. | Return value Returns a Promise resolving to CreateFileMessageResp : | Property | Type | Description | | | | | | message | IMMessage | Locally instantiated file message object. | State changes after the call fileSourcePath must be accessible to the native SDK layer. fileName is displayed and saved by receiving clients and should preserve appropriate file extensions without substituting for real file content validation. Resolving the Promise creates the message object locally; calling Send message /sdk/harmony/message/sending messages/send message subsequently uploads the file through the SDK and sends the message.

title: Create file message from URL
description: Create a file message from pre-uploaded remote file metadata.
keywords: sdk harmony v4 sdk harmony message creating-messages create-file-message-by-url
content: Creates a file message using remote resource metadata when the file has already been uploaded by application servers or cloud storage. Code example import sdk, CreateFileMessageByURLReq, CreateFileMessageResp from '@openimsdk/imsdk'; const request: CreateFileMessageByURLReq = filePath: '', uuid: uploaded.uuid, sourceURL: uploaded.url, fileName: 'ProjectPlan.pdf', fileSize: uploaded.size, fileType: 'application/pdf', ; const response: CreateFileMessageResp = await sdk.createFileMessageByURL request ; const message = response.message; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | filePath | string | Yes | Local file path if available, or an empty string "" for pure remote resources. | | uuid | string | Yes | Unique identifier for the uploaded file asset. | | sourceURL | string | Yes | Remote download URL of the file. | | fileName | string | Yes | Original file name including extension. | | fileSize | number | Yes | File size in bytes. | | fileType | string | Yes | MIME type of the file. | Return value Returns a Promise resolving to CreateFileMessageResp : | Property | Type | Description | | | | | | message | IMMessage | Locally instantiated file message object. | State changes after the call All fields are required; pass an empty string "" for filePath when referencing remote assets only. Receiving clients must still validate download endpoints, MIME types, and file sizes without blindly trusting extensions. This operation creates the message object locally; call Send message /sdk/harmony/message/sending messages/send message to transmit it.

title: Create business card message
description: Create a contact card message to share user identity and profile information.
keywords: sdk harmony v4 sdk harmony message creating-messages create-card-message
content: Contact card data is captured at the time the message is created and does not automatically update when user profile attributes change later. Code example import sdk, CreateCardMessageReq, CreateCardMessageResp from '@openimsdk/imsdk'; const request: CreateCardMessageReq = userID: 'user 42', nickname: 'Alex', faceURL: 'https://example.com/avatar/user 42.png', ex: JSON.stringify source: 'team directory' , ; const response: CreateCardMessageResp = await sdk.createCardMessage request ; const message = response.message; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | userID | string | Yes | Target user ID represented by the contact card. | | nickname | string | Yes | Display nickname captured at creation time. | | faceURL | string | Yes | Avatar URL captured at creation time. | | ex | string | Yes | Custom extension string. | Return value Returns a Promise resolving to CreateCardMessageResp : | Property | Type | Description | | | | | | message | IMMessage | Locally instantiated business card message object. | State changes after the call All four fields are required. Before initiating friend requests or starting conversations from a card, receiving clients should query the latest user profile and verify permissions rather than treating card fields as live identity credentials. This operation instantiates the message object locally; call Send message /sdk/harmony/message/sending messages/send message to dispatch it.

title: Create location message
description: Create a location message with descriptive text and geographic coordinates.
keywords: sdk harmony v4 sdk harmony message creating-messages create-location-message
content: The SDK embeds provided location descriptions and coordinates into the message payload without performing geolocation, reverse geocoding, or map rendering. Code example import sdk, CreateLocationMessageReq, CreateLocationMessageResp from '@openimsdk/imsdk'; const request: CreateLocationMessageReq = description: 'Shenzhen Bay Park', longitude: 113.9516, latitude: 22.4864, ; const response: CreateLocationMessageResp = await sdk.createLocationMessage request ; const message = response.message; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | description | string | Yes | Human readable address or landmark name. | | longitude | number | Yes | Longitude coordinate 180 to 180 . | | latitude | number | Yes | Latitude coordinate 90 to 90 . | Return value Returns a Promise resolving to CreateLocationMessageResp : | Property | Type | Description | | | | | | message | IMMessage | Locally instantiated location message object. | State changes after the call Longitude must range between 180 and 180 , and latitude must range between 90 and 90 . Ensure coordinates use a consistent spatial reference frame such as WGS 84 or GCJ 02 . This operation only instantiates the IMMessage object locally; call Send message /sdk/harmony/message/sending messages/send message to dispatch it.

title: Create sticker message
description: Create a sticker or custom emoji message from index numbers and payload data.
keywords: sdk harmony v4 sdk harmony message creating-messages create-face-message
content: Creates a custom sticker or emoji message identified by index code and associated data. Code example import sdk, CreateFaceMessageReq, CreateFaceMessageResp from '@openimsdk/imsdk'; const request: CreateFaceMessageReq = index: 1001, data: JSON.stringify packID: 'default', name: 'wave' , ; const response: CreateFaceMessageResp = await sdk.createFaceMessage request ; const message = response.message; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | index | number | Yes | Custom sticker index number. | | data | string | Yes | Supplementary sticker data string for example, pack ID and name . | Return value Returns a Promise resolving to CreateFaceMessageResp : | Property | Type | Description | | | | | | message | IMMessage | Locally instantiated sticker message object. | State changes after the call Both sending and receiving clients should adhere to a unified emoji indexing protocol and provide graceful fallback rendering for unknown indexes. The SDK does not download, validate, or render graphic assets directly. This operation creates the message object locally; call Send message /sdk/harmony/message/sending messages/send message to dispatch it.

title: Create quote message
description: Quote an existing message with a simple text reply.
keywords: sdk harmony v4 sdk harmony message creating-messages create-quote-message
content: Creates a quote message referencing a previous message with text reply content. Code example import sdk, CreateQuoteMessageReq, CreateQuoteMessageResp from '@openimsdk/imsdk'; const request: CreateQuoteMessageReq = text: 'Received, I will handle it today.', quoteMessage: originalMessage, ; const response: CreateQuoteMessageResp = await sdk.createQuoteMessage request ; const message = response.message; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | text | string | Yes | Reply body text. | | quoteMessage | IMMessage | Yes | The original message being quoted. | Return value Returns a Promise resolving to CreateQuoteMessageResp : | Property | Type | Description | | | | | | message | IMMessage | Locally instantiated quote message object. | State changes after the call originalMessage should come directly from query results or message events; do not fabricate incomplete mock objects. Verify that the referenced message belongs to the active conversation, and design a fallback UI in case the original message has been deleted or cannot be loaded. Resolving the Promise constructs the message object locally; call Send message /sdk/harmony/message/sending messages/send message to dispatch it.

title: Create advanced quote message
description: Quote an existing message with rich entity spans attached to the reply text.
keywords: sdk harmony v4 sdk harmony message creating-messages create-advanced-quote-message
content: Creates a quote message referencing an existing message while supporting embedded rich text entities such as links or mentions in the reply body. Code example import sdk, CreateAdvancedQuoteMessageReq, CreateAdvancedQuoteMessageResp, MessageEntity, from '@openimsdk/imsdk'; const entity: MessageEntity = type: 'url', offset: 3, length: 4, url: 'https://example.com/task/42', ex: '', ; const request: CreateAdvancedQuoteMessageReq = text: 'View task details', quoteMessage: originalMessage, messageEntities: entity , ; const response: CreateAdvancedQuoteMessageResp = await sdk.createAdvancedQuoteMessage request ; const message = response.message; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | text | string | Yes | Reply body text. | | quoteMessage | IMMessage | Yes | The original message being quoted. | | messageEntities | MessageEntity | Yes | Array of rich entity spans within the reply text. | Return value Returns a Promise resolving to CreateAdvancedQuoteMessageResp : | Property | Type | Description | | | | | | message | IMMessage | Locally constructed advanced quote message object ready to send. | State changes after the call Entity offsets and lengths must fall strictly within the bounds of text . The quoted message must belong to the destination conversation. Receiving clients should validate boundaries, URLs, and extension data. This method creates the message object locally without modifying the quoted message or initiating network requests. Call Send message /sdk/harmony/message/sending messages/send message to dispatch it.

title: Create Markdown message
description: Create a message containing raw Markdown text.
keywords: sdk harmony v4 sdk harmony message creating-messages create-markdown-message
content: Creates a message containing raw Markdown syntax for formatting and rich text presentation. Code example import sdk, CreateMarkdownMessageReq, CreateMarkdownMessageResp from '@openimsdk/imsdk'; const request: CreateMarkdownMessageReq = content: ' Deployment Complete \n\nPlease review release notes.', ; const response: CreateMarkdownMessageResp = await sdk.createMarkdownMessage request ; const message = response.message; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | content | string | Yes | Raw Markdown source text. | Return value Returns a Promise resolving to CreateMarkdownMessageResp : | Property | Type | Description | | | | | | message | IMMessage | Locally instantiated Markdown message object. | State changes after the call content contains raw Markdown source text rather than pre rendered HTML. Receiving clients should render content using a sandboxed parser that sanitizes links, images, and raw HTML elements, falling back to plain text for unsupported clients. This operation creates the message object locally; call Send message /sdk/harmony/message/sending messages/send message to transmit it.

title: Create forward message
description: Create a forwardable message from an existing single message.
keywords: sdk harmony v4 sdk harmony message creating-messages create-forward-message
content: Creates a new message object suitable for forwarding an existing message to another conversation. Code example import sdk, CreateForwardMessageReq, CreateForwardMessageResp from '@openimsdk/imsdk'; const request: CreateForwardMessageReq = message: sourceMessage ; const response: CreateForwardMessageResp = await sdk.createForwardMessage request ; const message = response.message; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | message | IMMessage | Yes | Existing message to be forwarded. | Return value Returns a Promise resolving to CreateForwardMessageResp : | Property | Type | Description | | | | | | message | IMMessage | Locally instantiated forward message object. | State changes after the call The source message should originate from query results or message events and must have already been sent successfully. Verify that the user has authorization to distribute the content before forwarding. Local file paths, expired asset URLs, and device local extensions cannot be assumed valid in destination conversations. This operation creates the message object locally without altering the original message or picking destination targets; call Send message /sdk/harmony/message/sending messages/send message to dispatch it to a direct or group chat.

title: Create merge forward message
description: Combine multiple existing messages into a single merged forward message.
keywords: sdk harmony v4 sdk harmony message creating-messages create-merger-message
content: Consolidates multiple chat messages into a single forwardable chat record card. Code example import sdk, CreateMergerMessageReq, CreateMergerMessageResp from '@openimsdk/imsdk'; const request: CreateMergerMessageReq = messages: selectedMessages, title: 'Project Discussion History', summaries: 'Alex: Please confirm deployment time', 'Morgan: Scheduled for Friday release' , ; const response: CreateMergerMessageResp = await sdk.createMergerMessage request ; const message = response.message; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | messages | IMMessage | Yes | Array of messages to include in the merged record. | | title | string | Yes | Title displayed at the top of the merged record card. | | summaries | string | Yes | Array of summary preview strings shown on the message bubble. | Return value Returns a Promise resolving to CreateMergerMessageResp : | Property | Type | Description | | | | | | message | IMMessage | Locally instantiated merged message object. | State changes after the call The sequence of messages defines the order presented in the expanded chat history viewer. summaries must be formatted by the application layer; the SDK does not automatically generate summaries. This operation instantiates the IMMessage locally; call Send message /sdk/harmony/message/sending messages/send message to dispatch it.

title: Send message
description: Send a prepared message object to a direct chat peer or a group chat.
keywords: sdk harmony v4 sdk harmony message sending-messages send-message
content: sendMessage takes an IMMessage object returned by one of the message creation methods. For direct chats, pass recvID and set groupID to an empty string "" ; for group chats, pass groupID and set recvID to "" . Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | message | IMMessage | Yes | Prepared message object to send. | | recvID | string | Conditionally required | Peer user ID for direct chats; empty string "" for group chats. | | groupID | string | Conditionally required | Target group ID for group chats; empty string "" for direct chats. | | isOnlineOnly | boolean | Yes | Whether to deliver only to currently online clients; online only messages do not persist in local history. | Code example import sdk, EventOnSendMsgProgressData, OpenIMSDKEvent, SendMessageReq, SendMessageResp, from '@openimsdk/imsdk'; const request: SendMessageReq = message: message, recvID: receiverUserID, groupID: '', isOnlineOnly: false, ; const response: SendMessageResp = await sdk.sendMessage request ; replacePendingMessage response.message.clientMsgID, response.message ; const handleSendProgress = data: EventOnSendMsgProgressData : void = updateMessageProgress data.clientMsgID, data.progress ; ; const unsubscribeSendProgress = sdk.on OpenIMSDKEvent.EventOnSendMsgProgress, handleSendProgress ; export function removeSendProgressListener : void unsubscribeSendProgress ; Return value Returns a Promise resolving to SendMessageResp : | Property | Type | Description | | | | | | message | IMMessage | Updated message object with server message ID, delivery status, and timestamps. | State changes after the call When sending local media, upload progress events are tracked using clientMsgID ; do not associate progress with list array indexes. Progress updates do not guarantee successful transmission; determine success from Promise resolution and final message status flags. Upon Promise resolution, swap the pending message placeholder with the returned message object. Receipt of the message by remote clients occurs in a separate stage. Call removeSendProgressListener when tearing down the sending layer.

title: Receive messages
description: Listen for standard, offline, and online-only messages, and merge them into conversations.
keywords: sdk harmony v4 sdk harmony message receiving-messages receive-messages
content: Message events deliver incremental newly arrived messages. When first opening a conversation, scrolling through pages, or refreshing after reconnecting, actively load message history. Both paths may deliver the same message; resolve the target conversation first, then deduplicate by clientMsgID . Code example import sdk, EventOnRecvNewMessageData, EventOnRecvOfflineNewMessageData, EventOnRecvOnlineOnlyMessageData, OpenIMSDKEvent, from '@openimsdk/imsdk'; const handleNewMessage = data: EventOnRecvNewMessageData : void = routeAndMergeMessage data.message ; ; const handleOfflineMessage = data: EventOnRecvOfflineNewMessageData : void = routeAndMergeMessage data.message ; ; const handleOnlineOnlyMessage = data: EventOnRecvOnlineOnlyMessageData : void = showTransientMessage data.message ; ; const unsubscribeNewMessage = sdk.on OpenIMSDKEvent.EventOnRecvNewMessage, handleNewMessage ; const unsubscribeOfflineMessage = sdk.on OpenIMSDKEvent.EventOnRecvOfflineNewMessage, handleOfflineMessage, ; const unsubscribeOnlineOnlyMessage = sdk.on OpenIMSDKEvent.EventOnRecvOnlineOnlyMessage, handleOnlineOnlyMessage, ; export function removeMessageListeners : void unsubscribeNewMessage ; unsubscribeOfflineMessage ; unsubscribeOnlineOnlyMessage ; For direct chats, determine the counterparty using sessionType , sendID , and recvID ; for group chats, use groupID . Online only messages are ephemeral and do not persist in local history; do not use them for critical business data requiring replay. Batch message events The SDK also exposes batch events EventOnRecvNewMessages and EventOnRecvOfflineNewMessages , which deliver messages: IMMessage . Whether batching occurs depends on underlying batch delivery mechanisms. Choose either single or batch listener setups to implement a unified deduplication pipeline, avoiding dual registration that could insert the same message twice. If your application adopts the batch approach, replace the two individual history message listeners above with the following pattern, while retaining the separate online only listener: import sdk, EventOnRecvNewMessagesData, EventOnRecvOfflineNewMessagesData, OpenIMSDKEvent, from '@openimsdk/imsdk'; const handleNewMessages = data: EventOnRecvNewMessagesData : void = for let index = 0; index for let index = 0; index < data.messages.length; index += 1 routeAndMergeMessage data.messages index ; ; const unsubscribeNewMessages = sdk.on OpenIMSDKEvent.EventOnRecvNewMessages, handleNewMessages ; const unsubscribeOfflineMessages = sdk.on OpenIMSDKEvent.EventOnRecvOfflineNewMessages, handleOfflineMessages, ; export function removeBatchMessageListeners : void unsubscribeNewMessages ; unsubscribeOfflineMessages ; Register message listeners within the global session level state layer rather than re registering on every chat view mounting. Clean up listeners when the user logs out or when destroying the state container.

title: Receive custom business notifications
description: Listen for server-pushed custom business notifications.
keywords: sdk harmony v4 sdk harmony message receiving-messages receive-custom-business-messages
content: This event receives business notifications dispatched directly by the server, distinct from custom chat messages created via Create custom message /sdk/harmony/message/creating messages/create custom message ; the latter are handled by Receive messages /sdk/harmony/message/receiving messages/receive messages . Code example import sdk, EventOnRecvCustomBusinessMessageData, OpenIMSDKEvent from '@openimsdk/imsdk'; const handleBusinessMessage = data: EventOnRecvCustomBusinessMessageData : void = const payload = parseAndValidateBusinessPayload data.businessMessage ; applyBusinessPayload data.clientMsgID, payload ; ; const unsubscribeBusinessMessage = sdk.on OpenIMSDKEvent.EventOnRecvCustomBusinessMessage, handleBusinessMessage, ; export function removeBusinessMessageListener : void unsubscribeBusinessMessage ; Parameters This event listener does not take API call parameters. Event payload EventOnRecvCustomBusinessMessageData provides: | Property | Type | Description | | | | | | clientMsgID | string | Unique client message identifier. | | businessMessage | string | Raw payload string delivered by the server. | State changes after the call Validate string formatting, business types, schema versioning, and mandatory attributes before updating application state. Deduplicate by clientMsgID , and re query relevant business endpoints when definitive server state is required. Call unsubscribeBusinessMessage when logging out or disposing of the state layer.

title: Set application badge count
description: Synchronize current unread counts with the OpenIM push notification badge status.
keywords: sdk harmony v4 sdk harmony message set-app-badge
content: Reports the total displayed unread message count to the OpenIM SDK for server side push badge management. This API does not directly modify HarmonyOS home screen badge indicators; host applications must integrate system badge capabilities in according to platform specifications. Code example import sdk, SetAppBadgeReq from '@openimsdk/imsdk'; const request: SetAppBadgeReq = appUnreadCount: totalUnreadCount, ; await sdk.setAppBadge request ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | appUnreadCount | number | Yes | Non negative integer representing the aggregate unread message count across the entire application. | Return value Returns a Promise that resolves to void when the badge value is acknowledged by the SDK. State changes after the call Pass a non negative integer for appUnreadCount . Typically update this counter after total unread changes, initial sync completion, or clearing unread messages; do not report an individual conversation's unread count as the application aggregate. Promise resolution indicates acceptance by the SDK, without implying native HarmonyOS home screen badge presentation or altering conversation level unread counts. To query unread totals or handle unread events, see Get total unread message count /sdk/harmony/conversation/managing conversations/get total unread count .

title: Load older messages
description: Paginate backward chronologically to retrieve older message history in a conversation.
keywords: sdk harmony v4 sdk harmony message retrieving-messages load-older-messages
content: Pass an empty string "" for startClientMsgID when fetching the initial page; for subsequent backward pages, pass the client message ID of the oldest currently rendered message. Code example import sdk, ErrorCode, GetHistoryMessageListReq, GetHistoryMessageListResp, ViewType, from '@openimsdk/imsdk'; const request: GetHistoryMessageListReq = conversationID: conversationID, startClientMsgID: oldestClientMsgID, count: 30, isReverse: false, viewType: ViewType.ViewHistory, ; const response: GetHistoryMessageListResp = await sdk.getHistoryMessageList request ; if response.errCode === ErrorCode.NoError prependMessages response.messageList ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | conversationID | string | Yes | Target conversation identifier. | | startClientMsgID | string | Yes | Client message ID of the oldest message, or "" for the first page. | | count | number | Yes | Number of messages to retrieve per page. | | isReverse | boolean | Yes | Pass false for backwards chronological paging. | | viewType | ViewType | Yes | Message view mode, typically ViewType.ViewHistory . | Return value Returns a Promise resolving to GetHistoryMessageListResp : | Property | Type | Description | | | | | | errCode | ErrorCode | SDK error code enum value ErrorCode.NoError indicates success . | | errMsg | string | Error description if errCode is non zero. | | messageList | IMMessage | Array of older messages retrieved. | | isEnd | boolean | true if the oldest message in history has been reached. | State changes after the call Cease paging backward when isEnd becomes true . Treat rejected Promises and responses with non zero errCode as load failures. This query does not trigger new message events; when prepending results, scope mutations to the current conversationID and deduplicate by clientMsgID .

title: Load newer messages
description: Paginate forward chronologically towards newer messages from an anchor message.
keywords: sdk harmony v4 sdk harmony message retrieving-messages load-newer-messages
content: When navigating into a chat from search results or replied quotes and needing to fetch records newer than the anchor, set isReverse: true . This is a historical fetch method, not a real time message listener. Code example import sdk, ErrorCode, GetHistoryMessageListReq, GetHistoryMessageListResp, ViewType, from '@openimsdk/imsdk'; const request: GetHistoryMessageListReq = conversationID: conversationID, startClientMsgID: anchorMessage.clientMsgID, count: 30, isReverse: true, viewType: ViewType.ViewHistory, ; const response: GetHistoryMessageListResp = await sdk.getHistoryMessageList request ; if response.errCode === ErrorCode.NoError appendMessages response.messageList ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | conversationID | string | Yes | Target conversation identifier. | | startClientMsgID | string | Yes | Client message ID of the anchor message. | | count | number | Yes | Number of messages to retrieve. | | isReverse | boolean | Yes | Pass true for reverse pagination towards newer messages. | | viewType | ViewType | Yes | Message view mode, typically ViewType.ViewHistory . | Return value Returns a Promise resolving to GetHistoryMessageListResp : | Property | Type | Description | | | | | | errCode | ErrorCode | SDK error code enum value ErrorCode.NoError indicates success . | | errMsg | string | Error description if errCode is non zero. | | messageList | IMMessage | Array of newer messages retrieved. | | isEnd | boolean | true if no newer historical messages exist. | State changes after the call The anchor message must have a valid clientMsgID . When continuing pagination, advance the anchor to the latest received message; isEnd signals whether the newest boundary of synchronized history has been reached. Avoid alternating directions simultaneously on the same viewport boundary, and deduplicate by stable ID when appending to timeline feeds.

title: Find messages by ID
description: Look up locally synchronized messages by conversation ID and client message IDs.
keywords: sdk harmony v4 sdk harmony message retrieving-messages find-messages-by-id
content: When navigating from search results, quoted replies, or push notifications, retain both the conversation ID and client message ID. Code example import sdk, FindMessageListReq, FindMessageListResp from '@openimsdk/imsdk'; const request: FindMessageListReq = conversationsArgs: conversationID: conversationID, clientMsgIDList: clientMsgID , , , ; const response: FindMessageListResp = await sdk.findMessageList request ; const results = response.findResultItems; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | conversationsArgs | ConversationArgs | Yes | List of query criteria grouped by conversation, each containing conversationID and clientMsgIDList . | Return value Returns a Promise resolving to FindMessageListResp : | Property | Type | Description | | | | | | totalCount | number | Total number of messages retrieved across all queried conversations. | | findResultItems | FindResultItem | List of result sets grouped by conversation. | State changes after the call A single invocation can query across multiple conversations. Do not assume returned items match the order of input arrays; match records using conversationID on result items and clientMsgID on messages. When messages have not yet synced, have been deleted, or IDs do not exist, the response returns empty results. To locate context around a message and expand surrounding history, see Load message context /sdk/harmony/message/retrieving messages/load message context .

title: Load message context
description: Retrieve surrounding chat messages before and after a specific anchor message.
keywords: sdk harmony v4 sdk harmony message retrieving-messages load-message-context
content: When jumping into chat context from search results or replied quotes, use the complete fetched message as the anchor. Code example import sdk, FetchSurroundingMessagesReq, FetchSurroundingMessagesResp, ViewType, from '@openimsdk/imsdk'; const request: FetchSurroundingMessagesReq = startMessage: targetMessage, viewType: ViewType.ViewHistory, before: 20, after: 20, ; const response: FetchSurroundingMessagesResp = await sdk.fetchSurroundingMessages request ; renderMessages response.messages ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | startMessage | IMMessage | Yes | Anchor message object around which surrounding history is retrieved. | | viewType | ViewType | Yes | View mode, typically ViewType.ViewHistory . | | before | number | Yes | Number of messages to retrieve chronologically before the anchor. | | after | number | Yes | Number of messages to retrieve chronologically after the anchor. | Return value Returns a Promise resolving to FetchSurroundingMessagesResp : | Property | Type | Description | | | | | | messages | IMMessage | Array of chronologically ordered surrounding messages including the anchor. | State changes after the call Returned message counts may be fewer than before + after if the anchor is near timeline boundaries or if intermediate messages have been deleted. The anchor message must come from query results or message events; do not construct incomplete objects. When merging with existing lists, deduplicate by conversation context and clientMsgID . For ongoing pagination forward or backward, see Load older messages /sdk/harmony/message/retrieving messages/load older messages and Load newer messages /sdk/harmony/message/retrieving messages/load newer messages .

title: Search messages
description: Search through locally synchronized messages on the current device using keywords and filter criteria.
keywords: sdk harmony v4 sdk harmony message searching-messages search-messages
content: Local search queries device storage without making backend search requests. Passing an empty string "" for conversationID searches across all local conversations; for group chats, supply the conversation ID rather than the groupID . Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | conversationID | string | Yes | Target conversation identifier; pass empty string "" for all local conversations. | | keywords | string | Yes | Array of non empty search keywords. | | keywordMatchType | KeywordListMatchType | Yes | Match type: match any keyword or match all keywords. | | senderUserIDs | string | Yes | Array of sender user IDs to filter by; pass empty array for no restriction. | | messageTypes | ContentType | Yes | Array of content types to filter by; pass empty array for all types. | | searchTimePosition | number | Yes | UTC second timestamp search start point; 0 denotes current time. | | searchTimePeriod | number | Yes | Number of seconds backward from start point to search; 0 denotes unlimited. | | pagination | RequestPagination | Yes | Pagination object with pageNumber and showNumber . | Code example import sdk, ContentType, KeywordListMatchType, SearchLocalMessagesReq, SearchLocalMessagesResp, from '@openimsdk/imsdk'; const request: SearchLocalMessagesReq = conversationID: conversationID, keywords: searchText.trim , keywordMatchType: KeywordListMatchType.KeywordMatchOr, senderUserIDs: , messageTypes: ContentType.Text, ContentType.AtText , searchTimePosition: 0, searchTimePeriod: 0, pagination: pageNumber: 1, showNumber: 20 , ; const response: SearchLocalMessagesResp = await sdk.searchLocalMessages request ; renderSearchResults response.searchResultItems, response.count ; Return value Returns a Promise resolving to SearchLocalMessagesResp : | Property | Type | Description | | | | | | count | number | Total number of matching messages found across all queried conversations. | | searchResultItems | SearchResultItem | Array of search result items grouped by conversation. | State changes after the call Search results are grouped by conversation. When navigating to a search hit, use the item's conversationID and the message's clientMsgID . Reset pagination to page 1 whenever search filters or keywords change. This query searches only local messages synchronized to the current device; to jump to a message and expand surrounding context, see Load message context /sdk/harmony/message/retrieving messages/load message context .

title: Translate text
description: Translate arbitrary text into a specified target language.
keywords: sdk harmony v4 sdk harmony message translating-messages translate-text
content: Translates an arbitrary input text snippet without creating or modifying chat message records. Code example import sdk, TranslateTextReq, TranslateTextResp from '@openimsdk/imsdk'; const request: TranslateTextReq = text: 'Hello, OpenIM', sourceLanguage: 'en', targetLanguage: 'zh CN', ; const response: TranslateTextResp = await sdk.translateText request ; showTranslation response.translatedText, response.detectedLanguage ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | text | string | Yes | Raw text string to translate. | | sourceLanguage | string | Yes | Source language code for example, 'en' . | | targetLanguage | string | Yes | Target language code for example, 'zh CN' . | Return value Returns a Promise resolving to TranslateTextResp : | Property | Type | Description | | | | | | translatedText | string | Translated text output. | | detectedLanguage | string | Language detected by the translation service engine. | State changes after the call Language codes must adhere to formats supported by your configured translation service provider. detectedLanguage reflects the language detected by the engine and may differ from the requested source language. Render translation output alongside the original text without overwriting it. To translate an existing message and update local message state, see Translate message /sdk/harmony/message/translating messages/translate message .

title: Translate message
description: Translate a synchronized message and obtain an updated message object containing translated content.
keywords: sdk harmony v4 sdk harmony message translating-messages translate-message
content: Locates the target message using conversationID and clientMsgID . Code example import sdk, TranslateMessageReq, TranslateMessageResp from '@openimsdk/imsdk'; const request: TranslateMessageReq = conversationID: conversationID, clientMsgID: message.clientMsgID, sourceLanguageCode: 'en', targetLanguageCode: 'zh CN', ; const response: TranslateMessageResp = await sdk.translateMessage request ; replaceMessage response.message.clientMsgID, response.message ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | conversationID | string | Yes | Target conversation identifier. | | clientMsgID | string | Yes | Client message identifier of the message to translate. | | sourceLanguageCode | string | Yes | Source language code for example, 'en' . | | targetLanguageCode | string | Yes | Target language code for example, 'zh CN' . | Return value Returns a Promise resolving to TranslateMessageResp : | Property | Type | Description | | | | | | message | IMMessage | Updated message object containing translated text. | State changes after the call The source message must already be synchronized to the local database. After the Promise resolves, update the local message item matching conversationID:clientMsgID , while preserving the original message text for toggle display. This operation does not broadcast translation results to other client devices. For standalone text translation, see Translate text /sdk/harmony/message/translating messages/translate text .

title: Update typing status
description: Report the current account’s active typing status within a conversation.
keywords: sdk harmony v4 sdk harmony message composing-messages update-typing-status
content: Report conversation typing status Pass focus: true when the user begins typing, and pass focus: false when sending a message, blurring the input field, switching conversations, or stopping input. Typing state is transient and is never saved as a draft or message. import sdk, ChangeInputStatesReq from '@openimsdk/imsdk'; const startRequest: ChangeInputStatesReq = conversationID: conversationID, focus: true, ; await sdk.changeInputStates startRequest ; const stopRequest: ChangeInputStatesReq = conversationID: conversationID, focus: false, ; await sdk.changeInputStates stopRequest ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | conversationID | string | Yes | Target conversation identifier. | | focus | boolean | Yes | true when input starts; false when input stops. | Throttle and deduplicate typing start calls rather than sending an update on every keystroke. Promise resolution confirms that the reporting request completed, without guaranteeing immediate UI updates across remote clients. Send direct chat typing prompt The HarmonyOS SDK also provides typingStatusUpdate , a legacy single chat typing prompt method that sends an ephemeral indicator string to a recipient user. It does not use conversationID and accommodates custom protocols relying on msgTip . import sdk, TypingStatusUpdateReq from '@openimsdk/imsdk'; const request: TypingStatusUpdateReq = recvID: receiverUserID, msgTip: 'typing', ; await sdk.typingStatusUpdate request ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | recvID | string | Yes | Recipient user ID in a single chat. | | msgTip | string | Yes | Ephemeral typing prompt string. | Return value Both methods return Promises that resolve to void upon server acceptance. State changes after the call Prefer changeInputStates for modern multi platform synchronized typing states; see Receive and query typing status /sdk/harmony/message/composing messages/get typing status for receiver handling. Avoid calling both APIs simultaneously to prevent duplicated typing indicators on receiving devices.

title: Receive and query typing status
description: Query active typing platforms for a member and listen for real-time typing status changes.
keywords: sdk harmony v4 sdk harmony message composing-messages get-typing-status
content: When entering a conversation, reconnecting, or when event state might be incomplete, query which platforms a specific member is currently typing on. Code example import sdk, EventOnConversationUserInputStatusChangedData, GetInputStatesReq, GetInputStatesResp, OpenIMSDKEvent, from '@openimsdk/imsdk'; const request: GetInputStatesReq = conversationID: conversationID, userID: memberUserID, ; const response: GetInputStatesResp = await sdk.getInputStates request ; setTyping memberUserID, response.platforms.length 0 ; const handleInputStatusChanged = data: EventOnConversationUserInputStatusChangedData : void = updateTypingState data.conversationID, data.userID, data.platforms ; ; const unsubscribeInputStatus = sdk.on OpenIMSDKEvent.EventOnConversationUserInputStatusChanged, handleInputStatusChanged, ; export function removeInputStatusListener : void unsubscribeInputStatus ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | conversationID | string | Yes | Target conversation identifier. | | userID | string | Yes | Member user ID to query. | Return value Returns a Promise resolving to GetInputStatesResp : | Property | Type | Description | | | | | | platforms | number | Array of platform IDs on which the user is actively typing. | State changes after the call An empty platforms array indicates that no device is currently typing. Merge member typing indicators using conversationID:userID . Event updates do not replace initial query snapshots and are ephemeral. Upon reconnecting, re query only members currently visible on screen; avoid polling all members in large group chats. Call unsubscribeInputStatus when disposing of the state layer. To broadcast typing state from the sender side, see Update typing status /sdk/harmony/message/composing messages/update typing status .

title: Check speech-to-text capabilities
description: Query audio formats, sampling rates, and constraints supported by the speech recognition service.
keywords: sdk harmony v4 sdk harmony message composing-messages check-speech-to-text
content: Query speech recognition capabilities before displaying transcription buttons or initializing audio recording. Code example import sdk, GetSpeechToTextCapabilitiesResp from '@openimsdk/imsdk'; const capabilities: GetSpeechToTextCapabilitiesResp = await sdk.getSpeechToTextCapabilities ; configureRecorder capabilities.format, capabilities.sampleRateHz, capabilities.maxRecordTimeMs, capabilities.maxFileSize, ; Parameters This method does not take any parameters. Return value Returns a Promise resolving to GetSpeechToTextCapabilitiesResp : | Property | Type | Description | | | | | | format | string | Audio encoding format for example, m4a , mp3 . | | sampleRateHz | number | Required audio sampling rate in Hz. | | maxRecordTimeMs | number | Maximum allowed recording duration in milliseconds. | | maxFileSize | number | Maximum allowed audio payload size in bytes. | | provider | string | Speech to text recognition service provider. | | requestType | string | Integration request method type. | | crossDomain | boolean | Cross origin configuration setting. | State changes after the call maxRecordTimeMs is in milliseconds, and maxFileSize is in bytes. When this request fails or returned capability properties are empty, disable or hide the transcription interface rather than assuming default parameters. This query does not record audio, transcribe voice messages, or trigger message events. To transcribe audio, see Transcribe audio to text /sdk/harmony/message/composing messages/transcribe audio .

title: Transcribe audio to text
description: Convert Base64-encoded audio data into recognized text.
keywords: sdk harmony v4 sdk harmony message composing-messages transcribe-audio
content: Do not pass local file paths, raw ArrayBuffer instances, or data URLs prefixed with data: ;base64, . Code example import sdk, SpeechToTextReq, SpeechToTextResp from '@openimsdk/imsdk'; const request: SpeechToTextReq = filename: 'voice.m4a', data: audioBase64, ; const response: SpeechToTextResp = await sdk.speechToText request ; showTranscript response.text ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | filename | string | Yes | Audio filename including the valid file extension. | | data | string | Yes | Pure Base64 encoded audio payload string. | Return value Returns a Promise resolving to SpeechToTextResp : | Property | Type | Description | | | | | | text | string | Recognized text content extracted from the audio. | State changes after the call filename must include an extension corresponding to the real audio format, and data must contain only the raw Base64 string. Before calling this method, validate format, sampling rate, duration, and file size limits against Check speech to text capabilities /sdk/harmony/message/composing messages/check speech to text . Transcription results do not modify the original voice message record or trigger message events.

title: Update local message content
description: Replace full message contents directly within the local device database.
keywords: sdk harmony v4 sdk harmony message composing-messages save-local-transcript
content: This operation modifies only the local message record on the current device. The API expects a complete IMMessage object rather than isolated partial fields. Code example import sdk, IMMessage, SetMessageLocalContentReq from '@openimsdk/imsdk'; const localMessage: IMMessage = cloneMessage message ; if localMessage.textElem == undefined localMessage.textElem.content = 'Device local updated text'; const request: SetMessageLocalContentReq = conversationID: conversationID, message: localMessage, ; await sdk.setMessageLocalContent request ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | conversationID | string | Yes | Target conversation identifier. | | message | IMMessage | Yes | Complete message object with modified local contents. | Return value Returns a Promise that resolves to void when the local database write completes. State changes after the call In the example, cloneMessage represents a type safe deep clone helper implemented by your application. The updated message object must preserve original keys and mandatory properties; do not pass an object containing only clientMsgID and partial content. Promise resolution does not upload modifications to OpenIMServer, synchronize to other devices, or fire shared message events. If you only need to store auxiliary application data like voice transcripts, saving them to local extensions via Set message local extension /sdk/harmony/message/managing messages/set message local ex is usually preferable.

title: Modify message
description: Edit the content of an already sent message and synchronize changes across participants.
keywords: sdk harmony v4 sdk harmony message managing-messages modify-a-message
content: Modifying a message replaces existing content on both the server and peer clients, unlike local only content overwrites or deletions. Code example import sdk, EventOnMessageEditedData, EventOnMessageModifiedData, IMMessage, ModifyMessageReq, ModifyMessageResp, OpenIMSDKEvent, from '@openimsdk/imsdk'; const editedMessage: IMMessage = cloneMessage message ; if editedMessage.textElem == undefined editedMessage.textElem.content = editedText; const request: ModifyMessageReq = conversationID: conversationID, message: editedMessage, ; const response: ModifyMessageResp = await sdk.modifyMessage request ; replaceMessage conversationID, response.message ; const handleMessageModified = data: EventOnMessageModifiedData : void = const targetConversationID = resolveMessageConversationID data.message ; replaceMessage targetConversationID, data.message ; ; const unsubscribeMessageModified = sdk.on OpenIMSDKEvent.EventOnMessageModified, handleMessageModified, ; const handleMessageEdited = data: EventOnMessageEditedData : void = const targetConversationID = resolveMessageConversationID data.message ; replaceMessage targetConversationID, data.message ; ; const unsubscribeMessageEdited = sdk.on OpenIMSDKEvent.EventOnMessageEdited, handleMessageEdited ; export function removeMessageEditListeners : void unsubscribeMessageModified ; unsubscribeMessageEdited ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | conversationID | string | Yes | Target conversation identifier. | | message | IMMessage | Yes | Modified message object containing updated content elements. | Return value Returns a Promise resolving to ModifyMessageResp : | Property | Type | Description | | | | | | message | IMMessage | Updated message object acknowledged by the server. | State changes after the call The modified message object must retain its original clientMsgID and mandatory metadata. Permitted sender identities, editing time windows, and editable message types are strictly validated by OpenIMServer. After the Promise resolves, immediately update the local message item; other clients receive updates via events. Both EventOnMessageModified and EventOnMessageEdited deliver the latest IMMessage . Locate the conversation using conversationID , then update the message matching clientMsgID . These two events represent different underlying notification paths; do not assume a modification necessarily triggers both simultaneously. Remove listeners when tearing down the state layer.

title: Revoke message
description: Recall an already sent message and synchronize its recalled state across participants.
keywords: sdk harmony v4 sdk harmony message managing-messages revoke-a-message
content: Use this operation when conversation members need to see a recalled message notice, rather than silently deleting records locally or in batch. Code example import sdk, EventOnNewRecvMessageRevokedData, OpenIMSDKEvent, RevokeMessageReq, from '@openimsdk/imsdk'; const request: RevokeMessageReq = conversationID: conversationID, clientMsgID: message.clientMsgID, ; await sdk.revokeMessage request ; const handleMessageRevoked = data: EventOnNewRecvMessageRevokedData : void = markMessageRevoked data.revoked.clientMsgID, data.revoked ; ; const unsubscribeMessageRevoked = sdk.on OpenIMSDKEvent.EventOnNewRecvMessageRevoked, handleMessageRevoked, ; export function removeMessageRevokedListener : void unsubscribeMessageRevoked ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | conversationID | string | Yes | Target conversation identifier. | | clientMsgID | string | Yes | Client message identifier of the message to revoke. | Return value Returns a Promise that resolves to void upon server acceptance. State changes after the call Revocation permissions, eligible time windows, and revocable message types are verified by OpenIMServer. Resolving the Promise confirms request acceptance on the server without implying all peer clients have re rendered. When the revocation event arrives, locate the item by clientMsgID and render a recalled message notification instead of removing the row entirely from the timeline. Remove the listener during logout or when disposing of the message state layer.

title: Batch delete messages
description: Delete multiple messages from a conversation with optional multi-device synchronization.
keywords: sdk harmony v4 sdk harmony message managing-messages delete-saved-messages
content: All client message IDs within a single batch must belong to the same conversation. Code example import sdk, DeleteMessagesReq, EventOnMessageDeletedData, OpenIMSDKEvent, from '@openimsdk/imsdk'; const request: DeleteMessagesReq = conversationID: conversationID, clientMsgIDs: selectedMessageIDs, IsSync: true, ; await sdk.deleteMessages request ; const handleMessageDeleted = data: EventOnMessageDeletedData : void = const targetConversationID = resolveMessageConversationID data.message ; removeMessage targetConversationID, data.message.clientMsgID ; ; const unsubscribeMessageDeleted = sdk.on OpenIMSDKEvent.EventOnMessageDeleted, handleMessageDeleted, ; export function removeMessageDeletedListener : void unsubscribeMessageDeleted ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | conversationID | string | Yes | Target conversation identifier. | | clientMsgIDs | string | Yes | Array of client message IDs to delete. | | IsSync | boolean | Yes | Note PascalCase capitalization. Set true to synchronize deletion across other devices of the current account. | Return value Returns a Promise that resolves to void upon server acceptance and local deletion. State changes after the call Setting IsSync: true synchronizes message deletions to other devices of the signed in account; it does not delete copies held by other conversation participants or generate recall notices. Clients identify and remove local records using clientMsgID qualified by conversationID as needed . Promise resolution, delete event delivery, and history query re calibration represent separate stages. Dispose of listeners when navigating away or logging out.

title: Delete all messages by user in group chat
description: Delete all messages sent by a specified user within a target group conversation.
keywords: sdk harmony v4 sdk harmony message managing-messages delete-user-messages
content: This is a high impact administrative moderation action and should not appear in regular single message context menus. Permissions are enforced by OpenIMServer. Code example import sdk, DeleteUserAllMessagesInConvReq, EventOnDeleteUserAllMsgsInConvData, OpenIMSDKEvent, from '@openimsdk/imsdk'; const request: DeleteUserAllMessagesInConvReq = conversationID: conversationID, userID: targetUserID, ; await sdk.deleteUserAllMessagesInConv request ; const handleUserMessagesDeleted = data: EventOnDeleteUserAllMsgsInConvData : void = reloadGroupHistory data.conversationID, data.userID ; ; const unsubscribeUserMessagesDeleted = sdk.on OpenIMSDKEvent.EventOnDeleteUserAllMsgsInConv, handleUserMessagesDeleted, ; export function removeUserMessagesDeletedListener : void unsubscribeUserMessagesDeleted ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | conversationID | string | Yes | Target group conversation identifier. | | userID | string | Yes | User ID whose messages should be purged. | Return value Returns a Promise that resolves to void upon server acceptance. State changes after the call conversationID must identify a group conversation. Clients can filter and purge in memory messages by matching conversationID and userID . Promise resolution does not imply that other clients have already re rendered their timeline. Once the event arrives, reload affected conversation history from the server. Unregister the listener when tearing down the state layer.

title: Clear all local and remote messages
