Supply only the attributes being modified: await OpenIMSDK.setSelfInfo nickname: nickname.trim , faceURL, ex: mergedExtra, ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | nickname | string | No | New nickname for the account. | | faceURL | string | No | New public avatar image URL. | | ex | string | No | Custom business extension string. | Supply at least one field to update. ex is a string; serialize JSON if storing structured metadata. Return value A resolved Promise confirms that the profile update was applied on the server. Mutations trigger the OnSelfInfoUpdated event with the updated SelfUserInfo payload. Reconcile local state keyed by userID . Listen for user profile changes Register an event listener for OnSelfInfoUpdated to keep UI components in sync when profile attributes change: const handleSelfInfoUpdated = selfUserInfo: SelfUserInfo = // Update local profile state using selfUserInfo.userID ; // Register listener OpenIMSDK.on OpenIMEvent.OnSelfInfoUpdated, handleSelfInfoUpdated ; // Remove listener OpenIMSDK.off OpenIMEvent.OnSelfInfoUpdated, handleSelfInfoUpdated ; Unregister this listener when the component unmounts, the user signs out, or accounts switch.

title: Set global message reception
description: Configure account-level default message reception and do-not-disturb options using the OpenIM React Native SDK.
keywords: sdk react-native v4 sdk react-native user profile set-global-message-reception
content: Configure the account level message notification policy: await OpenIMSDK.setSelfInfo globalRecvMsgOpt: MessageReceiveOptType.NotNotify, ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | globalRecvMsgOpt | MessageReceiveOptType | Yes | Global message reception option. | MessageReceiveOptType values: | Enum value | Value | Description | | | | | | MessageReceiveOptType.Normal | 0 | Receive messages and notify normally. | | MessageReceiveOptType.NotNotify | 2 | Receive messages silently without notification Do Not Disturb . | Return value A resolved Promise confirms that the global message reception option was updated on the server. The change triggers the OnSelfInfoUpdated event. Reconcile local state using userID and update globalRecvMsgOpt . For event listener details, see Update current user profile /sdk/react native/user/profile/set self info . Global reception is an account level fallback; individual conversations can override this behavior using per conversation options as described in Set message receive options /sdk/react native/conversation/managing conversations/set message receive option .

title: Set friend add permission
description: Configure approval requirements and permissions for incoming friend requests using the OpenIM React Native SDK.
keywords: sdk react-native v4 sdk react-native user profile set-friend-add-permission
content: Control how the system processes incoming friend requests sent to the current account: await OpenIMSDK.setSelfInfo addFriendPermission: AddFriendPermission.AddFriendAllowed, ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | addFriendPermission | AddFriendPermission | Yes | Friend verification policy option. | AddFriendPermission option values: | Enum value | Value | Description | | | | | | AddFriendPermission.AddFriendAllowed | 0 | Anyone can send a request; manual approval is required. | | AddFriendPermission.AddFriendAllowedNoReview | 1 | Automatic acceptance without review; friendship is created immediately. | | AddFriendPermission.AddFriendDenied | 2 | Disallow friend requests from other users entirely. | Return value A resolved Promise confirms that the friend permission setting was persisted on the server. This setting applies to subsequent incoming friend requests; it does not alter existing friendships or auto approve pending applications. Updates trigger the OnSelfInfoUpdated event. Reconcile local state by userID and update addFriendPermission . For event listeners, see Update current user profile /sdk/react native/user/profile/set self info .

title: Subscribe to user online status
description: Subscribe to real-time online presence states for specified users with the OpenIM React Native SDK.
keywords: sdk react-native v4 sdk react-native user online-status subscribe-users-status
content: Subscribe to real time online presence states for target users. Limit subscriptions to currently visible contacts or active chat peers to minimize bandwidth: const userIDs = ...new Set visibleUserIDs.filter Boolean ; const states = await OpenIMSDK.subscribeUsersStatus userIDs ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | userIDList | string | Yes | Array of user IDs whose online status should be monitored. | Return value Resolves to an array of UserOnlineState representing the initial presence snapshot: | Field | Type | Description | | | | | | userID | string | Target user ID and primary reconciliation key. | | status | OnlineState | Presence state: OnlineState.Online or OnlineState.Offline . | | platformIDs | Platform optional | Array of platform clients currently connected for this user. | Online status reflects an active WebSocket connection to OpenIMServer; it does not indicate whether the user is actively viewing a specific screen. Listen for status changes When a subscribed user connects, disconnects, or changes platforms, the SDK emits OnUserStatusChanged : const handleStatusChanged = state: UserOnlineState = // Update UI presence indicator matching state.userID ; // Register listener OpenIMSDK.on OpenIMEvent.OnUserStatusChanged, handleStatusChanged ; // Remove listener OpenIMSDK.off OpenIMEvent.OnUserStatusChanged, handleStatusChanged ; When navigating away or logging out, unsubscribe and remove the listener.

title: Get subscribed user status
description: Retrieve current presence states for all previously subscribed users with the OpenIM React Native SDK.
keywords: sdk react-native v4 sdk react-native user online-status get-subscribe-users-status
content: Retrieve the latest online presence states for all users currently subscribed by this account: const states = await OpenIMSDK.getSubscribeUsersStatus ; Return value Resolves to an array of UserOnlineState . Update local presence indicators keyed by userID . If target users have not yet been subscribed, follow Subscribe to user online status /sdk/react native/user/online status/subscribe users status .

title: Unsubscribe from user online status
description: Stop observing presence status for specified users with the OpenIM React Native SDK.
keywords: sdk react-native v4 sdk react-native user online-status unsubscribe-users-status
content: Cancel active presence subscriptions for designated users: await OpenIMSDK.unsubscribeUsersStatus userIDs ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | userIDList | string | Yes | Array of user IDs to unsubscribe from. | Return value A resolved Promise confirms that the subscription was removed on the server. Unsubscribe when paging away, clearing search results, unmounting components, or logging out. Once unsubscribed, presence events for these users cease arriving.

title: Relationships overview
description: Understand friend relations, friend requests, and blacklists in the OpenIM React Native SDK.
keywords: sdk react-native v4 sdk react-native user overview-relationships
content: Relationship capabilities manage social connections between the current user and other accounts—encompassing friendships, incoming and outgoing friend requests, and blacklists. User profiles, presence, and account settings are covered separately in User overview /sdk/react native/user/overview user . Relationship data structures The SDK provides specialized models corresponding to each social state: | Structure | Context | Applicable guides | | | | | | PublicUserItem | Search public profiles, display friend candidates, or render stranger cards | Get user profiles /sdk/react native/user/profile/get users info | | FriendUserItem | Friend list, friend remark aliases, pin status, and relationship extensions | Get friend list by page /sdk/react native/user/friends/get friend list page , Get specified friends info /sdk/react native/user/friends/get specified friends info | | FriendshipInfo | Check whether a friendship exists between users | Check friend relationship /sdk/react native/user/friends/check friend | | FriendApplicationItem | Received or sent friend requests and their processing statuses | Get received friend applications /sdk/react native/user/friend applications/get friend application list as recipient , Get sent friend applications /sdk/react native/user/friend applications/get friend application list as applicant | | BlackUserItem | Blacklisted users maintained by the current account | Get blacklist /sdk/react native/user/blacklist/get black list , Add user to blacklist /sdk/react native/user/blacklist/add black , Remove user from blacklist /sdk/react native/user/blacklist/remove black | Browse by task | Task | Recommended guide | | | | | Query public profiles | Get user profiles /sdk/react native/user/profile/get users info | | Paginate, search, or query friends by ID | Get friend list by page /sdk/react native/user/friends/get friend list page , Search friends /sdk/react native/user/friends/search friends , Get specified friends info /sdk/react native/user/friends/get specified friends info | | Check friendship status | Check friend relationship /sdk/react native/user/friends/check friend | | Modify or delete friendships | Update friend profile /sdk/react native/user/friends/update friends , Delete a friend /sdk/react native/user/friends/delete friend | | Send or process friend requests | Send a friend request /sdk/react native/user/friend applications/add friend , Get received friend applications /sdk/react native/user/friend applications/get friend application list as recipient , Accept a friend request /sdk/react native/user/friend applications/accept friend application , Refuse a friend request /sdk/react native/user/friend applications/refuse friend application | | Manage blacklists | Get blacklist /sdk/react native/user/blacklist/get black list , Add user to blacklist /sdk/react native/user/blacklist/add black , Remove user from blacklist /sdk/react native/user/blacklist/remove black | Event listeners Relationship mutations trigger asynchronous events: Friend application events are documented in Get received friend applications /sdk/react native/user/friend applications/get friend application list as recipient . Friendship establishment, deletion, and profile changes are documented in Get friend list by page /sdk/react native/user/friends/get friend list page . Blacklist additions and removals are documented in Get blacklist /sdk/react native/user/blacklist/get black list .

title: Get friend list by page
description: Paginate and retrieve the friend list with filtering options using the OpenIM React Native SDK.
keywords: sdk react-native v4 sdk react-native user friends get-friend-list-page
content: Paginate and retrieve the friend list of the authenticated user with optional blacklist filtering: const friends = await OpenIMSDK.getFriendListPage offset: 0, count: 50, filterBlack: true, ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | offset | number | Yes | Pagination offset starting from 0 . | | count | number | Yes | Maximum number of friends to retrieve per batch. | | filterBlack | boolean | No | Whether to exclude blacklisted users; defaults to false . | Return value Resolves to an array of FriendUserItem for the requested page. Friend properties Key properties of FriendUserItem : | Field | Type | Description | | | | | | userID | string | Unique friend user ID and primary state reconciliation key. | | nickname | string | Friend account nickname. | | faceURL | string | Friend avatar image URL. | | remark | string | Custom remark alias set for this friend by the current user. | | isPinned | boolean | Whether this friend is pinned in the friend list. | | ownerUserID | string | User ID who owns this friendship relation. | | operatorUserID | string | User ID of the operator who last modified the relationship. | | addSource | number | Source channel through which the friendship was established. | | createTime | number | Friendship establishment timestamp in Unix milliseconds. | | ex | string | Relationship specific custom extension string. | | attachedInfo | string | SDK internal metadata. | Note that remark , isPinned , and ex are scoped strictly to the current user's friendship record and do not alter the friend's global profile. Listen for friend updates Friendship updates trigger OnFriendAdded , OnFriendInfoChanged , or OnFriendDeleted with the affected FriendUserItem : const handleFriendAdd = friend: FriendUserItem = // Insert new friend into list ; const handleFriendChanged = friend: FriendUserItem = // Update friend attributes matching friend.userID ; const handleFriendDeleted = friend: FriendUserItem = // Remove friend matching friend.userID from list ; // Register listeners OpenIMSDK.on OpenIMEvent.OnFriendAdded, handleFriendAdd ; OpenIMSDK.on OpenIMEvent.OnFriendInfoChanged, handleFriendChanged ; OpenIMSDK.on OpenIMEvent.OnFriendDeleted, handleFriendDeleted ; // Remove listeners OpenIMSDK.off OpenIMEvent.OnFriendAdded, handleFriendAdd ; OpenIMSDK.off OpenIMEvent.OnFriendInfoChanged, handleFriendChanged ; OpenIMSDK.off OpenIMEvent.OnFriendDeleted, handleFriendDeleted ; Unregister these listeners when the friend list screen unmounts, the user signs out, or accounts switch.

title: Search friends
description: Search friends by keyword across user ID, nickname, and remark using the OpenIM React Native SDK.
keywords: sdk react-native v4 sdk react-native user friends search-friends
content: Search friend records by keyword across specified fields. Trim whitespace before querying; the search evaluates the first non empty string in keywordList : const friends = await OpenIMSDK.searchFriends keywordList: keyword.trim , isSearchUserID: true, isSearchNickname: true, isSearchRemark: true, ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | keywordList | string | Yes | Array of keyword strings; the first non empty item is used for search. | | isSearchUserID | boolean | Yes | Whether to match against user IDs. | | isSearchNickname | boolean | Yes | Whether to match against friend nicknames. | | isSearchRemark | boolean | Yes | Whether to match against friend remarks. | Return value Resolves to an array of SearchedFriendsInfo . Each item includes friend attributes along with relationship : 0 indicates a blacklisted relation, while 1 indicates a friendship relation. Use userID as the unique key to identify and display search results.

title: Get specified friends info
description: Batch retrieve friendship profile information for specified user IDs using the OpenIM React Native SDK.
keywords: sdk react-native v4 sdk react-native user friends get-specified-friends-info
content: Batch retrieve friendship records for a list of target user IDs: const friends = await OpenIMSDK.getSpecifiedFriendsInfo userIDList: 'user a', 'user b' , filterBlack: true, ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | userIDList | string | Yes | List of friend user IDs to retrieve. | | filterBlack | boolean | No | Whether to filter out blacklisted users; defaults to false . | Return value Resolves to an array of matching FriendUserItem . The return order is not guaranteed to match the input list. For field definitions, see Get friend list by page /sdk/react native/user/friends/get friend list page . To fetch public profile cards for users who are not friends, use Get user profiles /sdk/react native/user/profile/get users info .

title: Check friend relationship
description: Batch verify friendship status with specified users using the OpenIM React Native SDK.
keywords: sdk react-native v4 sdk react-native user friends check-friend
content: Batch verify whether friendship relationships exist between the authenticated user and specified target users: const checks = await OpenIMSDK.checkFriend 'user a', 'user b' ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | userIDList | string | Yes | Array of user IDs to check. | Return value Resolves to an array of FriendshipInfo : | Field | Type | Description | | | | | | userID | string | The checked user ID. | | result | number | Friendship status: 1 indicates friends, 0 indicates not friends. | To inspect blacklist relationships, see Get blacklist /sdk/react native/user/blacklist/get black list .

title: Update friend profile
description: Update friendship attributes such as remark alias, pin status, or custom extension with the OpenIM React Native SDK.
keywords: sdk react-native v4 sdk react-native user friends update-friends
content: Modify friendship attributes—including custom remark alias, pin to top status, or custom extensions—for specified friends: await OpenIMSDK.updateFriends friendUserIDs: friendUserID , remark: remark, isPinned: true, ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | friendUserIDs | string | Yes | List of friend user IDs to update. | | remark | string | No | New custom remark alias for the friend. | | isPinned | boolean | No | Whether to pin this friend in the friend list. | | ex | string | No | Custom extension string. | Provide at least one attribute to update alongside friendUserIDs . If different friends require distinct values, call this method separately for each user. Return value A resolved Promise confirms that the friend information was updated on the server. Updates trigger the OnFriendInfoChanged event. Use userID to locate the friend entry in your local cache and reconcile remark, pin, or extension attributes. For event listeners, see Get friend list by page /sdk/react native/user/friends/get friend list page .

title: Delete a friend
description: Remove a friendship relation with a specified user using the OpenIM React Native SDK.
keywords: sdk react-native v4 sdk react-native user friends delete-friend
content: Remove an established friendship between the authenticated user and a specified friend: await OpenIMSDK.deleteFriend friendUserID ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | friendUserID | string | Yes | Target friend's user ID to delete. | Return value A resolved Promise confirms that the friendship has been dissolved on the server. Both users' clients receive the OnFriendDeleted event. Remove the friend entry keyed by userID from your local friend cache. For full event listeners, see Get friend list by page /sdk/react native/user/friends/get friend list page .

title: Send a friend request
description: Dispatch an outgoing friend application to a specified user using the OpenIM React Native SDK.
keywords: sdk react-native v4 sdk react-native user friend-applications add-friend
content: Dispatch a friend request to a target user with an optional verification greeting: await OpenIMSDK.addFriend toUserID, reqMsg, ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | toUserID | string | Yes | Target user ID to add as a friend. | | reqMsg | string | Yes | Request message or greeting. Pass empty string "" if not needed. | Return value A resolved Promise confirms that the friend request was submitted to the server. A successful Promise resolution indicates only that the request was delivered to the backend, not that the recipient has accepted it. Once processed by the recipient, the caller receives OnFriendApplicationAccepted or OnFriendApplicationRejected . If accepted, OnFriendAdded is triggered. Reconcile new friendships using userID . For event handling, see Get received friend applications /sdk/react native/user/friend applications/get friend application list as recipient .

title: Get received friend applications
description: Paginate and retrieve incoming friend requests by status using the OpenIM React Native SDK.
keywords: sdk react-native v4 sdk react-native user friend-applications get-friend-application-list-as-recipient
content: Paginate and query friend applications received by the authenticated user filtered by handling status: const applications = await OpenIMSDK.getFriendApplicationListAsRecipient handleResults: ApplicationHandleResult.Unprocessed , offset: 0, count: 20, ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | handleResults | number | Yes | List of application statuses to filter by. | | offset | number | Yes | Pagination offset starting from 0 . | | count | number | Yes | Maximum number of records to fetch per batch. | Status enum values: | Enum value | Value | Description | | | | | | ApplicationHandleResult.Unprocessed | 0 | Pending review. | | ApplicationHandleResult.Agree | 1 | Approved. | | ApplicationHandleResult.Reject | 1 | Rejected. | Return value Resolves to an array of FriendApplicationItem for the requested page. Friend application properties Key properties in FriendApplicationItem : | Field | Type | Description | | | | | | fromUserID | string | User ID of the applicant. | | fromNickname | string | Nickname of the applicant. | | fromFaceURL | string | Avatar URL of the applicant. | | toUserID | string | User ID of the recipient the current user . | | toNickname | string | Nickname of the recipient. | | toFaceURL | string | Avatar URL of the recipient. | | reqMsg | string | Greeting message attached to the request. | | handleResult | ApplicationHandleResult | Current handling status. | | handlerUserID | string | User ID who processed the application. | | handleMsg | string | Response note provided when processing. | | handleTime | number | Processing timestamp in Unix milliseconds. | | createTime | number | Request creation timestamp in Unix milliseconds. | | ex | string | Custom extension string. | Listen for friend application changes Friend application events trigger OnFriendApplicationAdded , OnFriendApplicationAccepted , OnFriendApplicationRejected , or OnFriendApplicationDeleted , delivering the affected FriendApplicationItem : const handleApplicationChanged = application: FriendApplicationItem = // Update state using composite key fromUserID and toUserID ; const handleApplicationDeleted = application: FriendApplicationItem = // Remove application matching fromUserID and toUserID ; // Register listeners OpenIMSDK.on OpenIMEvent.OnFriendApplicationAdded, handleApplicationChanged ; OpenIMSDK.on OpenIMEvent.OnFriendApplicationAccepted, handleApplicationChanged ; OpenIMSDK.on OpenIMEvent.OnFriendApplicationRejected, handleApplicationChanged ; OpenIMSDK.on OpenIMEvent.OnFriendApplicationDeleted, handleApplicationDeleted ; // Remove listeners OpenIMSDK.off OpenIMEvent.OnFriendApplicationAdded, handleApplicationChanged ; OpenIMSDK.off OpenIMEvent.OnFriendApplicationAccepted, handleApplicationChanged ; OpenIMSDK.off OpenIMEvent.OnFriendApplicationRejected, handleApplicationChanged ; OpenIMSDK.off OpenIMEvent.OnFriendApplicationDeleted, handleApplicationDeleted ; Identify individual application entries using the composite key fromUserID:toUserID . Unregister listeners when the view unmounts, the user signs out, or accounts switch.

title: Get sent friend applications
description: Paginate and retrieve outgoing friend applications sent by the current account using the OpenIM React Native SDK.
keywords: sdk react-native v4 sdk react-native user friend-applications get-friend-application-list-as-applicant
content: Paginate and query outgoing friend requests sent by the authenticated user: const applications = await OpenIMSDK.getFriendApplicationListAsApplicant offset: 0, count: 20, ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | offset | number | Yes | Pagination offset starting from 0 . | | count | number | Yes | Maximum number of application records to fetch. | Return value Resolves to an array of FriendApplicationItem representing outgoing friend applications for the current page. For detailed property descriptions and event listeners, see Get received friend applications /sdk/react native/user/friend applications/get friend application list as recipient .

title: Get unhandled friend application count
description: Query the unhandled incoming friend request counter since a given timestamp using the OpenIM React Native SDK.
keywords: sdk react-native v4 sdk react-native user friend-applications get-friend-application-unhandled-count
content: Query the count of unhandled friend requests received since a given timestamp, ideal for rendering notification badges or contact tab dots: const count = await OpenIMSDK.getFriendApplicationUnhandledCount time, ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | time | number | Yes | Start timestamp in Unix milliseconds. Pass 0 to count all unhandled friend applications. | Return value Resolves to a number representing the count of unhandled friend applications since the specified time. This query reads a snapshot of the counter and does not mutate conversation unread counts or emit events.

title: Accept a friend request
description: Accept an incoming friend application to establish a mutual friendship with the OpenIM React Native SDK.
keywords: sdk react-native v4 sdk react-native user friend-applications accept-friend-application
content: Accept an incoming friend request from a specified applicant: await OpenIMSDK.acceptFriendApplication toUserID: applicantUserID, handleMsg: '', ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | toUserID | string | Yes | User ID of the applicant who initiated the friend request. | | handleMsg | string | Yes | Optional response message attached to the approval. Pass an empty string "" if not needed. | Return value A resolved Promise confirms that the friend application was accepted on the server. Accepting a friend application creates a mutual friendship, emitting OnFriendApplicationAccepted and OnFriendAdded on both clients. Keyed by userID , insert the new friend record into your local friend list and update the application record status. For event listeners, see Get friend list by page /sdk/react native/user/friends/get friend list page .

title: Refuse a friend request
description: Decline an incoming friend application from a specified applicant with the OpenIM React Native SDK.
keywords: sdk react-native v4 sdk react-native user friend-applications refuse-friend-application
content: Decline an incoming friend request from a specified applicant: await OpenIMSDK.refuseFriendApplication toUserID: applicantUserID, handleMsg: '', ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | toUserID | string | Yes | User ID of the applicant who initiated the request. | | handleMsg | string | Yes | Rejection reason message. Pass empty string "" if not needed. | Return value A resolved Promise confirms that the refusal was recorded on the server. Refusing a request emits the OnFriendApplicationRejected event on both users' clients. Update the status of the application entry in the friend request list. For event listener setup, see Get received friend applications /sdk/react native/user/friend applications/get friend application list as recipient .

title: Delete friend requests
description: Batch remove friend request historical records from the application list using the OpenIM React Native SDK.
keywords: sdk react-native v4 sdk react-native user friend-applications delete-friend-requests
content: Batch remove friend application records from the local history list: await OpenIMSDK.deleteFriendRequests fromUserID, toUserID , ; Parameters Accepts an array of application target descriptors: | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | fromUserID | string | Yes | User ID of the applicant who initiated the friend request. | | toUserID | string | Yes | User ID of the recipient of the friend request. | Return value A resolved Promise confirms that the designated friend application records were deleted. Deleting an application record does not reject the request or affect existing friendships. Deletion triggers the OnFriendApplicationDeleted event. Remove items from the local friend application list using the composite key fromUserID:toUserID . For event listeners, see Get received friend applications /sdk/react native/user/friend applications/get friend application list as recipient .

title: Get blacklist
description: Retrieve the list of blocked users for the current account using the OpenIM React Native SDK.
keywords: sdk react-native v4 sdk react-native user blacklist get-black-list
content: Retrieve the complete list of blacklisted users for the authenticated account: const blockedUsers = await OpenIMSDK.getBlackList ; Return value Resolves to an array of BlackUserItem records: | Field | Type | Description | | | | | | userID | string | Blacklisted user ID and primary reconciliation key. | | nickname | string | Nickname of the blacklisted user. | | faceURL | string | Avatar image URL of the blacklisted user. | | ownerUserID | string | User ID who owns this blacklist entry. | | operatorUserID | string | User ID of the operator who executed the blacklisting. | | createTime | number | Timestamp when the entry was created in Unix milliseconds. | | addSource | number | Source channel for the blacklist entry. | | ex | string | Custom extension string. | When checking blacklist relations in profile cards or chat windows, match by userID . Blacklisting is independent of group permissions; use group APIs to mute or kick group members. Listen for blacklist changes Blacklist additions and removals trigger OnBlackAdded or OnBlackDeleted with the affected BlackUserItem : const handleBlackAdded = blackUser: BlackUserItem = // Add or update blacklist cache matching blackUser.userID ; const handleBlackDeleted = blackUser: BlackUserItem = // Remove entry matching blackUser.userID from blacklist cache ; // Register listeners OpenIMSDK.on OpenIMEvent.OnBlackAdded, handleBlackAdded ; OpenIMSDK.on OpenIMEvent.OnBlackDeleted, handleBlackDeleted ; // Remove listeners OpenIMSDK.off OpenIMEvent.OnBlackAdded, handleBlackAdded ; OpenIMSDK.off OpenIMEvent.OnBlackDeleted, handleBlackDeleted ; Unregister these listeners when the screen unmounts, the user signs out, or accounts switch.

title: Add user to blacklist
description: Block a specified user and add them to the blacklist using the OpenIM React Native SDK.
keywords: sdk react-native v4 sdk react-native user blacklist add-black
content: Add a designated user to the current account's blacklist to block direct communication: await OpenIMSDK.addBlack toUserID, ex, ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | toUserID | string | Yes | Target user ID to blacklist. | | ex | string | No | Custom extension string attached to the blacklist record. | Return value A resolved Promise confirms that the user was added to the blacklist on the server. Adding a user to the blacklist triggers the OnBlackAdded event. Use userID as the unique key to append the entry into your local blacklist cache. For event listener details, see Get blacklist /sdk/react native/user/blacklist/get black list .

title: Remove user from blacklist
description: Unblock a specified user and remove them from the blacklist using the OpenIM React Native SDK.
keywords: sdk react-native v4 sdk react-native user blacklist remove-black
content: Unblock a user by removing them from the current account's blacklist: await OpenIMSDK.removeBlack blackUserID ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | blackUserID | string | Yes | Target user ID to unblock and remove from the blacklist. | Return value A resolved Promise confirms that the user was removed from the blacklist on the server. Unblocking triggers the OnBlackDeleted event. Remove the entry keyed by userID from your local blacklist cache. For event listener details, see Get blacklist /sdk/react native/user/blacklist/get black list .

title: Conversation overview
description: Understand conversations, conversation state, message options, and conversation grouping in the OpenIM React Native SDK.
keywords: sdk react-native v4 sdk react-native conversation overview-conversation
content: In the OpenIM React Native SDK, a conversation represents the state of a chat session maintained by the currently authenticated account. Both direct one to one chats and group chats map to a ConversationItem , which encapsulates list display metadata, unread counters, drafts, and message reception preferences. Conversations and chat targets use distinct identifiers: conversationID identifies the conversation record for the current account and acts as the unique primary key for client side state merging; direct chat targets use the peer's userID , and group chat targets use the groupID . Group profiles, members, and permissions remain managed through group specific APIs. Conversation identifiers | Identifier | Description | | | | | conversationID | Unique primary key for the conversation record of the current account; used for settings, message history, and unread reconciliation. | | userID | Target user ID in direct 1 on 1 chats. | | groupID | Target group ID in group chats. | | sourceID | Target identifier when querying by type: supply userID for direct chats, or groupID for group chats. | To compute the conversationID from a chat target without a network round trip, invoke Get conversation ID /sdk/react native/conversation/retrieving conversations/get conversation id with sourceID and sessionType . Conversation properties A ConversationItem contains display fields alongside account level conversation settings: | Category | Fields | Description | | | | | | Identity & type | conversationID , conversationType | Locates the conversation and distinguishes between direct and group chats. | | List display | showName , faceURL , latestMsg , latestMsgSendTime | Displays conversation title, avatar, and preview of the latest message. | | Unread & mentions | unreadCount , groupAtType | Reflects unread badge counts and @ mention notifications. | | Organization | isPinned , draftText , isMarked Commercial , remark Commercial | Controls pin to top, marking, message drafts, and custom remarks for the current user. | | Message policy | recvMsgOpt , isPrivateChat Commercial , burnDuration Commercial , isMsgDestruct Commercial , msgDestructTime Commercial | Configures notification options, burn after reading, and automated message retention policies. | | State & extensions | isNotInGroup , attachedInfo , ex | Indicates group membership status, SDK internal metadata, and custom business extensions. | Browse by task | Task | Guide | | | | | Retrieve conversations | Get conversation by target /sdk/react native/conversation/retrieving conversations/get conversation by target , Get conversations by ID /sdk/react native/conversation/retrieving conversations/get conversations by id , Retrieve conversation list /sdk/react native/conversation/retrieving conversations/retrieve conversation list | | Organize conversations | Pin a conversation /sdk/react native/conversation/managing conversations/pin conversation , Mark a conversation /sdk/react native/conversation/managing conversations/mark conversation , Conversation groups overview /sdk/react native/conversation/managing conversation groups/overview conversation groups | | Manage drafts & remarks | Set conversation draft /sdk/react native/conversation/managing conversations/set conversation draft , Set conversation remark /sdk/react native/conversation/managing conversations/set conversation remark , Set conversation extension /sdk/react native/conversation/managing conversations/set conversation extension | | Message policies | Set message receive options /sdk/react native/conversation/managing conversations/set message receive option , Set burn duration /sdk/react native/conversation/managing conversations/set burn duration , Automate server message destruction /sdk/react native/conversation/managing conversations/set message destruct | | Unread & mention handling | Mark conversation as read /sdk/react native/conversation/managing conversations/mark conversation read , Get total unread count /sdk/react native/conversation/managing conversations/get total unread count , Clear group mentions /sdk/react native/conversation/managing conversations/clear group mentions | Hiding, deleting, and clearing Hiding, deleting, and clearing have distinct scopes: | Action | Effect | | | | | Hide a conversation /sdk/react native/conversation/managing conversations/hide a conversation | Hides a single conversation from the current account's list; it reappears when a new message arrives. | | Hide all conversations /sdk/react native/conversation/managing conversations/hide all conversations | Hides all conversation entries from the local list for the current account. | | Delete conversation with messages /sdk/react native/conversation/managing conversations/delete conversation with messages | Removes the conversation entry and permanently deletes local and server messages for this account. | | Clear conversation messages /sdk/react native/conversation/managing conversations/clear conversation messages | Preserves the conversation entry while wiping all message records for this account. | Event listeners Conversation state mutations trigger asynchronous push events: Retrieve conversation list /sdk/react native/conversation/retrieving conversations/retrieve conversation list documents OnNewConversation and OnConversationChanged listeners. Get total unread count /sdk/react native/conversation/managing conversations/get total unread count documents OnTotalUnreadMessageCountChanged . Conversation groups overview /sdk/react native/conversation/managing conversation groups/overview conversation groups documents group lifecycle and membership events.

title: Get conversation by target
description: Retrieve a single conversation item by target ID and session type using the OpenIM React Native SDK.
keywords: sdk react-native v4 sdk react-native conversation retrieving-conversations get-conversation-by-target
content: Retrieve the conversation details for a specific chat recipient or group using getOneConversation : const conversation = await OpenIMSDK.getOneConversation sourceID: targetUserID, sessionType: SessionType.Single, ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | sourceID | string | Yes | Target identifier: user ID for direct 1 on 1 chats, or group ID for group chats. | | sessionType | SessionType | Yes | Conversation session type: SessionType.Single for direct chats, or SessionType.Group for group chats. | Return value Resolves to the matching ConversationItem object. This query retrieves a local snapshot and does not trigger conversation events. Subsequent state updates arrive asynchronously via event listeners as described in Conversation overview /sdk/react native/conversation/overview conversation ; for field details, see Retrieve conversation list /sdk/react native/conversation/retrieving conversations/retrieve conversation list .

title: Get conversation ID
description: Generate or retrieve a deterministic conversation ID based on target ID and session type with the OpenIM React Native SDK.
keywords: sdk react-native v4 sdk react-native conversation retrieving-conversations get-conversation-id
content: Derive the deterministic conversation ID locally based on the chat target ID and session type using getConversationIDBySessionType : const conversationID = await OpenIMSDK.getConversationIDBySessionType sourceID: targetUserID, sessionType: SessionType.Single, ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | sourceID | string | Yes | Target identifier: user ID for direct 1 on 1 chats, or group ID for group chats. | | sessionType | SessionType | Yes | Conversation session type: SessionType.Single for direct chats, or SessionType.Group for group chats. | Return value Resolves to a string representing the deterministic conversationID . This identifier serves as the primary key for locating conversation records, filtering events, and executing conversation specific operations.

title: Get conversations by ID
description: Batch retrieve conversation details by conversationID using the OpenIM React Native SDK.
keywords: sdk react-native v4 sdk react-native conversation retrieving-conversations get-conversations-by-id
content: When holding an array of conversation IDs, retrieve their latest conversation items in a batch with getMultipleConversation : const conversations = await OpenIMSDK.getMultipleConversation conversationIDList ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | conversationIDList | string | Yes | Array of conversation IDs to retrieve. | Return value Resolves to an array of ConversationItem . The returned array length may be smaller than the input list if certain conversation records do not exist in the local SQLite database. Reconcile the returned conversation records into your application state keyed by conversationID . For detailed property definitions, see Retrieve conversation list /sdk/react native/conversation/retrieving conversations/retrieve conversation list .

title: Retrieve conversation list
description: Paginate and retrieve the conversation list for the current account using the OpenIM React Native SDK.
keywords: sdk react-native v4 sdk react-native conversation retrieving-conversations retrieve-conversation-list
content: Paginate and load local conversation records for the authenticated user with getConversationListSplit to establish the initial list snapshot: const conversations = await OpenIMSDK.getConversationListSplit offset: 0, count: 50, ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | offset | number | Yes | Pagination offset index. Pass 0 for the initial page, then increment by the accumulated count. | | count | number | Yes | Maximum number of conversations to retrieve per batch. | Return value Resolves to an array of ConversationItem for the requested page. When the returned array length is less than count , the end of the list has been reached. Conversation properties A ConversationItem object includes display attributes, unread counters, and account specific preferences: | Field | Type | Description | | | | | | conversationID | string | Primary conversation identifier. | | conversationType | SessionType | Conversation type: single or group chat. | | userID | string | Target user ID in single chats; empty string in group chats. | | groupID | string | Target group ID in group chats; empty string in single chats. | | showName | string | Display name of the conversation. | | faceURL | string | Avatar image URL for the conversation. | | recvMsgOpt | MessageReceiveOptType | Notification receive options for this conversation. | | unreadCount | number | Total unread message count in this conversation. | | groupAtType | GroupAtType | Group @ mention status; not used in single chats. | | latestMsg | string | Serialized JSON string of the most recent message. | | latestMsgSendTime | number | Send timestamp of the latest message in Unix milliseconds. | | draftText | string | Local message draft saved on this device. | | draftTextTime | number | Timestamp when the draft was last updated. | | isPrivateChat | boolean | Whether private chat burn after reading is enabled. | | burnDuration | number | Burn after reading countdown duration in seconds. | | isMsgDestruct | boolean | Whether server message destruction is enabled. | | msgDestructTime | number | Automated server message destruction period in seconds. | | isPinned | boolean | Whether the conversation is pinned to the top. | | isMarked Commercial | boolean | Whether the conversation is marked. | | isNotInGroup | boolean | Whether the current user is no longer a member of this group. | | attachedInfo | string | SDK internal metadata. | | ex | string optional | Custom business extension string. | | remark Commercial | string optional | Custom conversation remark for the current user. | When accumulating paginated results, always deduplicate and merge records using conversationID as the primary key. When refreshing the list, re query from offset: 0 . Listen for conversation changes The SDK triggers OnNewConversation when a new conversation entry is created, and OnConversationChanged when an existing conversation mutates such as new message arrival, unread counter changes, draft updates, or pin toggle . Both event payloads provide ConversationItem . Reconcile incoming incremental items into your state keyed by conversationID . function handleNewConversation conversations: ConversationItem // Merge new conversations into UI state function handleConversationChanged conversations: ConversationItem // Update existing conversation entries by conversationID // Register listeners OpenIMSDK.on OpenIMEvent.OnNewConversation, handleNewConversation ; OpenIMSDK.on OpenIMEvent.OnConversationChanged, handleConversationChanged ; // Remove listeners OpenIMSDK.off OpenIMEvent.OnNewConversation, handleNewConversation ; OpenIMSDK.off OpenIMEvent.OnConversationChanged, handleConversationChanged ; Unregister these listeners when the user logs out, switches accounts, or the conversation list unmounts.

title: Pin or unpin a conversation
description: Pin a conversation to the top of the list or remove its pin state using the OpenIM React Native SDK.
keywords: sdk react-native v4 sdk react-native conversation managing-conversations pin-conversation
content: Toggle the pin to top status on a conversation for the current account. Pinned conversations are rendered at the top of the conversation list: await OpenIMSDK.pinConversation conversationID, isPinned: true, ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | conversationID | string | Yes | Target conversation ID to update. | | isPinned | boolean | Yes | Set true to pin the conversation to the top, or false to unpin. | Return value A resolved Promise confirms that the conversation pin state was updated on the server and local database. The update triggers the OnConversationChanged event. Use conversationID to identify the conversation in your local state store and update isPinned so the list order recalculates immediately. For event listeners, see Retrieve conversation list /sdk/react native/conversation/retrieving conversations/retrieve conversation list .

title: Mark or unmark a conversation
description: Toggle the marked status on a conversation for categorization using the OpenIM React Native SDK.
keywords: sdk react-native v4 sdk react-native conversation managing-conversations mark-conversation
content: Set or clear the marked flag on a conversation for the current account. Marked conversations can be highlighted or organized into custom flagged views: await OpenIMSDK.setConversation conversationID, isMarked: true, ; Pass false for isMarked to unmark the conversation. To manage conversation grouping, see Conversation groups overview /sdk/react native/conversation/managing conversation groups/overview conversation groups . Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | conversationID | string | Yes | Target conversation ID to update. | | isMarked | boolean | No | Set true to mark the conversation, or false to clear the mark. | Return value A resolved Promise confirms that the marked status of the conversation has been updated. State changes trigger the OnConversationChanged event. Use conversationID to locate the target conversation entry in your state store and reconcile its isMarked value. For complete event listeners, see Retrieve conversation list /sdk/react native/conversation/retrieving conversations/retrieve conversation list .

title: Set conversation remark
description: Configure a personal alias remark for a conversation using the OpenIM React Native SDK.
keywords: sdk react-native v4 sdk react-native conversation managing-conversations set-conversation-remark
content: Assign a custom alias remark for a conversation visible only to the current account: await OpenIMSDK.setConversation conversationID, remark: 'Project Discussions', ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | conversationID | string | Yes | Target conversation ID to update. | | remark | string | No | Custom conversation remark. Pass an empty string "" to clear the existing remark. | When rendering conversation titles in the list view, prioritize remark over showName if present. Setting a conversation remark affects only the conversation display for this account; it does not change the global nickname of a user or group. Return value A resolved Promise confirms that the conversation remark was saved to the server. The update triggers the OnConversationChanged event. Use conversationID to identify the conversation entry and update its remark field. For event listener details, see Retrieve conversation list /sdk/react native/conversation/retrieving conversations/retrieve conversation list .

title: Set conversation extension
description: Store custom application metadata in the conversation ex field using the OpenIM React Native SDK.
keywords: sdk react-native v4 sdk react-native conversation managing-conversations set-conversation-extension
content: Attach or update application defined metadata in the conversation's ex field: await OpenIMSDK.setConversation conversationID, ex: JSON.stringify category: 'work', , ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | conversationID | string | Yes | Target conversation ID to update. | | ex | string | No | Custom extension string. Serialize JSON or proprietary structured text as needed. | If you need to preserve existing extension keys, read the current ex property first, merge your mutations in application code, and write back the consolidated string. Return value A resolved Promise confirms that the extension field was persisted on the server. The update triggers the OnConversationChanged event. Use conversationID to identify the conversation in local state and merge the updated ex attribute. For event registration, see Retrieve conversation list /sdk/react native/conversation/retrieving conversations/retrieve conversation list .

title: Set conversation draft
description: Persist or clear unsent message draft text for a conversation using the OpenIM React Native SDK.
keywords: sdk react-native v4 sdk react-native conversation managing-conversations set-conversation-draft
content: Persist unsent text as a draft for a specified conversation. Call this method when the user exits the chat screen, switches conversations, or backgrounds the application to safeguard unsaved edits: await OpenIMSDK.setConversationDraft conversationID, draftText: editorValue, ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | conversationID | string | Yes | Target conversation ID to store the draft for. | | draftText | string | Yes | Draft text content. Pass an empty string "" to clear the existing draft. | During active text input, manage ephemeral text state in memory and persist it to the SDK only upon conversation blur or screen unmount. Return value A resolved Promise confirms that the draft text has been persisted to local storage. Saving a draft triggers the OnConversationChanged event. Use conversationID to locate the target conversation and merge the updated draftText and draftTextTime properties. For event listener setup, see Retrieve conversation list /sdk/react native/conversation/retrieving conversations/retrieve conversation list . Purge in memory draft buffers when switching accounts or logging out.

title: Set message receive option
description: Configure do-not-disturb and message reception options for a conversation using the OpenIM React Native SDK.
keywords: sdk react-native v4 sdk react-native conversation managing-conversations set-message-receive-option
content: Configure the notification behavior or mute setting for an individual conversation: await OpenIMSDK.setConversationRecvMessageOpt conversationID, opt: MessageReceiveOptType.NotNotify, ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | conversationID | string | Yes | Target conversation ID to configure. | | opt | MessageReceiveOptType | Yes | Message reception option to apply. | MessageReceiveOptType options include: | Enum value | Value | Description | | | | | | MessageReceiveOptType.Normal | 0 | Receive messages and show notifications normally. | | MessageReceiveOptType.NotReceive | 1 | Reject incoming messages for this conversation. | | MessageReceiveOptType.NotNotify | 2 | Receive messages silently without notification banners or sounds Mute . | Return value A resolved Promise confirms that the conversation message reception option was updated on the server. The update triggers the OnConversationChanged event. Use conversationID to identify the conversation in your state store and update recvMsgOpt to toggle mute badges or silent indicators. For account wide defaults, see Set global message reception /sdk/react native/user/profile/set global message reception . For event registration, see Retrieve conversation list /sdk/react native/conversation/retrieving conversations/retrieve conversation list .

title: Clear group mentions
description: Reset group chat @ mention status on a conversation using the OpenIM React Native SDK.
keywords: sdk react-native v4 sdk react-native conversation managing-conversations clear-group-mentions
content: Reset the @ mention indicator on a group conversation after the user opens or dismisses mention alerts: await OpenIMSDK.resetConversationGroupAtType conversationID ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | conversationID | string | Yes | Target group conversation ID whose mention state will be reset. | This operation restores groupAtType to its default non mention state. Clearing group mentions is independent of Mark conversation as read /sdk/react native/conversation/managing conversations/mark conversation read . Return value A resolved Promise confirms that the group mention status has been reset. The state update triggers the OnConversationChanged event. Use conversationID to locate the target conversation in your state store and update groupAtType to GroupAtType.AtNormal . For event registration, see Retrieve conversation list /sdk/react native/conversation/retrieving conversations/retrieve conversation list .

title: Mark conversation as read
description: Mark all unread messages in a conversation as read using the OpenIM React Native SDK.
keywords: sdk react-native v4 sdk react-native conversation managing-conversations mark-conversation-read
content: When the user enters a chat screen to read incoming messages, mark all unread messages in the conversation as read: await OpenIMSDK.markConversationMessageAsRead conversationID ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | conversationID | string | Yes | Target conversation ID to mark as read. | Return value A resolved Promise confirms that the unread message counter for the current account in this conversation has been reset to zero. The reset triggers the OnConversationChanged and OnTotalUnreadMessageCountChanged events. Locate the target conversation using conversationID and update its unreadCount to 0 . In group chats, this method resets only the current account's local unread counter; to broadcast per message read receipts to other group members, see Send group read receipts /sdk/react native/message/managing read status/send group read receipts . For event handling, see Retrieve conversation list /sdk/react native/conversation/retrieving conversations/retrieve conversation list .

title: Get total unread count
description: Retrieve and observe the aggregate unread message counter across all conversations using the OpenIM React Native SDK.
keywords: sdk react-native v4 sdk react-native conversation managing-conversations get-total-unread-count
content: Retrieve the aggregate unread message count across all conversations for the authenticated user. Always query this API or observe unread change events directly rather than manually summing the unreadCount of paginated conversations, which omits unread counts from unloaded conversations. const totalUnread = await OpenIMSDK.getTotalUnreadMsgCount ; Return value Resolves to a number representing the total unread message count. Event listener While the application is active in the foreground, observe unread count fluctuations via the OnTotalUnreadMessageCountChanged event: function handleTotalUnreadChanged totalUnread: number // Update app tab bar badge or notification icon // Register listener OpenIMSDK.on OpenIMEvent.OnTotalUnreadMessageCountChanged, handleTotalUnreadChanged ; // Remove listener OpenIMSDK.off OpenIMEvent.OnTotalUnreadMessageCountChanged, handleTotalUnreadChanged ; Unregister this listener when the component unmounts, the user signs out, or accounts switch. To synchronize this count with the OS level badge counter, see Set application badge /sdk/react native/message/set app badge .

title: Enable or disable private chat
description: Toggle private chat mode (burn-after-reading) for a direct conversation using the OpenIM React Native SDK.
keywords: sdk react-native v4 sdk react-native conversation managing-conversations set-private-chat
content: Toggle the burn after reading private chat mode for a direct one to one conversation. The countdown duration after reading is configured separately via Set burn duration /sdk/react native/conversation/managing conversations/set burn duration . await OpenIMSDK.setConversationPrivateChat conversationID, isPrivate: true, ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | conversationID | string | Yes | Target conversation ID to configure. | | isPrivate | boolean | Yes | Set true to enable burn after reading, or false to disable it. | Return value A resolved Promise confirms that the private chat setting has been saved to the server. The update triggers the OnConversationChanged event. Locate the conversation by conversationID in your local store and update isPrivateChat . For event details, see Retrieve conversation list /sdk/react native/conversation/retrieving conversations/retrieve conversation list .

title: Set burn duration
description: Configure the burn-after-reading countdown duration in a direct chat using the OpenIM React Native SDK.
keywords: sdk react-native v4 sdk react-native conversation managing-conversations set-burn-duration
content: Configure the countdown duration in seconds before read messages are destroyed in a direct 1 on 1 chat. This method adjusts only the duration; toggling private chat on or off is managed via Enable or disable private chat /sdk/react native/conversation/managing conversations/set private chat . Do not confuse burnDuration with the server wide message retention period msgDestructTime . await OpenIMSDK.setConversationBurnDuration conversationID, burnDuration: 30, ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | conversationID | string | Yes | Target conversation ID to configure. | | burnDuration | number | Yes | Burn countdown duration in seconds. | Return value A resolved Promise confirms that the burn duration setting has been persisted on the server. The update triggers the OnConversationChanged event. Use conversationID to locate the target conversation in your state store and update its burnDuration property. For event listener details, see Retrieve conversation list /sdk/react native/conversation/retrieving conversations/retrieve conversation list .

title: Set message destruct
description: Configure automated server-side message retention and deletion policies using the OpenIM React Native SDK.
keywords: sdk react-native v4 sdk react-native conversation managing-conversations set-message-destruct
content: Configure an automated server side message deletion policy for a conversation: await OpenIMSDK.setConversation conversationID, isMsgDestruct: true, msgDestructTime: 3600, ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | conversationID | string | Yes | Target conversation ID to configure. | | isMsgDestruct | boolean | No | Whether to enable automatic server side message destruction. | | msgDestructTime | number | No | Automated destruction interval in seconds. | To enable the policy, provide both isMsgDestruct: true and msgDestructTime ; set isMsgDestruct: false to disable it. Note that this feature is distinct from one to one burn after reading, which is managed via isPrivateChat and burnDuration . Automated destruction purges historical messages retained on the cloud server. Messages already stored in the local SQLite database remain intact until locally cleared; however, once wiped or on a new device, expired server messages cannot be synchronized again. Return value A resolved Promise confirms that the message destruction policy was updated on the server. The update triggers the OnConversationChanged event. Use conversationID to identify the conversation in your state store and reconcile isMsgDestruct and msgDestructTime . For event listener details, see Retrieve conversation list /sdk/react native/conversation/retrieving conversations/retrieve conversation list .

title: Hide a conversation
description: Hide a single conversation from the conversation list without deleting messages using the OpenIM React Native SDK.
keywords: sdk react-native v4 sdk react-native conversation managing-conversations hide-a-conversation
content: Hide a single conversation entry from the active conversation list for the current account. This action hides the list item on the current device without deleting chat history; the conversation will reappear when a new message arrives or an interaction occurs. await OpenIMSDK.hideConversation conversationID ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | conversationID | string | Yes | Target conversation ID to hide. | Return value A resolved Promise confirms that the request to hide the conversation was processed. Upon Promise resolution, remove the conversation identified by conversationID from the local UI list view. Subsequent mutations or incoming messages will trigger the OnConversationChanged event, prompting the application to re insert or update the conversation by conversationID . For full event handling, see Retrieve conversation list /sdk/react native/conversation/retrieving conversations/retrieve conversation list .

title: Hide all conversations
description: Hide all conversations from the conversation list for the current account using the OpenIM React Native SDK.
keywords: sdk react-native v4 sdk react-native conversation managing-conversations hide-all-conversations
content: Hide all conversation entries from the active conversation list for the current account. This batch operation hides conversations on the current device without deleting any historical chat messages. await OpenIMSDK.hideAllConversations ; Return value A resolved Promise confirms that the request to hide all conversations was processed. Upon successful resolution, clear the locally rendered conversation list and refresh the interface by invoking Retrieve conversation list /sdk/react native/conversation/retrieving conversations/retrieve conversation list and Get total unread count /sdk/react native/conversation/managing conversations/get total unread count . When new messages arrive or new interactions occur, affected conversations reappear through OnNewConversation or OnConversationChanged events, where the client merges entries keyed by conversationID .

title: Delete conversation with messages
description: Delete a conversation entry and permanently remove all its associated messages using the OpenIM React Native SDK.
keywords: sdk react-native v4 sdk react-native conversation managing-conversations delete-conversation-with-messages
content: Delete a conversation entry and purge all its associated messages for the current account: await OpenIMSDK.deleteConversationAndDeleteAllMsg conversationID ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | conversationID | string | Yes | Target conversation ID to permanently delete. | Return value A resolved Promise confirms that the conversation record and its historical messages were removed locally and from the server. The deletion triggers the OnConversationChanged event. Use conversationID to identify the conversation, remove it from local UI state lists, and purge the chat view message cache. For event listener registration, see Retrieve conversation list /sdk/react native/conversation/retrieving conversations/retrieve conversation list .

title: Clear conversation messages
description: Clear all message history in a specified conversation while retaining the conversation entry using the OpenIM React Native SDK.
keywords: sdk react-native v4 sdk react-native conversation managing-conversations clear-conversation-messages
content: Clear all message history records in a specified conversation. This operation removes stored messages while keeping the conversation entry and its settings intact: await OpenIMSDK.clearConversationAndDeleteAllMsg conversationID ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | conversationID | string | Yes | Target conversation ID whose message history should be cleared. | Return value A resolved Promise confirms that the request to clear messages was processed by the server. Promise resolution indicates that historical messages have been purged. When the conversation's latest message, unread counter, or preview state changes as a result, the SDK triggers the OnConversationChanged event. Reconcile changes by matching conversationID and wipe the corresponding local message list view. For full listener registration, see Retrieve conversation list /sdk/react native/conversation/retrieving conversations/retrieve conversation list .

title: Conversation groups overview
description: Understand conversation categorization, group types, data structures, and event listeners in the OpenIM React Native SDK.
keywords: sdk react-native v4 sdk react-native conversation managing-conversation-groups overview-conversation-groups
content: Conversation groups allow applications to categorize the current account's conversations into dedicated views—such as Work, Personal, Follow up, or custom business categories. Group types ConversationGroupType defines the categorization criteria: | Enum value | Value | Description | | | | | | ConversationGroupType.ConversationGroupTypeNormal | 0 | Standard user created custom group. | | ConversationGroupType.ConversationGroupTypeFilter | 1 | Rule based automated filter group. | | ConversationGroupType.ConversationGroupTypeAll | 2 | Match all conversation group types when querying. | ConversationGroup properties A ConversationGroup is uniquely identified by conversationGroupID : | Field | Type | Description | | | | | | conversationGroupID | string | Unique conversation group identifier. | | name | string | Display name of the group. | | serial | number | Ordering sequence value for sorting groups. | | version | number | Data synchronization version. | | conversationGroupType | ConversationGroupType | Group type. | | hidden | boolean | Whether the group is hidden from the UI. | | unreadCount | number | Aggregate unread message count of conversations in this group. | | conversationIDs | string | List of conversation IDs currently belonging to this group. | | ex | string optional | Custom business extension string. | Listen for group changes When groups are created, updated, or deleted, the SDK emits group lifecycle events. Membership changes dispatch member specific callbacks. When updating local application state, always use conversationGroupID to locate and manage conversation groups, and use conversationID to manage member conversations inside each group. const handleGroupAdded = groups: ConversationGroup = // Insert new groups into local state ; const handleGroupChanged = groups: ConversationGroup = // Update modified group properties ; const handleGroupDeleted = groups: ConversationGroup = // Remove deleted groups from local state ; const handleGroupMemberAdded = payload: ConversationGroupMemberChangedCallbackData = // Add conversation IDs into target group ; const handleGroupMemberDeleted = payload: ConversationGroupMemberChangedCallbackData = // Remove conversation IDs from target group ; // Register listeners OpenIMSDK.on OpenIMEvent.OnConversationGroupAdded, handleGroupAdded ; OpenIMSDK.on OpenIMEvent.OnConversationGroupChanged, handleGroupChanged ; OpenIMSDK.on OpenIMEvent.OnConversationGroupDeleted, handleGroupDeleted ; OpenIMSDK.on OpenIMEvent.OnConversationGroupMemberAdded, handleGroupMemberAdded ; OpenIMSDK.on OpenIMEvent.OnConversationGroupMemberDeleted, handleGroupMemberDeleted ; // Remove listeners OpenIMSDK.off OpenIMEvent.OnConversationGroupAdded, handleGroupAdded ; OpenIMSDK.off OpenIMEvent.OnConversationGroupChanged, handleGroupChanged ; OpenIMSDK.off OpenIMEvent.OnConversationGroupDeleted, handleGroupDeleted ; OpenIMSDK.off OpenIMEvent.OnConversationGroupMemberAdded, handleGroupMemberAdded ; OpenIMSDK.off OpenIMEvent.OnConversationGroupMemberDeleted, handleGroupMemberDeleted ; Unregister these listeners when the component unmounts, the user logs out, or accounts switch. Related tasks | Task | Guide | | | | | Create & modify groups | Create a conversation group /sdk/react native/conversation/managing conversation groups/create conversation group , Update a conversation group /sdk/react native/conversation/managing conversation groups/update conversation group , Set conversation group order /sdk/react native/conversation/managing conversation groups/set conversation group order | | Delete groups | Delete a conversation group /sdk/react native/conversation/managing conversation groups/delete conversation group | | Manage members | Add conversations to groups /sdk/react native/conversation/managing conversation groups/add conversations to groups , Remove conversations from groups /sdk/react native/conversation/managing conversation groups/remove conversations from groups | | Query groups & memberships | Get conversation groups /sdk/react native/conversation/managing conversation groups/get conversation groups , Get conversation group IDs by conversation ID /sdk/react native/conversation/managing conversation groups/get conversation group ids by conversation id , Get conversation group info with conversations /sdk/react native/conversation/managing conversation groups/get conversation group info with conversations |

title: Create a conversation group
description: Create a new conversation categorization group for the current account using the OpenIM React Native SDK.
keywords: sdk react-native v4 sdk react-native conversation managing-conversation-groups create-conversation-group
content: Create a new conversation group for the authenticated account. Supply at least name when creating a custom group, and optionally specify an initial conversation to associate: const group = await OpenIMSDK.createConversationGroup name: 'Work', order: 100, conversationID, conversationGroupType: ConversationGroupType.ConversationGroupTypeNormal, ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | name | string | Yes | Name of the conversation group. | | order | number | No | Ordering priority value for list sorting. | | ex | string | No | Custom extension string for this group. | | conversationID | string | No | Initial conversation ID to add to the group upon creation. | | conversationGroupType | ConversationGroupType | No | Group type: pass ConversationGroupTypeNormal for custom groups. | Return value Resolves to a ConversationGroupResp object containing conversationGroupID , name , order , and conversationIDs . Creation triggers the OnConversationGroupAdded event. Use conversationGroupID as the primary key to insert or reconcile the group in local state, and use conversationID to manage member conversations inside the group. For event registration, see Conversation groups overview /sdk/react native/conversation/managing conversation groups/overview conversation groups .

title: Get conversation groups
description: Retrieve conversation groups by group type using the OpenIM React Native SDK.
keywords: sdk react-native v4 sdk react-native conversation managing-conversation-groups get-conversation-groups
content: Retrieve conversation groups created by the authenticated account filtered by type: const groups = await OpenIMSDK.getConversationGroups ConversationGroupType.ConversationGroupTypeNormal, ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | groupType | ConversationGroupType | Yes | Conversation group type filter. | Group type enum values: | Enum value | Value | Description | | | | | | ConversationGroupTypeNormal | 0 | Standard custom conversation groups. | | ConversationGroupTypeAll | 1 | All conversation group categories. | Return value Resolves to an array of ConversationGroup . For field definitions, see Conversation groups overview /sdk/react native/conversation/managing conversation groups/overview conversation groups . Each group item contains conversationGroupID , name , order , and the list of associated conversationIDs . To retrieve group metadata populated with full conversation items in a single call, use Get conversation group info with conversations /sdk/react native/conversation/managing conversation groups/get conversation group info with conversations .

title: Get conversation group info with conversations
description: Retrieve conversation group details and its paginated conversation items using the OpenIM React Native SDK.
keywords: sdk react-native v4 sdk react-native conversation managing-conversation-groups get-conversation-group-info-with-conversations
content: Retrieve group metadata alongside a paginated list of conversations in that group: const result = await OpenIMSDK.getConversationGroupInfoWithConversations conversationGroupID, pagination: pageNumber: 1, showNumber: 20, , ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | conversationGroupID | string | Yes | Target conversation group ID to query. | | pagination.pageNumber | number | Yes | Page number starting from 1 . | | pagination.showNumber | number | Yes | Number of conversation items per page. | Return value Resolves to an object containing: | Field | Type | Description | | | | | | group | ConversationGroup | Conversation group details. | | conversationTotal | number | Total number of conversations associated with this group. | | conversationElems | ConversationItem | Conversation items retrieved for the current page. | When the accumulated conversations reach conversationTotal , further pagination can stop. Reconcile groups by conversationGroupID and individual conversations by conversationID . For conversation properties, see Retrieve conversation list /sdk/react native/conversation/retrieving conversations/retrieve conversation list ; for group properties, see Conversation groups overview /sdk/react native/conversation/managing conversation groups/overview conversation groups .

title: Get conversation group IDs by conversation ID
description: Query all conversation groups that a specific conversation belongs to using the OpenIM React Native SDK.
keywords: sdk react-native v4 sdk react-native conversation managing-conversation-groups get-conversation-group-ids-by-conversation-id
content: A conversation can belong to multiple groups simultaneously. Pass a conversationID to query all conversation groups containing that conversation: const groups = await OpenIMSDK.getConversationGroupByConversationID conversationID ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | conversationID | string | Yes | Target conversation ID to query. | Return value Resolves to an array of ConversationGroup , where each element represents a complete group structure including conversationGroupID , name , and order . This query returns a point in time snapshot and does not dispatch push events. For live updates, see Conversation groups overview /sdk/react native/conversation/managing conversation groups/overview conversation groups .

title: Update a conversation group
description: Modify conversation group properties such as name, visibility, or extensions using the OpenIM React Native SDK.
keywords: sdk react-native v4 sdk react-native conversation managing-conversation-groups update-conversation-group
content: Modify the name, custom extension, or visibility of an existing conversation group. Pass only the fields that need to be changed: const group = await OpenIMSDK.updateConversationGroup conversationGroupID, name: 'Priority Work', hidden: false, ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | conversationGroupID | string | Yes | Target conversation group ID to update. | | name | string | No | New display name for the group. | | ex | string | No | New custom business extension string. | | hidden | boolean | No | Whether to hide the group in the UI. | Return value Resolves to the updated ConversationGroupResp object. Modifications trigger the OnConversationGroupChanged event. Locate the group using conversationGroupID to reconcile properties in your local group state. For event listener setup, see Conversation groups overview /sdk/react native/conversation/managing conversation groups/overview conversation groups .

title: Set conversation group order
description: Batch update sort order priorities for conversation groups using the OpenIM React Native SDK.
keywords: sdk react-native v4 sdk react-native conversation managing-conversation-groups set-conversation-group-order
content: Batch reorder conversation groups for the current account: await OpenIMSDK.setConversationGroupOrder conversationGroupID: firstGroupID, order: 100 , conversationGroupID: secondGroupID, order: 200 , ; Parameters Accepts an array of order specification objects: | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | conversationGroupID | string | Yes | Target conversation group ID to reorder. | | order | number | Yes | New numeric ordering priority value. | Return value A resolved Promise confirms that the new sort order was saved on the server. Ordering updates trigger the OnConversationGroupChanged event. In local state reconciliation, update the order property of each group identified by conversationGroupID and re sort the conversation group list view. For event details, see Conversation groups overview /sdk/react native/conversation/managing conversation groups/overview conversation groups .

title: Add conversations to groups
description: Batch assign one or more conversations into one or more conversation groups using the OpenIM React Native SDK.
keywords: sdk react-native v4 sdk react-native conversation managing-conversation-groups add-conversations-to-groups
content: Associate one or more conversations into one or more conversation groups in a batch operation: await OpenIMSDK.addConversationsToGroups conversationIDs: conversationID , conversationGroupIDs: conversationGroupID , ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | conversationIDs | string | Yes | List of conversation IDs to add. | | conversationGroupIDs | string | Yes | List of destination conversation group IDs. | Return value A resolved Promise confirms that the conversations were successfully assigned to the specified groups. Membership updates trigger the OnConversationGroupMemberAdded event.
