In local state reconciliation, identify the target group by conversationGroupID and append member conversation records by conversationID . For event registration, see Conversation groups overview /sdk/react native/conversation/managing conversation groups/overview conversation groups .

title: Remove conversations from groups
description: Batch disassociate conversations from conversation groups without deleting them using the OpenIM React Native SDK.
keywords: sdk react-native v4 sdk react-native conversation managing-conversation-groups remove-conversations-from-groups
content: Disassociate one or more conversations from one or more conversation groups. This operation removes group membership only; it does not delete conversations or messages: await OpenIMSDK.removeConversationsFromGroups conversationIDs: conversationID , conversationGroupIDs: conversationGroupID , ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | conversationIDs | string | Yes | List of conversation IDs to remove. | | conversationGroupIDs | string | Yes | List of target conversation group IDs. | Return value A resolved Promise confirms that the conversations were detached from the designated groups. Removal triggers the OnConversationGroupMemberDeleted event. Reconcile local state by locating the group using conversationGroupID and removing the member conversation matching conversationID . For event registration, see Conversation groups overview /sdk/react native/conversation/managing conversation groups/overview conversation groups .

title: Delete a conversation group
description: Delete a conversation group and clear its associations without deleting conversations using the OpenIM React Native SDK.
keywords: sdk react-native v4 sdk react-native conversation managing-conversation-groups delete-conversation-group
content: Delete a conversation group and dissolve its conversation associations. This operation only deletes the group category; it does not delete conversations or message histories: await OpenIMSDK.deleteConversationGroup conversationGroupID ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | conversationGroupID | string | Yes | Target conversation group ID to delete. | Return value A resolved Promise confirms that the conversation group was deleted from the server. Deletion triggers the OnConversationGroupDeleted event. Remove the conversation group entry matching conversationGroupID from local UI lists. For full event listeners, see Conversation groups overview /sdk/react native/conversation/managing conversation groups/overview conversation groups .

title: Group overview
description: Understand group profiles, group members, join applications, and group events in the OpenIM React Native SDK.
keywords: sdk react-native v4 sdk react-native group overview-group
content: Multi party messaging in OpenIM is anchored on groups. Group related APIs use groupID to identify the group entity—such as querying group profiles, managing members, and reviewing join applications. Group conversations use conversationID to manage conversation settings, message history, and unread counters. Keep groupID the group entity and conversationID the chat session distinct in your code. Core data structures | Structure | Description | | | | | GroupItem | Group name, avatar, announcement, owner, join verification policy, member count, and custom extensions. | | GroupMemberItem | A member's group scoped nickname, role level, muting duration, and join metadata within a specific group. | Group member roles are enumerated in GroupMemberRole : Normal for standard members, Admin for administrators, and Owner for the group creator/owner. GroupItem properties | Field | Type | Description | | | | | | groupID | string | Group ID and unique reconciliation key for group profiles. | | groupName | string | Group title. | | notification | string | Group announcement text. | | friendUserIDs | string | Friend user IDs associated with this group. | | remark | string | Group remark alias set by the current account. | GroupMemberItem properties | Field | Type | Description | | | | | | groupID | string | Target group ID to which this member belongs. | | userID | string | Member user ID. | | nickname | string | Member's display name inside this specific group. | | faceURL | string | Member's avatar image URL inside this specific group. | | roleLevel | GroupMemberRole | Member role: Normal , Admin , or Owner . | | muteEndTime | number | Timestamp in Unix seconds when the member mute expires. | | joinTime | number | Join timestamp in Unix seconds. | | joinSource | GroupJoinSource | Method or invitation through which the member joined. | | inviterUserID | string | User ID of the member who extended the invitation. | | operatorUserID | string | User ID of the administrator who last modified this member. | | ex | string | Member specific extension string. | Note that nickname , faceURL , and roleLevel are strictly scoped to the specified group and do not alter the user's global profile. Browse by task | Task | Guide | | | | | Create & update group profiles | Create a group /sdk/react native/group/create group , Update group profile /sdk/react native/group/update group profile , Set group announcement /sdk/react native/group/set group announcement , Set group extension /sdk/react native/group/set group extension | | Manage permissions & verification | Set group join verification /sdk/react native/group/set group join verification , Set member profile access /sdk/react native/group/set group member profile access , Set group member friend permission /sdk/react native/group/set group member friend permission | | Join, leave, or dismiss groups | Join a group /sdk/react native/group/join group , Quit a group /sdk/react native/group/quit group , Dismiss a group /sdk/react native/group/dismiss group | | Query groups | Get specified groups info /sdk/react native/group/retrieving groups/get specified groups info , Get joined group list by page /sdk/react native/group/retrieving groups/get joined group list page , Search groups /sdk/react native/group/retrieving groups/search groups | | Review group applications | Get received group applications /sdk/react native/group/group applications/get group application list as recipient , Get sent group applications /sdk/react native/group/group applications/get group application list as applicant | | Query & manage members | Get group member list by page /sdk/react native/group/retrieving group members/get group member list , Invite users to group /sdk/react native/group/managing group members/invite user to group , Kick group member /sdk/react native/group/managing group members/kick group member , Set member role level /sdk/react native/group/managing group members/set group member role level , Transfer group ownership /sdk/react native/group/managing group members/transfer group owner | | Manage muting | Mute entire group /sdk/react native/group/change group mute , Mute a group member /sdk/react native/group/managing group members/change group member mute | Listen for group changes Group membership additions, removals, profile modifications, and dissolutions trigger OnJoinedGroupAdded , OnJoinedGroupDeleted , OnGroupInfoChanged , and OnGroupDismissed : const handleJoinedGroupAdded = group: GroupItem = // Add group to joined groups list ; const handleJoinedGroupDeleted = group: GroupItem = // Remove group matching group.groupID ; const handleGroupInfoChanged = group: GroupItem = // Update group properties matching group.groupID ; const handleGroupDismissed = group: GroupItem = // Remove or disable dismissed group matching group.groupID ; // Register listeners OpenIMSDK.on OpenIMEvent.OnJoinedGroupAdded, handleJoinedGroupAdded ; OpenIMSDK.on OpenIMEvent.OnJoinedGroupDeleted, handleJoinedGroupDeleted ; OpenIMSDK.on OpenIMEvent.OnGroupInfoChanged, handleGroupInfoChanged ; OpenIMSDK.on OpenIMEvent.OnGroupDismissed, handleGroupDismissed ; // Remove listeners OpenIMSDK.off OpenIMEvent.OnJoinedGroupAdded, handleJoinedGroupAdded ; OpenIMSDK.off OpenIMEvent.OnJoinedGroupDeleted, handleJoinedGroupDeleted ; OpenIMSDK.off OpenIMEvent.OnGroupInfoChanged, handleGroupInfoChanged ; OpenIMSDK.off OpenIMEvent.OnGroupDismissed, handleGroupDismissed ; Unregister these listeners when the group view unmounts, the user signs out, or accounts switch. Member updates are covered in Get group member list by page /sdk/react native/group/retrieving group members/get group member list , and application events in Get received group applications /sdk/react native/group/group applications/get group application list as recipient .

title: Create a group
description: Create a new group with initial members, administrators, and owner using the OpenIM React Native SDK.
keywords: sdk react-native v4 sdk react-native group create-group
content: Create a new group chat and configure initial members, administrators, and the group owner: const group = await OpenIMSDK.createGroup memberUserIDs: 'user 003', 'user 004' , adminUserIDs: 'user 002' , ownerUserID: currentUserID, groupInfo: groupName: 'Project Team', groupType: GroupType.WorkingGroup, faceURL: 'https://example.com/group.png', , ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | memberUserIDs | string | Yes | List of user IDs for initial regular members. | | adminUserIDs | string | No | List of user IDs designated as initial administrators. | | ownerUserID | string | No | User ID of the group owner; defaults to the authenticated user if omitted. | | groupInfo | Partial | Yes | Initial group metadata object, including groupName , groupType , and faceURL . | Do not duplicate user IDs across member, admin, and owner arrays. Specify GroupType.WorkingGroup for standard working groups. Return value Resolves to the newly created GroupItem object. Use the returned groupID to open the group conversation or navigate to the chat room. Upon group creation, the creator and initial members receive the OnJoinedGroupAdded event. Merge the new group into your joined group list keyed by groupID , and track member statuses with the composite key groupID:userID . For event listeners, see Group overview /sdk/react native/group/overview group .

title: Update group profile
description: Update group name, description, and avatar using the OpenIM React Native SDK.
keywords: sdk react-native v4 sdk react-native group update-group-profile
content: Update essential group attributes—including name, description, and avatar image. Pass only the properties to be modified: await OpenIMSDK.setGroupInfo groupID, groupName: groupName.trim , introduction: introduction.trim , faceURL, ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | groupID | string | Yes | Target group ID to update. | | groupName | string | No | New group name. | | introduction | string | No | New group description text. | | faceURL | string | No | New group avatar image URL. | Alongside groupID , provide at least one field to modify. Omitted fields remain unchanged on the server. Return value A resolved Promise confirms that the group profile fields were updated on the server. The update triggers the OnGroupInfoChanged event for all group members. Reconcile the local group record keyed by groupID . For complete event listeners, see Group overview /sdk/react native/group/overview group .

title: Set group announcement
description: Publish or update the group notice announcement text using the OpenIM React Native SDK.
keywords: sdk react-native v4 sdk react-native group set-group-announcement
content: Publish or update the announcement text for a group: await OpenIMSDK.setGroupInfo groupID, notification: announcement, ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | groupID | string | Yes | Target group ID to update. | | notification | string | Yes | Announcement notice text. Pass an empty string "" to clear the announcement. | notification is distinct from the group description introduction . Return value A resolved Promise confirms that the announcement was updated on the server. The update triggers the OnGroupInfoChanged event for all group members. Reconcile the local group item matching groupID and update its notification property. For event listener details, see Group overview /sdk/react native/group/overview group .

title: Set group extension
description: Store custom application metadata in the group ex field using the OpenIM React Native SDK.
keywords: sdk react-native v4 sdk react-native group set-group-extension
content: Attach custom application metadata to a group's ex property: await OpenIMSDK.setGroupInfo groupID, ex: JSON.stringify projectID: 'project 42', , ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | groupID | string | Yes | Target group ID to update. | | ex | string | Yes | Custom business extension string. Serialize JSON strings if saving structured objects. | Return value A resolved Promise confirms that the group extension was persisted on the server. The update triggers the OnGroupInfoChanged event. Use groupID as the key to locate the group in your state store and update its ex field. For event listener setup, see Group overview /sdk/react native/group/overview group .

title: Set group join verification
description: Configure verification requirements for group applications and invitations with the OpenIM React Native SDK.
keywords: sdk react-native v4 sdk react-native group set-group-join-verification
content: Configure the verification policy required for incoming join requests and member invitations: await OpenIMSDK.setGroupInfo groupID, needVerification: GroupVerificationType.AllNeed, ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | groupID | string | Yes | Target group ID to update. | | needVerification | GroupVerificationType | Yes | Group verification policy enum. | Verification policy options: | Enum value | Value | Description | | | | | | GroupVerificationType.ApplyNeedInviteNot | 0 | Direct applications require approval; member invitations join directly. | | GroupVerificationType.AllNeed | 1 | Applications and regular member invitations both require approval; owner and admin invites join directly. | | GroupVerificationType.AllNot | 2 | Open group: applications and invitations join directly without approval. | Return value A resolved Promise confirms that the join verification policy was updated on the server. The update triggers the OnGroupInfoChanged event. Use groupID to update the needVerification property of the group in your state store. For event details, see Group overview /sdk/react native/group/overview group .

title: Set member profile access
description: Configure whether members can inspect each others profile details inside a group with the OpenIM React Native SDK.
keywords: sdk react-native v4 sdk react-native group set-group-member-profile-access
content: Control whether regular members have permission to view other members' profile details within the group: await OpenIMSDK.setGroupInfo groupID, lookMemberInfo: AllowType.NotAllowed, ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | groupID | string | Yes | Target group ID to update. | | lookMemberInfo | AllowType | Yes | Member profile access permission setting. | Access options: | Enum value | Value | Description | | | | | | AllowType.Allowed | 0 | Allow members to view other members' profiles. | | AllowType.NotAllowed | 1 | Disallow regular members from viewing other members' profiles. | This setting controls profile viewing access and operates independently of Set group member friend permission /sdk/react native/group/set group member friend permission . Return value A resolved Promise confirms that the profile visibility setting was updated on the server. The update triggers the OnGroupInfoChanged event. Use groupID to update the lookMemberInfo property of the group in local state. For full event listeners, see Group overview /sdk/react native/group/overview group .

title: Set group member friend permission
description: Configure whether members can send friend requests to each other from within a group using the OpenIM React Native SDK.
keywords: sdk react-native v4 sdk react-native group set-group-member-friend-permission
content: Control whether group members are permitted to send friend requests to each other directly from the group member card: await OpenIMSDK.setGroupInfo groupID, applyMemberFriend: AllowType.NotAllowed, ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | groupID | string | Yes | Target group ID to update. | | applyMemberFriend | AllowType | Yes | Policy controlling inter member friend requests. | Permission options: | Enum value | Value | Description | | | | | | AllowType.Allowed | 0 | Members may send friend requests to fellow group members. | | AllowType.NotAllowed | 1 | Restrict members from sending friend requests from within this group. | This setting controls the friend request shortcut inside the group and is independent of Set member profile access /sdk/react native/group/set group member profile access . Return value A resolved Promise confirms that the inter member friendship policy was updated on the server. The change triggers the OnGroupInfoChanged event. Use groupID to locate the group in your state store and update applyMemberFriend . For event details, see Group overview /sdk/react native/group/overview group .

title: Mute entire group
description: Enable or disable group-wide muting with optional bypass users using the OpenIM React Native SDK.
keywords: sdk react-native v4 sdk react-native group change-group-mute
content: Toggle group wide muting to silence regular members in a group: await OpenIMSDK.changeGroupMute groupID, isMute: true, muteBypassUserIDs: serviceAccountUserID , ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | groupID | string | Yes | Target group ID to mute or unmute. | | isMute | boolean | Yes | Set true to enable group wide muting, or false to disable. | | muteBypassUserIDs Commercial | string | No | List of member user IDs permitted to speak even when muting is active. | Do not pass all group members into muteBypassUserIDs . Group owners and administrators bypass muting automatically based on server permissions. Return value A resolved Promise confirms that the group mute setting was applied on the server. The update triggers the OnGroupInfoChanged event. Use groupID to update the group's mute status and bypass list in your local state store. For full event listeners, see Group overview /sdk/react native/group/overview group .

title: Join a group
description: Apply to join a group with application notes and join source using the OpenIM React Native SDK.
keywords: sdk react-native v4 sdk react-native group join-group
content: Submit an application to join a group specified by groupID , providing a greeting message and join source: await OpenIMSDK.joinGroup groupID, reqMsg: 'Applying to join project discussion', joinSource: GroupJoinSource.Search, ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | groupID | string | Yes | Target group ID to join. | | reqMsg | string | Yes | Application greeting message; pass empty string "" if not provided. | | joinSource | GroupJoinSource | Yes | Source channel through which the user discovered the group. | | ex | string | No | Custom business extension string. | GroupJoinSource values: | Enum value | Value | Description | | | | | | GroupJoinSource.Invitation | 2 | Joined via an invitation link or prompt. | | GroupJoinSource.Search | 3 | Joined via search results. | | GroupJoinSource.QrCode | 4 | Joined by scanning a group QR code. | joinSource records the acquisition channel; whether verification is required depends on the group's join verification policy. Return value A resolved Promise confirms that the join application was submitted to the server. If the group allows direct entry or an administrator approves the application, the joining user receives the OnJoinedGroupAdded event. Merge the group into your joined group list keyed by groupID . For event listeners, see Group overview /sdk/react native/group/overview group .

title: Quit a group
description: Leave a joined group chat as a member or administrator using the OpenIM React Native SDK.
keywords: sdk react-native v4 sdk react-native group quit-group
content: Leave a group that the authenticated account is currently a member of: await OpenIMSDK.quitGroup groupID ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | groupID | string | Yes | Target group ID to leave. | Group owners cannot directly quit a group; the owner must first Transfer group ownership /sdk/react native/group/managing group members/transfer group owner before leaving. Return value A resolved Promise confirms that the current user has left the group on the server. Leaving the group triggers OnJoinedGroupDeleted on the departing client and OnGroupMemberDeleted for remaining members. Use groupID to remove the group from the local joined groups list and clear group conversation state. For full event listeners, see Group overview /sdk/react native/group/overview group .

title: Dismiss a group
description: Disband and permanently dismiss a group as group owner using the OpenIM React Native SDK.
keywords: sdk react-native v4 sdk react-native group dismiss-group
content: Disband and permanently dismiss a group. Only the group owner possesses permission to dismiss the group: await OpenIMSDK.dismissGroup groupID ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | groupID | string | Yes | Target group ID to dismiss. Verified against the caller's owner role by the server. | Return value A resolved Promise confirms that the group has been permanently dismissed on the server. Dismissal emits the OnGroupDismissed event to all members with the dismissed group payload. Remove the group entry identified by groupID from the joined groups list and clear local group member caches. For event listeners, see Group overview /sdk/react native/group/overview group .

title: Get specified groups info
description: Batch query detailed group information by group IDs using the OpenIM React Native SDK.
keywords: sdk react-native v4 sdk react-native group retrieving-groups get-specified-groups-info
content: Batch query detailed profile information for specified groups by their IDs: const groups = await OpenIMSDK.getSpecifiedGroupsInfo 'group 001', 'group 002', ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | groupIDs | string | Yes | Array of group IDs to query. | Return value A resolved Promise returns GroupItem matching the requested group IDs. The order of elements in the returned array is not guaranteed to match the input sequence; correlate and merge records into local state using groupID . For field definitions, see Group overview /sdk/react native/group/overview group .

title: Get joined groups
description: Retrieve all groups joined by the current account using the OpenIM React Native SDK.
keywords: sdk react-native v4 sdk react-native group retrieving-groups get-joined-group-list
content: Retrieve a snapshot of all groups joined by the current login account: const groups = await OpenIMSDK.getJoinedGroupList ; Return value A resolved Promise returns GroupItem representing all groups joined by the account. Maintain and merge group state in your local cache using groupID as the unique key. If an account belongs to a large number of groups, prefer Get joined group list by page /sdk/react native/group/retrieving groups/get joined group list page to fetch and reconcile data incrementally. For field definitions, see Group overview /sdk/react native/group/overview group .

title: Get joined group list by page
description: Query groups joined by the current account with pagination using the OpenIM React Native SDK.
keywords: sdk react-native v4 sdk react-native group retrieving-groups get-joined-group-list-page
content: Query the list of groups joined by the current login account by page: const groups = await OpenIMSDK.getJoinedGroupListPage offset: 0, count: 50, ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | offset | number | Yes | Pagination offset; pass 0 for the first page. | | count | number | Yes | Number of group records to retrieve in this batch. | To retrieve subsequent pages, set offset to the cumulative count of groups already fetched. Return value A resolved Promise returns GroupItem for the current page. If the returned array contains fewer items than count , all joined groups have been retrieved. Reconcile and maintain your group list using groupID as the unique key. For field definitions, see Group overview /sdk/react native/group/overview group .

title: Check group membership
description: Check whether the current account is a member of a specified group using the OpenIM React Native SDK.
keywords: sdk react-native v4 sdk react-native group retrieving-groups is-join-group
content: Check whether the current login account belongs to a designated group: const isJoined = await OpenIMSDK.isJoinGroup 'group 001' ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | groupID | string | Yes | Target group ID to check. | Return value A resolved Promise returns a boolean : true indicates that the current account is an active member of the group, and false indicates that the account has not joined or has left the group. This check returns a point in time local snapshot; for real time updates on group membership status, subscribe to group events documented in Group overview /sdk/react native/group/overview group .

title: Search groups
description: Search locally cached or joined groups by group ID or group name using the OpenIM React Native SDK.
keywords: sdk react-native v4 sdk react-native group retrieving-groups search-groups
content: Search locally cached or joined groups by group ID or name keywords: const groups = await OpenIMSDK.searchGroups keywordList: 'project' , isSearchGroupID: false, isSearchGroupName: true, ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | keywordList | string | Yes | Array of keyword strings to search for. | | isSearchGroupID | boolean | Yes | Whether to match group IDs against the search keywords. | | isSearchGroupName | boolean | Yes | Whether to match group names against the search keywords. | Return value A resolved Promise returns GroupItem matching the search criteria. Correlate and display group entries using groupID as the unique key. For field definitions, see Group overview /sdk/react native/group/overview group .

title: Get received group applications
description: Paginate and retrieve incoming group join applications as owner or admin using the OpenIM React Native SDK.
keywords: sdk react-native v4 sdk react-native group group-applications get-group-application-list-as-recipient
content: Group owners and administrators can paginate and query join requests received across administered groups, filtering by group IDs and handling statuses: const applications = await OpenIMSDK.getGroupApplicationListAsRecipient groupIDs: 'group 001' , handleResults: ApplicationHandleResult.Unprocessed , offset: 0, count: 20, ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | groupIDs | string | Yes | List of group IDs to filter by; pass empty array to query all administered groups. | | handleResults | number | Yes | List of handle statuses to filter by; pass empty array to match all. | | offset | number | Yes | Pagination offset starting from 0 . | | count | number | Yes | Maximum number of records to retrieve. | ApplicationHandleResult status values: | Enum value | Value | Description | | | | | | ApplicationHandleResult.Unprocessed | 0 | Pending review. | | ApplicationHandleResult.Agree | 1 | Approved. | | ApplicationHandleResult.Reject | 1 | Rejected. | Return value Resolves to an array of GroupApplicationItem for the requested page. When the returned count is less than count , the end of the list has been reached. Reconcile entries using the composite key groupID:userID . Group application properties | Field | Type | Description | | | | | | groupID | string | Target group ID of the application. | | userID | string | Applicant user ID. | | nickname | string | Applicant nickname at the time of application. | | userFaceURL | string | Applicant avatar image URL at the time of application. | | reqMsg | string | Application greeting message. | | reqTime | number | Timestamp when the application was submitted. | | joinSource | GroupJoinSource | Join discovery channel. | | handleResult | ApplicationHandleResult | Current handling status. | | handleUserID | string | User ID of the operator who processed the request. | | handledMsg | string | Operator note text. | | handledTime | number | Processing timestamp. | | groupName | string | Group name snapshot in the application record. | | groupFaceURL | string | Group avatar URL snapshot in the application record. | | groupType | GroupType | Group type. | | ownerUserID | string | Group owner user ID. | | creatorUserID | string | Group creator user ID. | | introduction | string | Group description snapshot. | | notification | string | Group announcement snapshot. | | memberCount | number | Member count snapshot. | | status | GroupStatus | Group status snapshot. | | createTime | number | Application creation timestamp in Unix milliseconds. | | ex | string | Custom extension string. | User and group profiles within application records reflect historical snapshots at submission time. To render real time profiles, query current user or group endpoints separately. Listen for group application changes Application mutations trigger OnGroupApplicationAdded , OnGroupApplicationAccepted , OnGroupApplicationRejected , or OnGroupApplicationDeleted . Reconcile state items using the composite key groupID:userID : const handleApplicationChanged = application: GroupApplicationItem = // Update application matching application.groupID and application.userID ; const handleApplicationDeleted = application: GroupApplicationItem = // Remove application matching application.groupID and application.userID ; // Register listeners OpenIMSDK.on OpenIMEvent.OnGroupApplicationAdded, handleApplicationChanged ; OpenIMSDK.on OpenIMEvent.OnGroupApplicationAccepted, handleApplicationChanged ; OpenIMSDK.on OpenIMEvent.OnGroupApplicationRejected, handleApplicationChanged ; OpenIMSDK.on OpenIMEvent.OnGroupApplicationDeleted, handleApplicationDeleted ; // Remove listeners OpenIMSDK.off OpenIMEvent.OnGroupApplicationAdded, handleApplicationChanged ; OpenIMSDK.off OpenIMEvent.OnGroupApplicationAccepted, handleApplicationChanged ; OpenIMSDK.off OpenIMEvent.OnGroupApplicationRejected, handleApplicationChanged ; OpenIMSDK.off OpenIMEvent.OnGroupApplicationDeleted, handleApplicationDeleted ; Unregister these listeners when the screen unmounts, the user logs out, or accounts switch.

title: Get sent group applications
description: Paginate and retrieve outgoing group join applications submitted by the current account using the OpenIM React Native SDK.
keywords: sdk react-native v4 sdk react-native group group-applications get-group-application-list-as-applicant
content: Paginate and query outgoing group applications submitted by the current account, with optional filters for group IDs and review statuses: const applications = await OpenIMSDK.getGroupApplicationListAsApplicant groupIDs: 'group 001' , handleResults: ApplicationHandleResult.Unprocessed, ApplicationHandleResult.Agree, ApplicationHandleResult.Reject, , offset: 0, count: 20, ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | groupIDs | string | Yes | Array of group IDs to filter by; pass an empty array to query all groups. | | handleResults | number | Yes | List of handle statuses to filter by; pass an empty array to match all. | | offset | number | Yes | Pagination offset starting from 0 . | | count | number | Yes | Maximum number of records to retrieve. | Status values correspond to ApplicationHandleResult , detailed in Get received group applications /sdk/react native/group/group applications/get group application list as recipient . Return value Resolves to an array of GroupApplicationItem for the requested page. When the returned count is less than count , the end of the list has been reached. Reconcile records using the composite key groupID:userID . For property definitions and event listeners, see Get received group applications /sdk/react native/group/group applications/get group application list as recipient .

title: Get unhandled group application count
description: Query the number of unhandled group join applications since a specified timestamp with the OpenIM React Native SDK.
keywords: sdk react-native v4 sdk react-native group group-applications get-group-application-unhandled-count
content: Query the number of group applications awaiting review by the current user since a specified timestamp: const count = await OpenIMSDK.getGroupApplicationUnhandledCount time: 0, ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | time | number | Yes | Start timestamp in Unix milliseconds. Pass 0 to count all unhandled group applications. | Return value Resolves to a number representing the unhandled group application count. This query reads a count snapshot and does not alter conversation unread counters or emit events.

title: Accept a group application
description: Approve an incoming group join request as group owner or administrator using the OpenIM React Native SDK.
keywords: sdk react-native v4 sdk react-native group group-applications accept-group-application
content: Approve an applicant's pending join request as a group owner or administrator: await OpenIMSDK.acceptGroupApplication groupID: application.groupID, fromUserID: application.userID, handleMsg: 'Approved', ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | groupID | string | Yes | Target group ID of the application. | | fromUserID | string | Yes | Applicant user ID corresponds to application.userID . | | handleMsg | string | Yes | Approval note text. Pass an empty string "" if not provided. | Return value A resolved Promise confirms that the join application was approved on the server. Approval triggers OnGroupApplicationAccepted , while the applicant joining the group emits OnGroupMemberAdded . Maintain the new member record using the composite key groupID:userID . For complete event handling, see Get received group applications /sdk/react native/group/group applications/get group application list as recipient .

title: Refuse a group application
description: Decline an incoming group join application as owner or administrator with the OpenIM React Native SDK.
keywords: sdk react-native v4 sdk react-native group group-applications refuse-group-application
content: Decline an applicant's group join request as a group owner or administrator: await OpenIMSDK.refuseGroupApplication groupID: application.groupID, fromUserID: application.userID, handleMsg: 'Application declined', ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | groupID | string | Yes | Target group ID of the application. | | fromUserID | string | Yes | Applicant user ID corresponds to application.userID . | | handleMsg | string | Yes | Reason for refusal. Pass empty string "" if not provided. | Return value A resolved Promise confirms that the refusal was recorded on the server. Refusing an application triggers the OnGroupApplicationRejected event. Update the review status of the application entry in the group application list. For full event listeners, see Get received group applications /sdk/react native/group/group applications/get group application list as recipient .

title: Delete group requests
description: Batch remove group join request history records using the OpenIM React Native SDK.
keywords: sdk react-native v4 sdk react-native group group-applications delete-group-requests
content: Batch purge group join application records from the local history list. This operation cleans up record entries only; it does not approve or reject applications: await OpenIMSDK.deleteGroupRequests fromUserID: application.userID, groupID: application.groupID, , ; Parameters Accepts an array of group request identifiers: | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | fromUserID | string | Yes | Applicant user ID corresponds to application.userID . | | groupID | string | Yes | Target group ID of the application. | Deleting records does not change the approval status of a pending request. To process applications, see Accept a group application /sdk/react native/group/group applications/accept group application and Refuse a group application /sdk/react native/group/group applications/refuse group application . Return value A resolved Promise confirms that the group request records were deleted on the server. Deletion triggers the OnGroupApplicationDeleted event. Remove items from your local application list using the composite key groupID:fromUserID . For event details, see Get received group applications /sdk/react native/group/group applications/get group application list as recipient .

title: Get group member list by page
description: Query members of a specified group by page and filter by member role using the OpenIM React Native SDK.
keywords: sdk react-native v4 sdk react-native group retrieving-group-members get-group-member-list
content: Query the member list of a designated group by page, with optional role based filtering: const members = await OpenIMSDK.getGroupMemberList groupID: 'group 001', filter: GroupMemberFilter.All, offset: 0, count: 50, ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | groupID | string | Yes | Target group ID. | | filter | GroupMemberFilter | Yes | Filter criteria for member roles. | | offset | number | Yes | Pagination offset; pass 0 for the first page. | | count | number | Yes | Number of members to retrieve in this batch. | Supported GroupMemberFilter values: | Enum value | Value | Description | | | | | | GroupMemberFilter.All | 0 | All members. | | GroupMemberFilter.Owner | 1 | Group owner only. | | GroupMemberFilter.Admin | 2 | Group administrators only. | | GroupMemberFilter.Normal | 3 | Regular members only. | | GroupMemberFilter.AdminAndNormal | 4 | Administrators and regular members. | | GroupMemberFilter.AdminAndOwner | 5 | Administrators and the group owner. | To retrieve subsequent pages, set offset to the cumulative count of members already retrieved. Return value A resolved Promise returns GroupMemberItem for the current page. If the returned array contains fewer items than count , the end of the member list has been reached. When caching or updating the member list, use the composite key groupID:userID as the unique identifier. For field definitions, see Group overview /sdk/react native/group/overview group . Listen for group member changes When a member joins, leaves, or updates profile information, the SDK emits OnGroupMemberAdded , OnGroupMemberDeleted , and OnGroupMemberInfoChanged events respectively. Reconcile incremental updates using the groupID:userID composite key: const handleMemberAdded = member: GroupMemberItem = // Append member to the local cache keyed by member.groupID and member.userID ; const handleMemberDeleted = member: GroupMemberItem = // Remove member from the local cache keyed by member.groupID and member.userID ; const handleMemberChanged = member: GroupMemberItem = // Update member attributes in the local cache keyed by member.groupID and member.userID ; // Register listeners OpenIMSDK.on OpenIMEvent.OnGroupMemberAdded, handleMemberAdded ; OpenIMSDK.on OpenIMEvent.OnGroupMemberDeleted, handleMemberDeleted ; OpenIMSDK.on OpenIMEvent.OnGroupMemberInfoChanged, handleMemberChanged ; // Clean up listeners when unmounting or switching users OpenIMSDK.off OpenIMEvent.OnGroupMemberAdded, handleMemberAdded ; OpenIMSDK.off OpenIMEvent.OnGroupMemberDeleted, handleMemberDeleted ; OpenIMSDK.off OpenIMEvent.OnGroupMemberInfoChanged, handleMemberChanged ; Always pass the identical function references to OpenIMSDK.off when unmounting screens, switching accounts, or logging out.

title: Get specified group member profiles
description: Query member profiles for specific users within a group using the OpenIM React Native SDK.
keywords: sdk react-native v4 sdk react-native group retrieving-group-members get-specified-group-members-info
content: Retrieve member profiles for designated users within a specific group: const members = await OpenIMSDK.getSpecifiedGroupMembersInfo groupID: 'group 001', userIDList: 'user 001', 'user 002' , ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | groupID | string | Yes | Target group ID. | | userIDList | string | Yes | Array of member user IDs to retrieve. | Return value A resolved Promise returns GroupMemberItem matching the requested user IDs. The order of elements in the returned array is not guaranteed to match the input ID sequence; use the composite key groupID:userID to correlate and merge member data into your local state. For field definitions, see Group overview /sdk/react native/group/overview group .

title: Check users in a group
description: Filter a list of user IDs to identify which users belong to a specific group using the OpenIM React Native SDK.
keywords: sdk react-native v4 sdk react-native group retrieving-group-members get-users-in-group
content: Filter a list of user IDs to verify which users are currently members of a designated group: const userIDs = await OpenIMSDK.getUsersInGroup groupID: 'group 001', userIDList: 'user 001', 'user 002', 'user 003' , ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | groupID | string | Yes | Target group ID. | | userIDList | string | Yes | Array of user IDs to check. | Return value A resolved Promise returns string containing the user IDs that have joined the target group. User IDs omitted from the array are not currently members of the group. To retrieve detailed profile attributes for confirmed members, see Get specified group member profiles /sdk/react native/group/retrieving group members/get specified group members info .

title: Search group members
description: Search members within a group by user ID or nickname using the OpenIM React Native SDK.
keywords: sdk react-native v4 sdk react-native group retrieving-group-members search-group-members
content: Search for group members matching user ID or group nickname keywords: const members = await OpenIMSDK.searchGroupMembers groupID: 'group 001', keywordList: 'Zhang' , isSearchUserID: false, isSearchMemberNickname: true, offset: 0, count: 50, ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | groupID | string | Yes | Target group ID. | | keywordList | string | Yes | Array of keyword strings to search for. | | isSearchUserID | boolean | Yes | Whether to match search keywords against member user IDs. | | isSearchMemberNickname | boolean | Yes | Whether to match search keywords against member group nicknames. | | offset | number | Yes | Pagination offset; pass 0 for the first page. | | count | number | Yes | Number of matching member items to retrieve. | Return value A resolved Promise returns GroupMemberItem matching the search query for the current page. If the returned array contains fewer items than count , all matching results have been retrieved. Correlate and display members using the composite key groupID:userID . For field definitions, see Group overview /sdk/react native/group/overview group .

title: Invite users to group
description: Invite one or more users to join a specified group using the OpenIM React Native SDK.
keywords: sdk react-native v4 sdk react-native group managing-group-members invite-user-to-group
content: Invite one or more users to join a designated group: await OpenIMSDK.inviteUserToGroup groupID: 'group 001', reason: 'Inviting to join project discussion', userIDList: 'user 002', 'user 003' , ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | groupID | string | Yes | Target group ID. | | reason | string | Yes | Invitation greeting or note. Pass empty string "" if not provided. | | userIDList | string | Yes | Array of user IDs to invite into the group. | Return value A resolved Promise confirms that the invitation request was submitted to the server. When invited users enter the group directly or after approval based on group policies , the OnGroupMemberAdded event is emitted. Add member items into the group member list using the composite key groupID:userID . For complete event listeners, see Get group member list by page /sdk/react native/group/retrieving group members/get group member list .

title: Remove group members
description: Remove one or more members from a specified group using the OpenIM React Native SDK.
keywords: sdk react-native v4 sdk react-native group managing-group-members kick-group-member
content: Remove one or more members from a designated group: await OpenIMSDK.kickGroupMember groupID: 'group 001', reason: 'No longer involved in the project', userIDList: 'user 002' , ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | groupID | string | Yes | Target group ID. | | reason | string | Yes | Reason for removal; pass an empty string "" if no reason is specified. | | userIDList | string | Yes | Array of user IDs to remove from the group. | Return value A resolved Promise confirms that the specified members have been removed from the group on the server. Kicking members triggers the OnGroupMemberDeleted event, delivered to both the removed members and remaining group members. Update local state by removing the corresponding member records using the composite identifier groupID:userID , and associate them with the group via groupID . For complete event listeners, see Get group member list by page /sdk/react native/group/retrieving group members/get group member list .

title: Update group member nickname
description: Update the group-specific nickname of a group member using the OpenIM React Native SDK.
keywords: sdk react-native v4 sdk react-native group managing-group-members set-group-member-nickname
content: Update a member's group specific nickname group display name : await OpenIMSDK.setGroupMemberInfo groupID: 'group 001', userID: 'user 002', nickname: 'Project owner', ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | groupID | string | Yes | Target group ID. | | userID | string | Yes | User ID of the member whose group nickname is being updated. | | nickname | string | Yes | New group specific nickname for the member. | A group nickname applies solely within the specified group and does not alter the user's account level global nickname. Return value A resolved Promise confirms that the group member nickname was successfully updated on the server. Member profile updates emit the OnGroupMemberInfoChanged event carrying the latest member record. Reconcile the member's nickname using the composite key groupID:userID . For complete event listeners, see Get group member list by page /sdk/react native/group/retrieving group members/get group member list .

title: Manage group administrators
description: Promote a group member to administrator or revoke administrator privileges using the OpenIM React Native SDK.
keywords: sdk react-native v4 sdk react-native group managing-group-members set-group-member-role-level
content: Promote a member to administrator or demote them back to regular member: await OpenIMSDK.setGroupMemberInfo groupID: 'group 001', userID: 'user 002', roleLevel: GroupMemberRole.Admin, ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | groupID | string | Yes | Target group ID. | | userID | string | Yes | User ID of the member whose role is being configured. | | roleLevel | GroupMemberRole | Yes | Target member role level. | | Enum value | Value | Description | | | | | | GroupMemberRole.Normal | 20 | Regular group member. Pass this value to revoke administrator privileges. | | GroupMemberRole.Admin | 60 | Group administrator. | | GroupMemberRole.Owner | 100 | Group owner; used solely for role identification. | Group ownership cannot be transferred by assigning GroupMemberRole.Owner . To transfer ownership, see Transfer group ownership /sdk/react native/group/managing group members/transfer group owner . Return value A resolved Promise confirms that the member's role level has been updated on the server. Role changes trigger the OnGroupMemberInfoChanged event carrying the updated member profile. Reconcile the member's role status using the composite key groupID:userID . For complete event listeners, see Get group member list by page /sdk/react native/group/retrieving group members/get group member list .

title: Update group member avatar
description: Update the avatar of a specific group member in a group using the OpenIM React Native SDK.
keywords: sdk react-native v4 sdk react-native group managing-group-members set-group-member-avatar
content: Update the avatar of a designated member within a specific group: await OpenIMSDK.setGroupMemberInfo groupID: 'group 001', userID: 'user 002', faceURL: 'https://example.com/avatar.png', ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | groupID | string | Yes | Target group ID. | | userID | string | Yes | User ID of the member whose avatar is being updated. | | faceURL | string | Yes | Member avatar URL within this specific group. | Group specific avatars apply solely within the target group. To update an account level global avatar, see Update self profile /sdk/react native/user/profile/set self info . Return value A resolved Promise confirms that the member avatar was successfully updated on the server. Member profile changes emit the OnGroupMemberInfoChanged event containing updated profile information. Match and update the corresponding member record using the composite key groupID:userID . For complete event listeners, see Get group member list by page /sdk/react native/group/retrieving group members/get group member list .

title: Set group member extension data
description: Configure custom extension fields for a specific group member using the OpenIM React Native SDK.
keywords: sdk react-native v4 sdk react-native group managing-group-members set-group-member-extension
content: Configure custom extension metadata for a designated group member: await OpenIMSDK.setGroupMemberInfo groupID: 'group 001', userID: 'user 002', ex: JSON.stringify title: 'maintainer', , ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | groupID | string | Yes | Target group ID. | | userID | string | Yes | User ID of the member whose custom extension data is being updated. | | ex | string | Yes | Custom extension string, typically a serialized JSON payload or custom business identifier. | Return value A resolved Promise confirms that the member extension field was successfully updated on the server. Member profile updates emit the OnGroupMemberInfoChanged event carrying the updated details. Reconcile the local member cache using the composite key groupID:userID . For complete event listeners, see Get group member list by page /sdk/react native/group/retrieving group members/get group member list .

title: Transfer group ownership
description: Transfer ownership of a group to another member using the OpenIM React Native SDK.
keywords: sdk react-native v4 sdk react-native group managing-group-members transfer-group-owner
content: Transfer group owner status to another existing member in the group: await OpenIMSDK.transferGroupOwner groupID: 'group 001', newOwnerUserID: 'user 002', ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | groupID | string | Yes | Target group ID. | | newOwnerUserID | string | Yes | User ID of the new group owner. This user must already be an active member of the group. | Return value A resolved Promise confirms that the group ownership transfer has completed on the server. Transferring ownership triggers OnGroupMemberInfoChanged notifications for both the former and new owners, as well as an OnGroupInfoChanged notification reflecting the group's new ownerUserID . Update local member records using the composite identifier groupID:userID , and update the group profile keyed by groupID . For complete event listeners, see Get group member list by page /sdk/react native/group/retrieving group members/get group member list .

title: Mute a group member
description: Mute or unmute an individual group member for a specified duration using the OpenIM React Native SDK.
keywords: sdk react-native v4 sdk react-native group managing-group-members change-group-member-mute
content: Silence an individual group member for a set duration, or pass 0 to unmute: await OpenIMSDK.changeGroupMemberMute groupID: 'group 001', userID: 'user 002', mutedSeconds: 3600, ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | groupID | string | Yes | Target group ID. | | userID | string | Yes | Member user ID to mute or unmute. | | mutedSeconds | number | Yes | Mute duration in seconds; pass 0 to lift the mute immediately. | Return value A resolved Promise confirms that the member muting status was updated on the server. The update triggers OnGroupMemberInfoChanged carrying the member's latest attributes, including muteEndTime . Reconcile member status using the composite key groupID:userID . For complete event listeners, see Get group member list by page /sdk/react native/group/retrieving group members/get group member list .

title: Message overview
description: Learn about the OpenIM React Native SDK message model, message lifecycle, and message event listeners.
keywords: sdk react-native v4 sdk react-native message overview-message
content: OpenIM React Native SDK represents every message using the MessageItem structure. Creating a message creates a client side MessageItem ready to be dispatched; to send it to a one to one user or a group, call the appropriate sending API. Incoming messages, queries, and lifecycle state changes deletion, revocation, modification, read receipts are processed through their respective APIs and event listeners. Message lists rely on clientMsgID as the primary identifier to deduplicate, update, and locate individual messages. Note that MessageItem does not contain a conversationID property; obtain the message's conversation context from active conversation state, history query parameters, or event metadata. Message lifecycle workflow | Stage | Capability | Description | | | | | | Create | create Message | Initializes a local MessageItem instance ready for sending without calling the server. | | Send | Send message /sdk/react native/message/sending messages/send message , Send uploaded media message /sdk/react native/message/sending messages/send message not oss | Dispatches the message to a one to one or group conversation. | | Receive | Message events | Receives real time, offline, and online only incoming messages. | | Query | History, lookup by ID, search | Retrieves and paginates historical messages from local cache and server. | | State changes | Revoke, delete, modify, read receipts | Reconciles message status transitions via API results and incremental events. | MessageItem structure All creation, transmission, reception, and query APIs return MessageItem objects. Common core properties include: | Field | Type | Description | | | | | | clientMsgID | string | Unique client generated message ID, used for deduplication, updates, and indexing. | | serverMsgID | string | Unique server assigned message ID. | | sessionType | SessionType | Conversation type, distinguishing one to one chats from group chats. | | sendID | string | Sender user ID. | | recvID | string | Recipient user ID for one to one messages. | | groupID | string | Target group ID for group messages. | | contentType | MessageType | Message content type, determining which payload element to render. | | createTime | number | Timestamp when the message object was created. | | sendTime | number | Timestamp when the message was dispatched. | | seq | number | Server assigned message sequence number. | | senderPlatformID | Platform | Platform identifier of the sending client. | | status | MessageStatus | Transmission status of the message. | | isRead | boolean | Read receipt state for the message. | | senderNickname | string | Display nickname of the sender. | | senderFaceUrl | string | Avatar URL of the sender. | | offlinePush | OfflinePush | Offline push notification payload configuration. | | content | string | Serialized message payload. For UI rendering, read the specific element corresponding to contentType . | | ex | string | Custom global extension field synchronized across clients. | | localEx | string | Custom local only extension string stored exclusively on the current device. | Message content payloads are stored in specific element fields matching contentType : | Content payload | Field | | | | | Text, rich text, and Markdown | textElem , advancedTextElem , markdownTextElem | | Image, audio, video, and file | pictureElem , soundElem , videoElem , fileElem | | Mention @ message | atTextElem | | Quote reply message | quoteElem | | Merged forward | mergeElem | | Business card, location, and face/sticker | cardElem , locationElem , faceElem | | Custom business message | customElem | | System notification, typing indicator, attached info | notificationElem , typingElem , attachedInfoElem | All payload elements are optional fields on MessageItem . Inspect contentType first to determine which element to parse and render. Create and send messages Invoke the dedicated creation method to construct a MessageItem , then invoke the appropriate sending API. Use Send message /sdk/react native/message/sending messages/send message when the SDK handles uploading local media files; use Send uploaded media message /sdk/react native/message/sending messages/send message not oss when media files already have pre uploaded remote URLs. | Content type | Guide | | | | | Text and rich text | Create text message /sdk/react native/message/creating messages/create text message , Create rich text message /sdk/react native/message/creating messages/create advanced text message | | Mention @ | Create @ message /sdk/react native/message/creating messages/create text at message | | Image, audio, video, and file | Create image message from file /sdk/react native/message/creating messages/create image message by file , Create audio message from file /sdk/react native/message/creating messages/create sound message by file , Create video message from file /sdk/react native/message/creating messages/create video message by file , Create file message from file /sdk/react native/message/creating messages/create file message by file | | Business card, location, and face | Create card message /sdk/react native/message/creating messages/create card message , Create location message /sdk/react native/message/creating messages/create location message , Create face message /sdk/react native/message/creating messages/create face message | | Reply, forward, and merged forward | Create quote message /sdk/react native/message/creating messages/create quote message , Create forward message /sdk/react native/message/creating messages/create forward message , Create merger message /sdk/react native/message/creating messages/create merger message | | Custom message | Create custom message /sdk/react native/message/creating messages/create custom message | Capabilities by task | Task | Guide | | | | | Receive real time, offline, and online only messages | Receive messages /sdk/react native/message/receiving messages/receive messages | | Receive custom business messages | Receive custom business messages /sdk/react native/message/receiving messages/receive custom business messages | | Load message history or message context | Load older messages /sdk/react native/message/retrieving messages/load older messages , Load message context /sdk/react native/message/retrieving messages/load message context | | Find or search messages by ID | Find messages by ID /sdk/react native/message/retrieving messages/find messages by id , Search messages /sdk/react native/message/searching messages/search messages | | Delete, revoke, or modify messages | Delete saved messages /sdk/react native/message/managing messages/delete saved messages , Revoke a message /sdk/react native/message/managing messages/revoke a message , Modify a message /sdk/react native/message/managing messages/modify a message | | Manage device local message data | Delete local message /sdk/react native/message/managing messages/delete local message , Set message local extension /sdk/react native/message/managing messages/set message local ex | | Report or query group read receipts | Send group read receipts /sdk/react native/message/managing read status/send group read receipts , Get group message readers /sdk/react native/message/managing read status/get group message readers | | Report or query typing status | Update typing status /sdk/react native/message/composing messages/check speech to text , Transcribe audio /sdk/react native/message/composing messages/transcribe audio | Event handling Complete event listener implementations and registration patterns are documented on their dedicated pages: New messages, offline messages, and online only messages: OnRecvNewMessage , OnRecvOfflineNewMessage , OnRecvOnlineOnlyMessage . See Receive messages /sdk/react native/message/receiving messages/receive messages . Custom business messages: OnRecvCustomBusinessMessage . See Receive custom business messages /sdk/react native/message/receiving messages/receive custom business messages . Message deletion: OnMsgDeleted . See Delete saved messages /sdk/react native/message/managing messages/delete saved messages . Message revocation: OnNewRecvMessageRevoked . See Revoke a message /sdk/react native/message/managing messages/revoke a message . Message modification: OnMessageModified . See Modify a message /sdk/react native/message/managing messages/modify a message . Group message read receipts: OnRecvGroupReadReceipt . See Send group read receipts /sdk/react native/message/managing read status/send group read receipts . Typing status changes: OnInputStatusChanged . See Change input states /sdk/react native/message/composing messages/change input states .

title: Create text message
description: Construct a basic plain-text message using the OpenIM React Native SDK.
keywords: sdk react-native v4 sdk react-native message creating-messages create-text-message
content: Construct a standard plain text chat message: const message = await OpenIMSDK.createTextMessage 'Hello, welcome to the discussion.' ; Parameters Supply the plain text message string as the sole argument. Return value A resolved Promise returns the initialized MessageItem object with message body populated in textElem . This method builds the message structure strictly in client memory; it does not dispatch messages to the server or trigger lifecycle events. After initialization, invoke Send message /sdk/react native/message/sending messages/send message to deliver it to a one to one or group conversation.

title: Create @ message
description: Construct a mention (@) message for group conversations using the OpenIM React Native SDK.
keywords: sdk react-native v4 sdk react-native message creating-messages create-text-at-message
content: Construct a mention @ message in a group conversation. Ensure mention tokens embedded in text align with the user IDs provided in atUserIDList . const message = await OpenIMSDK.createTextAtMessage text: '@user 001 please review the release checklist.', atUserIDList: 'user 001' , atUsersInfo: atUserID: 'user 001', groupNickname: 'Taylor', , , ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | text | string | Yes | Body text containing mention tags. | | atUserIDList | string | Yes | Array of user IDs mentioned in the message. | | atUsersInfo | AtUsersInfoItem | No | Member display attributes in the group, including atUserID and groupNickname . | | message | MessageItem | No | Optional referenced original message for combined mention and quote replies. | Return value A resolved Promise returns the initialized MessageItem object with mention attributes stored in atTextElem . This method builds the message structure strictly in client memory; it does not dispatch messages to the server or trigger lifecycle events. After initialization, invoke Send message /sdk/react native/message/sending messages/send message to deliver it to a group conversation.

title: Create custom message
description: Construct a custom business message with arbitrary structured payload using the OpenIM React Native SDK.
keywords: sdk react-native v4 sdk react-native message creating-messages create-custom-message
content: Construct a custom business message with arbitrary structured payloads: Both the sending and receiving applications must align on serialization schemas for data and extension . const message = await OpenIMSDK.createCustomMessage data: JSON.stringify type: 'task', taskID: 'task 42' , extension: JSON.stringify version: 1 , description: 'Task Card', ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | data | string | Yes | Business payload string, typically serialized JSON. | | extension | string | Yes | Custom extension payload string. | | description | string | Yes | Message summary text, often displayed as fallback preview text on older client versions. | Return value A resolved Promise returns the initialized MessageItem object with payload attributes stored in customElem . This method builds the message structure strictly in client memory; it does not dispatch messages to the server or trigger lifecycle events. After initialization, invoke Send message /sdk/react native/message/sending messages/send message to deliver it to a one to one or group conversation. For server push notifications outside chat conversations, see Receive custom business messages /sdk/react native/message/receiving messages/receive custom business messages .

title: Create image message from file
description: Construct an image message from a local file path using the OpenIM React Native SDK.
keywords: sdk react-native v4 sdk react-native message creating-messages create-image-message-by-file
content: Construct an image message from a local image file on the device filesystem: const message = await OpenIMSDK.createImageMessageFromFullPath imagePath ; Parameters Supply imagePath as the absolute local filesystem path to the image file. Return value A resolved Promise returns the initialized MessageItem object with image details populated in pictureElem . This method builds the message structure strictly in client memory; it does not dispatch messages to the server or trigger lifecycle events. After initialization, invoke Send message /sdk/react native/message/sending messages/send message to deliver it to a conversation; the SDK automatically uploads the local image and generates thumbnail snapshots during transmission.

title: Create image message from URL
description: Construct an image message using pre-uploaded remote image metadata and URLs using the OpenIM React Native SDK.
keywords: sdk react-native v4 sdk react-native message creating-messages create-image-message-by-url
content: Construct an image message using remote URLs and dimensions from pre uploaded image assets: The original image, high resolution preview, and thumbnail can share the same descriptor object or use separate URLs tailored for specific resolutions. const picture = uuid: 'image 001', type: 'image/jpeg', size: 120000, width: 1280, height: 720, url: 'https://www.example.com/picture.png', ; const message = await OpenIMSDK.createImageMessageByURL sourcePicture: picture, bigPicture: picture, snapshotPicture: picture, sourcePath: '', ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | sourcePicture | PicBaseInfo | Yes | Original image resource metadata. | | bigPicture | PicBaseInfo | Yes | High resolution image resource metadata. | | snapshotPicture | PicBaseInfo | Yes | Thumbnail image resource metadata. | | sourcePath | string | Yes | Local file path; pass empty string "" when using remote only assets. | Each PicBaseInfo object contains uuid , type , size , width , height , and url , representing unique identifier, MIME type, file size in bytes, pixel dimensions, and remote HTTP URL respectively. Return value A resolved Promise returns the initialized MessageItem object with image details stored in pictureElem . This method builds the message structure strictly in client memory; it does not dispatch messages to the server or trigger lifecycle events. After initialization, invoke Send uploaded media message /sdk/react native/message/sending messages/send message not oss to deliver it directly without re uploading media files.

title: Create video message from URL

content: Construct a video message using remote metadata from pre uploaded video and thumbnail resources: const message = await OpenIMSDK.createVideoMessageByURL videoPath: '', duration: 36, videoType: 'video/mp4', videoUUID: 'video 001', videoUrl: 'https://www.example.com/video.mp4', videoSize: 820000, snapshotPath: '', snapshotUUID: 'cover 001', snapshotSize: 42000, snapshotUrl: 'https://www.example.com/snapshot.png', snapshotWidth: 1280, snapshotHeight: 720, snapShotType: 'image/jpeg', ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | videoPath | string | Yes | Local video path; pass empty string "" when using remote only assets. | | duration | number | Yes | Video playback duration in seconds. | | videoType | string | Yes | Video MIME type e.g. 'video/mp4' . | | videoUUID | string | Yes | Unique resource identifier for the video asset. | | videoUrl | string | Yes | Remote network URL where the video file is hosted. | | videoSize | number | Yes | Video file size in bytes. | | snapshotPath | string | Yes | Local thumbnail path; pass empty string "" when using remote only assets. | | snapshotUUID | string | Yes | Unique resource identifier for the thumbnail asset. | | snapshotUrl | string | Yes | Remote network URL where the thumbnail snapshot is hosted. | | snapshotSize | number | Yes | Thumbnail file size in bytes. | | snapshotWidth | number | Yes | Width of the snapshot in pixels. | | snapshotHeight | number | Yes | Height of the snapshot in pixels. | | snapShotType | string | No | Thumbnail MIME type e.g. 'image/jpeg' . | Return value A resolved Promise returns the initialized MessageItem object with remote video and thumbnail attributes stored in videoElem . This method builds the message structure strictly in client memory; it does not dispatch messages to the server or trigger lifecycle events. After initialization, invoke Send uploaded media message /sdk/react native/message/sending messages/send message not oss to deliver it to a conversation without repeating file uploads.

content: Construct a contact card message representing a user profile: const message = await OpenIMSDK.createCardMessage userID: 'user 002', nickname: 'Alex', faceURL: 'https://example.com/avatar.png', ex: '', ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | userID | string | Yes | User ID referenced on the contact card. | | nickname | string | Yes | Display nickname shown on the card. | | faceURL | string | Yes | Avatar URL shown on the card. | | ex | string | Yes | Custom extension string; pass empty string "" if not provided. | Return value A resolved Promise returns the initialized MessageItem object with contact details populated in cardElem . title: Send message
description: Send a message to a one-to-one or group conversation with automatic media upload using the OpenIM React Native SDK.
keywords: sdk react-native v4 sdk react-native message sending-messages send-message
content: Dispatch a MessageItem constructed by a message creation method to a designated one to one or group conversation: When sending image, audio, video, or file messages created with local filesystem paths, the SDK automatically uploads the media files prior to dispatch. If media files are already hosted on your own server or object storage and created via URL, use Send uploaded media message /sdk/react native/message/sending messages/send message not oss . const sentMessage = await OpenIMSDK.sendMessage recvID: receiverUserID, groupID: '', message, ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | recvID | string | Conditional | Recipient user ID for one to one chats; pass an empty string "" for group chats. | | groupID | string | Conditional | Target group ID for group chats; pass an empty string "" for one to one chats. | | message | MessageItem | Yes | Message object generated by a message creation method. | | offlinePushInfo | OfflinePush | No | Custom offline push notification title, content, and passthrough payload. | | isOnlineOnly | boolean | No | Whether to deliver solely to currently online clients without storing in server offline history. | Return value A resolved Promise returns the dispatched MessageItem containing server assigned properties such as serverMsgID , sendTime , and updated status . State changes and lifecycle phases 1. Promise resolution : Indicates the message has been written to the local database and accepted by the OpenIM server dispatch queue. It does not signify that the counterparty has received or read the message. 2. Event arrival : During media uploads, the SDK periodically emits SendMessageProgress events. When the counterparty receives or reads the message, corresponding delivery or read receipt events are triggered. 3. Re query reconciliation : If disconnected or encountering timeout errors, invoke Load older messages /sdk/react native/message/retrieving messages/load older messages upon reconnecting to verify the final message status. Always use clientMsgID as the unique key to transition message state from "sending" to "success" or "failed" in local UI state. Listen for media upload progress Track upload progress when dispatching large files, high resolution videos, or audio: interface SendMessageProgressPayload clientMsgID: string; progress: number; const handleSendMessageProgress = clientMsgID, progress, : SendMessageProgressPayload = // Locate the pending message by clientMsgID and update UI upload percentage ; // Register listener OpenIMSDK.on OpenIMEvent.SendMessageProgress, handleSendMessageProgress ; // Unregister listener on cleanup OpenIMSDK.off OpenIMEvent.SendMessageProgress, handleSendMessageProgress ; Unregister the listener using the same function reference when unmounting screens or signing out.

title: Send uploaded media message
description: Send a pre-uploaded media message using remote URLs without triggering SDK file upload using the OpenIM React Native SDK.
keywords: sdk react-native v4 sdk react-native message sending-messages send-message-not-oss
content: Send an image, audio, video, or file message that already contains accessible remote URLs: When your application hosts media assets on a private cloud or has completed file uploads independently, use this method to dispatch messages directly, bypassing the SDK's internal file upload workflow. const sentMessage = await OpenIMSDK.sendMessageNotOss recvID: receiverUserID, groupID: '', message: uploadedMessage, ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | recvID | string | Conditional | Recipient user ID for one to one chats; pass an empty string "" for group chats. | | groupID | string | Conditional | Target group ID for group chats; pass an empty string "" for one to one chats. | | message | MessageItem | Yes | Message object constructed via URL based message creation methods. | | offlinePushInfo | OfflinePush | No | Custom offline push notification title, content, and passthrough payload. | | isOnlineOnly | boolean | No | Whether to deliver solely to currently online clients without storing in server offline history. | Return value A resolved Promise returns the dispatched MessageItem containing server assigned fields including serverMsgID , sendTime , and updated status . State changes and lifecycle phases 1. Promise resolution : Indicates the message with remote URLs has been written to local storage and delivered to the server queue. 2. Event arrival : Because the media asset is already hosted remotely, no upload progress events are triggered. Recipient clients receive normal incoming message notifications. 3. Re query reconciliation : In offline or uncertain network conditions, re query conversation history via Load older messages /sdk/react native/message/retrieving messages/load older messages . Always reconcile local message status using clientMsgID . For local filesystem assets requiring automatic SDK uploads, use Send message /sdk/react native/message/sending messages/send message .

title: Receive messages
description: Listen for real-time incoming messages, offline messages, and online-only messages using the OpenIM React Native SDK.
keywords: sdk react-native v4 sdk react-native message receiving-messages receive-messages
content: When new messages arrive in a conversation, the SDK dispatches the corresponding MessageItem in real time via message events across three primary scenarios: OnRecvNewMessage : Standard incoming messages received while connected online applies to both one to one and group chats . OnRecvOfflineNewMessage : Historical offline messages retrieved in batches upon reconnecting to the server. OnRecvOnlineOnlyMessage : Ephemeral instant messages flagged for online only delivery by the sender or server these messages are not persisted to offline history . const handleNewMessage = message: MessageItem = // Identify the target conversation and deduplicate by message.clientMsgID ; const handleOfflineNewMessage = message: MessageItem = // Batch process offline messages, deduplicating by message.clientMsgID ; const handleOnlineOnlyMessage = message: MessageItem = // Handle transient online notifications or typing signals ; // Register listeners OpenIMSDK.on OpenIMEvent.OnRecvNewMessage, handleNewMessage ; OpenIMSDK.on OpenIMEvent.OnRecvOfflineNewMessage, handleOfflineNewMessage ; OpenIMSDK.on OpenIMEvent.OnRecvOnlineOnlyMessage, handleOnlineOnlyMessage ; // Unregister listeners on cleanup OpenIMSDK.off OpenIMEvent.OnRecvNewMessage, handleNewMessage ; OpenIMSDK.off OpenIMEvent.OnRecvOfflineNewMessage, handleOfflineNewMessage ; OpenIMSDK.off OpenIMEvent.OnRecvOnlineOnlyMessage, handleOnlineOnlyMessage ; Client state reconciliation When receiving incoming messages: 1. Identify the target conversation context e.g. from the active chat view or session metadata . 2. Deduplicate and merge messages into your local message cache using clientMsgID as the primary key to prevent duplicate entries caused by network retries or multi device synchronization. 3. Always unregister event listeners using identical function references when unmounting chat components, logging out, or switching accounts.

title: Receive custom business messages
description: Listen for custom business notifications and server push signals using the OpenIM React Native SDK.
keywords: sdk react-native v4 sdk react-native message receiving-messages receive-custom-business-messages
