content: When the server dispatches non chat administrative notifications such as system wide broadcasts, order status updates, or marketing alerts through management endpoints, the SDK emits the OnRecvCustomBusinessMessage event. Unlike standard chat messages, the event payload is raw business data typically a JSON string , rather than a MessageItem object. For in conversation custom chat messages exchanged between users, see Receive messages /sdk/react native/message/receiving messages/receive messages . const handleCustomBusinessMessage = businessData: string = try const payload = JSON.parse businessData ; // Process business notification e.g., refresh global badge or display banner catch error console.error 'Failed to parse custom business payload:', error ; ; // Register listener OpenIMSDK.on OpenIMEvent.OnRecvCustomBusinessMessage, handleCustomBusinessMessage, ; // Unregister listener OpenIMSDK.off OpenIMEvent.OnRecvCustomBusinessMessage, handleCustomBusinessMessage, ; Validate payload structures and signatures according to your application protocol before handling data. Always unregister the listener using the same function reference when unmounting components or signing out.

title: Set the app badge count
description: Synchronize the app's current unread count with the OpenIMClientSDK push badge state.
keywords: sdk react-native v4 sdk react-native message set-app-badge
content: Report the total unread message count currently displayed by the application to the OpenIM SDK to synchronize badge state with remote push notification services: await OpenIMSDK.setAppBadge totalUnreadCount ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | totalUnreadCount | number | Yes | Total unread message count currently displayed by the application. Must be a non negative integer. | Return value A resolved Promise confirms that the SDK accepted and updated the badge count. This method only synchronizes the total unread count with the SDK and remote push notification services; it does not directly alter the unread status of individual conversations. To display a numeric badge on the mobile home screen icon iOS launcher badge or Android application icon , combine this API with native React Native badge packages such as @react native community/push notification ios or vendor push SDKs to update system launcher badges. For querying and tracking real time unread counts, see Get total unread count /sdk/react native/conversation/managing conversations/get total unread count .

title: Load older messages
description: Load historical messages backward in time with pagination using the OpenIM React Native SDK.
keywords: sdk react-native v4 sdk react-native message retrieving-messages load-older-messages
content: Page backward in time to retrieve earlier historical messages in a conversation: Pass an empty string "" for startClientMsgID when fetching the initial page. On subsequent upward scrolls, supply the clientMsgID of the earliest loaded message in the current list. const page = await OpenIMSDK.getAdvancedHistoryMessageList conversationID, startClientMsgID: oldestMessage?.clientMsgID ?? '', count: 30, viewType: ViewType.History, ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | conversationID | string | Yes | Target conversation ID. | | startClientMsgID | string | Yes | Anchor client message ID; pass an empty string "" for the initial page. | | count | number | Yes | Maximum number of messages to fetch in this batch. | | viewType | ViewType | Yes | Retrieval context; pass ViewType.History when browsing standard chat logs. | Return value A resolved Promise returns an AdvancedGetMessageResult object: | Field | Type | Description | | | | | | messageList | MessageItem | Array of historical messages for the current page, sorted chronologically. | | isEnd | boolean | Indicates whether pagination has reached the earliest message; true means no older messages exist. | | errCode | number | Status code returned for this history request. | | errMsg | string | Status message corresponding to errCode . | When merging messageList into the local conversation state, deduplicate entries by clientMsgID to prevent duplicate renders from asynchronous callbacks or network retries.

title: Load newer messages
description: Load history messages forward in time from an anchor message using the OpenIM React Native SDK.
keywords: sdk react-native v4 sdk react-native message retrieving-messages load-newer-messages
content: Page forward in time to retrieve newer messages following a designated anchor message: Use this method when a user jumps to an older historical message and scrolls downward to load subsequent conversation records. const page = await OpenIMSDK.getAdvancedHistoryMessageListReverse conversationID, startClientMsgID: anchorMessage.clientMsgID, count: 30, viewType: ViewType.History, ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | conversationID | string | Yes | Target conversation ID. | | startClientMsgID | string | Yes | Anchor client message ID from which forward pagination begins. | | count | number | Yes | Maximum number of messages to fetch in this batch. | | viewType | ViewType | Yes | Retrieval context; pass ViewType.History when browsing standard chat logs. | Return value A resolved Promise returns an AdvancedGetMessageResult object: messageList MessageItem : Array of newer messages retrieved for the current page. isEnd boolean : Indicates whether forward pagination has reached the newest message in the conversation; true means no newer messages exist. Deduplicate and merge retrieved records into the active conversation view using clientMsgID . For full response structures, see Load older messages /sdk/react native/message/retrieving messages/load older messages .

title: Find messages by ID
description: Locate specific messages by conversation ID and client message IDs using the OpenIM React Native SDK.
keywords: sdk react-native v4 sdk react-native message retrieving-messages find-messages-by-id
content: Look up specific messages by conversation ID and client message ID list: This query is ideal when jumping directly to a referenced message from search results, quoted replies, system notices, or offline push notifications. const result = await OpenIMSDK.findMessageList conversationID, clientMsgIDList: clientMsgID , , ; const targetMessage = result.findResultItems?. 0 ?.messageList?. 0 ; Parameters Supply an array of query condition objects. Each entry defines a conversation level lookup scope: | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | conversationID | string | Yes | Target conversation ID containing the messages. | | clientMsgIDList | string | Yes | Array of client message IDs to locate. | Return value A resolved Promise returns a SearchMessageResult object, where matched messages reside in findResultItems : Each entry in findResultItems contains the target conversationID and matching messageList: MessageItem . If an ID is not found locally or on the server, the corresponding item is omitted or returns an empty messageList . For complete result structures and multi criteria queries, see Search messages /sdk/react native/message/searching messages/search messages .

title: Load message context
description: Retrieve contextual messages before and after an anchor message using the OpenIM React Native SDK.
keywords: sdk react-native v4 sdk react-native message retrieving-messages load-message-context
content: Retrieve adjacent surrounding messages preceding and following a known anchor message: Use this method when a user navigates to a specific message from search results, quoted replies, or deep links to reconstruct the complete conversational context. const messageList = await OpenIMSDK.fetchSurroundingMessages startMessage: targetMessage, viewType: ViewType.Search, before: 20, after: 20, ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | startMessage | MessageItem | Yes | Reference anchor message object. | | viewType | ViewType | Yes | Context navigation mode; pass ViewType.Search when navigating from search results. | | before | number | Yes | Maximum number of earlier messages to load before the anchor. | | after | number | Yes | Maximum number of newer messages to load after the anchor. | Return value A resolved Promise returns an object containing messageList: MessageItem . Messages are sorted in ascending chronological order and include the anchor message itself. The returned count may be less than before + after + 1 if the anchor is close to conversation boundaries or adjacent messages have been deleted. Deduplicate and merge retrieved records into the active conversation view using clientMsgID .

title: Search messages
description: Search locally synchronized message records by keywords, message types, sender, and time ranges using the OpenIM React Native SDK.
keywords: sdk react-native v4 sdk react-native message searching-messages search-messages
content: Search locally synchronized message records across multiple criteria such as keywords, message types, senders, and timestamps: const result = await OpenIMSDK.searchLocalMessages conversationID, keywordList: 'release' , messageTypeList: MessageType.TextMessage , pageIndex: 1, count: 20, ; Parameters Supply one or more search keywords in keywordList . For standard search input bars, pass trimmed, non empty keyword strings. | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | conversationID | string | No | Scope search to a specific conversation ID. Pass an empty string "" to execute a global search across all conversations. | | keywordList | string | Yes | Array of keyword strings to search for. | | keywordListMatchType | number | No | Multiple keyword matching strategy: 0 matches any keyword OR ; 1 requires all keywords to match AND . Defaults to 0 . | | senderUserIDList | string | No | Array of sender user IDs to restrict search results to messages sent by these users. | | messageTypeList | MessageType | No | Array of message types e.g., text, pictures ; defaults to common chat message types. | | searchTimePosition | number | No | Search time window endpoint Unix timestamp in seconds . | | searchTimePeriod | number | No | Duration in seconds to search backward from searchTimePosition . | | pageIndex | number | No | Pagination page index, starting at 1 . | | count | number | No | Maximum number of matching message items per page. | Return value A resolved Promise returns a SearchMessageResult object: | Field | Type | Description | | | | | | totalCount | number | Total number of messages matching the search criteria. | | searchResultItems | SearchMessageResultItem | Search result items categorized and grouped by conversation. | Each SearchMessageResultItem contains conversation metadata and an array of matched messages messageList: MessageItem . When a user taps a matching message in the search results, use Load message context /sdk/react native/message/retrieving messages/load message context to navigate to the message and reconstruct surrounding conversation context. Reset pageIndex to 1 whenever query keywords or filter criteria change.

title: Update typing status
description: Send custom typing status indicator text to a one-to-one conversation recipient using the OpenIM React Native SDK.
keywords: sdk react-native v4 sdk react-native message composing-messages update-typing-status
content: Send custom typing indicator text to the counterparty in a one to one conversation: await OpenIMSDK.typingStatusUpdate recvID: receiverUserID, msgTip: 'typing…', ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | recvID | string | Yes | Recipient user ID in the target one to one conversation. | | msgTip | string | Yes | Custom typing indicator message string. | Return value A resolved Promise confirms that the custom typing status indicator was dispatched to the recipient. To synchronize typing activity automatically based on input focus events, see Change input states /sdk/react native/message/composing messages/change input states .

title: Get typing status
description: Query the current typing platforms of a user in a conversation using the OpenIM React Native SDK.
keywords: sdk react-native v4 sdk react-native message composing-messages get-typing-status
content: Query the active typing platforms of a specific user within a conversation: const platformIDs = await OpenIMSDK.getInputStates conversationID, userID, ; const isTyping = platformIDs.length 0; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | conversationID | string | Yes | Target conversation ID. | | userID | string | Yes | Target user ID whose typing status is being queried. | Return value A resolved Promise returns number containing platform IDs where the user is currently typing. An empty array indicates the user is not actively typing on any device. For real time typing notifications, subscribe to OnInputStatusChanged as documented in Change input states /sdk/react native/message/composing messages/change input states .

title: Change input states
description: Update user typing state focus within a conversation using the OpenIM React Native SDK.
keywords: sdk react-native v4 sdk react-native message composing-messages change-input-states
content: Update the current user's typing activity in a conversation. Pass focus: true when the user starts typing into the input field, and false when sending a message, losing input focus, or closing the conversation screen. await OpenIMSDK.changeInputStates conversationID, focus: true, ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | conversationID | string | Yes | Target conversation ID. | | focus | boolean | Yes | true indicates active typing; false indicates typing has stopped. | To prevent excessive network traffic, debounce repeated keystrokes rather than reporting on every individual character change. Return value A resolved Promise confirms that the typing status update was submitted to the server. Typing state transitions trigger the OnInputStatusChanged event on the recipient client. Reconcile the UI by matching conversationID and using userID to show or hide the "User is typing..." indicator. interface InputStatusChangedPayload conversationID: string; userID: string; platformIDs: number ; const handleInputStatusChanged = inputStatus: InputStatusChangedPayload = // Update typing indicator for the matching conversationID and userID ; // Register listener OpenIMSDK.on OpenIMEvent.OnInputStatusChanged, handleInputStatusChanged ; // Unregister listener on cleanup OpenIMSDK.off OpenIMEvent.OnInputStatusChanged, handleInputStatusChanged ; Always unregister listeners using identical function references when unmounting components or signing out.

title: Check speech-to-text capabilities
description: Query speech recognition constraints and supported audio formats using the OpenIM React Native SDK.
keywords: sdk react-native v4 sdk react-native message composing-messages check-speech-to-text
content: Query audio format constraints, sampling rate requirements, maximum recording duration, and file size limits supported by the active speech to text provider. To execute audio transcription, see Transcribe audio /sdk/react native/message/composing messages/transcribe audio . const capabilities = await OpenIMSDK.speechToTextCapabilities ; Return value A resolved Promise returns a SpeechToTextCapabilities object: | Field | Type | Description | | | | | | format | string | List of supported audio encoding formats. | | sampleRateHz | number | Required audio sampling rate in Hertz Hz . | | maxRecordTimeMs | number | Maximum allowed audio duration in milliseconds. | | maxFileSize | number | Maximum allowed audio file size in bytes. | | provider | string | Identification tag for the speech recognition service provider. |

title: Transcribe audio
description: Convert local audio file speech to text using the OpenIM React Native SDK.
keywords: sdk react-native v4 sdk react-native message composing-messages transcribe-audio
content: Transcribe a local audio recording into text: Pass the absolute local filesystem path accessible to the SDK. Do not pass remote HTTP URLs, Base64 strings, or uploaded storage keys. const text = await OpenIMSDK.speechToText filename ; Parameters Supply filename as the full local filesystem path of the audio file. Return value A resolved Promise returns an object containing text , representing the transcribed text string. Before transcribing, consider verifying format and duration constraints with Check speech to text capabilities /sdk/react native/message/composing messages/check speech to text . To store the transcribed result onto a local voice message, see Save local transcript /sdk/react native/message/composing messages/save local transcript .

title: Save local transcript
description: Save speech-to-text transcription results to a local voice message on the current device using the OpenIM React Native SDK.
keywords: sdk react-native v4 sdk react-native message composing-messages save-local-transcript
content: Persist audio transcription text to a locally stored voice message on the current device: Pass the updated full MessageItem object while preserving all existing properties. const updatedMessage = ...message, soundElem: ...message.soundElem, text: text: transcript, translate: message.soundElem?.text?.translate ?? , , , ; await OpenIMSDK.setMessageLocalContent conversationID, message: updatedMessage, ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | conversationID | string | Yes | Target conversation ID. | | message | MessageItem | Yes | Complete message object incorporating the updated transcription text. | Return value A resolved Promise confirms that the transcription text was successfully saved to the local SQLite database on the current device. This modification is stored strictly on the local client; it is not synchronized to remote servers and does not trigger multi device sync events. Reconcile the UI view by updating the message bubble keyed by clientMsgID within the scope of the corresponding conversationID .

title: Delete local message
description: Delete a single message from the current device local storage using the OpenIM React Native SDK.
keywords: sdk react-native v4 sdk react-native message managing-messages delete-local-message
content: Delete a single message from local device storage for a specified conversation: await OpenIMSDK.deleteMessageFromLocalStorage conversationID, clientMsgID, ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | conversationID | string | Yes | Conversation ID containing the message. | | clientMsgID | string | Yes | Client message ID to delete locally. | Return value A resolved Promise confirms that the target message has been removed from the local database on this device. This operation alters only local device data; it is not uploaded to the server, does not synchronize to other devices, and does not trigger remote deletion events. Remove the message from the local UI view using clientMsgID within the scope of conversationID . To synchronize message deletion across multiple devices or conversation participants, see Delete saved messages /sdk/react native/message/managing messages/delete saved messages .

title: Delete saved messages
description: Batch delete messages in a conversation with optional two-way synchronization using the OpenIM React Native SDK.
keywords: sdk react-native v4 sdk react-native message managing-messages delete-saved-messages
content: Batch delete multiple messages from a designated conversation: await OpenIMSDK.deleteMessages conversationID, clientMsgIDs, isSync: true, ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | conversationID | string | Yes | Conversation ID containing the messages to delete. | | clientMsgIDs | string | Yes | Array of client message IDs to delete; all must belong to the specified conversation. | | isSync | boolean | Yes | Whether to synchronize deletion to the counterparty. When true , messages are deleted for both participants; when false , messages are deleted only for the current account. | Return value A resolved Promise confirms that the message deletion request was processed on the server. When isSync is true , the deletion synchronizes to counterparties; when false , it applies only to the current account. Regardless of the setting, deletions are automatically propagated to other active devices logged into the current account. Listen for message deletion When messages are deleted, the SDK emits the OnMsgDeleted event carrying the deleted MessageItem . Remove the corresponding entry from the active conversation view using clientMsgID . const handleMessageDeleted = message: MessageItem = // Remove message from the active conversation list by message.clientMsgID ; // Register listener OpenIMSDK.on OpenIMEvent.OnMsgDeleted, handleMessageDeleted ; // Unregister listener on cleanup OpenIMSDK.off OpenIMEvent.OnMsgDeleted, handleMessageDeleted ; Always unregister listeners using identical function references when unmounting components or signing out.

title: Delete all messages of a user in a group
description: Delete all message history sent by a specific user in a group conversation using the OpenIM React Native SDK.
keywords: sdk react-native v4 sdk react-native message managing-messages delete-user-messages
content: Delete all historical messages posted by a specific user within a group conversation: This administrative action is typically initiated by group owners or managers to moderate chat logs and remove spam or abusive content. await OpenIMSDK.deleteUserAllMessagesInConv conversationID, userID, ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | conversationID | string | Yes | Target group conversation ID. | | userID | string | Yes | Target user ID whose messages will be deleted. | Return value A resolved Promise confirms that the deletion request was validated and executed on the server. Permissions are enforced according to group roles; invoking this method without administrative privileges returns an error. Listen for user message deletions When a user's messages are removed from a group, the SDK emits the OnDeleteUserAllMsgsInConv event. The callback payload provides the target conversationID and userID . Locate the active conversation and filter out all messages sent by userID . interface DeleteUserAllMsgsData conversationID: string; userID: string; const handleUserMessagesDeleted = data: DeleteUserAllMsgsData = // Locate the target conversation by data.conversationID and filter out messages from data.userID ; // Register listener OpenIMSDK.on OpenIMEvent.OnDeleteUserAllMsgsInConv, handleUserMessagesDeleted, ; // Unregister listener on cleanup OpenIMSDK.off OpenIMEvent.OnDeleteUserAllMsgsInConv, handleUserMessagesDeleted, ; Always unregister listeners using identical function references when unmounting components or signing out.

title: Revoke a message
description: Recall a previously sent message within the permitted time window using the OpenIM React Native SDK.
keywords: sdk react-native v4 sdk react-native message managing-messages revoke-a-message
content: Recall a previously sent message from a conversation: Upon successful revocation, clients in the conversation update the message bubble to display a revocation placeholder e.g., "Message was recalled" . await OpenIMSDK.revokeMessage conversationID, clientMsgID, ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | conversationID | string | Yes | Target conversation ID. | | clientMsgID | string | Yes | Client message ID of the message to revoke. | Return value A resolved Promise confirms that the revocation request was accepted and processed by the server. Revocation time constraints e.g. within 2 minutes and role permissions are validated by server policy; exceeding the limit returns an error. Listen for message revocations When a message is recalled, all clients in the conversation receive the OnNewRecvMessageRevoked event. The callback payload contains a RevokedInfo object. Locate the target message by clientMsgID and update its display state to a recalled notice. interface RevokedInfo clientMsgID: string; revokerID: string; revokerRole: number; revokerNickname: string; sessionType: number; const handleMessageRevoked = revokedInfo: RevokedInfo = // Locate the message by revokedInfo.clientMsgID and update its status to revoked ; // Register listener OpenIMSDK.on OpenIMEvent.OnNewRecvMessageRevoked, handleMessageRevoked ; // Unregister listener on cleanup OpenIMSDK.off OpenIMEvent.OnNewRecvMessageRevoked, handleMessageRevoked ; To remove a message strictly from the local device without alerting the counterparty, use Delete local message /sdk/react native/message/managing messages/delete local message .

title: Modify a message
description: Edit and update the content of an existing message using the OpenIM React Native SDK.
keywords: sdk react-native v4 sdk react-native message managing-messages modify-a-message
content: Modify the content of a previously sent message in a conversation: Use this method to correct typos or append annotations. Permitted message types, sender permissions, and editing time windows are governed by server configuration policies. const updatedMessage: MessageItem = ...message, textElem: ...message.textElem, content: editedText, , ; const modifiedMessage = await OpenIMSDK.modifyMessage conversationID, message: updatedMessage, ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | conversationID | string | Yes | Target conversation ID containing the message. | | message | MessageItem | Yes | Complete modified message object, retaining the original clientMsgID and core metadata. | Return value A resolved Promise returns the updated MessageItem confirmed by the server. Update the local message list by replacing the entry matching clientMsgID . If the modification window has expired or the sender lacks edit permissions, an error is returned. Listen for message modifications When a message is edited in a conversation, all clients receive an OnMessageModified notification. The event delivers the full updated MessageItem . Reconcile your UI by matching the message via clientMsgID . const handleMessageModified = message: MessageItem = // Locate the message by message.clientMsgID and replace it in the active conversation view ; // Register listener OpenIMSDK.on OpenIMEvent.OnMessageModified, handleMessageModified ; // Unregister listener on cleanup OpenIMSDK.off OpenIMEvent.OnMessageModified, handleMessageModified ; Always unregister listeners using identical function references when unmounting components or signing out.

title: Insert local single message
description: Insert a message directly into local storage for a one-to-one chat without sending over the network using the OpenIM React Native SDK.
keywords: sdk react-native v4 sdk react-native message managing-messages insert-local-single-message
content: Write a one to one message directly into local device database storage: This method saves the message exclusively in the local client database without transmitting network packets to the server or conversation counterparty. It is ideal for inserting local greeting prompts, service guidelines, or temporary UI placeholders. const localMessage = await OpenIMSDK.insertSingleMessageToLocalStorage message, recvID, sendID, ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | message | MessageItem | Yes | Complete message object to store locally, typically constructed via message creation methods. | | recvID | string | Yes | Recipient user ID for the one to one chat. | | sendID | string | Yes | Sender user ID, which can be the current user or a virtual system user ID. | Return value A resolved Promise returns the MessageItem written to the local database. The message is indexed locally by clientMsgID . To dispatch messages over the network to the counterparty, use Send message /sdk/react native/message/sending messages/send message .

title: Insert local group message
description: Insert a message directly into local storage for a group chat without sending over the network using the OpenIM React Native SDK.
keywords: sdk react-native v4 sdk react-native message managing-messages insert-local-group-message
content: Write a group message directly into local device database storage: This method persists the message record only in the local client database without sending it across the network to the server or other group members. It is commonly used for inserting onboarding tips, system alerts, or UI placeholder notices. const localMessage = await OpenIMSDK.insertGroupMessageToLocalStorage message, groupID, sendID, ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | message | MessageItem | Yes | Complete message object to store locally, typically constructed via message creation methods. | | groupID | string | Yes | Target group ID. | | sendID | string | Yes | Sender user ID, which can be the current user or a virtual system user ID. | Return value A resolved Promise returns the MessageItem written to the local database. The message is indexed locally by clientMsgID . To dispatch standard messages over the network to other group members, use Send message /sdk/react native/message/sending messages/send message .

title: Clear all local messages
description: Clear all message records stored locally on the current device using the OpenIM React Native SDK.
keywords: sdk react-native v4 sdk react-native message managing-messages clear-all-local-messages
content: Clear all message records stored in the local SQLite database for the current logged in account on this device: await OpenIMSDK.deleteAllMsgFromLocal ; Return value A resolved Promise confirms that all message records in the local database on the current device have been deleted. Historical messages remain preserved on the server. This is an irreversible, account level local action. Before executing, explain the impact clearly to the user and require secondary confirmation. This operation modifies only local device storage; it does not affect other active sessions or trigger multi device deletion events. Clear local conversation lists and view caches in the client UI accordingly.

title: Clear all messages
description: Clear all message records both locally and on the server for the current account using the OpenIM React Native SDK.
keywords: sdk react-native v4 sdk react-native message managing-messages clear-all-messages
content: Clear all message records for the current account across both local storage and the remote server: await OpenIMSDK.deleteAllMsgFromLocalAndSvr ; Return value A resolved Promise confirms that all message records belonging to the current account have been purged from both local databases and server side history. Messages already delivered to and stored by counterparties remain unaffected. This is an irreversible, account level operation; require explicit secondary confirmation from the user prior to execution. Once cleared, message histories are synchronized across all devices where this account is logged in. Reset all local conversation message caches and UI lists upon completion.

title: Set message local extension
description: Store custom device-local extension strings on a specific message using the OpenIM React Native SDK.
keywords: sdk react-native v4 sdk react-native message managing-messages set-message-local-ex
content: Attach custom local metadata to a specific message record stored on the current device: This field is maintained solely within the local SQLite database on the client; it is never transmitted to the server or synced to other devices. It is commonly used for caching local media playback states, audio transcript UI toggles, or draft references. await OpenIMSDK.setMessageLocalEx conversationID, clientMsgID, localEx: JSON.stringify isPlaying: false, isExpanded: true , ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | conversationID | string | Yes | Conversation ID containing the message. | | clientMsgID | string | Yes | Target client message ID. | | localEx | string | Yes | Custom local extension string, typically formatted as a JSON string for structured attributes. | Return value A resolved Promise confirms that the local extension string was written to the local database. Reconcile the local UI state by updating the localEx property of the corresponding message identified by clientMsgID .

title: Send group read receipts
description: Report read receipts for messages in a group chat using the OpenIM React Native SDK.
keywords: sdk react-native v4 sdk react-native message managing-read-status send-group-read-receipts
content: Submit read receipts in batches for messages read within a group conversation: Invoke this method when a user views incoming messages from other group members in the active chat screen. Group members receive read status updates accordingly. await OpenIMSDK.sendGroupMessageReadReceipt conversationID, clientMsgIDs, ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | conversationID | string | Yes | Target group conversation ID. | | clientMsgIDs | string | Yes | Array of client message IDs that have been read; all messages must belong to the specified group conversation. | Return value A resolved Promise confirms that the read receipt submission was accepted by the server. To reset or clear the unread counter for the current user in this conversation, invoke Mark conversation read /sdk/react native/conversation/managing conversations/mark conversation read . Listen for group read status changes When other group members view messages and report read receipts, the SDK emits the OnRecvGroupReadReceipt event. The callback payload contains GroupMessageReceiptInfo , specifying the target conversationID alongside updated read and unread counts for each message. Update UI read count badges using clientMsgID as the composite key. interface GroupMessageReceiptItem clientMsgID: string; readCount: number; unreadCount: number; interface GroupMessageReceiptInfo conversationID: string; receiptList: GroupMessageReceiptItem ; const handleGroupReadReceipt = payload: GroupMessageReceiptInfo = // Match the conversation by payload.conversationID and update read counters by clientMsgID ; // Register listener OpenIMSDK.on OpenIMEvent.OnRecvGroupReadReceipt, handleGroupReadReceipt ; // Unregister listener on cleanup OpenIMSDK.off OpenIMEvent.OnRecvGroupReadReceipt, handleGroupReadReceipt ; Always unregister listeners using identical function references when unmounting components or signing out.

title: Get group message readers
description: Query members who have or have not read a specific group message by page using the OpenIM React Native SDK.
keywords: sdk react-native v4 sdk react-native message managing-read-status get-group-message-readers
content: Query members who have read or not yet read a specific group message with pagination: Use this method to render the read/unread count badge beside a group message bubble and open the member reader list modal. const members = await OpenIMSDK.getGroupMessageReaderList conversationID, clientMsgID, filter: GroupMessageReaderFilter.Read, offset: 0, count: 50, ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | conversationID | string | Yes | Target group conversation ID. | | clientMsgID | string | Yes | Client message ID whose read status is being queried. | | filter | GroupMessageReaderFilter | Yes | Reader filter criteria. Use Read for members who have read the message, or Unread for members who have not yet read it. | | offset | number | Yes | Pagination offset; pass 0 for the first page. | | count | number | Yes | Maximum number of member records to retrieve. | Return value A resolved Promise returns GroupMemberItem for the current page. Each member is uniquely identified by the composite key groupID:userID . For member attribute definitions, see Group overview /sdk/react native/group/overview group . To load subsequent pages, increment offset by the number of members returned from previous pages.

title: Upload a file
description: Upload local files independently and obtain remote resource URLs with the OpenIM React Native SDK.
keywords: sdk react-native v4 sdk react-native file-uploads upload-file
content: Upload device local files to the OpenIMServer storage backend such as MinIO or third party cloud object storage . Upon successful upload, the SDK returns a publicly accessible resource URL, commonly used to update user avatars, configure group avatars, or pre upload media assets before creating URL based messages. const url = await OpenIMSDK.uploadFile name: 'avatar.png', contentType: 'image/png', uuid: 'avatar upload 20260827', cause: 'user avatar', filepath, ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | name | string | Yes | Target file name for the upload. | | contentType | string | Yes | MIME type of the file e.g., image/png , video/mp4 . | | uuid | string | Yes | Unique business identifier for tracking this upload task. | | cause | string | No | Business reason tag such as user avatar or group avatar . | | filepath | string | Yes | Absolute path to the local file readable within the application sandbox. | Return value Resolves to an object containing the remote URL: url: string . Use the returned url to update user profiles via Update current user profile /sdk/react native/user/profile/set self info . Or pass it to create URL based media messages and send them via Send pre uploaded media messages /sdk/react native/message/sending messages/send message not oss . Listen for upload status When uploading large files, monitor upload progress and completion events: interface UploadProgressPayload current: number; size: number; interface UploadCompletePayload data: fileSize: number; streamSize: number; storageSize: number; ; const handleUploadProgress = current, size : UploadProgressPayload = // Update upload progress percentage in UI ; const handleUploadComplete = data : UploadCompletePayload = // Handle post upload completion logic ; // Register listeners OpenIMSDK.on OpenIMEvent.UploadOnProgress, handleUploadProgress ; OpenIMSDK.on OpenIMEvent.UploadComplete, handleUploadComplete ; // Remove listeners OpenIMSDK.off OpenIMEvent.UploadOnProgress, handleUploadProgress ; OpenIMSDK.off OpenIMEvent.UploadComplete, handleUploadComplete ; Remove these listeners when the component unmounts, the user logs out, or accounts switch.

title: Audio and video calling overview
description: Understand OpenIM React Native SDK RTC signaling, room credentials, and call event boundaries.
keywords: sdk react-native v4 sdk react-native calling overview-calling
content: The OpenIM React Native SDK provides real time calling signaling APIs to initiate and handle call invitations, query room information, and synchronize call states. The SDK exclusively manages RTC signaling workflows; it does not capture or render audio/video media tracks, manage media network sockets, or draw in call UI components. When initiating or accepting a call, the SDK returns room credentials including roomID , token , and liveURL . Feed these credentials into your real time audio/video media engine such as LiveKit, WebRTC, or TRTC to join the media room, while managing local device permissions, audio routing, and UI rendering directly in your application. Call workflow 1. Initiate a direct call via Start a one to one call /sdk/react native/calling/managing calls/start single call , or a multi party call via Start a group call /sdk/react native/calling/managing calls/start group call . 2. The invitee receives the call invitation through the OnReceiveNewInvitation event, choosing either to Accept a call /sdk/react native/calling/managing calls/accept call or Reject a call /sdk/react native/calling/managing calls/reject call . 3. Upon accepting, retrieve the room credentials roomID , token , and liveURL to connect the media engine. 4. During an active call, update the UI according to invitation state, participant state, media stream state, and custom signals. 5. The caller can cancel an unanswered call via Cancel a call invitation /sdk/react native/calling/managing calls/cancel call ; any participant can terminate an active call via Hang up a call /sdk/react native/calling/managing calls/hang up call . Core data structures | Structure | Description | | | | | RtcInvite | Call invitation object containing inviter, invitees, group ID, room ID, media type, timeout, and session type. | | RtcInviteResults | Room credentials roomID , token , and liveURL returned upon initiating, accepting, or querying a call room. | | CallingRoomData | Room ID, active invitation, and participant profiles returned when querying by group ID. | | OnReceiveNewInvitationPayload | Event payload received on incoming invitations, containing invitation , optional offlinePushInfo , and participant details. | Both customData and custom signaling payloads are arbitrary business strings. You can pass JSON strings or custom serialized formats based on your application protocol. Call state reconciliation After invoking initiate, accept, reject, cancel, or hang up APIs, update the local screen state based on the method result. State changes from other users or devices arrive via push events. When reconciling call state in local storage or state managers, always use roomID as the primary identifier for the call room, and combine roomID:userID to manage individual participant states. For invitation lifecycles, participant room changes, and media stream events, see Handle call events /sdk/react native/calling/managing calls/handle call events . For application level signaling, see Send a custom signal /sdk/react native/calling/sending custom signals/send a custom signal . Browse by task | Task | Guide | | | | | Initiate calls | Start a one to one call /sdk/react native/calling/managing calls/start single call , Start a group call /sdk/react native/calling/managing calls/start group call | | Respond to invitations | Accept a call /sdk/react native/calling/managing calls/accept call , Reject a call /sdk/react native/calling/managing calls/reject call | | End or cancel calls | Cancel a call invitation /sdk/react native/calling/managing calls/cancel call , Hang up a call /sdk/react native/calling/managing calls/hang up call | | Query room information & restore state | Get a group call room /sdk/react native/calling/retrieving call information/get room by group id , Get room credentials /sdk/react native/calling/retrieving call information/get token by room id , Restore a pending invitation /sdk/react native/calling/retrieving call information/restore pending invitation | | Listen to events & custom signals | Handle call events /sdk/react native/calling/managing calls/handle call events , Send a custom signal /sdk/react native/calling/sending custom signals/send a custom signal |

title: Start a one-to-one call
description: Initiate a direct audio or video call using the OpenIM React Native SDK.
keywords: sdk react-native v4 sdk react-native calling managing-calls start-single-call
content: Initiate a direct one to one audio or video call. When the method resolves, use the returned room credentials roomID , token , and liveURL to connect your real time audio/video media engine. const roomCredentials = await OpenIMSDK.signalingInvite invitation: inviterUserID: currentUserID, inviteeUserIDList: peerUserID , groupID: '', roomID, timeout: 30, mediaType: 'video', sessionType: SessionType.Single, platformID: currentPlatform, , ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | invitation | RtcInvite | Yes | Call invitation payload. | | invitation.inviterUserID | string | Yes | User ID of the caller initiating the call. | | invitation.inviteeUserIDList | string | Yes | List containing the recipient user ID for direct calls. | | invitation.groupID | string | Yes | Pass an empty string "" for direct one to one calls. | | invitation.roomID | string | Yes | Unique identifier for this call room. Used in subsequent call operations and events. | | invitation.timeout | number | Yes | Invitation timeout duration in seconds. | | invitation.mediaType | string | Yes | Media stream type, such as 'audio' or 'video' . | | invitation.sessionType | SessionType | Yes | Pass SessionType.Single for direct calls. | | invitation.platformID | Platform | Yes | Platform enum value representing the caller's operating platform. | | invitation.customData | string | No | Optional business extension string attached to the invitation. | | invitation.initiateTime | number | No | Initiation timestamp in Unix milliseconds. Automatically generated if omitted. | | invitation.busyLineUserIDList | string | No | List of users currently on a busy line. Leave empty when initiating. | | offlinePushInfo | OfflinePush | No | Offline push configuration when the recipient is offline. | | offlinePushInfo.title | string | Conditional | Notification title when offlinePushInfo is provided. | | offlinePushInfo.desc | string | Conditional | Notification body text when offlinePushInfo is provided. | | offlinePushInfo.ex | string | Conditional | Custom extra payload string. Pass empty string "" if not needed. | | offlinePushInfo.iOSPushSound | string | Conditional | iOS push sound file identifier. | | offlinePushInfo.iOSBadgeCount | boolean | Conditional | Whether to increment the iOS application badge count. | Return value Resolves to an RtcInviteResults object: | Field | Type | Description | | | | | | roomID | string | Unique identifier of the calling room. | | token | string | Authentication token used by the media engine to enter the room. | | liveURL | string | Endpoint URL of the media server room. | | busyLineUserIDList | string | List of invited users currently occupied on another call. | The recipient receives an invitation notification via the OnReceiveNewInvitation event. Identify the active call session using roomID and combine roomID:userID to manage calling and connected states. For accept, reject, cancel, and hang up flows, see Handle call events /sdk/react native/calling/managing calls/handle call events .

title: Start a group call
description: Initiate a multi-party group audio or video call using the OpenIM React Native SDK.
keywords: sdk react-native v4 sdk react-native calling managing-calls start-group-call
content: Initiate a multi party group audio or video call with selected group members. Supply the target groupID and specify inviteeUserIDList with the user IDs of the invited members; it does not automatically ring all members of the group. const roomCredentials = await OpenIMSDK.signalingInviteInGroup invitation: inviterUserID: currentUserID, inviteeUserIDList: memberUserIDs, groupID, roomID, timeout: 30, mediaType: 'video', sessionType: SessionType.Group, platformID: currentPlatform, , ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | invitation | RtcInvite | Yes | Call invitation payload. | | invitation.inviterUserID | string | Yes | User ID of the caller initiating the call. | | invitation.inviteeUserIDList | string | Yes | List of user IDs of group members to invite. | | invitation.groupID | string | Yes | Target group ID. | | invitation.roomID | string | Yes | Unique room identifier for this group call session. | | invitation.timeout | number | Yes | Invitation timeout duration in seconds. | | invitation.mediaType | string | Yes | Call media type, typically 'audio' or 'video' . | | invitation.sessionType | SessionType | Yes | Pass SessionType.Group for group calls. | | invitation.platformID | Platform | Yes | Platform enum value representing the caller's operating platform. | | invitation.customData | string | No | Optional business extension string attached to the invitation. | | invitation.initiateTime | number | No | Initiation timestamp in Unix milliseconds. Automatically populated by the SDK if omitted. | | invitation.busyLineUserIDList | string | No | List of users currently on a busy line. Leave empty when initiating. | | offlinePushInfo | OfflinePush | No | Offline APNs/FCM push configuration for invitees. | | offlinePushInfo.title | string | Conditional | Notification title when offlinePushInfo is provided. | | offlinePushInfo.desc | string | Conditional | Notification body text when offlinePushInfo is provided. | | offlinePushInfo.ex | string | Conditional | Custom extra payload string. Pass empty string "" if not needed. | | offlinePushInfo.iOSPushSound | string | Conditional | iOS push sound file identifier. | | offlinePushInfo.iOSBadgeCount | boolean | Conditional | Whether to increment the iOS application badge count. | Return value Resolves to an RtcInviteResults object containing roomID , token , liveURL , and an optional busyLineUserIDList . See Start a one to one call /sdk/react native/calling/managing calls/start single call for complete field descriptions. Invited group members receive the invitation via the OnReceiveNewInvitation event. Identify the call session using roomID and combine roomID:userID to manage member calling and connected states. For complete event listeners, see Handle call events /sdk/react native/calling/managing calls/handle call events .

title: Accept a call
description: Accept an incoming audio or video call invitation using the OpenIM React Native SDK.
keywords: sdk react-native v4 sdk react-native calling managing-calls accept-call
content: Upon receiving an incoming call invitation, invoke signalingAccept to accept the invitation and join the RTC room. const roomCredentials = await OpenIMSDK.signalingAccept opUserID: currentUserID, invitation, ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | opUserID | string | Yes | User ID of the participant accepting the invitation. | | invitation | RtcInvite | Yes | Complete call invitation object. Supply the exact object received from the incoming invitation callback rather than constructing it manually. | Return value Resolves to an RtcInviteResults object containing the room credentials: roomID , token , and liveURL . A successful Promise resolution confirms that the signaling request succeeded and room credentials have been issued; it does not indicate that the media pipeline has finished connecting. Other participants receive the OnInviteeAccepted event. Maintain local room state using roomID as the primary key and track participant status using userID . For complete event handling, see Handle call events /sdk/react native/calling/managing calls/handle call events .

title: Reject a call
description: Decline an incoming audio or video call invitation using the OpenIM React Native SDK.
keywords: sdk react-native v4 sdk react-native calling managing-calls reject-call
content: When an incoming call invitation arrives and the user declines to answer, invoke signalingReject to refuse the invitation: await OpenIMSDK.signalingReject opUserID: currentUserID, invitation, ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | opUserID | string | Yes | User ID of the participant rejecting the invitation. | | invitation | RtcInvite | Yes | Complete call invitation object received in the incoming invitation callback. | Return value A resolved Promise confirms that the rejection signaling request has been processed by the server. The caller and other devices receive notification via the OnInviteeRejected event. Reconcile the local room state using roomID and update participant states using userID . For complete event listeners, see Handle call events /sdk/react native/calling/managing calls/handle call events .

title: Cancel a call invitation
description: Cancel a pending audio or video call invitation using the OpenIM React Native SDK.
keywords: sdk react-native v4 sdk react-native calling managing-calls cancel-call
content: The caller can cancel an outgoing call invitation before any invitee connects: await OpenIMSDK.signalingCancel opUserID: currentUserID, invitation, ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | opUserID | string | Yes | User ID of the participant canceling the invitation. | | invitation | RtcInvite | Yes | Complete call invitation object preserved from when the call was initiated. | Return value A resolved Promise confirms that the cancellation request was received and processed by the server. Invited members receive cancellation notifications through the OnInvitationCancelled event. Identify the active call session using roomID to reset the calling UI. For complete event registration, see Handle call events /sdk/react native/calling/managing calls/handle call events .

title: Hang up a call
description: Terminate an active audio or video call and leave the room with the OpenIM React Native SDK.
keywords: sdk react-native v4 sdk react-native calling managing-calls hang-up-call
content: After a call is connected or while it is in progress, invoke signalingHungUp to hang up and exit the call room: await OpenIMSDK.signalingHungUp opUserID: currentUserID, invitation, ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | opUserID | string | Yes | User ID of the participant terminating the call. | | invitation | RtcInvite | Yes | Complete call invitation object for the active call. Its roomID must match the current room. | Return value A resolved Promise confirms that the hang up signaling request has been processed by the server. Other participants receive notification via the OnHangUp event. The client should identify the call room using roomID and release local media engine resources and screen state. For full event handling, see Handle call events /sdk/react native/calling/managing calls/handle call events .

title: Handle call events
description: Listen to RTC call invitations, participant changes, and media stream events with the OpenIM React Native SDK.
keywords: sdk react-native v4 sdk react-native calling managing-calls handle-call-events
content: Calling events notify applications of invitation state changes, participant joins and leaves, and media stream mutations. Invitation events provide room metadata within payload.invitation , while media stream events supply roomID directly. For custom signaling, see Send a custom signal /sdk/react native/calling/sending custom signals/send a custom signal . Event parameters | Event | Payload type | Key fields | | | | | | OnReceiveNewInvitation | OnReceiveNewInvitationPayload | invitation , userID , participant , offlinePushInfo . | | OnInviteeAccepted | OnInviteeAcceptedPayload | invitation , userID , participant , opUserPlatformID . | | OnInviteeRejected | OnInviteeRejectedPayload | invitation , userID , participant , opUserPlatformID . | | OnInvitationCancelled | OnInvitationCancelledPayload | invitation , userID , participant , offlinePushInfo . | | OnInvitationTimeout | OnReceiveNewInvitationPayload | invitation , userID , participant , offlinePushInfo . | | OnInviteeAcceptedByOtherDevice | OnInviteeAcceptedPayload | invitation , userID , participant , opUserPlatformID . | | OnInviteeRejectedByOtherDevice | OnInviteeRejectedPayload | invitation , userID , participant , opUserPlatformID . | | OnHangUp | OnHangUpPayload | invitation , userID , offlinePushInfo . | | OnRoomParticipantConnected | OnRoomParticipantConnectedPayload | invitation , groupID , participant . | | OnRoomParticipantDisconnected | OnRoomParticipantDisconnectedPayload | invitation , groupID , participant . | | OnStreamChange | OnStreamChangePayload | roomID , streamType , mute . | When merging and reconciling call state in local caches or UI stores, always use roomID or invitation.roomID as the primary key for the calling room. For participant statuses inside the room, combine roomID with the user ID participant.userInfo.userID . Code example function handleReceiveNewInvitation payload: OnReceiveNewInvitationPayload // Update state for new incoming call invitation function handleInviteeAccepted payload: OnInviteeAcceptedPayload // Update state when an invitee accepts function handleInviteeRejected payload: OnInviteeRejectedPayload // Update state when an invitee rejects function handleInvitationCancelled payload: OnInvitationCancelledPayload // Clear call state when inviter cancels function handleInvitationTimeout payload: OnReceiveNewInvitationPayload // Handle invitation timeout function handleInviteeAcceptedByOtherDevice payload: OnInviteeAcceptedPayload // Synchronize state when accepted on another device function handleInviteeRejectedByOtherDevice payload: OnInviteeRejectedPayload // Synchronize state when rejected on another device function handleHangUp payload: OnHangUpPayload // Handle call hangup function handleRoomParticipantConnected payload: OnRoomParticipantConnectedPayload // Add participant to the active room function handleRoomParticipantDisconnected payload: OnRoomParticipantDisconnectedPayload // Remove participant from the active room function handleStreamChange payload: OnStreamChangePayload // Update audio/video stream mute status // Register listeners OpenIMSDK.on OpenIMEvent.OnReceiveNewInvitation, handleReceiveNewInvitation ; OpenIMSDK.on OpenIMEvent.OnInviteeAccepted, handleInviteeAccepted ; OpenIMSDK.on OpenIMEvent.OnInviteeRejected, handleInviteeRejected ; OpenIMSDK.on OpenIMEvent.OnInvitationCancelled, handleInvitationCancelled ; OpenIMSDK.on OpenIMEvent.OnInvitationTimeout, handleInvitationTimeout ; OpenIMSDK.on OpenIMEvent.OnInviteeAcceptedByOtherDevice, handleInviteeAcceptedByOtherDevice ; OpenIMSDK.on OpenIMEvent.OnInviteeRejectedByOtherDevice, handleInviteeRejectedByOtherDevice ; OpenIMSDK.on OpenIMEvent.OnHangUp, handleHangUp ; OpenIMSDK.on OpenIMEvent.OnRoomParticipantConnected, handleRoomParticipantConnected ; OpenIMSDK.on OpenIMEvent.OnRoomParticipantDisconnected, handleRoomParticipantDisconnected ; OpenIMSDK.on OpenIMEvent.OnStreamChange, handleStreamChange ; // Unregister listeners OpenIMSDK.off OpenIMEvent.OnReceiveNewInvitation, handleReceiveNewInvitation ; OpenIMSDK.off OpenIMEvent.OnInviteeAccepted, handleInviteeAccepted ; OpenIMSDK.off OpenIMEvent.OnInviteeRejected, handleInviteeRejected ; OpenIMSDK.off OpenIMEvent.OnInvitationCancelled, handleInvitationCancelled ; OpenIMSDK.off OpenIMEvent.OnInvitationTimeout, handleInvitationTimeout ; OpenIMSDK.off OpenIMEvent.OnInviteeAcceptedByOtherDevice, handleInviteeAcceptedByOtherDevice ; OpenIMSDK.off OpenIMEvent.OnInviteeRejectedByOtherDevice, handleInviteeRejectedByOtherDevice ; OpenIMSDK.off OpenIMEvent.OnHangUp, handleHangUp ; OpenIMSDK.off OpenIMEvent.OnRoomParticipantConnected, handleRoomParticipantConnected ; OpenIMSDK.off OpenIMEvent.OnRoomParticipantDisconnected, handleRoomParticipantDisconnected ; OpenIMSDK.off OpenIMEvent.OnStreamChange, handleStreamChange ; Unregister these listeners when the call component unmounts, the user signs out, or accounts switch.

title: Restore a pending call invitation
description: Recover pending incoming call invitations upon app launch or resume with the OpenIM React Native SDK.
keywords: sdk react-native v4 sdk react-native calling retrieving-call-information restore-pending-invitation
content: When the application cold starts or resumes from the background in response to a VoIP notification, retrieve any pending call invitations that remain unhandled: const invitation, offlinePushInfo = await OpenIMSDK.getSignalingInvitationInfoStartApp ; Return value Resolves to an object containing pending invitation data: | Field | Type | Description | | | | | | invitation | RtcInvite or null | The pending call invitation, or null if no active invitation exists. | | offlinePushInfo | OfflinePush | The offline push configuration bundled with the invitation. | When invitation is not null , use the invitation data to render the incoming call screen and identify the room via roomID . Subsequent cancellation, timeout, acceptance, or hang up updates are delivered through events documented in Handle call events /sdk/react native/calling/managing calls/handle call events .

title: Get a group call room
description: Query active audio or video call room information by group ID using the OpenIM React Native SDK.
keywords: sdk react-native v4 sdk react-native calling retrieving-call-information get-room-by-group-id
content: Query active call room metadata and connected participants for a specific group using signalingGetRoomByGroupID : const room = await OpenIMSDK.signalingGetRoomByGroupID groupID ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | groupID | string | Yes | Target group ID. | Return value Resolves to a CallingRoomData object: | Field | Type | Description | | | | | | roomID | string | Calling room identifier. | | invitation | RtcInvite optional | Call invitation metadata corresponding to the room. | | participant | ParticipantInfo optional | Active participants currently in the room. | participant .userInfo provides individual user profiles; group scenarios may also include groupMemberInfo and groupInfo . This query returns a current snapshot of the room and does not dispatch signaling events. For subsequent live state updates, reconcile incoming events using roomID and participant userID as detailed in Handle call events /sdk/react native/calling/managing calls/handle call events .

title: Get room credentials by room ID
description: Retrieve audio or video call room credentials by room ID using the OpenIM React Native SDK.
keywords: sdk react-native v4 sdk react-native calling retrieving-call-information get-token-by-room-id
content: When the calling room ID is already known, query its RTC media access credentials using signalingGetTokenByRoomID : const roomCredentials = await OpenIMSDK.signalingGetTokenByRoomID roomID ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | roomID | string | Yes | Target calling room ID. | Return value Resolves to an RtcInviteResults object containing roomID , token , liveURL , and optional busyLineUserIDList . Pass these room credentials to your real time audio/video media engine to connect to the media session. For detailed field descriptions, see Start a one to one call /sdk/react native/calling/managing calls/start single call .

title: Send a custom signal
description: Broadcast application-defined RTC custom signaling messages to call room participants using the OpenIM React Native SDK.
keywords: sdk react-native v4 sdk react-native calling sending-custom-signals send-a-custom-signal
content: Broadcast application defined signaling data to active participants in a calling room—such as hand raising, custom reactions, or layout mode changes. customInfo accepts a string payload; serialize structured data as a JSON string before dispatching. await OpenIMSDK.signalingSendCustomSignal roomID, customInfo: JSON.stringify type: 'hand raised', , ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | roomID | string | Yes | Target calling room ID. | | customInfo | string | Yes | Application defined signaling content payload. | Return value A resolved Promise confirms that the custom signaling message was processed and forwarded by the server. Receive custom signals When other participants send custom signals, the SDK triggers the OnReceiveCustomSignal event. Its payload is typed as OnReceiveCustomSignalPayload , containing roomID and customInfo . Match the calling room using roomID before deserializing the business payload. function handleCustomSignal payload: OnReceiveCustomSignalPayload if payload.roomID === currentRoomID const data = JSON.parse payload.customInfo ; // Handle application signaling event // Register listener OpenIMSDK.on OpenIMEvent.OnReceiveCustomSignal, handleCustomSignal ; // Remove listener OpenIMSDK.off OpenIMEvent.OnReceiveCustomSignal, handleCustomSignal ; Unregister this listener when the call screen unmounts, the user signs out, or accounts switch.

title: Events overview
description: Understand the OpenIM React Native SDK event model, event categories, and listener lifecycle.
keywords: sdk react-native v4 sdk react-native events overview-events
content: Event model The OpenIM React Native SDK uses OpenIMEvent to define event names and a shared listener interface to report connection state, data changes, and business signaling. Call OpenIMSDK.on to register a listener and OpenIMSDK.off to remove it. Event names can use enum values from OpenIMEvent or the corresponding event strings. When using a string, it must exactly match the event name defined by the SDK. function handleEvent payload: unknown // Update application state from the event payload. // Register listener OpenIMSDK.on OpenIMEvent.OnConversationChanged, handleEvent ; // Or use the event string OpenIMSDK.on "onConversationChanged", handleEvent ; // Remove listener OpenIMSDK.off OpenIMEvent.OnConversationChanged, handleEvent ; // Or use the event string OpenIMSDK.off "onConversationChanged", handleEvent ; The callback parameter for each event is defined by the SDK declaration. It can be an entity, an array, a progress value, or error information. See the corresponding feature page for the exact parameter format and handling example. Event categories React Native SDK events are grouped by business domain: | Event category | Typical events | Description | | | | | | Connection and sign in state | OnConnecting , OnConnectSuccess , OnConnectFailed , OnKickedOffline , OnUserTokenExpired , OnUserTokenInvalid | Connection, connection failure, forced sign out, and token state changes. | | Initial synchronization | OnSyncServerStart , OnSyncServerProgress , OnSyncServerFinish , OnSyncServerFailed | The lifecycle of server data synchronization after sign in. | | Users and online status | OnSelfInfoUpdated , OnUserStatusChanged | Changes to the current user's profile and user online status. | | Friends and blacklist | OnFriendAdded , OnFriendDeleted , OnFriendInfoChanged , OnFriendApplicationAdded , OnBlackAdded | Changes to friend relationships, friend applications, and the blacklist. | | Conversations and unread state | OnNewConversation , OnConversationChanged , OnTotalUnreadMessageCountChanged , OnInputStatusChanged | Conversation list, unread count, and typing state changes. | | Conversation groups | OnConversationGroupAdded , OnConversationGroupChanged , OnConversationGroupDeleted | Conversation groups and their membership changes. | | Groups and members | OnGroupInfoChanged , OnGroupMemberAdded , OnGroupMemberDeleted , OnGroupApplicationAdded , OnJoinedGroupAdded | Group profile, member, application, and joined group changes. | | Messages | OnRecvNewMessage , OnMsgDeleted , OnNewRecvMessageRevoked , OnMessageModified , OnRecvC2CReadReceipt | New messages, deletions, revocations, modifications, and one to one read receipts. | | File uploads | UploadOnProgress , UploadComplete | File upload progress and completion. | | Audio and video calls | OnReceiveNewInvitation , OnInviteeAccepted , OnInvitationCancelled , OnHangUp , OnReceiveCustomSignal | Call invitations, participant state, and call signaling changes. | | Custom business messages | OnRecvCustomBusinessMessage | Custom business messages. | Registration timing and lifecycle The React Native SDK allows global listeners to be registered at any time. It starts delivering connection, synchronization, and business data events after initSDK and sign in; register listeners before the operation whose events you need to receive. The React Native SDK supports multiple listeners for the same event. Every registered listener receives the event, unlike the single listener mechanism in the Flutter and Android SDKs, where a later listener replaces the earlier one. Even though multiple listeners are supported, register and manage callbacks centrally in the application so that rendering or re entering a component does not register the same business handler repeatedly. Keep listener functions in stable references. When logging out, switching accounts, or destroying related state, call off with the same event name and function reference used for registration. Client state reconciliation guidelines When receiving asynchronous events from the SDK, update local application state using these primary identifiers: Conversation : conversationID Conversation group : conversationGroupID Group : groupID Group member : groupID:userID Friend & Blacklist : userID Message : clientMsgID qualified with conversationID when necessary Call : roomID using userID for individual participant states Never use array indexes or display names as reconciliation keys. Treat Promise resolution, incoming push events, and re query reconciliation as three distinct phases in your UI architecture. Connection and initial synchronization events Connection events report the SDK connection state: | Event | Description | | | | | OnConnecting | The SDK starts connecting to the server. | | OnConnectSuccess | The SDK connects successfully. | | OnConnectFailed | The connection fails and error information is provided. | | OnKickedOffline | The current account signs in on another client or is forced offline by the server. | | OnUserTokenExpired | The current login token has expired. | | OnUserTokenInvalid | The current login token is invalid. | After sign in, the SDK reports initial synchronization through these events: | Event | Description | | | | | OnSyncServerStart | Synchronization starts. | | OnSyncServerProgress | The current synchronization progress. | | OnSyncServerFinish | The current synchronization completes. | | OnSyncServerFailed | The current synchronization fails. | After synchronization completes, query the data needed by the current interface again. Later user, friend, conversation, group, message, and call changes are reported by the corresponding business events. Handle events by domain The feature pages below provide complete parameter descriptions and listener examples: | Event scope | Reference pages | | | | | User profile and online status | Update the current user profile /sdk/react native/user/profile/set self info , Subscribe to user online status /sdk/react native/user/online status/subscribe users status | | Friends, friend applications, and blacklist | Get the friend list by page /sdk/react native/user/friends/get friend list page , Get received friend applications /sdk/react native/user/friend applications/get friend application list as recipient , Get the blacklist /sdk/react native/user/blacklist/get black list | | Conversations, unread counts, and conversation groups | Retrieve the conversation list /sdk/react native/conversation/retrieving conversations/retrieve conversation list , Get the total unread count /sdk/react native/conversation/managing conversations/get total unread count , Conversation groups overview /sdk/react native/conversation/managing conversation groups/overview conversation groups | | Groups, members, and applications | Group overview /sdk/react native/group/overview group , Get received group applications /sdk/react native/group/group applications/get group application list as recipient , Get the group member list by page /sdk/react native/group/retrieving group members/get group member list | | Messages and message status | Receive messages /sdk/react native/message/receiving messages/receive messages , Receive custom business messages /sdk/react native/message/receiving messages/receive custom business messages , Delete saved messages in a batch /sdk/react native/message/managing messages/delete saved messages , Revoke a message /sdk/react native/message/managing messages/revoke a message , Modify a message /sdk/react native/message/managing messages/modify a message , Send group read receipts /sdk/react native/message/managing read status/send group read receipts | | File uploads | Upload a file /sdk/react native/file uploads/upload file | | Audio and video calls and custom signaling | Handle call events /sdk/react native/calling/managing calls/handle call events , Send a custom signal /sdk/react native/calling/sending custom signals/send a custom signal |

title: Logging
description: Configure OpenIM React Native SDK logging, write diagnostic information, and upload logs to the server.
keywords: sdk react-native v4 sdk react-native logger
content: OpenIM React Native SDK logs help troubleshoot initialization, connection, and business API issues. Development and staging environments can use verbose logs. Production applications should lower the log level and avoid recording tokens, full message content, raw file URLs, call room credentials, or sensitive user fields. Configure logging during initialization Configure logging options when invoking the SDK initialization method. For complete details on server endpoints, storage paths, and the sign in workflow, see Authenticate and manage a session /sdk/react native/getting started/authenticate and manage session . await OpenIMSDK.initSDK apiAddr, wsAddr, dataDir, logFilePath, logLevel: LogLevel.Debug, isLogStandardOutput: true, ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | logFilePath | string | Yes | Local directory for SDK log files, located within the application's writable sandbox. | | logLevel | LogLevel | No | Log output verbosity level: Debug , Info , Warn , Error , Fatal , or Panic . | | isLogStandardOutput | boolean | No | Whether to print underlying SDK logs to the system console. Recommended during development. | Use LogLevel.Debug in development and testing environments. Set logLevel to LogLevel.Warn or LogLevel.Error in production, and disable standard console output to optimize performance. Write application logs Append application level diagnostic information directly to the SDK logging pipeline to facilitate unified log extraction and troubleshooting: await OpenIMSDK.logs logLevel: LogLevel.Error, file: 'chatRepository.ts', line: 184, msgs: 'send message failed', err: error.message, keyAndValue: 'conversationID', conversationID, 'clientMsgID', clientMsgID, , ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | logLevel | number | Yes | Log level for this specific entry. | | file | string | Yes | Source file name or module name where the log originated. | | line | number | Yes | Line number in the source file. | | msgs | string | Yes | Brief description of the business action or diagnosis. | | err | string | Yes | Error message string. Pass an empty string "" if no error occurred. | | keyAndValue | string | No | Additional diagnostic key value pairs passed as paired entries: key1, val1, key2, val2 . | Use keyAndValue only for necessary troubleshooting identifiers such as conversationID , clientMsgID , or groupID . Never record sensitive credentials such as tokens or plaintext passwords. Upload logs When a user encounters an issue or triggers an in app "Report Log" diagnostic action, call this method to package client logs and upload them to the server: await OpenIMSDK.uploadLogs line: 2000, cancelID: 'support ticket 42', ex: 'user initiated diagnostics', ; Parameters | Parameter | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | line | number | Yes | Maximum number of log lines to extract for this upload. | | cancelID | string | No | Unique identifier for the upload task, used to cancel the upload if needed. | | ex | string | No | Additional business diagnostic notes. Do not include sensitive data. | Return value A successful Promise resolution indicates that the log upload task was submitted and processed by the server. Prior to uploading, inform the user about the scope of data collected and ensure compliance with relevant privacy regulations.

title: Authenticate and initialize
description: Use the Electron FFI initSDK, login, and unInitSDK methods to establish a session, and understand how their parameters differ from WASM login.
keywords: sdk electron v4 sdk electron getting-started authenticate-and-init
content: The Electron FFI SDK separates SDK initialization from user authentication. First call initSDK to configure the OpenIMServer addresses and local runtime directory, then call login with the userID and token. This differs from WASM authentication and session management /sdk/wasm/getting started/authenticate and manage session , where a single InitAndLoginConfig is passed to login . This page covers only the Electron FFI lifecycle APIs. Use the WASM authentication page as a reference for the handling boundaries around connection success, token expiration, and forced sign out. Electron FFI uses its own exported event enum. Differences from WASM | Step | Electron FFI | WASM | | | | | | Configure server addresses and runtime | initSDK InitConfig | Included in login InitAndLoginConfig | | Submit user credentials | login userID, token | Included in the same login call | | Release the native SDK | unInitSDK | No equivalent public unload API; use logout to end the session | If the Electron renderer uses the WASM package, follow the WASM authentication page directly and do not call the initSDK described here. Initialize the SDK At initialization, InitConfig supplies server addresses, platform information, a local data directory, and logging options. Parameters | Field | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | apiAddr | string | Yes | OpenIMServer HTTP API address. | | wsAddr | string | Yes | OpenIMServer WebSocket address. | | platformID | number | Yes | Current client platform value. It must conform to the OpenIMServer multi device login policy. | | dataDir | string | Yes | Writable absolute path for the native SDK's local data. | | systemType | string | Yes | System type identifier required by the Electron FFI SDK. | | logLevel | LogLevel | No | Logging level. | | logFilePath | string | No | Log file path. | | isLogStandardOutput | boolean | No | Whether to write logs to standard output. | await openimsdk.initSDK apiAddr, wsAddr, platformID, dataDir: '/absolute/path/to/openim data', systemType: 'electron', logLevel: LogLevel.Warn, isLogStandardOutput: false, ; A successful initSDK Promise indicates that the native runtime is configured and ready for authentication; at this stage, the WebSocket connection and user session are not yet established. Log in the current user Call login after initSDK succeeds. FFI login accepts only the user's credentials: Parameters | Field | Type | Required | Description | | | | | | | userID | string | Yes | Current OpenIMSDK user ID. Must strictly match the token subject. | | token | string | Yes | OpenIMSDK authentication token returned by your application backend. | await openimsdk.login userID, token, ; A successful login Promise confirms that the credentials were submitted and validated. The persistent WebSocket connection is fully established upon receiving the OnConnectSuccess event, after which normal chat and conversation operations can proceed. See Authenticate and manage a session /sdk/wasm/getting started/authenticate and manage session for complete event listener registration. Log out and uninitialize When the user signs out or switches accounts, first call the shared logout method to end the session. Call unInitSDK afterward when the native resources must be released. await openimsdk.logout ; await openimsdk.unInitSDK ; unInitSDK takes no business parameters. When switching accounts, finish signing out the old account and clear its state before calling initSDK and login again when necessary. Do not initialize two native instances concurrently.
